Fang Wang feigned hesitation before replying, "I trained for seven days."
"Good! Good! Very good!"
Fang Meng was overwhelmed with excitement, trembling all over. He even wanted to stand and hug Fang Wang, who quickly walked over and took his hands.
"The Fang Family has successors, we can break the curse of doom!"
Fang Meng cried tears of joy, tears streaming down his face, causing Fang Wang to panic. This was the first time he had seen his grandfather cry.
Afterward, Fang Meng began to recount past events.
As a founding hero of the Grand Qi Dynasty, Fang Meng naturally knew more than the common people, including knowledge about the Cultivation World. However, to Fang Meng, Cultivators were still an elusive concept. He did not know much about them, just that they existed.
He urged Fang Wang to cultivate diligently.
He even considered betrothing Zhou Xue to Fang Wang, to ensure a more stable path to cultivation, but Fang Wang tactfully declined.
What a joke, Zhou Xue was a reincarnated person, and moreover, a Demonic Cultivator. Such a woman certainly would not prioritize love. If she decided to cut emotional ties for the sake of longevity, wouldn't that be troublesome?
Moreover, having lived another life, Fang Wang did not want to be committed to anyone. He yearned only for unbounded freedom and leisure.
Before encountering Cultivators, he had planned to wander to the ends of the earth!
Now, after discovering the path of cultivation, this desire grew even stronger. In this life, he wanted to traverse mountains and rivers, witness the world's splendor, and seek the law of Immortal longevity, never slowing down for anyone.
That night, the grandfather and grandson talked for a long time.
...
The next day at noon, while the Fang Residence was immersed in grief, Southern Hills City was engulfed in turmoil. The attack on Fang Residence had resulted in many deaths, and the commoners under the Fang Family's protection were naturally afraid. There were also many people gossiping about the incident.
Fang Wang went out to visit Zhou Xue.
The two maids guarding the door immediately bowed upon seeing him. One of them said, "Young Master, the young lady has instructed that if you arrive, you may go straight in."
The night before, the battle between Fang Wang and the demonic cultivator to save the Fang Residence had already spread throughout the household. The relationship between the two in the eyes of the people of Fang Residence had also changed. The two maids had heard last night that the Fourth Young Master intended to match-make the two of them.
Fang Wang nodded, then pushed the door open, closed it behind him, and sat down beside Zhou Xue's bed.
At this moment, Zhou Xue lay in bed, her complexion pale and her body wrapped in white cloth in many places, looking very seriously injured. Hearing footsteps, she opened her eyes and looked toward Fang Wang.
Fang Wang, however, did not greet her; after all, this person was a reborn individual, not truly a sixteen-year-old girl.
"Is it possible to take the Fang Family disciples along on the path to immortality? We have offended the imperial power, and even if we cause a big commotion, there will come a day when we are forgotten, but then will the threat of death return?" Fang Wang asked. This was also Fang Meng's hope.
Zhou Xue withdrew her gaze, slowly closed her eyes, and said softly, "The threshold for cultivation is extremely high; not everyone who wishes to cultivate can do so, but I indeed have such plans. This month, I will select disciples with potential to join us on our journey to cultivate."
Fang Wang asked curiously, "Where are we going? Could you tell me about the path of cultivation, for example, the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure you mentioned last night?"
"In the Cultivation World of the Grand Qi, there are Nine Great Sects, hidden in deep mountains and wondrous lands. We are headed for the Great Abyss Gate, a sect that ranks within the top five of the Nine Great Sects, with profound heritage. I have a way to get you into the sect."
Zhou Xue spoke at length, giving a general introduction to the Great Abyss Gate, creating a great sense of anticipation in Fang Wang for this Cultivation Sect.
Once he joined the Great Abyss Gate, he would find a way to practice the most profound Cultivation Techniques and Spells. With the Heavenly Palace in his mind, he was certain to surpass his fellow cultivators from the same period.
As for Zhou Xue, the reborn individual, he would try his best to keep up with her increase in strength, and if he could surpass her, that would be even better!
"As for the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, first we must speak of the realms of cultivation. Above Qi Cultivation Realm is the Soul Sculpting Realm. Only by shaping one's own Lifespirit Treasure can one enter the Spiritual Refinement Realm. The Lifespirit Treasure is hidden within a cultivator's body, and its rank often determines the cultivator's aptitude.
The ranks of Lifespirit Treasures from low to high are Yellow Origin, Mysterious Origin, Earth Origin, and Heavenly Origin, each with their sub-divisions. I'll tell you more about this later," Zhou Xue said.
At this point, she couldn't help but open her eyes and look at Fang Wang, her eyes filled with anticipation.
Lifespirit Treasure...
Fang Wang began to fantasize about what rank his Lifespirit Treasure might reach.
After chatting for a while, Fang Wang appropriately voiced his request, "By the way, could you teach me a Cultivation Technique so that I can develop Spiritual Power during the month while you heal? That way, once we join the Great Abyss Gate, I won't embarrass you."
The perfected Sword Control Technique easily killed the Qingyi Daoist. How strong would it be if he used Spiritual Power?
Zhou Xue thought for a moment and said, "Fine, this will give me a chance to see your comprehension. I will pass on the basic Qi Gathering Method to you."
"Wait, could you pass on to me some more profound Cultivation Laws…" Fang Wang asked tentatively.
Basic Qi Gathering Method?
That's too shabby!
Zhou Xue frowned at him. She intended to educate him but then she recalled the Sword Control Technique that Fang Wang used the night before, and other thoughts crossed her mind.
Fang Wang's Sword Control Technique had already surpassed the level of Qi Cultivation Realm cultivators. His talent was unquestionable, making him worthy of her special cultivation.
"Well, considering you saved me, I'll pass on a Cultivation Technique to you. Although I have many techniques, I can only give you three choices. The first is the Spring Autumn Art, a unique technique from ancient times. Its creator was the foremost cultivator of the Grand Qi a thousand years ago. It can extend lifespan and pursue immortality.
When cultivated to Great Completion, living for three thousand years is not difficult. The second is the Devouring Heaven Demonic Art, which I found in some ancient secret realm. It was my first cultivation practice. It can absorb others' Spiritual Power, but practicing it will reduce one's lifespan and easily give rise to Heart Demons.
It's a thorny road to cultivation, but with my guidance, you can achieve twice the results with half the effort," she explained.
"The third is the Solaris Scripture, the most profound technique I have obtained in the Mortal Realm. Before my ascension, I did not manage to complete it. I do not know just how powerful the Solaris Scripture truly is, but because of it, I almost died in a dangerous land even though I was already in the Mahayana Realm."
After finishing, Zhou Xue smiled at Fang Wang, curious to see what he would choose.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 7: Solaris Scripture Nine Layers of Great Perfection
chapters.content:
"Can I learn them all?"
Fang Wang made his choice, causing Zhou Xue's mouth to twitch slightly, unable to help rolling her eyes.
Too arrogant!
Zhou Xue explained with some patience, "Different cultivation techniques cultivate different kinds of Spiritual Power. Learning a mishmash of them can easily lead to chaotic Spiritual Power. Moreover, specializing in one technique is easier than practicing several."
Fang Wang, unabashed, asked, "If I choose one and can't learn it, can I switch to another?"
"Fine, you did save me after all."
Zhou Xue couldn't help but chuckle softly, a laugh that aggravated her injuries, prompting a fit of coughing.
Fang Wang couldn't bring himself to touch her, so he could only watch from the sidelines.
"Which one do you want to learn first?" Zhou Xue asked, her voice weaker after coughing.
After some thought, Fang Wang said, "Then let's try the most difficult one, the Solaris Scripture. If I start with the hardest one, other techniques will seem easier later on."
Zhou Xue didn't waste words and began to relay the mental method and incantations of the Solaris Scripture, including the Qi Gathering Method.
Fang Wang listened intently, filled with anticipation. Only by mastering a cultivation technique would he truly step onto the path of cultivation.
As Zhou Xue imparted the technique, she observed him with a sense of poignancy in her heart.
"I never thought I'd treat someone this way. Is this what family feels like? Ruo Lan, you were right. Relying on others is useless. One must cultivate a trustworthy force. Perhaps my rebirth is a sign from the heavens, guiding me to embark on a different path."
Watching Fang Wang, who bore no recollection from her previous life, seriously listening to her teachings, Zhou Xue truly felt reborn.
Since she had the chance to live again, she aimed not just to become an Immortal!
A myriad of thoughts arose in Zhou Xue's mind. The crisis of the Fang Residence's destruction had passed, and now she needed to plan for a new life.
Unaware of her thoughts, Fang Wang was wholly focused on the Solaris Scripture.
Once Zhou Xue finished explaining the entire Solaris Scripture, Fang Wang felt his mind explode, his vision blurring.
The next second, he found himself within the Heavenly Palace. When he opened his eyes and clearly saw his surroundings, he immediately punched the air, lifting his arms and shouting triumphantly.
"I did it!"
Overcome with excitement, Fang Wang knew that being able to enter the Heavenly Palace meant he could cultivate the Solaris Scripture!
While the Heavenly Palace could only aid him in comprehending supreme techniques, if he could bring the Solaris Scripture to Great Perfection and then practice Qi Gathering, his efforts would be much more effective.
This was a technique that even Zhou Xue couldn't master before her ascension!
Right there, Fang Wang sat down cross-legged and began to cultivate the Solaris Scripture.
The Solaris Scripture had nine levels. Reaching the third level, one's Spiritual Power would contain the Solaris Flame, capable of incinerating the soul. At the sixth level, one would be invulnerable to all flames. At the ninth level, one could condense Solaris True Fire, incinerating everything!
Fang Wang started with the most basic Qi Gathering Method. The Heavenly Palace began to change, producing natural spiritual energy needed by cultivators, which was illusory and meant to aid his practice. This so-called natural spiritual energy, born from nature, nurtures all beings.
However, there are many types of energy in the world, and Qi Gathering for cultivation involves extracting and refining nature's spiritual energy.
However, just to cultivate the first layer of the Solaris Scripture, Fang Wang felt as if ten years had passed. Ten years just to master the first layer?
Could my talent for cultivation be so poor?
Fang Wang refused to be discouraged and continued his practice. To verify the time of his cultivation, he willed a large clock to appear within the Heavenly Palace, much like a modern device from Earth but with an ancient appearance and a base recording years, to keep track of time.
Yet, the time taken to cultivate the second layer was twice that of the first. Fang Wang had no choice but to put aside his concerns about his talent and concentrate on his practice.
And so, Fang Wang continued to cultivate the Solaris Scripture, gradually becoming numb, forgetting everything outside.
As if years flowed by and stars shifted.
By the time he brought the Solaris Scripture to Great Perfection, flames spontaneously ignited behind his head, condensing into orbs of fire that resembled miniature suns, creating a halo of these suns behind him, the very essence of Solaris True Fire.
Solaris True Fire may appear similar to ordinary flames, but it can absorb sunlight. The longer it burns during daylight, the more terrifying its power becomes.
Fang Wang opened his eyes, his gaze now seasoned. This was not the world-weariness from traversing Hong Chen, but a tiredness that stemmed from within.
He turned and saw that he had spent a total of two hundred thirteen years cultivating the Solaris Scripture!
This was nearly as long as the lifespan of an entire dynasty!
Fang Wang was downcast and could only blame the difficulty of the Solaris Scripture.
Well, better to blame the goal than to worry about oneself.
No wonder Zhou Xue couldn't master it before her ascension; who could spend two hundred years practicing a single technique?
Collecting himself, Fang Wang willed himself out of the Heavenly Palace.
His gaze cleared, and Zhou Xue's face appeared before him. She lay in bed, looking frail.
He had experienced centuries, but in reality, only a moment had passed.
"This month, you focus on cultivating the Solaris Scripture. Once my injury is healed, we'll set off. The Great Abyss Gate recruits disciples once every five years, and if we miss it this year, we'll have to wait another five," Zhou Xue said softly, a strange look in her eyes.
For some reason, after finishing her explanation of the Solaris Scripture, she felt that Fang Wang had changed. She couldn't put her finger on it, but the feeling was subtle.
"Being an Immortal Venerable reborn, why not create your own sect?" Fang Wang asked, puzzled.
Zhou Xue smiled helplessly, "Cultivation isn't that simple. The Blessed Lands of Grotto-Heaven and various resources in Grand Qi have long been divided by the Nine Great Sects. Moreover, after my rebirth, I must walk the path of cultivation once again. By joining a sect, I can not only obtain resources for cultivation but also ensure my protection."
Fang Wang nodded, seeing her complexion grow paler, then said, "You focus on recovering. We can talk more after you're better."
After speaking, he stood up, ready to leave.
"Oh yes, last night that cultivator left behind two Magic Artifacts. Since he was killed by you, they rightfully belong to you. Once my wounds are healed, I'll give them to you and teach you how to control them, to start your cultivation journey on a higher level than others," Zhou Xue mentioned.
Fang Wang didn't turn around but simply raised his hand, saying, "Keep them for yourself. You introduced me to the path of cultivation, so consider this a token of thanks. In the future, just teach me some more spells."
Without pausing, he quickly left the room.
After the door closed, Zhou Xue's face broke into a smile, and she muttered to herself, "Taking him as a disciple is not a bad idea, after all. Oh well, since we are one family, there's no need to be stubborn about formalities."
Having been reborn, she had decided that it was not enough for her to cultivate alone – she intended to lead the Fang Residence in cultivation too. The betrayal she had experienced in her previous life made her realize that no matter how powerful one was, without a trustworthy force, one could still end up dead and dissolved into nothingness.
Putting aside the nurturing kindness the Fang Residence had shown her, with a genius like Fang Wang, it was worth her effort to cultivate him.
Zhou Xue closed her eyes, taking the time to heal her injuries and intending to sort out her thoughts.
She had realized that being reborn was not as simple as changing her regrets; she could also take a path stronger than she had in her past life. Those missed opportunities in her memory could be hers with careful planning!
Moreover, she couldn't let the secret of her rebirth slip—this would be her greatest secret.
Before her rebirth, even in the Upper Realm, she had never heard of a rebirth experience as bizarre as hers. Putting herself in others' shoes, if she really believed someone had been reborn, she would probably scheme against them.
...
Back in his room, Fang Wang sat cross-legged next to a table, cultivating the Solaris Scripture and absorbing nature's spiritual energy.
Without any obstacles, nor needing any adaptation, it was almost instant: a whirlpool formed around him, and the colorless, invisible spiritual energy poured into his body, leaving him feeling refreshed and clear-headed.
He had felt this way while cultivating in the Heavenly Palace, but it was nowhere as intense as it was in the flesh.
He was so caught up in the exhilarating sensation of the Qi Gathering that he couldn't extricate himself.
The strength of the Solaris Scripture at the Ninth Level of Great Perfection was astounding. Fang Wang had no clue about the pace of cultivation for others, but as for himself, he was thoroughly enjoying it, having already gathered Solaris Spiritual Power within his Dantian.
An hour later, he successfully stepped into the first level of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
After one day and one night, he forcefully achieved the second level of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
In the days that followed, Fang Wang did not leave his house and focused solely on Qi Gathering. At first, his parents came to visit, but when they heard he was cultivating, they dared not disturb him and only had a maid deliver meals every day.
Following that night's great battle, Fang Wang's status within the Fang Residence soared dramatically, turning him into the pride of the entire household. Yet the matter of cultivation was not spread; Fang Meng even ordered a ban on talking about the existence of demonic cultivators, only telling that the Fang Residence had been attacked by a group of mysterious martial arts experts.
...
In a quiet study.
The Emperor of Grand Qi was seated, holding an ancient book. He appeared to be in his early twenties and was very young.
An elderly official entered, walked up to the desk, and bowed deeply.
"Your Majesty, the Southern Hills plan has failed, and the Immortal Master requested by your servant has died," the minister said softly. He was dressed in official robes, slightly portly, with graying temples, and his complexion didn't change as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, the Emperor's right hand, which held the book, trembled. He slowly put the book down, staring emotionlessly at the official, and said, "Didn't you claim it was foolproof?"
The official sighed, "To kill an Immortal Master means the Fang Residence must have such a force hidden or that there is such a force protecting them. I indeed miscalculated, thinking it was foolproof. However, it's not an issue. I've already written to that person. Before this matter occurred, he assured me there would be no complications. Presumably, he will resolve this himself."
The Emperor of Grand Qi turned to look outside the window, murmuring to himself, "The power of cultivation, immortality... I wish to step through this gate. With so many sacrifices, I still haven't succeeded. What is the Fang Residence relying on to have the support of cultivation power?"
The official did not answer; he, too, was at a loss and didn't even dare to investigate the Fang Residence, fearing he might startle the snake in the grass.
After a long while.
The Emperor of Grand Qi withdrew his gaze, stared at the official, and said, "Let's leave it at that for now. I shouldn't know about this—take care of the matter cleanly."
The official nodded.
The Emperor waved his sleeve, and the official respectfully bowed before taking his leave.
"Everyone says it's good to have imperial power, but how can the greatest authority compare with immortality?"
The Emperor's deep sigh filled the study, his tone laced with helplessness.
...
After half a month in seclusion, news of the Fang Residence's slaughter spread throughout Grand Qi. All the states and counties were talking about it, and the Fang Residence even sent people into the Imperial City to proclaim their innocence, which sent chills down the spines of all the influential families.
After all, the Fang Residence was the Duke's Mansion—who was bold enough to assault them like this?
That day.
Zhou Xue came to visit Fang Wang, who stood up to greet her. The two sat down at a table, and Fang Wang poured tea for her.
"You've recovered from your injuries far too quickly..."
Fang Wang inwardly marveled; Zhou Xue's injuries had been so severe that ordinary medical treatment would have required half a year to heal.
Zhou Xue had regained her striking presence, still in a bright red outfit that was dazzling to behold. Compared to half a month ago, her demeanor had become even more outstanding, her eyes sharp and piercing. She sized up Fang Wang and asked, "How goes your practice of the Solaris Scripture?"
Fang Wang thought to himself that it was quite good, reaching the Ninth Level of Great Perfection.
However, facing Zhou Xue, a reborn individual, he didn't dare reveal everything, especially since she was also a Demonic Cultivator. The two had fought side by side before, but only because the crisis facing the Fang Residence was so imminent that there had been no time for either side to guard against the other.
"Not bad, I feel like I can continue practicing," Fang Wang responded. After cultivating the Solaris Scripture, he had no immediate plans to practice techniques like the Spring Autumn Art or the Devouring Heaven Demonic Art.
The Solaris Scripture was too powerful; just half a month of cultivation had revolutionized his very being, propelling his cultivation realm to the sixth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
Moreover...
Spending a century in the Heavenly Palace was torture; only he knew just how dull and torturous it was.
Zhou Xue stared at him, her gaze enigmatic.
Fang Wang felt a jolt in his heart under her look; could it be that she had noticed something?
Zhou Xue looked away and spoke softly, "We will set out in thirteen days. I've made some choices, and together with you and me, there will be nine Fang Family Disciples heading to the Great Abyss Gate."
Fang Wang nodded, his eyes brimming with anticipation.
Merely mastering cultivation techniques wasn't enough; he wanted to learn powerful spells!
"Ahem, Zhou Xue, could you teach me a spell?" Fang Wang coughed deliberately, brazenly asking.
Zhou Xue looked at him with an amused and smiling gaze and replied, "Sure, you're so skilled with your Sword Control Technique that you must be talented in the Sword Dao. I have a set of sword techniques; if you master them, you'll be able to sweep through peers of the same realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 10 - 8 Cultivation Dynasty
chapters.content:
"Really? Then I must learn!"
Fang Wang's eyes lit up, and he quickly responded. Swordsmanship was his strongest skill, principally because he harbored a dream of wandering the world with his sword, and swords were especially suited to cultivators.
Take the Sword Control Technique as Zhou Xue mentioned; every cultivator learns it, which shows the universality of the sword in the path of cultivation.
Zhou Xue wasted no time and began to teach the sword techniques, with Fang Wang listening intently.
Some time passed.
After Zhou Xue finished, she stared at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang, however, furrowed his brows. He hesitated briefly and said, "There's something off about this sword technique. Although I've never practiced the cultivation sword techniques, all methods share commonalities, let alone all being part of the Sword Dao. I feel that following the method you described to practice these techniques, it won't work."
He hadn't even entered the Heavenly Palace, enough to prove that the sword technique was a fake!
Upon hearing this, Zhou Xue didn't get angry. Instead, admiration appeared in her eyes. She lauded, "Impressive. I can now confirm that, apart from your talent, your comprehension is exceptionally high. No wonder you were able to reach that level with the Sword Control Technique within seven days."
"Since you've already achieved the sixth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm, you should continue your practice. Spells aren't a priority right now. Once you enter Great Abyss Gate, you'll have to engage in arduous cultivation for the first couple of years, focusing primarily on your cultivation realm.
The last three levels of the Qi Cultivation Realm are significantly harder than the first six, especially the breakthrough from the ninth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm to the Soul Sculpting Realm. The hardships involved are beyond what you can currently imagine. If you can achieve Spiritual Refinement within five years, then you can choose any spell from Great Abyss Gate."
When Zhou Xue pinpointed Fang Wang's realm, he wasn't surprised. After all, he was the reincarnation of an Immortal Venerable, so it was normal to discern his cultivation level.
Feigning frustration, Fang Wang said, "If I hadn't seen through it, wouldn't I have practiced this sword technique in vain?"
Zhou Xue shook her head slightly and said, "I was just testing you. Your talent and comprehension are indeed extraordinary, but you are still a mortal. Mortals have a limited lifespan. Remember, cultivation is of the utmost importance. Don't rely too much on your strong comprehension and spend most of your time dabbling in minor techniques."
Hearing this, Fang Wang had no choice but to let it go.
He wasn't too disappointed. After all, the Solaris Scripture inherently possessed the Solaris True Fire, which, if applied to his Sword Control Technique and the martial arts he had mastered, was equivalent to the power of spells.
After giving a few more admonitions, Zhou Xue got up and left.
Watching her leave, Fang Wang suddenly became very curious about her cultivation level.
Intuition told him that Zhou Xue had already embarked on the path of cultivation and that her cultivation level was not weak. It seemed that she possessed some method of concealing her presence, rendering him unable to see through it.
As soon as Zhou Xue closed the door, Fang Wang stopped pondering and continued his practice.
Practicing was addictive, especially when effort led to results.
...
Beneath the blue sky, amidst the green mountains, three horse-drawn carriages were making their way forward. Dwarfed by the majestic mountains, they seemed insignificant, indistinguishable from pebbles in the eyes of eagles soaring above.
Fang Wang leaned against the carriage door, holding the reins in his hand, enjoying the scenic beauty along the way.
Thirteen days had not been enough for him to break through to the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm, but his Spiritual Power had increased significantly.
Recalling the reluctance of his parents when they parted, Fang Wang felt a tinge of emotion, yet he was more excited. Not that he was cold-hearted, but he had memories of his past life. Although he was fond of his current life's Fang Residence, he did not feel an inseparable attachment to it.
He had long wished to venture out. However, in this ancient-like world where bandits often roamed outside the cities, he had never left Southern Hills City from childhood to adulthood, so everything on the journey was novel to him.
Zhou Xue emerged from the carriage and sat beside him to enjoy the landscape together.
"How big is this world, and how much of it does Grand Qi occupy?" Fang Wang suddenly asked.
Looking into the distance, Zhou Xue answered, "It's vast, very vast. Grand Qi is just a grain of sand in the Canghai. I heard from a senior that beyond Grand Qi, there even exist dynasties where everyone practices cultivation."
To keep the matter of his rebirth concealed and to establish Zhou Xue's authority, all members of the Fang Family knew that she was guided by some senior cultivator.
"Everyone practicing cultivation? How powerful that must be!" Fang Wang's eyes sparkled with longing.
Zhou Xue chuckled softly and said, "Perhaps Grand Qi will also transform into a Cultivation Dynasty in the future."
Perhaps?
Then, it must be true!
Since there were others in the carriage, Zhou Xue dared not reveal her full knowledge and could only speculate, a point Fang Wang clearly understood.
The Qi Dynasty could transform from a mortal dynasty to a Cultivation Dynasty. No wonder Zhou Xue was willing to support the Fang Residence. Could it be she wanted to establish a foothold in the future Qi Dynasty?
Fang Wang mused silently. Zhou Xue might have another agenda, but he didn't oppose it. After all, it was easy for an Immortal Venerable to support a power. Zhou Xue had not let down the care shown by the Fourth Elder Fang Zhen, showing that she still had some kindness in her heart, at least not the Demonic Cultivator he had imagined.
He was always curious about why Zhou Xue had been reborn. Surely, she couldn't have been reborn suddenly while meditating?
The two of them continued their casual conversation as the sun gradually set.
At dusk, they stopped by a river on the mountain road to rest. Fang Family disciples began to gather firewood to start a fire, and Fang Wang found a place to sit down. He did not need to do such menial tasks, as his duty was to protect his fellow clan members.
Along with Fang Wang and Zhou Xue, there were nine people in total. Among them was Fang Hanyu, who at a young age had achieved the skills of a first-rate expert. All three of them did not need to gather firewood, leaving that to the other six.
Fang Hanyu sat not far away, glancing at Fang Wang from time to time, seemingly hesitating about something.
After struggling for a while, Fang Hanyu gritted his teeth, stood up, and approached Fang Wang.
Fang Wang opened his eyes, looked at him, and smiled, "Han Yu, what's the matter?"
Although Fang Hanyu was two years older than him, Fang Wang had the mind of an adult as soon as he was born, so he would address his peers by their names throughout his childhood, and Fang Hanyu had grown accustomed to it.
After that night, neither of them had the chance to talk. Even after leaving Southern Hills City for three days, Fang Hanyu and Fang Wang merely nodded to each other, never having a conversation.
"Fang Wang, Zhou Xue taught us the basic Qi Gathering Method. After half a month of training, I have barely managed to cultivate some Spiritual Power. Could you teach me the Sword Control Technique? I don't want to bother Zhou Xue..." said Fang Hanyu awkwardly, his gaze flitting away, not daring to look at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang couldn't help but chuckle, stood up, and laughed, "Sure, Han Yu, I have been waiting for you to come to me for a long time. I thought you had forgotten about me. When we were kids, if I told you to lie down, you would lie down. Now that you have grown up, you seem so aloof."
Aloof?
Fang Hanyu couldn't help but smile. He had always been used to Fang Wang using some odd and interesting vocabulary, and he could roughly understand the meaning. With a slightly red face and a hint of embarrassment, he said, "After all, it's been many years since we have seen each other, let's not mention childhood.
Like the time you told me to lie down and pretend to be a dog searching for meat buns, that I still remember!"
The two brothers became comfortable with each other and started reminiscing about their childhood.
After a while, seeing that Fang Hanyu had completely relaxed, Fang Wang began to teach the Sword Control Technique.
It is worth mentioning that since they set out, Zhou Xue would spend every night alone in the woods, away from everyone else. Knowing she was reborn, Fang Wang was not worried about her safety.
That's why Zhou Xue was so distant from the other Fang Family Disciples, and it was one of the reasons why Fang Hanyu sought out Fang Wang to train in the Sword Control Technique.
From that night on, Fang Wang tutored Fang Hanyu in the Sword Control Technique every night. It must be said, the lad truly was a genius. In just three days, he was able to make a wooden sword float.
This was no ordinary wooden sword but a special Peach Wood Sword made by the Qingyi Daoist, which could be manipulated by Spiritual Power. Zhou Xue had collected all the Qingyi Daoist's belongings, and upon hearing that Fang Wang was teaching Fang Hanyu the Sword Control Technique, she lent the wooden sword to Fang Hanyu.
"Brother Han Yu is really amazing!"
"I haven't even managed to cultivate Spiritual Power yet, sigh, the difference is huge."
"Hahaha, Han Yu was always a genius, remember what Zhou Xue said? Having a sliver of Spiritual Power within half a year qualifies one to cultivate."
"The more powerful Han Yu is, the more confident we will be when we reach Great Abyss Gate. We'll be able to look out for each other."
Surrounded by his clansmen, Fang Hanyu, who was usually stern, showed a rare smile. He wasn't being smug but was excited about his own achievements. His gaze shifted towards Fang Wang, who was standing on the shore of the lake.
In the early morning, Fang Wang and Zhou Xue stood by the lake, looking at them from afar. The mist on the lake made the landscape seem like a place out of the Mortal Realm and the two standing together appeared as a match made in heaven, ready to ascend to immortality at any moment.
"Fang Hanyu's aptitude is indeed impressive; it's quite a surprise," Zhou Xue commented. In her eyes, these Fang Family Disciples were not her peers. She viewed them more like her descendants, considering she had lived through two lifetimes, making her older than even the longest historical records of the Grand Qi.
Hearing this, Fang Wang looked at Fang Hanyu and thought to himself that in their original fate, Fang Hanyu would die on the night the Fang Residence was destroyed.
Smiling at this thought, Fang Wang was happy for Fang Hanyu.
"How many days' journey is it from Great Abyss Gate?" Fang Wang asked.
He was already capable of flying with a sword, but among his traveling companions were seven other family members, including two young girls who found even half a day's walk tiring, so they had no choice but to travel by horse-drawn carriage.
Zhou Xue looked at the youthful family members and softly answered, "Another three days' travel should get us there."
She paused before continuing, "You should have noticed these past two days that we are encountering villages less and less often. Moving forward, we are more likely to run into evil spirits and Spirit Demons, so be careful on the road."
Evil spirits?
Spirit Demons?
Rather than being tense, Fang Wang became excited.
It was a perfect opportunity to test his Solaris Scripture!
As the sun rose, the Fang Family Disciples, invigorated for a while, began packing up their belongings to continue on their journey.
The mountain roads in the area were rugged, the trees tall, and the flowers and plants dense. The fog made the forests seem magical, and the bumpy journey roused all those who wanted to sleep from their slumber.
By noon, Zhou Xue pulled on the reins and stood up, calling out to those behind her, "Everyone pack your things and get off the carriage; we proceed on foot from here."
Each carriage had three passengers, usually taking turns to sleep, one leading the horses, another keeping watch, and the last one sleeping inside.
Soon enough, all the Fang Family Disciples dismounted. Aside from Fang Wang, Zhou Xue, and Fang Hanyu, the other six were carrying their luggage on their backs, including the two girls.
Fang Wang glanced at Zhou Xue, aware that she possessed the Qingyi Daoist's storage bag, and wondered how large the space inside it was.
According to Zhou Xue, a storage bag, Talisman Paper, and a Flying Sword were the standard accessories for a Cultivator.
Zhou Xue drew Fang Wang's Treasured Sword from his waist and deftly cut all the horses' reins from the three carriages.
"What does this mean?" Fang Hanyu asked in surprise.
Zhou Xue replied, "We are headed to Great Abyss Gate, and it will be difficult to return for several years. Even if we do come back, we won't need the carriages. It's better to set them free now rather than letting them fall prey to the beasts and ghosts of the mountains."
Ghosts and beasts!
Upon hearing this, the faces of the two Fang Residence girls went pale, and the same was true for the four young men.
With a flick of her wrist, Zhou Xue threw the Treasured Sword through the air, accurately sliding it into Fang Wang's scabbard from three yards away, a move that made everyone's eyes pop.
Squinting, Fang Wang's hand slightly trembled as he thought to himself about the strength and speed of Zhou Xue's throw. His curiosity about her current level of cultivation increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 11 - 9: Competing with Cultivation Families
chapters.content:
The mountain forest was serene, shrouded in heavy fog, and streaks of sunlight filtered through the gaps in the leaves above, creating visible slanting beams.
Zhou Xue walked at the front, Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu at the very back, nine people in total, trekking on foot, having been on this journey for nearly two days.
The mountain paths in the forest were difficult to navigate, muddied and often frequented by snakes, rodents, spiders, which kept the Fang Family Disciples on edge, careful with every step.
"It's hard to imagine a Cultivation Sect hidden in such deep mountains."
Fang Hanyu whispered in amazement. The Grand Qi Kingdom was vast, with countless uninhabited mountain ranges like this one, roaming with wild beasts, bandit hideouts, places where even a martial artist like himself rarely set foot.
Fang Wang could feel the richness of nature's spiritual energy in this region, growing more abundant the further they ventured, making him even more eager for the Great Abyss Gate.
At that moment.
A cry came from up ahead, sounding like a woman, yet also like a child, giving Fang Wang and the others goosebumps, but seeing Zhou Xue continuing without pause, they followed suit.
Fang Wang turned to look back, seeing only dense fog where nothing could be distinguished beyond seven steps away.
He had felt something following them, a sensation that began after the cries ahead had started.
He was not panicked, continuing on with calm resolve.
Soon, the mist ahead grew thinner and the terrain flattened out. They came upon a woman seated under an ancient tree, in simple clothing, disheveled and dirty, clearly a village woman of the mountains. She was cradling a child and sobbing softly.
"Should we ask her what happened?"
The youngest, Fang Xin, asked. She was a year younger than Fang Wang, frail, carrying two bundles, drenched in sweat.
Another girl, Fang Ziqing, pulled at her, shaking her head.
All eyes turned to Zhou Xue. She had become their leader throughout the journey, after all, it was she who taught them the Qi Gathering Technique, and even the strongest Fang Wang followed her lead.
Zhou Xue didn't stop, but walked straight up to the woman.
The woman heard the footsteps and looked up with tears streaming down her face and eyes red from crying. She seemed to see a lifeline and stretched out her hands to Zhou Xue, crying out, "Miss, please save my child, he's been bitten by a poisonous snake..."
Upon hearing this, some of the Fang Family Disciples wanted to step forward to help, but then they saw a dagger slip from Zhou Xue's right sleeve into her hand.
The woman saw the dagger as well and turned pale. Before she could speak, Zhou Xue suddenly hurled the dagger, aiming straight for her head.
Boom!
The woman suddenly turned into a puff of white mist. The dagger cut through the mist and lodged into the tree trunk.
When the mist cleared, the clothes fell to the ground, revealing two weasels, one large and one small, leaping to a tree trunk in the distance. This spectacle left the Fang Family crowd gaping; had that woman been a transformed weasel?
Zhou Xue's expression didn't change as she eyed the two weasels perched on the tree, her gaze indifferent.
"Good skills, you're at least at the fifth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. Young girl, if you really want to join the Great Abyss Gate, why not go to Taiyuan City?" the weasel spoke, its voice identical to the woman's from before.
Zhou Xue replied, "Taiyuan City is too far; it's more convenient to visit the Great Abyss Gate directly. We are sincerely here to cultivate, and I hope the senior will not play tricks on us anymore."
The weasel chuckled, almost human-like, and waved its paw to signal them to continue on their way.
Zhou Xue looked back, gave her companions a glance, and then continued to lead the way. As they passed under the tree where the weasels perched, everyone was tense, fearing a sudden attack.
After walking a distance, Zhou Xue finally began to explain, "Those were two Spirit Demons. The forests around the Great Abyss Gate are home to many such creatures. There are wild ones and some raised by Disciples of the sect. Demons on the periphery discourage mortals who stray in, cultivating legends of ghosts to keep them away."
A Fang Family youth couldn't help but ask, "Is it just to scare them off?"
"They might also get eaten. While the Great Abyss Gate is considered a righteous sect, in the Cultivation World, there's a gray area between good and evil. You all must be cautious in your actions in the future," Zhou Xue said with a smile, but her smile seemed sinister to the others.
After saying this, Zhou Xue continued to lead the way.
Fang Wang kept walking at the end of the group, but his attention was on what was behind them. Even after passing the two Spirit Demons, he felt like he was still being watched, making him remain on guard.
After half a stick of incense, the feeling of being watched still lingered in Fang Wang's mind.
"Don't be nervous, he dares not act rashly."
A voice reached Fang Wang's ears. He looked up at Zhou Xue, who was far ahead, with a puzzled look.
It seemed that only he could hear Zhou Xue's voice. The others didn't glance aside or look back as they moved on.
"This is the Sound Transmission Technique. Once you've entered the Great Abyss Gate, you can learn it too. The person following us must be connected to the Cultivator you killed. I've been hiding deep in the forest these days, pretending to study the Soul Burning Banner, while leaving traces for them to follow."
Zhou Xue's words reached him again, causing Fang Wang to frown, not understanding what she was planning.
"That fellow holds two Magic Artifacts; there must be someone behind him. I fear the Fang Residence might face further threats, so I deliberately attracted that person to investigate. If they find out we've entered the Great Abyss Gate, they wouldn't dare make a move. No matter how important that person is, they are just in the Qi Cultivation Realm.
Offending a behemoth like the Great Abyss Gate for his sake would be a loss not worth the gain."
So that was it.
Fang Wang felt it made sense, but another confusion arose in his mind.
Was the other party so audacious to have followed them here, not fearing that the Great Abyss Gate might discover them?
Zhou Xue stopped using the Sound Transmission Technique, and Fang Wang did not let his guard down, remaining vigilant.
By evening, that feeling of being watched finally disappeared; it seemed the other party did not dare to advance any further.
In the woods, the group stopped beside a stream, a fire had been lit, and Fang Wang sat next to Zhou Xue to rest, while the others also sat around together.
"We'll reach the valley town in front of the Great Abyss Gate by tomorrow, I'll explain to you now. The Great Abyss Gate has nine veins, and in about six or seven days, the entrance assessment will be conducted. With your talents, it won't be difficult to pass. I hope each of you will join a different vein, and not to cluster together," Zhou Xue said softly.
There were more than just them in the Fang Residence capable of cultivation; Zhou Xue had only chosen the most outstanding disciples to come and secure a foothold first.
Upon hearing that they should join a vein on their own, Fang Xin's face turned pale, and she became nervous, whereas the other youths showed no cowardice, feeling more excitement instead.
Zhou Xue glanced at Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu, saying, "When the two of you enter the assessment, do not hold back. You must show off your talents as much as possible, as this will determine the treatment you receive after joining the Great Abyss Gate. Those with average aptitude can only become ordinary disciples and will need many years of effort to advance."
"Especially you, Fang Wang, don't try any tricks like pretending to be a pig to eat the tiger this time."
Zhou Xue was very concerned about Fang Wang, because this kid was too good at hiding. After her rebirth, she had learned that it was not just her, but the entire Fang Residence, including Fang Wang's parents, who did not know he possessed such high martial skills.
She had also wondered why she had not seen Fang Wang make a move in her previous life and later realized that on the night of the clan's destruction, she was powerless and had fled that very night, only catching a glimpse of the Qingyi Daoist once.
She had not seen the fights between many Fang Family Disciples and the Qingyi Daoist; without the Sword Control Technique, Fang Wang would have died by the hands of the Qingyi Daoist, however strong he might have been.
Resigned, Fang Wang said, "I understand."
As if he were being tolerated.
Zhou Xue continued to give warnings; she did not specifically mention the content of the assessment, either to temper them or for fear of being overheard by the higher-ups in the Great Abyss Gate.
The night passed uneventfully.
As the moon set and the sun rose, when the first rays of morning light shined down, Fang Wang and the others continued their journey.
Along the way, they saw many strange creatures: spiders as big as human heads, man-eating trees flailing about, wild mountain goats with human-like faces, and black cats with five tails, among others. According to Zhou Xue, these were the lowest level of monstrous creatures, not yet reaching the level of spirit demons, which are characterized by their ability to speak human language.
In addition to monstrous creatures, they also saw many brightly colored flowers and fruits that looked extraordinary, but after Zhou Xue warned them of their deadly poison, they dared not touch them.
Finally, after noon, they reached the valley mentioned by Zhou Xue. A giant gate stood at the entrance to the valley, with a sign hanging above it:
Taiyuan Town!
The valley was filled with layered buildings, and columns of smoke rose slowly, surrounded by majestic mountains that oddly reminded Fang Wang of Five Fingers Mountain, with Taiyuan Town trapped within it.
The mountain gate was unguarded, so Fang Wang and the others entered the town directly. On the streets ahead, many people came and went, all of them looking extraordinary, not mere mortals, and some even ascended on cranes, flying out of the town and quickly towards the high mountains, igniting the excitement and longing of the Fang Family Disciples.
In that moment, they truly felt like they were coming into contact with the way of cultivation.
As they went, Fang Wang also observed his surroundings; both sides of the street were lined with various shops selling elixirs, magic artifacts, talisman papers, cultivation techniques, spells, and more. There was even an oddities pavilion. Although most shops were not overcrowded, they still displayed a strong cultivation atmosphere.
Zhou Xue led them to an inn to stay. After paying with silver, the attendant led them upstairs to their rooms. Except for Fang Xin and Fang Ziqing, the others each had a separate room.
"Tsk tsk, even the Great Abyss Gate accepts silver?"
Fang Wang reflected in his mind, finding it odd, but seeing Zhou Xue handing over a substantial amount of silver indicated that the Great Abyss Gate also needed engagement with the secular world.
Fang Wang entered his room, closed the door, and sat down on the bed. After a simple tidy-up, he began to meditate.
With six or seven days left, he did not want to wander around aimlessly, opting instead to enhance his cultivation level as much as possible.
His Solaris Scripture had reached Great Perfection, but spiritual power needed time to accumulate, and since Zhou Xue had told him not to conceal his skills, he had to strive with all his might.
Fang Wang thus shut himself in, and the other Fang Family Disciples did not dare to disturb him easily.
After six days.
At the hour of Si, the sky was bright, and a series of bell tolls resounded through the valley, deafening and waking Fang Wang.
"Has it come?"
Fang Wang thought silently, a smile appearing on his face.
Just the night before, he had finally made a breakthrough to the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. With the power of the Solaris Scripture at Great Perfection, it had taken him over a month to reach the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. If he had started from the first level of the Solaris Scripture, it was hard to imagine how much time it would have taken to reach this realm.
"Hurry out, the entrance assessment is upon us!"
Zhou Xue's voice came from outside the door as Fang Wang picked up his treasured sword and stepped off the bed.
With the Qi gathering and body refining, he needed no washing or eating, so he required no further preparation, looking clean and refreshed.
After a short while, under Zhou Xue's lead, Fang Wang and the others left the inn and saw that many people were doing the same, with groups on the streets heading in the same direction.
Curiously, Fang Wang asked, "You mentioned Taiyuan City before. What's the difference between Taiyuan City and Taiyuan Town?"
Zhou Xue replied, "Taiyuan City is the city run by the Great Abyss Gate for the entire Cultivation World, while Taiyuan Town is a mortal town cultivated by the Great Abyss Gate itself. The mortals living here are responsible for mining various resources for the disciples of the Great Abyss Gate.
Almost everyone who comes to Taiyuan Town has a cultivation background, coming from cultivation families all over, without background and information. It is impossible to discover this path."
"Simply put, in Taiyuan City, we compete with mortals, but here, we are competing with some cultivation families with cultivation backgrounds. Of course, passing the assessments from here brings more benefits."

chapters.title: Chapter 12 - 10 The Momentum of Rising
chapters.content:
Challenge the Cultivation Clans!
The Fang Family Disciples were scared, even Fang Hanyu subconsciously tightened his grip on the sword sheath.
Zhou Xue didn't say much, she took the lead and walked onto the street, following the flow of people, with Fang Wang and others closely behind her.
All the way, Fang Wang was feeling the aura of the people around them, not everyone could conceal their aura as Zhou Xue did, and he sensed quite a few fluctuations of Spiritual Power.
Many people had already cultivated Spiritual Power, and there were mortals like the Fang Family Disciples, so they didn't stand out too much.
It seems that so-called Cultivation Clans also have their strong and weak, perhaps even having one Cultivator amongst one's ancestors could count as a Cultivation Clan.
Fang Wang thought so, and soon he noticed a figure with particularly robust Spiritual Power almost catching up to him.
The person was wearing a Bamboo Hat, dressed in black, carrying a bookcase, and had a gourd hanging at the waist, the attire was strange, attracting many curious glances.
Taiyuan Town had a main thoroughfare that led straight to the end, where there was a large lake. The lake was surrounded by high mountains and the town, with a diameter exceeding one hundred feet. The water was a clear blue, gleaming under the sunlight's reflection.
Along the lakeside stood a row of men and women in identical robes, each with upright postures, the men handsome, the women beautiful, like the disciples of Immortals. Fang Wang guessed they must be Tai Yuan Sect Disciples, wearing white robes as the base with black on the cuffs, shoulders, waists, and boots, embroidered with delicate patterns.
Zhou Xue stopped walking, and Fang Wang and the others halted around her. Looking around, there were at least five hundred people gathered, and the number was still growing.
This made Fang Wang reflect; living in Southern Hills City, one would never know of the existence of the Cultivation World. Now that they had left the mundane world, there were so many people pursuing The Path of Immortality.
Southern Hills City could be considered one of the wealthiest cities in Grand Qi, often visited by martial arts masters. Fang Wang made many such acquaintances, yet had never heard of Cultivation, which showed how great the cognitive gap between Immortals and mortals truly was.
Zhou Xue remained silent, while the other members of the Fang Residence whispered among themselves. Fang Hanyu looked around, seemingly calm, but Fang Wang noticed that the youngster kept a tight grip on his sword sheath, clearly very nervous.
After about half an hour, the crowd by the lake had grown to over a thousand, and there were even some whom Fang Wang couldn't gauge their cultivation level.
Boom—
The sound of the bell from before rang out once more, quieting everyone by the lakeside.
Fang Wang focused and saw that it was a male Disciple striking the bell. The bell was only the size of a palm, entirely made of brass. A gentle tap with an iron pick produced an effect as if it could shake mountains and forests.
Another male Disciple stepped forward, looking to be in his early thirties, with a refined and scholarly aura.
"I am a fifth meridian Disciple of the Great Abyss Gate, Guan Linfeng. Today, I will oversee the admission assessment. The assessment is divided into two stages. The first stage is Spirit Attraction—everyone will come before me and place their hands on the Spirit Stone in my palm. Any person who causes the Spirit Stone to light up will immediately proceed to the next stage."
"The second stage lies behind me—leap over this lake, climb over that mountain, and follow the guide of the white crane in the sky. The journey is fraught with difficulties, but if you shout loudly to give up, someone will save you. The further you travel, the higher your score. Remember, do not stray from the direction the white crane points. If you do and perish, you have only yourselves to blame."
This Disciple who called himself Guan Linfeng spoke with a tone that wasn't arrogant but contained an indescribable pressure.
Fang Wang looked up and sure enough, there were white cranes circling the summit ahead. Looking further, there were more cranes in the sky, which from his perspective lined up into a straight trajectory.
Looking at the large lake in front of them, panic struck the Fang Family Disciples, aside from Zhou Xue, Fang Wang, and Fang Hanyu. How were the others, with their mere basic martial arts skills, to leap over this lake and climb over that mountain which was at least a hundred and fifty feet tall?
Zhou Xue reassured, "As long as you make that Spirit Stone light up, you are considered to have entered the gates. The second stage is for those who have a foundation in Cultivation to compete over."
Upon hearing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Fang Hanyu looked towards Fang Wang and asked, "Can your Sword Control Technique fly over that mountain?"
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and asked with a smile, "What? You want me to carry you?"
Hearing this, Fang Hanyu rolled his eyes irritably, "Of course not, I was just asking. I don't need you to carry me, and don't you carry anyone else either. Carrying someone while controlling a Flying Sword would surely deplete Spiritual Power greatly. You need to try your best to bring glory to the Fang Residence."
This was also a reminder to the other Fang Family Disciples.
Fang Wang shook his head with a wry smile, saying nothing more.
Meanwhile, some had already approached Guan Linfeng, and a long queue quickly formed, with Zhou Xue leading everyone to line up.
"Pass!"
Guan Linfeng's voice rang out from the front. Subsequently, Fang Wang saw a man leap up, a Flying Sword shot out from the storage bag on his waist, quickly expanded, settled under his feet, and carried him towards the horizon.
This scene amazed many onlookers and made them desire the Great Abyss Gate even more.
A young disciple from the Fang Residence named Fang Mo exclaimed, "If one masters the Sword Control Technique, wouldn't that ensure the highest score?"
Zhou Xue glanced at him and said, "It's not that simple, how do you know how long the journey is, or whether there are demon beasts or Spirit Demons in the sky to obstruct you?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Mo scratched his head and gave an embarrassed smile.
The first stage of the assessment was quick, averaging ten breaths per person. Fang Wang and the others were not too far back in the line, and they waited patiently.
Under Zhou Xue's arrangement, Fang Wang was the first in line, and she was at the very end to look after the others.
Such thoroughness made Fang Wang wonder if she really was a Demonic Cultivator.
Can a Demonic Cultivator become an Immortal Venerable?
She wouldn't be bluffing him, would she?
That's what Fang Wang thought. He found that he could no longer see through Zhou Xue, who after adapting to her rebirth, became unfathomable. Like these past few nights, when he would hear her footsteps leaving in the dead of night, without knowing her purpose.
He had considered pandering to Zhou Xue like mad in order to gain more cultivation techniques, but he quickly dismissed the thought. Not only was he unsure if Zhou Xue would fall for that, but he also did not want to demean himself.
Besides, he couldn't follow Zhou Xue's exact path. Her rebirth indicated a failure in her previous life, and he had to forge a stronger path.
Time quickly slipped away amidst Fang Wang's thoughts.
Finally, it was Fang Wang's turn for the assessment. He had noticed that the light emitted by the spirit stones varied among the individuals, with more than half unable to make the stones light up at all.
Having already cultivated spiritual power, he wasn't worried for himself; he was merely curious about the intensity of the luminescence he could trigger, suspecting that the brighter the light, the better the talent.
He approached Guan Linfeng and placed his right hand on the spirit stone held in Guan Linfeng's hand.
A cool sensation penetrated his palm, followed by a pull that tugged at the spiritual power within him. Without resisting, he let his spiritual power flow into the stone, causing it to burst into light.
"Pass!"
Guan Linfeng spoke, his expression unchanging.
Fang Wang was slightly disappointed since his light was clearly brighter than that of the others, but it seemed not to signify talent, maybe it was just related to cultivation level.
He stopped overthinking it, saluted Guan Linfeng with a fist-clasped bow, then headed towards the lake. With a leap, he jumped into the lake and began to rapidly stride across the surface.
This scene did not attract the attention of the Tai Yuan Sect disciples; others before him had done the same, as not everyone was adept at the Sword Control Technique.
Guan Linfeng summoned another disciple to take his place and then turned around, watching Fang Wang glide across the lake surface like a swan and swiftly scale the cliffside with ease.
Fang Wang's performance buoyed Fang Hanyu and the others; with Fang Wang there, the Fang Residence wouldn't be embarrassed, even if they lacked reputation here, they still felt a hint of pride.
"Impressive,"
Guan Linfeng murmured as he watched Fang Wang reach the summit, appreciation filling his eyes.
"This batch of disciples is remarkable. There may well arise individuals of the single lineage's top disciple level. It remains to be seen who will claim that superior grade spiritual weapon and rise to prominence."
Meanwhile, standing atop the mountain, Fang Wang's waist-bound white robe fluttered in the breeze, with strands of hair brushing backward, revealing his handsome face.
Bewitched by the magnificent plains ahead, Fang Wang was astonished by the landscape beyond the mountain, with two mountain ranges stretching to the horizon and a vast plain lying between them, as if carved by an immortal's sword.
Fang Wang did not have the luxury of lingering appreciation, as he leaped from the summit. The wind howled during his swift descent; as he neared the ground, he drew his treasured sword, twisted his body mid-air, and thrust the sword into the cliffside. With rock fragments flying and his descent slowing substantially, the sword proved its worth – indeed, it was tough!
As he came within less than five zhang from the ground, his fall nearly halted. He immediately kicked against the cliff, withdrew his sword blade, flipped in the air, and landed safely on the grass.
He sheathed his sword and ran in the direction indicated by the crane above.
Although his Sword Control Technique at the Great Perfection level would allow him to fly with the sword, the consumption was enormous, for the sword was not a magic sword; it couldn't channel spiritual power but only be wrapped and driven by it, so he planned not to use it prematurely.
He had a premonition: at the end of this path, there might be a battle awaiting.
If the test was merely about who could run the farthest, then it would be a mere comparison of spiritual power; Tai Yuan Sect wouldn't be so hasty.
Fang Wang dashed across the plain, using his spiritual power to perform the Shadowless Step, consuming much less than the Sword Control Technique, and his speed surpassed that of the fastest horse. At a glance, his feet barely seemed to touch the ground as he ran, leaving trails of fluttering grass.
Before long,
Fang Wang caught sight of two figures battling near the mountain wall to his front left. They moved with extreme agility; one wielded a curved blade that produced quick lightning strikes while the other held a folding fan, releasing bursts of fiery wind that set ablaze the grass within a ten-zhang radius.
Fang Wang merely glimpsed the scuffle without stopping.
Indeed, such an extendable path for the assessment was definitely not as straightforward as it appeared.
A whooshing sound swept past Fang Wang's head. He looked up to see a woman in yellow clothing wearing a bamboo hat and a white veil. She had three sword scabbards on her back and was dressed like a wandering swords(wo)man. Most critically, she was not flying with a sword but was riding a fiery-red gourd.
That was too...
Fang Wang felt jealous; that was definitely a magic artifact, and the woman's cultivation was surely not low, estimated to be at the eighth or ninth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
After only a few glances, he maintained his speed and continued on his way, in no rush to catch up.
In the sky.
Gu Li stood on her treasured gourd, gazing into the distance with an absent look. Even veiled, her eyes were inviting to the imagination.
Suddenly, as if sensing something, she turned her head and saw a man in black, also wearing a bamboo hat, flying past her on a sword at incredible speed.
"Qi Cultivation Realm, ninth layer. It seems my father was right, Great Abyss Gate is on the rise. However, I have no intention of losing to my peers!"
Gu Li let out a cold snort and started to speed up.

chapters.title: Chapter 13 - 11 I Disagree
chapters.content:
```
On the plain, Fang Wang maintained his own pace, moving forward. He had already been overtaken by seven people, but he was not in a hurry; he even wanted to see if Zhou Xue could catch up.
Among the eight remaining from the Fang Residence, only Zhou Xue was likely to catch up. Although Fang Hanyu had developed Spiritual Power, he was still merely a Martial Artist after all. Just climbing over that high mountain would be enough to stump him, so how could he catch up to this place?
As Zhou Xue said, this assessment was intended for those with a certain foundation in cultivation, not for mere mortals to participate in.
Time continued to pass.
After about half an hour, Fang Wang saw a great fog rising from the horizon, vaguely revealing the contour of mountains, magnificent and mysterious. In front of these mountains, the high mountains on both sides of the plain were nothing in comparison.
At first glance, Fang Wang thought of the Great Abyss Gate.
Could it be that the area ahead was the territory of the Great Abyss Gate sect?
Thinking with anticipation, Fang Wang saw that many had stopped in front of a cliff. As he was about to stop as well, he heard someone shout, "I give up!"
As soon as the words were spoken, a streak of green light descended from the sky, flashed past the person, and a splinter of the green light wrapped around the person, lifting them into the air and quickly disappearing into the immense fog before the cliff.
Was that a Magic Artifact?
Even with Fang Wang's eyesight, he could not clearly discern what it was.
Fang Wang walked to an unoccupied spot and stood on the edge of the cliff to look down. It was bottomless and pitch-dark below, and the sides were obscured by the fog. Looking up, he estimated that to reach the mountains behind the fog, there would be at least a ten-mile journey.
One must fly over!
Fang Wang turned his head to see that some people who had previously employed the Sword Control Technique were now at a loss, looking exhausted. He reckoned they had depleted their Spiritual Power, and some were even meditating on the spot, consuming Elixirs.
Could it be done like this?
Fang Wang was not resentful, but he couldn't help feeling that the scions of great families were indeed different.
"What are you looking at? Have you depleted your Spiritual Power?"
A familiar voice came from behind him. Fang Wang turned to look and saw Zhou Xue landing in front of him on a Flying Sword.
Fang Wang was curious—where had this Flying Sword come from?
Zhou Xue didn't dismount from the Flying Sword; instead, she waved her hand, and a slender Flying Sword flew out of her storage bag, which Fang Wang caught.
The moment he gripped the sword, he could feel the Spiritual Power within it—it was not a common sword but a magic sword.
Surprised, Fang Wang looked at Zhou Xue and asked, "Where did this come from?"
Zhou Xue's mouth curled into a smile, and she waved her hand dismissively before turning and flying away, disappearing into the fog in the blink of an eye.
Mysteriously, Fang Wang thought of the two figures who had fought earlier. Could it be that Zhou Xue had taken it by force?
Indeed, such an act would be very consistent with a Demonic Cultivator.
Fang Wang no longer dwelled on it. He connected his Spiritual Power with the sword directly and then leaped up, with the Flying Sword landing under his feet, carrying him toward the fog.
The Great Perfection level of the Sword Control Technique allowed him to control this sword with ease. Of course, it was also because this sword was not considered a very powerful Magic Artifact. According to Zhou Xue, powerful Magic Artifacts are very difficult to subdue, and Cultivators need to create their Lifespirit Treasure in order to manipulate them properly.
Whooosh—
The strong wind whistled past his face, and Fang Wang smiled. It was still best to travel by sword flying.
Standing on the Flying Sword and progressing with the wind, he felt elated, standing exalted in the Firmament, a natural sense of pride welling up in his chest, no wonder everyone aspired to the path of cultivation.
Entering the fog, Fang Wang suddenly heard some peculiar sounds and immediately drew his Treasured Sword from his waist.
A black eagle suddenly lunged out, its claws fiercely striking at him with speed that surpassed even the top Martial Artists, Fang Wang responded with a swing of his sword, condensing his Spiritual Power into Sword Qi, slashing the bird to dissipate it.
The black eagle turned to smoke and vanished, which made Fang Wang raise an eyebrow.
It wasn't a living creature!
It appeared to be another part of the assessment!
Fang Wang cautiously continued on his way, defending against black eagles that intermittently lunged out from all directions. Fortunately, he managed to fend them all off.
It wasn't too difficult.
As he passed through the immense fog, he saw a majestic mountain range that seemed to stand above the clouds, with peaks rising behind the mountains, the highest of which reaching into the clouds, its height beyond measure.
Above Fang Wang, cranes signaled the way, aligning with them, he landed on a vast open ground where Zhou Xue was already waiting.
After landing, Fang Wang grasped the Flying Sword in his hand and saw, besides the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples guarding the forefront, a total of sixteen candidates had arrived, each of them looking far from ordinary.
Gu Li glanced at Fang Wang but didn't pay too much attention. She remembered the young man who had run on foot, seemingly from not a very wealthy family, at least not posing a threat to her subsequent goals.
Zhou Xue approached Fang Wang and remarked, "That was quick. I thought you'd need some time to get used to it."
Fang Wang laughed, "It did take me a moment."
The two of them stood together, conversing quietly, while the others were scattered around and not approaching one another.
Time continued to elapse.
One after the other, Cultivators passed through the fog and landed on the ground. Fang Wang noticed that even the weakest had the cultivation level and aura of the fifth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm, which made him feel deeply moved.
```
```
No wonder the treatment here is better; they're all top students.
An hour later.
The number of junior disciples in this place had exceeded fifty, causing Fang Wang to secretly be alarmed.
Just here, there are fifty people, plus those who passed before, at least five hundred people have passed the entry assessment. And this is just Taiyuan Town; the number of disciples recruited by Taiyuan City is certainly even greater. Could it be that every five years, a few thousand disciples are recruited?
"This is why I chose the Great Abyss Gate. A hundred years from now, the Great Abyss Gate will become the strongest sect in the lands of Grand Qi."
Zhou Xue's voice came, using the Sound Transmission Technique, which made Fang Wang turn his head to look at her involuntarily.
Strongest sect?
Fang Wang believed her since Zhou Xue was a reborn person, and he looked forward even more to his own years of cultivation at the Great Abyss Gate.
After a while, a white crane descended from the sky, carrying a short and chubby old man on its back. Fang Wang had noticed this white crane before but hadn't seen anyone riding on it.
When the white crane landed, the short and chubby old man slowly sat up. Even though he was dressed in a daoist robe of the Great Abyss Gate, he appeared rather sloppy and indolent, with none of the imposing manner of an immortal.
Seeing the man's demeanor, Fang Wang immediately tagged him as a master in his mind.
This person must be very powerful!
The short and chubby old man, twisting his beard, glanced over all the present individuals and then said with a smile, "Not bad, not bad, a total of fifty-two people. It seems that my Great Abyss Gate is on the rise. Your arrival here qualifies you to become a branch disciple of the Great Abyss Gate."
"Within the Great Abyss Gate, status and treatment range from low to high: Outer Sect Disciples, Inner Sect Disciples, Branch Disciples, Sword-Bearing Disciples, and Direct Disciples. Outer and Inner Sect Disciples can also choose to follow a branch for their cultivation, but they must start from menial tasks. Branch Disciples can directly choose a master on the peak they select."
All the listeners were fully engrossed, which pleased the short and chubby elder and made him smile with satisfaction.
"Let me introduce myself, I am a Revered Elder of the sect, and you may address me as Greedy Sleeper. Don't you laugh at my title; it carries a significant repute in the Cultivation World," said the short and chubby old man, now identified as Greedy Sleeper, laughing proudly.
A young man in blue robes, with a look of respect and admiration, saluted and said, "I have indeed heard of the great reputation of Greedy Sleeper. Legend has it that during the great war between the righteous and the demonic a hundred years ago, you charged into Ancient Demon Mountain with a single sword, slaying over a thousand demon heads.
That battle vastly demoralized the Demonic Dao, enabling peace to come early."
Upon hearing this, Greedy Sleeper couldn't help but raise his chin, looking down his nose at others.
Gu Li glanced at the young man in blue robes; though her face was veiled, her eyes showed undisguised disdain.
Most of the others showed looks of admiration—notable, it was their first time hearing this legend.
Fang Wang thought to himself that this was indeed a master! Probably one of the top figures in the Great Abyss Gate—seemingly nonchalant, but undeniably formidable when it mattered.
"Alright, back to business. Now that you have become branch disciples, you may vie for the positions of Sword-Bearing and Direct Disciples," said Greedy Sleeper, coughing deliberately and speaking seriously.
A woman couldn't help but ask, "Directly contend for the role of a Direct Disciple? None of the Nine Great Sects have precedents for this."
The other scions of noble families discussed in low voices, clearly exhilarated.
Greedy Sleeper proclaimed proudly, "It was so before, but things will be different from now on. The Great Abyss Gate is breaking old norms precisely to help talents grow better. All of you are at the Qi Cultivation Realm. You can vie for it now. Those who aim to become Direct Disciples may step forward, alone challenging all others, and the one who wins will become a Direct Disciple.
The best five will be promoted to Sword-Bearing Disciples."
Alone challenging all others!
Upon these words, everyone fell silent.
Fang Wang turned to glance at Zhou Xue, asking through his gaze if they should contend.
Zhou Xue slowly nodded, but her brows were slightly furrowed, clearly surprised.
Could it be that her previous life was not as a disciple of the Great Abyss Gate?
Fang Wang couldn't help but mock in his mind, beginning to suspect Zhou Xue had other intentions for the Great Abyss Gate.
Gu Li spoke out, "May I ask the elder, if more than one person wants to be a Direct Disciple, who will challenge everyone alone?"
This question caused a dozen people to nod, all full of confidence.
"That's up to you," replied Greedy Sleeper with an ambiguous smile. "A Direct Disciple must have the ability to enforce law and manage fellow sect members. You must be able to command respect."
Gu Li stepped forward at once, saying, "My name is Gu Li. I come from the Luo Bei Gu Family. Having practiced cultivation for twelve years, I have reached the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation Realm, and I have learned the Five Saints Sword Technique of my father Gu Tianxiong. I wish to be a Direct Disciple. Who disagrees?"
The Luo Bei Gu Family!
Most of the people present were visibly moved, making Fang Wang curious about the strength of the Luo Bei Gu Family.
The man in black clothes and a bamboo hat, with his arms folded across his chest, snorted, "The Luo Bei Gu Family is indeed qualified. Then, I shall leave this opportunity to you. I'm curious to see whether the Five Saints Sword Technique can overpower numerous rivals of the same realm."
With that said, no one else dared to step forward.
In his heart, Fang Wang wondered when the day would come for the Fang Family of Southern Hills to hold such prestige?
"Go on, a Direct Disciple enjoys benefits you cannot begin to imagine. My talents are not as good as yours, and though I have many opportunities to contend for, it's different for you. Your cultivation journey can't always depend on me, unless you also wish to turn to the Demonic Dao.
As for the Luo Bei Gu Family, it will be destroyed within twenty years—it poses no threat to you!" Zhou Xue's transmitted message arrived.
Fang Wang was already prepared, and he would have stepped forward even without Zhou Xue's urging, but her words lessened his burden.
Without further thought, Fang Wang stood out and declared, "I disagree!"
All eyes immediately turned to him, causing his heart to quiver, but he still managed to maintain a facade of composure, staring calmly at Gu Li.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 14 - 12: Immediate Transmission upon Entry
chapters.content:
"Who are you?"
Gu Li stared at Fang Wang, her fine eyebrows furrowed as she sized him up carefully. For him to step forward at this moment, he must be no ordinary individual. Could it be that she had misjudged him, and this young man had a remarkable background?
Everyone scrutinized Fang Wang, including Greedy Sleeper.
Fang Wang said calmly, "My name is Fang Wang. Why don't we have a bout first? The winner will earn the right to fight everyone alone. How about it?"
As soon as these words came out, some people started to make a commotion. Everyone present had the backing of Cultivation families. Although they did not dare to rashly take the lead, they were excited to see someone challenging Gu Li's face.
Most people were wary of the Luo Bei Gu Family's reputation, but the rest were just being cautious. They felt that rashly vying for the position of direct disciple, they might not even get the chance to compete for the position of disciples wielding swords. With fifty-one people potentially attacking at once, they might be overwhelmed before having a chance to show their strength.
Greedy Sleeper stood on the side, twirling his beard with a face that reveled in the excitement. He had no intention of stopping them.
Gu Li stepped forward two paces and drew a slender sword from behind her back. It was two fingers wide, yet four feet long, its blade flashing with cold light.
"Then let's give it a try!" Gu Li's tone was forceful as she raised her sword towards Fang Wang.
Fang Wang lifted his right arm and raised the Flying Sword in his hand, but quickly let go. The Flying Sword hovered in mid-air.
Gu Li narrowed her eyes and immediately swung her sword, slicing out with a Sword Qi that was unstoppable, kicking up clouds of dust and sand as it barreled towards Fang Wang.
Fang Wang's right hand swung out fiercely, and the Flying Sword burst forth at terrifying speed, like a streak of cold light, ripping through the oncoming Sword Qi and dispersing the stormy winds in almost an instant, coming to a halt before Gu Li's forehead.
The draft from the sword blew away Gu Li's bamboo hat and veil, revealing a stunningly beautiful face that was now filled with a look of astonishment.
Looking at the Flying Sword hovering before her face, Gu Li stiffened, her pupils reflecting the tip of the sword, which twinkled with a cold light like the stars, and cold sweat ran down her forehead.
Everyone was shocked, including Zhou Xue, who couldn't help but raise her eyebrows.
"I really didn't misjudge him, but this kid's Sword Control Technique..."
Considering Fang Wang's performance that night, Zhou Xue had felt that Fang Wang's true strength was far greater than his cultivation level showed, which is why she had put him forward.
