She was surprised to see the extent to which Fang Wang had mastered the Sword Control Technique; even some cultivators in the Soul Sculpting Realm might not be able to match that speed.
Indeed, at that time, Fang Wang had used a mere mortal's sword, but now he held a magic sword in his hand.
However, even though this magic sword was of the most ordinary kind, it enabled him to unleash such power. Where was the limit for this young man?
Greedy Sleeper was also taken aback, his eyes gleaming as he focused intently on Fang Wang.
"Such domineering control and ferocious speed, to come to an instant stop... even I almost failed to react in time," Greedy Sleeper thought to himself with lingering fear. If Gu Li had died here, it would have been a major problem.
The Luo Bei Gu Family was not one to be trifled with!
He had to be vigilant, watching Fang Wang closely, fearing that the young man would be too heavy-handed.
Behind him, the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples all looked as if they had seen a ghost. Was this young man really at the Qi Cultivation Realm?
Fang Wang didn't look at Gu Li but swept his gaze over the others and asked, "I am standing as a candidate for the direct disciple, does anyone object?"
No one dared to answer. They all watched him as if facing a formidable enemy, and they began to silently take out their respective magic artifacts.
Zhou Xue's lips curved slightly upward as she thought to herself, "This kid is truly sharp. Usually, he seems restrained, but when it's time to contend, he exudes such an aura. If he hadn't died on the night of the clan's destruction in his former life, how high might he have risen?"
Think as she might, she also drew out a magic artifact, which was the Yellow Talisman previously used by the Qingyi Daoist.
Fang Wang caught sight of this and his heart skipped a beat. You're not going to really go through with it, are you?
Hey!
We're on the same side!
Fang Wang's right hand rotated inward, and the Flying Sword hovering before Gu Li's forehead snapped back, landing in his palm.
Gu Li's heartbeat thundered, and as she looked at Fang Wang, she felt a sense of unreality.
In that instant, she had felt the breath of death. Had her opponent wanted to kill her, she surely would not have been able to escape.
Why was there such a large gap?
She hadn't even used her Five Saints Sword Technique yet...
At that moment, she remembered her father's words, "The Great Abyss Gate has the aspect of soaring. Titans are bound to emerge; once there, you must not let down your guard."
Fang Wang paid no attention to Gu Li's thoughts. Seeing the others begin to move, encircling him, he knew that just relying on his Sword Control Technique was not enough to handle the current situation.
With that thought, he plunged his Flying Sword into the ground and faced the surrounding adversaries empty-handed.
Madness!
That was the feeling of everyone present. Just as someone couldn't restrain themselves any longer, Fang Wang raised his right hand with his palm facing downwards.
Boom!
An overbearing aura erupted from within Fang Wang. Dust swirled up from beneath his feet as three fireballs formed behind his head, resembling miniature suns. His robe billowed out, and his expression became stern.
"This is..."
"How is that possible!"
Both Greedy Sleeper and Zhou Xue were shocked. The former was pleasantly surprised, while the latter was purely astonished.
The Solaris Scripture!
Zhou Xue claimed she had not mastered it before her ascension, using it to intimidate Fang Wang. But in truth, she had practiced the Solaris Scripture to the sixth layer, only to abandon it later due to other reasons.
Just the sixth layer alone took her decades to master. How long had Fang Wang been practicing?
Looking at the three blazing orbs behind Fang Wang's head, it was clear that he had achieved more than just the first layer. She suddenly suspected that Fang Wang might have reached the seventh layer—a realm she hadn't attained.
No wonder this youngster's cultivation was increasing so rapidly, advancing the Solaris Scripture to such a degree in just over a month…
The emergence of such a genius in Grand Qi made Zhou Xue suddenly feel the power of destiny; perhaps an unseen force was influencing the Fang Family's fate.
In this life, Fang Wang had survived. That meant the times were about to change.
Although Zhou Xue found it unbelievable, it was not beyond her acceptance; after all, she had ascended and had seen even more monstrous beings.
"Attack!"
The bamboo hat-wearing black-clothed man took the lead, slamming the ground as he spoke. His backpack opened, unleashing a volley of black arrows towards Fang Wang.
The others immediately cast their spells, all opting for long-range attacks, and even Zhou Xue made her move, her Yellow Talisman bursting into dozens of golden rays.
In an instant, multicolored lights enveloped Fang Wang.
Fang Wang's gaze sharpened, his right hand clenched into a fist, and the three fireballs behind him suddenly exploded, transforming into a rolling inferno that swept away the various spells and magic artifacts from all directions. The rising flames were spectacular.
The next second, Fang Wang dashed forward using the Shadowless Step. Having mastered the ninth level of the Solaris Scripture and reached Great Perfection, he no longer feared any flames. In just three strides, he was in front of a cultivator.
He struck out with his palm, swift as the wind and forceful as thunder.
Boom!
The cultivator was sent flying, coughing out blood in mid-air.
Fang Wang turned, his leg sweeping out in a horizontal kick aimed at the female cultivator beside him. He was not just a cultivator; he was also a martial artist, with extremely fast physical reaction time. Spiritual Power condensed on his right leg, striking the opponent's face directly and knocking her out on the spot.
He continued his assault on the next person; he intended to defeat all his adversaries in the shortest possible time, as his Spiritual Power was limited and couldn't sustain such an intensity of combat for long.
The Solaris Spiritual Power was tremendously domineering. When Fang Wang used the Solaris Spiritual Power to execute the martial art of the True Dragon Palm, what emerged was not a dragon-shaped True Qi but a spectacular fire dragon that rampaged forth, overpowering several cultivators.
The bamboo hat-wearing black-clothed man came up behind Fang Wang, attempting a sneak attack, only for Fang Wang to evade using the Shadowless Step, causing his staff blow to miss.
Fang Wang spun around and executed a True Dragon Palm that the man dodged, but the cultivators behind him weren't so lucky.
Several more were sent flying, their bodies ablaze.
The observing Tai Yuan Sect Disciples reacted quickly, rushing to aid these newly burnt disciples, only to discover that the flames were difficult to extinguish, forcing them to resort to spells.
Fortunately, the flames suddenly disappeared, which gave them some relief.
This was Fang Wang's doing; the ninth level of Great Perfection of the Solaris Scripture allowed him to control the Solaris True Fire to the extreme; he was wary of burning these people to death.
In less than ten breaths' time, half the group was incapacitated, and the remaining cultivators retreated, daring not to let him get close.
Fang Wang moved fast as an arrow, constantly seeking targets. His True Dragon Palm was too domineering for anyone to withstand. When Zhou Xue appeared before him, Fang Wang showed no mercy, treating her as if she was a stranger.
Zhou Xue actually clashed palms with him!
Boom——
Their palms met, and a wild wind erupted. Fang Wang frowned as he felt a sinister Spiritual Power, snake-like, trying to erode his Solaris Spiritual Power, but luckily his power was strong enough.
The Greedy Sleeper couldn't help but glance at Zhou Xue, his eyes lighting up as he thought to himself that here was another genius.
He instantly categorized Zhou Xue as one of the sword-bearing disciples.
As this thought crossed his mind, Zhou Xue spat out blood and was sent flying, falling several meters away. She struggled to get up but failed several times.
Fang Wang really admired her; her acting skills were impeccable.
From that last exchange of palms, he was almost certain that Zhou Xue was not weaker than him.
Thinking about it, it made sense. It was unlikely that Zhou Xue would teach him her strongest cultivation technique. Likewise, if he were reborn, he would not foster someone stronger than himself.
One might care for their kin, but only to make them better, not to devote everything to their growth beyond the point of control.
With Zhou Xue defeated, the rest stood no chance against Fang Wang. Most of them were in the fifth to eighth levels of the Qi Cultivation Realm, with only three reaching the ninth level—among them, Gu Li and the black-clothed man.
Soon, only the black-clothed man was left fighting Fang Wang. This fellow had exceptional agility, which meant Fang Wang couldn't hit him for a while.
The black-clothed man felt the same way, even more frustrated, as his spells were rendered useless the moment they neared Fang Wang, dissipated by the fireballs behind him. After more than a dozen exchanges, Fang Wang's True Dragon Palm struck from an unexpected angle, and caught off guard, the black-clothed man instinctively met it with his own palm.
This clash spelled his defeat!
Falling to the ground, the black-clothed person clutched his chest, coughed up blood, and was unable to continue fighting.
Fang Wang turned his gaze to Gu Li, who had not taken any action and was watching from a distance. Sensing his look, she shook her head slightly, indicating surrender.
"Good! Very good!"
The Greedy Sleeper laughed heartily and called out loudly, "Fang Wang, promoted to Direct Disciple, is the Tai Yuan Sect's first ever new disciple to become a Direct Disciple upon joining since the sect's founding!"
His voice echoed beneath the firmament, and the observing Tai Yuan Sect Disciples all looked at Fang Wang with complicated expressions.
The Tai Yuan Sect valued not only cultivation talent but also combat talent, and often, the two were inseparable.
The Greedy Sleeper was already looking forward to what rank of precious spirit Fang Wang would have after his Spiritual Refinement, and whether he could catch up with that youngster.

chapters.title: Chapter 15 - 13: Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation
chapters.content:
Direct Disciple!
Hearing the words of Greedy Sleeper, Fang Wang secretly let out a sigh of relief. Although he seemed strong and ended the battle decisively, the Spiritual Power within his body had already been depleted by eighty percent. He was only pretending to be calm and unaffected.
Those cultivators who had not yet passed out looked at Fang Wang with various expressions, all with mixed feelings in their hearts. They couldn't believe that someone could actually fight fifty-one people alone, especially considering the small gap in their realms and the fact that all of them came from cultivator clans.
"Fang Wang? Why have I never heard of him before?"
"The Fang Family is truly remarkable, but I wonder which branch of the Fang Family he is from."
"Too strong. To become a direct disciple as soon as he joins, I'm thoroughly convinced. I couldn't even block a single one of his moves."
"His flames could have burned us to death, he was deliberately holding back."
Almost everyone was convinced by their defeat, realizing the terror of Solaris Spiritual Power only after fighting Fang Wang.
They even felt as though they were not fighting a Qi Cultivation Realm cultivator, but a Soul Sculpting Realm expert!
Gu Li looked at the tall and straight figure of Fang Wang and for the first time felt very mediocre. No wonder her father sent her to the Great Abyss Gate. If she had stayed in the family all this time, she would have really thought herself to be an unmatched genius in the world.
Just then, a figure descended from the sky, like an immortal descending from the heavens. He was dressed in the Great Abyss Gate's Dao robe, elegant and poised, with white temples that only highlighted his ethereal demeanor. His facial features seemed only to be in his thirties.
Greedy Sleeper turned his head and smiled, saying, "Junior brother, it's him, take him up."
He then looked at Fang Wang and introduced, "This is Inheritance Elder Zhao Chuanqian. Follow him to receive your reward as a direct disciple."
Fang Wang hurriedly paid his respects to Zhao Chuanqian, who had an indifferent expression and merely nodded slightly. Suddenly he swung his sleeve, a breeze faced forward, directly sweeping Fang Wang away, and the two turned into a rainbow light disappearing between the mountains.
This scene filled all the new disciples with envy, and Zhou Xue watched, with the corners of her mouth turning upwards, also in high spirits.
"In the future, he will definitely become a prominent figure in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, and within the Great Abyss Gate. After a hundred years, no, in at most fifty years, you all will take pride in having joined during the same period as him."
Greedy Sleeper stroked his beard and chuckled, his tone full of contemplation.
"Alright, next we will determine the five Sword Disciples."
Greedy Sleeper's tone shifted, his gaze stern as he looked at the cultivators.
...
Fang Wang rode a Flying Sword, standing behind Zhao Chuanqian, the Flying Sword beneath his feet was thirty feet long, its Sword Blade shimmering with strands of silver light, dazzlingly beautiful.
Looking down from above at the Great Abyss Gate, he saw a vast city amid the peaks, with Tai Yuan Sect Disciples coming and going, various flying Magic Artifacts and mounts catching his eye.
Zhao Chuanqian was solemn and reticent, making Fang Wang feel it was inappropriate to engage in conversation directly and instead, he just enjoyed the scenery along the way.
The Great Abyss Gate was vast, so much larger than Southern Hills City, and Zhao Chuanqian was headed towards the tallest mountain peak. The majesty of the towering peak only became truly apparent as they drew near.
Soon, the two of them soared up the mountain on their swords and landed in front of a palace.
Fang Wang looked up and saw this grand and majestic palace named Shiyuan Hall, with two fierce-looking mythical beast statues standing at its entrance.
Behind him was a stone stairway made of hundreds of white jade steps, leading to a spacious platform spanning two or three miles, where three disciples were cleaning.
"Follow me."
Zhao Chuanqian spoke and then stepped into the Shiyuan Hall, with Fang Wang closely following behind.
Walking into Shiyuan Hall, Fang Wang looked around at the vast and bright interior. It was his first impression; there were no weapons displayed, nor any flashy decorations.
Fang Wang's gaze was caught by a figure in front, an elder in white robes with white hair, coiled under a jade crown, not particularly tall, but with a back emanating a comforting and stable aura, as if ready to face all the calamities of the world with his hands clasped behind his back.
"Sect Leader senior brother, he has arrived."
Zhao Chuanqian halted and said, and at the mention of the Sect Leader, Fang Wang couldn't help but feel nervous.
The Sect Leader turned around, and with that motion, arranged his sleeves. His face did not look as old as his back suggested, although not young, it matched the image of a crane-haired youth.
Fang Wang saw the Sect Leader's gaze and quickly bent down to bow with cupped fists.
Zhou Xue had previously mentioned that the Sect Leader of the Great Abyss Gate, Guang Qiuxian, was highly skilled, regarded as one of the top five in terms of personal strength among the Nine Great Sects, with no clear ranking among the top five.
"I have seen your performance with my own eyes, not bad. I think highly of you. As a direct disciple, you can directly obtain a Superior Grade Spiritual Weapon. However, before that, you need to choose which lineage to join."
Guang Qiuxian looked at Fang Wang with a smile, his demeanor friendly and not at all oppressive.
Fang Wang replied, "I would like to join the third lineage."
This was prearranged by Zhou Xue on the way there; every Fang Family Disciple had to join different lineages.
Hearing this, Zhao Chuanqian couldn't help but give Fang Wang a strange look.
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and laughed heartily, saying in a warm voice, "Fang Wang, it seems you have some understanding of the Great Abyss Gate. Nevertheless, I still need to make it clear to you that the third lineage indeed has the most profound inheritance among the nine lineages. The third lineage is currently in a special situation. In terms of overall strength, it ranks eighth.
The ranking of the lineage will affect its resources. You may want to consider this carefully."
Hearing that the inheritance was the most profound, Fang Wang immediately nodded and said, "I choose the third lineage."
Zhao Chuanqian shook his head slightly but did not speak.
Guang Qiuxian nodded in agreement, then raised his right hand from which three bright lights flew out of his sleeve, hovering above the hall. They were a green longsword, a jade flute, and a folding fan.
"All three of these are Superior Grade Spiritual Weapons, not much different from one another. Take a look and choose the one you feel a connection with."
Guang Qiuxian briefly introduced them and then waited for Fang Wang to make his choice.
Fang Wang didn't hesitate and directly chose the sword, since swordsmanship was what he excelled at. He could branch out to other magic artifacts after he had learned other peerless skills.
For a cultivator to establish themselves, they couldn't rely on just one magic artifact.
Guang Qiuxian pointed with his hand, and the green longsword fell into Fang Wang's hand. The sword was entirely green, as if forged from green jade, and the blade was not sharp. Holding the blade with both hands, he felt its coolness and his heart settled down.
He noticed two characters carved into the hilt of the sword.
Qing Jun!
"Do not use this magic artifact lightly before achieving Spiritual Refinement, as it can easily backfire," Guang Qiuxian reminded.
Zhao Chuanqian turned and said, "Let's go, I'll take you to receive the rewards for becoming a Direct Disciple."
Fang Wang hastily sheathed the sword, bowed to Guang Qiuxian, and then followed Zhao Chuanqian's steps.
Watching Fang Wang's retreating figure, the smile on Guang Qiuxian's face never faded. Once the two had left the Shiyuan Hall, he murmured to himself, "Another genius emerges. It seems that the Great Abyss Gate is on the rise. It's a pity that he joined the sect too late to catch the upcoming opportunities."
After leaving the Shiyuan Hall, under Zhao Chuanqian's guidance, Fang Wang went to the main peak's administrative hall to receive the Jade Pendant for Direct Disciples, then to the Magic Artifact Hall to collect a storage bag, a Flying Sword, a hundred pieces of Talisman Paper, and ten Spirit Stones.
And that wasn't all; they then went to the Elixir Hall, where he received ten bottles of Spiritual Power Elixirs.
Zhao Chuanqian also introduced the situation of the Third Vein. The total number of disciples in the Third Vein exceeded two thousand, including Outer Sect Disciples. Currently, there were four Direct Disciples in the Third Vein, and with Fang Wang, there were now five.
Above the Direct Disciples were the Chief Disciples of each vein, and above them were the Chief Disciples of the Great Abyss Gate.
The Chief Disciple of each vein would have the opportunity to inherit the position of Peak Master, while the Chief Disciple of the Great Abyss Gate would be the next Sect Leader!
Fang Wang was not particularly interested in the promotion of status and position; he inquired about the most profound inheritance of the Third Vein.
Zhao Chuanqian looked at him deeply and replied, "The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation. This sword array can be considered the strongest formation of the Great Abyss Gate, capable of being executed by a single person and also being the strongest spell. It holds the world-shaking power to stabilize the world, but nowadays, no one can master the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation."
Fang Wang silently took note.
Afterwards, Zhao Chuanqian flew with him to the mountain peak of the Third Vein, where disciples could be seen cultivating in meditation all over the mountain. There were many stone doors on the mountain, with unknown contents within.
Under Zhao Chuanqian's lead, Fang Wang landed on an open space where hundreds of disciples were gathered, cultivating a certain swordsmanship.
In front of the open space, a row of imposing disciples were scrutinizing those cultivating. When they saw Zhao Chuanqian, they immediately turned around and saluted him in unison.
"Li Yu, this is your junior brother, Fang Wang. He has joined the sect today and has already been recognized by the Sect Leader. Take him to his cave dwelling," Zhao Chuanqian said to the leading man. After speaking, he rode his sword away, leaving Fang Wang behind.
Li Yu, the Chief Disciple of the Third Vein, appeared young but was actually over two hundred years old.
Hearing Zhao Chuanqian's words, Li Yu's eyes lit up, and the other disciples behind him were equally excited, all swarming over.
"Direct Disciple, seems you're the strongest among this batch of new disciples!"
"Good lad, you've got taste, choosing the Third Vein will definitely not disappoint you."
"Hahaha, finally, a promising genius has joined the Third Vein."
"Fang Wang Senior Brother, if you need anything, just come to me. I'm a Branch Disciple, my name is Zhou Bo."
In the Great Abyss Gate, a higher ranking meant the title of Senior Brother, and only disciples of the same level would compare seniority.
Fang Wang did not put on airs, exchanging pleasantries with them one by one. After some hubbub, Li Yu led Fang Wang to pick his cave dwelling.
Along the way, Li Yu was passionate and introduced the Third Vein to Fang Wang.
The Peak Master of the Third Vein was named Yang Yuanzi. Besides leading the vein's affairs, he also accepted Direct Disciples as students. Li Yu highly praised Yang Yuanzi, as if he were the strongest Peak Master.
After a good half-hour, Fang Wang finally settled on his own cave dwelling. It turned out that the stone doors on the mountain were the entrances to the cave dwellings, which also differed in ranks. As a Direct Disciple, he had access to one of the best cave dwellings.
After Li Yu said his farewells and left, Fang Wang entered the cave dwelling. From then on, he would use his own identity token to enter and exit. An ownerless cave dwelling could be claimed by simply pressing a disciple token against the door. Of course, this claim was not unbreakable; the Peak Master could forcefully take back a cave dwelling.
The sight before him made Fang Wang's eyes light up. From the outside, the dwelling seemed small, but inside it was another world, as large as half a soccer field, with a small lake at the deepest part. The dwelling surged with dense Spiritual Energy, and just a single breath made him feel refreshed.
Inside the dwelling were stone tables and chairs, as well as a white jade bed. After a quick walk around, he sat down on the white jade bed to cultivate and gather Qi.
He had expended too much Spiritual Power today and needed to replenish it.
According to Li Yu, Yang Yuanzi would not be out of seclusion for another five days to meet him. Direct Disciples in the Great Abyss Gate had a lot of freedom; they didn't have any obligations on normal days, and would still receive resources from the Great Abyss Gate for cultivation on schedule.
While cultivating and gathering Qi, Fang Wang harbored his own thoughts.
The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, I must get my hands on it!

chapters.title: Chapter 16 - 14: Jinghong Divine Sword Art, Thirty-Six Swords Great Completion
chapters.content:
For five days, Fang Wang had not left his cave dwelling. Although he was excited to have joined the Great Abyss Gate, he had no desire to go out and socialize with the other disciples. He was acutely aware that his position within the Great Abyss Gate depended on his cultivation level. As long as he maintained the reputation of a genius, he would be surrounded by good people.
But if he were to delay his cultivation, trouble would naturally follow.
At noon on this day.
Fang Wang felt something, opened his eyes, and picked up the token at his waist. A voice transmitted from it:
"Fang Wang, come see me at the Qingxin Hall."
The voice was aged and hoarse, but upon hearing "Qingxin Hall," Fang Wang's expression brightened. He immediately got up, thought for a moment, hung his storage bag on his belt, and took up the Flying Sword given to him by Zhou Xue. He quickly stepped out of his cave dwelling and flew off on his sword.
The Qingxin Hall was the palace of the Peak Master, which meant the person who had just spoken was his future master, Yang Yuanzi.
He was very much looking forward to what he could learn next.
Qingxin Hall was situated on the summit of the third peak, a place previously pointed out by the eldest disciple, Li Yu.
Ascending all the way, Fang Wang soon arrived in front of Qingxin Hall. There were no disciples guarding it, and the palace was surrounded by tall trees, standing like giant swords.
Fang Wang stood in front of the grand entrance, slowly pushed the door open, and stepped inside.
Qingxin Hall was not large—it looked like an ordinary Daoist temple. Fang Wang walked up behind a figure and bowed, saying, "Disciple Fang Wang, pays respects to Master."
Yang Yuanzi sat with his back to him, meditating in front of a stone statue of a woman with a graceful figure. Her face was devoid of features, which instead lent it a solemn and mysterious air.
Upon hearing him, Yang Yuanzi stood up and turned to look at Fang Wang.
Only now did Fang Wang clearly see Yang Yuanzi's true face. His hair was a mix of black and white, carelessly draped, and he wore a black Dao robe. His eyes were dull like a dry well, and the stubble around his mouth was unkempt. This was very different from the Yang Yuanzi Fang Wang had imagined.
Yang Yuanzi asked, "Why choose the third peak?"
Fang Wang had already thought about his response. He replied, "For the highest and most profound legacy."
"Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation? Indeed. Which family are you from?"
"Disciple is from the Fang Family of Southern Hills City."
"Never heard of it, but I'm not interested anyway. Now that you have become my disciple, you will be the fifth in ranking, with four elder martial brothers and sisters ahead of you. You'll meet them in time. You're already at the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. Is there anything specific you wish to learn?"
Yang Yuanzi's words were calm, revealing an indifference towards this so-called genius disciple, Fang Wang.
It was then that Fang Wang realized why Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian had advised him to join the first peak. It seemed the third peak's issue lay with Yang Yuanzi himself.
Fang Wang did not hold back, asking, "Master, can you teach me how to use the storage bag?"
Upon hearing this question, Yang Yuanzi's pupils shrank slightly. He could not help but ask, "You don't know how to use a storage bag? Didn't your family teach you?"
"My family does not understand cultivation; there was just one clan member who received guidance from a cultivator. I came to the Great Abyss Gate with her."
"How long have you been cultivating?"
"Less than a year."
"Less than a year and you've achieved the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm?"
Yang Yuanzi looked at Fang Wang anew, squinting his eyes and commenting, "Not bad. To open a storage bag, you'll need to develop your spiritual consciousness."
Seeing that Fang Wang wanted to continue asking questions, Yang Yuanzi handed him a secret manual and said, "This is the general outline of cultivation for the Great Abyss Gate; it records all kinds of basic techniques for cultivation. You should take it back and study it."
Fang Wang hurriedly thanked his master, unaware that Yang Yuanzi was rather speechless.
This book was prepared by the Great Abyss Gate for Outer Sect Disciples to introduce them to the path of cultivation. Ever since he became a Peak Master, he had almost never taken out this book. This particular book was a memento from when he first joined the Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang tucked the secret manual into his chest and then asked, "Master, may I learn the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation? I would like to give it a try."
Yang Yuanzi snorted and said dismissively, "In the Great Abyss Gate, you can't simply learn whatever you want, even if you are highly talented and perceptive. You must make contributions. When you joined, the Great Abyss Gate didn't check your background because firstly, it does not matter, and secondly, as a new member you need to prove yourself through contributions."
"As a Direct Disciple, you are allowed to choose three superior manuals from the Daofa Pavilion. However, the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation is the cornerstone legacy of the first peak. If you want to learn it, you'll have to become the eldest disciple first."
Fang Wang quickly inquired, "How can I become the eldest disciple?"
With no irritation, but rather with interest, Yang Yuanzi replied, "To become the eldest disciple, you must first reach the Spirit Elixir Realm and have made significant contributions. Don't even think about it for the next fifty years."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately felt disappointed.
Yang Yuanzi's tone shifted, "However, you are the first in the history of the Great Abyss Gate to become a Direct Disciple upon joining. Although there has never before been such an exception in accepting disciples, you will still be recorded in the annals of the Great Abyss Gate."
He raised his right hand, and a green Jade Slip appeared in his palm.
"This sword technique is called the Jinghong Divine Sword Art. It is a techniqueI personally mastered. The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation is the heritage of the Great Abyss Gate, and I cannot give it to you on my own accord, but the Jinghong Divine Sword Art is different. I acquired it while adventuring in the Cultivation World.
Once you develop your spiritual consciousness, you will be able to read the contents of the Jade Slip with it."
A smile appeared on Yang Yuanzi's face, though it was uglier than a cry, quite frightening indeed.
Fang Wang took the Jade Slip, his excitement barely contained. He asked, "Master, is this sword technique powerful?"
Yang Yuanzi raised his chin proudly, saying, "Your master seized the position of the third peak's Peak Master with this sword technique. What do you think? I've only mastered twenty-seven of the sword movements and already I can sweep through those in the same realm. If within ten years, you achieve minor success, it will be a sign of exceptional comprehension."
"Thank you, Master. I will certainly not disappoint you!"
"First, cultivate to the ninth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. As a Direct Disciple, you can practice freely. Once you achieve the Soul Sculpting Realm, it won't be too late to start practicing the Jinghong Divine Sword Art."
"Understood."
Yang Yuanzi then went on to explain the rules of the Great Abyss Gate, emphasizing that disciples must not kill each other, must not harm innocent mortals, and must not associate with the Demonic Dao, among other things.
```
After giving his instructions, Yang Yuanzi let Fang Wang leave.
Fang Wang did not immediately go to the Daofa Pavilion to select a cultivation technique, feeling that it was not urgent. Just the Jinghong Divine Sword Art alone would take him time to practice. What seemed like an instant had, for him, really been many, many years lived.
Locking a person in a room, with only food and drink provided and no other forms of entertainment, could drive someone insane within a month.
Even though Fang Wang aimed to grow stronger, spending one or two hundred years in the Heavenly Palace was very painful.
Once inside the Heavenly Palace, one could not leave unless they reached the Great Perfection Realm.
Yet, he vaguely discovered another advantage of the Heavenly Palace—it guaranteed that any cultivation technique or ultimate skill could be mastered to Great Perfection. That was truly domineering!
Moreover, ever since he had entered the Heavenly Palace, Fang Wang had gained a photographic memory.
Upon returning to his cave dwelling, Fang Wang first took out the 'General Outline of Cultivation.' Following the records, he cultivated his divine consciousness. For him, at the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm, this was no big feat, and he accomplished it within an hour.
The 'General Outline of Cultivation' also recorded the cultivation realms, which from low to high were: Qi Cultivation, Soul Sculpting, Spirit Elixir, Profound Heart, and Condensation. Above Condensation, there are realms that even the book suggested, 'hope disciples will one day touch higher realms.'
The Soul Sculpting Realm was a crucial stage that determined a cultivator's fate. The grade of the Lifespirit Treasure one could forge directly decided their aptitude and comprehension. Of course, it was not absolute. On the path of cultivation, there will always be extraordinary people who create a sensation through the ages.
Putting down the 'General Outline of Cultivation,' Fang Wang began his practice.
He planned to first build his cultivation up to the ninth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
Now that he had reached the stage where he no longer needed to eat, Fang Wang could cultivate in peace. Closing his eyes, he seemed to re-enter the state of cultivation he had experienced in the Heavenly Palace.
One and a half months later, Fang Wang reached the eighth layer of the Qi Cultivation realm. The gap between the seventh and the eighth layer was indeed as large as Zhou Xue had described. He only won previously because the Solaris Scripture was stronger than the cultivation techniques of the other cultivators.
He continued to practice.
Nearly four months passed, and Fang Wang finally reached the ninth layer of the Qi Cultivation realm in one go.
As he opened his eyes, a gleam flashed in them. He once again gathered the Solaris True Fire, and nine little suns floated behind his head, illuminating the cave dwelling. Feeling the surging spiritual power within him, he suddenly recalled the sensation when he had reached the Martial Mythical Realm.
Uh, he felt invincible.
Of course, this feeling was fleeting. He knew that in the cultivation world, he was still at the bottom and needed to work hard.
Fang Wang picked up the Jade Slip given to him by Yang Yuanzi and probed it with his divine consciousness. A significant amount of text flooded into his mind. After organizing it all, his consciousness blurred, and when he opened his eyes again, he was already inside the Heavenly Palace.
He stood in the great hall of the Heavenly Palace and began practicing the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
The Jinghong Divine Sword Art had a total of thirty-six swords—no actual sword was needed in hand. The sword technique would condense into sword shapes, akin to a magic artifact, moving at will.
Yang Yuanzi claimed he only mastered up to the twenty-seventh sword, which made Fang Wang greatly look forward to the full thirty-six.
However, he spent five years just on the first sword.
The Jinghong Divine Sword Art was difficult to practice!
It wasn't just about condensing spiritual power into a sword shape; it also involved infusing one's divine consciousness into it, allowing the sword shape to become one's own field of vision—a test of divine consciousness.
No matter how difficult, as long as one entered the Heavenly Palace, it could certainly be mastered—worse comes to worst, just endure the time!
Fang Wang continued to practice the second sword.
The second sword also took five years!
It wasn't until the sixth sword that the practice duration decreased to two years. Fang Wang thought he was making rapid progress, but by the time he reached the eighteenth sword, it took him over ten years for each one, nearly driving him to despair.
Who can go day after day, training and learning for hundreds of years without any form of leisure in between?
Fang Wang had tried to create a computer from his previous life within the Heavenly Palace, but it was just an empty shell. As for creating a person, that was even more impossible.
And so it was.
By the time Fang Wang had finally mastered the thirty-six swords, thirty-six sword shapes floated around him, all bearing the likeness of the Qingjun Sword, quite splendid. Yet his face wore an expression of numbness.
"It's finally over," he said.
As his words fell, Fang Wang's consciousness returned to reality.
Practicing the Jinghong Divine Sword Art had somehow taken him two hundred years!
Numb!
Fang Wang immediately got up and walked out of the cave dwelling; he had to go see the outside scenery, or he would go mad.
Boom!
The doors of the dwelling burst open, and sunlight poured onto Fang Wang, giving him the feeling of being alive in that moment.
He walked to the cliff's edge and admired the majestic scenery of the Great Abyss Gate's peaks, simply standing there for half an hour before heading back to continue his practice.
Watching the figures of disciples coming and going, Fang Wang finally felt a sense of reality.
"Fang Wang, long time no see. Have you reached the Soul Sculpting Realm?"
A female voice reached him. Fang Wang turned his head to look, and it was Gu Li from the Luo Bei Gu Family.
Gu Li's cave dwelling was right next to his, which surprised him—this area was reserved for direct disciples!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 17 - 15: Illusionary Realm Examination
chapters.content:
"Not yet, I didn't expect Miss Gu's cave to be right next to mine."
Fang Wang looked at Gu Li, who was standing at the entrance of the cave, and replied with a smile. Under the sunlight, without her veil, the Gu Li clad in the Great Abyss Gate's Dao robe looked particularly charming, just like an immortal descended to the mortal realm.
There was a set of Sect Leader Dao robes in Fang Wang's cave, which looked nearly identical to the one Gu Li wore. Could it be that Gu Li had also become a Direct Disciple?
Gu Li fixed her gaze on Fang Wang and said softly, "I chose to be next to you on purpose. I have already succeeded in Spiritual Refinement and have become a Direct Disciple; from now on, you are my senior brother."
Direct Disciple?
So quickly?
Fang Wang was surprised inside, but he maintained his composure on the surface.
Seeing his indifferent reaction, Gu Li's hand inside her sleeve clenched slightly. She tried to stabilize her emotions, reminding herself not to rush.
"Master told me that when you were admitted, you were only at the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm. It's only been a few months, and now you've reached the ninth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm. It seems that you'll be undergoing Spiritual Refinement soon. Before that, could we spar again?" By the end of her words, Gu Li's face had flushed a bit.
Fang Wang looked at her skeptically.
Soul Sculpting Realm against Qi Cultivation Realm?
What a joke!
So shameless?
Fang Wang was about to refuse when he heard Gu Li continue, "I won't use my Lifespirit Treasure, it's just that I've made a breakthrough in my Five Saints Sword Technique, and I would like to spar with you. Don't worry, we'll find a secluded place to spar, and it won't be spread around."
Fang Wang had originally found it a hassle, but now he suddenly wanted to witness the power of the Soul Sculpting Realm firsthand; within the Great Abyss Gate, they wouldn't have to worry about murderous intent.
"Where to?" Fang Wang asked.
Gu Li's eyes brightened as she said, "Let's go to the forest at the foot of the mountain. Sparring is a common occurrence, and as long as we don't develop hatred, the Great Abyss Gate won't forbid it. We won't use magic swords, just spar with wooden ones."
Fang Wang wanted to say that both wooden swords and magic swords can kill, but he wasn't in the mood for idle talk. This was a good opportunity to try out the Jinghong Divine Sword Art!
"Let's go, to the forest!"
"Okay!"
They immediately set off toward the mountain's base, with Gu Li leading the way. They didn't fly with their swords, and from high above, the two walking side by side on the mountain trail looked like a pair of immortal lovers.
On the way, Gu Li chatted with Fang Wang. Hearing that Fang Wang had been cultivating since joining the sect, she started talking about recent amusing events within the Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang had just experienced two hundred years of darkness, so he was also interested in these fun stories, listening to her go on, occasionally interjecting with questions.
"By the way, is Zhou Xue a member of your clan?" Gu Li suddenly asked.
Fang Wang nodded and said, "Yes, what about her?"
He wasn't worried about Zhou Xue getting into trouble; this lady was a reborn individual, and it would already be good if she didn't trouble others.
"She passed the sect's Illusionary Realm test and received the inheritance of the previous Sect Leader. Her fame has skyrocketed, and once she goes through Spiritual Refinement, even if her Lifespirit Treasure is of average quality, she would still be able to become a Direct Disciple," remarked Gu Li.
Illusionary Realm test?
Fang Wang hadn't heard Zhou Xue mention it, but it was within reason that Zhou Xue could get such an opportunity. Her rebirth was her greatest reliance; with so many chances recorded in her mind, she would surely choose a stronger path than in her former life.
Since entering the Great Abyss Gate, they had lost contact, but Fang Wang remembered that she had chosen the first lineage for herself.
Thus, Fang Wang and Gu Li continued to chat leisurely as they headed to the forest.
After a stick of incense had burned.
The two entered the forest, where the trees were sparse, making it convenient for a duel. The dense foliage above also shielded them from the prying eyes of passing disciples.
Standing three yards apart, Fang Wang raised his right hand and said, "Come on, this time, I won't use Sword Control Technique."
Sword Control Technique!
When Gu Li heard these three words, her face visibly stiffened—it turned out that the technique that had defeated her last time was indeed the Sword Control Technique.
Being defeated by a sophisticated swordsmanship was acceptable to her, but by the Sword Control Technique...
And the opponent was only at the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm at the time!
Taking a deep breath, Gu Li immediately took out two wooden swords, tossing one to Fang Wang and gripping the other in her right hand.
Fang Wang caught the wooden sword and examined it. He intended to refuse to use it, but he did not want to insult her, thinking to himself, Oh well, I might as well play along.
It was actually not a bad idea; he had always pretended to be a sword adept, yet he did not need a sword to execute the Jinghong Divine Sword Art. This might save him at a critical moment in the future.
Grasping the wooden sword, Fang Wang raised it toward Gu Li. His left hand reached out with two fingers and traced on the sword blade, instantly conjuring three streams of Sword Qi along the blade and quickly forming three sword shapes floating before him.
This scene made Gu Li frown, wondering inwardly, What swordsmanship is this?
Gu Li took a deep breath and immediately executed her family's secret Five Saints Sword Technique. She swung her sword rapidly, with sharp moves and fast enough to create afterimages. In an instant, it seemed as though five people were swinging swords at once, and visible, domineering Sword Qi swept towards Fang Wang like a violent storm.
Trees along the way were sliced with countless fine cuts, extremely fierce.
Fang Wang held his sword in his right hand and twisted his wrist, then thrust it forward. The three sword shapes suddenly turned into three streaks of cyan light and shot out.
Boom!
The Sword Qi clashed, and the seemingly formidable Five Saints Sword Qi was instantly shredded by the cyan streaks. Gu Li's hair was whipped about, and she instinctively widened her eyes.
At that moment, she felt the same dread as she had during the competition to become a Direct Disciple.
Luckily, the three streaks of cyan light dissipated just as they reached her face, yet the powerful sword light still made her heart pound.
Fang Wang put away his sword and reflected inwardly, Fortunately, my Jinghong Divine Sword Art has reached Great Perfection; otherwise, I really would have had difficulty retracting the sword just now.
The surrounding trees shook violently, leaves falling like rain, and amidst this shower of leaves, Gu Li found herself in a daze.
Fearing she would make another request, Fang Wang quickly said, "Miss Gu, your swordsmanship is very strong, the strongest I've faced among sword cultivators so far. Let's spar again later; I need to go back to my cultivation."
After speaking, he leaped up, stepping onto a wooden sword and quickly flew out of the forest.
At the same time,
a male disciple flew over, noticing something unusual happening in the forest below. Just as he thought about checking it out, he saw Fang Wang flying out on his sword, and he was instantly overjoyed, hurrying to approach him.
"Brother Fang, it's rare to see you!" The male disciple intercepted Fang Wang and said with enthusiasm.
Fang Wang felt he looked somewhat familiar and politely responded, "I've been closed off for cultivation, just came out for a stroll today."
"Brother Fang, do you still remember me? I'm Zhou Bo!"
"Remember, remember..."
Inside the forest.
Gu Li took a deep breath. This wasn't the first time she had been defeated, and the blow didn't hit her as hard as before, especially since she had received Fang Wang's recognition.
Wait a minute!
That boy hasn't been cultivating for even a year. How could he have met so many sword cultivators?
Gu Li recalled her master Yang Yuanzi's lamentations, and her complexion instantly turned ugly. There was no anger in her heart, just endless confusion.
She took a deep breath and then flew off on her sword.
After Fang Wang hastily dealt with Zhou Bo, he left. Just as Zhou Bo was internally commending Brother Fang for being truly a dedicated cultivator, he saw Gu Li flying out from the forest.
With her hair slightly disheveled from the impact of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, Zhou Bo stared in astonishment.
Gu Li didn't bother with him at all and quickly flew towards the mountain.
Zhou Bo withdrew his gaze, stood on his flying sword, and murmured with a sigh, "Brother Fang is really in good spirits."
...
After landing, Fang Wang placed the wooden sword against the mountain gate of Gu Li's cave dwelling, then quickly returned to his own.
Having repeatedly shaken the pride of heaven's favored daughter, he feared endless troubles, but there was nothing he could do since Gu Li had sought him out first.
Sitting cross-legged on the white jade bed, Fang Wang reflected on the recent battle, feeling that there was nothing so remarkable about the Soul Sculpting Realm, at least not compared to the gap between him and it.
Perhaps the Lifespirit Treasure contributes significantly to combat power in the Soul Sculpting Realm.
Fang Wang stopped pondering and continued to gather Qi for cultivation. Reaching the ninth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm didn't mean he could immediately assault the Soul Sculpting Realm. Between Qi Cultivation Realm Nine and Soul Sculpting Realm lay a nameless level. This also existed in the martial path; some called it an opportunity, some called it Great Perfection.
All in all, he just wanted to quickly advance to the Soul Sculpting Realm.
Outside the cave dwelling.
Gu Li looked at the wooden sword leaning against the mountain gate, bit her lip, picked up the sword, and then walked back to her own cave dwelling.
In the blink of an eye.
Another month had passed.
Fang Wang's spiritual power had doubled, and deep within, he faintly sensed the signs of a breakthrough. However, he found his cultivation could still improve, so he continued his practice. He wanted to wait until his cultivation could no longer grow before attempting the breakthrough.
One day, a voice came from outside the cave dwelling:
"Fang Wang, are you there?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately got up to answer. He went to the mountain gate, opened it, and as the sunlight streamed in, he saw a familiar face.
Zhou Xue!
Months had passed and Zhou Xue, dressed in a Tai Yuan Sect disciple's robe, looked even more beautiful. The spirit and sharpness between her brows were something Gu Li didn't possess. Zhou Xue was spirited and fiercely shining, while Gu Li was merely cold in appearance.
Zhou Xue stepped directly into the cave dwelling, walked past Fang Wang, and, at the same time, waved her hand saying, "Close the door!"
Fang Wang immediately closed the door of the cave dwelling and then followed Zhou Xue's steps.
"Why are you here?" Fang Wang asked, puzzled.
Zhou Xue snorted, "You've been secluded in your cultivation, trying to cut ties with the Fang Family? Other disciples of the Fang Family have met and established connections, except for you who has never left the third vein. I had to come looking for you."
Fang Wang explained, "I just want to reach the Soul Sculpting Realm as soon as possible."
"Qi Cultivation Realm Nine? Not bad, looks like you haven't neglected your cultivation. I was just worried that the Gu girl would entangle you, and with your restless youthfulness, you'd be unable to resist and fall into it."
While speaking, Zhou Xue sat down at the stone table.
Fang Wang said helplessly, "How could that be? I am the Thirteenth Young Master of the Fang Family. If I were so easily moved, those beautiful maids at the mansion and the rich daughters in town would have already been tempted by me."
Zhou Xue snorted, "I hope so. I am here today to bid you farewell. I'm leaving and probably won't be back for three to five years."
"That long? What for?"
Fang Wang sat down and asked curiously, his mind figuring out how to gain some peerless skills.
Zhou Xue looked at him and said, "I'm going for a big opportunity, and along the way, investigate this Soul Burning Banner I have. I can't be at ease unless this matter is cleanly resolved."
"Take me with you?"
"With talent like yours, just focus on your cultivation. A genius like you should be earnest in practice. I've seen too many once-in-a-lifetime geniuses that thought they were strong enough, only to go out and get killed by old monsters and those favored by fate, becoming pitiable characters in other people's tales. Plus, I work better alone."
"Alright then..."
Fang Wang just made a token gesture of courtesy. He certainly couldn't thickly beg Zhou Xue to take him along, and he indeed did not wish to go. He wasn't yet at the stage where he needed to go out searching for opportunities.
Just...
How to express it?
Zhou Xue teased with a laugh, "What? You still want to get Cultivation Techniques or Spells from me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 16: The Great Perfection of the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, Beginning of Spiritual Refinement
chapters.content:
Fang Wang hadn't expected Zhou Xue to be so straightforward, he gave a fake cough and said, "I can only help you if I become stronger, just like in the crisis when our clan was nearly exterminated."
Zhou Xue stared into his eyes, making his heart feel hairy.
But thinking that it would be years before they could meet again, Fang Wang had no choice but to steel himself and meet Zhou Xue's gaze.
After a few moments of eye contact, Zhou Xue smiled and said, "I can only give you one chance, tell me, what kind of ultimate art do you want?"
One chance?
Fang Wang felt a slight disappointment in his heart but he could understand Zhou Xue, after all, you never know what's in people's hearts, let alone for Zhou Xue as a reborn person, she knew best how many times she had been betrayed in her previous life.
From the Sword Control Technique to the Solaris Scripture, and now, Fang Wang owed Zhou Xue even more.
As for the debt of saving a life, wasn't it Zhou Xue who saved Fang Wang? Without the Sword Control Technique, had Fang Wang met that cultivator, he would have been surely doomed. With his backbone, there was no way he would abandon his clansmen to escape. After all, he had already died once; in this matter, the two of them had redeemed each other.
How could Fang Wang directly tell Zhou Xue, "I possess the Heavenly Palace, you help me be invincible, and I will ensure your absolute safety forevermore?"
That's too far-fetched!
No one is the absolute protagonist of the world, even if Zhou Xue believed he had the Heavenly Palace, Fang Wang still had to consider whether the other party would harbor evil intentions.
In the end, one can only rely on oneself!
After much thought, Fang Wang felt that he wasn't lacking in cultivation techniques or spells for combat, what he needed was an ultimate art related to speed, for example, one that would allow him to run faster when facing an unbeatable enemy, so he shared his thoughts.
"The Sword Control Technique is just a basic spell in the Cultivation World, indeed, you need a technique for evasion. I'll pass on the White Rainbow Evasion Technique to you," Zhou Xue pondered and said. Seeing Fang Wang's desire to ask further, she glanced at him and said, "Don't ask me whether this technique is strong or not, you'll know once you've practiced it!"
Fang Wang felt awkward and could only nod his head.
Zhou Xue began to teach the cultivation method for the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, and Fang Wang listened intently.
Once Zhou Xue finished speaking, Fang Wang entered the Heavenly Palace without any room for refusal, looking at the magnificent inner palace, he couldn't help but sigh.
He had only been out for less than half an hour after being stifled for two hundred years, and he was back again.
There was nothing he could do about it, after all, Zhou Xue was about to leave.
He started to cultivate the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, a flying technique that allowed him to transform into a white rainbow, streaking across the sky at extreme speed, with Great Perfection he could be as fast as a white rainbow, soaring tens of thousands of miles.
The White Rainbow Evasion Technique wasn't categorized into levels like the Solaris Scripture or Jinghong Divine Sword Art, so as Fang Wang practiced, he couldn't see how far he was from achieving Great Perfection.
After sixty-three years of diligent practice, Fang Wang finally mastered the White Rainbow Evasion Technique to Great Perfection, and he was very satisfied with the final result. Indeed, he was fast as a white rainbow streaking across the sky. Moreover, as his cultivation level continued to rise, this technique would only become faster.
At least the speed he had demonstrated so far had exceeded all the flying speeds he had seen since joining the Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang's consciousness returned to reality, his vision cleared just in time to see Zhou Xue looking at him.
Zhou Xue asked jokingly, "How is it, little genius, was the technique difficult?"
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and smiled, "It was so-so, I've got it now."
"Heh heh!"
Zhou Xue couldn't help but roll her eyes, not believing him, she didn't force Fang Wang to demonstrate but instead stood up and said, "Well, I should be going. When I return, I hope you have successfully completed your Spiritual Refinement."
"Stay in touch with the other Fang Family Disciples when you have time. I have arranged for you to be dispersed across the various branches as part of a plan. Even as a one-in-a-million talent, you may still face suppression. Even the most upright sects have their struggles, and no sect is purely based on talent.
Relationships and interests are the true foundation of everything," Zhou Xue advised, fearing that Fang Wang would follow the same path as her in her previous life.
Fang Wang nodded, he was not averse to social interactions, especially with his own clan members. For now, he simply wanted to become stronger.
Afterwards, Fang Wang escorted Zhou Xue out of his dwelling; she took off on her sword directly, transforming into a white rainbow, and disappeared in the blink of an eye amidst the clouds.
White Rainbow Evasion Technique!
Fang Wang secretly assessed the technique, achieving a minor success, truly worthy of a reborn person.
Suddenly, he heard a noise from the side and turned his head to look, only to see Gu Li walking out of her own dwelling. She looked at Fang Wang with a complex expression.
Fang Wang's scalp tingled under her gaze. He smiled and nodded slightly towards Gu Li.
Gu Li also nodded back, and then departed on her sword, which made Fang Wang heave a sigh of relief. He had indeed feared she might entangle him further.
Afterwards, Fang Wang returned to his dwelling to continue his cultivation.
...
Three months later, Fang Wang's Spiritual Power reached a state of fullness, feeling that he could no longer improve, he left his dwelling to visit his master, Yang Yuanzi.
Inside Qingxin Hall.
Yang Yuanzi looked at Fang Wang peculiarly and said, "Indeed, you have reached the state necessary for Spiritual Refinement. Have you been cultivating for a full year yet?"
Fang Wang replied, "Almost."
Yang Yuanzi's mouth twitched, and he sighed, "With such talent, you should be in the first vein. The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation is powerful but very difficult to learn. The heritage of the first vein is also very strong."
"Having joined the third vein, how could I be fickle-minded? Master, rest assured, I will devote myself to cultivating and bring honor to the third vein!" Fang Wang said earnestly.
```
He made a deliberate statement, aiming to become the head disciple as soon as possible, and then to inherit the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation. Even if he stepped back, being the head disciple would also grant him more cultivation resources.
Relying on the Great Perfection's Solaris Scripture and the cave dwelling of a Direct Disciple, Fang Wang didn't immediately need resources, but he would not be complacent; he believed that the later stages would be even more difficult.
Even someone as strong as Zhou Xue had to scheme for opportunities everywhere.
Yang Yuanzi heard Fang Wang's words, but instead of smiling, he shook his head and followed up, "There are spirit molding grounds in all nine veins, but with your cultivation talent, which is rarely seen in a century, I will take you to meet the Sect Leader. The spirit molding ground at the main peak is even more effective."
Overjoyed, Fang Wang hastily thanked his master.
Thus, Fang Wang followed Yang Yuanzi to the main peak, and the master and disciple entered the Shiyuan Hall to meet the Sect Leader, Guang Qiuxian.
Guang Qiuxian, hearing that Fang Wang was about to undergo Spiritual Refinement, was not surprised, as he was well aware of Fang Wang's speed of cultivation. He stroked his beard and said with a smile, "Of course, you may. Come, there's someone undergoing Spiritual Refinement right now; you can go and take a look as well."
He stood up and led Yang Yuanzi and Fang Wang to a side hall.
Through winding corridors, they arrived deep within Shiyuan Hall, where a waterfall cascaded from the clouds into a pool. In this pool a shirtless man was undergoing Spiritual Refinement.
Standing on the corridor, Fang Wang saw a set of clothes and a book box beside the pool, immediately realizing that this man was the individual in black who had joined the Great Abyss Gate with him. Previously covered by a bamboo hat and clothed tightly, he did not recognize him at first glance.
"This young man is called Zhou Xing Shi, joined the Great Abyss Gate with you, has been defeated by you, and now has become a disciple of the second vein. Don't underestimate him; he is about to create a Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit," Guang Qiuxian said with a smile and stroked his beard, feeling proud to see more and more talent emerging in the Great Abyss Gate.
With a snort, Yang Yuanzi said, "You brought him here for Spiritual Refinement, thinking he could create an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, right?"
"Well, everyone should have their aspirations."
"Hehe, talents like Lu Yuanjun are rare to encounter even in a few hundred years; they aren't easily found."
"Oh, is that so? You have no confidence in your disciple?"
Listening to the conversation, Fang Wang felt something was off. Why did these two seem to have an undercurrent of rivalry? Could it be that they didn't get along?
No wonder the Sect Leader initially tried to prevent him from going to the third vein.
Damn, had he chosen the wrong side?
Was the third vein being marginalized by the Sect Leader?
Yang Yuanzi snorted, "You will soon find out!"
Fang Wang focused on Zhou Xing Shi, who appeared to be in his twenties or thirties, with a somewhat world-weary face. At the moment, streaks of black light swirled around him like a vortex, flowing towards the top of his head.
Above his head, a black fan slowly took shape and gradually solidified, even showing a metallic luster.
Is this a Spirit Treasure?
Fang Wang filled with anticipation. He was looking forward to his own Treasure Spirit.
Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi stopped bickering and watched intently.
After the time it took an incense stick to burn, the black fan above Zhou Xing Shi's head suddenly quivered, and waves of visible black Qi burst forth, sweeping across the pool's surface, even cutting off the waterfall. As it looked about to hit Shiyuan Hall, Guang Qiuxian raised his hand and warded it off with his Spiritual Energy.
Boom—
The black Qi wave hit an invisible wall and instantly scattered. Fang Wang's clothes billowed, and his hair was swept up; he couldn't help but look at Guang Qiuxian with internal shock.
What realm does the Sect Leader possess?
Merely this momentum made Fang Wang feel an undeniable sense of submission.
In the pool, Zhou Xing Shi slowly opened his eyes, raised his right hand, and the black fan quickly fell into his grip. Holding the fan, he showed a relieved smile.
"A Superior Mysterious Origin Spirit Treasure, impressive. It's enough to place him in the top ten among contemporary disciples," Guang Qiuxian praised.
Zhou Xing Shi got up and bowed to Guang Qiuxian, and also noticed Fang Wang's arrival.
Guang Qiuxian looked towards Fang Wang and said with a smile, "Go ahead, sit cross-legged in the pool, cultivate while visualizing the Treasure Spirit you want. The Spiritual Energy of heaven and earth here will help you shape your own Treasure Spirit."
Fang Wang nodded, immediately stepping towards the pool. Zhou Xing Shi followed, and both nodded to each other as a greeting.
Sitting cross-legged in the middle of the pool, Fang Wang took a deep breath and began to circulate his Cultivation Technique with his eyes closed.
Zhou Xing Shi did not leave after putting on his clothes but stayed to watch Fang Wang's Spiritual Refinement.
With the three onlookers, Fang Wang felt some pressure, but he quickly cast aside any distractions from the outside world.
According to the main tenets of cultivation, Lifespirit Treasures are categorized from low to high as Yellow Origin, Mysterious Origin, Earth Origin, and Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasures. Each level is further divided into Lower Grade, Middle Grade, Superior, and Supreme.
The highest grade of Treasure Spirit ever seen in the history of the Great Abyss Gate is just a Lower Grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure.
It is said that the Lifespirit Treasure of Lu Yuanjun reached the rank of a Middle Grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, breaking the historical limit of the Great Abyss Gate and being the cause of its current rise.
Shaping one's Lifespirit Treasure requires a special Heavenly Dao Spirit Stone. Only on such a stone can one sculpt their Lifespirit Treasure, and beneath the pool where Fang Wang was sitting was a massive Heavenly Dao Spirit Stone.
The reason why the Nine Great Sects dominate the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm is that they control the highest grade Heavenly Dao Spirit Stones, and not just one piece. Many Cultivation Families unable to undergo Spiritual Refinement can only send their family disciples to join one of the Nine Great Sects.
Fang Wang began to envision the form of his Lifespirit Treasure.
His first choice was a sword, as his strongest counter is currently the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
Gradually, streaks of firelight emerged from his body, swirling around him, and then gathering above his head, much like Zhou Xing Shi before.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 17 Tianyuan!_1
chapters.content:
The process of Spiritual Refinement was incredibly wondrous. As Fang Wang envisioned the sword-shaped spirit he desired, he entered a strange state of inner vision, seeing within his body a black region where flames fiercely burned, gradually taking the shape of a sword.
Fang Wang's attention was focused on this sword. At that moment, his thoughts seemed to transform into invisible hands, capable of touching the sword.
As he was engrossed in the process, the flames around him surged towards his head, condensing into a fireball.
Guang Qiuxian, Yang Yuanzi, and Zhou Xing Shi stood on the walkway, watching.
"Your disciple's Cultivation Technique is extraordinary. It's the first time I've seen such a burning aura of Spiritual Power," Guang Qiuxian exclaimed in admiration.
Yang Yuanzi remained silent; his understanding of Fang Wang was actually quite shallow.
Zhou Xing Shi, on the other hand, thought back to the battle before his initiation. He had exchanged just one palm strike with Fang Wang and had to nurse his injuries for a whole month. Even now, the memory made him shudder.
The joy of sculpting the Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit had already faded; he stared at the nascent form of Fang Wang's spirit above his head, and intuition told him that Fang Wang's spirit would certainly surpass his own.
At the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm, he could sweep him and fifty other cultivators; he dared not speculate what kind of Lifespirit Treasure Fang Wang would shape.
In his family, he had heard many tales of geniuses, but Fang Wang was the most terrifying talent he had ever encountered.
Setting aside their strength, this youngster was only at the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm a few months ago, and now he was following him in Spiritual Refinement...
Zhou Xing Shi's heart trembled, and his gaze toward Fang Wang grew ever more complex.
Time slowly slipped by.
Half an hour later.
The treasure spirit forming above Fang Wang's head had already taken on a basic sword shape, and the blazing flames around him grew increasingly immense, like fiery snakes entwining his body, even causing the water in the pool to boil, sending up billows of hot mist.
Stroking his beard, Guang Qiuxian laughed and said, "He's attained at least a Mysterious Origin."
Yang Yuanzi, with a solemn expression, said, "Reaching the Mysterious Origin grade at this stage, he may truly attain the Earth Origin grade."
His glance unintentionally fell on Zhou Xing Shi, causing Zhou's heart to skip wildly. He suddenly regretted staying to watch, but to say he would leave now was even more impossible.
Guang Qiuxian, staring at Fang Wang, proudly laughed and said, "After Lu Yuanjun, there comes another Fang Wang. Why should Great Abyss Gate worry about flourishing?"
Upon hearing this, Yang Yuanzi shook his head and snorted coldly, "Sect Leader, I advise you not to get too carried away. Don't forget the tragedy of Taiqing Gate. Great Abyss Gate attracts cultivator clans with its talents, which might lead to jealousy from other sects. One Lu Yuanjun might not cause trouble, but another might not be so certain."
Hearing this, Guang Qiuxian's smile gradually faded.
Zhou Xing Shi, upon hearing this, grew even more regretful and began pondering how to respond later.
Time continued to pass, second by second.
The sword-shaped treasure spirit above Fang Wang's head became more tangible, with fine patterns even visible. Not only that, but this treasure spirit had begun to absorb the natural spiritual energy from the surroundings.
"Earth Origin!"
Guang Qiuxian uttered two words. The ability to absorb nature's spiritual energy during Spiritual Refinement was a characteristic of an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure.
Zhou Xing Shi felt a whirlwind of emotions, his hands clenched tight.
"For such a genius to sculpt an Earth Origin Treasure Spirit... is not surprising. Why should I bother comparing myself to him..." Zhou Xing Shi consoled himself.
Fang Wang's treasure spirit continued to condense, causing Guang Qiuxian to lose his composure, his brows furrowed tight.
Yang Yuanzi narrowed his eyes, his gaze firmly fixed on Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure.
At this moment, Fang Wang was still observing his Lifespirit Treasure within that dark realm. In the darkness, his Lifespirit Treasure had already taken the sword shape he wanted, with the hilt and the guard as if entwined by a majestic Red Dragon, powerful and commanding.
Wielding such a sword would be so cool!
Fang Wang was satisfied with his aesthetic choice. Just as he was admiring his treasure spirit, he suddenly sensed something and his gaze subconsciously drifted upwards.
Above, a light appeared in the darkness, and his Heavenly Palace revealed itself.
This is...
As Fang Wang was puzzled, the gates of the Heavenly Palace suddenly swung open, and a beam of light burst forth, shooting down and striking his Lifespirit Treasure head-on.
Boom!
His sword-shaped treasure spirit was instantly extinguished. At the same time, outside, the three observers Guang Qiuxian, Yang Yuanzi, and Zhou Xing Shi saw Fang Wang's treasure spirit above his head suddenly explode, with a blast of flame spreading out.
Guang Qiuxian raised his hand, shielding the blast of flames with his Spiritual Power. His brow was tightly knitted, and his eyes showed signs of disappointment.
Yang Yuanzi frowned deeply, speaking in a heavy tone, "He failed? How is that possible? Only a Yellow Origin Treasure Spirit could possibly result in failure..."
Zhou Xing Shi, witnessing this scene, felt a mix of surprise and pity. For such an outstanding figure to fail in Spiritual Refinement was like falling from the clouds to the mortal world. He still had been looking forward to seeing how powerful Fang Wang would become after successful refinement. If successful, he might have witnessed the rise of a legend.
What a pity!
Still in a state of inner vision, Fang Wang stared at the Heavenly Palace, stunned.
What's going on?
Why would the Heavenly Palace destroy his treasure spirit?
In that moment, he panicked. Although the Heavenly Palace was present, ensuring there must be a way forward, he didn't want to play the role of a hidden dragon. In Great Abyss Gate, a Lifespirit Treasure determined one's talent and was also decisive for one's treatment.
Just when Fang Wang didn't know what to do, the gates of the Heavenly Palace didn't close. More light appeared inside, growing brighter and brighter.
"That is..."
Fang Wang looked at the intense light inside the Heavenly Palace and vaguely saw a blurry figure.
...
"I've failed!"
Guang Qiuxian said in a deep voice, his face filled with disappointment. He took a deep look at Fang Wang, turned around, and prepared to leave.
Just then, he suddenly felt something and whirled around.
Flames surged in the eyes of the three men as they watched the blaze around Fang Wang grow wildly. His robe was burned to ashes, and the water in the pool evaporated at an extreme speed, filling the corridors of Shiyuan Hall with an overpowering heat.
Yang Yuanzi was moved, and Zhou Xing Shi's eyes widened in disbelief.
Under their scrutiny, Fang Wang had turned into a man of fire, with roaring flames surging towards the top of his head and converging there.
"Is this... the re-formation of a treasure spirit? How is that possible?"
Yang Yuanzi exclaimed, unable to maintain his composure any longer.
Guang Qiuxian seemed to think of something, his pupils dilated. He took a deep breath and said, "Legend has it that when the Lifespirit Treasure is condensed, a phenomenon of Nirvana rebirth may occur. This often happens to unparalleled geniuses. Lifespirit Treasures capable of Nirvana rebirth... are a mandate of heaven!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he turned to look at Zhou Xing Shi, only to see a black fan taking shape above his head.
"My treasure spirit... why is it out of control..."
Zhou Xing Shi asked in a panic, his gaze involuntarily seeking assistance from Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian.
However, Guang Qiuxian didn't pay him any attention; he gave Zhou Xing Shi a glance and then turned his gaze back to Fang Wang in the pool.
Elsewhere.
Gu Li, who was meditating in her cave, suddenly opened her eyes. She looked up with a frown, only to see a silver sword appearing above her head.
It was her Lifespirit Treasure!
"What's going on..."
Gu Li murmured to herself, an inexplicable sense of unease in her heart as she couldn't recall her own Lifespirit Treasure. Since reaching the Spiritual Refinement realm, it was the first time she had encountered such a situation.
It wasn't just her. Those Disciples of the Great Abyss Gate flying between the peaks in the Soul Sculpting Realm were also experiencing the same phenomenon, their Lifespirit Treasures materializing above their heads. Some Disciples stopped in their tracks, variously nervous or panic-stricken.
Inside Shiyuan Hall.
The glow of fire lit the faces of Guang Qiuxian, Yang Yuanzi, and Zhou Xing Shi, all three of them in shock, incapable of keeping their composure.
Yang Yuanzi clenched his teeth and said, "My Lifespirit Treasure is also afraid..."
Guang Qiuxian's face was grim and he remained silent, but his heart was equally turbulent.
They saw that among the roaring inferno above Fang Wang's head, the shape of a Divine Weapon gradually took form. It wasn't a sword but a long polearm!
At that moment, Fang Wang, in an introspective state, also saw this long polearm.
Boom!
The darkness shattered, his consciousness flickered, and suddenly he felt his feet touch the ground. He opened his eyes in surprise to find himself inside the Heavenly Palace.
A polearm nearly ten feet long stood before him, with an elusive Azure Dragon coiling around it. The halberd was embellished with crescent blades on both sides, each a third of the length of the halberd. Between the two blades ran the body of the polearm, shaped like a coiled dragon with its maw open to the skies, spitting out the blade, and the tail as sharp as a short sword.
The body of the polearm was pitch black, emitting a faint glow.
What an imposing halberd!
Fang Wang instinctively reached out and grasped the halberd. In that instant, his body's Solaris True Fire surged out, wrapping around the polearm. Blades at both ends caught flame, and even the sharp tail end ignited. Fiery patterns covered the shaft, adding both color and a divine aura to the weapon.
The moment he grasped the halberd, Fang Wang sensed a connection to it as if it were a part of his own body.
An intense emotion urged him to name the halberd, and he slowly voiced his thought, "Heavenly Palace Halberd!"
Named for the Heavenly Palace!
In an instant, his consciousness returned to reality, and he stood up instinctively.
Under the watchful eyes of Guang Qiuxian and the others, Fang Wang rose, flames engulfing his body, and gripped the halberd-shaped treasure spirit above his head. At this moment, his stance was like that of a war deity, imposing and towering. Compared to before, he was a changed man.
Unable to help himself, Yang Yuanzi turned to Guang Qiuxian and asked, "The Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit has mysterious light, and the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure can devour nature's spiritual energy. Then... what rank should a treasure spirit that undergoes Nirvana rebirth, causing other Lifespirit Treasures to fear, belong to?"
He had a hunch, but he dared not say it aloud.
Guang Qiuxian stared intently at Fang Wang's posture and uttered two words, "Heaven Yuan!"
Zhou Xing Shi was stupefied, standing in place without noticing the murderous gaze Yang Yuanzi directed at him.
Meanwhile, all the flames around Fang Wang poured into the Heavenly Palace Halberd, revealing his figure. The ten-foot-long Heavenly Palace Halberd in his hands appeared incredibly formidable.
Fang Wang firmly planted the halberd's tail into the bottom of the pool, and a terrifying wave of energy swept out, forcing Guang Qiuxian to take action again. This time, even Shiyuan Hall trembled.
"Sect Leader, what is the rank of my treasure spirit?"
Fang Wang looked at Guang Qiuxian and asked, holding back his excitement. He could clearly feel the Spiritual Power within him boiling and transforming.
Spiritual Refinement Realm!
Guang Qiuxian, while staring at the Heavenly Palace Halberd, said, "Above the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, the exact rank, I do not know, for I have never seen a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure..."
His gaze then shifted sideways to Zhou Xing Shi.
Sensing the threat, Zhou Xing Shi took two steps back and hastily said, "I... I will never speak of this!"

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - 18: The Next Sect Leader of the Great Abyss Gate
chapters.content:
```
The Superior Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit should have been treasured by the Great Abyss Gate just like a precious gem, which was the reason Guang Qiuxian allowed Zhou Xing Shi to stay and watch the commotion. In his view, for Fang Wang to even create an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure would have been an extravagance, let alone a successful attempt.
Should he succeed, it would be perfect for these two geniuses to meet and support each other, growing together.
But as Fang Wang's Treasure Spirit surpassed the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, everything changed.
Next to the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, the Superior Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit was not worth mentioning at all!
Guang Qiuxian realized something—if news of Fang Wang's Treasure Spirit spread, the other eight major sects would definitely find ways to eliminate Fang Wang. Therefore, he must not let this information leak out.
His gaze toward Zhou Xing Shi turned increasingly colder, and Yang Yuanzi made no effort to conceal his killing intent.
Facing the murderous intent from two sect powerhouses, Zhou Xing Shi knelt down, pleading for mercy, "Sect Leader! I will never speak of this, I swear! You must believe me! I am a Superior Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit after all, I will definitely be able to make significant contributions to the Great Abyss Gate in the future!"
By the end, his forehead was pressed firmly against the ground.
He knew he couldn't escape and had no choice but to beg for mercy.
Yang Yuanzi looked toward Guang Qiuxian and coldly said, "Sect Leader, we cannot afford a single slip in this matter. If you can't bear to do it, I will!"
Guang Qiuxian remained silent.
Yang Yuanzi raised his right hand, and Spiritual Power converged in his palm to form a Sword Qi.
Seeing this, Fang Wang, who held the Heavenly Palace Halberd, spoke up, "Is there really no way to control him? To prevent him from speaking of what he saw and heard today?"
