He wasn't that kind-hearted; life and death were at stake, so he certainly wasn't going to ask Guang Qiuxian and the other to spare Zhou Xing Shi. If Zhou Xing Shi could be controlled, it would allow him to live; if not, then he would have to be killed.
The Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure filled Fang Wang with unexpected joy, but after the surprise came endless worry. The mere Earth Origin Spirit Treasure was enough for the Great Abyss Gate to soar, but to produce a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure...
The most crucial aspect was that Guang Qiuxian couldn't yet determine the exact tier of his Heavenly Palace Halberd.
In that moment, Fang Wang even worried that Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi might harbor malicious intentions.
After hearing Fang Wang's words, Yang Yuanzi glanced at Guang Qiuxian, who took a deep breath and said, "The matter of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is of great significance and must be approached with caution, but the Great Abyss Gate is not a Demonic Dao. We will do as Fang Wang says."
Upon hearing this, Yang Yuanzi couldn't help but shake his head, feeling that Guang Qiuxian was too compassionate.
Then, Yang Yuanzi stepped forward, dissipated the Sword Qi in his hand, and took out a small bottle from his storage bag. He crouched in front of Zhou Xing Shi, grabbed his jaw with his left hand, pried his mouth open, and poured the content of the small bottle into it.
Throughout the process, Zhou Xing Shi didn't resist at all, aware that this was his only chance for survival; he even cast a grateful look at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang saw that the content of the small bottle was a kind of deep crimson insect, which made his skin crawl.
"This is the Myriad Poison Spring and Autumn Worm, incurable by any medicine. When the person dies, the worms die. They are bred to be obedient.
As soon as someone recites the incantation in front of the person who ingested the worms, the Myriad Poison Spring and Autumn Worm will self-destruct, spreading its poison throughout the body and causing the person to die violently within three breaths," Yang Yuanzi explained indifferently as he stood up and looked down at Zhou Xing Shi, his face as impassive as if he were observing an insect.
Then, he conveyed the incantation to Fang Wang through a whisper.
Fang Wang appeared calm, but inside he felt it was bizarre; his own master did not seem very righteous after all, keeping such poisonous creatures.
Guang Qiuxian turned to face Fang Wang and said, "The affair of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure must be kept secret. In the future, I will not treat you with any special favor in public; I will only treat you as an ordinary disciple. However, you may come to me with any matter, and I will help you discreetly. I assure you that you will be the next Sect Leader of the Great Abyss Gate!"
Regardless of character, regardless of origin, the position of Sect Leader was promised directly to Fang Wang.
In that moment, Fang Wang truly realized the importance of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure and promptly replied, "Whether or not I become the Sect Leader is irrelevant to me. Having joined the Great Abyss Gate, I will forever be a disciple of the sect and will always be ready to go through fire and water for the Great Abyss Gate!"
Beautiful words, who can't say them?
At least make the current situation more palatable, to prevent Guang Qiuxian from harboring any suspicions.
"Only the four of us can know about this matter, Fang Wang. Don't discuss it even with your clan. The Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is indeed powerful, but you have not yet grown strong. Be sure to keep a low profile. From now on, let's say your Lifespirit Treasure is the Superior Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit," Guang Qiuxian continued, glancing towards Zhou Xing Shi, who had just gotten up.
He spoke in a grave tone, "Zhou Xing Shi, from now on, your duty is to protect Fang Wang. At his command, you shall act, and your treatment will be calculated as that of a major sect's senior disciple!"
At these words, Zhou Xing Shi hastened to thank Guang Qiuxian and then gave his thanks to Fang Wang as well.
Yang Yuanzi added, "Sect Leader, let me take Fang Wang away first. Many people have arrived outside, and we can't let them see Fang Wang."
Guang Qiuxian nodded. Then, Yang Yuanzi took out a set of clothes from his storage bag and threw it to Fang Wang.
Fang Wang hurriedly dressed and followed Yang Yuanzi's footsteps.
There was surprisingly a tunnel leading underground within the Shiyuan Hall. Along the way, Fang Wang was constantly feeling the Heavenly Palace Halberd within him.
Within him, the Heavenly Palace Halberd was located in an independent space above the Dantian, a place utterly dark. He couldn't tell if it was an extradimensional space or a spiritual space, but he could feel the presence of the Heavenly Palace Halberd and could summon it at any time.
But one thing puzzled him. The space occupied by the Heavenly Palace Halberd was quite small compared to the entire dark space and wasn't in the central position.
Could there be a second Lifespirit Treasure?
The tunnel was silent, and just as Fang Wang was full of curiosity and confusion, Yang Yuanzi's voice came from ahead, "Fang Wang, remember, don't fully trust anyone in the future, not the Sect Leader, not even your master. You can't trust me entirely either."
Fang Wang looked up at the figure of Yang Yuanzi ahead of him, unsure how to respond.
"Human hearts will ultimately change. The Sect Leader is willing to cultivate you as the next leader because his end has not yet come. When he faces his limit, what kind of wicked thoughts will arise, even your master can't imagine. In the Cultivation World, seizing Treasure Spirits and snatching bodies are not uncommon. I won't lie to you; I have harbored such thoughts before," Yang Yuanzi went on.
```
Yang Yuanzi's tone was deep and enigmatic, making it impossible to discern what he was thinking.
Fang Wang spoke up, "Thank you for the reminder, Master. Your disciple will keep it in mind. I'll never forget the kindness you've shown me and will repay it in the future."
"Is that so?"
Yang Yuanzi chuckled, without ever looking back or stopping his stride.
For the rest of the journey, he spoke no more, while Fang Wang grew anxious, fearing a sudden attack.
Fortunately, their travel concluded without incident, and upon reaching the mouth of the cave, Yang Yuanzi instructed him to return to the residence first.
Fang Wang flew away on his sword, and during the flight, he noticed that many disciples were gathering on various peaks, seemingly discussing something. It was his first time witnessing such a lively scene since he had joined the sect.
Could it be the commotion caused by the Heavenly Palace Halberd?
A tightness gripped Fang Wang's heart as he sped up.
Upon returning to the Third Vein, he landed in front of the residence to see Gu Li gazing into the distance from her own gate.
Gu Li turned to look at Fang Wang and asked, "Brother Fang, where have you returned from?"
Fang Wang answered, "I went to the Daofa Pavilion. Something seems to have happened at the Great Abyss Gate. If Miss Gu is interested, you might go and chat with the other disciples."
With that, he entered his own residence.
Gu Li showed a puzzled look, but she didn't think too much about it. She was full of confusion. What exactly happened that made her Lifespirit Treasure uncontrollable?
After closing the gates to his residence, Fang Wang went straight to the open space inside and summoned his Heavenly Palace Halberd, admiring his Lifespirit Treasure, the more he looked, the fonder he became.
Holding the Heavenly Palace Halberd, he felt a powerful emotion, as if nothing in the world could stand against him. No wonder Spiritual Refinement was so crucial to Cultivators.
He then retracted the Heavenly Palace Halberd and sat cross-legged on the white jade bed to solidify his cultivation.
He had reached the first layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm, which was also divided into nine layers. Going forward, he planned to cultivate in peace and wait out the storm.
The emergence of the Heavenly Palace Halberd had forced Fang Wang to change his approach. He could no longer solely focus on swordsmanship; he had to learn the arts of long weapons.
The Jinghong Divine Sword Art wasn't a waste, as it didn't require a sword. He made up his mind to avoid using the Heavenly Palace Halberd within the Great Abyss Gate lightly, relying on the Jinghong Divine Sword Art should be enough to sweep through competitors of the same level.
Hmm, pretend to be a Sword Cultivator!
Two months passed by swiftly.
After entering the Soul Sculpting Realm, Fang Wang's training progress started to slow down. In two months, with the aid of the Great Perfection Solaris Scripture, he had barely broken through to the second layer.
Until this day.
Fang Hanyu came to visit Fang Wang, interrupting his secluded cultivation life.
After inviting Fang Hanyu into the residence and exchanging pleasantries, Fang Hanyu brought up recent significant events at the Great Abyss Gate. It was said that at the same time, all Lifespirit Treasures of the Soul Sculpting Realm disciples had gone out of control, which led to a speculation circulating within the Great Abyss Gate.
That was the birth of a supreme treasure!
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang breathed a sigh of relief inside.
He dared not expose the grade of his Lifespirit Treasure before he was strong enough.
"Fang Wang, the reason I'm here today is... well..." Fang Hanyu said hesitantly.
Fang Wang rolled his eyes, not in a good mood, "I just can't stand your hemming and hawing. You've come all this way, you couldn't possibly hold it back, could you? Out with it. We're brothers after all."
Right, not blood brothers, so don't ask for too much.
Fang Hanyu was relieved, "I'm planning to venture out for experience, but Zhou Xue instructed me to look after the other family members, to avoid bothering you as much as possible. However, staying inside the Great Abyss Gate all the time, my cultivation can't advance rapidly. After all, I'm just an Inner Sect Disciple, and I want to seek my own opportunities out there."
"Is that the matter? Do you have a plan?" Fang Wang inquired.
Everyone has their own destiny. It was only right for the other Fang Family Disciples, who didn't have his talents and treatment, to seek their own fortunes.
Fang Hanyu nodded, "A senior sister from the Second Vein obtained a map of a secret realm, supposedly with a Great Cultivator who passed away there. Twenty-three disciples from our vein have decided to explore together, and I don't want to miss out."
Fang Wang considered it and then nodded, "Then go. I'll take care of the other family members."
Fang Hanyu smiled gratefully, thanked him, and after a few more words, he took his leave when the conversation ran dry.
No sooner had he left, than someone else came to visit Fang Wang.
Zhou Xing Shi!
Fang Wang, holding the spell to kill Zhou Xing Shi, naturally wasn't afraid of him and invited him into the residence.
Although Zhou Xing Shi wore the Dao robe of the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples, his bamboo hat, carried by the dusty aura of the road, left him looking weary. Seated at the stone table, he took out two Jade Slips from his bosom and said, "These are Superior Spell Arts given to you by the Sect Leader, suited for your treasure spirit, not to be shared with outsiders."

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 19: Body-protecting Divine Barrier, Great Celestial Thunder Technique
chapters.content:
"Not for transmission to others? What if I transmit it to you?" Fang Wang looked at Zhou Xing Shi, smiling as he asked.
Zhou Xing Shi's face changed slightly, and he hurriedly said, "Brother Fang, please don't joke with me. How dare I entertain such a wild idea?"
Fang Wang shook his head and smiled, "I'm not joking. In the future, you belong to me, and naturally, I want you to be as strong as possible. Go back, and after seven days, come to get these two Jade Slips."
After hearing this, Zhou Xing Shi was pleasantly surprised, yet he did not dare to show his happiness. He could only comply and then stand up to leave.
After taking a few steps, he suddenly remembered something, turned around, and said, "Right, the Sect Leader asked me to remind you that you can still do the usual tasks of the third vein, as they can refine your combat experience and temper your Dao heart. If you have any needs, you can look for him, but the rewards for the tasks won't change outwardly."
Zhou Xing Shi felt a profound sense of emotion in his heart; now, whenever he thought of Fang Wang possessing the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, he couldn't help but feel awe.
That was the legendary Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, after all!
In the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, there had never been a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure since ancient times.
Zhou Xing Shi would not question Guang Qiuxian's judgment, for that day his Treasure Spirit truly felt fear, and afterward, he learned that all the Treasure Spirits of the Tai Yuan Sect were uncontrollable, revealing such a fierce presence just after being formed. Apart from the legendary Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, what other rank could it be?
Fang Wang nodded, then casually picked up one of the Jade Slips on the table.
Seeing this, Zhou Xing Shi did not bother any longer and quickly left.
Once the mountain gate of the cave dwelling closed, Fang Wang looked at the Jade Slip in his hand, thinking to himself, "Zhou Xing Shi, do you truly belong to me, or to the Sect Leader? Let's see how you perform."
Yang Yuanzi's words were indeed engraved in his memory. He would not fully trust anyone, at least not internally.
Regarding the so-called "Myriad Poison Spring Autumn Worm," Fang Wang always felt there was more than just reciting the incantation; the incantation was probably only to prevent Zhou Xing Shi from making a killing move, and Yang Yuanzi certainly had other means, at least the ability to control Zhou Xing Shi's life and death from afar.
This was interesting. Zhou Xing Shi's life and death were controlled by Yang Yuanzi, yet he acted on behalf of Guang Qiuxian, and now he was also assisting Fang Wang, holding three identities, which probably made him extremely uncomfortable.
Fang Wang began to read the content of the Jade Slip with his spiritual sense.
The first thing he saw were four large characters.
Body-protecting Divine Barrier!
...
Seven days passed in the blink of an eye.
Zhou Xing Shi arrived as scheduled. Inside the cave dwelling, he held the two Jade Slips and hesitantly asked, "Are you really giving these to me? And in such a short time, you've completely memorized all the cultivation methods?"
Fang Wang nodded and said, "Remembering them is not difficult. Take them and cultivate."
For Zhou Xing Shi, it had only been seven days, but for Fang Wang, one hundred thirty-eight years had already passed.
In the Heavenly Palace, it took him forty years to cultivate the Body-protecting Divine Barrier and ninety-eight years to cultivate the Great Celestial Thunder Technique.
The Body-protecting Divine Barrier, as the name implies, was a defensive spell.
And the Great Celestial Thunder Technique was very domineering, summoning the thunder of the firmament to descend on the world and annihilate enemies, with infinite power.
Judging from the length of time spent on cultivation, Guang Qiuxian had indeed been genuine, and both were superior methods.
Ordinary cultivators spend most of their time every day gathering Qi, and the time allocated to cultivating spells hardly exceeds one-third. To master the Body-protecting Divine Barrier to the Great Perfection, it would probably take a hundred years, and that's under the condition that one's aptitude is comparable to Fang Wang's.
Not to mention the Great Celestial Thunder Technique, it is surely a Dao method that the majority of the Tai Yuan Sect disciples would not even come into contact with in their lifetimes.
As a Direct Disciple, Fang Wang could also select three superior Dao methods from the Daofa Pavilion, but he had no intention of doing so at the moment. Currently, he had enough combat techniques, so it was better to focus his energy on accumulating his cultivation level.
Zhou Xing Shi looked at the two Jade Slips in his hands, deeply moved.
That he had survived was thanks to Fang Wang's word. Now, without having done anything for Fang Wang, he was bestowed two ultimate teachings—how could he not be moved?
However, he was not the type of person who liked to express his feelings.
"Good!"
Zhou Xing Shi affirmed with a single word, bowed, and then left. Once the mountain gate of the cave dwelling closed, Fang Wang could practice with peace of mind.
It was but a case of 'borrowing flowers to offer Buddha.' If he could win people's hearts, it was naturally a good thing; if not, he wouldn't lose anything.
...
As autumn passed and winter came, the end of the year brought snow. The peaks of the Great Abyss Gate were covered with pristine white snow, lending a vast and uniquely enchanting atmosphere.
A huge Flying Sword cut through the massive snowfall, landing in front of the city gate within the huge city of the Great Abyss Gate.
Two figures jumped down from the Flying Sword, one of them being the Emperor of Grand Qi; he was in disguise, looking like a scholar.
The Tai Yuan Sect Disciple standing on the Flying Sword looked down at him and said, "Your Token only allows you to stay for a month. After one month, leave on your own, or our Enforcement Hall won't show any kindness to you."
With that, the disciple controlled his sword and left.
Once he had disappeared into the vast snowfall, the young man behind the Emperor of Grand Qi sneered, "Your Majesty, he is truly arrogant. It's simply..."
"Shut up! Do not speak rashly!" the Emperor of Grand Qi hissed in a cold voice, frightening the young man into silence, not daring to speak anymore.
The heavy snow fell. The Emperor of Grand Qi patted the snow off his head and looked up at the towering city walls with eyes full of longing as he whispered, "Let's go, let's see this abode of immortals."
In the vast expanse of snow, a master and his servant walked towards the city gate; their figures were so tiny that they seemed as if they could be covered by the heavy snow at any moment.
Elsewhere.
Atop the third vein's peak, the cave abode's mountain gate opened, and Fang Wang emerged with six of his clansmen, all chatting and laughing.
"Brother Fang Wang, we'll head off first."
"Make sure to cultivate well once you're back."
"Hehe, with Thirteen's guidance, we'll definitely cultivate diligently."
"Fang Wang, don't worry, I'll definitely become an Inner Sect Disciple!"
Fang Wang paused, watching them descend the mountain.
Having joined the Great Abyss Gate for ten months, these Fang Residence Disciples, selected by Zhou Xue, had all developed their Spiritual Power and embarked on the path of cultivation. The highest among them had reached the third layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
However, their Sword Control Technique was not yet perfected, and they couldn't use flying swords to leave the mountain, so they had to walk down on foot.
With heavy snow fluttering about, the sight of his clansmen gradually disappearing into the white expanse filled Fang Wang with warmth.
In his previous life, reading fantasy novels, he thought the path of cultivation was lonely, was desolate. Now, with these clansmen by his side, he felt a sense of reliance – the feeling was quite pleasant.
At this moment, Fang Wang suddenly understood why Zhou Xue wished to cultivate alongside the disciples of the Fang Residence; besides planning, companionship and support were equally crucial. Being alone might stimulate one's potential, but it could also be exhausting.
The neighboring cave abode's mountain gate suddenly opened, and Gu Li walked out. Upon seeing her, Fang Wang felt a headache coming on.
This girl really had her sights set on him.
Every time he emerged, she would follow him out if she was in her cave abode.
Gu Li naturally approached Fang Wang and asked, "Are they all your clansmen?"
Fang Wang could only respond politely, "Yeah, we grew up together."
Gu Li lifted her right hand, gently arranging her hair, and said, "I'm really envious of you. In our Gu Family, only I came to the Great Abyss Gate, the others joined other sects."
Cultivating families, aiming for longevity, often spread their offspring to various sects. The Fang Family had just stepped into the cultivation world and did not yet have this foundation.
The two started to chat casually. Having cultivated for a long time, Fang Wang wished to enjoy the scenery, so he continued chatting with her.
Most of the time, it was Gu Li talking, while Fang Wang listened.
"By the way, have you already succeeded in Spiritual Refinement? Why can't I discern your cultivation level – have you surpassed me?" Gu Li asked curiously, her bright, sparkling eyes fixed on Fang Wang, with an unusual glint.
Unable to withstand her gaze, Fang Wang looked into the distance and said, "Yes, I've succeeded in Spiritual Refinement – a Superior Mysterious Origin Precious Spirit."
His cultivation had reached the third layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm, not far from the fourth, while Gu Li was still at the first layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm, naturally unable to see through his level.
"What do you think my Treasure Spirit's rank is?" Gu Li blinked and asked, covering her mouth with a laugh.
Fang Wang knew it was higher than his as soon as she asked. No wonder she could become a Direct Disciple so quickly. He had previously thought the Gu Family had used their influence, but now it seemed that her aptitude was key.
It appeared that Zhou Xue was right; even without him, the Great Abyss Gate would become the strongest sect in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
"An Earth Origin Precious Spirit?" Fang Wang asked with ostensible caution.
"Mhm, a Lower Grade Earth Origin Precious Spirit. Although the rank of the Treasure Spirit is a little bit higher than yours, you've overtaken me in cultivation. Seems like your Cultivation Technique is stronger than mine. When we're about to break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm, shall we have a competition then?" Gu Li nodded, her face full of anticipation.
Well, that was her intention all along.
Fang Wang thought Gu Li had started to fancy him, but it turned out she merely didn't like to lose.
In that case, he felt unburdened and, raising his chin with a smile, he said, "Alright, you'll need to cultivate well. In the future, I'll wait for you to challenge me at each major realm boundary."
"It's a deal!"
"Mhm!"
The two of them exchanged smiles, and then Gu Li began to talk about the local customs and traditions of Northern Luo, introducing her family.
After about half an hour, a bell rang out from the third vein.
Fang Wang had heard this bell sound twice before. It signaled the arrival of a vein mission. He had previously paid no attention; a Direct Disciple could ignore these missions.
"Let's go, take a look together. Can't always be holed up in the cave abode," suggested Gu Li, and Fang Wang hesitated for a moment before nodding in agreement.
For some reason, he felt an inexplicable unease when he heard the bell, as though something unpleasant had happened.
The two flew towards the Qingxin Hall atop the mountain using their Flying Swords.
From various cave abodes on the third vein's peak, Disciples flew out, all heading toward the summit, finally gathering in front of the Qingxin Hall.
Seeing Fang Wang and Gu Li arrive, many Disciples immediately approached them with enthusiasm. Some of the male Disciples clenched their fists secretly, thinking the two had already established some relationship.
Some of the female Disciples, whose affections had been stirred, also felt secretly heartbroken – the admirable Brother Fang was taken, already having a favored consort in mind.
The eldest Disciple, Li Yu, stood on the steps, hands behind his back. Seeing Fang Wang come, he nodded towards him, his face breaking into a smile.
After a while, once most of the Disciples had arrived, Li Yu finally began to speak, "Today, I have called everyone here because a problem has arisen among the second vein's Disciples, and they need the assistance of our third vein. This mission is entirely voluntary, involving a journey into the territory of a Demonic Sect."
Second vein's Disciples in trouble?
Fang Wang's thoughts immediately turned to Fang Hanyu; he had left months ago and hadn't returned since. During a recent chat with their youngest, Fang Xin expressed her worries about him.
No sooner had Li Yu finished speaking than some Disciples questioned why the third vein should help with the second vein's problems.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 20: Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique
chapters.content:
Facing the disciples' confusion, Li Yu explained, "This matter concerns the Second Vein, so they naturally have to participate. However, their task differs from ours. They are to confront the Demonic Sect; our mission is to rescue the Second Vein disciples. After being attacked by Demonic Cultivators, that group of Second Vein disciples scattered, hence the tasks assigned to us are quite dispersed."
Zhou Bo asked, "Why did the Second Vein disciples go to the Demonic Dao territory?"
Without hiding anything, Li Yu replied, "They discovered the secret realm of a Great Cultivator from the Ji Hao Sect, so the disciples organized themselves to explore it, only to be ambushed by Demonic Cultivators."
Ji Hao Sect!
The gathered Third Vein disciples at the bottom of the steps were instantly abuzz, all apparently familiar with the name Ji Hao Sect.
Fang Wang asked Gu Li in a low voice beside him, "What is the origin of the Ji Hao Sect?"
At this point, he could be sure that it was Fang Hanyu and his group of disciples that had run into trouble.
"The Ji Hao Sect was a great sect from a thousand years ago. Grand Qi, as well as the surrounding kingdoms, were once under the Ji Hao Sect's domain. But for some unknown reason, the Ji Hao Sect fell apart, and the current Nine Great Sects all rose after its downfall.
Everything about the Ji Hao Sect is still pursued by various sects and noble families to this day, especially the heritage of the Ji Hao Sect," Gu Li answered.
Indeed, from a great family, he knew more.
As Fang Wang hesitated internally, Li Yu's voice reached them, "According to intelligence sent back by the Second Vein disciples, they discovered the legendary Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique. The mission to investigate the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique offers the highest reward. Anyone who acquires this Divine Skill can directly advance to become a Direct Disciple.
This is a common mission for disciples of all Nine Veins, but the specifics about this Divine Skill are few, so the difficulty of the mission is extremely high."
Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique?
It sounds so domineering!
Since Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure was a polearm, he had decided to focus on enhancing his physical strength in the future, and this Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique sounded perfect for that.
He asked Gu Li once more, "Is the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique very strong?"
Gu Li nodded with a look of yearning and said, "According to legend, the Heavenly Body possesses the power to move mountains and overturn seas. In ancient myths, the Heavenly Body is also one of the ancient gods, a symbol of strength, and the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique is the method to cultivate the Heavenly Body, also one of the strongest techniques of the Ji Hao Sect.
In the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, the legend of the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique has been passed down."
Move mountains and overturn seas!
Fang Wang's heart was stirred upon hearing this, and so were the other disciples, though no one stepped forward to take on the mission yet.
After pondering for a moment, Fang Wang stepped forward towards Li Yu.
Hmm, not for Fang Hanyu, but for the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
"Big Brother, I want to take on the mission!"
Fang Wang approached Li Yu and said. Hearing this, Li Yu hesitated a bit. Seeing all the disciples looking at him, he had no choice but to use the Sound Transmission Technique to remind him, "Fang Brother, this mission might be simple, but it could also be very dangerous. And that Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique is illusory and ephemeral.
As a Direct Disciple, you do not need to take such risks; it's better to let the other disciples gain the experience."
Without using the Sound Transmission Technique, Fang Wang bluntly replied, "I have a clansman in the Second Vein who likely got involved in this matter. His name is Fang Hanyu. I don't know if you have any leads on him, Brother, but I must go and save him."
Upon hearing this, Li Yu could only acquiesce. He projected his divine sense into his storage bag to search and soon raised his right hand, with a piece of Green Jade appearing in his palm.
"The last location that Fang Hanyu's Disciple Token transmitted Spiritual Energy to the Sect is recorded in this Guide Jade. It will lead you to that place; we have no more clues for now," Li Yu announced.
Fang Wang took the Green Jade, expressed his thanks, and then turned to leave.
Seeing Fang Wang join, other disciples immediately rushed forward to receive missions from Li Yu.
Gu Li approached Fang Wang and asked, "Do you need my help?"
Fang Wang shook his head, "I'm not in this purely for the mission; you should stay out of this. Focus on your cultivation, and I will wait for you to challenge me at the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm."
Gu Li nodded and without further ado, both flew back to the cave dwelling.
Once back at the cave dwelling, Fang Wang began to pack his belongings. After he was ready, he probed the Green Jade with his divine sense and immediately found himself in utter darkness. Instinctively, he looked around and saw a bright light far away from him.
This is the direction to follow!
He remembered reading about the Guide Jade in the comprehensive guide to cultivation. It was his first time using it, and he was quite curious.
Not wasting much time, once he had confirmed the direction, he placed the Guide Jade back into his storage bag and stood up to leave.
After leaving the cave dwelling, he didn't immediately depart from Great Abyss Gate but headed towards the Elixir Hall to collect all the Sect elixirs for the past six months and buy some extra healing medicines, just in case.
Half an hour later.
Fang Wang, riding a Flying Sword, left the huge city, ready to head down the mountain.
"Wait! I'll accompany you!"
A voice called out. Fang Wang turned to look, seeing Zhou Xing Shi catching up.
Seeing him appear, Fang Wang knew that he was being watched. Yang Yuanzi had certainly asked other disciples to keep an eye on his movements. It might be out of good intentions, but he had to be careful.
"Who asked you to come?" Fang Wang inquired.
Zhou Xing Shi, flying on his sword alongside Fang Wang, answered, "It was your master. He's worried you'll run into trouble on your first trip down the mountain. If we work together, at least we can look out for each other."
Fang Wang nodded and continued on without further questions, hurrying on his way.
The two sped through the vast white snow, their figures quickly disappearing into the distance.
```
In the Grand Qi Western Territory, beneath a blue sky dotted with white clouds, green mountains and clear waters combined to form a picturesque scene.
In a valley, where flowers and plants grew wild and branches and leaves were exceedingly dense, Fang Hanyu leaned against a tree trunk, his body shaded by the canopy. His robes were dirty and tattered; a piece of cloth was tied over his eyes, concealing his vision.
He tried to invoke his inner strength but couldn't help coughing violently, even coughing up blood.
"Don't move around carelessly. You've been poisoned by Green Cicada Valley, and even with my treatment, you need several years to recuperate," a female voice said.
A girl in green clothing and wearing a fox mask was squatting on a neighboring tree. Her figure suggested she was only about fifteen or sixteen years old.
Fang Hanyu, unable to see, asked, "When will I be able to walk?"
"Wait another three months. You were close to breaking every bone in your body. You should be grateful you're still alive. Don't rush it, alright?" The girl in green clothes snapped impatiently.
Fang Hanyu remained silent.
His fists clenched tightly inside his sleeves, feeling incredibly frustrated.
At this moment, he suddenly thought of Fang Wang, Zhou Xue, and other clan members from Great Abyss Gate. His thoughts turned to the Fang Residence in Southern Hills City. He tried to calm his emotions and motivate himself; he couldn't give up here.
A screech swept across the sky, startling the birds in the forest.
The girl in green clothes looked up and saw a giant demon bird flying overhead. She clicked her tongue in wonderment and said, "What on earth is it that's causing so many Demonic Cultivators to mobilize? They seem to be searching for something. Could they be looking for you? Do you have something on you that they want?"
Fang Hanyu didn't answer, appearing to have fallen asleep against the tree trunk.
"Tch, if you won't talk, then forget it. I don't want to invite trouble. Just pray they don't find us here. If they do, I can't guarantee your safety and will definitely abandon you," the girl in green clothes huffed.
Saying so, she, too, lay down on the branch, ready to nap.
Fang Hanyu tilted his head slightly as if longing to see the sky, but it had been a long time since he'd last seen light.
…
Night fell.
In the woods, Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi sat in front of a fire, their shadows elongated by the flames.
"The seasons within Great Abyss Gate are so different from in the Mortal Realm," Fang Wang remarked.
It had been five days since they descended the mountain. They were nearing the direction indicated by the Guide Jade. Fang Wang tried not to think about the possibility of Fang Hanyu being dead.
Zhou Xing Shi nodded, "The Nine Great Sects each have their own spiritual arrays. With more of nature's spiritual energy concentrated, their celestial phenomena also tend to last longer than in the Mortal Realm."
Fang Wang asked, "Did you practice the Body-protecting Divine Barrier and the Great Celestial Thunder Technique?"
Hearing this, Zhou Xing Shi revealed a bitter smile, "Those two divine skills are extremely profound. I fear it would take decades of arduous cultivation to master them."
Fang Wang, curious, pressed, "How many spells have you mastered and how many of them have you brought to Great Completion?"
"I have mastered seven spells, but only one truly reaches Great Completion, and even that is a family transmission. The path of cultivation, just gathering Qi to accumulate cultivation, requires a lot of time. It's already quite an achievement for me to bring one spell to Great Completion," Zhou Xing Shi answered honestly, his gaze shifting to Fang Wang.
He couldn't forget the sight of Fang Wang fighting alone against fifty-one cultivators. The sword strike that shocked Gu Li was definitely of Great Completion, and his cultivation technique, that terrifying flame, clearly also reached Great Completion.
Fang Wang felt much more at ease after listening. After all, others didn't have a Heavenly Palace. Even cultivators in the Soul Sculpting Realm could only bring a few spells to Great Completion. Besides his Lifespirit Treasure's grade, he also had an advantage in combat techniques.
He had mastered the Solaris Scripture, Jinghong Divine Sword Art, White Rainbow Evasion Technique, Body-protecting Divine Barrier, and Great Celestial Thunder Technique all at Great Perfection. He could attack, defend, and escape, making him well-rounded.
"According to this direction, we might encounter Green Cicada Valley and Huangyu Mountain. Green Cicada Valley is a Demonic Sect known for using poison, and Huangyu Mountain is more comprehensive. These two sects are neighbors and in constant conflict. We have to be careful and not reveal our identities," Zhou Xing Shi cautioned.
Fang Wang nodded, "I just want to find my clan. I won't act rashly."
I wonder how strong the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique is?
The Solaris Scripture could be considered inner strength, and the Heavenly Gang Divine Skill should be external strength. Possessing both, his power would soar.
Zhou Xing Shi said no more and began to sit cross-legged, gathering Qi.
Fang Wang did the same.
As the night deepened, the occasional howl of wolves sounded.
In the blink of an eye.
Three days later, Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi arrived at a market town in the wilderness. They changed into their clothes from before entering Great Abyss Gate. Fang Wang wore a well-fitting white robe and a bamboo hat given to him by Zhou Xing Shi, resembling a wandering swordsman.
Zhou Xing Shi transmitted his voice, "The spiritual energy here is richer than other places. It's probably a marketplace built by cultivators. Only mention Fang Hanyu's physical characteristics when inquiring. I have a bad feeling; it's unusually crowded here."
Having already learned the Sound Transmission Technique, Fang Wang replied and began to observe the people they passed.
Nearly everyone in the town had an aura of spiritual power. Most were below the fifth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm and posed no threat.
According to the Guide Jade, the last time Fang Hanyu made contact with the sect using the disciple's token was in this town.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 21: Meeting Zhou Xue Again
chapters.content:
Upon entering the town, Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi did not immediately ask around for Fang Hanyu's whereabouts; instead, they decided to take a look around first.
Fang Wang had previously asked Zhou Xing Shi how to distinguish the Demonic Cultivators, and Zhou Xing Shi's answer was not to judge based on appearance or aura, but rather to consider the environment and actions.
The cultivators in this town were a mixed bunch, and for the moment, it was unclear where the town's allegiances lay.
As they proceeded, Fang Wang heard the names of many sects and noble families; this place seemed truly to be a market bustling with Loose Cultivators, with shops everywhere trading Cultivation resources, and without any dedicated patrols.
"You find a place to stay, and I'll go investigate alone," Zhou Xing Shi conveyed to Fang Wang using the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang replied using the Sound Transmission Technique, "How can that be acceptable? You are here to assist me, how can I not do anything?"
"Although I come from a Cultivation family, I have been roaming the world since the age of ten and have long been exposed to the Cultivation World. I am confident I can find clues about Fang Hanyu. You are stronger than me, and if danger arises, you'll surely need to intervene.
With so many cultivators in this town, fearing a significant event might occur, it's actually better for us to act separately," Zhou Xing Shi explained using the Sound Transmission Technique.
After thinking it over, Fang Wang agreed, as he indeed knew less about the Cultivation World than Zhou Xing Shi.
Afterward, the two found an inn; once they had reserved rooms, Fang Wang went upstairs while Zhou Xing Shi left the inn to continue the investigation.
Once inside his room, Fang Wang closed the door and then sat on the bed to begin his cultivation.
Although he was only at the third level of the Soul Sculpting Realm, he was confident he could sweep through the Soul Sculpting Realm, especially since he had mastered so many Great Perfection techniques and possessed what seemed to be the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure—the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
Even though he was full of confidence, he didn't want to waste time, since even the strongest Inner Strength required time to accumulate cultivation.
Dusk fell, and the moon rose.
After nightfall, the town grew quiet, and Fang Wang occasionally sensed auras sweeping past his window. It seemed the night would not be peaceful.
As long as no one disturbed him, he was too lazy to go out and see for himself.
The night passed.
With the sunrise, the small town became lively again, the streets were very noisy, and with Fang Wang's keen hearing, he could pick up some conversations.
"Disciples of Green Cicada Valley have been found dead on the eastern bridge."
"Who did it? Could it be Huangyu Mountain?"
"These two major sects have been increasingly active recently, as if they're searching for something."
"It's said that relics of a Great Cultivator from Ji Hao Sect were found in a demon-infested area five hundred li to the west."
"That person died so miserably, even their eyes were gouged out."
In his room, Fang Wang slowly opened his eyes, realizing that news had spread, making finding Fang Hanyu even more troublesome.
The cultivation of the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique would have to wait; it couldn't be rushed.
Fang Wang pondered in his heart, deciding to leave once he found Fang Hanyu.
But Zhou Xing Shi hadn't returned all night—could he have run into trouble?
Fang Wang's gaze flickered, his mind wary of Zhou Xing Shi, worried that Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were planning something against him. But then, on second thought, he was only in the Spiritual Refinement Realm now. If Guang Qiuxian and the others truly wanted to take his treasure spirit, why go through all this trouble?
Suppressing the suspicions in his heart, he decided to wait a little longer. If Zhou Xing Shi did not return by noon, then he would have to act on his own.
Fortunately, things did not turn out as badly as he imagined; Zhou Xing Shi returned after an hour.
Once inside the room, Zhou Xing Shi closed all the doors and windows.
"The situation is dire; it's possible that our disciple really acquired a legacy. Both Green Cicada Valley and Huangyu Mountain are searching for the whereabouts of the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples," Zhou Xing Shi sat in front of Fang Wang, still communicating via the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang also inquired with the Sound Transmission Technique, "Then, do you have any trace of Fang Hanyu?"
"Four months ago, Fang Hanyu was indeed seen in this town, but he was pursued by Green Cicada Valley and ran into the deep mountains. Many of the town's long-standing merchants witnessed this..." Zhou Xing Shi hesitated for a moment, then continued with the Sound Transmission Technique, "Being chased by Green Cicada Valley for four months without returning to the sect, he is likely..."
He did not finish his sentence, but Fang Wang understood the implication.
It was more likely bad news than good!
Fang Wang frowned. He and Fang Hanyu had been close in their childhood, and regardless of that, they shared the surname Fang, and he had promised Zhou Xue he would take care of the family members.
"By the way, Zhou Xue is related to you, isn't she? Can she be trusted?" Zhou Xing Shi suddenly asked through the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and asked through the Sound Transmission Technique, "Why do you ask? Have you met her?"
"That's right, the person who killed the Green Cicada Valley disciple last night was her. Her methods are cruel, and she even used Green Cicada Valley's techniques, brutally gouging out that person's eyes..."
Zhou Xing Shi couldn't help shuddering as he spoke, his eyes filled with fear.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang felt surprised and delighted; if Zhou Xue was here, then the chances of finding Fang Hanyu were even greater.
He responded through the Sound Transmission Technique, "She can be trusted. I've been through life and death with her. You've met her; did she not notice you?"
He was suspicious; could Zhou Xing Shi's experience in the Cultivation World really compare with Zhou Xue's?
Zhou Xing Shi shook his head and was about to respond through the Sound Transmission Technique when the door suddenly pushed open, startling them as they stood. They focused their attention and saw a red-clad woman wearing a Bamboo Hat enter the room. She tilted her head back, gazing at Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi with a superior smile.
If not Zhou Xue, then who?
"You..."
Zhou Xing Shi paled, instinctively stepping in front of Fang Wang.
Zhou Xue smiled and said, "I was wondering why the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples were investigating Fang Hanyu's whereabouts. The kid has talent alright, but he started late and needs time to accumulate experience. The Tai Yuan Sect shouldn't really care about him. So it turns out that you are the person behind this, kid. How did you two end up together?"
Having not seen her for several months, Zhou Xue's grace seemed even more pronounced. Fang Wang still couldn't see through her cultivation level.
No, he must learn her method for concealing her cultivation level!
Fang Wang said helplessly, "Could you close the door before saying that?"
Zhou Xue raised her hand and the door behind her shut through the air. She made herself comfortable and sat down at the table, saying irritably, "Everyone in the inn has gone out to watch the commotion. You call yourselves cautious, knowing how to use the Sound Transmission Technique to communicate. But the fact that you dare to come here is utterly brazen.
The inheritance of the Ji Hao Sect has been leaked. Even though you've reached the Soul Sculpting Realm, it's still very dangerous."
Her gaze landed on Fang Wang, with an intensity that caused him to feel uneasy.
Fang Wang cleared his throat awkwardly and said, "If it weren't for Fang Hanyu going missing, I wouldn't have had to come. Who asked you to entrust their care to me?"
"Guarding them was within the sect, not running around outside. You haven't been in the Tai Yuan Sect for even a year and have already reached the third level of the Soul Sculpting Realm. You should be focusing on cultivation.
Maybe in ten years, you could reach the Spirit Elixir Realm, and then you would have enough strength to traverse the Cultivation World," Zhou Xue glared at Fang Wang, her admonishment laced with a touch of exasperation, as if lamenting his wasted potential.
Zhou Xing Shi moved aside, curious about the closeness between Zhou Xue and Fang Wang, but even more astonished to find that Fang Wang had actually reached the third level of the Soul Sculpting Realm.
The two had started their Spiritual Refinement on the same day, yet he hadn't even broken through to the second level of the Soul Sculpting Realm...
Was this the difference between the Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit and the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?
Fang Wang, scolded by Zhou Xue, did not get angry. Instead, he felt a vague warmth in his heart.
In this foreign land, with the fate of his clan uncertain and himself caught between a rock and a hard place, Zhou Xue's arrival brought hope to him.
After all, she was an Immortal Venerable reincarnated. Following her would surely increase his chances of survival.
"By the way, what grade of treasure spirit do you possess? Have you reached the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure?" Zhou Xue asked.
Lifespirit Treasures were special. Unless a cultivator revealed them, they were difficult for others to detect. It was said that Lifespirit Treasures were hidden within the soul, and even divine consciousness could not peer into them from the outside.
Fang Wang nodded. Before he took action in the Heavenly Palace, his sword-shaped treasure spirit indeed had the potential to reach the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure. It seemed Zhou Xue had an astute eye, accurately discerning this right away.
Zhou Xing Shi roared inside, "It's more than just an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure; it's a damn Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure!"
It was precisely because Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure was a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure that he found himself in the current awkward predicament, beleaguered and indecisive under the pressure of three others.
"Talk about Fang Hanyu. Weren't you planning to leave for a few years? Find Fang Hanyu, and I'll take him back, then you can continue to make your way in the world," she said.
Fang Wang changed the subject, saying, "The longer we delay here, the greater the danger Fang Hanyu faces."
Zhou Xue's smile faded, and she said calmly, "He's not dead. As for how I know, I can't tell you for now. I'll go save him. You should return to the main territory and wait for me somewhere safe."
Fang Wang frowned and said, "Zhou Xue, I can help you. After all, we started on the path of cultivation at the same time; our strengths can't be that different."
With Zhou Xing Shi nearby, he could not speak more openly.
Zhou Xue couldn't help but recall the night her clan was wiped out. That night, she had indeed been careless, and if it weren't for Fang Wang's intervention, she would probably have had to abandon the Fang Residence and flee alone, then like in her previous life, enter the Cultivation World carrying the burden of a bloody vendetta, rather than with the ease she had now.
"Be mentally prepared; we might encounter masters at the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm," Zhou Xue stated solemnly.
Zhou Xing Shi's eyelids twitched, his hands clenched tightly.
Fang Wang asked in surprise, "Are you saying there definitely won't be masters at the Spirit Elixir Realm?"
Zhou Xue shot him a glance and said, "According to my investigation, at least ninety percent certain."
Fang Wang immediately understood. Zhou Xue in her previous life must have been involved or knew about this matter, which is why she felt so confident. The remaining ten percent were variable factors since nothing in the world is absolute.
"Then let's go!" Fang Wang said with determination.
Masters at the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm?
He wondered if they could withstand the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, the Great Perfection Solaris Scripture, the Great Perfection Jinghong Divine Sword Art, the Great Perfection Great Celestial Thunder Technique...
Deep down, Fang Wang harbored a passion for pursuing the ultimate strength, so he was eager to know just how powerful he could be when going all out.
If they were at the Spirit Elixir Realm, then fleeing would be the best strategy, but if they were merely at the Soul Sculpting Realm, then, apologies, but his sword might prove efficient!
"There's no rush. Wait another five days. You two should cultivate here for now. I have something to do," Zhou Xue said, standing up and preparing to leave the room.
"Wait, can I..." Fang Wang quickly began to ask, but Zhou Xue didn't turn back and rapidly left the room.
She arrived quickly and left just as swiftly.
Fang Wang sighed. It seemed she had anticipated what he wanted to say.
Zhou Xing Shi closed the door and cautiously asked, "Did she really start cultivating with you? Why didn't we notice her approach before?"
Fang Wang thought to himself that the methods of an Immortal Venerable were beyond Zhou Xing Shi's imagination. He evaded the question, saying, "How should I know? Why don't you ask her?"
Zhou Xing Shi, recalling Zhou Xue's antics from the previous night, immediately shook his head.
Wait a minute!
Zhou Xue seemed like a Demonic Cultivator!
And Fang Wang...
Zhou Xing Shi felt a chill, and he dared not even look at Fang Wang anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 22: The Position of the Eldest Disciple Has Been Decided
chapters.content:
For the entire day, Fang Wang stayed within his own guest room to practice cultivation, and Zhou Xing Shi similarly remained within his room, each respecting the other's privacy, yet both harbored their own thoughts.
Fang Wang was curious about what Zhou Xue was up to, why she would gouge out the eyes of Green Cicada Valley disciples, while Zhou Xing Shi wrestled internally, contemplating that if both Fang Wang and Zhou Xue were Demonic Cultivators, Great Abyss Gate nurturing Fang Wang would be akin to digging their own grave.
However, Fang Wang treated him well, even imparting the Body-protecting Divine Barrier and Great Celestial Thunder Technique to him, which caused him much anguish.
In the days that followed, the atmosphere in Fang Town became increasingly strange; the night battles grew more frequent, and the number of corpses appearing by day likewise increased.
Fang Wang overheard Cultivators passing by in the street below, discussing how the victims were almost all deprived of their eyes.
Could it all be the work of Zhou Xue?
Why would she do such a thing, wasn't she afraid of attracting the wrath of the Great Cultivators from Green Cicada Valley?
Fang Wang believed that Zhou Xue wouldn't trap him, so he could only suppress his confusion and continue cultivating.
Five days passed quickly.
On this day, before dawn had broken, Zhou Xue came to find him, asking Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi to follow her and leave.
The three of them quickly left the town and entered the forest.
Fang Wang couldn't help but ask, "Were all those corpses with their eyes gouged out your doing?"
He always felt that her actions were not as simple as exterminating monsters; she must have been plotting something. But he was worried that Zhou Xing Shi would tell Guang Qiuxian about Zhou Xue's style of doing things. If Guang Qiuxian concluded that Zhou Xue was a Demonic Cultivator, that would be bad news.
"Hmm, isn't eradicating the Demonic Dao what we, the righteous Cultivators, should do?"
Zhou Xue, walking in front, suddenly twisted her head around to smile at Fang Wang, her expression sending chills down Zhou Xing Shi's spine.
"Then I'll tell you. Green Cicada Valley is practicing a Secret Technique called Absolute Heart Evil Eye, which requires live human eyes to cultivate the Evil Eye.
My actions are merely to mislead Green Cicada Valley into thinking it's an inside job, leading them into internal suspicion, while I also gather Spirit Stones, Elixirs, Magic Artifacts, etc., in the process of killing Demonic Cultivators," Zhou Xue turned her head back, gazing forward, and spoke calmly.
Zhou Xing Shi heaved a silent sigh of relief upon hearing this.
The explanation seemed reasonable, although he had never heard of Absolute Heart Evil Eye, at least it was an excuse he could live with.
The trio walked through the forest, not too swiftly. Along the way, Zhou Xue occasionally scattered some powder onto the roadside flowers and herbs.
Both Fang Wang and Zhou Xing Shi were puzzled but did not ask further.
Until nightfall came.
The three of them rested in the woods, with Zhou Xue calling Fang Wang aside while Zhou Xing Shi stayed by the fire, casting them only a glance.
Fang Wang followed Zhou Xue to a riverbank several miles away, where the two stood face to face. Zhou Xue frowned and asked, "That guy has the Wondrous Spring of Ten Thousand Poisons worm inside him, how did that come to be? And why does he obey you so readily?"
Fang Wang thought for a moment before deciding to share what had happened that day, although he did not reveal the grade of his Spirit Treasure.
"So that's how it is; looks like those two still had some conscience. But the Wondrous Spring of Ten Thousand Poisons worm relies on more than just a chant," Zhou Xue said in a singsong tone.
Fang Wang inquired, "Can you solve it?"
Zhou Xue laughed, "The Wondrous Spring of Ten Thousand Poisons worm is a breed of Green Cicada Valley, and having cultivated there for fifty years, I naturally can solve it. However, I can't solve it now, to avoid alerting the enemy. Before achieving the Profound Heart Realm, you must leave Great Abyss Gate, at least you can't break through within the sect.
When the time comes, I will personally guard you."
With these words, Fang Wang felt much relieved.
"Aren't you an Immortal Venerable? Why then are you fixated on the Ji Hao Sect's legacy?" Fang Wang shifted the topic, a question that had long bothered him.
Zhou Xue couldn't possibly have come for Fang Hanyu; Fang Hanyu had only sent a message to the sect, and Zhou Xue, being outside, likely didn't know he was in trouble.
Zhou Xue gave Fang Wang a sidelong glance, saying, "Although I was an Immortal Venerable before, I had not mastered all of the world's supreme arts before ascending. Don't tell me you think an Immortal Venerable can look down upon and perceive all of the Mortal Realm? You would be gravely mistaken. The Immortal Realm and the Mortal Realm are separated; it is hard to cross between them.
Mortals cannot ascend to the Upper Realm, and the mighty ones of the Upper Realm cannot descend to the Mortal Realm—it's completely two different worlds, though the Upper Realm is stronger."
"Furthermore, I came here not for supreme arts but for the special Magic Artifacts, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, and superior Spirit Stones left by the Ji Hao Sect. Even as an Immortal Venerable reborn, I need to cultivate step by step. Collecting the cultivation resources of the Mortal Realm is my task, and moreover, ascending is not so simple."
At the mention of ascension, Zhou Xue's face showed an expression Fang Wang couldn't understand.
It seemed that ascension was incredibly difficult, and even Zhou Xue, who had already successfully ascended once, didn't have absolute certainty in doing it again.
Fang Wang, however, wasn't intimidated; with the Heavenly Palace in his possession, there was always hope.
"The Cultivator who attacked the Fang Residence was named Luo Shang. Can you guess his sect or clan?" Suddenly, Zhou Xue stared at Fang Wang, her gaze cold as she posed the question.
Fang Wang furrowed his brow and ventured, "Green Cicada Valley?"
He thought of the revenge Zhou Xue had taken on Green Cicada Valley in the past few days, hence the guess.
"No, Great Abyss Gate!"
"What?"
Fang Wang was deeply moved, and his hands inside his sleeves suddenly clenched.
Zhou Xue sighed, "In my past life, I escaped a narrow death and wandered for many years. By the time I stepped onto the path of cultivation, I could no longer find any clues about the massacre at Fang Residence. Before my rebirth, I didn't even know his name.
But in Grand Qi, besides the Fang Residence, there were other Duke's Mansions and cities that were massacred by mysterious Qi Cultivation Realm cultivators. In my previous life, I only knew that it involved a collusion between the Prime Minister and the cultivation sects.
By the time I had the power to investigate, that Prime Minister had already died, and his family did not meet good ends, so the matter was left unresolved."
"Three months ago, I went to wait near another Duke's Mansion that was supposed to be destroyed and caught another cultivator. He revealed the truth. He and Luo Shang are both outer sect disciples of the first vein of the Great Abyss Gate, acting on behalf of Lu Yuanjun.
They disguised themselves as demonic cultivators, since the Soul Burning Banner is commonly seen in the Cultivation World as a ghost instrument, making it easy to conceal their identities."
Lu Yuanjun!
The top prodigy of Great Abyss Gate, a mid-grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure!
Fang Wang furrowed his brows, the vengeance for Fang Residence could not go unavenged, so many dead, how could he just let it go?
Zhou Xue continued, "I suppose Great Abyss Gate is unaware of this matter. Perhaps it even involves the Emperor of Grand Qi. In the past life, Lu Yuanjun had a good relationship with the Emperor of Grand Qi. It was with Lu Yuanjun's support that Grand Qi was transformed into a Cultivation Dynasty. I tell you these things only to caution you against Lu Yuanjun.
He is kind and always manages to attract those around him to serve him."
Fang Wang's eyes flickered, and he asked, "Are you sure it was him?"
"Hmm, the outer sect disciple confessed under duress that it was indeed Lu Yuanjun who assigned him to collect ghosts, probably because Lu Yuanjun is nurturing a powerful ghost instrument," Zhou Xue nodded, a murderous intent also evident in her eyes.
Lu Yuanjun!
For Fang Wang and Zhou Xue, he was an insurmountable mountain at present. They could not possibly accuse Lu Yuanjun; the entire Great Abyss Gate was campaigning for him.
Fang Wang took a deep breath and said, "If that's the case, then I am determined to win the identity of the leading disciple of Great Abyss Gate!"
Zhou Xue smiled and said, "Good, I knew I wasn't wrong about you. Before you become the leading disciple, let's pretend this never happened. Although Great Abyss Gate is part of the righteous path, not everyone there is good-hearted. The fate of Zhou Xing Shi is the best proof."
Just a moment ago, Fang Wang even thought of seeking out Guang Qiuxian, using the rank of his Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure to pressure Lu Yuanjun, but he quickly dismissed the thought as too risky.
Today's Lu Yuanjun was different; he was the face of Great Abyss Gate. Could Guang Qiuxian really suppress Lu Yuanjun directly?
Even if he could, it would probably only result in a reprimand. After all, could he kill Lu Yuanjun just because of a bunch of mortals?
"Tell me, what do you want to learn? I'll teach you, but remember, you can only make one request." Zhou Xue crossed her arms in front of her chest, arching an eyebrow as she looked at Fang Wang.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately said, "Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique!"
Zhou Xue couldn't help but glare at him, saying irritably, "Do you really think I know everything? In my past life, I hadn't acquired this technique. Before my ascension, I wasn't an invincible entity. There were more than a handful of people who could rival me; it's just that ascension also depends on fate."
Fang Wang smiled; he was just testing the waters. Since Zhou Xue didn't know it, he might as well learn a technique to conceal his presence.
Zhou Xue readily agreed to his request.
This technique was called Effortless Breath Technique, a supplementary Inner Strength art mainly for hiding one's emotions.
In Heavenly Palace, it only took Fang Wang ten years to reach Great Perfection. From Zhou Xue's perspective, Fang Wang's breath vanished instantly just after listening to her, and if she closed her eyes without using spiritual sense, she wouldn't even be aware that someone was in front of her.
"With this kid's comprehension, he will eventually bring down Lu Yuanjun."
Zhou Xue revealed a gratified smile; she had long been convinced of Fang Wang's talents.
Fang Wang was responsible for competing for the leading disciple position within Great Abyss Gate to further the interests of the Fang Family, while she would nurture the Fang Family. Great Abyss Gate was just a stepping stone in her plan.
…
Sunlight filtered through the gaps between the leaves, scattering mottled specks of light across the grass.
Bang!
A man dressed in a green Dao robe smashed against a huge tree trunk, shaking the ancient tree to its core. He fell to the ground, spitting out a large mouthful of blood.
A short distance away, Fang Wang retracted his leg, with Zhou Xue and Zhou Xing Shi looking on with differing expressions. Zhou Xue was full of satisfaction, while Zhou Xing Shi was shocked.
After talking with Zhou Xue three nights ago, Zhou Xing Shi always felt that there was a fierce killing intent about Fang Wang, a far cry from before.
For instance, a cultivator at the ninth level of Qi Cultivation Realm couldn't withstand a single kick from him!
Zhou Xue stepped forward, squatting in front of the seriously injured disciple from Green Cicada Valley, beginning to interrogate him.
Over these days, they had interrogated seven disciples from Green Cicada Valley and learned that this group was searching for a disciple from Great Abyss Gate. According to the description, it was very likely Fang Hanyu.
After a while, Zhou Xue snapped the neck of the Green Cicada Valley disciple, took his storage bag, and then signaled to Fang Wang and the others.
As they passed by the corpse, Fang Wang noticed the man's eyes had been gouged out as well.
He suddenly wondered if Zhou Xue was also trying to cultivate the Absolute Heart Evil Eye?
Fang Wang was not too opposed to it; Green Cicada Valley disciples were notorious, not only for using poison but also for their ruthless acts, often slaughtering villagers in rural areas. According to Zhou Xing Shi, the most cruel among the Demonic Sects were the cultivators from Green Cicada Valley, even despised by other Demonic Sects.
Zhou Xue, walking ahead and wiping her hands, said, "Fang Hanyu is probably hiding somewhere up ahead in the Demon Forest Mountain Range. The Demonic Qi here is very dense, and there may be powerful demonic beings. Be very careful."

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 23: The Next Green Cicada Valley Master
chapters.content:
Fang Wang and his two companions groped their way along, occasionally encountering disciples of the Green Cicada Valley and even suffered ambushes, but these disciples were all in the Qi Cultivation Realm, posing no real threat to them.
Another three days passed, and besides the Green Cicada Valley, they began to encounter disciples of the Huangyu Mountain. However, the Huangyu Mountain disciples were more cautious; upon seeing the trio, they chose to avoid them.
Furthermore, they encountered many Loose Cultivators scouring the forests, clearly all here for the inheritance of the Ji Hao Sect.
It was noon on this day.
Fang Wang and his companions arrived at a cliff where they could overlook the endless forest ahead. Glancing around, they could see many cultivators and even some clashing in the air.
Quite the spectacle!
This was the first time Fang Wang had seen so many disciples from different sects and Loose Cultivators gathered together, especially in the remote mountains far from human habitation.
Cultivators were not only flying with swords but also with all sorts of bizarre flying magical artifacts, and some even rode spirit demons and magical creatures as mounts, causing Fang Wang to envy them. He secretly decided that one day he must have a domineering, stylish mount for himself.
"It seems that Fang Hanyu or other disciples' whereabouts have been exposed, hence so many people have come," Zhou Xue pondered.
Zhou Xing Shi frowned, "Exposed, yet not captured; could it be that some powerful force is protecting him?"
Zhou Xue shook her head, unable to be certain.
"Ahead are not only those in the Qi Cultivation Realm, I've already sensed many cultivators stronger than me. Are we really going to rescue him?" Zhou Xing Shi continued.
Zhou Xue didn't answer, staring ahead and falling into deep thought.
Fang Wang didn't feel too pressured; he was eager to show his prowess.
As long as no experts beyond the Soul Sculpting Realm appeared, he was unafraid of the numbers of enemies in the same realm. Even if he couldn't win, he could run.
Great Perfection of the White Rainbow Evasion Technique gave him the confidence to break through encirclement and shake off pursuers!
Just then, a gust of wind blew from the east, causing Fang Wang and the others to turn their heads and see a beetle as large as a hill flying towards them. It flapped its wings rapidly, creating waves of wind that shook the trees along its path, creating a spectacular wave through the forest.
This beetle was pitch-black with eight legs and a pair of scorpion-like pincers on its head, resembling a demon insect from a demonic realm, eerie and terrifying. Standing behind the pincers was a mysterious red sedan chair.
"It's him..."
Zhou Xue squinted and mumbled to herself.
Hearing this, Fang Wang asked, "Who is he?"
"The number one talent of the Green Cicada Valley, Li Hongshuang. He is an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, but this news has not yet spread," Zhou Xue whispered in introduction.
Zhou Xing Shi frowned, "I've heard of Li Hongshuang. The Li Family is a millennium-old family, and he was the pride of the family since childhood. But he chose to join the Green Cicada Valley, enraging the Li Family. Although they ostensibly expelled him from the family records, there are rumors that this was the Li Family's arrangement."
Fang Wang asked Zhou Xue through a private message, "What realm is Li Hongshuang in now?"
"He should be in the eight or ninth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm. It will be a few years before he reaches the Spirit Elixir Realm. Once he does, his insects will evolve, making him easy to identify.
Two hundred years later, he will become the number one person in Green Cicada Valley, and fifty years after that, he will be the Valley Master of the Green Cicada Valley, becoming a leading figure in the Grand Qi Demonic Dao. It will be troublesome to encounter him," Zhou Xue answered gravely through private message.
That impressive?
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow but wasn't intimidated. No matter how formidable, that was a matter for the future. In this life, he had survived, and with the help of the Heavenly Palace, everything in the future would change because of him!
Li Hongshuang's giant insect drew the attention of many cultivators, with disciples of Green Cicada Valley immediately flying towards him like a rain of arrows coming from all directions—the scene was quite spectacular.
Seeing this momentum, there must have been at least three to four hundred disciples from the Green Cicada Valley alone, not to mention other cultivators. If their target was all Fang Hanyu, that would indeed be troublesome.
Boom!
A thunderous roar came from the horizon, accompanied by the trembling of the mountains. Li Hongshuang's insect immediately flew towards that direction.
Zhou Xing Shi looked at Fang Wang and silently prayed he wouldn't do anything foolish.
"Let's go see. If it's not Fang Hanyu, we'll leave. I've already mastered the White Rainbow Evasion Technique you taught me!" Fang Wang said softly.
Zhou Xue looked at him in surprise. The White Rainbow Evasion Technique was not a simple flying technique, by no means comparable to mundane techniques like the Sword Control Technique. This kid had already mastered it?
She knew that when Fang Wang said 'mastered', it wasn't just about being able to use it—it was Great Completion!
"Let's go have a look then. There are so many loose cultivators anyway!" Zhou Xue decided, and the two immediately chased after using their swords.
Zhou Xing Shi gritted his teeth and could only bravely follow suit.
They're both crazy!
...
In the forest, a black panther was fleeing rapidly, carrying a person on its back—Fang Hanyu. He was clutching the panther's neck tightly, his eyes still wrapped in cloth, and as the difficulty of the chase increased, his eye sockets began to bleed.
In the branches nearby, a green figure was leaping swiftly, its speed no less than the panther's. It was the green-dressed girl who had rescued Fang Hanyu. She wore a fox mask, ghostly in appearance.
"Leave me behind; don't let me involve you..."
Fang Hanyu gritted his teeth and said. During this time, although he could not see, he often heard the sounds of fighting, understanding it was the green-dressed girl and her tribespeople protecting him.
"You think I don't want to? But as soon as those people set foot in our tribal land, they started killing indiscriminately. Many of my friends have been flayed and dismembered. It's not just you I'm saving—earlier, my sister saved another disciple from the Tai Yuan Sect, and after handing him over, my sister was killed on the spot... despicable!
One day, I will destroy Green Cicada Valley and Huangyu Mountain!"
"Since it's death either way, might as well save your life, so you can return to the Tai Yuan Sect for help. Tai Yuan Sect is a righteous sect; they surely won't let this go!"
The green-dressed girl answered quickly, her words weighing heavily on Fang Hanyu's heart.
How many of his fellow disciples who embarked on this adventure with him had survived?
Falling into the hands of the Demonic Dao, even if they were alive, it would be worse than death.
Fang Hanyu was filled with hatred but could only suppress it. At that moment, he lacked not only the strength to fight but even the strength to stand.
Boom!
A deafening roar came from ahead, followed immediately by a gale that caught Fang Hanyu off guard, blowing him into the air. With a thud, he felt his waist collide with a tree trunk, and he nearly passed out from the pain.
The girl in the green dress landed, her body sliding uncontrollably backwards. She looked up and saw a trench had appeared in the forest ahead, with trees toppling to either side and dust filling the air.
A menacing, black, giant insect hovered in the air, with a red sedan resting atop its head, its curtains flickering like intense flames.
Behind the giant insect, a large number of Green Cicada Valley disciples were approaching.
A middle-aged man landed in front of the red sedan and spoke, "Senior Brother, there's a seriously injured cultivator ahead; his eyes have been gouged out. It's very likely he's one of the Tai Yuan Sect disciples who escaped from us."
A languid voice came from within the red sedan, "Bring him here and ask."
"There's a demon creature nearby..."
"Kill it then."
"Yes!"
The middle-aged man immediately turned and signaled the Green Cicada Valley disciples behind him. Immediately, twelve disciples flew towards the girl in green and Fang Hanyu using their Sword Control Technique.
The black panther that had been carrying Fang Hanyu was pinned down by a tree that had snapped in half, wailing and unable to move.
The girl in green wanted to carry Fang Hanyu on her back, but the sound of a sword cutting through the air made her jump back in fright as a long sword intercepted her path.
Seeing this, the girl in green could only flee in another direction, vanishing into the depths of the forest within a few steps.
The middle-aged man standing on the giant insect waved his hand once more, and nine Green Cicada Valley disciples immediately pursued the girl in green.
Fang Hanyu lay in front of the tree, his body hurting so much that he felt as if he was falling apart. The cloth over his eyes was soaked with blood, even dripping, presenting a particularly tragic sight.
He heard footsteps and knew the enemy was approaching him.
"I remember this guy, taking advantage of our unpreparedness, he actually threw himself over the cliff. When we went to look for him later, he was nowhere to be found."
"Oh? He's the Tai Yuan Sect disciple who escaped from your grasp?"
"Hmm, he still has some backbone. His limbs were broken, his eyes gouged out, yet he didn't beg for mercy, much more backbone than his Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters."
"Tsk tsk, look at him now, he looks just like a worm about to be crushed to death."
Hearing the Green Cicada Valley disciples' laughter, Fang Hanyu's fingers dug into the soil, filled with hatred in his heart.
Just then, a White Rainbow shot out from the forest at breakneck speed.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh...
A series of piercing sounds of slicing air rose, one after another, and Fang Hanyu faintly felt the sharp Sword Qi. Being a swordsman himself, he was very sensitive to it.
Before he had time to think, he heard the thud of bodies hitting the ground, and the Green Cicada Valley disciples' shouts abruptly ceased.
What's happening?
Fang Hanyu was extremely nervous, his body shivering instinctively.
At this moment, a figure stood in front of him, straight and tall in the sunlight, in fluttering white robes, surrounded by bodies.
It was Fang Wang!
Fang Wang, with his back to Fang Hanyu, held the Superior Grade Spiritual Weapon, Qingjun Sword; his eyes, cold under the bamboo hat, were fixed on the giant insect hovering above the forest.
"Who are you?"
The middle-aged man beside the red sedan on the insect's head asked harshly, fear filling his eyes.
Fang Wang was too fast!
He hadn't even seen how Fang Wang had made his move before the twelve disciples were all dead!
When Fang Hanyu heard this, he realized someone was rescuing him, and he gritted his teeth, "Whoever you are, don't save me. I'm already done for. Instead of being dragged down by me, you should run!"
He thought it was the girl in green or someone from her clan; he didn't want to implicate innocent people anymore.
"Dragged down? This is the second time I'm saving you. If you're broken, think of a way to recover. I'll be waiting for you to repay the life-saving grace in the future!"
A familiar voice came from ahead, causing Fang Hanyu to suddenly look up.
"Fang... Wang?"
Fang Hanyu's tone was filled with disbelief. He couldn't believe that Fang Wang would appear at this moment.
"Tsk tsk, such a terrible injury, even your eyes have been gouged out."
A mocking laugh came through, and Fang Hanyu, upon hearing it, wasn't angry. Instead, his body shook violently, feeling aggrieved for the first time, because his clanmates had arrived.
Zhou Xue had come too!
Facing torture by Green Cicada Valley disciples, he didn't feel wronged; being treated by the girl in green, no matter the pain, he wasn't scared; but only in the face of the arrival of two kin did he find it impossible to contain his emotions.
Zhou Xue and Zhou Xing Shi stepped out from the neighboring forest, and Zhou Xing Shi also felt a chill seeing the terrible state Fang Hanyu was in.
"Li Hongshuang, some believe you can become the next Master of Green Cicada Valley, but my sword disagrees!"
Fang Wang called out loud, surprising Zhou Xue and Zhou Xing Shi as they looked towards him.
After saying this, Fang Wang transmitted a message to Zhou Xue, asking her to take Fang Hanyu and leave quickly.
Zhou Xue indeed was an Immortal Venerable reborn, but Fang Wang didn't believe she was necessarily stronger than him, and since he lacked medical knowledge, it would be better to entrust the task of taking Fang Hanyu to Zhou Xue.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 24: The Astonishing 32 Swords!
chapters.content:
Hearing Fang Wang's words, Zhou Xue immediately said to Zhou Xing Shi, "Carry him on your back, I'll protect you, let's go!"
"But..."
Zhou Xing Shi hesitated; his mission was to protect Fang Wang, and he did not care about Fang Hanyu.
"Don't worry, he's very strong. Hurry up; don't hold him back!" Zhou Xue said sternly, sounding somewhat impatient.
Urged by her, Zhou Xing Shi had no choice but to carry Fang Hanyu on his back, and the two rushed into the forest, quickly disappearing from sight.
The middle-aged man standing beside the red sedan immediately waved his hand, and instantly, more than a dozen Green Cicada Valley disciples chased after Zhou Xue.
Fang Wang lifted his left hand in front of him, his index and middle fingers pressed together. In an instant, three sword shapes condensed around him and immediately surged towards the group of Green Cicada Valley disciples.
The Sword Qi ripped through the air, its speed incredibly fast!
The faces of those Green Cicada Valley disciples changed drastically. Disciples at or above the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm scrambled to dodge, while those below the seventh layer were pierced through the throat by the Sword Qi, blood spraying the sky. The remaining disciples tried to evade, but their speed was no match for the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
In less than the time it takes for three breaths, all the disciples from the Green Cicada Valley at the Qi Cultivation Realm level were killed, their bodies plummeting to the ground.
Fang Wang's gaze remained fixed on the red sedan above the Gu insects, sneering to himself: "The Demonic Dao is just the Demonic Dao, watching fellow sect members die a gruesome death yet sitting still without moving."
The middle-aged man glared at Fang Wang, enraged. Behind him, the Green Cicada Valley disciples spread out, encircling Fang Wang. Each brandished their own Magic Artifacts or Gu insects.
