Under the watchful eyes of all, White Garment Astonishing Swan slowly looked up, and beneath the bamboo hat was a fox mask—further adding to his mystery.
The newcomer was none other than Fang Wang!
Fang Wang's right hand slowly drew out the Qingjun Sword, standing proudly in mid-air as he looked down at Li Honggang and said, "Shall we have a battle to resolve our karma?"
Li Honggang slowly stood up on the hilt of his saber, his robe billowing dramatically as he raised his eyes to Fang Wang and replied in a cold voice, "Let's settle life and death and end our karma!"

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - 31: Thirty-six Swords Emerge
chapters.content:
Seal life and death, settle karma!
As soon as Li Honggang's words came out, the cultivators around the southern gate of Haixia City were all excited.
The Cultivation World is even crueler than the secular world. Although there are distinctions between righteous and demonic, cultivators prioritize their own interests. They embark on the path of cultivation not for world peace but to pursue immortality, a choice that inherently opposes nature.
"Such domineering presence, truly befitting of a cultivator from the Li Family."
"A powerful dynasty a thousand years ago, today's top-tier cultivator family, the Li Family's inheritance is truly solid."
"White Garment Astonishing Swan looks so calm, who exactly is he?"
"He can't be Lu Yuanjun, right? Lu Yuanjun no longer needs to wear a mask, it seems Great Abyss Gate has cultivated another extraordinary talent."
"I think he might be one of the Peak Masters or Elders of the Great Abyss Gate!"
Standing on the city wall, Gu Li listened to the surrounding discussions, and a smirk flickered beneath her veil. She thought to herself that he was not an elder, but a genius even more incredible than Lu Yuanjun!
Before entering Great Abyss Gate, her father often mentioned Lu Yuanjun, lamenting that Lu Yuanjun would become a pivotal figure in the future Cultivation Realm of Grand Qi. She never felt satisfied with this, always believing she was not inferior. Why didn't her father praise her?
Although she had not met Lu Yuanjun, she firmly believed in her heart that any genius seemed mediocre in front of Fang Wang and was not worthy of mention.
Listening to the discussions around her, Gu Li's worries disappeared, replaced by anticipation.
Fang Wang will definitely win!
Tang Chengfeng stared intently at Fang Wang, not uttering a word, and it was difficult to discern his thoughts from his expression.
The woman in white beside him muttered, "His figure looks fine, but I wonder if the face under the mask is good-looking."
Li Honggang's body emitted a tangible aura as he rose into the air, with no magic artifact beneath his feet. The long saber planted in the soil trembled a few times and then shot out, with the hilt smoothly landing in his right hand.
Grasping the long saber, Li Honggang fixed his eyes on Fang Wang. His robe fluttered, and his long hair danced wildly, as if possessed.
Through the eyeholes of his mask, Fang Wang's gaze was sharp. Within his pupils, Li Honggang's figure burned with flames, gradually merging with the scorching sun above.
Li Honggang kept ascending until he could look down upon Fang Wang.
At this moment, he was like the blazing sun, the aura around him reaching its peak. It even extended along the sword blade, forming a terrifying three-zhang-long Sword Qi that began to burn under the sun's illumination.
Fang Wang lifted his sword, its tip pointing upward, the blade horizontal in front of him, as various sword shapes condensed around him.
One sword!
Three swords!
Nine swords!
Twelve swords!
This scene further excited the watching cultivators. For cultivators, the admiration for swords was greater. The Jinghong Divine Sword Art was quite famous in the Cultivation World. Yang Yuanzi had once used this sword technique to enter Green Cicada Valley alone and emerged unscathed. That battle is still thrilling to many cultivators to this day.
This is also why Yang Yuanzi was able to inherit the Great Abyss Gate's ultimate technique, the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation!
When the number of sword shapes surrounding Fang Wang exceeded twenty-four, sword cultivators on the city wall even began to count them.
"Thirty-two swords! It's really the Jinghong Thirty-Two Swords!"
Someone shouted fanatically, his hand clutching the sword sheath trembling.
Thirty-two swords surrounded Fang Wang, all pointing toward Li Honggang. The combined might of the thirty-two swords made Fang Wang's momentum overwhelming, in no way inferior to Li Honggang's.
"No wonder my son died at your hands, White Garment Astonishing Swan, let me see just how powerful the Jinghong Thirty-Two Swords are!"
Li Honggang leveled his saber, pointing it diagonally at Fang Wang, his gaze condescending.
The momentum of the Jinghong Thirty-Two Swords was indeed strong, but feeling Fang Wang's momentum, Li Honggang conceived a bold idea.
Perhaps the opponent has not reached the Spirit Elixir Realm!
This speculation startled him, seeming incredible and even stirring an unprecedented fear within him.
To have such a presence without reaching the Spirit Elixir Realm, this was undoubtedly a talent more terrifying than Li Hongshuang. He could not imagine how high Li Hongshuang could climb, nor could he predict how high the future limit of White Garment Astonishing Swan might be.
Such a terrifying existence, if harboring resentment towards the Li Family, would definitely be a disaster for them!
He must be slain!
A fierce killing intent burst forth from Li Honggang's eyes, and his momentum abruptly soared, the flames on his long saber intensifying.
"Thirty-two swords?"
Fang Wang's voice suddenly came through, tinged with a hint of disdain.
Fang Wang's right wrist twisted, the sword blade facing his forehead, his eyes piercingly sharp!
Boom!
Fang Wang's momentum suddenly surged, and four swords appeared out of nowhere around him, making a total of thirty-six swords hovering in a large circle.
The power of each layer of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art wasn't just about the increase in the number of swords; the sword intent and momentum grew as well. The more advanced the stage, the addition of each new sword brought about a vastly different might!
With the emergence of thirty-six swords, Fang Wang's sword momentum soared to the sky. Even the cultivators around the distant southern gate of the city felt their hearts tremble, and many of their swords quivered in response.
Gu Li's sword case behind her trembled. At that moment, she suddenly recalled the day at Great Abyss Gate when all the Lifespirit Treasures went out of control, and her Lifespirit Treasure had a similar response.
Could that anomaly have been because of him...
Gu Li thought of the day Fang Wang had hurried back, and perhaps...
Her gaze towards Fang Wang became even more fervent, filled with expectation.
"Jinghong Thirty-Six Swords!"
Tang Chengfeng enunciated each word deliberately, his face turning solemn.
All the cultivators around the south gate were moved; they tried to calm their quivering swords while looking excitedly at Fang Wang.
Li Honggang was startled too; his eyes betrayed a panic.
Thirty-six swords!
How could it be possible!
Li Honggang's mind was shaken, his blood qi fluctuating wildly. At that moment, a strong sense of fear surged up within him. He bellowed angrily and swung his saber down.
A flame saber qi, nearly thirty feet in length, swept across the sky, unleashing a terrifying inferno and morphing into a giant fireball that resembled the blazing sun, hurtling towards Fang Wang with incredible speed!
Fang Wang's eyes hardened as he swung his sword forcefully forward. Thirty-six swords descended like rain, moving with the speed of thunder and the force of a flash flood.
In an instant, it seemed as if Fang Wang wasn't controlling merely thirty-six swords, but rather three hundred and sixty swords!
Boom—
The sword rain was relentless, sweeping across and scattering the fierce flames with an overwhelmingly domineering force. Li Honggang's eyes widened as his robe was shredded by the sword qi, unable to react in time.
Under the watchful eyes of all the cultivators, with a flourish of his sword, Fang Wang amplified the Jinghong Thirty-Six Swords, their number dazzling as they powerfully dispersed Li Honggang's Scorching Sun Slaughter Sword. They didn't even have time to see Li Honggang's movements before he was overwhelmed by the sword rain.
The vast sword rain swept past the sky above Haixia City, extending for miles before finally dissipating, leaving behind a spectacular trail in the air.
When the sword rain passed, Li Honggang was nowhere to be seen in the sky, leaving only his long saber and an egg-sized spirit pill, which was red all over and still wrapped in flames.
The long saber slowly fell to the ground, disintegrating into mist as it descended.
The dispersal of the Lifespirit Treasure signified the death of its master!
As Li Honggang's spirit pill hit the ground, Fang Wang turned and transformed into a white rainbow that swiftly disappeared into the horizon.
Haixia City fell into deathly silence.
"White Garment Astonishing Swan won!"
A man exclaimed excitedly, breaking the silence and setting off a thunderous cheer throughout the city.
Li Honggang's son, the young man in purple, along with other members of the Li Family, stood in front of the city gate, watching the scene unfold in stunned silence. The young man in purple fell to his knees with a thud, utterly disheartened.
"My God! Thirty-six swords!"
"Jinghong Divine Sword Art truly has thirty-six swords? Such a powerful sword technique!"
"I thought it would be a great battle, but who would have imagined Li Honggang couldn't even withstand a single move..."
"Who exactly is White Garment Astonishing Swan? To kill a third-layer Spirit Elixir Realm cultivator with a single stroke is simply unbelievable!"
"Another prodigy has emerged from Great Abyss Gate!"
As all the cultivators marveled, Gu Li looked in the direction where Fang Wang had disappeared, the corners of her mouth lifting slightly under her veil.
Seeing Fang Wang slay Li Honggang with a single strike did not shock her; on the contrary, she felt it was just as it should be.
"Father, you said that once a true peerless genius appears, they would overshadow everyone else. I've truly encountered one," Gu Li silently reflected, then turned and left.
Fang Wang's strength did not crush her spirit; instead, it made her even more eager to return to her sect to cultivate.
Tang Chengfeng looked towards the horizon, musing, "Zhi Xin, go to Great Abyss Gate. With the emergence of Jinghong Thirty-Six Swords, the winds and clouds of the world will change dramatically. It seems the hidden dragon of Great Abyss is truly destined to soar to the heavens."
The white-garbed woman beside him was still in shock, her gaze vacant, unable to come back to her senses.
The bright sun shone down, and the airflow above Haixia City lingered for a long time, as if the sword intent of White Garment Astonishing Swan was deeply engraved in the hearts of all the spectators, indelible.

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - 32: The Five Poisons of the North, Lu Yuanjun
chapters.content:
Above the mountain range, a white rainbow streaked across the sky; as the white light dissipated, the speed decreased, and Fang Wang's figure appeared.
No longer using the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, he flew with his Sword Control Technique, and under his mask, he breathed a sigh of relief.
It seemed like he had used only one move to kill Li Honggang, but in reality, it had consumed half of his Spiritual Power; thus, he dared not continue to use the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, lest he was attacked later on.
"The Solaris Scripture is indeed strong enough for me, at the fourth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm, to use just half my Spiritual Power to instantly kill a fully-engaged opponent at the third level of the Spirit Elixir Realm."
Fang Wang thought silently to himself, feeling that he was already quite well-rounded at the moment. If he had to point out a shortcoming, it would be the lack of techniques targeting the soul and sealing arts.
As he flew on his sword, he silently summarized his thoughts, the breeze fluttering his white garment, showcasing the awe-inspiring aura of a Sword Cultivator.
Ever since he joined Great Abyss Gate, Fang Wang had never really fought with all his strength; he had never used his Lifespirit Treasure, and the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art had been reserved as his trump card.
After this battle, Fang Wang could be sure that his strength was far above the third level of the Spirit Elixir Realm; as for his limit, that remained unclear.
Even though the Spiritual Power of the Spirit Elixir Realm was indeed higher than that of the Soul Sculpting Realm, and even though Fang Wang was using Solaris Spiritual Power, he was momentarily startled by Li Honggang's Spirit Elixir Realm Spiritual Power; fortunately, he was wearing a mask at the time.
He approached on his sword, struck with a single slash, and then soared away...
Fang Wang gave himself a perfect score silently in his heart, believing he had maxed out the setup of a master and was sure to spark a following within Great Abyss Gate.
He continued on his way.
The world around him grew increasingly silent.
Fang Wang seemed to sense something and looked up, only to see a dense forest ahead of him, with jagged peaks rising like spikes, majestic and desolate in their beauty.
At the top of five of these peaks stood a figure each; these five people were dressed in the robes of Green Cicada Valley, their bodies crawling with poisonous insects and surrounded by a miasma of toxins, creating a terrifying sight.
Green Cicada Valley!
Fang Wang slowed down and clenched the hilt of the Qingjun Sword at his waist.
"White Garment Astonishing Swan, do you realize your crime in killing a disciple of Green Cicada Valley?"
An icy female voice rang out, echoing between the peaks as if the Grim Reaper were announcing the end of a mortal's life.
Fang Wang snorted, "Green Cicada Valley slaughters my Tai Yuan Sect disciples; do you realize your crime?"
The aura emanating from these five individuals signaled danger, yet he was not afraid; it was a good opportunity to test the strength of his Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art!
Seeing Fang Wang's defiant attitude, the five Cultivators from Green Cicada Valley rose into the air, closing in on him, their surrounding miasma spreading and causing the trees below to wither rapidly, a horrifying scene.
Spirit Elixir Realm!
Fang Wang instantly judged the cultivation level of the five, aware that Green Cicada Valley, even while contesting other sects for the Ji Hao Sect's legacy, could still spare five individuals to ambush him—worthy of being one of the Nine Great Sects.
"To harm a disciple of Tai Yuan Gate, do you wish for death?"
An icy shout suddenly came through, followed by Fang Wang sensing an overwhelming presence sweeping in from the horizon. He turned to look and saw a lightning bolt racing towards him, upon which stood a figure.
It was a handsome man dressed in the Tai Yuan Sect disciple's robe, with a purple crown on his head, and two locks of long hair beside his cheeks. His features were striking, and there was a sharpness between his brows; his eyes were bright and piercing, and at his waist on each side hung a Treasured Sword, with a golden halo floating behind him, casting a faint glow.
"Lu Yuanjun!"
A female Demonic Cultivator from Green Cicada Valley gritted her teeth as she spat out the name.
Hearing this name, the eyes under Fang Wang's mask narrowed.
Lu Yuanjun, his feet on the lightning, came swiftly and stopped in front of Fang Wang, alone against the five Spirit Elixir Realm demonic cultivators.
His right hand rested on the scabbard, and he slightly lifted his chin, looking down disdainfully at the five, "Great changes are impending in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm; I don't want to kill you, so as not to affect the cooperation between our sects. Begone!"
Upon hearing this, the five demonic cultivators immediately halted, exchanging glances and communicating through eye contact.
Fang Wang observed Lu Yuanjun's silhouette, secretly gauging the latter's aura.
Very strong!
Clearly, he was of a different caliber compared to the five Cultivators he had just faced!
Li Honggang was even less of a match!
Why had Lu Yuanjun come?
```
Fang Wang's eyes sparkled as numerous speculations flashed through his mind.
"I didn't expect Great Abyss Gate to send you out, fine, I'll give Lu Yuanjun some face, but if we encounter him again, we won't let things slide!"
An elder from Green Cicada Valley coldly snorted, and after speaking, he left with his sleeves fluttering, the other four people fiercely glared at Fang Wang before following the elder.
They left swiftly, disappearing in less than the time it takes for three breaths.
Lu Yuanjun turned around to look at Fang Wang, his face showing an enthusiastic and sunny smile as he laughed, "Junior Brother Fang, you truly have great skill, Soul Sculpting Realm killing Spirit Elixir Realm, in the history of Great Abyss Gate, not a single disciple has been as powerful as you."
Hearing Lu Yuanjun mention his surname, Fang Wang understood that it was Guang Qiuxian who had sent him.
The news about Fang Wang inheriting the White Garment Astonishing Swan's thirty-six swords had not spread, and although Fang Residence was nearly annihilated by Lu Yuanjun's disciples, Lu Yuanjun did not order anyone to keep an eye on Fang Wang, probably fearing the issue would escalate.
Fang Wang spoke, "Thank you, Senior Brother Lu, for the rescue."
Lu Yuanjun waved his hand, "Those five guys are the Five Poisons of the North from Green Cicada Valley, all with cultivation between the fifth and eighth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm. They might have a notorious reputation, but with Junior Brother Fang's talent, in less than twenty years, no, maybe in less than ten years, killing them will be as easy as slaughtering chickens and dogs."
Looking at Fang Wang, his gaze was full of appreciation, and his smile even more enthusiastic.
It had to be said that if the truth behind the annihilation of Fang Residence were unknown, Fang Wang would actually find this senior brother quite agreeable, his words were comforting, and his gaze and expression did not seem feigned.
"Senior Brother overpraises me."
"Hahaha, Junior Brother is modest, I understand, I understand. Let's go, I'll escort you back. It's an order directly from the Sect Leader. When we return to the Great Abyss Gate, if you have any trouble in the future, or want to learn something, or want anything, just come find me."
Lu Yuanjun laughed heartily, with a bold tone.
Fang Wang hesitated deliberately, "Senior Brother, may I not return? I've found a blessed land that may contain hidden secrets, and I would like to study them for a while before returning to Great Abyss Gate in a few months."
The reason he did not speak of Fang Hanyu was that he feared Lu Yuanjun might directly ask to go to Fang Realm, as for healing, surely Great Abyss Gate was more convenient.
Speaking of opportunities was an easier excuse.
What cultivators care most about is opportunity, even among fellow sect members, no one would disturb another's opportunity. It was a rule in the entire Cultivation World: infringing on someone's opportunity was as egregious as killing one's parents, unshareable under the same sky.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yuanjun furrowed his brow slightly, "Junior Brother, is that opportunity worth the risk?"
Fang Wang nodded.
Seeing this, Lu Yuanjun took out a stack of Talisman Paper from his storage bag and threw it to Fang Wang through the air; they were tied up with two red strings, which prevented them from scattering.
"These are high-grade talismans. Just channel your Spiritual Power into them, and three breaths later, they will explode. All of them exploding together can kill a Great Cultivator at the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, of course, you have to be close enough. Junior brother, your strength is extraordinary and you have your own judgment, so I will not intrude.
Take these things, I'll pursue the Five Poisons of the North and harry them for a few days to prevent them from turning back to trouble you."
After speaking, Lu Yuanjun left, his speed even faster than that of the Five Poisons of the North.
Very decisive!
Without any hesitation!
Fang Wang, holding the Talisman Paper in his hand, could not help but recall Zhou Xue's evaluation of Lu Yuanjun.
This person indeed has a charismatic personality, never boasts, only acts. If there were no family enmity, Fang Wang would undoubtedly owe him a debt of gratitude.
Fang Wang did not dwell on it further and continued to fly away with his Sword Control Technique.
He did not head straight for Fang Realm afterwards, instead, he looped around the vicinity, making several large circles for days, then discarded the Talisman Papers Lu Yuanjun gave him in a forest before finally rushing to Fang Realm.
That deep night.
Fang Wang returned to Fang Realm; he opened the mountain gate mechanism and entered the tunnel.
Once the mountain gate was closed, he rested directly in the tunnel to prevent Lu Yuanjun from discovering Fang Realm.
The next morning, Qing Wan'er came to the tunnel and, upon seeing his figure, burst with joy. She immediately rushed over and asked, "Fang Wang, you're back, did you win?"
Fang Wang opened his eyes and laughed, "I barely managed to win, but it took a lot out of me, that's why I rested here last night."
Qing Wan'er looked him over, marveling, "That's really impressive, defeating a Spirit Elixir Realm cultivator after just one year of cultivation. Not to mention you, Fang Hanyu's talent is also quite extraordinary. Just what is the origin of you Fangs?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang stood up and smiled, "Oh? Has Han Yu achieved something?"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - 33: The Fang Family Trio
chapters.content:
Fang Hanyu's talent is exaggerated?
Upon hearing Qing Wan'er's words, Fang Wang didn't question them; instead, he was filled with anticipation. After all, Fang Hanyu had fitted himself with the Absolute Heart Evil Eye, which was a pair of eyes meticulously prepared by Green Cicada Valley.
Moreover, Zhou Xue had also said that after replacing his eyes with these, Fang Hanyu would be reborn from Nirvana, his talent surpassing his past self by far.
Even though he believed it, when he truly witnessed Fang Hanyu's talent, he was still astonished.
At noon, Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu sparred by the lakeside.
After a month's absence, Fang Hanyu's cultivation had advanced by another level. Now, with the cloth that covered his eyes removed, and as his figure flitted back and forth, his eyes shone with a blood-red light. Because his movements were so fast, they seemed like two extending, shifting bloodlines, eliciting occasional exclamations from the distant watching beasts.
Fang Wang wasn't fighting seriously, he was simply acting as a sparring partner. He felt that Fang Hanyu's reaction speed could already match up to the ninth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm.
Every time he increased the intensity of his attacks, Fang Hanyu would adapt after a while and catch up. Most crucially, Fang Hanyu was able to learn the sword techniques Fang Wang used rapidly.
Is this the Absolute Heart Evil Eye?
Fang Wang became more interested in Fang Hanyu's eyes and began to use the basic moves of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
When he executed the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, it appeared that he directly formed a sword shape, but in reality, it wasn't that simple. The normal Jinghong Divine Sword Art required sword moves to lead it, but he, having reached the Great Perfection Realm, had achieved mastery and was able to do it so simply.
The sword technique for each cut of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art was different.
As Fang Wang's sword moves began to change, Fang Hanyu also started to imitate them; the movements of the two were almost in sync.
What did this imply?
It indicated that Fang Hanyu's observational abilities were extremely strong, especially his eyes—they moved too quickly, dazzling onlookers.
Upon closer inspection, Fang Hanyu's pupils were the color of blood, while the eyeballs were green. At first glance, he looked quite like a fierce ghost, extremely terrifying.
It had to be said that after fitting the Absolute Heart Evil Eye, Fang Hanyu's entire persona had changed. He had a more aggressive air than before, giving Fang Wang the impression that he belonged to some demonic sect.
A good half-hour passed.
Fang Hanyu stopped, kneeling on the ground with one hand on his sword, gasping for air, already drenched in sweat.
Fang Wang stood in front of him and looked down at him, asking, "How much have you learned?"
"I've memorized all of it, but haven't fully mastered it yet," Fang Hanyu said between breaths, looking up at Fang Wang with a spirited gleam in his eyes.
The sunlight shone on the two, making the scene appear somewhat surreal to Qing Wan'er.
She had a premonition that in a hundred years, these two would become famous throughout Grand Qi.
Fang Wang reached out his hand, Fang Hanyu smiled, took his hand, and was pulled up.
"Your eyes are no trivial matter. In addition to enhancing your talent, they've greatly strengthened your body."
"Yes, any movement appears very slow in my eyes. Moreover, for some reason, I can remember everything after just one look, and my body can smoothly mimic the motions. The only issue is that my heart can't help but surge with a killing intent that will have to be controlled later on."
"Remarkable. Your experiences and transformations would make you the main character if they were put in a story."
"Main character?"
"Yeah, from now on, me, Zhou Xue, and you, let's be the three main characters of the Fang Family. Zhou Xue will handle the strategies and manage the Fang Family, you'll be responsible for killing the enemy, sweeping aside all obstacles. The trio in stories often accomplish great things!"
"What about you?"
"I'm responsible for being invincible."
"..."
Although Fang Hanyu was rendered speechless, his heart was actually quite excited. He felt as though he had been acknowledged.
The first batch of cultivator disciples from the Fang Family all looked up to Fang Wang and Zhou Xue. He had been a genius since he began his martial training, but ever since the start of cultivation, he couldn't catch up with the two and always felt a compulsion to do so.
Fang Hanyu took a deep breath and said earnestly, "Alright! From now on, whomever you two want me to kill, I'll kill, without questioning the reasons!"
With green eyes and red pupils, coupled with slightly disheveled long hair, even in broad daylight, Fang Hanyu had the aura of a ghost from the mortal realm.
"Continue your training and aim to reach the stage where you can perform Spiritual Refinement."
```
Fang Wang spoke softly with a chuckle, "He wasn't in a hurry to return to Great Abyss Gate at the moment; the spiritual energy of Fang Realm was not inferior to that of his cave abode. It would be better to cultivate Fang Hanyu here, and after returning to Great Abyss Gate, Fang Hanyu could train the other Fang Family disciples.
In this way, he would have a group of trustworthy and useful people at Great Abyss Gate."
What came next was the need to develop well, to become stronger himself, and to make his clanspeople stronger so that they could challenge Lu Yuanjun in time!
Lu Yuanjun was not simply a genius; aside from being powerful himself, the support behind him was certainly deep.
With this thought, Fang Wang was filled with a fighting spirit.
…
In the midst of the wilderness, an inn sat by the side of a large river, with cultivators occasionally landing and others departing.
The inn was large, three stories high, with smoke curling up from the kitchen.
At this moment, in the center of the first floor, a middle-aged man dressed like a scholar held a folding fan and exclaimed passionately, "In the battle of Haixia City, White Garment Astonishing Swan struck down Li Honggang with a single sword. The astonishing Sword Qi remained lingering in the sky for a long time.
That strike seemed to sever karmic ties but actually ignited cultivators' pursuit of the Sword Dao!"
"White Garment with a fox's face, Astonishing Swan ascends in the Mortal Realm!"
As his voice fell, the surrounding cultivators burst into cheers, the battle achievements of White Garment Astonishing Swan always stirring the blood of cultivators.
Seated at a table in the corner, Fang Yin, the father of Fang Wang, expressed his amazement, "White Garment Astonishing Swan is truly incredible; I never expected the Cultivation World to be as exciting as the martial fraternity."
Zhou Xue, sitting opposite him wearing a bamboo hat, smiled slightly and said, "White Garment Astonishing Swan is indeed formidable. With such a talent in Great Abyss Gate, it is thoroughly taking off, and our Fang Family can benefit from it."
A young man sitting beside them curiously asked, "Younger Sister, have you ever met White Garment Astonishing Swan?"
Zhou Xue shook her head, then added, "How could I have contact with such a figure? Enough now; don't inquire about him. With the widespread reputation of White Garment Astonishing Swan, be careful not to be overheard by his enemies, who might think we're associated with him."
Upon hearing these words, the young man shrank his neck, and the elders beside him gave him disapproving looks.
"How far are we from Fang Realm?" Fang Yin inquired.
Zhou Xue responded, "Before we go to Fang Realm, we must first visit another place to prepare for the construction of Fang Realm and also to add to the Fang Family's combat strength."
Hearing this, the people of the Fang Family showed no concern; they all appeared eager. Since Zhou Xue had led them away from Fang Residence, after several months on the road, her actions had won their unconditional respect, even the elders regarded her as the leader.
Fang Yin sighed, "I haven't seen Fang Wang for so long. That kid always had many ideas since he was little. I hope he doesn't offend anyone when he gets to Great Abyss Gate."
The others consoled him, all praising Fang Wang for his sensibility.
Zhou Xue smiled silently and quietly picked up her tea cup, savoring the aroma of the tea.
…
At Fang Realm, by the lake.
Fang Wang was meditating, gathering Qi while keeping an eye on Fang Hanyu nearby. Fang Hanyu, facing the lake, was channeling his powers. The spiritual energy turned into mist, condensed around him, attempting to form a dragon shape, but at present, it looked more like a bloated python.
"The Absolute Heart Evil Eye is really powerful, this kid has already caught a glimpse of the threshold," Fang Wang thought to himself, realizing why Zhou Xue had harvested so many eyes. It was indeed strong.
Had it not been for witnessing Fang Hanyu's madness, almost leading to a massacre, he might have actually wanted to acquire a pair of Absolute Heart Evil Eyes for himself.
Two months ago, in the night, Fang Hanyu had a cultivation mania, suddenly becoming possessed and wanting to slaughter the beasts within Fang Realm. Fortunately, Fang Wang managed to stop him in time, knocking him unconscious. After that, Fang Hanyu did not suffer another possession, but it left a seed of worry in Fang Wang's heart.
What quality of Lifespirit Treasure would Fang Hanyu forge with the Absolute Heart Evil Eye?
Fang Wang was looking forward to it.
It had been five months since his return to Fang Realm; Fang Wang's cultivation had reached the fifth level of Soul Sculpting Realm, while Fang Hanyu had reached the eighth level of Qi Cultivation Realm, soon to break through to the ninth level. Once he reached the ninth level of Qi Cultivation Realm, Fang Wang planned to take him back to Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang believed that with his own talent, Guang Qiuxian would probably accept Fang Hanyu and provide a way to suppress the Heart Demon.
After some time,
the mist around Fang Hanyu dissipated, and he turned to look at Fang Wang, sighing, "Fang Wang, this technique is too difficult to master. What level have you reached? Can you show it to me?"
Fang Wang replied with a laugh, "Even if I showed it to you, you wouldn't understand. This technique is incredible, after all, it's a legacy of Ji Hao Sect. Don't pry anymore, lest it scares you."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - 34 Contribution Ranking
chapters.content:
Hearing Fang Wang's words, Fang Hanyu thought for a moment and still chose to trust Fang Wang. The commotion caused by Ji Hao Sect was too great; it was best that he knew nothing about it, to avoid trouble.
Fang Hanyu took a deep breath and then said, "Fang Wang, you're already seventeen, right? If you weren't cultivating, your fifth uncle would probably have celebrated your birthday for you."
Fang Wang laughed and said, "We're all pursuing immortality, so why care about birthdays? In the future, we're going to live for hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of years. Only such round-numbered birthdays are worth celebrating for us."
A smile appeared on Fang Hanyu's face as he started to reminisce with him about the past.
Time passed quickly during the days at Fang Residence.
Over one more month had passed, and Fang Hanyu had reached the ninth level of the Qi Cultivation Realm. The rapid progress was enough to prove how powerful the Absolute Heart Evil Eye was, and because of this, Fang Wang decided to return to the Great Abyss Gate.
Before leaving, Fang Wang admonished Qing Wan'er to go out as little as possible and wait for Zhou Xue to return.
The Fang Residence was now well-developed, with storied buildings lined up along the lake and many spiritual grasses and flowers planted in front of the mountain cliffs, with the spiritual energy also continuously increasing.
"Don't worry, we won't make a mess of things," Qing Wan'er nodded and said. After experiencing the incident with Li Honggang, she decided to cultivate seriously and not always rely on others for protection.
Fang Wang didn't waste words and left with Fang Hanyu.
To conceal the Absolute Heart Evil Eye, Fang Hanyu put on a white cloth strip again to cover his eyes; he had already cultivated divine consciousness and could see with it.
And so, Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu left the Fang Residence and departed on flying swords.
Along the way, Fang Wang thought of teaching the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, so he increased his speed, and Fang Hanyu did his best to keep up.
For cultivators, the journey from the western territory of the Qi Dynasty to the Great Abyss Gate only required a few days. The further in they went, the fewer demonic cultivators they encountered. After donning the robes of Tai Yuan Sect disciples, they encountered no trouble on their way.
Four days later.
The two of them returned to the Great Abyss Gate using the guidance of their disciple tokens.
After returning to the Great Abyss Gate, the two did not part ways. Fang Wang took Fang Hanyu straight to the main peak to meet the Sect Leader in front of Shiyuan Hall.
"Come in,"
The doors of Shiyuan Hall opened, and the voice of Guang Qiuxian came from within.
Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu immediately entered the hall. Inside, Guang Qiuxian was meditating on a meditation cushion, eyes closed, like an immortal from heaven, with an aura of Immortal Aura and Daoist Bones.
Fang Wang saluted and then narrated Fang Hanyu's experiences without any concealment, including the part where Zhou Xue bestowed the Absolute Heart Evil Eye on Fang Hanyu. This was the outcome of discussions with Zhou Xue, who had told him to be honest because she had her own ways of dealing with it.
It didn't take long for Guang Qiuxian to open his eyes, his eyebrows furrowing and his gaze turning cold.
As a Sect Leader, how could he remain indifferent upon hearing that his disciple had suffered such painful torment?
After Fang Wang finished speaking, Guang Qiuxian slowly said, "The Absolute Heart Evil Eye, like the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, was created by ancients based on ancient physiques. It has the effect of defying the heavens and changing fate. Green Cicada Valley has possessed the method of cultivating the Absolute Heart Evil Eye for a hundred years but has never succeeded.
I didn't expect you to succeed. It seems the expert behind Zhou Xue is not simple."
"In a lifetime of cultivation, besides the sect, one also needs many benefactors. The Great Abyss Gate respects each disciple's fate, and although the Absolute Heart Evil Eye is considered part of the Demonic Dao, it does not wholly belong to Green Cicada Valley."
Guang Qiuxian raised his sleeve, and a jade slip flew out, landing in Fang Hanyu's hand, and said, "This is my decree. Go to the Technique Pavilion to collect the Clear Heart Mantra; it can effectively suppress your innate urge to kill."
Fang Hanyu quickly nodded and said, "Thank you, Sect Leader."
"In the future, continue to cover your eyes to avoid unnecessary troubles. I'm not talking about being ostracized by fellow disciples but being discovered by Green Cicada Valley; you should understand that there will always be spies of the Demonic Dao within the righteous sects," Guang Qiuxian advised.
Fang Hanyu responded and, seeing Guang Qiuxian wave his hand, he took his leave with a salute.
Only Fang Wang and Guang Qiuxian were left inside the hall.
Guang Qiuxian revealed a smile, abandoning his previous Sect Leader demeanor. He glared at Fang Wang and huffed, "You brat, stirring up so much trouble in just one year since joining the sect. I sent Lu Yuanjun to pick you up; why didn't you come back?"
Fang Wang said helplessly, "Sect Leader, I had no choice. I couldn't ignore the suffering of my kin."
"White Garment Astonishing Swan, what a formidable reputation, even more prestigious than when Lu Yuanjun first rose to fame. As the Sect Leader, I'm naturally delighted, your fame will benefit the Great Abyss Gate, but speaking as an individual, I hope you won't act recklessly.
Focus on cultivating diligently; too many talents have perished young, and only those who survive can become the powerhouses of this era," Guang Qiuxian said earnestly.
Fang Wang nodded and replied, "Thank you for the guidance, Sect Leader."
Following that, he prepared to spend time accumulating his cultivation.
"The Thirty-Six Swords of Astonishing Swan, tsk tsk, you've already surpassed your master. Hahaha, whenever you see your master next time, make sure to keep him happy. That man, he's quite petty. I remember when I was chosen as the Sect Leader, he was sullen for a very long time, ignored me for a good ten years..."
Guang Qiuxian began to share his old stories with Yang Yuanzi, painting him as a petty and straightforward junior brother.
Fang Wang listened intently, at the same time analyzing the true nature of their relationship.
For a long while.
Once Guang Qiuxian had finished his endless stories, Fang Wang asked, "Sect Leader, who is Lu Yuanjun's master? Is he a Peak Master?"
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and smiled, "Lu Yuanjun has two masters. One is a Peak Master, and the other is me. Why do you ask?"
Fang Wang smiled and said, "After meeting Brother Lu, I found him to be a truly good person, surely to become a fine Sect Leader in the future. But Sect Leader, you also intend to train me as the next Sect Leader, so I'm somewhat torn."
He was probing.
Guang Qiuxian replied with a smile, "Becoming the Sect Leader isn't just about being a good person. A fine Sect Leader must undergo intense struggles, be powerful enough, and command respect. If you wish to compete, I can offer my support in private to give you an edge over Lu Yuanjun, but you need prestige. At the very least, the disciples in the sect must believe you qualify to contest with him.
When the entire Great Abyss Gate believes you are more suitable than Lu Yuanjun to be the Sect Leader, that will be the time for me to cede my position to you."
"You don't need to worry about your relationship with Lu Yuanjun. A sect cannot have only one strong person. Losing the position of Sect Leader doesn't mean a complete fallout. Just like your master and I, regardless of who wins or loses, both of you are the pillar of the next generation in the Great Abyss Gate."
Guang Qiuxian advised him on many aspects and even taught him how to vie for the position of sect's chief disciple.
Half an hour later.
Fang Wang left the Shiyuan Hall and flew towards the Sect's Main City.
Along the way, he pondered Guang Qiuxian's words. Guang Qiuxian seemed supportive, but in reality, he was instilling a concept: no matter the competition, keep the harmony. This indicated that Lu Yuanjun held significant weight in Guang Qiuxian's heart, and even with Fang Wang being the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, Guang Qiuxian was not willing to give up on Lu Yuanjun.
From a disciple's perspective, such a Sect Leader is commendable, but from Fang Wang's point of view, it was a major obstacle. He and Lu Yuanjun could not possibly be on good terms!
If not for Zhou Xue's resurrection, without his mastery of the Sword Control Technique, he would surely have perished in a deadly battle on the night of the clan's destruction, along with everyone in the Fang Residence.
This vengeance was a breath stuck in his chest that he could not release.
Fortunately, Fang Wang had long known that Lu Yuanjun was behind the night of the clan's destruction; otherwise, Lu Yuanjun's warmth could have tormented him.
His struggle for the position of chief disciple was not for power, but simply to surpass Lu Yuanjun so that one day when he draws his sword against Lu Yuanjun, the entire sect could only acquiesce, or at least tolerate it!
After entering the city, Fang Wang flew towards the Task Hall.
The Task Hall was one of the busiest places in the city. The hall, which had nine floors, was bustling with disciples coming and going.
Fang Wang sheathed his sword and landed, walking into the Task Hall. He was ready to turn in the head of Li Hongshuang.
Within the Great Abyss Gate, aside from the basic disciple benefits, if the disciples wished to upgrade their dwelling standards, obtain cultivation techniques, elixirs, magic artifacts, etc., they had to rely on contributions, which are earned through various tasks.
Tasks ranged from eliminating demonic cultivator heavyweights to cultivating medicinal herbs, and each task's difficulty came with different levels of contribution as recorded in the Core Cultivation Codex.
Even the most talented disciples need to continuously undertake tasks to build prestige, especially since promotions to high ranks are extremely contribution dependent.
In the process of carrying out continuous tasks, the bond between the disciple and the sect grows deeper. Even demonic spies will find life difficult upon returning to their own ranks after killing too many demonic cultivators for the sect.
Entering the main hall, the capacious chamber came into view. As he walked in, he saw ten pillars, with nine surrounding one central giant pillar, each one displaying glowing characters representing various disciples' names and their contribution levels.
The Contribution Pillars tracked the contribution rankings of each lineage's disciples, including the elders. The central giant pillar represented the overall contribution ranking of the whole Great Abyss Gate. Those who were ranked on the main pillar were the sect's powerhouses.
The existence of the Contribution Pillars was one way to elevate the fame of disciples, ensuring that those who dedicated themselves quietly did not go unrecognized.

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - 35: The Identity of the One in White, The Emperor's Cultivation
chapters.content:
"Senior Brother Fang, you've come back to turn in your task?"
A surprised voice came from the side, prompting Fang Wang to turn his head and look.
Fang Wang gazed at the speaker, pondered for a moment, and nodded, "Yes, you're here too—what a coincidence."
This time, leaving the Great Abyss Gate seemed to have been but a few months, but when including the time spent cultivating the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, he had actually been away for two hundred years. Apart from those close to him, he couldn't remember the people he'd met only once or twice.
The other person came closer, warmly making conversation with him.
As they chatted, Fang Wang recalled who it was—wasn't this Zhou Bo? Always so enthusiastic every time they met.
After chatting for a good while, Fang Wang finally found an opportunity to excuse himself. He glanced at the main pillar, where the name of Lu Yuanjun had already reached the top twenty. It's worth noting that most names ahead belonged to figures like Peak Masters and Elders, who had lived for hundreds of years.
Fang Wang made his way to the fourth floor and found the study of the Elder of the Task Hall. As a Direct Disciple, he could meet with the Elder directly.
The study was large, filled with various Magic Artifacts, while against the wall stood bookshelves lined with countless books and Jade Slips.
"You're Fang Wang, right, the first disciple in the history of the Great Abyss Gate to become a Direct Disciple upon joining. I'm quite curious about you; from now on, just call me Elder Zhang."
Elder Zhang of the Task Hall said with a chuckle. He was chubby and appeared simple and honest, yet Fang Wang had seen his name among the top ten on the main pillar.
"Elder Zhang, I have a task to turn in, but I'm afraid the news might spread, putting me in danger. Can we just record it without making it known?" Fang Wang respectfully said.
Elder Zhang stroked his beard and smiled, "Don't worry. The Task Hall only records contributions and doesn't spread gossip. Besides, I'm here to handle your task personally, what's there to worry about?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately felt relieved and then took out a cloth bag from his storage bag, placing it on the table.
Elder Zhang wasn't startled but watched him with a smile.
Fang Wang untied the cloth bag, revealing Li Hongshuang's severed head. Apart from the blood being coagulated, it seemed as though she had died only a few days ago, with no signs of decomposition.
Elder Zhang glanced at it without much concern, but his eyes soon widened.
"Huh? Is this... Li Hongshuang?"
Elder Zhang was startled, quickly picked up Li Hongshuang's head to examine it and then looked up at Fang Wang with shock in his voice, "Are you the White Garment Astonishing Swan?"
Seeing the White Garment Astonishing Swan wouldn't have surprised him, except that this figure had only joined the sect a year ago...
A year ago, Fang Wang was merely in the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm!
With only the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm, he had swept through fifty-one cultivators of the same realm. This news had long been discussed among the elders, and every Peak Master was envious of Yang Yuanzi for his good fortune in having such a talented disciple. Although Elder Zhang was the Elder of the Task Hall, he too wished for a genius disciple like Fang Wang.
As they grow old, and their cultivation reaches its limit, their pursuits, besides defying fate, are to find a suitable successor to ensure their legacy endures within the sect.
A year ago, he had been at the seventh layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm and had executed Li Hongshuang, who was at the ninth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm...
The most crucial part was that this event took place several months prior, and the latest feat of the White Garment Astonishing Swan was defeating Li Honggang of the Spirit Elixir Realm Third Layer...
Elder Zhang had been in his position for one hundred and fifty years; what kind of achievements hadn't he heard of?
Yet he was still startled by Fang Wang...
His gaze towards Fang Wang was as if he were looking at a monster.
Fang Wang coughed artificially, interrupting Elder Zhang's thoughts, and Elder Zhang exclaimed with a sigh, "Twenty-five years ago, the Li Family came to visit our sect and Li Hongshuang was among them. At that time, our Sect Leader had predicted that Li Hongshuang had the potential comparable to Lu Yuanjun.
The Li Family also intended for her to join our sect, but to think that in the end, she joined the Green Cicada Valley and, more lamentably, met her demise at the hands of one of our disciples."
Fang Wang didn't know how to respond and could only nod with a smile.
Afterward, Elder Zhang requested his Disciple Token to record the contribution points. Li Hongshuang was a famous talent in the Demonic Dao, and the task involving her had always been available, meaning Fang Wang could turn it in directly, even if he had not previously accepted it.
Aside from that, Fang Wang also turned in the task of rescuing Fang Hanyu. When a disciple returns to the Great Abyss Gate, their Disciple Token is checked, with these tokens linked to a sect-defining Magic Artifact. All tasks within the main city's halls connect to this Magic Artifact. In short, Elder Zhang could confirm whether Fang Hanyu had returned.
Fang Wang tried to turn in other identity tokens belonging to the disciples of the Green Cicada Valley, which Zhou Xue had selected.
After half an hour of administrative work, Fang Wang finally left.
Elder Zhang sat in his chair, unable to calm his emotions for a long time.
"White Garment Astonishing Swan... Seventeen years old... Less than two years into cultivation and already able to kill someone in the third layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm... A monstrous talent... No wonder the Sect Leader values him so highly. It won't do, I must do something for him..."
Elder Zhang silently thought, after the shock had passed, his heart filled with boundless anticipation.
Before his time was up, could he witness a Great Abyss Gate like none ever seen before?
Meanwhile.
Fang Wang arrived on the first floor, where he paused beside a main pillar, his gaze settling on the name of Lu Yuanjun. Following Lu Yuanjun's name was a string of numbers, marking his contribution points, exceeding three million.
After completing his task, Fang Wang's contribution points were just over nine hundred. Li Honggang was not considered an enemy of the Great Abyss Gate, so he did not fall within the scope of the task.
Fang Wang simply glanced at it and then withdrew his gaze, lifting his feet and walking away.
In the grand hall, amidst the hustle and bustle, Fang Wang was inconspicuous, much like the names below Lu Yuanjun's, lost in the multitude of lives.
...
Upon returning to his cave dwelling, Fang Wang began his cultivation routine.
He was not lacking in spells now, so he focused on practicing and gathering Qi, aiming to reach the ninth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm as soon as possible.
Time flew by.
Half a year passed.
Fang Wang reached the sixth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm. Such a rate of breakthrough, if known, would surely cause a huge stir in the Great Abyss Gate.
One afternoon, Fang Hanyu, accompanied by six Fang Family disciples, came to visit Fang Wang, making the cave dwelling lively with their presence.
Seeing his clan members, Fang Wang was very happy. After sitting down, they began to share their experiences.
They were all Fang Family disciples selected by Zhou Xue. Now, the weakest among them had reached the third layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm. Compared to Fang Wang, they were like heaven and earth apart, but in reality, cultivation was difficult.
Many outer sect disciples of the nine veins struggled for decades and could hardly surpass the fifth layer of the Qi Cultivation Realm, let alone reach the Soul Sculpting Realm.
Fang Hanyu had succeeded in Spiritual Refinement, his Lifespirit Treasure being a top-grade Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit, which made the Fang family extremely proud.
Fang Wang, however, felt somewhat disappointed. Anything less than an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure no longer caught his eye.
"Thirteenth brother, what grade is your treasure spirit?" Fang Xin asked curiously, the others looking at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang smiled, looking at Fang Hanyu, who immediately said, "Don't ask anymore. It's definitely higher than mine, but too high can be a bad thing. Attracting murderous disasters is easy. Remember, do not mention Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure to outsiders."
Upon hearing this, everyone quickly nodded in agreement.
Fang Hanyu had a serious expression, but internally he was as restless as if scratching at his heart. He was more curious than anyone about the grade of Fang Wang's treasure spirit, yet the young man simply wouldn't reveal it.
Fang Zigeng, who had reached the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation, spoke up, "By the way, do you know about the Emperor of Grand Qi entering the Great Abyss Gate to cultivate?"
The others joined in the discussion.
"I know. It has already spread to the seventh vein. They say that the Qi Dynasty is transforming into a Cultivation Dynasty, but who knows if it's true."
"With the emperor entering the sect, won't he have to address us as senior brothers and sisters?"
"Tsk, I thought that after cultivating, we would be above imperial power. I didn't expect the imperial power to start cultivating too."
"It is said that the emperor gave up a lot to gain the agreement of the Great Abyss Gate. The Task Hall has seen a surge in tasks for mining spirit mines and searching for spirit veins. The emperor's concessions must be behind this."
Listening to their discussion, Fang Wang raised an eyebrow.
Zhou Xue had mentioned before that Grand Qi would become a Cultivation Dynasty. He did not expect it to come so quickly.
On second thought, it was now just the emperor embarking on cultivation. If the cultivation method were to be truly promoted to all the people, it would take at least decades of effort.
Zhou Xue suspected that the dealings between Prime Minister of Grand Qi and Lu Yuanjun might involve the shadow of the Emperor of Grand Qi. After all, in the predetermined future, the Emperor of Grand Qi and Lu Yuanjun had a very close private friendship and reached the pinnacle of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm together.
Now hearing about the Emperor of Grand Qi's induction into the Great Abyss Gate, Fang Wang suddenly thought of a possibility.
The cultivator who attacked the Fang Residence held a Soul Burning Banner, a Ghost Instrument that collected souls. Orthodox sects did not allow disciples to wantonly kill mortals. Could it be that the emperor was willing to sacrifice civilians to enter the Great Abyss Gate, in exchange for Lu Yuanjun's recommendation?
As for why the Fang Residence was chosen, it was probably a matter of convenience. On the surface, it seemed to be a power struggle within the court, and at most, it would tarnish the reputation of the imperial power as cruel.
If it were discovered that the emperor intended to sacrifice an entire city's population for cultivation methods, the matter would become serious, and the world would surely be in turmoil!
Fang Wang remained silent, listening to the family conversation and sorting through his thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - 36 Jin Xiao Sect, Nine Veins Combat Method
chapters.content:
```
Whether it was the Emperor of Grand Qi who chose to sacrifice the Fang Residence, or it was Lu Yuanjun who chose to massacre the Fang Residence, or perhaps it was just their subordinates who targeted the Fang Residence, none of that mattered.
The extermination crisis of the Fang Residence was inseparably linked to them.
Now that the Fang Residence still stood, Fang Wang didn't rush to seek revenge. What he aimed to do was to diligently cultivate until he was strong enough that no one would dare protect his enemies.
After chatting for a while, the Fang Family Disciples began to discuss matters of the Cultivation World. The disturbances caused by the Ji Hao Sect had already ceased, and neither the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique nor the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art had been obtained by anyone, at least not publicly. All the participating Nine Great Sects had suffered casualties.
"Recently, a mysterious sect called the Jin Xiao Sect appeared in the Cultivation World. They say that during a contest for a Magic Artifact among the Great Abyss Gate, Taiqing Gate, Green Cicada Valley, and Ancient Demon Mountain, a powerful Jin Xiao Sect practitioner forcefully entered the scene.
He stood alone against the elders of four sects, seized the Magical Artifact, and departed triumphantly. Tsk tsk, now there are rumors that the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm will no longer have just the Nine Great Sects, but ten."
Fang Mo marveled with a face full of longing.
They were all young men and women in their prime, who didn't want to make a name for themselves, who didn't want to become a celebrated figure worshipped by the masses?
Fang Wang listened with rapt attention.
Two hours later, the clan members prepared to leave. Before departing, Fang Wang distributed all the Spirit Stones and Spiritual Energy pills he had received to them, leaving them deeply moved.
After stepping out of the cave abode's gate, Fang Wang watched them fly away on their swords.
Although only half of them had mastered the art of sword flying, it was enough to carry the others down the mountain.
The last time they had parted, they had to walk down the mountain.
Fang Wang felt more emotional than the Fang Family Disciples did, because for him, it had been much more than a year since he had last seen them.
Boom—
The door to the adjacent cave abode opened, and Fang Wang glanced over to see Gu Li walking out. However, judging by her attire, it was clear she was going out, and not coming to see Fang Wang.
"You've finally returned,"
said Gu Li with a smile, wearing a sword case on her back as she approached Fang Wang. She sized him up, her eyes filled with admiration.
Fang Wang smiled and asked, "Miss Gu, are you heading out on a long journey?"
Gu Li nodded and said, "There is a family matter. They've called me back."
Suddenly, Fang Wang remembered that when he first joined, Zhou Xue had mentioned that in twenty years, the Gu Family would no longer exist...
If it had been the person he was before, he surely would not have cared, but having known her for so long, and with Gu Li having specifically sought him out, he clearly understood the affection she held; the thought of Gu Li possibly dying along with her family made his heart sink.
However, fortunately, it was twenty years away. When Zhou Xue returned, he would make a point to inquire thoroughly.
After a brief exchange, Gu Li left on her sword and quickly disappeared into the vast fog surrounding Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang stood in place, gazing thoughtfully towards the horizon.
If Zhou Xue had not been reborn, he might already be dead and would never have met Gu Li, who might also die along with her family. Their destinies were originally two parallel lines that should never have crossed, yet now they were entwined. This proved that fate could change.
But even someone as powerful as Zhou Xue, who ascended to become an Immortal Venerable, met with the demise of both body and path, forced to cultivate anew. Could Cultivation truly offer carefree immortality?
Is immortality and everlasting life achievable?
After a long while.
Fang Wang withdrew his gaze and turned back into his own cave abode.
The Path of Immortality was a path he had to explore himself, to seek its true meaning.
...
As spring passed and autumn came, in the blink of an eye, two years went by.
The Great Abyss Gate was once again greeted with heavy snow. The snowflakes danced in the sky as Disciples bustled through the snow and fog, appearing small and weak amidst the vast and violent snowstorm.
Within the cave abode.
Fang Wang was practicing his cultivation; two years had passed, and he had reached the eighth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm. At this moment, he was making a breakthrough to the ninth layer.
The Solaris True Fire swirled around him, and the Heavenly Palace Halberd revealed itself above his head, faintly visible.
Suddenly.
He opened his eyes abruptly, flames flashing in his gaze. A powerful blast of air erupted, shaking everything within the cave abode.
```
Gu Li, who resided in the cave dwelling next door, seemed to sense something and opened her eyes to look over.
"He has broken through again?"
Gu Li inwardly felt a shock. She had come back last year, but she hadn't seen Fang Wang in that year. When she saw that Fang Wang was in seclusion, she too began to cultivate in solitude, not wanting to fall too far behind.
She marveled at Fang Wang's natural talent, then suddenly thought of her father's words, and her expression dimmed.
Meanwhile.
Fang Wang's breakthrough was successful, and he stepped into the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm. He began to practice his techniques to regulate his breath.
A full seven days passed before his breath completely stabilized. By now, his Spiritual Power was about ten times that of when he had faced Li Honggang, bolstering his confidence immensely.
Exhilarating!
Fang Wang didn't get up to rest, instead he continued to cultivate.
Upon reaching the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm, he vaguely felt a change in the Treasured Spirit Space within him. He wasn't clear about the specifics, so he wanted to investigate further.
When he had just stepped into the Soul Sculpting Realm, he suspected that he could condense a second Lifespirit Treasure, but he couldn't be certain.
Half a month later.
Suddenly, the bells of the third vein rang out, and not just from the third vein – the peaks of the other veins rang out one after another, awakening all the disciples who were cultivating.
Fang Wang took out his disciple token, and the voice of Yang Yuanzi came from it:
"All disciples, including direct disciples, gather immediately in front of Qingxin Hall!"
Fang Wang immediately put his disciple token into his storage bag, then stood up, straightened his robes, and, holding the Qingjun Sword, walked out of his cave dwelling.
As he left his cave dwelling, he saw Gu Li.
Gu Li nodded slightly to him and then flew into the sky on her sword.
Seeing her leave without saying a word made Fang Wang feel somewhat unaccustomed. He then saw Gu Li stop mid-air, look back at him, and ask, "Brother Fang, why aren't you moving?"
Fang Wang shook his head with a wry smile and followed her on his sword.
The two flew side by side toward the mountaintop. Figures flew out from the entirety of the third vein, all heading to the summit. The sight was magnificent.
They traveled fast, without speaking along the way, and quickly arrived in front of Qingxin Hall. As soon as they landed, a group of disciples crowded around them, led by the eldest disciple, Li Yu.
Fang Wang and Gu Li became the subject of the surrounding disciples' teasing. Gu Li did not rebut, making it awkward for Fang Wang to clarify without embarrassing her.
"Eldest brother, what's going on that's causing such a commotion?" Fang Wang asked when the opportunity arose.
Li Yu said, "It should be the Nine Veins Combat Method. It was originally scheduled for three years later, but with the Grand Qi Dynasty soon transitioning into a Cultivation Dynasty, it's been brought forward. It's said that after the Nine Veins Combat Method finishes, there will be a great opportunity."
This statement made the other disciples even more curious.
A great opportunity?
Fang Wang was very interested in the Nine Veins Combat Method. The general guidelines of cultivation recorded that every ten years, the Nine Veins disciples would engage in combat to compete for their vein rankings. The higher the rank, the more cultivation resources they'd obtain. Many of the senior disciples had once been the strongest in a session of the Nine Veins Combat Method.
Great Abyss Gate, being one of the Nine Great Sects, had spies from various sects and noble families. Whoever stood out in the Nine Veins Combat Method would rise to fame in the Cultivation World. This was how Lu Yuanjun became famous. After his fame, the Great Abyss Gate announced he was a mid-grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, elevating his prestige even further.
More and more disciples rushed over, none daring to join the conversations of the sword-wielding or direct disciples. The open space in front of Qingxin Hall formed into various circles.
"The Emperor has arrived!"
Someone said, prompting everyone to turn their heads. Fang Wang did the same.
They saw the Emperor of Grand Qi, dressed in the robes of a sword-wielding disciple, flying over on his sword. He was tall and upright, with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes. Despite the heavy snow that fell upon him, it could not conceal his figure; an aura like that of a dragon seemed to radiate from him, setting him apart from the surrounding disciples.
The Emperor, named Zhao Zhen, ascended to the throne at thirteen. He was the third Emperor of the Grand Qi Dynasty. Qi Gaozu founded the dynasty, but passed away due to illness less than ten years into his reign. Zhao Zhen's father ascended at thirty, but died less than two years into his rule.
Therefore, although Zhao Zhen was young, he was already the longest-reigning Emperor of the Grand Qi Dynasty.
Under the gaze of the disciples, Zhao Zhen walked forward leisurely and came before Fang Wang, Li Yu, and the others, raising his hand in greeting and smiling, "Zhao Zhen greets his senior brothers and sisters."
His gaze swept over them, and when it passed over Fang Wang, it did not linger.
Li Yu responded with a warm smile, "Junior Brother Zhao, there's no need for such courtesy. And yes, this is your senior brother Fang Wang, he comes from the Fang State Duke's Mansion of Southern Hills City. You should get to know each other better, especially since he was once a subject of yours."
Zhao Zhen's gaze then turned toward Fang Wang, revealing a warm smile, "The Duke of Fang has established great military merits for Grand Qi, for which I hold immense respect. Now that the Fang State Duke's Mansion has produced a proud son of heaven like Senior Brother Fang Wang, in the future the Fang Residence will surely become a Cultivation family, pursuing immortality."

chapters.title: Chapter 39 - 37 Spirit Elixir Realm
chapters.content:
```
Facing Zhao Zhen's smiling face, Fang Wang responded with a smile as well, saying, "If Grand Qi can become a Cultivation Dynasty, then there will be many more cultivating noble families, and for that, we would have to thank your efforts."
Zhao Zhen nodded with a smile, and then Li Yu began to introduce the others to Zhao Zhen.
Throughout the process, Zhao Zhen showed no arrogance befitting an emperor, while the other disciples were all very interested in this Heavenly Son.
On this land, dynasties change, and whenever a dynasty is renamed, the prefix of the Cultivation World would change accordingly. Though they cultivate, they cannot completely detach from mortals; the Qi Dynasty serves as the foundation for the Grand Qi Cultivation World.
Cultivation seeks resources, and mortals are the tools through which cultivators extract resources, with cultivators themselves emerging from among these mortals.
Many disciples had been mortals who seized an opportunity to step onto the path of cultivation. Before they began their cultivation, royal authority was regarded as untouchable and exalted as the heavens themselves.
Now, seeing the Emperor as their fellow sect member, most disciples inevitably felt a bit disconcerted.
More and more disciples arrived, making the area in front of Qingxin Hall lively and noisy.
The number of Third Vein disciples exceeded ten thousand, of which seventy percent were Outer Sect Disciples. Under the arrangement of Direct Disciples, they stood on the lower slopes, waiting for Yang Yuanzi to speak.
It was the same with the other veins; all of the disciples gathered together, and Fang Wang could hear cheering from the neighboring peaks from time to time, though he wondered what could make them so happy.
A little while later.
The doors to Qingxin Hall opened, and Yang Yuanzi slowly walked out.
"Pay respects to Master!"
Li Yu's voice suddenly rang out, drowning all other voices. As soon as these words were spoken, all the disciples turned around and saw Yang Yuanzi, subsequently bending over to pay their respects.
"Pay respects to Master!"
"Pay respects to Peak Master!"
The voices of tens of thousands of people came together, shaking the very heavens.
Yang Yuanzi's gaze swept over the Direct Disciples and Sword-bearing Disciples in the front rows, then turned towards the various levels of disciples in the back. Most of them were excited to see him, struggling to contain their emotions.
"Today, I have summoned you all for one reason. One month from today, our Sect will hold the Nine Veins Combat Method. The reason for the advance notice is that the Nine Great Sects have already come to an agreement, and the righteous and demonic paths will join forces to promote the transformation of Grand Qi into a Cultivation Dynasty."
Yang Yuanzi said, speaking calmly, but these words caused the disciples to cast their gaze toward Zhao Zhen.
Zhao Zhen's expression remained unchanged, as if all of this had nothing to do with him, the Emperor of Grand Qi.
"The Nine Veins Combat Method consists of two stages. The first stage is competition among the disciples of each vein, where the Peak Master will select nine disciples to compete against those from the other eight veins.
The second stage will involve one-on-one battles among the Nine Veins disciples, ranked by the number of victories, and the strongest nine disciples will represent Great Abyss Gate in the grand opportunity organized by the Nine Great Sects."
Yang Yuanzi briefly introduced and did not elaborate on the grand opportunity.
He paused, then continued, "In the next three days, Li Yu, you personally select the combatants. Fang Wang does not need to participate in the assessment and will directly represent the Third Vein. Very well, from now on, your Senior Brother Li Yu will organize everything. Fang Wang, follow me into the hall."
Having said that, Yang Yuanzi turned and entered the hall, regardless of the disciples' clamor.
Fang Wang immediately followed him. He felt many eyes on his back, but he was not intimidated; on the contrary, he was pleased. It would have been too much of a waste of time to fuss for three days.
Those disciples who did not know Fang Wang began to inquire among those beside them, quickly learning that Fang Wang was the first-ever prodigious talent to become a Direct Disciple upon entry, and their confusion and indignation dissipated.
Zhao Zhen watched Fang Wang's retreating figure, still wearing a smile, but his hands clenched tightly within his sleeves.
After entering the hall, the doors closed.
Fang Wang approached Yang Yuanzi, who had already sat down, staring at him with an expressionless face.
"Master, have I done something wrong?" asked Fang Wang, feigning confusion. He remembered Guang Qiuxian had said that Yang Yuanzi was very petty.
Yang Yuanzi snorted, "You're quite bold. Do you still have regard for me, your Master? Do you remember what I've told you?"
"Of course, I dare not forget for even a moment!"
```
Fang Wang had long forgotten; after all, it had been over two hundred years.
"I told you to cultivate diligently and to stay out of trouble, what have you done? You just reached the Soul Sculpting Realm and are already battling at the ninth layer, and then you even battled someone at the third layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm!"
Yang Yuanzi scolded angrily, in a tone that spoke of disappointed yet hopeful expectations; Fang Wang hastily apologized, incessantly making promises.
After scolding for a while, Yang Yuanzi revealed a contented smile and said, "However, your battle record has not brought shame to your master, which is quite impressive!"
Fang Wang immediately started to flatter, "It's all thanks to Master's excellent teaching."
"No, I haven't really taught you anything. You have already surpassed me."
"Disciple has only had the good fortune to comprehend these skills. In the future, I will still need Master's guidance and the transmission of more skills."
These words made Yang Yuanzi feel even more pleased. In fact, he had felt envious at times, mainly because Fang Wang had managed to execute the astonishing thirty-six strikes, while he had only reached the twenty-seventh. However, with Fang Wang's humble attitude—not showing an ounce of arrogance and even making him feel somewhat ashamed—
As a master, he had felt jealousy towards his disciple during troublesome times, which was truly unworthy of a teacher's role.
"Fang Wang, your talent is unmatched, and I truly cannot guide you much. But since we are master and disciple, whatever you wish to do in the future, I will support you with all my might. I have requested permission from the Sect Leader for you to train in the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, but even the Sect Leader cannot agree so easily because it would not comply with the rules.
In the coming days, you should strive to contribute to our sect, and if you need me to speak on your behalf, just let me know," Yang Yuanzi said deeply, his gaze filled with expectation as he looked at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang quickly responded, "Thank you, Master. I'm preparing to break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm. Could Master perhaps offer some guidance?"
The Solaris Scripture mentioned the Spirit Elixir Realm. To enter this realm, one must have external aid. The better the crafted Spirit Pill, the more helpful it is for future cultivation and the smaller the chance of facing Heart Demons, so advancing to the Spirit Elixir Realm cannot simply rely on Qi Gathering.
The expression on Yang Yuanzi's face turned odd as he asked, "Have you already reached the ninth layer of the Spiritual Refinement Realm?"
Fang Wang, accustomed to concealing his aura, had prevented Yang Yuanzi from perceiving his true cultivation level.
Confronted with his master's inquiry, Fang Wang slowly nodded, causing Yang Yuanzi's mouth to twitch.
He had made an exception for Fang Wang to join the Nine Veins Combat Method because of Fang Wang's combat achievements. Little did he expect that Fang Wang's cultivation level had already reached the ninth layer of the Spiritual Refinement Realm. That would mean Fang Wang's strength...
This kid had been in the sect for only three years!
Yang Yuanzi, who had lived for more than three hundred years, couldn't help feeling inferior at this moment.
Guang Qiuxian was right; compared to Fang Wang, he truly was mediocre.
After taking a deep breath, Yang Yuanzi slowly began to speak: "The Spirit Elixir Realm can be directly cultivated, but if you can find Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures to temper your bones and condense your Spirit Pill, it would be beneficial for enlightening the Dao in the future.
Here's something I'll tell you in advance: during the recent struggle over the heritage of the Ji Hao Sect, a blessed land was discovered on the borders of Grand Qi. It harbors countless Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.
We had to consider collaborating with others because we detected the presence of Cultivation Sects from other Dynasties, making us inclined to jointly seize this blessed land."
"If you stand out in the Nine Veins Combat Method, you will be able to go to that blessed land. Once inside, whatever you obtain will be yours. Of course, if you are unable to secure one of the nine spots, I will collect for you," Yang Yuanzi explained.
Now that things had come this far, Fang Wang naturally had to express his stance. He immediately replied, "Master, rest assured, I will do my best to make Master and the Third Vein proud!"
Yang Yuanzi showed a pleased smile and said, "Even Disciples in the Spirit Elixir Realm are not guaranteed to stand out. However, I do have some expectations for you. If you can secure a good position for the Third Vein, all the disciples of our vein will be indebted to you, which will aid you in your future contest for the position of chief disciple."
No matter how strong a talent is, it's meaningless if not put to use!
The Third Vein is currently ranked second to last. Yang Yuanzi seems indifferent, but he is, in fact, holding back a sense of frustration.
The master and disciple chatted like this for a full half-hour before Yang Yuanzi finally let Fang Wang leave.
Stepping out of the Qingxin Hall, Fang Wang saw Li Yu and the other Direct Disciples already organizing selection trials. Both Outer and Inner Sect Disciples were nearly all spectating, aware that they had no place to participate. Yet observing the high realm Cultivators' battles also excited them— it at least broadened their horizons.
Fang Wang slipped away quietly. When he returned to his cave abode, he suddenly discovered a silhouette waiting at the gate.
Zhou Xue!
She was dressed in the robes of a Taiyuan Gate Direct Disciple, leaning against the gate, idly playing with a flute. When she saw Fang Wang return, a smile spread across her face.
"You're finally back!"
Fang Wang approached Zhou Xue quickly, saying with joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - 38: The Lifesaving Treasure Spirit, the Magic Battle Approaches
chapters.content:
"Do you miss me, or is it the cultivation techniques and spells on me that you miss?"
Zhou Xue teased with a laugh, scrutinizing Fang Wang with a look of satisfaction in her eyes.
Fang Wang walked to her side, opening the door as he said, "Let's go inside to talk."
"Mm."
The two entered the cave abode, and the mountain gate closed tightly behind them.
They sat down at a table, where Fang Wang poured tea for Zhou Xue and asked, "Has the Fang Residence already moved to the Fang Realm?"
Zhou Xue nodded, saying, "Over a hundred disciples have already moved into the Fang Realm, led jointly by my fifth uncle and my father, with grandfather stationed in Southern Hills City. He said the Fang Residence cannot move out entirely; he fears that chaos might break out in Southern Hills City."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang frowned slightly.
"Don't worry, as long as the real identity of White Garment Astonishing Swan remains hidden, the Fang Residence won't suffer retaliation from Green Cicada Valley or the Li Family. As for Lu Yuanjun, he helped the Emperor of Grand Qi enter the Great Abyss Gate. Now that Grand Qi's transformation into a Cultivation Dynasty has begun, he surely dares not continue collecting souls.
Moreover, from his perspective, he definitely won't retaliate against the Fang Residence to avoid exposure. As for Zhao Zhen, the Emperor of Grand Qi, he truly is ruthless."
Zhou Xue said this with a hint of mockery in her tone.
Fang Wang asked, "What makes you say that?"
"He had the Prime Minister who was behind this assassinated and posthumously labeled him with the crime of exterminating nine kinship. He claimed that the previous attack on the Fang Residence and other cities that were slaughtered were all related to the Prime Minister. Then, in a short time, he exterminated the Prime Minister's nine kinship," Zhou Xue answered.
Fang Wang furrowed his brow further and asked, "There were other cities as well?"
"Mm, apart from visiting the Duke's Mansion I previously mentioned, they targeted another two Duke's Mansions and slaughtered the inhabitants of the cities where those two Fang State Duke's Mansions were located. Lu Yuanjun collected millions of souls at the very least."
