Hearing Zhou Xue's words, Fang Wang couldn't help but think about his earlier interaction with Zhao Zhen. That emperor had seemed so gentle and sunny that it was hard to imagine him committing such cruel acts behind the scenes.
With narrowed eyes, Fang Wang said, "Lu Yuanjun's objective is to collect souls, and Zhao Zhen, in order to assist, conveniently let Lu Yuanjun's people eliminate the Duke's Mansions that threatened his power?"
Zhou Xue nodded and said, "Exactly, and by doing so, this whole affair appears to be merely a tragic conflict between imperial power and ministerial authority, not involving the Cultivation World."
"But with the Prime Minister dead, won't we lack evidence for revenge in the future? Are there any cultivators who helped Lu Yuanjun that survived?" Fang Wang asked with a frown.
Zhou Xue smiled sardonically, "Do you really need evidence to seek revenge? Evidence is only used to convince oneself. Leave the matter of revenge to me, and you focus on cultivating. I told you the truth only to make sure you aren't deceived by the façades of Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen."
Fang Wang was about to respond when Zhou Xue interrupted, "Let's talk about the upcoming Nine Veins Combat Method. You must compete, because the nine disciples who ultimately win will be allowed to enter the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven is a secret realm transmitted from ancient times which, if things go as expected, will mostly benefit the Great Abyss Gate and lay the foundation for their rise to power."
Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven?
Fang Wang's interest was piqued—Zhou Xue herself was urging him to compete, signaling there were many benefits within.
"I will also enter the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven this time. Once you manage to get in, I'll explain everything to you in detail.
The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven will be a turning point for the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, and we will also encounter sects from other dynasties, and perhaps even meet an exceptional talent with a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure," Zhou Xue laughed, making Fang Wang even more interested in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
Fang Wang asked curiously, "What have you been doing these two years, just taking care of the Fang Residence?"
Zhou Xue shook her head, "Of course not. I also needed to grow stronger."
"What realm are you at now?"
"I won't tell you, but I know you've reached the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm."
Zhou Xue propped her cheek with her right hand, staring at Fang Wang with a smile.
Fang Wang's expression stiffened for a moment, as he had not expected Zhou Xue to see through his cultivation level. It seemed the Breath Concealment Technique had a counter after all.
"To be honest, I was surprised you could defeat Li Honggang. It seems you've kept secrets from me as well, but that's fine. It's the secretive you that reassures me the most," Zhou Xue continued with a laugh, already comparing Fang Wang to the legendary geniuses from her past memories.
Fang Wang gave a feigned cough and asked, "On that note, I have a question—can a cultivator only have one Lifespirit Treasure?"
Zhou Xue's eyes narrowed as she asked, "Could it be that there is something unusual with your Treasured Spirit Space?"
Fang Wang didn't hide anything and shared what he had experienced. After he finished speaking, Zhou Xue was not shocked but spoke with a wistful tone, "So that's how it is. It's no wonder your talent is so strong. Indeed, there are cultivators in the world with more than one type of Lifespirit Treasure. The most Lifespirit Treasures I've seen on one proud talent were nine.
He ascended with me and, after ascension, became unstoppable, a being even I had to look up to."
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and asked, "Really? What kind of realm must one reach to be looked up to by an Immortal Venerable?"
"The so-called Immortal Venerable is just a title of respect in the Upper Realm," Zhou Xue answered, seemingly unwilling to discuss the Upper Realm further, and instead continued to speak about Lifespirit Treasures.
"The stages of Cultivation are divided into Qi Cultivation, Spiritual Refinement, Spirit Pill, Profound Heart, and Condensation. Generally speaking, possessing an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure offers the hope of advancing to the Condensation Spirit Realm.
Currently, in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, the number of Great Cultivators in the Condensation Spirit Realm can be counted on one's fingers, which shows the importance of the grade of the Spirit Treasure. Those who have more than one Lifespirit Treasure have more possibilities than other cultivators due to having one or two additional Lifespirit Treasures."
"Take you, for example, the grade of your second Lifespirit Treasure may not be lower than the first, but it could also be insignificant, all depending on fate."
"It's estimated that when you break through to the Spirit Pill Realm, you will be able to shape your second Lifespirit Treasure."
Fang Wang was thrilled. Although he hadn't used the Heavenly Palace Halberd, when he was in the Heavenly Palace and wielded the Heavenly Palace Halberd while performing the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, its power was terrifying, which was enough to prove that the Heavenly Palace Halberd was far stronger than the Superior Grade Spiritual Weapon, the Qingjun Sword.
If he could obtain another Lifespirit Treasure...
The two continued their conversation, with Fang Wang asking questions and Zhou Xue answering. Gradually, Fang Wang's understanding of the Cultivation World grew.
An hour later,
Zhou Xue stood up, ready to leave, and Fang Wang immediately offered to see her out.
"Don't make any more requests. When you reach the Spirit Pill Realm, I will teach you another technique that will not disappoint you," Zhou Xue said as she walked ahead.
Fang Wang pouted, thinking to himself, am I the kind of person who only thinks of taking?
"Alright, that day won't be too far off!"
"Mhm."
...
A month passed quickly, and during this time, Fang Wang had not been cultivating; he was planting spiritual herbs and flowers in his cave dwelling.
When the day of the Nine Veins Combat Method arrived, his Disciple Token vibrated with Spiritual Power, and he immediately picked it up, hearing Yang Yuanzi's voice from within:
"Fang Wang, come to Qingxin Hall immediately."
Fang Wang stood up, got ready quickly, and then walked out of his cave dwelling.
As soon as he came out, he saw Gu Li, which made Fang Wang raise an eyebrow.
Gu Li noticed the look on his face and said, annoyed, "What? You think I'm not qualified to represent the third vein?"
"It's not that, it's just that you've only recently joined..."
"You don't think the Nine Veins Combat Method is only fought between Spirit Pill Realm disciples, do you?"
"Isn't it?"
"How could that be possible? Disciples in the Spirit Pill Realm are already qualified to be promoted to junior elders, or to hold office. Although there are indeed Spirit Pill Realm Disciples participating in the Nine Veins Combat Method, they account for less than forty percent of participants," Gu Li huffed, which gave Fang Wang a clearer understanding of the Great Abyss Gate.
Above the Spirit Pill Realm is the Profound Heart Realm, and as Zhou Xue had said, the Peak Masters of each vein were all in the Profound Heart Realm. As for the Condensation Spirit Realm, only the Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian might have reached it.
Fang Wang laughed and said, "Let's go, we must bring honor to the third vein."
"Hmph!"
Gu Li gave him a cold look, then the two flew on their swords towards the Qingxin Hall at the peak of the mountain.
In front of Qingxin Hall, Yang Yuanzi and the head disciple, Li Yu, were already waiting. After Fang Wang and the other person landed, four disciples had yet to arrive.
Soon after, the remaining four arrived one after another.
Fang Wang noticed that besides him and Gu Li, there were three other Spiritual Refinement Realm disciples, all at the eighth level of Spiritual Refinement, no wonder the third vein ranked second to last in the last combat method session.
Yang Yuanzi looked down at the nine disciples and said expressionlessly, "Since there are new disciples participating, I will explain the rules again. The upcoming Nine Veins Combat Method will adopt a one-on-one duel format, where the Peak Master selects opponents and can only pick those from a vein ranked higher than their own, leading to a duel of disciples from one vein against another.
We have seven choices, while the number one ranked first vein can only wait for challenges from other veins. During the combat method, if all disciples from a higher-ranked vein are defeated, their ranking will be replaced by the winner, and the defeated vein may consider whether to continue challenging. However, the nine participating disciples cannot be substituted."
"In the end, the nine disciples with the most individual victories will represent the Great Abyss Gate in seeking opportunities in the Blessed Land of Grotto-Heaven!"

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - 39: Taking the Lead
chapters.content:
After listening to Yang Yuanzi's introduction, Fang Wang felt that something was amiss. If the final nine spots were determined solely by the number of victories, wouldn't it be advantageous to rank later?
Wouldn't the second-ranked peak have the opportunity to effectively choke the first if it chose not to challenge them?
But upon further thought, he understood.
This was the Nine Veins Combat Method!
It began with the competition among the nine veins, and only then did personal contests follow. Which vein to challenge was not up to the disciples to decide. For peak masters, the ranking of their peaks was of paramount importance. As for the final nine spots, those were of personal interest to the disciples.
The second-ranked peak would definitely challenge the first vein, for they would have to wait another ten years otherwise!
The ranking of the peaks affected the distribution of resources within the sect and would also attract disciples to join. The first vein, for instance, had the most disciples.
Wait a minute!
Zhou Xue was in the first vein, and so was Lu Yuanjun...
Fang Wang suddenly felt the pressure from the first vein. The first vein was untouchable!
However, he guessed that the third vein, ranked eighth, probably would not challenge the first vein either.
Yang Yuanzi continued to explain some precautions. The nine disciples listened attentively until the bell in the Sect's Main City rang, signaling Yang Yuanzi to lead them away.
The group flew on their magic swords, soaring high in the sky where Fang Wang could see many disciples flying towards the ten peaks surrounding the Sect's Main City, darting through the misty snow.
The bell of the Sect's Main City rang continuously. Golden light rose from various areas of the city, totaling thirty-two beams, which converged in mid-air to form thirty-two semi-transparent Golden Mirrors. Upon getting closer, Fang Wang could see that on the surfaces of the mirrors were reflected a gigantic arena for combat.
That arena was located in the central area of the Sect's Main City, a hundred zhang in length and width, with a Formation of magic artifacts at the edges. Further out were pavilions where disciples often settled their disputes.
Fang Wang followed Yang Yuanzi towards the combat arena. Disciples from all nine veins arrived and scattered throughout the city. They did not need to approach the arena closely; simply looking up at the Golden Mirrors allowed them to watch the fights. Some enthusiastic disciples began setting up various betting pools, where other disciples wagered with Spirit Stones and Spirit Pills.
"It's Fang Wang, big brother Wang! He's going to participate!"
On a street, Fang Xin watched with excitement as Fang Wang flew by overhead. The three Fang Family Disciples beside her became thrilled as well. Such an important event in the sect, and Fang Wang was taking part after only three years of entry?
What exceptional talent!
These clan members felt no envy, only endless pride. The more renowned Fang Wang became, the more they benefitted.
Fang Hanyu, blindfolded, arrived on his magic sword from amidst the vast snow and fog. Although he could not see Fang Wang, he came specifically to watch Fang Wang's fight. After learning of White Garment Astonishing Swan's achievements, he understood the truth—Fang Wang was the White Garment Astonishing Swan!
With the strength of White Garment Astonishing Swan, entering the Nine Veins Combat Method was not difficult!
After Spiritual Refinement, Fang Hanyu's strength increased significantly; unfortunately, he had not managed to emerge victorious from the second vein. The overall strength of the second vein ranked among the top three, something the third vein could not compare with.
The naming of the peaks was based on the initial rankings; the third vein was once known as the third-ranked peak. Now, relegated to the eighth position, the third vein had become the Great Abyss Gate's biggest joke.
Fang Wang followed Yang Yuanzi into a pavilion on the edge of the combat arena, where Yang Yuanzi nonchalantly made his way to a seat and sat down. The disciples stood behind him.
"Master, which vein shall we challenge first?" Li Yu asked.
Fang Wang watched as disciples from the other veins flew into other pavilions and, for the moment, did not catch sight of Zhou Xue.
Yang Yuanzi calmly said, "Let's challenge the fifth vein first."
The fifth vein, which was ranked seventh in the previous evaluation, posed the least pressure to challenge for the third vein.
After a while, Fang Wang saw the first vein arrive. A large group of disciples from the first vein came, including Lu Yuanjun and Zhou Xue.
A stick of incense later, Guang Qiuxian, along with a group of elders from the main peak, descended. Yang Yuanzi and other peak masters stood up in respect, which also caused their disciples to fall silent behind them.
The previously appointed examination elder, Greedy Sleeper, landed on the combat arena, appearing as eccentric as ever compared to three years ago.
"The once-every-ten-years Nine Veins Combat Method is starting early. I believe the peak masters have already explained the rules. There will be seven days in total, so fight at your leisure. Which vein wishes to be the first challenger?"
Greedy Sleeper asked with a laugh, his voice spreading throughout the entire main city through the thirty-two Golden Mirrors.
Having said that, Greedy Sleeper's gaze swept across the pavilions.
Yang Yuanzi did not speak but instead closed his eyes.
Seven days were enough for every vein to make an appearance, and the defeated could continue to challenge, as long as there were still combat-ready disciples remaining.
Quickly thereafter, the peak master of the fifth vein said, "The fifth vein challenges the second vein!"
As his words fell, a disciple behind him flew onto the stage, followed by a disciple from the second vein who leapt onto the combat arena. Four elders seated around the arena immediately started casting spells to activate the Formation.
The magic artifacts at the edge of the arena emitted a pale white light curtain, which expanded as it rose, eventually connecting end to end with other light curtains.
Once the Formation was in place, Greedy Sleeper announced the start of the combat.
Both sides participating in the battle were from the Spirit Elixir Realm, and clearly, both wanted to get off to a good start. Fang Wang watched intently as he too wanted to see a battle between combatants of the Spirit Elixir Realm.
His battle with Li Honggang ended too quickly, so he still wasn't clear on how typical Spirit Elixir Realm combat occurred.
But then again, the fifth vein was quite hardheaded, with their seventh-ranked challenging the second rank within the top three veins!
As the battle began, the two disciples immediately summoned their respective lifebound magic artifacts, engaging in long-range combat with rapid spell casting. An assortment of spells were unleashed, and the sound of explosions was incessant.
The combat platform was exceptionally sturdy, maintaining a jade-like smoothness with not a single scratch, no matter what spells struck it.
Disciples within the Sect's Main City all watched the battle, discussing it with their friends, keeping the whole city buzzing with noise.
The first battle lasted for the time it took an incense stick to burn halfway, ending with the disciple from the second vein victorious. That person didn't leave the stage, instead continuing to wait for the next challenger.
"Master, who among us will go up first later?"
Li Yu asked. He was not as excited as other disciples from various veins, for the recent Nine Veins Combat Method events had been nothing but days of humiliation for them.
Yang Yuanzi, with his eyes closed, said, "You decide."
Upon hearing this, Li Yu turned to look at the other disciples, his brow slightly furrowed.
"Who could be the White Garment Astonishing Swan?"
Li Yu thought quietly to himself. The name of the White Garment Astonishing Swan was known throughout the Cultivation World, and he had naturally heard of it - one who could execute the Jinghong Divine Sword Art was surely from the third vein.
However, Yang Yuanzi and the elders of the third vein had all denied it, leading him to boldly guess that the White Garment Astonishing Swan might be a certain direct disciple.
Suddenly, Li Yu's gaze fell on Fang Wang and he asked, "Junior Brother Fang, are you willing to lead the charge?"
Fang Wang nodded and said, "Of course I'm willing!"
However, if I do go up, you won't have a chance!
"Brother Fang will definitely be able to do it!" Zhou Bo flattered.
Indeed, Zhou Bo had also made it into the top nine of the third vein, and Fang Wang suspected that he had gotten in through the back door.
The other disciples looked at Fang Wang with curiosity and scrutiny. As a direct disciple from the moment he joined, that halo was too heavy, and so many disciples had even higher expectations of him.
Gu Li shook her head slightly and sighed internally. It seemed she would not have a chance to go on stage at least for today.
The competition between the second and fifth veins lasted an hour and ended with the fifth vein's defeat. With five severely injured, it was quite a tragic outcome.
Many elders surrounded the combat platform, and with Greedy Sleeper present on stage, there was no chance of a disciple dying.
Next, it was the ninth vein's turn, and this vein, initially ranked at the bottom, boldly challenged the first vein. Fang Wang then learned that the ninth vein had placed fourth in the previous Nine Veins Combat Method event.
The fourth challenging the first showed great daring, just as headstrong as the fifth vein.
The first to compete from the first vein wasn't Lu Yuanjun nor Zhou Xue, but this disciple was powerful. With a magic sword, he won four consecutive matches and then calmly stepped down for someone else's turn.
Fang Wang compared them secretly and thought that Li Honggang was probably no match for this disciple from the first vein.
The first vein truly deserved the title of the strongest peak!
In less than half an hour, the peak competition came to an end, with the first vein securing the victory. They only lost one match, and only four people took the stage, with Zhou Xue not participating.
"It seems Zhou Xue holds a high position within the first vein."
Fang Wang was curious. Zhou Xue had been away for three years, and upon her return, what kind of strength had she shown to attain such a status?
All the disciples in the city were amazed by the power of the first vein, and the disciples of the first vein took pride in their glory, brimming with arrogance.
"Which vein wishes to challenge next?"
Greedy Sleeper stood on the combat platform and asked. As his voice fell, Yang Yuanzi's voice rang out, "The third vein challenges the fifth vein!"
As soon as these words were spoken, there was an uproar throughout the city!
Following the fifth vein's failed challenge against the second vein and with five seriously injured, it hadn't been long before the third vein pounced opportunistically.
This was Yang Yuanzi's original plan, and Fang Wang thought Yang Yuanzi would change his mind after the fifth vein's defeat, but that didn't happen.
Well, it seems the Nine Veins Combat Method was truly a serious affair, with undercurrents at play!
The disciples of the third vein looked at Fang Wang, who, without a second word, walked to the edge of the terrace and leaped onto the combat platform.
"It's you, kiddo, you've grown up fast,"
Greedy Sleeper winked and teased Fang Wang.

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 40 One Move! One Move!
chapters.content:
Facing the teasing from Greedy Sleeper, Fang Wang could only smile and nod.
Seeing Fang Wang ascend the stage, Guang Qiuxian at the main building adjusted his sitting posture and looked at Fang Wang with a hint of anticipation in his eyes.
Zhou Xue saw Fang Wang but was indifferent.
Knowing that Fang Wang was the White Garment Astonishing Swan, Lu Yuanjun chuckled softly and said, "This is Junior Brother Fang Wang from the third vein; he's very strong, definitely the strongest in this lineup of the third vein."
As soon as these words came out, the disciples of the first vein who still had some doubts about Fang Wang were all astonished. They wouldn't question Lu Yuanjun's judgment; they were just wondering when the third vein had produced such a disciple?
At the same time, the whole city burst into disapproval.
"The third vein is kicking someone when they're down. Now the fifth vein will end up at the bottom."
"Hahahaha, this Junior Brother must have just entered the gate. The Nine Veins Combat Method is indeed this cruel; after all, it's about competing for the cultivation resources of a vein, and naturally interest takes precedence."
"Don't be in a hurry; this is just the beginning. Sooner or later, the third vein will be targeted."
"Even if the third vein wins, it won't be a glorious victory. If they lose, then it's a huge embarrassment."
"Who is this guy? He looks quite handsome!"
In the city, the disciples of the Fang Residence became excited when they saw Fang Wang on stage, introducing him to their fellow disciples from the same peaks.
Inside an inn, Emperor of Grand Qi, Zhao Zhen, was sitting by the window. He looked at the golden mirror in the sky, observing Fang Wang's figure, with his brows tightly furrowed.
Fang Wang had not been on the stage for long when a disciple from the fifth vein leapt onto the combat platform, holding a long sword. Having previously won two fights against the second vein, he was definitely the strongest presence in the fifth vein's lineup.
Fang Wang raised his right hand, and his Lifespirit Treasure slowly gathered above his head.
The Heavenly Palace Halberd!
He couldn't use the Jinghong Divine Sword Art as it would expose his identity, and the Great Celestial Thunder Technique consumed too much Spiritual Power, so it was better to use the Heavenly Palace Halberd for combat.
He was about to consolidate his second Lifespirit Treasure; it was time to wield the Heavenly Palace Halberd!
A Heavenly Palace Halberd, one zhang long, appeared above Fang Wang's head, held in his right hand. Under the sunlight, the halberd blade flashed with a cold gleam, and the dragon shape on its body seemed lifelike, as if a True Dragon had come into being.
The appearance of the Heavenly Palace Halberd caused quite a stir.
"A long weapon-type Lifespirit Treasure? Fang Tian Painted Halberd? Rare indeed!"
An elder sitting beside Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and laughed, with other elders following with their comments. It was clear at a glance that the Heavenly Palace Halberd was no ordinary item.
Guang Qiuxian smiled without saying a word, not joining their discussion.
Zhou Xue's gaze locked onto the Heavenly Palace Halberd, her beautiful brows slightly furrowed as if she had thought of something, her eyes revealing a different color.
The one zhang long Heavenly Palace Halberd was so immense that it gave off an enormous sense of oppression with Fang Wang holding it.
"Is that his Lifespirit Treasure?"
Gu Li's beautiful eyes were filled with anticipation. She had previously thought Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure was a sword, not expecting it to be a long weapon.
Greedy Sleeper stared at the Heavenly Palace Halberd, frowning.
Having seen much of the world, he knew at first glance that this Lifespirit Treasure was extraordinary.
An Earth Origin Spirit Treasure?
Could it be of higher grade than Lu Yuanjun's Lifespirit Treasure?
Atop the first vein's loft, Lu Yuanjun was also captivated by the Heavenly Palace Halberd. At this moment, the eyes of ninety percent of the city's people were drawn to the figure of the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
Such a domineering Lifespirit Treasure!
Fang Hanyu's eyes were covered with a white cloth, but in fact, he could see, and he was astonished in his heart.
Fang Wang isn't a Sword Cultivator?
On the combat platform!
Fang Wang spun the Heavenly Palace Halberd in his right hand and then drew it forward. The spearhead pointed at the sword cultivator disciple from the fifth vein as he smiled and asked, "Senior Brother, are you ready?"
If they were going to compete, then he would reveal his sharp edge!
After all, Fang Wang still had an even stronger trump card hidden away!
The sword cultivator disciple from the fifth vein, being pointed at by the Heavenly Palace Halberd, felt an immense pressure. But under the watchful eyes of the public, he wasn't about to show weakness.
"Then bring it on," the sword cultivator disciple said coldly.
As his voice fell, Fang Wang suddenly released his grip. The Heavenly Palace Halberd burst forth with terrifying speed, tearing through the air and producing a piercing explosion sound, like a streak of cold light aiming for the sword cultivator disciple.
The sword cultivator disciple's pupils shrank, and he instinctively raised his sword to block.
Clang!
The halberd blade struck the sword blade, and an unimaginably huge force attacked, directly sending the Spirit Elixir Realm sword cultivator disciple flying backward. In the blink of an eye, he crashed against the formation's light screen at the edge of the combat platform, blood spraying from his mouth. Then he fell to the ground.
Silence!
The city fell silent all at once, as within the thirty-two Golden Mirrors, Fang Wang still maintained the posture of his raised hand, while the Heavenly Palace Halberd remained at the position where the Sword Cultivator Disciple had previously stood.
Everyone on the various pavilions of the Nine Veins and the Main Meridian was shocked.
Crushing victories had occurred before, but never so exaggerated!
Yang Yuanzi pinched his beard, secretly relieved, as he had indeed feared Fang Wang would use the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
After this battle, in the eyes of the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples, Fang Wang was completely dissociated from the Sword Cultivators.
"Incredible, Brother Fang!"
Zhou Bo suddenly cheered, his voice breaking the silence, drawing discussions from the pavilions surrounding the combat platform.
An elder swiftly landed beside the Sword Cultivator Disciple, checked his injuries, and then escorted him out of the Formation.
Soon, the second Disciple stepped onto the stage—a female Disciple with a face full of rage, who without a word, directly condensed her Lifespirit Treasure, a silver long sword, and exhibited her Swordsmanship. The sword blade trembled as blossoms of sword flowers made from condensed Sword Qi assaulted Fang Wang.
With a sweep of his right hand, the Heavenly Palace Halberd suspended in mid-air erupted with terrifying speed once more!
Sword Control Technique at the Great Perfection!
The Heavenly Palace Halberd forcefully vanquished the sword flowers one after another, frightening the female Disciple into a pallor as she quickly leaped up, only to see the Heavenly Palace Halberd suddenly change direction, carving out a perfect arc.
In mid-air, the shaft of the Heavenly Palace Halberd struck the female Disciple's abdomen, smashing her out of the combat platform and against the Formation's light screen before she fell to the ground.
The female Disciple's hair was disheveled, as she forcibly endured the pain, trying to stand up, only for a mouthful of blood to surge up her throat, forcing her to spray it out onto the ground.
Whoosh—
Another move, another defeat!
Although the Disciples of the Fifth Vein had already gone through tough battles, their strength should not have been so disparate!
This was the thought in the minds of most Disciples, who now looked at Fang Wang differently.
The elders of each Vein also altered their gaze towards Fang Wang; the Fifth Vein Peak Master furrowed his brows tightly as a Disciple emerged behind him and leaped onto the combat platform.
"Come on!"
He was a burly middle-aged man, who raised his hand to condense his own Lifespirit Treasure, which turned out to be a long whip.
Fang Wang immediately rushed towards him, simultaneously raising his right hand to retract the Heavenly Palace Halberd from mid-air, quickly grasping it in his hand.
The middle-aged man leaped into the air, a Flying Sword flew out from his storage bag at his waist, quickly enlarging. He stood on the Flying Sword, waving the whip with his right hand, countless golden fine arrows shot towards Fang Wang, like a torrential downpour, creating an immense sound.
Using the Shadowless Step, Fang Wang easily dodged. Suddenly, he stopped, and with a fierce throw, he launched the Heavenly Palace Halberd into the air.
At that moment, the distance between the two was less than fifteen meters. With such proximity, the middle-aged man was so intimidated by the might of the Heavenly Palace Halberd that his body tensed up, with no time to dodge.
Clang!
A deafening collision sounded, only to see a golden mirror appear out of nowhere in front of the middle-aged man, similar to the thirty-two Golden Mirrors suspended above the main city, which valiantly blocked the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
Fang Wang frowned, a flash of surprise in his eyes.
"That's enough, the Third Meridian wins this round; the Fifth Meridian, send in the next person!"
A commanding voice rose from the stage, belonging to none other than Greedy Sleeper, who extended his hand and the golden mirror swiftly flew into his sleeve.
It turned out to be an elder's intervention!
Fang Wang exhaled in relief, having thought his opponent to be so formidable.
The middle-aged man in the air was drenched in sweat, his gaze toward Fang Wang filled with fear.
Three consecutive victories, each with absolute strength!
All the Disciples in the city were excited, as no one in previous combats had shown such vigor. In an instant, the discussions regarding the unsportsmanlike victory of the Third Meridian dissipated, replaced by inquiries into Fang Wang's identity, which rapidly spread throughout the city.
The news that he had been a Direct Disciple from the start also spread, adding a legendary aura to Fang Wang in the eyes of the Disciples from all Peaks.
"The Fifth Vein forfeits!"
The Fifth Vein Peak Master declared, his expression still calm, as if he felt no disgrace.
Greedy Sleeper immediately ordered, "The Third Meridian wins, replacing the Fifth Meridian's ranking, moving up to seventh."
Fang Wang raised his hand to recall the Heavenly Palace Halberd and was about to step down from the platform, when Yang Yuanzi's voice came through, "The Third Meridian will continue the challenge, targeting the Sixth Meridian!"
Greedy Sleeper was also taken aback, silently cursing Yang Yuanzi for stealing his line.
Fang Wang was too lazy to remember the rankings of the various Meridians, willing to fight against whomever Yang Yuanzi chose.
He hoisted the Heavenly Palace Halberd on his shoulder, his gaze turning towards the pavilion of the Sixth Meridian. His posture and look were perceived by the Disciples of the Sixth Meridian as a challenge.
The Disciples of the Third Meridian were excited; it had been a long time since such a figure had emerged. The eldest senior, Li Yu, was gentle to others, which was a polite way to put it. In fact, many thought Li Yu was too soft, diminishing the Third Meridian's image.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 41 High Cultivation Level
chapters.content:
The first to be sent out by the Sixth Vein was a male disciple, at the Spirit Elixir Realm cultivation level. After landing, he raised his hand to summon a small tower, which emitted rings of red light.
"My name is Qu Xiao. Let's see what you're made of!"
The male disciple said coldly, holding the tower in his right hand while casting spells with his left, channeling Spiritual Power into the small tower.
Fang Wang held the Heavenly Palace Halberd in his hand and nodded towards Qu Xiao.
Should he give his opponent a chance to show off?
Forget it!
He was pressed for time!
There were still eight people from the Sixth Vein!
After Fang Wang thought it through, he loosened his right hand again, preparing to use the Sword Control Technique.
Qu Xiao had already seen the terrifying speed of the Heavenly Palace Halberd and immediately leaped backward, with the small tower in his hand shooting countless red beams of light, setting up a net of heaven and earth between him and Fang Wang.
Fang Wang's mouth curled up into a smile as he charged head-on. With one step, an aura of flames enveloped him, quickly gathering behind his head to form three fireballs while the blade and end-spikes of the Heavenly Palace Halberd burst into Solaris True Fire.
In that moment, Fang Wang seemed to be possessed by a god of fire, eliciting gasps from the disciples inside the Sect's Main City.
Facing the net of heaven and earth laid by Qu Xiao, he lifted the Heavenly Palace Halberd, and his speed suddenly increased, becoming like a streak of fire that rapidly elongated, piercing through the countless red beams of light.
By the time the Heavenly Palace Halberd reached Qu Xiao, the numerous red beams of light that had been behind Fang Wang were dissipating, while remnants of Solaris True Fire still hung in the air.
"Impossible!"
Qu Xiao's eyes widened. He had mentally prepared himself, but only when directly facing the might of the Heavenly Palace Halberd did he truly feel the terror of its oppressive force.
In his pupils, the blade of the Heavenly Palace Halberd grew closer and closer, about to fill his entire field of vision.
He immediately lifted the small tower he held; all the doors of the tower swung open, and Talisman Papers flew out, rapidly enlarging and igniting to form a majestic sea of flames.
However, as soon as the sea of flames formed, it was shredded by a powerful surge of energy, and the Heavenly Palace Halberd struck the small tower in Qu Xiao's hand with an unstoppable force.
Boom!
Qu Xiao was directly blasted away by a formidable force he couldn't describe, slamming into the Formation barrier and losing consciousness the instant he spat out blood.
Fang Wang stopped in his tracks, his right hand extended forward, with the palm less than ten centimeters away from the end-spike of the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
The fireballs behind Fang Wang's head absorbed the flames that filled the sky, creating what looked like a vast cloak of fierce fire, with hot air waves sweeping in all directions of the combat platform.
"The Third Vein, Fang Wang wins!"
Greedy Sleeper called out loudly. This time, by mentioning Fang Wang's name, he sought to help make his name known throughout the Great Abyss Gate.
It was decided in one move again!
The uproar in the various areas of the Main City was even louder than before, and Fang Wang, standing on the combat platform, could hear astonished exclamations from all around.
"So strong! It ended with just one move!"
"That Sixth Vein brother must be powerful just from the display of his Spiritual Power!"
"Fang Wang, could he be another Lu Yuanjun?"
"Can he compare with Brother Lu? Brother Lu's reputation isn't just made within the sect. In my opinion, if White Garment Astonishing Swan really was a disciple, then he might be on par with Brother Lu."
"White Garment Astonishing Swan used Jinghong Divine Sword Art, could he be a disciple from the Third Vein?"
Unlike the battle with the Fifth Vein, this was the first time a disciple from the Sixth Vein took the stage, ranking higher than the Fifth Vein, but still, Fang Wang defeated him decisively, proving his strength and that it was not a matter of taking advantage of a weary disciple.
Li Yu sighed, "Brother Fang is really smart. Such a fighting style can reduce the consumption of Spiritual Power."
The other disciples nodded, following with their own comments.
Zhou Bo chuckled, "Smart for sure, but it's a style we can't afford to use."
Gu Li remained silent, her attention focused entirely on Fang Wang.
Disciples from all veins discussed Fang Wang's strength, with feelings ranging from curiosity to envy, as well as concern and fear.
On an upper floor of the Second Vein.
Zhou Xing Shi, hearing the exclamations of his fellow senior brothers and sisters, scoffed internally.
"This is a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure! It cannot be measured by common sense; none of you may be a match for him!"
Zhou Xing Shi looked at Fang Wang with burning eyes. As Fang Wang grew stronger, he began to see his own misfortune in a new light. Perhaps for him, the Myriad Poison Vernal Worm was not a calamity but an opportunity.
Grand Qi Cultivation Realm had never seen the birth of a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure since ancient times, but the Zhou Family, being a Cultivation family, made Zhou Xing Shi aware of how vast the world outside was.
Perhaps clinging tightly to Fang Wang's coattails could let him reach much farther!
Zhou Xing Shi thought of the promise Zhou Xue had made to him, and his heart grew even more fervent.
Fang Wang grasped the Heavenly Palace Halberd, turned around, and looked towards the sixth vein's loft.
At the fourth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm, he could kill a cultivator at the third layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm in an instant.
Now that he had reached the ninth layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm and held the Heavenly Palace Halberd, which was suspected to be a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, combined with his Great Perfection Solaris Scripture, he was confident in sweeping through the entire Spirit Elixir Realm.
In the upcoming battles, he would maintain this dominant posture!
Soon, the second disciple stepped onto the stage!
The battle ended in less than ten breaths!
When Fang Wang closed in on his opponent, the battle was over; no one could withstand the full force of the Great Perfection Sword Control Technique combined with the Heavenly Palace Halberd. The Heavenly Palace Halberd itself contained immense power, and with both forces combined, any who suffered this attack would either die or be severely injured!
One after another, disciples from the sixth vein took to the stage, only to be defeated in succession. The noise from the main city grew louder and louder, but as five disciples from the sixth vein were defeated, the clamor began to subside.
Until the ninth disciple from the sixth vein fell outside the combat platform, knocked out cold, the entire city fell silent!
The nine disciples of the sixth vein could at most withstand only two moves from Fang Wang!
Standing on the platform, Fang Wang stood tall and proud. Even without a smile, he radiated confidence and spirit.
"The third vein wins! It shall replace the ranking of the sixth vein!"
Greedy Sleeper yelled loudly, then turned to look at Yang Yuanzi.
Yang Yuanzi didn't utter a sound. Fang Wang waited for a while before flying towards the third vein's loft.
"Really, Master... Even if you don't want to challenge, you should say something," Fang Wang thought helplessly, but when he arrived in front of Yang Yuanzi, he still respectfully saluted.
Yang Yuanzi did not comment on Fang Wang's performance; instead, he was surrounded by his disciples, who were effusive with their praise and flattery.
The Nine Veins Combat Method continued!
The seventh vein challenged the second vein!
After dealing with his fellow sect members, Fang Wang sat down to meditate and restore his Spiritual Power, striving to maintain his best condition.
Fang Wang's twelve consecutive victories spread his fame throughout the Sect's Main City, and those disciples who were setting up betting markets all believed that Fang Wang had the strength to stand out and become one of the nine representatives of the Great Abyss Gate, so they started adjusting his odds.
For the next five hours, no vein challenged the third.
The Nine Veins Combat Method lasted for seven days, and this year, the third vein was clearly on the rise!
When night fell, the Nine Veins Combat Method continued. The duration of each battle began to stretch. The sixth vein, defeated by Fang Wang single-handedly, had now fallen to the last place, and when facing challenges from other veins, the Peak Master chose to forfeit, indicating that he was planning to make a push in the rankings in the last two days.
It must be said that the seven days did indeed test every vein. Those disciples who were from weaker veins but had strong capabilities would not be buried, and the disciples of the first vein were occasionally challenged. It seemed as though the veins had reached some sort of agreement to take turns exhausting the first vein's Spiritual Power.
From the current situation, the first vein appeared to cope with ease.
On the second day, nearing noon, the first vein encountered a challenge from the second vein. This time, Zhou Xue was the first to step onto the platform.
Fang Wang stood up, preparing to watch Zhou Xue's battle.
"You seem quite concerned about her," Gu Li approached Fang Wang and whispered.
Focusing on Zhou Xue, Fang Wang replied, "After all, she is a member of my clan."
"I heard that you two do not share blood relations, that she's just an adopted daughter."
"The Fang Family has never treated her as an adopted daughter."
"Hmm."
Gu Li said no more and watched the battle with Fang Wang.
Zhou Xue's Lifespirit Treasure was a zither, and as she played it, her opponents would lose their wits. Lighter cases would stagger, while severe cases would be stunned in place.
Such a Lifespirit Treasure provoked discussions among the various veins.
Zhou Xue secured six consecutive victories and was eventually replaced by the Peak Master. Her performance was strong, stirring up a lot of discussions in the main city, but in the hearts of most disciples, her performance was not as good as Fang Wang's.
Fang Wang was decisively dominant, while Zhou Xue was unfathomably profound.
"Fang Wang, this member of your clan is not simple; her cultivation is quite high," Yang Yuanzi said meaningfully.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang asked, "How high?"
Yang Yuanzi shook his head without answering, leaving Fang Wang speechless.
Li Yu then asked, "Master, what grade is Zhou Xue's precious treasure?"
Yang Yuanzi replied, "Lower Grade Earth Origin Precious Spirit. The news has not yet spread, but after this Nine Veins Combat Method, at least five disciples of the Great Abyss Gate will become famous in the Cultivation World."

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 42: Battle Spirit Elixir Realm Ninth Level
chapters.content:
Five disciples?
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow, curious. He, Zhou Xue, and Gu Li aside, could there be two other Earth Origin Spirit Treasure disciples?
This piqued his interest regarding the upcoming combat trials.
After Zhou Xue was replaced, the second vein lost another match, and its Peak Master directly conceded, choosing not to let the last two competitors take the stage.
It wasn't until evening that a vein peak finally challenged the third vein, but this time, Yang Yuanzi cut off Li Yu mid-speech and let others take the stage first while saving Fang Wang for last.
This arrangement was intended to allow Fang Wang to recover to his peak condition as much as possible while also giving other disciples the opportunity to showcase themselves.
The remaining combatants of the third vein all smiled. They too worried about Fang Wang single-handedly blocking all challengers, depriving them of their chance to perform.
The Nine Veins Combat Method was about winning glory for their vein peaks, and individual victories related to great opportunities to come; everyone wanted to try their luck.
Zhou Bo went first and lasted a hundred rounds before being defeated. Fortunately, he wasn't seriously injured. The second to enter was the eldest disciple Li Yu, who was at the Spirit Elixir Realm Seventh Level and achieved three consecutive victories before he fell.
Li Yu's performance didn't surprise the disciples from the other veins; they felt it was to be expected. The Peak Masters let out a slight sigh, somewhat disappointed in Li Yu.
Fang Wang knew that Li Yu was over two hundred years old and still in the Spirit Elixir Realm, which was evidence enough of his average talent.
The third to take the stage was Gu Li, who used her Earth Origin Spirit Treasure and the Gu Family's inherited Five Saints Sword Technique to dazzle everyone, defeating an opponent at the Spirit Elixir Realm First Layer, even though she herself was only at the Soul Sculpting Realm.
Each vein has its inherited cultivation techniques and spells, but disciples from prominent families like Gu Li have their own techniques and legacies. Their joining the Great Abyss Gate is more for the resources controlled by the Nine Great Sects.
Among the preceding disciples who had taken the stage, there were many sword cultivators, but none were as pure as Gu Li. With her brilliant use of the Five Saints Sword Technique, the name Gu Li began to spread.
The subsequent opponents were all below the Spirit Elixir Realm Second Layer, and some were even Soul Sculpting Realm disciples, causing Fang Wang to suspect that Yang Yuanzi had signaled the other side.
After three consecutive victories, Gu Li was replaced, and the matches that followed had wins and losses. In the end, the third vein maintained its ranking, making the other vein disciples realize the third vein had truly risen.
In the following three days, Fang Wang had not taken the stage, while other disciples had already made their moves. They were consistently challenged by the lower-ranked vein peaks, and ultimately the third vein secured its position.
The battles during these three days had been splendid, mainly among the top five vein peaks. The second vein unexpectedly presented a genius with Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, who was also in the Spirit Elixir Realm.
This person, named Ye Xiang, had been in the sect for fourteen years and had not participated in the previous Nine Veins Combat Method. He hadn't appeared in the earlier matches, so his reputation was not outstanding until now. He achieved seven consecutive victories, immediately making a name for himself within the Great Abyss Gate.
The second vein he represented secured the second place, unable to overcome the first vein, but the other vein peaks could not surpass them either.
In fights between the first vein and the second, it was a complete sweep; and as for the second vein versus other veins, they too displayed a sweeping momentum...
On the morning of the sixth day, another vein peak challenged the first vein, and this time Lu Yuanjun took the stage.
Lu Yuanjun scored nine straight victories, each fight ending within two moves, without even moving his position. He seemed even more at ease than Fang Wang, and his opponents were stronger than those Fang Wang had faced.
Although Lu Yuanjun won quickly, his opponents hardly got injured, simply being rapidly sealed and left with no choice but to concede.
Just like that, Lu Yuanjun also claimed nine victories, securing one of the final nine seats. Afterward, he no longer competed, leaving it to other disciples to take part.
That day at noon, as soon as the battles between the two veins ended, Yang Yuanzi immediately declared, "The third vein challenges the first vein!"
Upon these words, the entire city was electrified!
After lying dormant for several days, the third vein finally aimed for a higher ranking, and this time they directly challenged the first vein!
The spectating disciples were not so much focused on the third vein's performance but on Fang Wang taking action. Facing the strongest-ranked first vein, the third vein would surely send out Fang Wang, or else there would be no point in competing!
"Fang Wang, you go first," Yang Yuanzi instructed outright.
Fang Wang nodded and walked to the edge of the terrace amidst the encouragement of his fellow sect members, his heart ablaze with anticipation. The first vein was filled with experts, and what he most wanted was to challenge Lu Yuanjun, to see how great the gap between them was.
But just at that moment, a commotion rose up throughout the city, as a man from the first vein leaped onto the combat platform.
"How could it be him!"
Li Yu exclaimed in dismay.
Fang Wang fixed his gaze on the person standing on the combat platform. It was a man in blue attire, his long hair casually tied back with a straw rope, with a ruggedly handsome face marred by stubble, which gave off an air of nonchalance.
"Xu Lang, in the Spirit Elixir Realm Ninth Level with a Top-Grade Mysterious Elemental Spirit, is the disciple only second to Lu Yuanjun in the first vein. He was once the big brother of that vein and the foremost talent of the Great Abyss Gate. He stepped down only after his defeat to Lu Yuanjun.
Brother Fang, you must be careful!" Zhou Bo quickly informed, providing a simple introduction of the opponent's background.
Spirit Elixir Realm Ninth Level!
Far from being intimidated, Fang Wang felt a surge of excitement within him.
Good, bring it on!
He leaped gracefully, soaring like a white crane and landing lightly on the dueling platform.
Xu Lang's right hand rested on the bamboo rod at his waist. He lifted his chin and looked down on Fang Wang with a sneer, stating with a smile, "Junior Brother Fang, Lu Yuanjun says you are strong. I hope you won't disappoint me."
Fang Wang raised his right arm, and the Heavenly Palace Halberd materialized just beneath his palm. He grasped it and replied, "I will certainly give it my all. However, I hope Senior Brother Xu won't blame me if you end up defeated by my hand."
The thirty-two Golden Mirrors not only reflected images but also transmitted the conversations of the disciples on the stage to the crowd. Everyone could sense the tension in the air upon hearing the exchange between the two.
A female disciple from the first vein chuckled to Zhou Xue, "Your fellow clan member seems quite confident."
Zhou Xue replied with a smile, "He's only nineteen years old, at the peak of his youthful arrogance. If he isn't confident now, when should he be?"
Nineteen years old!
The expressions of the disciples from the first vein changed slightly, but only Lu Yuanjun maintained his smile; he seemed quite looking forward to Fang Wang's performance.
Xu Lang, faced with Fang Wang's domineering reply, snorted coldly and drew the long sword hidden within the bamboo rod.
Without further ado, Xu Lang fiercely hurled the bamboo sword. It glinted coldly, its speed not inferior to Fang Wang's earlier throw of the Heavenly Palace Halberd, and perhaps even faster!
Fang Wang's eyes focused, and he launched the Heavenly Palace Halberd from his hands like a cannon shot, emitting a roar as it tore through the air to meet its target.
Boom!
The moment the two weapons collided, an extremely powerful Sword Qi burst forth from the bamboo sword, shaking the dueling platform!
Almost simultaneously, Fang Wang and Xu Lang stepped forward. Even though Fang Wang moved with Shadowless Step, as he held the Heavenly Palace Halberd, Xu Lang also grasped the hilt of the bamboo sword; it should be noted that Xu Lang covered even more distance.
With weapons in their hands, Fang Wang swung his Halberd with great force, while Xu Lang agilely dodged and leaped into the air, swinging his sword down towards Fang Wang.
The two engaged in an intense close-quarters battle. The clashing sounds of halberd and sword echoed endlessly, with blades shimmering and cold light glittering.
Their movements were too fast; within a range of about fifteen meters, they interweaved back and forth, their forms a blur to those below the Spirit Elixir Realm, which led to a hush falling over the city as the spectators feared missing even a second of the action.
Disciples from the third vein were anxious for Fang Wang, while those from the first vein were surprised.
"Senior Brother Xu is wielding a top-grade Magic Artifact. He exchanged a million points of contribution to get it!"
"This indicates that Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure is of very high grade; it's likely an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure."
"It's definitely an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, just compare it to Ye Xiang!"
"Only nineteen and able to fiercely battle the ninth layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm. You should know that Senior Brother Xu is no ordinary person; he too is a genius."
"No wonder Senior Brother Lu said he's stronger than us. It's a shame such a talent didn't join our first vein."
Zhou Xue watched Fang Wang's performance with a slight smile, her eyes full of his silhouetted figure.
Boom!
Xu Lang unleashed an even greater Sword Intent; a single swing of his blade unleashed hundreds of Sword Qi, sweeping towards Fang Wang like a fierce storm, the force imposing.
Fang Wang planted the Heavenly Palace Halberd into the ground with one hand, and Solaris Spiritual Power erupted, forming an invisible barrier to defend. His robe billowed violently, yet his posture was steadfast, exuding an air of indomitable spirit. As the Sword Qi collided, they instantly formed a spectacular ten-meter-high wall of Qi.
Xu Lang leapt up high, holding the bamboo sword in his right hand. In his left, he conjured his Lifespirit Treasure, also a sword but without a blade, only a hilt. As he grasped it in reverse, the sun's rays faintly outlined the blade.
Fang Wang looked up, Solaris True Fire sparking from his eyes. His right hand ignited with Solaris True Fire, quickly enveloping the Heavenly Palace Halberd. Then, he let go and kicked the tail end of the halberd, launching the flame-engulfed weapon spinning into the air. As the blade pointed downward, he seized the Halberd's shaft and delivered a mighty upward slash.
Mighty Solaris True Fire transformed into a fire dragon soaring into the sky!
The entire sequence happened in the blink of an eye, dazzling to behold. Before Xu Lang in the air could swing his sword, a vast fire dragon had already manifested in front of him, its head several times larger than his entire body!

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 43 Promotion
chapters.content:
Facing the enormous fire dragon before him, Xu Lang's pupils suddenly constricted. He was not frightened but immediately twisted his waist, grasped the sword in both hands, and spun in mid-air, the fierce Sword Qi continuously streaking out, rapidly severing the Solaris True Fire Dragon.
Sword Qi wildly rained down, and Fang Wang swung the Heavenly Palace Halberd to defend. The platform was bombarded with Sword Qi, even causing ripples to spread throughout the formation shield at the edge of the combat platform.
"What immense Spiritual Power!"
"Brother Xu Lang is so strong, his Sword Qi so forceful and sharp!"
"Fang Wang is also very strong, not the slightest bit inferior."
"He's only been in the door for three years, and Fang Wang has already become this strong?"
"Even if Fang Wang loses this battle, he has proven that his potential is no less than that of Lu Yuanjun!"
Disciples from all over the city were discussing, and they all gave high praise to Fang Wang and Xu Lang, while the Fang Family Disciples held their breath in focus, even more nervous than Fang Wang.
Fang Hanyu stood in front of the window, looking up at the Golden Mirror in the sky, and seeing Fang Wang being suppressed by the Sword Qi in the mirror, he spoke to himself calmly, "How much longer do you intend to test him?"
In his heart, Fang Wang was unbeatable.
As if hearing Fang Hanyu's words, Fang Wang suddenly leaped back, avoiding Xu Lang's range of Sword Qi attack.
Before landing, Fang Wang raised the Heavenly Palace Halberd high, his left hand quickly casting a spell, Spiritual Power surged along his right arm into the halberd, and above the combat platform, thunder clouds spontaneously condensed, rapidly covering the entire platform.
At this moment, the elders surrounding the platform were all moved, and Greedy Sleeper, who was on the platform, widened his eyes, murmuring to himself, "No way... How is this possible..."
Peak Masters from each vein straightened up, all the elders and disciples turned their gaze toward the thunderclouds above the combat platform.
Xu Lang, still in mid-air, quickly landed, the sword in his hands raised. With a slight frown of his sword-shaped brows, he slowly exhaled five words: "Great Celestial Thunder Technique!"
All the disciples in the city could hear the thunder, oppressively intense. Before the Great Celestial Thunder Technique, there had been disciples who had used extensive and imposing spells, but none as thunderous as this.
Guang Qiuxian, Yang Yuanzi, Lu Yuanjun, and Zhou Xue remained unmoved, but even Zhou Xing Shi, Gu Li, and Fang Hanyu, who knew the true identity of White Garment Astonishing Swan, couldn't help but be moved.
In their minds, Fang Wang was an expert in swordsmanship; this was their first time witnessing him use the Great Celestial Thunder Technique.
Within three years of joining, he mastered thirty-six moves of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art and had also mastered such a powerful thunder spell?
They had previously heard that White Garment Astonishing Swan had used the Great Celestial Thunder Technique but facing it directly, they realized how terrifying the technique was.
With the Heavenly Palace Halberd held high, thunderclouds roiled above, and lightning interwove, an immense oppressive force amassing, ready to unleash. At this moment, Fang Wang seemed like a deity wielding the power of heaven and earth, with his long hair billowing in the wind.
Xu Lang realized the grim situation and immediately lunged toward Fang Wang.
He first threw the bamboo sword in his hand, which turned into a glint of cold light, sprinting towards him, aiming straight for Fang Wang's head.
So fast!
Greedy Sleeper on the platform nearly intervened, but he held back.
Fang Wang dodged using Shadowless Step, and Xu Lang followed, arriving in front of him, his left hand gripping his Lifespirit magic sword backwards, its invisible blade aimed at Fang Wang's neck.
In an instant, Fang Wang swung down the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
Clang—
When their Lifespirit Treasures clashed, Xu Lang heard a dragon's roar explode in his ear, causing him to be momentarily disorientated. By the time he opened his eyes again, Fang Wang had already soared into the sky.
Above him roared thunder and lightning, and Fang Wang looked down indifferently at Xu Lang before swinging down his halberd.
The Great Celestial Thunder Technique erupted!
Dozens of bolts of lightning descended all at once, varying in size but enough to cover the entire combat platform.
Faced with this world-ending thunderous might, Xu Lang let go of the sword in his hand. Both hands cast a spell, with the bamboo sword and invisible swords spinning rapidly around him. Sword Qi overflowed from his body.
A bolt of lightning struck at him, dispersed by two streams of crisscrossing Sword Qi, failing to harm him.
Surrounded by intertwining Sword Qi, Xu Lang quickly grew it into a formation, the Sword Qi storm rising from the ground, its prowess equally astonishing. But soon, he was engulfed by successive bolts of lightning.
Boom! Boom! Boom...
The combat platform trembled violently, even causing the formation shield at the edges to quiver. The city fell silent, with every disciple fixedly staring at the scene inside the Golden Mirror.
Greedy Sleeper held a Golden Mirror, fending off the fallout from the Great Celestial Thunder Technique. His gaze locked onto where Xu Lang had previously been, not blinking even as the lightning dazzled.
After Xu Lang's figure disappeared for more than three breaths, Greedy Sleeper couldn't restrain himself and immediately threw out the Golden Mirror in his hand.
The Golden Mirror burst forth with golden light, dissipating the lightning along the way, rapidly arriving at the center of the combat platform, its strong radiance warding off the heavens' lightning.
Seeing this, Fang Wang cut off the Spiritual Power, no longer maintaining the Great Celestial Thunder Technique.
The thunderous noise from the heavens faded, but the dark clouds couldn't be scattered away in short order; all eyes were now on what happened below the Golden Mirror.
As the lightning dissipated, Xu Lang's figure appeared. He was half-kneeling on the ground, gasping for air, his robe torn, his hair disheveled, his body covered with wounds, and bloodstains all around. The two swords that had been circling around him slowed down and then fell to the ground with a clang.
Struggling, Xu Lang looked up but before he could locate Fang Wang, he collapsed, unconscious.
This scene made Fang Wang secretly breathe a sigh of relief. Xu Lang was indeed powerful; it was difficult to defeat him solely with the Solaris True Fire, which is why Fang Wang resorted to using the Great Celestial Thunder Technique. It was a Superior Spell Art of the Great Abyss Gate.
It wasn't as difficult to learn as the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, so it wouldn't expose him as the White Garment Astonishing Swan.
To decisively defeat Xu Lang, Fang Wang didn't hold back when using the Great Celestial Thunder Technique.
"It's a pity I can't challenge Lu Yuanjun in peak condition," Fang Wang said, affecting a calm demeanor, while internally he sighed, having expended a lot of Spiritual Power against Xu Lang.
Greedy Sleeper immediately announced, "Third Vein's Fang Wang wins!"
An elder quickly climbed onto the stage to check on Xu Lang's injuries.
Disciples from all veins looked at Fang Wang with fear, and the entire city fell into silence.
"Could that have been the Great Celestial Thunder Technique?" a male disciple from the First Vein asked, his voice trembling.
The Great Celestial Thunder Technique was one of the most powerful thunder-based spells of the Great Abyss Gate. Although the Great Abyss Gate wasn't known for their mastery of thunder-based spells, the fame of the Great Celestial Thunder Technique was notable even within the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
After the introductions by Zhou Xue and Lu Yuanjun, the disciples in the loft from the First Vein all knew about Fang Wang's background.
To have mastered the Great Celestial Thunder Technique in just three years of entry, on top of his rapid increase in cultivation...
Such a genius...
Could the Lu Yuanjun of those days really compare?
After a brief moment of silence, cheers and exclamations erupted throughout the city.
Fang Wang turned to look at the First Vein, his gaze just beginning to search for Lu Yuanjun when Yang Yuanzi's voice came, "Switch!"
With those words, relief washed over the disciple from the First Vein who was about to take the stage.
Even Xu Lang, second only to Lu Yuanjun, had been soundly defeated, and they dared not take the stage.
Up to this point in the Nine Veins Combat Method, Fang Wang was the most ruthless. Every one of his opponents had suffered heavy injuries.
Under the cheers of the entire city, Fang Wang flew towards the Third Vein's loft to be welcomed by the surrounding crowd of disciples.
"Brother Fang, you have already surpassed me!" Li Yu said excitedly, seemingly not worried that Fang Wang might take his place as the top disciple.
The other disciples were also praising Fang Wang's strength, with Zhou Bo being the most extravagant, seemingly ready to kneel and worship him.
Lu Yuanjun stood inside the loft, watching Fang Wang from a distance, and laughed softly, "It seems I underestimated Brother Fang's abilities."
All the disciples were marveling at Fang Wang's strength. To have achieved such prowess in only three years of entry, even Lu Yuanjun hadn't been so astonishing in his day.
Coupled with Zhou Xue, Ye Xiang, and Gu Li—who had each made a name for themselves earlier—all the disciples felt the Great Abyss Gate was on the brink of soaring to greater heights.
Previously, Earth Origin Spirit Treasures were rare, seen maybe once in a hundred years, but now four had emerged in the Great Abyss Gate in quick succession, a true blessing for the sect.
Fang Wang and Zhou Xue were considered Earth Origin Spirit Treasures because of their formidable power.
"Fang Wang, rest well now. You needn't go onstage again. Your victories suffice for you to advance to the final nine seats," the voice of Yang Yuanzi reached him. His tone was calm, seemingly not shocked by Fang Wang's performance, but a closer look would reveal his hands gripping the armrests of the chair tightly.
Within the Main Meridian's loft,
Sitting beside Guang Qiuxian was Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi, who appeared to be in his early fifties, his frame slightly lean but more authoritative than the amiable Guang Qiuxian, his presence commanding and intense.
"Brother, this young man is so formidable. Could he be the one hidden in Shiyuan Hall that day?" Chen Anshi cast a sharp glance at Guang Qiuxian and slowly inquired.
Guang Qiuxian smiled without speaking. He seemed composed, yet inwardly he was filled with emotion.
Is this what a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is like?
Such power after only three years...
Fang Wang, unaware of what the Sect Leader, Vice Sect Leader, and elders were thinking, began to fantasize about his second Lifespirit Treasure upon learning he could advance to the last nine seats.
Once he entered the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven and collected Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, he was determined to break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm, at which point he should be able to condense his second Lifespirit Treasure.
If the first Lifespirit Treasure was a halberd, what should the second one be?
He would have to give it some thought—perhaps Heavenly Palace wouldn't interfere with his second Spiritual Refinement.

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 44: Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, Sword in the Eye
chapters.content:
After the battle with Xu Lang, more information about Fang Wang began to spread.
Before joining, he was only in the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm, but three years after joining, he defeated a direct disciple in the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm!
This news was spread by the disciples of the third vein and swept through the city like a whirlwind. All who heard it were shaken. The prodigies of legend had appeared among them, making it seem unreal. Many people doubted this, thinking that Fang Wang was just as low-profile as Ye Xiang, giving the impression he was a new disciple.
Time would prove the truth!
In an inn within the main city, Zhao Zhen sat by the window. He was not looking at the Golden Mirror in the sky, but was pouring himself a drink, his right hand trembling as he did so.
The disciples in the inn, engrossed in discussions about Fang Wang's strength, failed to notice his agitation. If someone had sat opposite him, they would have seen him sweating profusely, his face etched with fear.
After Fang Wang left the arena, the battles that followed were spectacular but felt somewhat lackluster to the audience.
It turned out that the first vein had hidden another genius with the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure. Without including Fang Wang and Zhou Xue, this genius, along with Ye Xiang, Gu Li, and Lu Yuanjun, meant that the Great Abyss Gate had four such talents. No wonder they could become the strongest sect in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm in another timeline.
Right up until the last half-day when a lower-ranked vein challenged the third, Yang Yuanzi sent Gu Li to face the challenge. Her opponents were three disciples in the Soul Sculpting Realm and one in the first level of the Spirit Elixir Realm.
Confirmed!
Something fishy!
After securing four consecutive victories, Gu Li returned to Fang Wang's side, her face expressionless. Perhaps it was Fang Wang's imagination, but it seemed she was deliberately avoiding his gaze. Even when the other disciples praised her, she merely nodded slightly.
Thinking back on Gu Li's previous opponents, it seemed likely that those above the Spirit Elixir Realm had intentionally gone easy on her.
Indeed, how could the Great Abyss Gate not nurture such a prodigy with the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure?
Every rule has its gray areas.
Time flew by.
The seven-day period for the Nine Veins Combat Method finally arrived, and in the end, the third vein maintained the fifth place, marking their best performance in fifty years.
After Guang Qiuxian finished announcing the rankings of the veins, the Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi stood up and declared, "The nine disciples representing the Great Abyss Gate to seek opportunities in the Cave Heavens are Lu Yuanjun, Fang Wang, Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, Zhou Xue, Gu Li, Yan Feiyue, Tang Jue, and Xiao Ling!"
"One month from today, at noon, gather in front of the Shiyuan Hall and wait!"
With that, this session of the Nine Veins Combat Method came to an end!
Disciples from various pavilions flew out, heading towards the pavilion of the third vein, all drawn by Fang Wang.
Facing the outreach from the direct disciples of the other veins, Fang Wang could not help but respond politely, and even elders from other veins arrived later on.
It took a full hour before Fang Wang could finally extricate himself. He quickly returned to his own cave abode's gate, only to find Gu Li waiting outside.
As Fang Wang landed, about to greet her, Gu Li spoke first, "You must be disappointed, but I had no choice in refusing. Even if I was unwilling, the sect would have pushed me forward, and I do want this opportunity as well. My father had discussed this with me beforehand."
Fang Wang blinked and replied, "Disappointed? All I feel is envy. Please, are you bragging?"
Fairness?
A joke—in this world, apart from life and death, what is truly fair? With the advent of cultivation, even life and death may become unfair.
Gu Li's mood lightened a bit at his tone. She rolled her eyes at him and then took out two blue-covered books from her storage bag, handing them to Fang Wang. She said, "After hearing about your victory over me during the entrance examination when you were at the seventh level of Qi Cultivation, my father wanted to make friends with you.
Here is the 'Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures' and my family's unique 'Divine Nurturing Sword Qi'."
"The 'Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures' records the various heavenly treasures of the world, which can help you collect treasures in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. 'Divine Nurturing Sword Qi' is the compulsory swordplay for the direct descendants of the Gu Family, but few can truly master it. Achieving greatness with it is said to possess divine prowess as in the legends."
After saying this, she turned and left. Watching her retreating figure, Fang Wang was left wanting to say more yet held back.
Gu Li walked away quickly, returning to her own cave abode as if afraid he would refuse.
Fang Wang shook his head with a wry smile, then entered his cave abode.
Sitting on his bed, Fang Wang began to peruse the 'Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures'. Each page was illustrated, followed by descriptions, and the variety of flora and minerals captivated him greatly. Although not a secret manual, the 'Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures' still brought surprises to Fang Wang.
After immersing himself in it for half an hour, he put the 'Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures' into his storage bag and then picked up the 'Divine Nurturing Sword Qi' to examine it.
He did not have high expectations for the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, having witnessed Gu Li's Five Saints Sword Technique.
As he watched, his expression turned serious.
Divine Nurturing Sword Qi is no mere trifle!
This sword qi is nourished within the Dantian, and the longer it is cultivated, the stronger it becomes. In general, Divine Nurturing Sword Qi is very weak in the early stages, and it is even difficult to form combat power within the first ten years, which is why Gu Li has never used it up to now.
Fang Wang was different. If he began with cultivating Divine Nurturing Sword Qi to the realm of Great Perfection, his speed in cultivating this sword qi would be far superior to any of the Gu Family, as they had to practice step by step, taking a long time to condense sword qi.
As Fang Wang was about to turn to the last page, his hand trembled slightly.
God knows how long he would stay within the Heavenly Palace, but thinking that he was about to go to the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, he felt that having one more method of combat was a good thing.
Fang Wang took a deep breath, then turned the last page and began to read.
When he finished reading the last word, his mind exploded, and everything before his eyes blurred.
When Fang Wang reopened his eyes, he found himself within the Heavenly Palace. He did not waste time and immediately began to cultivate Divine Nurturing Sword Qi.
Divine Nurturing Sword Qi did not have a division of levels in its realm, but the process of cultivation was challenging, resembling a quest to explore one's soul rather than an ordinary sword qi.
And so years passed.
Finally, it took Fang Wang a hundred and twenty years to cultivate the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi to the realm of Great Perfection. At that moment, he finally believed Gu Li's words.
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi indeed possessed divine and mystical abilities!
The sword qi of Great Perfection was not within the Dantian but within the soul, resulting in a significant enhancement of Fang Wang's spiritual sense, enabling him to introspect his own soul.
Essentially, the Great Perfection Divine Nurturing Sword Qi was like a portion of the soul that had been split off. It could shoot out from the eyes, under his control, return to the body after slaying the enemy without any impurity, and possess terrifying lethality.
The most crucial point was that there was no limit to the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi. The longer he nurtured it, the stronger it became.
Fang Wang's consciousness followed and exited the Heavenly Palace. When he opened his eyes, he saw his own cave dwelling.
He resisted the urge to go out and behold the world and began to cultivate Divine Nurturing Sword Qi. Spiritual energy entered his body, and in less than half the time it takes to brew a cup of tea, his soul had refined the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi.
From then on, whenever he gathered qi, a part of the spiritual energy would automatically nourish the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, which is the Great Perfection of Divine Nurturing Sword Qi that did not require separate cultivation.
Of course, if he felt that Divine Nurturing Sword Qi was affecting his cultivation speed, he could also sever the connection between it and the outside world on his own.
Fang Wang's eyes widened, shining brightly, and a stream of sword qi emerged from his eyes. It moved swiftly through the cave dwelling, fast as lightning. With a quick gesture, the sword qi rapidly reentered his eyes, and his gaze returned to normal.
Exhilarating!
The moment the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi left his body, Fang Wang felt as if he had a doppelganger, able to perfectly control the sword qi. Everything around him seemed to stand still.
In future battles, Divine Nurturing Sword Qi would be his ace!
Hundreds of years from now, Divine Nurturing Sword Qi would be his trump card. With a glare, sword qi would overflow, capable of destroying the heavens and the earth!
The mere thought filled Fang Wang with excitement.
He immediately got up, walked out of his cave dwelling, and stood on the edge of the cliff. Looking at the snowflakes whirling in the sky, he wanted to shout out loud to vent the frustrations of a century of arduous cultivation, but he refrained!
No!
He must go out for a walk, talk to someone!
Fang Wang immediately set off to visit his clan members. Except for Zhou Xue, they were all in their respective cave dwellings.
It was not until three days later that he returned, hesitating for a moment at the mountain gate. He then came to Gu Li's cave dwelling and called out, "Miss Gu, are you there?"
Soon after, the mountain gate opened, and Gu Li emerged. She asked with confusion, "What's the matter?"
Fang Wang seldom took the initiative to seek her out, and she thought something might have happened.
"I have been studying Divine Nurturing Sword Qi for the past three days. May I ask how many people in the Gu Family have mastered it? To what extent can the strongest among them utilize it?" Fang Wang asked earnestly.
After a hundred and twenty years of solitude, he needed to make some comparisons.
Gu Li replied helplessly, "Fang Wang, you are indeed a genius, but Divine Nurturing Sword Qi should not be rushed. Currently, in the Gu Family, less than a handful of people can use it in combat. The most powerful among them is my grandfather, who can exhale sword qi from his mouth, nothing can resist it, and it's even capable of shattering superior grade magic artifacts."

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 45 Chi Devil Sect
chapters.content:
```
Exhaling Sword Qi?
Wasn't that the level I attained after forty years of practice?
Having heard Gu Li's words, Fang Wang was certain that his mastery of the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi had already surpassed everyone in the Gu Family, well, everyone who was alive.
"I see, no wonder it's so hard to practice," Fang Wang said, feigning agreement.
Fearing she might have dampened Fang Wang's enthusiasm, Gu Li comforted him, "Don't be disheartened. With your outstanding talent, you have mastered the Sword Control Technique to an unimaginable extent. Given time, your Divine Nurturing Sword Qi will certainly reach a divine level, far surpassing even my grandfather."
"Thanks for the encouragement, Miss Gu. I'll have to practice more and not let you down."
"Hmm, if you do master the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, remember to tell me about it."
"Oh? Why is that?"
"My father is very much looking forward to your results."
"It won't be because once I have mastered it, your father will betroth you to me, will it?"
"As if! You wish. With my talent, my father would never arrange my marriage. I will pursue cultivation in this lifetime, not marriage!"
Gu Li retorted with wide eyes, her cheeks blushing slightly.
Fang Wang suddenly couldn't tell if she was shy or angry with embarrassment, but he dared not admit that he had already mastered the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi. He still wanted to keep his talent a secret.
"I need to go practice now, no more talking!"
Gu Li huffed and turned back to her cave dwelling.
Fang Wang smiled, finding this side of Gu Li quite interesting—she wasn't as aloof as she usually was.
He followed her back to the dwelling, preparing to cultivate. He might encounter cultivators from other dynastic realms of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm when he went to Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, so he needed to become as strong as possible.
...
The appointed month arrived quickly, yet the winter snow at Great Abyss Gate had not yet melted.
In front of Shiyuan Hall, on the Main Meridian.
Fang Wang and Gu Li arrived on their swords and landed. Five disciples were already waiting there, including Zhou Xue and Xu Lang.
