Upon seeing Fang Wang, Xu Lang's face turned unnatural, but he still took the initiative to nod to Fang Wang, who did not put on airs and nodded back.
Zhou Xue came up to Fang Wang and teased, "Look at you two, arriving together. You seem to have a good relationship."
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow, "After all, we are neighbors."
Gu Li glanced at Zhou Xue and silently moved aside, giving the two some space. She didn't feel left out, as the other disciples began to greet her warmly.
Fang Wang said softly with a smile, "It's still you, Han Yu. They all say they have received your help and guidance, you've never ignored anyone. In this regard, I cannot compare to you. You are indeed our lead big brother."
Lead big brother?
Zhou Xue pursed her lips and smiled, "That title doesn't sound very nice. Don't overthink it. You just focus all your energy on your own cultivation. If I need to leave for some matter, I'll tell you in advance. You don't need to worry about the Fang Family affairs."
Fang Wang nodded. The two had been through life and death together and were worthy of trust. Additionally, thanks to Zhou Xue's presence, he indeed hadn't needed to trouble himself with other matters, even when it came to rescuing Fang Hanyu, as Zhou Xue had accompanied him.
Zhou Xue had even taken on the task of revenge for him. Although Fang Wang had no complaints on the surface, he was inwardly determined.
Once he had the strength to confront Lu Yuanjun and the forces behind him, he would certainly take his revenge by his own hand!
It wasn't long before Lu Yuanjun and another disciple arrived, and for the first time, the nine disciples representing the Great Abyss Gate gathered together. Naturally, Lu Yuanjun was the central figure, with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to take care of every disciple.
Zhou Xue was the same, chatting and laughing with Lu Yuanjun as if they had a very good relationship as senior brother and junior sister. However, Fang Wang, who knew the truth, sensed her murderous intent.
At that moment,
The doors to Shiyuan Hall opened, and Guang Qiuxian, followed by a group of elders, walked out. Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi was right behind Guang Qiuxian, exuding an impressive aura that made him even more eye-catching than Guang Qiuxian.
"Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi is a spy of the Chi Devil Sect. The future assault on the Great Abyss Gate by the Demonic Dao will be led by him. Stay away from him and don't believe a word he says."
Suddenly, Fang Wang heard Zhou Xue's sound transmission. His heart skipped a beat.
Good lord, aren't you afraid the Vice Sect Leader will hear you?
Fang Wang didn't dare look at Zhou Xue or Chen Anshi; his gaze fell on Guang Qiuxian.
He knew his Sound Transmission Technique was not as good as Zhou Xue's, so he didn't dare respond.
```
Guang Qiuxian walked to the edge of the stone steps and spoke, "This journey will be led by the Vice Sect Leader and the Inheritance Elder. They will inform you of the specifics along the way. Although this trip presents an opportunity, it is also fraught with potential disaster. Take care of yourselves; I will be waiting for your return at the Great Abyss Gate."
Fang Wang's gaze fell upon Inheritance Elder Zhao Chuanqian. It had been Zhao Chuanqian who first introduced him to Guang Qiuxian and later initiated him into the third vein.
Feeling Fang Wang's gaze, Zhao Chuanqian maintained his dignity, merely exchanging a glance with Fang Wang without responding.
Chen Anshi stepped forward, and with a wave of his right hand, a small wooden boat flew out from his sleeve, swiftly enlarging to a length of thirty feet. The boat even had a pavilion on it, entirely red in color and adorned with hanging lanterns.
The wooden boat hovered in mid-air. As soon as it appeared, Fang Wang distinctly felt the surrounding nature's spiritual energy surging toward it.
Chen Anshi, Zhao Chuanqian, and five other elders leapt onto the boat, followed closely by the nine disciples.
Standing on the deck, Fang Wang probed the boat with his divine sense and found that beneath the wooden planks were various talisman papers and magic artifact components, complex and precise.
Soon, the wooden boat set sail. Its speed increased dramatically and, in the blink of an eye, it disappeared into the snowy mist on the horizon.
Guang Qiuxian stood on the steps, looking up at this scene, while the elders behind him gradually left. Eventually, Yang Yuanzi walked out from the Shiyuan Hall, coming to stand beside him.
Now only the two of them remained.
The cold wind passed by, blowing the hair at their temples.
"Elder brother, I always feel that the transition of Grand Qi into a Cultivation Dynasty isn't reliable. I fear that this trip to the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven may bring about a serious incident," Yang Yuanzi said, his tone indifferent.
Guang Qiuxian answered with an expressionless face, "I know, but luckily the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven is not controlled by any single sect. Such an opportunity cannot be missed. It will enable this group of disciples to grow faster, especially Yuanjun. The Great Abyss Gate needs his power."
Yang Yuanzi frowned and inquired, "Recently, rumors have been circulating about Lu Yuanjun within the main meridian. Elder brother, you must keep an eye on him, don't indulge him, and don't forget his origins."
Guang Qiuxian glanced at him and replied, "Junior brother, let the grievances of the past generation remain with them. As for those rumors, as long as they are not too influential, just let them be. Don't you also possess some spells from the Green Cicada Valley? Should I hold you accountable for that?"
"Hmph! Then let's see if your spoiled Lu Yuanjun can stand up to Chi Devil Sect's Xia Qingchan and Suspended Vast Sword Sect's Xu Qiuming!" Yang Yuanzi replied coldly.
Guang Qiuxian shook his head and chuckled, then turned to walk towards the Shiyuan Hall.
...
The setting sun dipped toward the horizon, half-obscured by it.
Fang Wang stood on the deck, facing the wind. He enjoyed the magnificent landscape along the journey, feeling his spirit uplifted.
Having been cooped up in the Heavenly Palace for one hundred and twenty years, he needed to relax, fearing that his mentality would otherwise suffer.
In his previous life, he had read cultivation novels with all kinds of sects, but never imagined that once he embarked on the path of cultivation, it would be a different route altogether.
What was this?
Cultivation-as-imprisonment?
Fang Wang mocked himself inwardly. Although the years of cultivation in the Heavenly Palace were dull and boring, the sense of achievement he felt afterward was tremendous, so he was still grateful for owning the Heavenly Palace.
"What are you thinking about?"
Zhou Xue's voice came, and he saw her walking up to stand side by side with Fang Wang.
Fang Wang glanced at her and replied with a soft laugh, "Nothing much, just appreciating the scenery of the Mortal Realm. Isn't it truly free and easy to gaze upon the world from here, seeking the joy of cultivation?"
Zhou Xue looked toward the horizon without responding.
Fang Wang also said nothing more, continuing to immerse himself in the vast beauty of the landscape.
At dusk, the firmament glowed red, and the cloud sea looked like splattered blood. The lofty mountains below seemed bleak, yet their peaks were bathed in light, creating a dreamlike scene across the entire earth.
"The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven might become a turning point for the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm in the future. You must be extremely cautious inside; if you encounter disciples from other sects, you cannot trust them. If anyone shows malice toward you, you must either kill or flee, without hesitation," Zhou Xue's voice rose next to Fang Wang's ear, using the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang didn't respond, fearing that the disciples and elders behind might detect something unusual.
Zhou Xue continued to use the Sound Transmission Technique to brief Fang Wang on prominent figures from other sects, even listing a few individuals who were best avoided.
Gu Li sat cross-legged at the edge of the boat. As she opened her eyes and looked, she saw the backs of Fang Wang and Zhou Xue together, bathed in the glow of the setting sun—a seemingly perfect match that left her in a trance.
A month ago, after witnessing Zhou Xue's performance, she knew that she was no match for her. Consequently, her goal now included one more person.
"If I can't defeat Zhou Xue, how am I qualified to challenge you?" Gu Li thought to herself, her eyes filled with resolve.
At that moment, another person was watching Fang Wang and Zhou Xue—this person was standing at the edge of the second floor of the pavilion, Lu Yuanjun.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 46 Unprovokable
chapters.content:
The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven was located outside the western territories of the Qi Dynasty, an area of chaos that lay between Qi and Wei, uncontrolled by any dynasty due to the frequent comings and goings of Cultivators.
In the past, Cultivators were attracted to this region because of the abundant Spiritual Energy, but no one could have imagined that a Cave Heaven was hidden behind it.
At dawn, the sunlight streaked across the deck, shining on every person aboard.
Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi stood on the deck, introducing the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, "The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven is a cave dwelling left by an ancient Great Saint, forming a small world unto itself. It was once under the control of Ji Hao Sect, but now that the sect has dissipated, the Artifact Spirit of the grotto still remains, maintaining the rules of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
During this exploration, the Great Cultivators from the Nine Great Sects won't be able to accompany you, so you'll have to rely on yourselves."
"The exploration will last for six months, and whatever you obtain will be yours to keep, with no need to contribute to the sect. After six months, I will wait for you at the entrance. Any enmity formed inside must not be brought out. In other words, there will be competition inside.
You represent the best talents of Tai Yuan Sect, and you need to not only strive to survive but also to win glory for Tai Yuan Sect, understand?"
Chen Anshi spoke seriously, his gaze sharply scanning all the Disciples.
Fang Wang felt in his heart that being an undercover agent required impressive acting skills. If it weren't for Zhou Xue's reminder, he truly wouldn't have realized Chen Anshi was a spy from the Demonic Dao.
Tsk, this fellow must have already leaked their information to the Chi Devil Sect, indicating that the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven will be fraught with deadly peril!
The Disciples listened attentively.
According to what Chen Anshi had said, the threshold to enter the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven was limited by the Artifact Spirit to those below the fifth level of Profound Heart Realm, and each sect could only enter with nine people.
As for whether there were only nine sects, the Artifact Spirit was ambiguous, so Chen Anshi reminded his Disciples that they might encounter Cultivators from the Grand Wei Cultivation World.
Having defeated Xu Lang, who was at the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, Fang Wang faced the Profound Heart Realm with wariness, but not outright fear—he had yet to employ his strongest Spells!
Half an hour later.
The Law Ship flew into a desolate wilderness, where the land was crimson red, with sparse flowers, grass, and trees, and fissures crisscrossed the ground, forming a complex network of canyons.
Two towering peaks appeared up ahead, about thirty feet apart, as if cleaved in two by a Sword Cultivator's strike—an awe-inspiring sight.
The Law Ship descended, and Fang Wang followed Chen Anshi off the vessel, with Zhao Chuanqian and the Elders trailing behind.
Fang Wang fixed his gaze and saw that Cultivators had already gathered at the base of the mountains, their attire indicating they were from six different sects, numbering over a hundred in total.
The arrival of the Tai Yuan Sect drew the attention of the various sects, and Fang Wang felt annoyed by the many divine senses sweeping over him.
"Hmph!"
Chen Anshi let out a cold snort, sounding like a peal of thunder, and the divine senses that surrounded Fang Wang immediately dissipated, with the complexions of the other Disciples also improving.
"Hahaha, isn't that the Vice Sect Leader of Tai Yuan Sect? Chen Anshi, when will you step into the Condensation Spirit Realm?" an Elder called out with a laugh, his voice booming and easing the tense atmosphere as other sect Elders greeted him.
"Vice Sect Leader Chen, this batch of Tai Yuan Sect Disciples is extraordinary!"
"Who is Fang Wang? In just three years of cultivation, to defeat someone at the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, that's truly remarkable!"
"With Fang Wang and Lu Yuanjun here, plus the three Earth Origin Spirit Treasures, tsk tsk, the primary seat among the Nine Great Sects will belong to Tai Yuan Sect in the future."
"Alas, it's a pity that Taiqing Gate doesn't have such good fortune, even though we share the same origins as Tai Yuan Sect."
The Great Cultivators from various sects gathered together, all praising Tai Yuan Sect.
Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, and other Tai Yuan Sect Disciples couldn't help but look towards Fang Wang, their gazes equally complicated.
Fang Wang didn't expect that in just a month, his reputation would spread so quickly. It seemed that there were quite a few spies within Tai Yuan Sect.
When Lu Yuanjun heard someone step on him to boost Fang Wang, he remained indifferent, even wearing a harmless smile on his face.
Chen Anshi snorted, "No matter how impressive Fang Wang's talent is, he is still young. I hope the other sects will be more accommodating, after all, in the future, the Nine Great Sects will work together to develop the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. Our opponents are the Cultivation Worlds of Wei, Chu, and Zhao."
With that said, the other sect's Great Cultivators refrained from teasing and steered the conversation towards the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
"Seems like your trouble has increased. Take care," Zhou Xue's voice reached Fang Wang's ears. He couldn't help but glance at her and shot her a look that told her to figure it out on her own.
Seeing this, Zhou Xue pursed her lips into a smile and moved beside him, taking out a secret manual from her storage bag and passing it to him.
Fang Wang glanced at it and saw four characters on the cover: Spiritual Refinement Compendium.
His heart leaped with joy, and he immediately placed the Spiritual Refinement Compendium inside his storage bag.
Gu Li, not far away, noticed this scene; she could vaguely see the girl biting her lip behind her veil.
An hour later, the remaining two sects arrived.
Fang Wang's attention was drawn to the Suspended Vast Sword Sect. His gaze swept over them as he tried to identify Xu Qiuming.
Zhou Xue had said that Xu Qiuming of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect was absolutely not to be provoked. The Tai Yuan Sect would become the strongest sect in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, but Xu Qiuming would become the strongest individual. It was only after he left the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm and journeyed overseas in search of opportunities that Lu Yuanjun could finally ascend to the top.
According to Zhou Xue, Lu Yuanjun was formidable, but only a significant figure within the pond that was the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, while Xu Qiuming was someone truly in pursuit of The Path of Immortality. When Zhou Xue reached the human realm's highest echelon, Xu Qiuming had already done the same, only he didn't have the fate to ascend to immortality.
"It seems the youngest-looking boy there is Xu Qiuming," Zhou Xue conveyed through a message.
Fang Wang's gaze settled on a black-clad youth who appeared around fourteen or fifteen years of age. His features weren't exactly handsome, but could be considered delicate. Unlike other disciples of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect who all wore treasured swords, he had nothing at his waist and did not carry a sword on his back, lacking the aura of a strong cultivator.
Feeling Fang Wang's gaze, Xu Qiuming looked towards him and offered a toothy smile that seemed somewhat shy.
Fang Wang nodded at him immediately, then withdrew his gaze.
Vice Sect Leaders and Elders from each sect were conversing while the disciples of each sect stood to aside, clearly demarcated.
Until midday.
The two straight mountain peaks in front suddenly trembled, diverting everyone's attention.
"Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven has opened, each sect prepare to enter!"
An Elder from the Taiqing Gate called out loudly, and instantly, the disciples got to their feet.
A bright light appeared between the two peaks, so dazzling that it was impossible to see what lay beyond the canyon.
The nine disciples from Green Cicada Valley were the first to enter the bright light, their presence vanishing after them, followed by Taiqing Gate and Chi Devil Sect.
Chen Anshi turned around and admonished, "Remember, be cautious in all things! Trust no one lightly; your aim is to seek Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures as well as legacies, understood?"
All the disciples nodded in unison. Aside from Fang Wang and Zhou Xue, they all felt that this Vice Sect Leader, though seemingly strict, had a warm heart.
Soon, it was the turn of the Tai Yuan Sect, with Lu Yuanjun leading the entry into the canyon.
Fang Wang followed behind Zhou Xue, and Gu Li was behind him.
Silence reigned throughout the journey.
As soon as Fang Wang stepped into the bright light, he was enveloped by an unimaginable force. He then felt his body out of control, as if suddenly plummeting, the sensation of weightlessness making him quite uncomfortable, but he couldn't open his eyes.
A full ten breaths passed.
Fang Wang finally felt his feet touch the ground, and the intense dizziness nearly made him fall, but he managed to stabilize his body.
Regaining control over his body gradually, Fang Wang felt nature's spiritual energy, richer than what was in Tai Yuan Sect's grotto-heavens, rushing towards him. He felt invigorated and reflexively opened his eyes.
A range of undulating hills stretched before him, with thunderclouds rolling at the horizon, the vast figures of demons circling. He stood on the brink of a cliff, just five steps away from taking a fall.
He immediately turned around, looking into the distance, but saw no one. Spreading his consciousness, he similarly detected no trace of others.
Indeed, just as Chen Anshi had said, upon transmission, they would be dispersed, and where exactly they landed was up to the will of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven's Artifact Spirit.
After half a year, the Artifact Spirit would send them out, so there was no need for them to find an exit.
Fang Wang did not rush to search but instead sat at the edge of the cliff, taking out the Spirit Refinement manual Zhou Xue had given him.
Spirit Refinement required Heavenly Dao Spirit Stones, and within the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, only the Nine Great Sects had access to Heavenly Dao Spirit Stones. Even if a noble family had any, they had to hide it, or else it would bring about a deadly calamity.
Fang Wang had originally planned to return to Tai Yuan Sect for Spiritual Refinement after concluding his journey, but now it seemed unnecessary since the first page of the Spirit Refinement manual detailed how to create temporary Heavenly Dao Spirit Stones!
Apart from the manufacturing method, there were also some special locations suitable for Spiritual Refinement temporarily undiscovered by the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
Even though it was called the Spirit Refinement manual, most of its content was about how to condense Spirit Pills. He suspected that this was specially written for him by Zhou Xue.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 47 Have You Ever Heard of the Great Saint's Heaven Subjugation?_1
chapters.content:
A period of time equivalent to one tea session later, Fang Wang set down the Spiritual Refinement Classic.
The difficulty of making a temporary Heavenly Dao Spirit Stone was quite high, requiring some special materials. It was better to find a place where Spiritual Energy was so abundant that it formed a whirlwind, then by setting up a special Formation, it would be possible to create an effect comparable to that of the Heavenly Dao Spirit Stone.
With his eidetic memory, Fang Wang noted down some key points and then got up to take action.
Before coming, he had exchanged for the largest capacity storage bag at the Great Abyss Gate, specifically for collecting as many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures as possible on this journey.
He descended into the forest below the cliff, and upon landing, he was attracted by some brightly colored flowers and fruits. He took out the catalog of natural treasures given to him by Gu Li. Regarding this book, he had only memorized the patterns and specific page numbers, not the detailed contents of each page.
He flipped directly to a certain page and then made a comparison.
"Luhuang fruit, good for enhancing one's vitality and energy. Not bad, I'll take it."
Fang Wang thought contentedly to himself. To have a find at the very start, he followed the tips in the catalog of natural treasures, avoiding the poisonous thorns of the surrounding weeds and easily picking the Luhuang fruit.
On the rest of his journey, Fang Wang's pace wasn't fast; it was as if he was taking a leisurely stroll through the forest.
This was his first time collecting Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, so he was quite excited, feeling like he was playing an adventure game.
In this life, aside from Cultivation, it was all about traveling. He had never really relaxed. Considering his actual age, he had lived for over a thousand years, and most of that time had been like being in jail. If he didn't relax properly, he feared that he might develop a Heart Demon.
This forest was vast, with trees taller than those in the outer world and denser undergrowth. Some of the bushes were even taller than Fang Wang himself.
An hour later, Fang Wang had already gathered quite a bit, but they could only be considered good materials, not reaching the level of Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.
To break through to the Spirit Pill realm, some special Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures were needed, and they also had to be of a particular attribute. During the breakthrough process, the more attribute-specific Spiritual Power absorbed from these materials and treasures, the stronger the created Spirit Pill would be, and it would also transform one's own attribute of Spiritual Power.
In Zhou Xue's Spiritual Refinement Classic, she cautioned Fang Wang against focusing on fire attributes and instead advised collecting Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures of all five elements to balance his Spiritual Power attributes. Although she didn't explain why, Fang Wang was willing to trust her.
Perhaps focusing on particular attributes of Spiritual Power could make a Cultivator stronger in the earlier stages, but to become an immortal, one certainly had to reach the level of natural harmony between heaven and earth—which meant the unity of the five elements.
To combine the five elements is to give birth to even more properties.
Suddenly.
Fang Wang stopped in his tracks, faintly hearing the sound of a woman crying. As a Cultivator, he was not one to have auditory hallucinations.
The women capable of entering the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven wouldn't cry so easily, would they?
Could it be a demon from the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven playing tricks?
Fang Wang was not apprehensive; instead, he felt some anticipation. Demons also cultivated, and some Great Demons could even cultivate a Demon Core. A Demon Core was also a treasured item that Cultivators could use when condensing a Spirit Pill.
He immediately headed toward the source of the sound, simultaneously cultivating his White Rainbow Evasion Technique to make his aura disappear.
As he advanced, the mysterious crying of the woman became clearer and clearer. Gradually, Fang Wang sensed Demonic Qi.
It was undoubtedly a demon!
Yet the distance between him and the creature was greater than he had expected.
After traveling several dozen miles, Fang Wang saw the end of the forest. He began to slow down and move through the branches.
It was obvious that the crying sound was intentionally made to lure him here.
Fang Wang's right hand gripped the hilt of his Qingjun Sword; his movements were as agile as a monkey yet as light as a wild goose, not making a single sound.
He arrived at the edge of the forest, using the dense leaves as cover, and looked towards the open area beyond. Ahead lay a hillside sparsely vegetated and strewn with rocks of various sizes.
His gaze quickly locked onto a figure halfway up the hillside—that of a woman in white standing on a cliff, disheveled, preventing a clear view of her face. She was holding a Green Snake in her right hand, which was continually emitting the sorrowful cries like that of a woman.
Fang Wang frowned. The Green Snake emitted an extremely strong Demonic Qi, the strongest he had ever felt. As for the woman in white, she emitted no aura at all; if one closed their eyes, they wouldn't be able to sense her presence.
The woman in white stood motionless; the Green Snake in her hand trembled slightly, and the whining sounded even more pitiable—just by listening, one could easily imagine a delicate and wronged woman weeping quietly.
Fang Wang was unable to gauge the strength of the woman in white and thus dared not act rashly.
He observed patiently and soon noticed a deep yellow rock embedded in the mountainside behind the white-clothed woman.
```
Earth Element Ore!
A heavenly material and earthly treasure for forging magic artifacts and condensing spirit pills, the Earth Element Ore harbors an extremely high concentration of earth-attributed spiritual energy, and the ore is far larger than it appears—it could very well be that this entire mountain is made of Earth Element Ore.
Fang Wang began to ponder, he must find a way to cut off a piece.
If only someone would emerge and test the waters!
Just as this thought surfaced, a swooshing sound broke the silence, startling Fang Wang into a focused gaze. From another direction, a flying sword shot out of the woods and streaked towards the woman in white with incredible speed.
So fast!
This was even faster than Xu Lang's sword!
In the blink of an eye, the flying sword reached the woman in white, and suddenly came to a halt mere five centimeters from her head. The sword blade trembled but could not move any further.
Swoosh—
A figure sprang from the woods, a young man clad in black garments. Fang Wang instantly recognized him as a cultivator from the Suspended Vast Sword Sect.
The disciples of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect wear black robes with a sword pattern embroidered on the back, and the number of swords signifies the disciple's rank. The man bore five swords, indicating he was a direct disciple of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect.
The man in black leapt forward, grabbed the hilt of his flying sword, and raised his left hand, flicking two fingers. A sword qi shot out, instantly striking the woman in white, piercing through her body, and then hitting the Earth Element Ore behind her, causing shards to fly in all directions.
The man in black tried to leap away with his sword, but found he couldn't lift the flying sword at all. An invisible force had fixed his sword in place, causing his complexion to drastically change.
He leaped away fiercely, abandoning the flying sword. Midair, his hands moved swiftly to cast spells. Rings of sword qi enveloped him and shot up into the sky. His right hand pointed towards the heavens, and the sword qi followed the direction of his fingertips to quickly condense into a colossal sword qi, fifty feet in length.
As the saying goes, "easier said than done," but the whole process was over in the blink of an eye!
The man in black used his palm as if it were a sword, slashing towards the woman in white. The giant sword qi crashed down like a heavenly punishment, striking the woman in white.
The mountains trembled violently as sword qi spilled out in every direction, like wind blades rampaging across the landscape, slicing even the peripheral trees with deep gashes.
Fang Wang's pupils suddenly dilated, and the man in black turned as pale as death. They saw his sword qi hovering above the woman's head, unable to fall.
The woman in white slowly lifted her head, revealing a ghastly pale face. Her features were undeniably beautiful enough to topple empires, but her skin was so pale it sent chills down one's spine, and her eyes were numb, as still as dead water.
Suddenly, she let go of the Green Snake in her hand. The snake fell to the ground, and as it tried to escape, she stepped on it. The snake's body twitched and then lay still.
Feeling an intense killing intent, the man in black immediately turned and fled.
With sword qi clinging to his body like a flying sword tearing through the sky, he rapidly disappeared on the other side of the woods, while the woman in white floated up and vanished on the spot.
Now was his chance!
Fang Wang immediately moved, transforming into a White Rainbow, and swiftly arrived at the edge of the cliff. He swung his sword to cut off a piece of the Earth Element Ore from the cliffside and threw it into his storage bag.
Before leaving, he glanced at the half-dead Green Snake on the ground, hooked it with his foot, grabbed the snake's head with his left hand to prevent it from biting, and took off with it on his flying sword.
To prevent the woman in white from catching up, Fang Wang immediately used the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, fleeing at full speed.
Fang Wang felt a thrill of excitement in his heart, having stumbled upon such great fortune just upon arrival, heaven was truly aiding him.
The Earth Element Ore could be used as one of the materials for spirit pills, and the Green Snake in his hand had an astonishing amount of demonic qi—perhaps it contained a demon core. He needed to find a place to dissect it and check!
Fang Wang's White Rainbow Evasion Technique was incredibly fast, and he sped over a hundred miles. He even encountered two disciples from other sects along the way, who were so startled by Fang Wang's speed that they too fled in different directions.
After escaping for two hundred miles, Fang Wang finally slowed down. He looked around for a suitable place to rest.
Just then, Fang Wang felt a chill run down his spine, followed by a cold voice that entered his ears:
"Have you ever heard of the Great Saint's Heaven Subjugation?"
He turned his head to look, and to his surprise, the woman in white was behind him, not even three meters away.
An exceedingly dangerous proximity!
```

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 48 Legend, True Skill Map [Seeking Monthly Pass]
chapters.content:
The moment Fang Wang caught sight of the woman in white, he immediately accelerated and once again employed the White Rainbow Evasion Technique. His right hand naturally slid the Qingjun Sword into its scabbard and summoned the Heavenly Palace Halberd. Only with the heavenly Palace Halberd in hand did his sense of security surge to its maximum.
He glanced back again and found that the woman in white had vanished, but he certainly wouldn't stop.
Ten breaths later.
"Have you ever heard of the Great Saint's Heaven Subjugation?"
The woman in white's voice came once more, but Fang Wang dared not answer, fearing it was a trick after all, he had seen Journey to the West.
Fang Wang glanced aside and saw the woman in white reappear behind him, this time even closer.
Without another word, he turned around and thrust with the halberd. The blade pierced through the woman's body with no bloodshed—her robe didn't even tear!
A ghost!
No wonder he couldn't sense her breath!
Fang Wang's eyes narrowed as the Solaris True Fire arose from his right hand, swiftly moving along the halberd towards the woman in white and reaching her in the blink of an eye.
The Solaris Flame is capable of scorching souls!
As expected, the woman in white immediately halted, and the distance between them rapidly grew.
The woman in white slightly furrowed her brow, then suddenly waved her sleeves to disperse the Solaris True Fire around her, and the next second, she disappeared into thin air.
Fang Wang couldn't afford to be careless, this creature could appear and disappear unpredictably; he had to remain vigilant.
On the road that followed, Fang Wang maintained full speed whilst the voice of the woman in white no longer echoed in his ears.
He looked back frequently but saw no sign of the woman in white.
Half an hour later.
Fang Wang landed by the riverbank. The area was a wilderness with an open view, convenient for resting.
He stuck the Heavenly Palace Halberd into the ground and looked around for a while to make sure the woman in white would not reappear before he finally relaxed.
He wondered about the fate of the black-clothed man who was chased before.
Fang Wang threw the Green Snake to the ground and then drew the Qingjun Sword, stabbing it into the snake's belly.
"Ah—"
A delicate female scream arose as the Green Snake opened its eyes, but Fang Wang's left hand instantly grabbed its head, suppressing it forcefully with his own Spiritual Power.
The Demonic Qi of the Green Snake was startling, but not enough to frighten Fang Wang; otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to bring it along.
"Don't kill me... don't kill me... I can lead you to treasures!"
The Green Snake cried out urgently, its pleading voice enough to soften the hearts of most men, but Fang Wang remained unmoved.
He couldn't sympathize with a snake. His sword-holding hand began to exert force, causing the Green Snake to cry out in even greater agony.
"I know the whereabouts of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven legacy!"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang's hand paused as he squinted and asked, "What legacy site?"
The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven once belonged to the Ji Hao Sect, possibly concealing its legacy.
To this day, Fang Wang was still preoccupied with the thought of obtaining the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
It was said that the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique was not any weaker than the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art—a cultivation technique that Zhou Xue could not acquire before her reincarnation.
The realms of immortals and mortals were separated. Once ascended, Zhou Xue couldn't return to the lower world, leaving many regrets to linger eternally.
"Many legacy sites..." the Green Snake sobbed and replied.
Fang Wang squinted and asked, "Does the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven have the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique?"
"The Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique? That's the strongest technique of the Ji Hao Sect—no, but I saw a map of it in one place!"
The Green Snake answered quickly, fearing Fang Wang would make a move since a Superior Grade Spiritual Weapon was still embedded in its belly.
Fang Wang weighed his options and decided to give it a chance.
He was certain to encounter another Demon Core, but a guide would be hard to find.
He would, however, need to guard against a sneak attack from the Green Snake.
Fang Wang pulled out his Qingjun Sword, then stepped back, taking the Heavenly Palace Halberd with him. The Green Snake rolled over and coiled up, flicking its tongue at Fang Wang with a look of aggrieved innocence on its serpentine face.
As he retreated to a distance of five zhang, Fang Wang sat down to gather Qi. He appeared to close his eyes, but his consciousness was constantly monitoring the Green Snake.
If the Green Snake attempted to flee, he would not hesitate to kill it, although if it managed to escape, he wouldn't lose anything.
Before long, Fang Wang sensed that a portion of nature's spiritual energy around him was being drawn towards the Green Snake, indicating that it was healing.
Quiet enveloped the riverbank.
Time slowly ticked by.
The mysterious woman in white did not appear again, seemingly fearing the Solaris True Fire.
Dusk gradually fell.
The small river flowed, glittering with waves, and tiny fish swam within.
The Green Snake raised its head, looked at Fang Wang, and constantly flicked its tongue. It mustered the courage to ask, "Young Master, how did you escape the pursuit of that evil spirit?"
Fang Wang did not open his eyes, answering, "I just used a little trick. By the way, she kept asking if you had heard of the Great Saint's Heaven Subjugation. What does that mean?"
Relieved by his non-threatening tone, the Green Snake said, "That evil spirit is extraordinary, the servant of an ancient Great Saint. Legend has it that in ancient times, the Heavenly Dao was unkind, and the Heavenly Gods descended, wreaking havoc upon the masses. The Great Saint stood up and slaughtered the Heavenly Gods, but also met with misfortune because of this, eventually perishing.
Her asking such a question is to see if beings in later generations remember this event. If they remember, she would spare them. Otherwise, they would die."
Fang Wang slightly raised his eyebrows, originally thinking 'Heaven Subjugation' was the Great Saint's name, not realizing it was a legend.
"Since you know this legend, why were you captured?"
"Because I've been trapped here for over three hundred years. She's caught me several times, and now the correct answer is useless…"
The Green Snake complained with a grievance, then opened up and did not stop pouring out its woes: "I was just a small green snake with no one to rely on. Three hundred years ago, I was carried away by an eagle. Halfway through, the eagle was shot down by a cultivator, and I fell to the ground. Despite the great disaster, I did not die.
Later, I accidentally crawled into a crevice and somehow came to the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. For three hundred years, I wanted to leave but could not escape. Young Master, I know you can't fully trust me, but please believe me, I also want to get out. Only by following you, can I have a glimmer of hope."
Fang Wang decided to test it, saying, "I will cultivate here for the next month. You help me collect Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures. If you do well, I will take you out."
This location had a wide view; if enemies approached, he could detect them early. It was better than being trapped in a dead end.
Hearing this, the Green Snake carefully asked, "May I rest for a few days?"
"Of course."
Upon hearing Fang Wang's answer, the Green Snake relaxed a lot.
In the following days, the Green Snake did not disturb Fang Wang and focused on healing.
After six days, the Green Snake left.
Fang Wang's Spiritual Power had recovered, so he began to walk along the riverbank to see if there were any treasures nearby.
Unfortunately, after walking dozens of miles, he saw no Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures and had to return the way he came.
Boom—
The ground suddenly trembled, and Fang Wang looked up towards the end of the earth and sky, sensing the direction from which the vibrations were coming.
This time, he did not join the commotion, instead choosing to cultivate on the spot, waiting for the return of the Green Snake.
If after one month the Green Snake did not return, then he would leave on his own, as if nothing had happened. But if the Green Snake came back, he could use its help to search for treasures and legacies.
The sunset gave way to moonrise, Fang Wang situated amid the vast world, facing the small river as he cultivated, feeling the Essence of the Sun and Moon and the gentle breeze of Spiritual Energy. This state of cultivation was far more comfortable than cultivating inside a cave dwelling.
Occasionally, cultivators passed by, but none dared to disturb him. Disciples from various sects were very cautious within the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
In the blink of an eye.
Half a month passed, and the Green Snake finally returned.
Fang Wang glanced over, watching it slither quickly towards him, his brow furrowed.
Nothing!
Was the snake playing tricks?
The Green Snake quickly arrived beside Fang Wang, opened its mouth, and spat out several fist-sized stones of various colors, at least five in total, followed by a scroll of paper.
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow, quite intrigued.
"Young Master, these stones all contain rich Spiritual Energy and should be considered Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures. And this map is the map of the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique. It took a lot of effort to find it. Can you trust me now?" the Green Snake said, flicking its tongue.
Fang Wang stared at it and asked, "I almost killed you. Why didn't you take that chance to run away and find other cultivators to take you out?"
"'Almost' doesn't count as killing. Besides, other cultivators might not be as powerful as you, Young Master, to have escaped from that evil spirit. With your strength, you must be very strong. There are countless evil spirits and terrifying demons in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. Following you feels safer."
The reply from the Green Snake seemed sincere, and Fang Wang reluctantly believed it.
He drew the Qingjun Sword, pried open the map with the Sword Blade, memorized the details of the map, then channeled the Solaris Spiritual Power within his body, igniting the Solaris True Fire, and let it run down the Sword Blade onto the map.
The map instantly caught fire, causing the Green Snake to cry out in alarm. Though it didn't understand, it didn't dare to intervene.
Fang Wang did so out of caution that the Green Snake might have played tricks by poisoning the map.
Smoke rose up, standing between Fang Wang and the Green Snake.
Fang Wang suddenly frowned. Why was the map so difficult to burn?
The Solaris True Fire was so fierce that after ten breathing cycles, only one-fifth of the map had burned, showing its material was special.
Just then, the rising smoke coalesced into a figure, startling Fang Wang to his feet. He instantly readied the Heavenly Palace Halberd, while the Green Snake, even more frightened, jumped away even further than Fang Wang.

chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 49 Zhou Xue's Tactics [Seeking Monthly Passes]
chapters.content:
Fang Wang maintained a distance of thirty feet from the mysterious figure on the map; the smoky haze wavered, and the figure gradually solidified as if a ghost had appeared. Even under the bright light of day, it was quite eerie.
"You... what are you?"
Before Fang Wang could ask, the Green Snake anxiously inquired. It was more frightened than Fang Wang, on two accounts: one was out of genuine fear, and the other was fear of being misunderstood by Fang Wang.
The figure was blurred, only allowing for a rough outline to be seen.
"Junior, do you wish to lay your hands on the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique?"
A voice aged with time emanated from the mysterious figure, its tone calm.
Fang Wang, holding the Heavenly Palace Halberd, replied, "Wouldn't it be a pity if such a fine technique weren't passed down?"
Currently, his physique was not an advantage. His ability to fight beyond his realm mainly relied on Solaris Spiritual Power and the Great Perfection Spell. The Heavenly Body was a powerful constitution from ancient times. Even Zhou Xue had praised it, and naturally, he coveted it.
"This map indeed records the site of the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique's inheritance, but the trials there are strict. Had you not burned this map to awaken a wisp of my consciousness and recklessly gone there, you would've undoubtedly died."
The mysterious figure spoke slowly, causing Fang Wang to raise an eyebrow.
Fang Wang immediately bowed with clasped hands and said, "Please, senior, give me guidance."
The other party clearly intended to guide him. Even if it were not a living person, such a gesture was proper.
Addressing Fang Wang, the mysterious figure spoke, "First, you must reach the Condensation Spirit Realm, and second, you must grasp the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art—both are indispensable."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang inwardly breathed a sigh of relief.
Not too difficult!
With his talent and status within the Great Abyss Gate, reaching the Condensation Spirit Realm was merely a matter of time. As for the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, he had already achieved the Great Perfection Realm.
"Could senior pass on the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art to my young master?" the Green Snake suddenly asked.
Fang Wang glanced at it, suddenly finding it somewhat more pleasing to the eye.
Although he had already mastered the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, the Green Snake did not know; to make such a request indicated that, even if not sincerely, it at least seemed to want to please him on the surface.
"My duty is only to remind you of these two points. The path of cultivation is, after all, about seeking achievements as difficult as ascending to heaven."
After saying this, the mysterious figure disappeared like smoke dispersing, leaving Fang Wang unable to inquire about its identity.
The map, burned by the Solaris True Fire, turned to ashes and scattered with the wind.
Fang Wang and the Green Snake looked at each other in silence for a long time.
After a while, the Green Snake finally expressed, "If an ordinary person had obtained the map and gone directly to seek the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, they would likely face a slim chance of survival. The young master is extraordinary, burning the map and instead, gaining the approval of the predecessor."
Fang Wang felt that he had inadvertently done the right thing, but naturally, he wouldn't voice his true thoughts.
He then began to check the five stones the Green Snake had brought, covering his palm with Spiritual Power and taking the stones to wash by the river.
The Green Snake drew near, maintaining a safe distance.
After Fang Wang cleaned the stones and placed them in his storage bag, the Green Snake finally spoke, "Young master, I know of a place with many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, but there is a Great Demon guarding it."
"How strong is this Great Demon?"
Fang Wang asked casually, having set a goal for himself to break through in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven and forge his second Lifespirit Treasure.
The Green Snake replied, "Equivalent to a Human Cultivator at the Ninth Level of the Spirit Elixir Realm."
Fang Wang looked at it with a smile, "It seems you're quite remarkable, not just any ordinary snake demon."
The Green Snake responded, "The young master jests. Having lived here for three hundred years, I've naturally received some inheritance. Over the years, cultivators have occasionally strayed in, so I have a general understanding of Human Cultivators."
Fang Wang thought this snake demon was not simple; after all, it managed to cry for such a long time in the hands of the lady in white, suggesting it had something up its sleeve.
Having rested for half a month, it was time to set out!
"Lead the way!"
"Alright, young master!"
The Green Snake immediately set off, its body writhing joyfully.
Fang Wang watched its movements, suddenly feeling a bit absurd.
He was actually embarking on an adventure with a snake?
...
Two days later.
At the entrance of a valley, Fang Wang stood under a tree, while the Green Snake slithered onto a nearby branch. One human, one demon, they looked in the same direction.
The flowers and trees in this area were dense, and the sunlight could hardly penetrate. Even at noon, the forest behind Fang Wang was pitch-black.
"Is that it?"
Fang Wang asked, his right hand resting on the hilt of his sword.
After two days of interaction, Fang Wang had learned the name of the Green Snake, which called itself Xiao Zi. A Green Snake calling itself Xiao Zi made Fang Wang suspect it was colorblind.
Xiao Zi nodded, "Yes, that's it. It tried to eat me before. Be careful, young master, its breath is very poisonous!"
Looking in the direction of its snake eyes, ahead the valley was filled with colorful flowers and plants, the tallest reaching up to two zhang high, and various bright fruits scattered like stars. At first glance, the valley seemed like a galaxy composed of exotic fruits, extremely enchanting.
In the center of the valley was a depression, its surface reflecting various colors, and a four-zhang-tall red toad lay there, its body covered with various mosses and flowers. At a glance, one might think it was a small hill.
Clang—
Fang Wang stepped forward and drew his sword in a fluid motion.
Xiao Zi, still somewhat concerned, couldn't help but say, "Young master, its back is incredibly hard. Its weakness should be the eyes…"
Fang Wang took five steps and immediately unleashed the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, gathering thirty-six swords with overflowing sword energy that whipped up a fierce wind, causing the surrounding branches and leaves to shake violently. This startled the giant red toad into opening its eyes, which were cold like those of a venomous snake.
Xiao Zi watched the thirty-six sword forms appear around Fang Wang and immediately shut its mouth, snake eyes firmly fixed on Fang Wang.
Fang Wang did not stop. With sword in right hand, he thrust forward, and the thirty-six Jinghong swords shot out violently, converging into a massive sword energy that flew forth with unstoppable force, tossing up flowers and plants along its path.
With a boom!
The giant red toad was struck by the sword energy, instantly exploding, its flesh scattering every which way onto the surrounding flowers, trees, and even hanging on the distant mountain walls, tainted with poisonous blood.
Xiao Zi moved like lightning, dodging the flying flesh and quickly scampered up to the branches above.
Fang Wang's movements were seamless, his robes fluttering as he did not even blink. After thrusting the Qingjun Sword forward, he flicked his wrist, spinning the treasured sword, and smoothly sheathed it with a backhand grip.
Drawing the sword, thrusting, and sheathing—all in less than the time it takes to take a breath!
He dispatched the giant red toad in an instant!
Fang Wang seemed calm and composed, but in fact, he had used all his strength. It was the strongest Jinghong thirty-six swords he could muster at the time. It was not just to kill the enemy but also to intimidate Xiao Zi.
"Go take a look around and see if there are any other demons nearby,"
Fang Wang said to Xiao Zi with his back turned. Hearing this, Xiao Zi immediately snapped to attention and agreed before darting into the forest.
Fang Wang took out the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures record, comparing it with the treasures he encountered along the way, looking for their descriptions.
Different Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures have different ways of harvesting; some lose their Spiritual Energy once removed from the soil, some wither swiftly if broken, and others are poisonous to the touch and can invade the body. They were indeed varied and bizarre; Fang Wang had been amazed the first time he looked at the record.
While harvesting, Fang Wang did not neglect his surroundings; he kept his divine sense on alert.
Half an hour later, Xiao Zi returned, and Fang Wang was still picking. The herbs and precious fruits here were too plentiful—it had to be said, the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven truly was a great opportunity. If one could stay alive here for half a year, anyone could strike it rich.
"Young master, there are no demons nearby."
Xiao Zi spoke softly, the tone respectful.
The reason it took so long to return was that it needed to calm its nerves.
Fang Wang was simply too terrifying!
With such strength, any thought of ambushing him was futile, and Xiao Zi also feared that Fang Wang might kill it after using its services.
"Then go to a higher place and keep watch."
Fang Wang uttered casually. He didn't need Xiao Zi's help; after all, the creature had not yet taken human form.
Hearing this, Xiao Zi immediately left and scurried straight to the mountain wall before swiftly climbing to the summit.
It wasn't until deep into the night that Fang Wang finally pillaged the entire valley, gaining a massive haul and even acquiring a demon core.
In the night, they came to a small stream in the forest. By the campfire, Fang Wang began drawing a map.
He had a strong memory, but he feared that he wouldn't be able to remember the map if he were to enter the Heavenly Palace for cultivation before acquiring the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique. Even with a strong memory, one couldn't possibly remember a map seen once hundreds of years ago.
Xiao Zi curled up quietly on the other side of the fire, not daring to disturb Fang Wang.
Ever since Fang Wang had unleashed the Jinghong thirty-six swords, it had grown less talkative.
Crack!
The sound of a broken twig came from the side. Fang Wang immediately glanced over, and Xiao Zi suddenly lifted its head.
A figure emerged from the darkness, and with the moonlight, Fang Wang could see her silhouette. His expression turned odd as he said, "It was the same when searching for Fang Hanyu before—are you sure you haven't cast some sort of spell on us?"
The person was none other than Zhou Xue.
As Zhou Xue approached, she laughed and said, "One day, you'll be thankful for this spell."

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 50: Soul-Binding Curse, The Chosen One
chapters.content:
"Really?"
Fang Wang smiled, not making grandiose statements. Zhou Xue meant that if he ever found himself in a predicament, she would have to come to his rescue.
Zhou Xue walked up to the fire and sat down directly, ignoring Xiao Zi next to her. Xiao Zi, terrified, scurried next to Fang Wang and whispered, "Young Master, she has a powerful Ghost Instrument on her. I've felt this sensation before in a secret realm."
It was unaware of the history between Fang Wang and Zhou Xue, but it did not want Fang Wang to die here.
Zhou Xue looked at it with a smile that was not quite a smile and said, "Perhaps it is the Ghost Instrument you're thinking of."
"You..."
Xiao Zi trembled all over, instinctively moving closer to Fang Wang.
Zhou Xue turned to Fang Wang and said, "What? Thinking of raising a snake demon? Snakes are inherently lustful, and many a cultivator likes to keep them; just don't let it hinder your cultivation."
"Nonsense!"
Fang Wang glared at Zhou Xue, finding her words outrageously unrestrained.
Xiao Zi blinked and said nothing more.
Zhou Xue enjoyed seeing Fang Wang flustered and covered her mouth with a laugh, "I can teach you a technique to control souls, ensuring this snake demon never betrays you. Would you want that?"
The moment Fang Wang heard this, his eyes lit up, and he said, "Good, tell me!"
Xiao Zi, however, panicked but dared not object because it knew it was no match for these two.
Zhou Xue immediately began to impart the spell, and Fang Wang listened intently.
Xiao Zi was caught in a painful dilemma, unsure whether to flee.
The technique Zhou Xue was teaching was called the Soul-Binding Curse; once it was cast on someone's soul, even if they were at the ends of the earth, the mere recitation of the curse would cause their soul to scatter. Moreover, it didn't require voicing out loud—one could simply recite it silently in their heart.
As Fang Wang listened, he was astonished; this was surely beyond the scope of spells, wasn't it?
"Wait! Wait a moment for me!"
Fang Wang suddenly interrupted Zhou Xue, then picked up a pen and paper and began to draw quickly.
Zhou Xue asked curiously, "What map are you drawing?"
Fang Wang replied, "The Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, want to learn it? I'll teach you once I find it!"
Zhou Xue looked at him with an odd expression and said, "You really are set on this technique. I don't need any cultivation techniques or spells. In fact, you don't either. Just by cultivating the Solaris Scripture, you could reach the pinnacle of the Mortal Realm."
"That might be enough, but if I can learn more, won't I be stronger?" Fang Wang replied.
He was not like Zhou Xue, whose mind was filled with all sorts of secret knowledge. At least, the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique was something he wanted to learn, and he suspected that paired with the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, it could unleash even greater power.
After hurriedly completing the map, Fang Wang stored it in his bag and then asked Zhou Xue to continue with the Soul-Binding Curse.
Quite some time passed before Zhou Xue finally finished explaining.
Xiao Zi also listened to the entire cultivation method of the Soul-Binding Curse, not understanding a bit of it, and felt it to be highly mystical. Relieved, it thought.
Such a complex spell; surely Fang Wang would find it difficult to master.
Zhou Xue looked up at Fang Wang and asked, "How is it? Did you understand?"
Under the moonlight, Fang Wang bowed his head slightly. After taking a deep breath, he said, "I understood, and I've mastered it."
"Hmm?"
"What?"
Zhou Xue and Xiao Zi spoke at the same time, the former perplexed, the latter terrified.
Fang Wang was already numb.
Damn it, luckily he had drawn the map beforehand!
He had actually spent a hundred and eighty years mastering this Soul-Binding Curse!
Returning to reality, his spiritual consciousness had greatly increased, and his senses began to sharpen, but he needed a moment of quiet.
The process of cultivating the Soul-Binding Curse was even more tedious than that of the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art or the Jinghong Divine Sword Art; at least those allowed Fang Wang to move around. The Soul-Binding Curse was utterly sedentary.
A hundred and eighty years of sitting still!
Fang Wang needed to calm down. He spread his arms, feeling the air around him, and felt completely relaxed.
"You really learned it?" Zhou Xue asked, her eyes complex, filled with both anticipation and unease.
Fang Wang twisted his neck and with his left hand, he grabbed Xiao Zi's snake head.
"Ah! Master! Don't! Xiao Zi will definitely never betray you!"
Xiao Zi let out a mournful scream, begging desperately.
Fang Wang brought it in front of him, and gazed into its eyes, saying, "Sorry, you do pose a certain threat to me. Behave yourself, and once we leave the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, I will release the Soul-Binding Curse and set you free."
Having said that, his right hand began to gesture the spell, and his eyes burst with a ghostly light.
Xiao Zi cried, but dared not to resist.
Zhou Xue saw him gesture the spell and knew that he had truly learned it, which made her look at him with a subtle expression.
"To learn it upon hearing it... such talent... could he also be a Chosen of Destiny? The Chosen of Destiny from my past life was clearly not him, could it be that because he died too young, the Mandate of Heaven moved to someone else? Adding things up, he was born in the same year as that person..."
Zhou Xue's gaze flickered, her attention fixed on Fang Wang.
Fang Wang had trained the Soul-Binding Curse to Great Perfection, and he quickly imprinted the curse seal upon Xiao Zi's soul.
All creatures that develop intelligence also give rise to a soul, and although Xiao Zi had not taken human form, it had a soul.
Very soon, Xiao Zi stopped moving, as if it had passed out, its mouth agape with its tongue hanging out.
The Soul-Binding Curse is a suppression of one soul by another, consuming not only Spiritual Power but also the energy of the soul. Furthermore, the Soul-Binding Curse could bind at most five souls simultaneously. Any more than that, the caster's soul could suffer backlash, and the power to suppress would also be impacted.
After a while.
Fang Wang placed the unconscious Xiao Zi beside him. Using the Soul-Binding Curse for the first time, even at the state of Great Perfection, made him feel somewhat dizzy.
"You really have learned it, but try not to use it in the future because your cultivation is still too low. I came to you this time wanting to help you break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm," Zhou Xue spoke, her composure returning, making it hard to guess what she was thinking.
Fang Wang nodded, then inquired, "After I break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm, should we deal with Lu Yuanjun within the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven? If we join forces, we should be able to take him down, considering his cultivation is below the fifth layer of the Profound Heart Realm."
The fifth layer of the Profound Heart Realm was the highest limit for entry into the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, which provided a way to gauge Lu Yuanjun's cultivation level.
On the night the Fang Residence was wiped out, the decision might have been made by the Emperor Zhao Zhen, but Zhao Zhen was working for Lu Yuanjun. Everything started with Lu Yuanjun's wish to absorb souls. Zhao Zhen merely took the opportunity to involve the Fang Residence.
Moreover, although Lu Yuanjun appeared kind and passionate, he had secretly killed millions of civilians; killing him brought no pressure to Fang Wang's mind.
Zhou Xue raised her hand and pointed at Xiao Zi from a distance, then finally answered.
"No, Lu Yuanjun is not that easy to deal with. What exactly that Ghost Instrument that absorbs millions of souls is, I have yet to find out. Because in my past life, he never used the Ghost Instrument, at least I have never seen it. Besides, killing Lu Yuanjun would entail too much trouble; Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi would become your sworn enemies."
Zhou Xue's words made Fang Wang frown.
It made sense to him that Guang Qiuxian supported Lu Yuanjun, but why would his own master support him?
Zhou Xue continued, "Lu Yuanjun's biological parents are from the Demonic Dao, dying when he was three years old. It was Yang Yuanzi who brought him back to the Great Abyss Gate. Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were close friends of Lu Yuanjun's mother; Yang Yuanzi even braved Green Cicada Valley alone for her.
This is a piece of history buried by the Great Abyss Gate, revealed only after many years when Yang Yuanzi lost his mind and caused havoc in the Great Abyss Gate."
"Then why did you let me join the Third Lineage?" Fang Wang felt speechless.
Zhou Xue snorted, "Joining any other lineage would be useless since it's the Sect Leader who supports Lu Yuanjun. I let you join the Third Lineage hoping you would encounter Yang Yuanzi sooner. He is very protective and doesn't have a good relationship with Lu Yuanjun. As long as you don't kill Lu Yuanjun, he might even help you seize the position of Lu Yuanjun's chief disciple.
The condition is that he doesn't know you two are mortal enemies."
Fang Wang's brows furrowed even more, as Zhou Xue was plotting against Yang Yuanzi.
"Lu Yuanjun can't die, at least not now, because we need him to push Grand Qi to transform into a Cultivation Dynasty. Lu Yuanjun's unique background and the people behind him can help him bridge the gap between the righteous and demonic paths. Once Grand Qi successfully transforms into a Cultivation Dynasty, a great opportunity will arise that all the Nine Great Sects aspire to.
After obtaining that chance, killing Lu Yuanjun would be justifiable even if Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were to interfere, and we can kill them and escape."
"What's most important is that the Fang Family needs time to grow. If we kill Lu Yuanjun now, we could flee, but the Fang Family cannot. Understand? Just be patient!" Zhou Xue said earnestly. Hearing this, Fang Wang felt he should not act recklessly.
He sighed and said, "Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
Zhou Xue responded, "If you knew all this, how could you face Yang Yuanzi?"
Fang Wang fell silent.
Zhou Xue did not continue, allowing him to ponder on his own.
Fang Wang looked up and asked, "What about Emperor Zhao Zhen?"
Zhou Xue replied calmly, "When he leaves the Great Abyss Gate, I will kill him. Once dead, the Sect will support his offspring as emperor. His role will be over by then. It was necessary not to kill him before, as we needed Zhao Zhen to help facilitate the transformation of Grand Qi into a Cultivation Dynasty. The matter involves various powers of the Cultivation World and the Mortal Realm."
"Alright, now we must prepare for your breakthrough to the Spirit Elixir Realm. I have already prepared the necessary Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures for you. The next step is to find a suitable place for the breakthrough."

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 51: Ancient Formation, Crossing Thunder Tribulation
chapters.content:
"Is everything ready? How can I possibly accept this?" Fang Wang hesitated on purpose.
Zhou Xue blinked and smiled, "If you feel embarrassed, forget it. When we return, you can slowly make your breakthrough. With your status as a direct disciple, Yang Yuanzi will definitely help you wholeheartedly."
"No, no, I'm flattered. After all, we're family!"
"Hmm."
Fang Wang felt warmth in his heart. Since stepping onto the path of immortality, Zhou Xue had always taken care of him, and he hadn't had the chance to reciprocate.
Only through diligent cultivation could he repay her!
Zhou Xue said, "Don't always harbor hatred in your heart. The path of cultivation is long, and Grand Qi is just a small corner of the universe. The Great Abyss Gate isn't the sect we will always belong to. Remember, at any time, put your own cultivation first. Only by becoming strong can you get revenge and everything you desire."
Fang Wang nodded. Zhou Xue had made things clear, and he naturally wouldn't be reckless.
After leaving the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, he would continue to cultivate in seclusion, striving to reach the Condensation Spirit Realm as soon as possible and then obtain the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
With the cultivation level of the Condensation Spirit Realm and the Great Perfection Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, combined with the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, who in the entire Grand Qi Cultivation Realm could be his match?
The two began to talk about the interesting things in the Cultivation World, mainly Zhou Xue talking, since she had been adventuring outside all these years.
...
Boom—
Thunderclouds rolled, endless rain poured.
Fang Wang and Zhou Xue walked through the wild mountains, undulating as far as the eye could see. The oppressive thunderclouds seemed as though the sky was about to collapse, with thunder, as if the roar of deities, adding a touch of terror to the world.
Xiao Zi lay on Fang Wang's shoulder, unable to help speaking out, "Are we really going there? I was almost struck by lightning when I got close last time. I reckon there's an ancient formation from ages past here."
Ever since Xiao Zi had been marked with the Soul-Binding Curse, Fang Wang had allowed it to perch on his shoulder.
Six days had passed since that night.
The Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven was larger than Fang Wang had imagined, inconceivable how powerful the Great Saint must have been to have created such a vast cave dwelling.
Without looking back, Zhou Xue said, "That's right, there is indeed a great formation here. It seems the legacy you acquired is extraordinary, enabling you to know so much. Fang Wang, when we leave, don't let it go; keep it with you from now on."
"You..."
Xiao Zi trembled with rage but dared not curse out loud, as it would seem that it was eager to escape.
Fang Wang didn't tease Xiao Zi and curiously asked, "Could it be you plan to use this great formation to help me break through?"
"Yes, this formation has stood for at least ten thousand years. The spiritual energy that has accumulated day by day has turned into a thunder attribute, which can substitute for the heavenly materials and earthly treasures of the thunder attribute."
Zhou Xue replied, her gaze drawn to a piece of rock nearby.
Following her gaze, Fang Wang saw a man leaning against a rock up ahead. Although his clothes were disheveled, they weren't torn; he was just lying against the rock, motionless.
Zhou Xue didn't slow her steps, continuing forward.
As they drew closer, Fang Wang saw that the man was already dead, his eyes wide open in death, his hollow gaze fixed on the firmament.
Zhou Xue stopped beside him, glanced over, and said, "No injuries, he must have had his soul drawn out while alive, a painful death."
Drawn the soul out?
The first thing that came to Fang Wang's mind was Lu Yuanjun; this was the very kind of thing he liked to do.
Could it be Lu Yuanjun was nearby?
Fang Wang looked carefully and found that the storage bag had been taken, and there were no rings or similar items on the corpse's hands.
"Let's keep going. If some blind fool has taken our spot, then we'll just have to avenge this disciple of the Taiqing Gate."
Zhou Xue moved on, her words causing Xiao Zi to shiver slightly.
Fang Wang promptly followed her steps.
A hundred paces later, Zhou Xue summoned her Lifespirit Treasure, a qin, which looked somewhat different from when she used it during the Nine Veins Combat Method; it seemed as if the exterior of the wooden qin had gained a series of white lines.
She advanced while carrying the qin, and a fierce aura burst forth, startling Fang Wang.
This aura was far stronger than that of Xu Lang, who was at the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm!
Just how powerful was she?
Deep down, Fang Wang always harbored the desire to compete with Zhou Xue, but he was too embarrassed to speak up out of gratitude for the many favors he owed her.
Lightning streaked across the way ahead, lifting gusts of wind that whipped their robes.
Bolts of lightning struck the mountain ground ahead, not touching the surface, but the might radiating from them was truly frightening.
Fortunately, with Zhou Xue's Lifespirit Treasure by their side, they avoided being struck by lightning and didn't even need to dodge.
Scaling the mountain peak, Fang Wang stood atop the summit, peering into the distance. Ten zhang down was a stone gate, and beyond it, a stone stairway stretched for over ten miles, leading to another peak soaring into the thunderclouds.
For some reason, as he gazed at that distant peak, a nameless trepidation crept into Fang Wang's heart.
He had a premonition that his breakthrough would not come easily; he was in for a difficult time.
However, in front of Zhou Xue, he couldn't show any weakness, lest he be looked down upon.
Fang Wang hurried to keep up with Zhou Xue's pace, avoiding the lightning strikes, while Xiao Zi crouched on his shoulder, shivering and not daring to utter a word.
After a while.
A figure leapt down from the distant peak, racing towards them. Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and, to his surprise, recognized it as Lu Yuanjun.
Lu Yuanjun, riding his Flying Sword, was enshrouded in dozens of intertwining bolts of lightning, which he dispelled with his Sword Qi, creating a rather spectacular scene.
Upon seeing Fang Wang and the other, he sped up his approach and quickly arrived in front of them, the thunderbolt behind him fluttering in the air like a cape before scattering in the wind.
"What brings you here? There's no treasure on this mountain, likely already claimed by disciples of other sects," Lu Yuanjun asked with a smile.
Zhou Xue replied, "We are preparing to practice thunder-element Spells."
Hearing this, Lu Yuanjun nodded slightly, then turned to Fang Wang and asked, "Junior Brother Fang, how goes your harvest? Do you need any Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures to break through to the Spirit Elixir Realm? Tell me what you lack, and your Senior Brother will provide."
Fang Wang shook his head with a smile, "Thank you, Senior Brother, but I don't need anything for the moment."
Lu Yuanjun nodded. He seemed to remember something and asked with concern, "Junior Brother Fang, I've heard that your Fang Family met with a great disaster three years ago. Has the matter been resolved? I have some connections in the Mortal Realm and could help you investigate."
A man of two lives, Fang Wang understood that this was a probing question upon hearing it.
He sighed and said, "The Prime Minister of the current dynasty was behind it, and he has been executed by the emperor. It's infuriating; I really wish I could have killed him myself."
At these words, Lu Yuanjun showed a sympathetic expression, "Condolences. Soon, Grand Qi will transform into a Cultivation Dynasty, which is also an opportunity for your Fang Family. Let the past stay in the past, and from now on, pursue The Path of Immortality."
"Yes, thank you for your concern, Senior Brother."
"It's nothing, Senior Brother didn't do much. You should continue on your way; I won't distract you anymore."
After Lu Yuanjun finished speaking, he nodded toward Zhou Xue and then left on his sword.
Only when he disappeared at the edge of heaven and earth did Zhou Xue start to speak with a laugh, "I underestimated you. You're quite good at keeping secrets."
"Once the seed of suspicion is planted, it will become a taboo. It's just uncertain how long he can hold back," Fang Wang said, shrugging his shoulders, his tone calm.
Zhou Xue smiled and said nothing more, continuing to lead the way.
Xiao Zi cocked her head in curiosity, eager to know what they were discussing but too afraid to ask more.
...
Half an hour later.
Atop a cliff, Fang Wang sat cross-legged on the ground, surrounded by all kinds of Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures ranging from flowering plants to peculiar stones, and even some indescribable objects.
Zhou Xue was drawing talismans. With each one completed, she affixed it to a wooden stick and then planted the stick around the periphery of the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures.
Fang Wang looked up to see the thunderclouds directly above, the oppressive Heavenly Might making him very uneasy.
"You're not going to make the young master cross the Thunder Tribulation, are you?" Xiao Zi asked, unable to hold back any longer as she lay on a rock, and Fang Wang cast an approving glance her way.
This snake was quite perceptive!
As Zhou Xue continued with her talismans, she replied, "It barely counts as crossing the Thunder Tribulation. It's not as dangerous as a real tribulation, just a bit painful. However, the lightning can help different medicinal effects merge better."
A bit painful?
This is bad!
Fang Wang realized he was in big trouble; the "a bit painful" from an Immortal Venerable's mouth was surely beyond a mortal's imagination.
"You evil woman, you don't have any malicious intentions, do you? Young master, do you really trust her that much? You can't see what's in someone's heart. I've seen many cultivators come together dependently, but once they can't get out, they start killing each other!" Xiao Zi was frantic, quickly trying to persuade Fang Wang.
Zhou Xue ignored Xiao Zi, focusing on her work.
Fang Wang was pleased with Xiao Zi's attitude, but outwardly he still spoke with righteous indignation, "She and I are of the same clan, having shared life-and-death experiences together. How could there be no trust?"
Still, he felt apprehensive on the inside.
He had to stay guarded!
The Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art was his reliance, and Zhou Xue was unaware that he had mastered it.
"If I really wanted to deal with your young master, would I need to waste so many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures? As for possessing a body, I do not favor men's bodies, and I have no need for possession," Zhou Xue said irritably. After finishing, she glanced at Fang Wang with a meaningful look in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - 52: Breaking Through to the Spirit Elixir Realm, The Second Spiritual Refinement_1
chapters.content:
```
After spending nearly half an hour, Zhou Xue finally ceased her work. At this moment, the formation completely surrounded Fang Wang. Twelve wooden stakes were embedded in the soil, covered with talisman papers that were not randomly attached.
Each stake had talisman papers arranged in accordance with some methodical rule, and the characters and drawings on each paper were different—Fang Wang couldn't understand any of these.
Fang Wang took a deep breath and said, "Let's begin!"
Zhou Xue eyed him and said, "Take off your clothes so as not to interfere with the absorption of Spiritual Energy."
"This..."
Fang Wang frowned and hesitantly asked, "Can you turn around then?"
"Hurry up, don't dawdle," Zhou Xue said expressionlessly. Hearing this, Fang Wang had no choice but to steel himself and strip off his clothing.
Perched on a rock, Xiao Zi watched Fang Wang, constantly flicking her snake tongue.
Being watched by a woman and a female demon, Fang Wang couldn't feel more awkward, and he couldn't refuse them either.
Forget it!
Fang Wang pushed aside all distractions, removed all his clothing, placed them into his storage bag, and then sat in meditation.
"You can start cultivating now. The Solaris Scripture has a breakthrough method," Zhou Xue spoke again, and Fang Wang immediately began to cultivate.
Suddenly, Zhou Xue waved her sleeves, and a strong wind blew towards Fang Wang. In an instant, all the talisman papers on the twelve wooden stakes ignited, forming twelve differently colored flames. Strangely, the talisman papers did not turn to ash, as if the flames merely clung to their surfaces.
As the formation was activated, Fang Wang could clearly feel the Spiritual Energy from beneath the earth rushing towards him. The ground around him rose with wind gusts, shaking the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures piled on the ground.
Winds of Spiritual Energy spiraled upwards, encircling Fang Wang's body.
For some reason, Fang Wang felt a cool sensation beneath him, indescribably refreshing, giving him the urge to stand up.
Boom, boom, boom—
Above, clouds roiled violently, with bolts of lightning slithering out like snakes, their immense rumble making the atmosphere atop the cliff even more oppressive.
Frightened, Xiao Zi hid away at a distance.
Zhou Xue stood before the formation, her robe billowing fiercely, her gaze fixed on the clouds above, undeterred by the ghastly wind and lightning.
As the surrounding winds grew stronger, the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures around Fang Wang began to release attribute-specific Spiritual Energy of various colors, which combined together to form a multicolored wind, dazzlingly beautiful.
Fang Wang immersed his mind in the breakthrough, setting aside all distractions.
Boom!
A bolt of lightning suddenly struck down, shattering the multicolored whirlwind and plunging into Fang Wang's crown. His body trembled, followed by the surrounding Spiritual Energy winds rushing madly into his body.
After a brief moment of intense pain, it was replaced by endless comfort, making Fang Wang long for another strike.
Boom! Boom! Boom...
Lightning struck down repeatedly, each time drawing the nearby Spiritual Energy into his body, cleansing his sinews and bones, and ultimately gathering above his Dantian, concentrating at one point.
Gradually, Fang Wang forgot the pain, his attention turned inward to his Dantian.
The mental method of the Solaris Scripture circulated, compressing and condensing the Spiritual Energy within the Dantian. The process was complex, and any laxity could easily disperse the condensed energy, especially since the energy of differing attributes inherently tended to repel each other.
Zhou Xue watched Fang Wang intently, and slowly, a smile spread across her face.
From time to time, Xiao Zi glanced at her, fearing she might do something rash because its life was in Fang Wang's hands, and it feared that it would die alongside him.
Time hurried along.
After an hour.
One-third of the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures around Fang Wang had wilted or turned to ash, scattering with the wind.
Zhou Xue no longer watched him; instead, she sat in meditation nearby, resting with her eyes closed.
Thunder occasionally fell but did not disturb Fang Wang, who remained sitting in meditation.
