Fang Wang thought carefully and concluded that Cao Ran probably wasn't lying to him. If it were an enemy, they wouldn't have fabricated such an excuse at the brink of death.
Moreover, he never had any dealings with Jin Xiao Sect.
"Can you tell me about the Jin Xiao Sect? Why did Zhou Xue join Jin Xiao Sect?" Fang Wang asked.
Cao Ran shook his head lightly, "Sorry, I can't say. She does not want you to get involved with Jin Xiao Sect. Jin Xiao Sect is not a force of good, and the things they are plotting will sooner or later make them the enemy of the world."
Fang Wang, hearing this, didn't press further but left a message before turning to leave:
"Heal your wounds and then be on your way."
Watching Fang Wang's retreating figure, Cao Ran wanted to say more but hesitated.
Why didn't this youngster act his age? Was he really not even twenty years old?
Cao Ran didn't have the courage to call out to Fang Wang; for the first time, he felt fear towards a junior.
Forget it, recover from the injuries and make a quick escape!
Returning to the lakeside, Fang Wang sat down to gather Qi, with Xiao Zi slithering over, her snake eyes fixated on Cao Ran, fearing he might launch a sneak attack.
Xiao Zi stayed silent, just sitting beside Fang Wang and watching Cao Ran.
Until dusk, when Cao Ran said his goodbyes and left, still bleeding along the way, looking very ragged.
"Master, should we find another place?" Xiao Zi asked softly.
Fang Wang, enjoying the sunset, replied, "No need, the scenery here is quite nice."
Even the fifth layer of the Profound Heart Realm was no match for him; he no longer needed to run away. Now he intended to concentrate on cultivation while waiting for the half-year period to end.
Lately, he had been contemplating whether to wander the world or find a quiet place to cultivate and open up a Cave Heaven that truly belonged to him.
His residence within the Great Abyss Gate ultimately belonged to the sect. And as he grew stronger, who knows if Lu Yuanjun would resort to schemes.
After all, Guang Qiuxian was a being of the Condensation Spirit Realm!
He was strong now but not yet so strong that he could disregard the Great Abyss Gate entirely.
His philosophy was to always keep a trick up his sleeve and never let others know how strong he really was.
Xiao Zi looked at him, then followed his gaze towards the lake surface. The setting sun reflected in the water, shimmering with light, as the silhouettes of both man and snake slowly darkened.
...
Atop a cliff, Zhou Xue stood against the wind; she wore a bamboo hat with a veil covering her face.
Cao Ran stood beside her, his body wrapped in white bandages, looking very ragged, his usually dark face showing signs of pallor.
After recounting his battle with Fang Wang, he couldn't help but start coughing.
"Your clansman is practically a monster. Now look at me. Not only did my old injuries not heal, but I've also got new ones. In the next twenty, no, fifty years, don't ask me to do anything else for you!" Cao Ran said bitterly, with a tone filled with emotion.
Zhou Xue was silent for a moment before suddenly laughing. She said softly, "He always surprises me. This time, I truly underestimated him. Cao Tianwang, I will compensate you and help your injuries heal soon."
At those words, Cao Ran's eyes brightened, and he asked, "Really?"
"Hmm, after the matter of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven is settled, I will accompany the Demon Monarch to the Northern Territory, and then I can pick a Thousand-Year Jade Bone Ice Lotus for you," Zhou Xue answered.
Upon hearing this, Cao Ran immediately smiled, "With the Sect Hierarch taking action, I'm naturally at ease. But on another note, where exactly has the Sect Hierarch gone? It's been three years since the founding of the sect, and when will the positions of the Four Heavenly Kings finally be filled?"

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 60 Demon Monarch, Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong
chapters.content:
"The Sect Hierarch of the Divine Dragon shows up unfathomably, her whereabouts unknown to me as well. I am waiting for her, too."
Zhou Xue replied, her tone calm, her gaze still fixed on the horizon.
Beyond the cliff lay a vast wasteland stretching as far as the eye could see. At the edge of the sky, flashes of bright light sparkled intermittently. Upon closer inspection, it was clear that two cultivators were in battle, the flashes of light coming from the magic artifacts they wielded.
Following her gaze, Cao Ran couldn't help but marvel, "After seeing the strength of that kid Fang Wang, these so-called geniuses seem quite ordinary. Are you truly not deceiving me that he has only been in the Great Abyss Gate for three years?"
Zhou Xue chuckled softly, "If you have doubts, then believe what you choose to believe."
Cao Ran snorted coldly, "Always pretending to be inscrutable—it's not amusing. I'm leaving."
With that, he turned and walked away.
Before he had gone far, Zhou Xue turned to call after him, "Before you leave, don't forget our main purpose."
Cao Ran waved his hand dismissively, then transformed into a mass of black mist and quickly flew towards the horizon.
Zhou Xue turned back and continued watching the battle.
…
For most cultivators, the half-year in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven was an ordeal, each day feeling as long as a year; however, for some powerful cultivators, they felt time was too short, as they had yet to explore the entire Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
Ever since Cao Ran left, no other cultivator had come to disturb Fang Wang. Whenever a demonic beast happened by, it was unnecessary for him to take action as Xiao Zi could handle it.
With each passing day, Xiao Zi's demonic qi grew stronger, and Fang Wang felt it was no weaker than Xu Lang—this was only judging from its demonic qi. Having stayed in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven for many years, it surely must have inherited some exceptional skills.
"It's finally over."
Fang Wang stood up and stretched. Two days ago, he had broken through to the Spirit Elixir Realm Second Layer, so he had not practiced cultivation these past few days. Instead, he spent his time playing by the lake with Xiao Zi, waiting for the Artifact Spirit of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven to send them out.
Xiao Zi snuggled into his chest, clinging to the front of his clothes. Since learning that the Artifact Spirit would send the cultivators away, Xiao Zi had barely left Fang Wang's side, staying curled up in his arms, afraid that Fang Wang might be sent away while it was left behind in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
"Master, how much longer?" Xiao Zi asked nervously, her voice soft and pitiable.
Fang Wang stroked her snake head and laughed softly, "I don't know either. Don't worry, we'll get out."
Xiao Zi had been hit with a Soul-Binding Curse and belonged to him; the Artifact Spirit should be able to discern that.
In this period, Xiao Zi had helped him gather many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, filling his two storage bags. Considering how tirelessly it had worked for him, it was only natural for him to reassure it.
"Once we get out, I'll release the curse and set you free. Now you can think about where you'd like to go," Fang Wang said, twisting his waist to stretch his muscles even as he spoke.
After returning to the Great Abyss Gate, he planned to seclude himself until reaching the Spirit Elixir Realm Ninth Level—at that point, with his exceptional skills, there would be few in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm who could take his life.
"Where to go..."
Xiao Zi muttered in Fang Wang's embrace, her snake eyes revealing a hint of confusion.
Previously, she only thought of escaping. She rarely considered this question, especially after meeting Fang Wang—she was too preoccupied trying to please him to think about anything else.
Indeed.
Where should she go?
After more than three hundred years in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, she had no home outside.
Not only was she without kin, but everything outside was unknown. Where should she head to?
Fang Wang sensed her gloomy mood and realized he hadn't comforted her properly, so he suggested, "If you don't know where to go, you could stay with me for a while. Whenever you wish to leave, just tell me. Once we leave the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, you won't be of any help to me, and I have no reason to keep you trapped. If I wanted to keep your secrets hidden, I would have killed you outright."
He tried to keep his voice as even as possible, to avoid frightening Xiao Zi.
Convinced by his reasoning—as Fang Wang no longer sought inheritances, and could have harmed her long ago if he wished—Xiao Zi coquettishly said, "Then I will follow Master for now, hoping Master will cherish me."
"Who did you learn that from?" Fang Wang asked, speechless, slapping her snake head lightly.
"A hundred years ago, a man and a woman mistakenly entered the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. When they realized they couldn't leave, the female cultivator spoke to the male cultivator just like that. Ever since then, the male cultivator doted on her, and when they encountered evil spirits, he even sacrificed himself to let the female cultivator escape to safety," Xiao Zi said, blinking her eyes.
Fang Wang retorted irritably, "I wouldn't sacrifice myself to save you. If we encountered danger, I'd throw you out as a distraction to buy me time."
"Master must be joking, how could you possibly be in danger? Anyone daring to provoke you is simply courting death!"
Her words were pleasing to Fang Wang, particularly because she seemed earnest, as if speaking from the heart.
In this way, the human and the demon idly chatted to pass the time.
Until noon, a powerful beam of light descended from the sky, startling Fang Wang into looking up. He had no time to dodge and was enveloped by it, his vision blurring.
"Young Master!"
The sound of Xiao Zi's alarmed cry reached Fang Wang's ears, making his heart sink. Had Xiao Zi been left behind?
Unfortunately, he was unable to move, powerless to do anything.
A few moments later, Fang Wang felt his feet touch the ground and regained control of his body. He instinctively reached for his chest.
"Young Master?"
Xiao Zi's voice sounded again, timid as if fearing it was all a dream.
"Yes, we're out," Fang Wang replied, and then took a step forward.
After five steps, his vision cleared, and what entered his sight were the Vice Sect Leaders and Elders of the Nine Great Sects.
Zhao Chuanqian saw him and visibly relaxed, an unexpected smile spreading across his usually stern face.
"What are you standing around for? Let's go," Zhou Xue said as she came up from behind and nudged Fang Wang with her shoulder.
Fang Wang immediately followed her pace, and as for Xiao Zi, it stayed close within his embrace, scared to be seen. He could even feel it trembling.
The disciples of the different sects walked towards their respective sects, quickly forming nine separate factions.
Only seven disciples from Great Abyss Gate had survived and returned, namely Fang Wang, Zhou Xue, Gu Li, Lu Yuanjun, Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, and Yan Feiyue.
There were casualties in all sects, but Great Abyss Gate fared relatively well. Fang Wang noticed that only three disciples from Green Cicada Valley had returned, the atmosphere there exceedingly bleak.
Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi looked towards Xu Lang, who had lost an arm and seemed utterly different from when he had first entered the fray. Despite his disheveled appearance, his eyes were fiercer than before.
"Only two dead, that's not too bad," Chen Anshi said cruelly, yet as the group was not made of the naive, there was no anger.
The other Elders of Great Abyss Gate did offer their consolation.
At this moment.
Xu Qiuming and Xu Tian Jiao of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect approached, causing everyone from Great Abyss Gate to turn their heads.
"Fang Wang, thank you for saving my sister. I owe you a favor. If you ever need my help, as long as it does not harm the interests of Suspended Vast Sword Sect, feel free to write to me," Xu Qiuming said seriously. He appeared youthful but when his face was devoid of smiles, the aura of grave dignity he exuded was quite oppressive.
Fang Wang nodded slightly and exchanged a few courteous words with Xu Qiuming while Xu Tian Jiao also expressed her gratitude.
Xu Qiuming did not linger and left with Xu Tian Jiao.
After they departed, Chen Anshi didn't ask them further. He gestured with a sweep of his sleeve, and the wooden ship that had brought them to the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven appeared in mid-air. The disciples promptly followed Chen Anshi onto the ship.
Upon their initial arrival, the Nine Great Sects had exchanged pleasantries. However, as their departure from the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven neared, the interactions had greatly diminished, as though a great calamity loomed.
The wooden ship flew swiftly through the sky. Standing at the edge, Fang Wang saw the other eight sects dispersing in different directions, all moving rapidly.
"During the return journey, everyone must stay vigilant and not let their guard down," Chen Anshi's voice echored, explaining why the sects had departed so quickly.
Coming in, they vowed not to carry grudges, but that was just a superficial agreement.
How could a sect like Green Cicada Valley, left with only three disciples, swallow such a slight?
"Junior Brother Fang, what did you gain?" Lu Yuanjun came over to Fang Wang with a smile and asked. His smile was warm and sunny, easily endearing and could make one let down their guard.
Fang Wang replied with a smile, "It was alright."
In a low voice, Lu Yuanjun said, "I won't hide it from you, junior brother, I've acquired one of the Three Great True Cultivations from Ji Hao Sect, the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong. If you are interested in learning it, once we return to the Sect, just come to me anytime."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang quickly said, "How could I accept such a thing? Senior brother, you risked your life to obtain it. I can't just reap the benefits."
"Junior Brother Fang, with your remarkable talents, sharing a cultivation method with you is actually helping the Sect to nurture you. When I become the Sect Leader someday, you'll be the Vice Sect Leader, so there's no need for modesty," Lu Yuanjun said with a smile.
Although their voices were quiet, everyone present were cultivators. How could they not hear?
The Elders didn't turn to look at them, but the disciples couldn't help but cast glances in their direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 61 A Big Incident
chapters.content:
After listening to Lu Yuanjun's words and sensing the gazes of the other disciples, Fang Wang's expression remained unchanged as he softly replied, "Brother Lu, all here are the future of Great Abyss Gate. Since you are willing to teach me, why not say it outright so that everyone can learn together?"
Thinking of cornering me?
Then don't blame me if I make you lose face!
If Lu Yuanjun truly wanted to teach him, he could have used the Sound Transmission Technique to inquire. But Lu Yuanjun spoke openly, and accepting it would confirm Fang Wang's allegiance to Lu Yuanjun, signifying service to him and an implicit forgoing of the competition for the Sect Leader position.
Fang Wang felt that Lu Yuanjun was somewhat hasty, previously his actions were flawless, but now his intentions were too obvious.
Upon hearing this, Lu Yuanjun's face turned slightly unnatural, but it was only for a moment. He mused, "Junior brother makes some sense. In that case, when I return, I will write down the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong and then submit it to the sect."
"That's not possible. The Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong is one of the Three Great True Cultivations of Ji Hao Sect. Spreading it will inevitably invite tremendous trouble. This cultivation method cannot be placed in the Daofa Pavilion!"
A voice rang out, and Fang Wang turned to look, seeing Chen Anshi standing at the entrance of the second floor of the pavilion looking down at them.
Chen Anshi's face was expressionless as he said, "Lu Yuanjun, since you are intent on teaching your fellow disciples, why not teach it on this ship? The rest of you remember, it will be hard to repay Lu Yuanjun's kindness, you must keep it to yourselves. To receive the core essence of Ji Hao Sect's cultivation is certainly a tremendous fortune."
Hearing this, Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, and the others all stood up, bowing with clasped hands towards Lu Yuanjun, thanking him for his teachings.
Fang Wang also clasped his fist, but in his heart, he was exclaiming what a character!
This undercover agent from the Demonic Sect turned out to be one of Lu Yuanjun's backers!
With these words, all disciples owe Lu Yuanjun a favor, not wanting to learn was no longer an option.
Lu Yuanjun nodded and said, "Since that's the case, I will now begin instructing the technique to all my fellow disciples."
After speaking, he gave Fang Wang a look, signaling him to come over.
All the disciples gathered together, sitting in meditation around Lu Yuanjun, with Fang Wang seated next to Zhou Xue. Throughout, Zhou Xue did not communicate with him using the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang was secretly curious whether Lu Yuanjun was truly willing to impart the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong. His Heavenly Palace could detect whether a cultivation method was genuine; only then would his consciousness directly enter the Heavenly Palace.
Wait a moment!
If it were true, wouldn't he be trapped in the Heavenly Palace for at least another two hundred years?
The True Combat Technique took four hundred and twenty-six years to achieve Great Perfection, and the cultivation time for the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong of the same level was probably similar, that's another four hundred years.
Fang Wang's heart sank, suddenly feeling as though he was shooting himself in the foot.
The more he thought about it, the more he believed Lu Yuanjun might actually impart the true method. If it were a sham, it would be meant to trap him. How then could he face the other disciples?
Even if it were true, Lu Yuanjun probably wasn't afraid of it spreading; such an ultimate art doesn't make one strong just by acquiring it.
Lu Yuanjun began to expound on the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, the disciples listened intently, and even though the elders were on the lookout in all directions, their thoughts were also on Lu Yuanjun.
"Heaven and Earth, Yin and Yang, channel the spirit into the body, transforming into two polarities, Yin being substance, Yang being void, the Big Dipper turns, from good to evil, from strong to weak..."
As Lu Yuanjun expounded on the mental mantra of the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, Fang Wang initially thought it sounded credible and could very well be true.
Previously, when comprehending the True Combat Technique and the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, the mantras were also profound and inscrutable, and despite memorizing the entire content, it was not possible to understand it all at once.
Time slowly passed.
Lu Yuanjun spoke for the duration of an incense stick, and once he finished, everyone was deeply furrowed in thought.
Fang Wang also furrowed his brows, but he was only pretending.
Since he did not enter the Heavenly Palace, it meant that the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong imparted by Lu Yuanjun was fake, or at least incomplete, as Lu Yuanjun did not possess the Heavenly Palace and could not judge its authenticity.
After surveying the group, Lu Yuanjun said, "This cultivation is profoundly intricate. I have studied it hard for a month and only understand a fraction; I haven't truly started practicing it. In the future, let's ponder it together, we can discuss and learn from each other, improving collectively."
His words were beautifully put, open and generous.
Yan Feiyue immediately smiled and said, "Thank you, Brother Lu, an ultimate art is naturally not easy to master. To acquire the cultivation method is already a tremendous grace."
Ye Xiang and Gu Li nodded in agreement.
"Ultimately, we will rely on Brother Lu to guide us, and we hope you will generously share your teachings in the future," Zhou Xue said with a smiling face.
"That's easy to say, your talents and comprehension might not be less than mine, who knows about the future," Lu Yuanjun replied modestly, the atmosphere was very harmonious. Not far away, Zhao Chuanqian slightly nodded, the corners of his mouth turning up unconsciously.
With the disciples so united, how could Great Abyss Gate not flourish?
After this event, the relationships among the disciples became closer, at least on the surface, as they began to share their experiences.
When Xu Lang mentioned his rescue by Fang Wang, Lu Yuanjun heaped praise on Fang Wang. Fortunately, Xu Lang and the others did not disclose the specific details of that underground space.
The atmosphere was quite subtle. Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, and Yan Feiyue were grateful to Fang Wang for saving them, Zhou Xue was a kinsman of Fang Wang, and Gu Li was a good friend of Fang Wang, so they were all speculating about the relationship between Fang Wang and Lu Yuanjun.
They seemed to understand nothing, but in their hearts, they were clear that Lu Yuanjun was trying to win over Fang Wang, while Fang Wang obviously did not want to bow down to Lu Yuanjun, at least not wanting to become a subordinate of Lu Yuanjun, otherwise Fang Wang would not have suggested that Lu Yuanjun teach them the "Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong."
Chen Anshi spoke nicely, but in reality, Lu Yuanjun did not want to impart it to them, a fact that was crystal clear to Ye Xiang and the others.
Of course, even though their motives differed, they indeed owed a favor to Lu Yuanjun, so they all had to do their due diligence on the surface.
...
After leaving the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, the Law Ship carrying Fang Wang and the others flew very fast, and in less than half a day's time, they had already arrived at the central region of the Grand Qi Dynasty, effectively returning to the righteous territory, where the speed of the Law Ship finally slowed down.
During the journey, they did not encounter attacks from other sects.
Fang Wang speculated it was related to Chen Anshi, after all, that guy came from the Chi Devil Sect of the Demonic Dao and was now openly and covertly supporting Lu Yuanjun, naturally he would not allow other Demonic Sects to launch an attack.
Thus, the group from Great Abyss Gate returned smoothly to their sect, just as dawn was breaking.
After disbanding, Zhao Chuanqian reminded Fang Wang that he needed to register his Demon Pet at the affairs hall. Although Xiao Zi had been hiding in his arms the whole time, others had noticed its presence, just without pointing it out.
Hence, Fang Wang flew towards the sect's main city.
After fussing about for nearly half an hour, he finally returned to his own cave dwelling.
As the stone door of the cave dwelling closed, Xiao Zi shot out from his arms with a swoosh, wandering all around the cave dwelling.
Fang Wang breathed a sigh of relief and a smile appeared on his face. For the other disciples, it had only been half a year since they had been home, but for him, it was six hundred years!
Looking at every grass and flower in the cave dwelling, he felt like he was in a dream.
He marched forward, placing two storage bags on the table, and then sat meditating on the white jade bed.
He pondered the attitudes of Chen Anshi and the other elders towards Lu Yuanjun; no wonder Zhou Xue had told him not to rush. Lu Yuanjun's backing was more complex than he had imagined.
He needed to do something to at least increase his standing in the Great Abyss Gate.
Guang Qiuxian had hidden the true grade of his Lifespirit Treasure under the pretense of his well-being. This also meant that no matter how well he performed in the Nine Veins Combat Method, he could not shake Lu Yuanjun's position.
The hierarchy of treasure grades is the world's most fundamental recognition.
The higher the treasure grade, the higher the limit of one's cultivation!
First, I will cultivate for half a year and then see!
Fang Wang closed his eyes and began cultivating.
...
Half a year later, Fang Wang broke through to the third layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm. On this day, he was organizing Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures in his cave dwelling, intending to donate a batch to the sect to increase his contribution.
"Is Fang Wang there?"
A voice came from outside the cave dwelling. Fang Wang used his divine sense to check outside the gate and saw that Fang Hanyu had come.
He immediately had Xiao Zi open the door.
The mountain gate opened, and the blindfolded Fang Hanyu stepped in, only to be startled by a blue-purple snake floating in front of him, causing him to grip the sword hilt at his waist.
"It's my Demon Pet," said Fang Wang's voice, floating over. Upon hearing this, Fang Hanyu relaxed his grip.
Then, Fang Hanyu walked past Xiao Zi towards Fang Wang, and Xiao Zi closed the mountain gate.
"There's a big problem," Fang Hanyu said as he arrived in front of Fang Wang, his voice heavy.
He glanced at the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures on the table, unmoved.
Fang Wang didn't even lift his eyes as he asked, "How big is it?"
Fang Hanyu took a deep breath and said, "The royal family of Grand Qi has been massacred, all the royals and nobles have been wiped out, even the two sons of the emperor, Zhao Zhen, have been killed. Now Grand Qi is in turmoil. The Sect Leader has already called an emergency meeting of the elders to discuss the matter.
Before this, including our Fang State Duke's Mansion, many cities with a Duke's Mansion suffered slaughters, and now the royal family has encountered this calamity too. Tell me, could it be that the Cultivation World of other dynasties intends to invade our Grand Qi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 62: The Legendary Tier
chapters.content:
"Who took action? Is there any news?"
Fang Wang frowned as he asked, hearing about Zhao Zhen's unfortunate encounter, he didn't feel elated; instinctively, something felt amiss.
Fang Hanyu shook his head, saying, "It's precisely because there's absolutely no clue that it could only be the work of the Cultivation Sects, and currently, the Nine Great Sects are planning to transform Grand Qi into a Cultivation Dynasty, needing stability in the kingdom. Why would they commit such an act? It can only be the work of Cultivation Sects from other kingdoms."
"If we really have to say it's the work of someone from within Grand Qi, then it could only be the Jin Xiao Sect; the Jin Xiao Sect has a mysterious origin, moves unpredictably, and it's hard to discern between its righteousness and evil."
The Jin Xiao Sect?
Fang Wang suddenly felt it was possible. Could it be that Zhou Xue made a move?
That's right, previously Zhou Xue said that once she returned, she would deal with Zhao Zhen.
Fang Wang then asked, "What about Zhao Zhen?"
"He's fine; he's been staying inside Great Abyss Gate, avoiding this calamity. I reckon he's not feeling great right now. Ah, who would have thought when we were young that the Duke's Mansion and the royal family would suffer such a disaster." Fang Hanyu sighed, expressing sympathy for Zhao Zhen.
If it weren't for Fang Wang concealing his strength and turning the tides that night, the Fang State Duke's Mansion would have been no more, and he would have met his death.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang felt even more that something wasn't right.
Should someone truly want to annihilate a dynasty, why not kill the emperor, why not attack cities and seize territories?
What's the point in killing royal relatives and dignitaries?
Fang Hanyu sat down, saying, "Regardless, Great Abyss Gate will definitely intervene, so you don't need to worry too much. I asked Zhou Xue, and more and more disciples from the Fang Residence are heading to the Fang Realm for cultivation, and she's hired two cultivators at the Spiritual Refinement Realm to guard the Fang Residence."
Fang Wang gave him a look and said, "I'm not worried, you're the one who rushed over to find me."
Fang Hanyu, unembarrassed, began to ask about his experiences in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
Fang Wang briefly recounted it, focusing on the enemies and perils he encountered, which made Fang Hanyu yearn for such adventures.
He was adventurous by nature, or he wouldn't have lost an eye and nearly died; however, after experiencing that calamity, he realized the importance of cultivation and had been diligently practicing without rashly seeking danger again.
"Regarding the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, many rumors have been circulating within the sect; now all branches hold high expectations of you. Ye Xiang, Yan Feiyue, Xu Lang – they're all praising your strength, saying your Lifespirit Treasure is definitely not a Mysterious Origin, it must be even higher," Fang Hanyu remarked with admiration.
Fang Wang didn't expect these three to be so appreciative; it wasn't in vain that he saved them.
As his cultivation continued to improve, it was time to also enhance the rank of his Lifespirit Treasure, to at least make sure the branches of the sect could not ignore him, and even possibly surpass Lu Yuanjun in talent.
Fang Wang advised, "Your Absolute Heart Evil Eye, as well as the secret techniques you carry on your back, are not simple. As long as you cultivate them wholeheartedly, you'll eventually make a name for yourself across the world. From what I understand, those geniuses of the sect are nothing special; at least in my eyes, they are not your equals, including Lu Yuanjun."
"How can that be? My talents can't be that exaggerated."
"You don't trust me, or do you also not trust your own eyes?"
Fang Hanyu fell silent, his heartbeat quickening.
Could it be that I've really underestimated myself?
He involuntarily reached for his eyes.
Fang Wang changed the subject, asking, "Have you encountered any difficulties with the secret techniques on your back lately?"
Having reached Great Perfection in his Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, Fang Wang was more than capable of guiding Fang Hanyu.
Without hesitation, Fang Hanyu stated that this was his main reason for coming, and the brothers began to exchange insights on the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art.
Xiao Zi sat quietly by their side, occasionally flicking her tongue.
...
The cave dwelling was shrouded in silence with green vines crawling up the walls and a small waterfall beside which the water fell silently into a pool, stirring up splashes yet making no sound at all, quite eerie.
Next to the small pool, Lu Yuanjun sat at a stone table with his right arm pressing on the tabletop. His face was incredibly dark, while Emperor Zhao Zhen of Grand Qi sat opposite him, his expression calm.
Lu Yuanjun said in a deep voice, "Is it necessary to go to such lengths? Those are your flesh and blood relatives, and even your two sons!"
Without changing expression, Zhao Zhen retorted, "If I don't do this, should I wait for death? When Fang Wang learns the truth and wants to kill me, will you oppose him for my sake?"
"It hasn't come to that. He survived, didn't he? Most of those who died in the Fang Residence were house servants. Our hatred hasn't reached the point of life and death. Moreover, my actions were not aimed at him. I will compensate him, mend our relationship, and dissolve the hatred.
Why the rush?" Lu Yuanjun asked with an icy voice, his eyes no longer filled with their usual warmth, but brimming with murderous intent.
Zhao Zhen replied with self-derision, "He survived on his own merit. If you were him, could you tolerate it? Besides, you cannot understand his sense of family loyalty. After all, you've been an orphan since childhood."
"Are you provoking me?" Lu Yuanjun narrowed his eyes.
Zhao Zhen took a deep breath and said, "Lu Yuanjun, let me repeat, I'm not trying to frame you. When you ordered soul snatching, there was already evidence, although it couldn't be traced back to you. But having my own family members' souls snatched made things easier. I share the same plight as the Fang Residence, facing the same enemy. Fang Wang won't suspect me, and besides, I didn't trouble you.
I dealt with it myself. Aren't you the one who benefits the most?"
"Ridiculous. The matter has escalated so much that not only will the Great Abyss Gate investigate, but the other eight sects will too. Do you really think the truth won't come out?" Lu Yuanjun, unable to contain his anger, said and even involuntarily slapped the table, causing cracks to form on its surface.
Zhao Zhen's gaze was distant as he spoke, "Cultivation is supposed to sever mundane ties. It solves potential calamities and purifies the six senses. What's wrong with that?
From now on, the karma of the mortal realm has nothing to do with me, and to prevent the Grand Qi Kingdom from instability which could affect the unlocking of the Nine Great Sects' fate, the Great Abyss Gate will value me even more. They fear something might happen to me. Even if Fang Wang uncovers the truth, he wouldn't dare to touch me."
Lu Yuanjun stared coldly at him, unable to contain his intent to kill.
No matter how eloquently Zhao Zhen spoke, Lu Yuanjun knew the other party was deliberately slinging mud at him. The demonic cultivator who slaughtered entire cities was his man, and now the demonic cultivator accused of massacring the royal family was also suspected to be his man. If he was exposed one day, wouldn't his crimes be greater?
Clearly, Zhao Zhen was dissatisfied with his attempts to please Fang Wang.
Lu Yuanjun genuinely wanted to kill Zhao Zhen at this moment. In his view, his karmic hatred with Fang Wang hadn't reached an irreconcilable level. In the Cultivation World, the pursuit of immortality was paramount. As long as he could assist Fang Wang in his cultivation, even if Fang Wang learned the truth, he would give up on revenge.
What could be more important than pursuing immortality through cultivation?
This was what he thought, and coincidentally, Zhao Zhen thought the same way. For the sake of immortality, Zhao Zhen sacrificed his own flesh and blood, their positions merely different.
Lu Yuanjun looked at Zhao Zhen and saw him calmly pouring a cup of tea for himself and suddenly felt that if he were to grow in power, he would definitely stir up the world.
"Enough about my concerns. You need not worry. You just need to make those disciples who did your bidding disappear. Let's talk about Fang Wang. You have invited him multiple times. Has he ever visited you?" Zhao Zhen looked at Lu Yuanjun and asked, mentioning Fang Wang without a hint of emotion in his tone.
Lu Yuanjun frowned.
With a smile that was not quite a smile, Zhao Zhen said, "Perhaps he already knows the truth. How could his growth rate simply be from the Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit? I heard that the year Fang Wang entered the Great Abyss Gate, all the disciples' Lifespirit Treasures showed abnormalities on the same day.
Afterward, the peak masters and elders approached the Sect Leader about it, and he dismissed it under the guise of crafting a magic artifact. What kind of artifact do you think could cause such a disturbance?"
Upon hearing these words, Lu Yuanjun's brow furrowed even tighter as he asked coldly, "What do you mean?"
"What if there's a possibility that Fang Wang's treasure spirit ranking has surpassed the Earth Origin and reached the legendary Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure ranking? Each ranking has different manifestations during their formation, but no one knows what kind of phenomena a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure would cause.
Thinking about it now, the Heavens are so high, overlooking all living beings, causing their treasures to tremble, it's quite reasonable, don't you think?" Zhao Zhen spoke in a voice so calm it was almost devoid of emotion, except his hand holding the teacup was shaking.
"Don't be too quick to deny it. Think about it, could the Earth Origin Spirit Treasure defeat someone at the Spirit Elixir Realm Ninth Level after just three years of cultivation? Maybe the Sect Leader feared the news would leak, attracting an attack from the other eight sects, and deliberately concealed his true ranking."
With his face growing ever darker, Lu Yuanjun's right hand clenched into a fist on the table.
Zhao Zhen continued, "With his talent, within twenty years, no, perhaps within just ten years, he could surpass you. And if he becomes the strongest in the Great Abyss Gate after another ten years and learns the truth by then, do you think he will definitely forgive you? If he wants to kill you, who could stop him?"
Lu Yuanjun's eyes flickered as he recalled his interactions with Fang Wang.
Although Fang Wang greeted him with a smile, there was indeed a sense of distancing.
For instance, half a year ago, he wanted to win Fang Wang over with the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong and told the other disciples that Fang Wang was the one he valued, but Fang Wang declined in another way. He had thought it was because Fang Wang feared the other disciples would gossip, but now it seemed Fang Wang may have intended to make him lose face.
In fact, ever since he knew that the Fang Family had been slaughtered by his own people, Lu Yuanjun had harbored the thought of killing Fang Wang. However, by then Fang Wang had already become a disciple of Yang Yuanzi, so he dared not act. He could only think positively, trying his best to win Fang Wang over and compensate him.
The thought that Fang Wang could potentially surpass him left Lu Yuanjun's heart unable to calm down.

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 63 Turmoil in the Cultivation World
chapters.content:
Fang Wang followed Fang Hanyu out of the cave residence, and the two went their separate ways, with Fang Hanyu returning to the cave residence to cultivate, while Fang Wang flew towards the Sect's Main City.
He took out one-tenth of the treasures he had obtained in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven and donated them to the Sect, in exchange for contribution points.
He arrived at the Task Hall and found Elder Zhang. When he presented a batch of Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, Elder Zhang was astonished, finding it to be an excessive amount.
Elder Zhang was too busy to handle it alone, so he called over several disciples to help calculate the treasures.
In the end, Fang Wang received seven hundred and ninety thousand contribution points, catapulting him into the top twenty of the third vein's contribution list. Elder Zhang praised Fang Wang for his grand vision and promised to report the matter to the main meridian. The Task Hall disciples looked at Fang Wang with admiration in their eyes.
After exchanging pleasantries for quite a while, Fang Wang finally left the Task Hall.
Back at the third vein, Fang Wang did not directly return to his cave dwelling, but instead, he went to the mountain peak to visit his master, Yang Yuanzi, who happened to be present.
Upon entering Qingxin Hall, Fang Wang bowed and said, "Master, your disciple donated a batch of Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures to the Task Hall. Recently, I have had new insights into the Jinghong Divine Sword Art and would like to show them to you, to see if I am on the right path."
He took out a yellow-bound book from his storage bag, which contained his recent understanding of the last nine moves of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
He had prepared this book long ago; previously, he was afraid to stimulate Yang Yuanzi. Now, hearing about the disaster that had befallen the royal family of Grand Qi, he felt it necessary to act and at least strengthen his relationship with Yang Yuanzi.
Yang Yuanzi frowned, not reaching out to take the book.
Fang Wang then said, "Master, this secret technique was originally passed down to me by you. It is only right that I return it to you. I also want to contribute to the third vein and not just reap the benefits."
Guang Qiuxian was right; his master really was stingy, or rather, Yang Yuanzi was too proud.
Yang Yuanzi hesitated for a long time but eventually accepted the yellow-bound book from Fang Wang.
"Recently Grand Qi is unstable, with invasions from other dynasties and Sects, and the Jin Xiao Sect causing trouble from within. You should just stay in the Sect and cultivate quietly, don't go out. As for whether or not you contribute, don't feel too burdened. You have already achieved the best result for the third vein in decades.
The overall resources of the third vein have greatly increased, and all the disciples of the vein should be grateful to you," Yang Yuanzi said earnestly.
Fang Wang nodded and said, "Your disciple will follow the Master's instruction. I'm preparing to enter closed-door cultivation, striving to reach the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm and then break through to the Profound Heart Realm."
Upon hearing this, Yang Yuanzi was deeply moved and said, "Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure indeed exceeds expectations. You have only been with the Sect for four years, yet you have begun to aspire to the Profound Heart Realm. When you truly break through to the Profound Heart Realm, I will appoint you as the great disciple of the third vein.
If you wish to compete for the position of great disciple of Great Abyss Gate in the future, I will support you."
"Hmph, it's about time our third vein rose to prominence. Your talents exceed those of Lu Yuanjun; you should compete for it!"
When speaking of Lu Yuanjun, Yang Yuanzi's tone was full of mockery.
Fang Wang felt a complex emotion inside. Who would have thought that Yang Yuanzi, who mocked Lu Yuanjun, would be willing to die for him?
He suddenly became very curious about the story between Yang Yuanzi, Guang Qiuxian, and Lu Yuanjun's mother. He wondered whether it was a poignant tale or one filled with melodramatic clichés.
After conversing for quite some time, Fang Wang then took his leave.
Descending from the mountain peak, he encountered Tai Yuan Sect Disciples from the third vein greeting him warmly along the way. His reputation within Great Abyss Gate was considerable. Apart from his achievements in the Nine Veins Combat Method, the public praise from Ye Xiang, Xu Lang, and Yan Feiyue kept his fame from fading over time but rather deepened his imprint in people's hearts.
After returning to his cave residence, Fang Wang began to meditate and practice.
Xiao Zi was also cultivating; Fang Wang gave it a portion of the black dragon's flesh and blood treasure, which thrilled it immensely.
According to Xiao Zi, the hierarchy of Monster realms, from low to high, can be divided into Spirit Demon, Spirit Demon, Great Demon, Demon King, and Great Demon King, corresponding respectively to the Qi Cultivation, Spiritual Refinement, Spirit Elixir, Profound Heart, and Condensation realms.
Currently, Xiao Zi had reached the pinnacle of the Great Demon stage, thanks to the flesh and blood of the black dragon. Now it aimed to advance to the Demon King realm.
Fang Wang was quite looking forward to the idea of it becoming a Demon King. There were no Demon Kings in Great Abyss Gate. Most of the Demon Pets were at the Spirit Demon level, with only the Great Demons being in the hands of the elders and peak masters.
The cave dwelling was quiet, and outside, the sun and moon cycled through the sky.
Years passed by.
In the first year, the Fang Family Disciple all visited Fang Wang, and learning that he was in closed-door cultivation, they did not disturb him in the following years.
In the blink of an eye.
Six years had passed.
The farther one progressed in the Spirit Elixir Realm, the more difficult cultivation became. Even with the power of the Great Perfection's Solaris Scripture, Fang Wang had only reached the eighth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm.
As for Xiao Zi, it had successfully stepped into the realm of the Demon King. However, it still couldn't transform into a human shape, which was quite mysterious, and even it didn't understand the reason.
Fang Wang wasn't in a rush, remaining in his original form was quite fine. If he transformed, Zhou Xue would definitely tease him, so staying as a pet for now was quite good.
It was autumn, and the third vein was tinged with autumn colors, with leaves fluttering down.
A figure landed in front of the mountain gate, it was Fang Hanyu, standing tall with his long hair coiled beneath a purple crown, his eyes wrapped with a black cloth, with two locks of hair falling along the corners of his eyes. A gentle breeze sent them fluttering, showcasing an elegant and carefree demeanor.
"Fang Wang."
Fang Hanyu called out, his bearing more refined than six years ago, more handsome and spirited, yet with an undeniable sharpness.
The mountain gate opened with a bang, and Fang Hanyu stepped in.
"Your aura's not bad, have you reached the ninth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm?"
Xiao Zi teased, but Fang Hanyu simply nodded slightly and went straight over to Fang Wang.
Fang Wang opened his eyes and sized him up.
Six years ago, Fang Hanyu had already been at the third level of the Soul Sculpting Realm. Jumping to the ninth level in six years wasn't slow at all. Although he couldn't compare with Fang Wang, he could definitely be considered a top-notch genius.
And now, Fang Hanyu was already wearing the robe of a direct disciple.
One had to admit, the Absolute Heart Evil Eye was indeed powerful. The Green Cicada Valley had researched it for many years without success, which showed how difficult it was to master. It was only thanks to Zhou Xue, who had been reborn, that Fang Hanyu had such a great opportunity.
"Soul Sculpting Realm ninth level, you haven't disappointed me. With you here, I'll be able to cultivate with much less concern. Do you need me to provide you with heavenly materials and earthly treasures to condense your spirit pills?" Fang Wang asked with a satisfied smile.
Fang Hanyu sat down at the table, shook his head, and poured himself some tea, saying, "No need, Zhou Xue has already prepared everything for me."
It was her again.
Fang Wang felt in his heart, damn, a reborn person was indeed different, constantly increasing in cultivation, able to go undercover, and helping those close to her gather heavenly materials and earthly treasures. He couldn't imagine how busy Zhou Xue's life was.
"Zi Geng and the others have made their own progress too, and now the one with the lowest status is already an inner sect disciple. Our Fang Family has a bit of a reputation in the Great Abyss Gate, especially with you and Zhou Xue leading the way, outshining those millennium-old families," Fang Hanyu said in a soft laugh.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang too felt very happy. It would naturally be excellent if he could have his family by his side on the path to seeking longevity.
Afterwards, Fang Hanyu continued talking about the events in the Great Abyss Gate over the years.
The tragedy of the Grand Qi royal family eventually came to nothing, with the new Prime Minister now in control of the government, corresponding with Zhao Zhen on important matters of state. Zhao Zhen remained in the Great Abyss Gate for cultivation. His talent was commendable, and he proved himself within the sect.
His Lifespirit Treasure was a middle-grade Mysterious Origin Precious Spirit, and he was worth being nurtured by the sect.
Having spoken of Zhao Zhen, Fang Hanyu then mentioned the Cultivation World.
"Over these years, the Jin Xiao Sect has made waves, with their four Guardian Kings successfully attacking Green Cicada Valley and Huangyu Mountain, causing heavy losses for the two demonic sects. They even declared that they intended to make the Jin Xiao Sect the only sect in Grand Qi."
"All four Guardian Kings are comparable to vice sect leaders, and the strongest of them single-handedly stormed Huangyu Mountain, unstoppable by anyone."
Fang Hanyu showed a look of admiration when talking about the Jin Xiao Sect.
Because the Jin Xiao Sect attacked the Demonic Sects, the cultivators of the righteous Great Abyss Gate did not despise them. In the Cultivation World, which was a much larger place, most cultivators still greatly valued their reputation. They were quite curious about how far the Jin Xiao Sect could go.
Fang Wang, knowing that Zhou Xue had joined the Jin Xiao Sect, also held great expectations for it.
What kind of sect could be worthy of Zhou Xue, the reborn Immortal Venerable?
"By the way, three years ago, Lu Yuanjun was attacked by the Jin Xiao Sect's hierarch, the Demon Monarch. He was said to be gravely injured and has been recovering in his cave haven ever since. The sect leader was furious, and one Peak Master even came down the mountain to investigate the Jin Xiao Sect," Fang Hanyu mentioned the incident as if it didn't surprise him.
He said reflectively, "Lu Yuanjun is really unlucky, to encounter the Demon Monarch while out on a journey. Fortunately, the Demon Monarch didn't want to kill him."
If all four Guardian Kings of the Jin Xiao Sect were that strong, the Demon Monarch's cultivation was naturally unfathomable. Therefore, although Lu Yuanjun was injured, more people believed that the Demon Monarch had intentionally shown mercy.
After hearing this, Fang Wang thought the same. He even believed that there might be backers from the Jin Xiao Sect within Lu Yuanjun's faction, or else why would Zhou Xue have joined the Jin Xiao Sect?
The two brothers talked for a long time.
Before leaving, Fang Hanyu informed Fang Wang that once he broke through to the Spirit Elixir Realm, he would come down the mountain to earn sect contributions.
He did this firstly because sect contributions could be exchanged for a great amount of cultivation resources—he wanted to help the Fang Family become a cultivation family, and secondly, he was also very interested in the position of the top disciple of the second vein.
After seeing him off, Fang Wang returned to the white jade bed and continued meditating.
Xiao Zi approached and said, "Young Master, you could defeat a fifth-level Cultivator of the Profound Heart Realm six years ago. Sweeping through the Profound Heart Realm shouldn't be difficult for you now, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 64: Shocking the World with Heavenly Origin
chapters.content:
"It's hard to say, after all, I haven't crossed hands with someone at the Ninth Level of the Profound Heart Realm. Do you really know the strength of someone at that level? In my view, the distinction between strength and weakness depends not on one's realm but on who the opponent is."
Fang Wang answered, feeling the weight of his own strength in his heart.
Although he was just twenty-six years old, he had spent over fifteen hundred years cultivating those exceptional skills, and his strength could no longer be defined by his realm alone.
However, his current goal was to break through the Profound Heart Realm.
Having already reached the eighth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, he naturally wanted to push through to the Profound Heart Realm in one go. At that point, he would have the confidence to face all powerful enemies and dangers.
Afterward, he would take the time to do tasks, ensuring his contribution exceeded that of Lu Yuanjun, and then he would seize the position of chief disciple and become a candidate for Sect Leader.
Such actions would mean not only revenge but also bringing more benefits to his family.
The so-called cultivation is about more than just aptitude; it's more importantly about fortune, and what is fortune?
Resources are fortune!
Xiao Zi flattered, "Master is right, with your talent, another hundred years of cultivation, pushing aside all in this world, what difficulty could there be? Indeed, you must not be careless now."
After leaving the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, it learned of Fang Wang's age and time spent cultivating, greatly surprising it.
When it had been cultivating for ten years, let alone defeating a Demon King, it didn't even count as a Spirit Demon...
That's precisely why it now held great expectations for Fang Wang.
In the secret realms of the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, it had witnessed many ancient wonders, fully aware that becoming an Immortal was exceptionally difficult, with an Immortal emerging perhaps once in a thousand years—those who achieved it were invariably individuals with peerless talent and overwhelming fortune.
Fang Wang's talent had shocked it, and his fortune hardly needed elaboration—his gains within the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven alone were tremendous.
The Golden Scale White Feather Robe, the Demon King's Demon Pill, and that mysterious wall—it seriously suspected that Fang Wang had already learned the mystic legacy from that wall.
It had to cling tightly to such a powerful ally; should Fang Wang become an Immortal in the future, wouldn't it be able to ascend to heaven alongside him?
Fang Wang took out the black Jiaolong's Demon Pill from his storage bag and handed it to Xiao Zi, saying, "This Demon Pill won't be of use for a while. When I decide to use it in the future, killing a Demon King won't be difficult. I'm giving it to you. While I cultivate, you must also strive to become stronger. In a few years, we will roam the world together, endeavoring to become living legends."
"Thank you, Master. I will go through fire and water for you in the future!"
Xiao Zi was incredibly excited, wrapping its tail around the Demon Pill and licking it twice with an enchanted expression.
"Aim to transform into a dragon—afterward, I'll be the Divine Dragon Immortal Monarch."
"The Divine Dragon Immortal Monarch? That sounds so domineering. I'll cultivate diligently. In the future, I will let Master ride me."
"It's 'ride the dragon', not 'ride on the dragon'!"
"What's the difference?"
The two of them, one person and one snake, chatted and dreamed about the future.
Zhou Xue had advised Fang Wang to set aside his hatred for the time being and concentrate on cultivation. Listening to her words, Fang Wang now felt she was right. His greatest advantage was his speed of cultivation; as long as he kept growing stronger, let alone taking revenge, it wouldn't even be difficult to have the final say in the Great Abyss Gate one day.
As long as he was powerful enough, whether it was Lu Yuanjun or Zhao Zhen, righteousness or evil, he would be the one to decide!
...
Time flies like an arrow. Fang Wang, who had stayed indoors, kept on with his seclusion. Since the day Fang Hanyu left, he hadn't come to visit again, and other disciples from the Fang Residence didn't dare to disturb him, either.
Nearly two years passed.
Fang Wang's cultivation finally reached the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, where the difficulty of cultivating the last layer far exceeded that of the previous ones, but fortunately, his Solaris Scripture was a supreme practice.
The Profound Heart Realm differed from the Spirit Elixir Realm; it didn't rely on external objects but on comprehending the nature of heaven and earth to condense the heart into a Profound Heart, which is the heart that comprehends the profound mysteries of the Dao.
The Profound Heart Realm is considered a first-class realm in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, while the higher Condensation Spirit Realm is as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns, very hard to encounter.
Breaking through to the Profound Heart Realm emphasized perception and serendipity.
One day, Fang Wang rarely left his cave abode, going to the brink of a cliff to admire the majestic scenery of the Great Abyss Gate. Xiao Zi slithered over his shoulder and into his chest, peeking out its snake head.
Eight years of cultivation had completely transformed Xiao Zi into a purple snake, its scales reflecting a strange cold light under the sunlight.
It was now summer, with the fierce sun hanging high. None of the ten peaks of the Great Abyss Gate were shrouded in thick fog, all revealing their grandeur, soaring into the clouds, magnificent and majestic. One look over the scenery was refreshing and invigorating.
The ten peaks surrounded the Sect's Main City like a pair of hands cradling it. As Fang Wang looked into the distance, he could see disciples from various peaks flying with swords and rows of white cranes passing by.
"Living like this, cultivating all the time, it's quite nice too," Fang Wang suddenly reflected, isolated from the mundane world, temporarily forgetting hatred, and focusing on cultivation—wasn't this the life of cultivation he had fantasized about?
Xiao Zi twisted its head and looked up at Fang Wang, asking, "Master, don't you want to become the Divine Dragon Immortal Monarch anymore?"
For it, staying in one place for too long lost its appeal, perhaps because the three hundred years it spent in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven shaped this mindset, giving it the desire to flee from environments where it lingered too long.
"Of course not, it's just a passing remark," Fang Wang replied with a light chuckle.
In his previous life, he hadn't traveled the world and lived rather ordinarily. This life, having decided from a young age to traverse mountains and rivers, he had quietly practiced martial arts. He did so to avoid revealing his talents, to prevent the Fang Family from placing too many expectations on him, binding him. Now that he was cultivating, his desire to travel the world remained unchanged.
Once he had helped the Fang Residence firmly embark on the path of cultivation and eliminated their enemies, he intended to see the world beyond Grand Qi.
Just then,
Fang Wang heard the rumbling sound of the sect gate opening behind him. Glancing over, he saw Gu Li walking out from her cave dwelling. She approached Fang Wang and asked, "Have you concluded your seclusion?"
"Just came out for some fresh air. It's been many years, Miss Gu, how goes your practice?" Fang Wang asked with a smile.
Gu Li had clearly cultivated some advanced technique for concealing her aura, and Fang Wang was unable to see through her cultivation level.
Truly worthy of the northern Luo Gu Family.
Gu Li looked at him with a subtle gaze and in a soft voice said, "Not bad, but definitely not comparable to you... Fang Wang, is your Lifespirit Treasure really of the Heaven Yuan grade?"
Heaven Yuan grade?
Fang Wang was caught off guard by her words and feigned astonishment, "How is that possible? Why would you ask that?"
Could something have happened in the past two years?
Fang Wang instantly thought of Guang Qiuxian. Could it be Guang Qiuxian trusted Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi too much and revealed his treasure's grade?
"Now, the entire Grand Qi Cultivation Realm is abuzz with this news, saying that Great Abyss Gate has discovered an extraordinary genius with a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, named Fang Wang," Gu Li replied, her eyes burning when she looked at him.
She wanted to hear Fang Wang himself admit it.
Fang Wang showed a wry smile, helplessly asking, "Who's been saying that? How come I don't know that my treasure is a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?"
Gu Li continued to gaze intently at him, saying, "I don't know who spread the rumor, but this news has been circulating for a year. Last month, the Tian Shu Sect's elder Supreme Fu Xuanji declared after divining the heavens that Great Abyss Gate has indeed given birth to a talent surpassing those with Earth Origin Spirit Treasures..."
Tian Shu Sect, one of the Nine Great Sects, is considered righteous and has a relationship with Great Abyss Gate that is neither too good nor too bad.
Hearing this, Fang Wang appeared composed but internally was bewildered.
Had the grade of his treasure been spread throughout the world?
Although he had previously thought about elevating his treasure's grade, he had never intended to expose it as being of the Heaven Yuan grade.
Zhou Xue had mentioned before that in his previous life, Great Abyss Gate almost faced destruction due to being invaded by the Demonic Dao because it produced several talents with Earth Origin Spirit Treasures. It was only after surviving this calamity that Great Abyss Gate transformed and eventually became the strongest sect in Grand Qi.
Now that his Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure was exposed, could it hasten this calamity?
"You have no idea what a stir your Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure has caused. Even my father wrote to me, insisting that I must foster good relations with you..." Gu Li said with emotion. For some reason, her ears turned red by the end of her sentence.
"Wow, young master, your treasure is of the Heaven Yuan grade!"
Xiao Zi poked her head out from Fang Wang's embrace and asked excitedly.
Fang Wang pressed the snake's head back into his arms and followed up with, "What did master say? And what's the Sect Leader's attitude, he surely doesn't believe it, right?"
Gu Li replied, "Master instructed us not to disturb you and forbade disciples from the other lineages from visiting, fearing it would affect your cultivation. As for the Sect Leader, I'm not sure about his stance, but all of the nine peak's masters were summoned by him. What exactly was said, the Direct Disciples don't know. If you hadn't come out on your own, I wouldn't have bothered you."
Her gaze towards Fang Wang was filled with wonder.
A living Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure!
Her first reaction upon learning of this was disbelief, then an epiphany, followed by restored confidence.
No wonder she couldn't compare to Fang Wang, the disparity in their treasure's grade was vast.
Without comparing herself to Fang Wang, she remained a talent rarely seen in a century.
Fang Wang remained silent.
HIs mind flooded with various consequences but recalling his own cultivation level and considering Zhou Xue's existence, he was filled with confidence.
As long as he broke through to the Ninth Level of Profound Heart Realm, even if someone from the Condensation Spirit Realm took action against him, he might not lack the power to counter-kill!
"Things have come to this... I can only be frank. Indeed, my treasure is a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure. I had intended to interact with you all as having a Mysterious Origin grade treasure, but I never expected..."
Fang Wang took a deep breath, his face etched with a worried expression, seemingly like one who stands alone in lofty isolation.
Although Gu Li found his words peculiar, she didn't dwell on it. She spoke with renewed vigor, "Your fame now surpasses Lu Yuanjun. Everyone in the sect agrees that you are Great Abyss Gate's number one genius, and some even suggest you should be groomed as the next Sect Leader!"

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 67: Listing Remarks_1
chapters.content:
The novel will be precisely updated at noon tomorrow!
Thanks to the chief editor Northern River and the responsible editor Jia Nan; thanks to my loyal readers who have accompanied me from my previous book, and also to the new readers who started following my work with this book—myriad words converge into a surge of updates tomorrow~~
Since the book was released on October 10th, and it will go live tomorrow, November 10th, it has been exactly one month. I have seen all your criticisms and support. Without deviating from the main storyline I envision, I will correct what I can to try to satisfy everyone. However, it's hard to please everyone, and there will always be some who dislike it; I hope you all understand.
I saw a comment before saying why do I always write these cliche plots filled with fighting and killing, and why can't I write about low-key cultivation and the years spent in cultivation. I almost couldn't hold it together.
The person probably doesn't know that I've already written two books like that. When I was writing them, everyone felt it was too monotonous and hoped I could try a different approach. After changing my style, some asked why I didn't stick to my previous approach, which left me both amused and frustrated.
This book will still maintain my original core, meaning the protagonist will not act rashly without absolute certainty, nor will they actively provoke unrelated enemies or force open subplots. However, compared to my previous books, I want to write with more human touch, and the necessary boldness will also be present.
Beyond the protagonist's growth, this book will also focus on the growth of the family. Fang Family Disciples will have different development arcs. Right now, it's still too early for much description because I feel that ten years isn't significant enough to drive the ambition of a family seeking cultivation.
The family can't have the same growth rate as the protagonist; even if the supporting characters get their chapters, they can't artificially keep up with the protagonist's pace. That would be unreasonable.
Furthermore, as the title indicates, becoming immortal is something achieved after ascending, but the protagonist will become immortal in the mortal world. The mortal realm will be significant and won't involve rapidly changing realms. Consider this a reassurance pill for everyone!
Let's talk about the additional update rules for after the novel goes live.
For every 500 additional monthly tickets, I will release an extra chapter. There's no cap~~
For each appearance of a leader among supporters, I will add an extra chapter~~
It's not that the threshold for additional chapters is too high; it's that I've reduced it. I can't add that much, nor would it be meaningful~~
The additional chapters start the day after the novel goes live, and do not count the surge of updates tomorrow!
Let's play a game for fun!
Choose one of the numbers below and guess how many extra chapters I will release tomorrow.
1, If there are 3 or fewer chapters, it would be feeble and unsatisfying—just like you.
2, If there are 3 to 5 chapters, it's a modest effort that'll raise some eyebrows among my brothers and sisters.
3, If there are 5 to 7 chapters, it's enough to draw attention, showing that there's something different about this guy.
4, If there are 7 to 10 chapters, it's incredibly impressive—he's awakened.
5, Everyone, feel free to imagine.

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 65 Breakthrough to the Profound Heart Realm [Request for First Subscription]
chapters.content:
"The third vein has become lively because of you; daily, disciples from other veins come to inquire about your news. When you go to the Sect's Main City in the future, it may be difficult for you to get away," Gu Li said, her tone full of teasing.
Fang Wang smiled and said, "Then I'll just have to visit the Sect's Main City less often."
Afterward, he changed the topic and asked about the changes in the Great Abyss Gate over the past two years.
Gu Li stood side by side with him, gazing together at the distant scenery, and she began to talk about what she knew.
The previous year had been calm for the Great Abyss Gate, with no major incidents until the news of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure was revealed. After that, the Great Abyss Gate became a bustling hub, receiving visits from various sects and cultivator families each month. As a result, the Great Abyss Gate exceptionally admitted quite a few disciples, all of whom chose to join the third vein.
More and more people started to extol Fang Wang's cultivation exploits, elevating him to the realm of the fantastic.
If the earlier Great Abyss Gate was seen as star-studded, then now Fang Wang overshadowed everyone's shine, including Lu Yuanjun. Ever since Lu Yuanjun had been gravely injured by a Demon Monarch, he had been recuperating for several years, rarely showing himself, leading most disciples to hardly think of him.
Fang Wang listened while pondering.
Being too prominent can bring troubles!
Next, he must focus on making a breakthrough to the Profound Heart Realm. After the breakthrough, he would then try to gauge the Sect Leader's intentions!
The two talked for half an hour, and Fang Wang found an opportunity to excuse himself and returned to his cave abode to cultivate.
Gu Li looked at his cave entrance, filled with emotion.
"The Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure truly exists... Just how strong is he now...
...
In the Sect's Main City, Task Hall, on the ground floor.
Fang Hanyu, with his eyes covered, stepped inside and immediately drew the attention of many people.
"It's him again, back so soon?"
"That must be Fang Hanyu, Fang Wang's cousin. His contribution points are rising quickly."
"He's taken on tasks about slaying enemies, all very difficult."
"It is said that last month, he killed two Direct Disciples of the Chi Devil Sect, even facing two at once."
"Tsk tsk, if he's that powerful, then how much stronger is Fang Wang? It looks like the Fang Family from Southern Hills is on the rise."
Fang Hanyu ignored the surrounding whispers. He made his way to the fourth floor to meet with Elder Zhang.
Upon seeing him enter the room, Elder Zhang couldn't help but smile and said, "Your efficiency is just too high, averaging two missions completed per month, and all are targets in the first or second layer of the Spirit Elixir Realm."
Fang Hanyu came to the table and raised his hand to take out a well-wrapped head from his storage bag. He spoke modestly, "I'm just doing my best, my contributions are still quite small."
Elder Zhang checked and verified the head while sighing," Your fame has grown too much lately, be careful of being targeted by the Demonic Dao."
Fang Hanyu nodded and said, "Elder, rest assured, I always disguise myself when I go out, I won't be targeted."
"You also need to be cautious within the sect. No sect in this world is completely airtight, understand?" Elder Zhang said, his words laden with meaning.
Upon hearing this, Fang Hanyu frowned and began to review the details of each mission he had embarked on.
Soon, Elder Zhang helped him re-enter his contribution points, and he took his leave.
As he reached the door, he saw someone and couldn't help but stop; the person approaching was Zhou Xue.
Zhou Xue, dressed in red and wearing two storage bags at her waist, looked heroic. Her makeup was exquisite, and as her cultivation grew, she became even more beautiful and captivating.
"Long time no see!" Zhou Xue said to Fang Hanyu with a raised eyebrow and a smile, then brushed past him without waiting for a reply.
"Elder Zhang, I'm here to report a mission too, and don't get scared this time."
Hearing Zhou Xue's words, Fang Hanyu couldn't help but turn to look, but he only stole a glance before he left the room, closing the door behind him.
Walking along the corridor, Fang Hanyu was filled with curiosity.
He was curious about how strong Zhou Xue was and even more curious about Fang Wang's current level of cultivation.
Zhou Xue, like him, often went out to gain experience, likely hindering her cultivation, certainly not as much as Fang Wang.
Whenever Fang Hanyu thought about Fang Wang's nearly ten-year seclusion, he truly felt admiration.
Not everyone can meditate for so long, especially young people like them who find it difficult to endure the solitude, always longing for the world beyond the mountains.
...
Within the cave abode.
Fang Wang sat cross-legged on a white jade bed, his hands moving through cultivation gestures, with nine fireballs floating in a circle behind his head, distorting the space around him.
Xiao Zi lay near a small pond, peering at Fang Wang.
It was secretly astonished, curious about the cultivation technique Fang Wang was practicing; the flames were too domineering!
It had never seen such a fierce fire-based cultivation technique in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
At this moment, Fang Wang was breaking through to the Profound Heart Realm.
It had been a year and a half since Fang Wang last spoke with Gu Li, and he was nearing thirty.
Reaching the Profound Heart Realm by the age of thirty was definitely a demonstration of the strongest aptitude within Great Abyss Gate. Monsters wishing to cultivate to the realm equivalent to the Demon King would find it nearly impossible without two hundred years.
Perhaps it was due to the Combat Heart, but Fang Wang encountered no hindrance during the process of condensing his Profound Heart. He operated his cultivation technique while feeling the natural essence within his cave abode.
The Profound Heart, understanding the natural ways of the world, enabled one to listen to the voices of all things, such as animals that could not speak the human tongue, and even to sense the emotions of plants.
In some sense, reaching the Profound Heart Realm truly marked the official start of the cultivation path, with the preceding three realms merely laying the foundation for cultivation.
Gradually, Spiritual Power began to grow within Fang Wang's heart, flowing through his tendons and into every part of his body, enhancing the essence of his own Spiritual Power.
This process was wonderful and ineffable, irresistibly enthralling.
It continued for several days.
Finally, Fang Wang achieved a breakthrough and officially reached the first layer of the Profound Heart Realm. His Spiritual Power surged, and his spiritual consciousness strengthened significantly, bringing him immense joy.
Under his inner vision, he noticed another black slot appearing in the Treasured Spirit Space, indicating he could form a third Lifespirit Treasure.
However, with no Heavenly Dao Spirit Stone in his cave abode, he was unable to condense the Lifespirit Treasure.
He didn't get up immediately but chose to continue consolidating his cultivation.
After seven full days, his Spiritual Power ceased to grow on its own, signifying the end of the breakthrough period.
He stood up and stretched, feeling lighter than before.
After warming up, he tidied his clothes, put on his storage bag, and Xiao Zi, noticing he was about to leave, immediately followed; it had been restless for a while.
Fang Wang didn't dare let it go out, fearing it might cause trouble or encounter dangers.
Stepping outside the cave abode, sunlight poured down on him, making him feel refreshed and clear-headed.
Having reached the Profound Heart Realm, his outlook on the world had changed. With the Great Perfection techniques he mastered, in addition to his Lifespirit Treasure and magic artifacts, he could escape even if Lu Yuanjun and Guang Qiuxian conspired to kill him—no one would be able to stop him.
"Young master, where to next?" Xiao Zi asked, its tone full of expectation.
Fang Wang originally intended to find Guang Qiuxian to gauge his stance but, after giving it some thought, decided to first find Zhou Xue.
Many years had passed without seeing her, and he found himself quite missing her.
Without answering, Fang Wang immediately took to the sky on his sword, heading toward the First Peak.
Despite being well known within the sect after nearly ten years of seclusion, few disciples remembered his face. So, as he flew past, the disciples didn't recognize him immediately; they simply thought he looked quite handsome.
Upon arriving at the First Peak, it took Fang Wang a while to find Zhou Xue's cave abode location. Now, Zhou Xue also had a notable reputation, ranking among the top five in fame among the new generation of disciples. Only Fang Wang, Lu Yuanjun, and Ye Xiang were decidedly above her.
At the gate of the mountain, Fang Wang called out, "Zhou Xue, are you there?"
He wasn't confident she would be inside. In his memory, Zhou Xue spent most of her time adventuring outside, and he was uncertain if she was currently in her cave abode.
After a few moments of silence and no response, Fang Wang felt a hint of disappointment and was about to leave when suddenly the mountain gate opened.
"Come in."
The entrance of the cave was dark and the interior indiscernible. Zhou Xue's indifferent voice wafted through, and Fang Wang, elated, stepped inside.
As soon as he entered, the mountain gate shut by itself, and a faint fragrance filled Fang Wang's nostrils. He noticed the cave walls were covered in various vines blooming with dark purple flowers. As he advanced, taking three steps at a time, he spotted Talisman Paper of formations, either affixed to the cave walls or the vines.
Reaching the chamber within, Fang Wang saw Zhou Xue. She was meditating in a pond, drenched, her curvaceous figure evident, thankfully her red clothes were not see-through.
Each Direct Disciple's cave had such a pond, varying in size, made from coalesced Spiritual Energy.
Fang Wang approached the edge of the pond, observing her hair sticking to her face and her skin as white as snow. Her hair was carelessly tied behind her head, and truly, she looked quite feminine this way.
"Why don't you get up and change into dry clothes to greet me?" Fang Wang couldn't help but ask.
Zhou Xue, with her eyes still closed, said, "Nobody but you can come in here. Why stand on ceremony with you? What, with Miss Gu living next door and a female snake demon in your arms, that's not enough? You're still coveting me?"
"Nonsense, how could that be!"
Fang Wang rolled his eyes, annoyed, and quickly changed the subject, "My Treasured Spirit grade has been exposed, who do you think could have let that information slip?"
Only then did Zhou Xue open her eyes. Lifting her long, water-droplet adorned eyelashes, she revealed a pair of bright and captivating eyes as she gazed upon Fang Wang. She didn't answer immediately but instead took a moment to size him up.
Averting his gaze, Fang Wang suddenly felt a stir in his arms as Xiao Zi popped out, exclaiming, "It's you, wicked woman! Who's calling whom a female snake demon?"
"Are you saying you're a male?"
"Of course not, but the implication in your words feels off."
"It seems you have a bit of wit about you."
Zhou Xue and Xiao Zi began to quarrel, but regretfully for Xiao Zi, it couldn't outtalk her and was promptly put in its place after a few exchanges.
Splash—
Zhou Xue stood up and steam rose from her body as her clothing dried at a visibly rapid pace, her wet hair doing likewise. Her black hair fluttered, her red dress billowed, and she exuded an air of an immortal.
Stepping out of the pond barefoot, she approached Fang Wang, stopping less than half a meter away. Black miasma swirled within her captivating eyes, giving them an eerie appearance.
"Profound Heart Realm, you really haven't disappointed me. With the speed of your progress, I am willing to impart a technique to you. Would you like to learn it?" Zhou Xue smiled contentedly, looking intently at Fang Wang.

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 66 Transformation Technique [Seeking First Subscription]
chapters.content:
```
Pass on the technique?
Fang Wang's heart leaped with joy, but he managed to keep his face composed and said calmly, "If you're willing to teach, I'm naturally willing to learn. However, you must pass on something powerful. Ordinary spells won't be much help to me."
The Solaris Scripture, True Combat Technique, Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, Jinghong Divine Sword Art—whoever mastered any of these could proudly stand above their peers, and he had already cultivated them to Great Perfection. His vision had accordingly risen.
Besides, he had mastered the White Rainbow Evasion Technique, Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, Body-protecting Divine Barrier, Great Celestial Thunder Technique, and the Breathless Natural Technique.
At present, he did not lack combat spells. Instead, he was interested in some of the more esoteric arts.
Such as sealing, soul snatching, divination, and so on.
Upon hearing his words, a broader smile appeared on Zhou Xue's face. She walked toward the couch nearby and called out in a light voice, "Come here."
Fang Wang followed, eagerly anticipating what kind of spell this Immortal Venerable would bestow upon him.
Zhou Xue sat cross-legged on the couch and signaled Fang Wang to sit in front of her. Fang Wang, unflinching, joined her on the couch.
Xiao Zi poked its head out from his embrace, flicking its tongue, its serpentine gaze fixated on Zhou Xue.
