Suddenly Zhou Xue waved her sleeve at it, and its neck twisted. It immediately lost consciousness, its forked tongue dangling out of its mouth, and then Zhou Xue pulled it out of his arms.
Fang Wang did not intervene, knowing Zhou Xue had something to say.
"Let's first address your initial question. I've done some investigating; the news came from a disciple of the third branch. Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were both taken by surprise. If my guess isn't wrong, it's either Zhao Zhen's doing or Lu Yuanjun's," Zhou Xue said softly, her eyes calm as a still lake.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang wasn't too surprised; he'd previously suspected it was staged propaganda.
Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen might not be aware that Fang Wang had learned the truth about the massacre night, but they themselves couldn't possibly forget.
Moreover, their passivity while Fang Wang's reputation skyrocketed just didn't make sense.
"Zhao Zhen has never left Great Abyss Gate, obviously wary of something. As for Lu Yuanjun, I was by his side when he clashed with the Demon Monarch. The world believes the Demon Monarch showed mercy, not realizing that it was Lu Yuanjun who escaped death by his own abilities. His Ghost Instrument has surpassed top-notch Magical Artifacts, reaching the rank of a Magical Treasure.
It's very difficult for someone in the Condensation Spirit Realm to kill him."
Upon saying this, Zhou Xue's eyes grew cold.
That powerful?
Fang Wang's eyebrows furrowed, and realizing that the Ghost Instrument had absorbed the souls of millions of people, he was then reassured.
Zhou Xue suddenly shifted the topic, saying, "But don't worry. Although he escaped with his life, he was severely injured and will likely need several years to recover."
Fang Wang shook his head and replied, "I'm naturally not worried. If it really comes down to it, once I break through the Condensation Spirit Realm, I'll take care of him. I'm just afraid that my reputation will bring trouble to Fang Residence."
"It won't. Your talent will only prove the extraordinary nature of the Fang Family's bloodline. Other sects will try to win over the Fang Family. I've already arranged for Fang Family Disciples to join the other Eight Great Sects. With that, at least the Nine Great Sects won't act against the Fang Family. At most, some of the noble families might take issue."
Zhou Xue's words made some sense to Fang Wang.
For the sects, the noble families did not pose a threat to them, their mechanisms being different. Plus, noble families could provide them with talented individuals.
"But back to the point, how did Zhao Zhen and Lu Yuanjun find out I am the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?" Fang Wang asked, puzzled.
Zhou Xue chuckled lightly, "They probably just wanted to burn you in your own fire. Your growth rate is, after all, astonishing, claiming you are the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is sure to be believed by some. Little do they know, they accidentally hit the mark, although describing your treasure as the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is quite an understatement."
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and asked, "What do you mean? Is there a higher grade above Heaven Yuan?"
Zhou Xue replied with a question of her own, "Alright, was there anything else you wanted to ask me?"
Fang Wang pouted but changed the subject, saying, "I'm preparing to mold my third treasure. Do you think I should do it at Great Abyss Gate or find another place?"
Not only the Main Meridian of Great Abyss Gate had Heavenly Dao Spirit Stones but no matter where he chose, it would attract the attention of his sect, so he hesitated.
Zhou Xue raised her right hand and opened a storage bag on the table—the jade flew out and landed in Fang Wang's hand, revealing itself as a Guide Jade.
"This is a Spirit Molding Ground I've selected for you in advance. It's best you assume a false identity when you perform the spiritual refinement there. When you successfully refine your treasure at that place, you'll receive an unexpected gift," Zhou Xue said suggestively.
Seeing Zhou Xue not surprised by his intention to create a third treasure, he was secretly disappointed.
Didn't get to show off this time.
Fang Wang took the Guide Jade and placed it in his own storage bag, teasingly saying, "All this mystery, it's not going to be the same trap set by the Southern Executioner Heavenly King Cao Ran, is it?"
Hearing the name Cao Ran, Zhou Xue couldn't help but glare at him and huffed, "Back then, I indeed underestimated you, but this time it is not my doing. The place is occupied by a master, so you must act cautiously. If successful, the benefits will far exceed your imagination."
Being described as a master by Zhou Xue piqued Fang Wang's interest.
"Alright, it's time to pass on the technique. Tell me, what do you wish to pass on to me?" Fang Wang asked eagerly.
Zhou Xue raised her right hand, showing three fingers, "I have three Transformation Techniques that could save your life or allow you to infiltrate enemy territories. The first is the Sparrow Technique, which allows you to transform into a sparrow. It consumes a lot of Spiritual Power and isn't very fast, but it's the easiest to conceal."
"The second is the White Crane Technique, which allows you to turn into a white crane. It has a smaller consumption and the speed of flight is fast."
"The third is the Black Hawk Technique, allowing you to become a black hawk. The consumption is moderate amongst the three, but the speed is the fastest."
Transformation Techniques!
Fang Wang's eyes lit up, and he asked, "Can I learn all of them?"
```
Zhou Xue shook her head and said, "This technique has already possessed divine skills, and in the Mortal Realm, divine skills should not exist. Each Transformation Technique will leave a different mark on your Profound Heart, and they repel each other."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang fell into hesitation.
Since it was a Transformation Technique, as long as he hid it well normally and transformed at critical moments, it would be very difficult for enemies to detect it, making the transformed physique's size less important.
So, choose the fastest one!
The higher the realm, the stronger the spiritual sense of the enemies faced. Even as small as a sparrow, it would be hard to escape the pursuit of spiritual sense; thus, naturally, the faster, the better.
"I will learn the Black Hawk Technique," Fang Wang said earnestly.
Zhou Xue didn't waste any words and immediately commenced teaching the incantations of the Black Hawk Technique.
Fang Wang sighed inwardly. Damn it, having just completed a ten-year retreat, it was time to start again.
But how could he refuse a supreme skill that was handed to him on a silver platter?
Transformation Techniques embodied the art of channeling energy into acupuncture points. By activating different points, one can achieve physical transformation. Moreover, one must also comprehend and blend with the natural world, so that the transformed body is not rejected by the Earth's energies.
After Zhou Xue finished speaking, Fang Wang inevitably entered the Heavenly Palace.
Zhou Xue, as always, remained silently observant of Fang Wang after finishing her explanation, curious to see his reaction.
After a brief moment of absent-mindedness, Fang Wang took a deep breath and remarked, "The art of Transformation truly is profound and inscrutable."
Zhou Xue's lips curled up as she said, "To reach minor accomplishment, it will take about one or two decades; Great Completion might require fifty years. When you reach the pinnacle, you will not need to perform any incantations; with a mere thought, you'll be able to transform into a black hawk, and even your aura will be just like that of an ordinary black hawk."
"Indeed, I can sense the difficulty."
Fang Wang sighed, Damn it, a single Transformation Technique took ninety-four years to train.
Fortunately, with Great Perfection of the Black Hawk Technique, he could instantly transform into a black hawk without any preparation, and there would be no slightest leakage of Spiritual Power after the transformation.
He did not reveal that he had already mastered the Black Hawk Technique; it was always good to keep some cards close to the chest.
Next, Fang Wang inquired about her experiences over the years.
Zhou Xue selectively shared her adventures, revealing that she had even left the Grand Qi Dynasty and traveled to the Northern Territory, which astonished Fang Wang with her propensity for traveling far and wide.
...
An hour later, once he stepped out of Zhou Xue's cave abode and the mountain gate had closed behind him, Fang Wang flew towards the Main Meridian.
With Xiao Zi still asleep in his arms, Fang Wang was organizing his thoughts.
The ninety-four-year cultivation of the Black Hawk Technique meant that he had to prepare anew his words for meeting with Guang Qiuxian.
Soon after, he arrived at the Main Meridian's peak and landed in front of Shiyuan Hall.
The disciples sweeping the plaza below merely glanced up at him and thought no more of it; only one seemed to think of something, looked up again, widened his eyes, and joyfully exclaimed, "Brother Fang Wang!"
Upon this exclamation, the other sweeping disciples all looked up in astonishment.
Those cleaning here weren't actually doing it for the sake of cleanliness; after all, Cultivators possessed Spells, and those assigned to sweeping were often being punished. Being allowed to clean here, they were at the very least at the level of sword-carrying disciples.
Fang Wang glanced over and thought the person looked somewhat familiar, but before he could ponder further, he saw the doors of Shiyuan Hall open and immediately strode in.
The disciple who recognized Fang Wang's identity laughed proudly and said, "Did you see that? Brother Fang just glanced at me. I've told you, Brother Fang Wang is very aloof in the sect, and there are few disciples he can actually talk to, but luckily I, Zhou Bo, am one of them. Do you want to know the hobbies that Brother Fang Wang keeps secret from others?"
The surrounding disciples looked at him. Although skeptical, they were still eager to hear what he had to say.
Meanwhile.
Fang Wang walked into Shiyuan Hall and approached Guang Qiuxian.
Sitting on a meditation cushion, Guang Qiuxian wore an amused smile as he watched Fang Wang approach and perform the proper formalities. He then took the initiative to ask, "How has your cultivation been these years?"
Fang Wang nodded and replied, "Quite good. Thanks to the Sect Leader and my master's care, I have been able to cultivate in peace."
"And what realm have you reached now?"
"The Profound Heart Realm."
"Yes, no... what? The Profound Heart Realm!" Guang Qiuxian's eyes widened in shock, interrupting his previous composure.
Fang Wang's strength couldn't be measured by realms alone, so revealing his true realm wasn't an issue, and it could also earn him more approval from Guang Qiuxian.
Fang Wang nodded, and upon seeing this, Guang Qiuxian tried to compose himself and exclaimed, "Good! Good! Good!"
"Fang Wang, you have truly exceeded my expectations. I originally thought that reaching the Profound Heart Realm by the age of forty would have been amazing, since you only started on the path of Cultivation at sixteen. But now, let's see... you're only about thirty years old, right?" The more Guang Qiuxian looked at Fang Wang, the more satisfied he became.
Fang Wang smiled and said, "Thank you for the Sect Leader's great kindness, for imparting Spells to me and providing Spiritual Energy, without which I wouldn't have made it this far."
Guang Qiuxian replied with a smile, "It's as it should be. Actually, I have something to tell you. Do you know that the rank of your Spirit Treasure has been exposed?"

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 67: A Gathering of Geniuses, An Unparalleled Arrival [Third Update]
chapters.content:
Facing Guang Qiuxian's inquiry, Fang Wang put on a rueful smile and said, "Sect Leader, I came here precisely because of this matter. You, I, and my master could not have spread this news. Who could have leaked it, if not Zhou Xing Shi?"
Hearing this, Guang Qiuxian's smile solidified, and his complexion darkened as he said, "There is indeed a problem with this situation. I've had people investigate, and they said it was a Third Vein disciple who spread the word. That disciple was captured by a Demonic Cultivator who forced information about the Great Abyss Gate out of him, leading to the reveal of the grade of your Treasure Spirit.
The disciple was convinced that your growth rate could not be the result of a Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit. Perhaps it was really an inadvertent slip. The disciple has died, without a chance to confirm his story, and what's key is that this matter has brought Fu Xuanji of the Tian Shu Sect into the prediction."
"That old undying fellow, indeed he has quite a knack for divining the secrets of heaven. Once he opened his mouth, the matter was as good as settled. Now all the sects have sent people here, and those geniuses even more so want to discuss the Dao with you."
Upon saying this, Guang Qiuxian sighed.
Seeing his expression, which didn't seem feigned, align with what Zhou Xue said, it seemed to Fang Wang that Lu Yuanjun hadn't told Guang Qiuxian about the Fang Residence yet.
Indeed, once spoken out loud, the matter of the Ghost Instrument would no longer be concealable. Guang Qiuxian had an excellent reputation, and even if he would protect Lu Yuanjun to the death, he wouldn't foster evil influences.
Fang Wang still decided not to test Guang Qiuxian. He now needed to enhance his standing in Guang Qiuxian's eyes as well as his position within the Great Abyss Gate, so when the day came for him to confront and break with Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen, the Great Abyss Gate and Guang Qiuxian would have to stand by his side.
After all, that day would not be too far off.
To this day, Fang Wang's hatred for Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen wasn't as urgent as it once was. After all, having spent so many years within the Heavenly Palace, even the deepest grudges tend to fade. Of course, once he was powerful enough, he would casually crush these two to prevent any further threats to his family.
"Let's talk business," Guang Qiuxian said. "The news about the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure has already spread; we at the Great Abyss Gate can no longer deny it. Starting from last year, prodigies have been visiting the Great Abyss Gate, hoping to exchange pointers with you, and to this day, they are still dwelling within the Great Abyss Gate.
Some came of their own accord, some were sent by their sects to test your strength. How about it, will you make a move?"
Guang Qiuxian asked tentatively, feeling somewhat guilty inside. He thought he had failed to protect Fang Wang, and if Fang Wang didn't want to make an appearance, he would brace himself to refuse.
"I will abide by the Sect Leader's commands," Fang Wang said without hesitation, agreeing to the matter immediately.
Gaining glory for the sect would enhance his status within it, wouldn't it?
Of course, this could also attract jealousy, but every matter has its pros and cons—as long as the benefits outweigh the drawbacks, that would suffice.
Moreover, he had been holding back for so many years and wished to vent a little.
Guang Qiuxian smiled and said, "There are thirteen prodigies, hailing from six major sects, five prominent families, and there are two who are considered Loose Cultivators, though their masters are highly regarded hermits of this era. Even the Great Abyss Gate has to show them the due respect."
Fang Wang thought for a moment and said, "Then, Sect Leader, pick a date. The sooner, the better. Have them all come together."
"All together?"
"Yes, settle it all in one go. Since they are all geniuses, their cultivation levels shouldn't have reached the Condensation Spirit Realm, right?"
"How could that be possible? The Condensation Spirit Realm is the pinnacle of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm; even some Sect Leaders from the Nine Great Sects have not attained the Condensation Spirit Realm."
Guang Qiuxian shook his head, looking at Fang Wang. Suddenly, he felt it was absurd.
How come Fang Wang seemed even more composed than him? He felt like a junior, unable to match Fang Wang's maturity.
However, whether Fang Wang was truly composed or merely arrogant would have to be seen in the outcome of the battle.
"Good, if that's the case, then let's set it for seven days from now. At noon, in the Sect's Main City's combat arena, settle who's superior. If you win against all of them, you'll be rewarded with five hundred thousand sect contributions, plus a choice of one of the Vein Suppression Ultimate Arts inheritances. How does that sound?" Guang Qiuxian asked intently, his gaze burning as he spoke.
Fang Wang smiled and replied, "Thank you, Sect Leader!"
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and laughed heartily, then after a few more words of caution, he let Fang Wang leave.
After departing from the Main Meridian, Fang Wang didn't head back to the Third Vein but rather visited his other kinsmen from the Fang Family within the Great Abyss Gate.
The family members Zhou Xue had picked were those who had grown up with Fang Wang. They had a good relationship from the start, and Fang Wang was worried he might forget them if he didn't visit.
Dusk fell, and the moon rose.
The following day, a piece of news went viral within the Great Abyss Gate!
Fang Wang, who had been in seclusion for ten years, was coming out to accept the challenges of prodigies from other sects and noble families!
The entire Nine Veins were buzzing with excitement. Since the revelation of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, disciples from all veins were full of curiosity, anticipation, and skepticism about Fang Wang. Now that they heard he was ready to fight, how could they not be thrilled?
At dusk.
Within a cave dwelling on the Fifth Vein's mountain peak.
Fang Wang was drinking with his older cousin Fang Zigeng, enjoying each other's company, mostly reminiscing about amusing childhood events at the Fang Residence.
Fang Zigeng had achieved the second layer of the Soul Sculpting Realm. Although he did not attain the sudden fame of Fang Hanyu, his rate of cultivation improvement was considered above average among the Fang Family Disciples.
With an ordinary appearance, one that would not stand out in a crowd, he kept a low profile with few close friends. Thus, the arrival of Fang Wang brought him great delight, and his face was constantly adorned with a smile.
Fang Hanyu held him in high esteem, stating he was the most diligent in cultivation amongst the Fang Family Disciples, never venturing down the mountain, instead spending his time either executing harvesting and planting tasks for the sect or staying within his cave dwelling.
"Fang Wang, brother!"
A female voice came from outside the mountain gate, it was the youngest, Fang Xin.
Fang Zigeng promptly went to open the door. The cave dwelling of an Inner Sect Disciple was very small, and he arrived at the mountain gate within a few steps.
Since Fang Zigeng had previously greeted Fang Wang before Fang Xin, she knew Fang Wang was in Fang Zigeng's cave dwelling.
Twenty-nine-year-old Fang Xin was no longer as immature as before, but she was still lively. She rushed over to Fang Wang and asked, "Brother Fang Wang, are you really going to compete against those geniuses? And you're going to fight them one after another in a single day?"
Fang Zigeng, who followed behind, heard about this and couldn't help but be moved, worry showing in his eyes.
Swirling his wine cup, Fang Wang smiled and said, "Yeah, they have waited for me for such a long time, it's only right to face them. I find it troublesome anyway, better to resolve it all in one day."
"Don't take it lightly, I've heard that the disciple of the Grand Qi Sword Saint broke through to the Profound Heart Realm ten years ago," Fang Zigeng said as he sat down, reminding him.
Although he couldn't understand the world of a genius like Fang Wang, he couldn't help but offer a warning.
Fang Wang smiled and said, "Don't worry, I know my limits. Just watch me win when the time comes."
Fang Xin looked up to Fang Wang with adoration and said, "Brother Fang Wang, if you defeat those geniuses, will you become the top disciple of the Great Abyss Gate?"
Ever since Fang Wang's Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure was revealed, most disciples believed he would become the next top disciple.
In the world of cultivation, talent is supreme. Such talent naturally deserved to be nurtured with the treatment of a top disciple.
Fang Wang shook his head and said, "It's not that easy, but I can get closer."
The three of them started discussing the position of the top disciple. The seat of the Great Abyss Gate's top disciple had been vacant for some time. The previous top disciple had died at the hands of a demonic cultivator from the Chi Devil Sect, and since then Guang Qiuxian had not appointed a new top disciple.
Privately, the disciples all thought that the top disciple's spot was reserved for Lu Yuanjun.
With Fang Wang's rise, the position of the Sect's top disciple became filled with suspense. People like to watch the new talents challenge the old number one, just as Lu Yuanjun had challenged Xu Lang back in the day. Now, many disciples were curious about whom the Sect Leader would ultimately choose.
With six days remaining, Fang Wang still didn't return to his cave dwelling, lingering instead at the dwellings of the Fang Family Disciples. Xiao Zi had already woken up long ago but had been hiding in Fang Wang's embrace until the third day when Fang Wang forcibly pulled her out and introduced her to the clan.
Afterward, Xiao Zi opened up her nature and often joined the conversations between Fang Wang and his clanspeople.
By the seventh day, as the sky just started lightening, the Sect's Main City was already packed to the brim.
Disciples had already gathered around the combat platform, layer upon layer, all eager to witness the prowess of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure.
In the Nine Veins Combat Method of ten years ago, Fang Wang's performance, though impressive, consisted mostly of quick victories, so it didn't show how strong he truly was. Now, with geniuses gathered, the disciples all wanted to see where Fang Wang's limits were.
The Third Vein Disciples took pride in Fang Wang. Even before the contests had started, they were everywhere proclaiming Fang Wang's strengths, and some even claimed that Fang Wang was the White Garment Astonishing Swan.
Of course, the name of the White Garment Astonishing Swan had already faded from within the cultivation world, and half of the geniuses who had come to challenge Fang Wang had even stronger records and greater renown.
The cultivators who had come as guests to the Great Abyss Gate also rushed over, making the Sect's Main City abuzz with lively sounds.
Rumors about Fang Wang and the geniuses circulated within the Main City.
In terms of Lifespirit Treasure grade alone, those geniuses all had Top-Grade Mysterious Elemental Spirit Treasures, far surpassing Fang Wang. However, these geniuses were older than Lu Yuanjun and were masters of ultimate arts with fierce records. Apart from the aura of genius, they were already strong figures within the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
This battle, in the eyes of cultivators from all walks, was a clash between two generations.
Lu Yuanjun shook the structure of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm with his Earth Origin Spirit Treasure. Now, with the appearance of a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, it was impossible for the Eight Great Sects and various influential families not to fear. This trial was not just about the excitement within the Great Abyss Gate; it would inevitably spread throughout the cultivation world.
As it approached noon, Guang Qiuxian arrived with the nine Peak Masters and dozens of elders, including Zhao Chuanqian, Elder Zhang of the Task Hall, and Greedy Sleeper.
The Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi did not come.
Eight elders spread out around the combat platform and began setting up formations.
Geniuses such as Lu Yuanjun, Xu Lang, Ye Xiang, Yan Feiyue, and Gu Li also arrived, standing together and discussing the day's competitions.
Soon after, Zhou Xue also came.
Within the Great Abyss Gate, even geniuses had their own hierarchy. Although Lu Yuanjun was amiable towards others, the disparity in Treasured Spirits was real and palpable; those with lower-grade Treasured Spirits dared not join their conversations.
The Emperor of Grand Qi, Zhao Zhen, walked over, surrounded by a group of Third Vein Disciples, his prestige among the Third Vein clearly visible.
After a while, the geniuses who had come to challenge Fang Wang began to arrive one after another.
Each of their arrivals stirred discussion among the surrounding disciples watching the event, and tales of their exploits were passed from mouth to mouth.
"That's Liu Jun from the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, second only to Xu Qiuming the genius, who stepped into the Profound Heart Realm four years ago."
"These peak geniuses of the present day truly have an imposing aura!"
"Peak geniuses? Ridiculous. What are they compared to a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?"
"That's Song Jinyuan, the disciple of the Sword Saint. Legend has it that his Sword Intent has reached a transformative level."
"Where is Brother Fang Wang? When will he show up? Facing thirteen formidable geniuses in a row, it's hard to imagine how he will perform."

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 68 Brilliant Light, The Divine Dragon Appears [Fourth Update, Seeking Monthly Pass]
chapters.content:
As the disciples discussed the influx of prodigies, Zhou Xue gathered with the Fang Family Disciples, the only exception being Fang Hanyu.
Fang Zigeng spoke, feeling emotional, "Fourteen years of cultivation and already overpowering those who've cultivated for dozens of years in sheer presence—could this be the deterrence of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?"
The other Fang Family Disciples were excited, feeling a vicarious sense of honor.
Zhou Xue, however, remained calm, her gaze fixed on the combat platform, lost in thought.
At that moment, exclamations from distant disciples rang out.
"Fang Wang has arrived!"
Zhou Bo called out excitedly, his right hand pointing towards Fang Wang.
Everyone turned their heads to look and saw a figure flying in from the direction of the third vein—it was indeed Fang Wang. He was not riding a Flying Sword, but his white disciple robe fluttered in the air. His aura was not strong, yet as he skimmed past the sky above the Sect's Main City, his otherworldly demeanor easily drew people's eyes to him.
After so many years of cultivation at the Heavenly Palace, Fang Wang exuded an indescribable sense of vicissitude which, combined with his youthful and elegant appearance, gave birth to a unique charm.
Zhao Zhen, watching Fang Wang's silhouette, remarked sentimentally, "There are people whose presence alone lets you know who the main character of the story is."
The surrounding disciples from the third vein echoed the sentiment. Fang Wang was now the pride of the entire third vein; you only had to praise Fang Wang to win the friendship of third vein disciples. Zhao Zhen's words made him even more beloved among them.
Lu Yuanjun also looked towards Fang Wang, a smile of expectation and admiration on his face.
"It's been ten years, and who knows how strong Fang Wang has become now," Yan Feiyue mused.
The image of Fang Wang slaying the black Jiaolong in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven was still vivid in his mind, as if it had happened only yesterday.
Gu Li, with her veil, stared intently at Fang Wang, her eyes filled with anticipation, for she believed Fang Wang could win.
Fang Wang moved through the gap in the Formation around the combat platform and landed lightly, becoming the center of attention in an instant. Scorching gazes came at him from all directions, yet his expression remained calm, his posture erect, as he casually rested his right hand on the hilt of his Qingjun Sword at his waist. Xiao Zi still resided in his embrace, too shy to peep out.
Cultivators were allowed to bring their Demon Pets into combat since a cultivator's overall strength was never solely determined by their cultivation level.
"Fang Wang really does have an impressive demeanor," Fang Mo commented admiringly.
With so many cultivators watching, Fang Wang remained unfazed. To think that he was one of his own clan, Fang Mo now had an almost surreal feeling.
Zhou Xue's expression remained unchanged, and she chose not to voice any opinions.
Greedy Sleeper stood outside the combat platform, performing a gesture with his hand, and twelve Golden Mirrors soared from within the Sect's Main City. Rapidly enlarging, they hovered in the air above the city, reflecting the combat platform so that Fang Wang's form could be seen from any corner of the city.
"Is that Fang Wang? How handsome he is!"
"Ten years have passed, and Brother Fang Wang's charm has only grown stronger."
"It's hard to believe he's only been cultivating for fourteen years. Just standing there, I feel like he's already won."
"That's just the psychological suggestion that the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure brings you. You all think that the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure should win."
"Strong as the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure may be, against thirteen first-rate talents of this era in succession, it's hard to imagine that he'll win every match, right?"
Discussions among the cultivators reverberated throughout the city. The vast majority of disciples believed Fang Wang was certainly the strongest, but his opponents were too numerous. To win against them all, that was unlikely; it wasn't as if it was the Nine Veins Combat Method—his opponents were the elites of various factions.
Guang Qiuxian leaped onto the combat platform, his face beaming with a gentle smile. Stroking his beard, he chuckled, "Today is the day of discourse between the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples and the talented cultivators from all around the Cultivation World. We discourse and not bear grudges, winners and losers will eventually emerge, but the Path of Immortality goes on without end.
Regardless of the outcome, I hope both parties will share their sights on the great Dao of longevity."
His words, echoed by the twelve Golden Mirrors across the city, received waves of admiration from the Nine Veins disciples and cultivators alike. The Sect Leader really does speak with such a grand vision.
At the edge of the combat platform, the thirteen prodigious talents preparing to challenge Fang Wang were chatting and laughing.
Liu Jun from the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, dressed in blue and graced with charm, with a folding fan in hand, smiled at his fellow talented cultivators and said, "Dear friends, how about letting me go first to test his depth?"
As soon as he said this, a genius cultivator from the Crimson Sect coldly rebutted, "Why should you go first?"
The other talents joined in, all wanting to be the first to challenge Fang Wang. First, they were aware of the years Fang Wang has spent cultivating, and second, they were confident in their abilities, each wanting to defeat Fang Wang fair and square.
Just then, a voice floated over:
"Gentleman, stop the quarrel, come up together."
Hearing this, the smiles on the faces of the thirteen talents froze, and they all looked at Fang Wang in astonishment.
Guang Qiuxian's smile stiffened as well, as he looked at Fang Wang to see if he was serious.
That day, Fang Wang had mentioned wanting to deal with these talents all at once, leading Guang Qiuxian to believe it would be a series of consecutive battles like the Nine Veins Combat Method. Little did he know this young cultivator actually intended to face all these talents alone.
The twelve Golden Mirrors focused on Fang Wang; thus, even if he spoke softly, his words would be clearly conveyed to every corner of the city, and he did not speak in hushed tones—his voice was loud and clear.
The city fell silent, and even the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples were moved.
Lu Yuanjun's smile vanished, anxiety creasing his brow.
Zhao Zhen, however, maintained his smile, though his hands clenched tightly within his sleeves.
"Hmph, are you not being too arrogant?"
Song Jinyuan, the exclusive disciple of the Grand Qi Sword Saint, stared coldly at Fang Wang, his words icy. He stood with his arms folded across his sword, dressed in plain clothes, a bamboo hat on his head, his features weathered, and his eyes as fierce as a lion's—both detached and exuding a domineering air.
Fang Wang said calmly, "None of you would want to miss the opportunity to cross hands with me, so let's all go together, save some time. Besides, if it's one-on-one, you really don't stand a chance."
Arrogant!
This was the first impression everyone had upon hearing his words.
Zhou Xue's lips curled up, revealing a smile for the first time on her face.
Seeing Fang Wang so confident, Guang Qiuxian had no choice but to believe in him and thus spoke up, "If that's the case, then all of you go up to the stage together."
Even he said so, the thirteen prodigies naturally couldn't refuse. They leaped onto the combat platform in quick succession, swiftly lined up, and surrounded Fang Wang. Their looks towards Fang Wang varied—some were angry, some disdainful, some envious, and some full of mockery.
Liu Jun tucked his folding fan into his belt and raised his hand to summon a large bow, sneering, "Fang Wang, bring out your Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure and let us take a good look. I'm really curious about what it looks like to make you so contemptuous of everything else!"
Song Jinyuan didn't bother with pleasantries and drew the long sword from his hand. The blade, four fingers wide and silver-blue in color, exuded cold air, making it obvious that its quality was extraordinary.
The other prodigies each brought out their magic artifacts, and some directly summoned their Lifespirit Treasures.
Fang Wang raised his right hand, and the Heavenly Palace Halberd materialized in his grasp. This time, he did not conceal the true might of the Heavenly Palace Halberd. A domineering aura erupted, sweeping across all directions and stirring up a strong wind.
Hummmm—
A dragon's hum came from within the Heavenly Palace Halberd, resonating throughout the entire city and capturing the attention of all cultivators.
What a domineering halberd!
Although many disciples had seen the Heavenly Palace Halberd during the Nine Veins Combat Method ten years ago, they were still amazed to see it anew.
At this moment, the Lifespirit Treasures of the thirteen prodigies began to tremble, and those prodigies who hadn't summoned their Lifespirit Treasures were shocked to find them uncontrollably revealing themselves.
The disciples surrounding the combat platform also changed in complexion as they felt their own Lifespirit Treasures becoming restless. Fortunately, the platform was isolated by a formation, preventing their treasures from going out of control.
"Could the anomaly back then have been because he molded a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?"
Some couldn't help but exclaim. Sixteen years ago, when all the sect's disciples' Lifespirit Treasures uncontrollably flew out of their bodies and trembled, how could they ever forget that?
Lu Yuanjun's expression was grave. His outward appearance seemed no different from the other disciples, but inside, his desire to kill surged.
He felt the threat from Fang Wang, and it was intense!
He thought of Zhao Zhen's words—if Fang Wang were to surpass him and came to know the truth of those years ago, could he really let him off?
Although he had only interacted with Fang Wang a few times, he realized that Fang Wang was different from most cultivators; he was not eager to pledge allegiance for benefits. Perhaps that was the nature of a true genius, needing no one else.
Fang Wang, halberd in one hand, clothes flapping in the wind, his aura like a rainbow, surveyed the surrounding prodigies and spoke, "Gentlemen, why not announce your names? Today's battle is also our first encounter. I hope that we can become friends through fighting, and together we pursue the path of eternal life."
He wanted to compete, and he intended to do it openly and honorably!
But he didn't wish to make enemies out of arrogance.
Upon hearing this, the thirteen prodigies relaxed their expressions. They could understand Fang Wang's arrogance—if they had Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasures, they would undoubtedly be even more arrogant. But now Fang Wang was extending an olive branch, how could they refuse?
Despite their anger, they all knew deep down that Fang Wang, with his Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, would eventually become a legend beyond their reach.
"Crimson Sect, Tang Kun!"
"Chi Devil Sect, Li Lisheng!"
"Sword Saint Disciple, Song Jinyuan!"
"Taiqing Gate, Lu Xunfeng!"
"Tian Shu Sect, Mo Bei!"
One prodigy after another announced their names. After everyone had finished, Fang Wang actually soared into the air, holding the halberd in one hand as he flew.
The thirteen prodigies subconsciously looked up to him.
"Ten years ago, I mastered a unique art in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. Now, I've barely scratched the surface, and I would like to demonstrate it to all of you."
Fang Wang looked down at them, his voice calm. As his words fell, streams of qi started to swirl around his body, quickly wrapping around him and solidifying into a massive dragon head.
Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, Qi Dragon!
Guang Qiuxian looked up, his brow furrowed, equally curious about the unique art Fang Wang had mastered.
Under the watchful eyes of all, the Qi Dragon around Fang Wang quickly solidified, with the dragon whiskers and eyes becoming vivid, as if a dragon spirit had possessed him.
Shape Dragon!
Then, the Shape Dragon burst into white light, transforming into a White Dragon!
Seeing this, both Guang Qiuxian and the Nine Veins peak masters' faces changed drastically, as if they had thought of something, their expressions one of disbelief.
Fang Wang leapt again, originally just a dragon head, but as he rose, the head ascended and a body extended below, as if a divine dragon was traveling from another dimension. When he reached a hundred meters in the sky, a white dragon, twenty-zhang long, stood proudly in the high air, overseeing the combat platform.
Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art!

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 69: Unable to Withstand a Single Blow, Inheritance of the Sword Array 【Fifth Update】
chapters.content:
```
The White Dragon loomed in the sky, and within the dragon's head, Fang Wang appeared as if he were a Dragon God, his indifferent eyes gazing down upon the thirteen prodigies below.
This was his first time publicly performing the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art. He hadn't done so before, fearing that possessing a treasure might bring him blame, but now he had a certain level of confidence. Although he did not dare to claim to be invincible, showing his strength appropriately would help him avoid more trouble.
Since his Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure had been exposed, he wanted to tell the world that he had grown up!
Whoever dared to scheme against him using the Fang Family should first measure if they were worthy!
Everyone was shocked by the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art. The White Dragon that Fang Wang had become was not only visually stunning but also exuded a powerful aura that even through the formation could be felt by the disciples outside.
The thirteen prodigies below felt it even more, treating him as a formidable opponent, some even beginning to sweat from their foreheads.
"Attack together, by joining forces, we may not lose to him. The more powerful the technique, the greater the consumption of Spiritual Energy!"
Liu Jun of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect said in a deep voice, as he pulled his bow into a full circle, concentrating Spiritual Power into an arrow, aiming at Fang Wang in the sky.
The other geniuses stimulated their Lifespirit Treasures, casting their most powerful spells.
Fang Wang's gaze sharpened, and he suddenly dived downward, his roar shaking the heavens. The twenty-zhang-long White Dragon descended with a momentum like that of a sky collapse!
How fast!
Song Jinyuan's pupils shrunk, a sense of alarm rising in his heart. He was the quickest to react among them; his figure flickered in place, casting sword moves swiftly as if drawing five clones, all lifting their swords to slash towards the heavens with soaring Sword Intent.
Liu Jun twisted his body, his upper half angled towards the sky, releasing his arrow in fury. The arrow, transformed from Spiritual Power, became a streak of intense light, swift and forceful as thunder.
The ultimates of the other geniuses were equally grand, making the Sect's Main City shudder.
The White Dragon fiercely plummeted, tearing through all attacks with absolute dominance. When it was about to hit the ground, it abruptly changed direction and struck at Liu Jun.
The White Dragon's speed was too fast; before Liu Jun could dodge, he was hit hard, spitting blood and flying out to crash against the formation's light barrier, sliding down slowly.
Before he could land, the other prodigies were consecutively blown off the sparring platform!
The White Dragon was unstoppable, ramming into anyone it encountered leaving Spiritual Power scattered, causing minor to severe injuries, from internal upheaval to fractures and broken bones.
In less than the time for three breaths, ten people had been thrown off the platform, and it was so quick that the spectators throughout the city didn't even have time to speak, all staring intently at the twelve golden mirrors in the sky, where within the White Dragon appeared so mighty, like a celestial beast descending to wreak havoc in the mortal realm.
Standing within the head of the dragon, Fang Wang had his sights set on who he considered the strongest—Song Jinyuan.
Song Jinyuan quickly retreated, his right hand executing sword moves. Numerous Flying Swords flew out from his storage bag, rapidly forming a Sword Array and drawing nature's spiritual energy to converge.
Facing the incoming White Dragon, he fiercely threw his sword. Dozens of Flying Swords followed in the formation's trail, accompanied by wind and thunder, with fierce Sword Intent.
Boom——
His Treasured Sword was directly knocked away, each of the Flying Swords shattered to pieces, and their Sword Intent dispersed, raising strong winds and shaking the formation's light barrier.
Song Jinyuan's eyes widened with shock.
His prized Sword Array was so easily defeated?
Before he had time to think further, the White Dragon rammed into him, rendering him unconscious as his body flew out like a shooting star.
Fang Wang had sped up particularly to deal with him, and luckily it was a success.
Only two remained now!
Fang Wang immediately turned around, and to his surprise, the last two fled the platform in fear, not daring to fight.
Fang Wang then halted, his feet touching the ground. The White Dragon coiled around him, dissipating into a gust of wind, the sound of dragon's roar resounding once more.
The entire ordeal lasted less than six breaths of time!
All the spectators shared the same sentiment.
Effortlessly dominant, unrivaled!
The contestants were not even on the same level!
Despite facing many, Fang Wang had shown a strength beyond everyone's imagination.
Everyone had great expectations for the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, but no one had anticipated the fight would go to such extremes.
After a brief silence, the Sect's Main City erupted in thunderous cheers and amazement.
"My God, what kind of spell is that, too strong, right?"
"So strong... those famous geniuses working together were no match for him in one single round!"
"Is that the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure? It's too exaggerated. Aside from cultivation level, he's also mastered such an incredible technique!"
"Why do I feel that he's transcended the category of a genius, feeling that even the elders might not be his match."
"After this battle, the title of Grand Qi's number one prodigy is undoubtedly his."
As disciples and cultivators from all sides debated in awe, the Peak Masters and the elders looked upon Fang Wang with complicated eyes.
They felt a sense of danger.
Facing the immediately preceding Fang Wang, they indeed lacked the confidence to claim a sure victory. Some elders even felt they were inferior to Fang Wang.
Zhao Chuanqian looked at Fang Wang with a complex look in his eyes.
Fourteen years ago, he had brought Fang Wang up the mountain, at that time regretting choosing the third meridian for Fang Wang. But now, fourteen years later, Fang Wang had grown to such an extent.
```
Greedy Sleeper couldn't stop laughing as he boasted to the surrounding elders about how, from the very first glance at Fang Wang, he knew the boy would one day soar to great heights; he just hadn't expected that day to come so soon.
Sword Saint's Successor Song Jinyuan lay on the ground, struggling to rise but utterly unable to. Fortunately, the Great Abyss Gate elders hurried over to help him sit in meditation and heal his injuries.
Barely opening his eyes, Song Jinyuan saw a blurry figure standing on the spellcasting platform that seemed achingly out of reach.
After eighty years of cultivation, he had never felt such defeat.
At first, when he heard that Lu Yuanjun had shaped a medium-grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, he was disdainful, still confident in his own Sword Intent. But now...
He was plunged into an unprecedented state of confusion.
Is strong Sword Intent enough to make up for the gap between Lifespirit Treasure grades?
Lu Yuanjun stood among the talented of Great Abyss Gate with a complex look in his eyes at Fang Wang. Around him, the disciples excitedly discussed the recent battle, but he couldn't maintain his composure because Fang Wang had just demonstrated terrifying strength. Without using that ultimate treasure, he wasn't entirely confident he could face him.
From afar, Zhao Zhen glanced at Lu Yuanjun. Seeing his expression, Zhao's eyes grew cold, and he silently turned to leave.
Zhou Xue watched the triumphant Fang Wang, chuckled softly to herself, and likewise turned to leave.
Guang Qiuxian stood on the spellcasting platform and, seeing that the elders had begun healing the geniuses, turned to Fang Wang and said, "Fang Wang, come with me."
He appeared calm, but inside he was extremely anxious.
Fang Wang was too strong!
He feared that the tree that stands out in the forest will be the first to be destroyed by the wind!
Defeating so many geniuses single-handedly, how could the eight major factions be at ease?
He needed to think of a strategy to deal with this.
Fang Wang put away the Heavenly Palace Halberd into his Treasured Spirit Space, then followed Guang Qiuxian's steps off the spellcasting platform, and Qiuxian even called Elder Zhang from Task Hall to join them.
Along the way, the disciples all chanted Fang Wang's name.
Fang Wang felt mixed emotions as these disciples truly lacked the composure of cultivators. Just by transforming into the White Dragon, he had driven them into a frenzy; what if he were to become the Black Dragon?
Along the way, Elder Zhang couldn't stop singing Fang Wang's praises, to the point that Fang Wang himself felt somewhat embarrassed.
Guang Qiuxian led the way ahead without turning back or joining in the conversation.
The three of them made their way quickly to the Task Hall, and upon reaching the fourth floor's Elder's Chamber, Guang Qiuxian spoke, "Record eight hundred thousand contribution points for him!"
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow; this was three hundred thousand more than had been agreed upon in advance.
He hurriedly took out his Disciple Token and handed it to Elder Zhang.
Elder Zhang complied immediately, chuckling, "It's not just eight hundred thousand, I think even a million is too little for the reputation this battle has brought. It's immeasurable."
Guang Qiuxian glared at him and retorted, "Are you the Sect Leader, or am I?"
Elder Zhang snorted and stopped talking.
It was clear from the relationship between the two that they were close and lacked a strict hierarchical divide.
Fang Wang remembered someone mentioning that Elder Zhang was the Sect Leader's senior brother, nearing the end of his life with not many years left.
Soon after, Elder Zhang handed the Disciple Token back to Fang Wang, who followed Guang Qiuxian as he turned and motioned for Fang Wang to keep up.
Elder Zhang sat down, watching Fang Wang's retreating figure, and remarked with a sigh, "To witness a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure in my twilight years, truly the heavens have graced me..."
...
After leaving Task Hall, Guang Qiuxian took Fang Wang back to the Main Meridian and into Shiyuan Hall, where they stood facing each other. Guang Qiuxian asked what Fang Wang wished to learn.
Without hesitation, Fang Wang chose the third vein's Sect Heritage, the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation!
This Sword Array was the most profound secret of the nine veins; to date, no one else had inherited it, including Yang Yuanzi, which implied that the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Array was stronger than the Jinghong Divine Sword Art.
Guang Qiuxian looked at him deeply, then raised his right hand, and a gust of wind echoed through the corridor. Shortly after, a Jade Slip flew into his palm, and he passed it on to Fang Wang.
"This is the inheritance Jade Slip for the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation. I can give you at most ten years; after that, you must return it," Guang Qiuxian said solemnly.
Fang Wang nodded and quickly replied, "It won't take that long. As soon as I memorize the cultivation method, I will return it early."
Guang Qiuxian nodded, "The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Array was created by the second Sect Leader, who once travelled beyond the land of Grand Qi to a vast dominion in search of immortality. Upon his return, he swept through the Cultivation World with the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Array. Unfortunately, no one managed to inherit his legacy.
You, being a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure bearer with a strong comprehension of the Sword Dao, I hope to see it reemerge in your hands."
Fang Wang immediately agreed, and Guang Qiuxian, without further ado, waved his sleeve to gesture that he could leave.
Fang Wang stowed the Jade Slip in his storage pouch and then bowed before taking his leave.
Upon exiting Shiyuan Hall, he was about to fly back to the third vein when he suddenly noticed someone approaching the mountain, and he hurried to greet them.
"Brother Lu, long time no see," Fang Wang greeted with a smile.
Lu Yuanjun, upon seeing him, showed a moment of discomfort, but soon reverted to his usual enthusiastic demeanor, laughing, "Brother Fang, your performance was impressive. I feel I'm no longer a match for you."
"You flatter me, Brother Lu. I still need to cultivate further to catch up to you. By the way, what brings you here?" Fang Wang asked with a shake of his head and a wry smile.
The two seemed to have a close relationship, with no hint of enmity.
Smiling, Lu Yuanjun answered, "About the intelligence on the other sects, I have to report to the Sect Leader."

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 70 Great Perfection of the Sword Array, Sword Heaven Marsh [Sixth Release, Requesting Monthly Votes]
chapters.content:
```
"Then, Senior Brother, please go ahead."
Fang Wang hastily made way, and Lu Yuanjun smiled and nodded. They brushed past each other.
As the two went their separate ways, Fang Wang leaped up, transforming into a streak of white light soaring toward the third peak. His face cooled, the smile no longer present.
Walking towards the Great Abyss Gate, Lu Yuanjun too lost his smile, his expression becoming particularly gloomy.
What was on each of their minds, only they themselves knew.
The Sect's Main City remained noisy, although the confrontation between Fang Wang and the thirteen geniuses was brief, its sensational impact was long-lasting.
Fang Wang moved quickly, swiftly arriving at the third peak. Landing in front of his cave dwelling, Xiao Zi peeked out from his embrace and asked, "Master, do you have a grudge against that person?"
As Fang Wang took out his disciple token to open the mountain gate, he replied, "Indeed, I do."
Once the mountain gate opened, he walked into his cave dwelling.
Xiao Zi slipped out of his embrace and, taking the opportunity, closed the mountain gate, then followed Fang Wang, asking, "Master, if you have trouble dealing with him, let me do it. One bite from me, and I guarantee he'll wish he was dead."
"No need. Killing him isn't difficult, but the relationships behind him are complicated. Let's wait a few more years. Perhaps he is already suffering quite a bit," Fang Wang replied.
His observational skills were incredibly sharp, as he distinctly felt Lu Yuanjun's nervousness during their recent encounter; he was merely feigning composure.
Perhaps Lu Yuanjun was still praying that Fang Wang would not discover the truth.
Fang Wang sat down in front of the white jade bed and took out the Jade Slip of the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, falling into hesitation.
Should he start learning it now?
It was likely to consume two hundred years of his time.
But if he did not learn it now, when would he?
Fang Wang had recently made a big splash, so in the future, not many might dare to trouble him. However, those who would dare to cross him must be existences above the fifth level of the Profound Heart Realm.
Forget it!
Let's learn it!
Fang Wang clenched his teeth, deciding to be harsh on himself. He immediately began to probe the Jade Slip with his divine sense.
Seeing him commence his cultivation, Xiao Zi did not disturb him anymore and went to the edge of the pool. It gazed at its reflection on the water surface, fantasizing it was a Dragon Head.
After half an hour.
Fang Wang's eyes suddenly became unfocused, and his consciousness entered the Heavenly Palace.
Standing inside the grand hall of the Heavenly Palace, Fang Wang struggled to calm his mind.
While reviewing the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, he realized it was even more profound and unfathomable than the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, which meant that the time it would take to cultivate it would be long.
"Train! I'll see just how potent the sword formation that swept the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm is!" Fang Wang murmured to himself, pumping himself up.
With a thought, flying swords started to materialize around him. The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation required swords to form the Sword Array, and to achieve Great Perfection, seventy-two formation swords were needed, with higher-quality swords resulting in stronger power.
Having thought his prior mastery of the Jinghong Divine Sword Art and the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi would make the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation less challenging to cultivate, he was surprised that even the initial stages nearly drove him to collapse.
It took a full forty years for him to barely enter the threshold. This Sword Formation required refinement of one's divine sense and comprehension of the thunder-attribute Spiritual Energy, which was immensely profound.
With thunder's essence solidifying the Sword Intent of the formation, transforming into the domain of the Nine Heavens swords, it would overpower all foes!
After entering the doorway, Fang Wang no longer found it tedious and became highly intrigued by the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation.
He felt that the potency of the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation was no less than that of the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art—to be precise, these were two different types of spells; the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art was suitable for destruction and breaking out of encirclements, while the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation was suited for mass slaying.
Thunder had a natural overwhelming effect against certain special monsters, evil spirits, and Cultivation Techniques.
Time in the Heavenly Palace passed by.
By the time Fang Wang had brought the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation to Great Perfection, he looked back to find it had taken him a total of three hundred and forty-two years.
If seventy-two cultivators practiced the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation together, they would achieve progress with half the effort. However, finding seventy-two qualified individuals with keen perception for thunder attributes and insight into the Sword Dao was something not even the Great Abyss Gate could manage.
Fang Wang's consciousness returned to the real world; his eyes regained their clarity. At this very moment, he was still holding the Jade Slip in his hand.
He tossed the Jade Slip into his storage bag, stood up, and said, "Xiao Zi, prepare to descend the mountain!"
Xiao Zi, who had been cultivating, opened its serpent eyes and asked with surprise, "So soon? Master, don't you need rest after the big battle? And the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, won't you study it further?"
"Are you coming or not? If you're not, I'm leaving!"
Fang Wang equipped the two storage bags on the table and then picked up the Qingjun Sword, heading toward the mountain gate.
Xiao Zi quickly followed him, afraid of being left behind.
"Master, why do you suddenly want to leave the mountain?"
"I'm feeling stifled."
"Stifled? How did you get stifled? Do you need my help to release it?"
```
```
"What do you know, and how exactly can you help me release my anger by letting me beat you up?"
"Ah? It's not impossible, as long as the young master is happy..."
...
Within Shiyuan Hall, Guang Qiuxian sat cross-legged on a cushion, his face looking exceedingly ugly, while Yang Yuanzi stood beside him, wearing an expression of rage.
"Foolish! Foolish! I've said it before, don't indulge him. Just look at him, he's just like his father, his heart isn't that of a human at all!"
Yang Yuanzi reprimanded sternly, gritting his teeth as he struggled to suppress his anger.
Guang Qiuxian glared at him and retorted, "Indulge him? When he was seven, I listened to you and let Chen Anshi take him to travel the world until he was twenty! Do you have any idea how much he suffered during those years? Maybe it was those experiences that warped his heart!"
Yang Yuanzi said fiercely, "I don't care. Fang Wang is my disciple and the hope of the Great Abyss Gate. No matter what, I will not allow Lu Yuanjun to threaten him. Since Lu Yuanjun has made a mistake, we should punish him. We must compensate Fang Wang. I suggest we make Fang Wang the head disciple of the Great Abyss Gate immediately!
He deserves this status on his own merits!"
Guang Qiuxian frowned deeply, sighing, "Lu Yuanjun certainly must be punished. Otherwise, we would do a disservice to those wrongful spirits. But can this matter really be concealed forever? Should we communicate with Fang Wang in advance to mitigate this issue?"
"How can we mitigate a massacre?"
"Then what do we do? In a hundred years, Fang Wang is bound to become the strongest in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. At that time, will you and I be able to control him?"
"Why control him? My disciple is broad-minded and kind-hearted, never bullying the weak. As for his grudge with Lu Yuanjun, the best solution is to make Lu Yuanjun disappear, to send him away!"
Yang Yuanzi stated in an indisputable tone, pausing for a moment before adding seriously, "Brother, we can't indulge him any longer. We are indebted to his mother, yes, but that was to his mother. As for such a calamitous son, just living is enough!"
Guang Qiuxian remained silent.
At that moment, a disciple's voice came from outside the door of Shiyuan Hall: "Sect Leader, Fang Wang is not in his cave residence. Disciples have investigated and discovered that his disciple token has left Great Abyss Gate. He must have gone down the mountain."
Upon hearing this, the expressions of Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi changed in an instant.
"Alright, go back to your cultivation," Guang Qiuxian replied, and the disciple outside the door immediately withdrew.
Shiyuan Hall had special prohibitions in place that could block prying eyes, so both men weren't worried about their conversation being overheard.
Guang Qiuxian's expression was odd as he said, "It's only been two hours since he obtained the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation. Other sects' prodigies haven't left yet, but he's already gone down the mountain. Could it be that he's fleeing with the secret technique?"
Yang Yuanzi glanced at him in disdain and said irritably, "What are you suggesting, that he's a Demonic Dao spy? Would you really use a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure as a mole? If he were truly a spy, why not climb to the position of vice sect leader or even take your place? To flee for a technique that cannot be practiced—do you think that's likely?
Moreover, the Fang Family has more than just him in the Great Abyss Gate. I really don't understand why our master chose you as Sect Leader!"
"I was just joking. What are you getting so worked up about? And attacking me," Guang Qiuxian defended himself, clearly irritated.
Yang Yuanzi snorted and said, "Bring Lu Yuanjun here. I want to interrogate him myself!"
Guang Qiuxian hesitated for a moment but ultimately nodded in agreement.
...
Amidst the boundless sea of clouds, a magnificent black hawk swooped down. The horizon glimmered with twilight, crimson rays illuminating the sky, while the mountains and rivers below gradually darkened, creating a uniquely desolate and beautiful scene.
"Young Master, can you go any faster?"
Xiao Zi lay on the head of the black hawk, asking curiously.
The black hawk immediately flew towards the ground, landing directly beside a large river amidst the mountains. The moment it landed, it transformed back into a human form—a man in white clothing, wearing a bamboo hat and holding a treasured sword, looking like a weary swordsman from the martial world.
Xiao Zi was tossed onto the ground by Fang Wang, who then went to sit by the river to meditate.
Xiao Zi quickly scrambled beside Fang Wang, cooing, "Young Master, where are we going? It's been half a month since we left, and you've been flying everywhere. I'm afraid you'll get obsessed."
While gathering Qi, Fang Wang replied, "Soon, no more than two hundred li away."
It had been half a month since he'd descended from the mountain. To ease the frustration of having been confined for three hundred forty-two years in the Heavenly Palace, he transformed into a black hawk, traveling through the Grand Qi Kingdom, passing dozens of cities, and occasionally even rescuing citizens oppressed by bandits.
Now, he was less than two hundred li from the Spirit Molding Ground recommended by Zhou Xue.
Seeing that he wasn't inclined to talk much, Xiao Zi gave up trying.
Fang Wang began to close his eyes and restore his spirit.
The sun gradually set.
As the sky darkened, the sound of something tearing through the air startled Xiao Zi, causing her to look up.
A middle-aged man dressed in blue brocade flew in on a sword. He had a robust build, carried a large sword on his back, and his handsome face was enhanced with a beard, giving him the charm of a rugged man.
He landed on the riverbank about fifteen meters away from Fang Wang and asked with a smile, "Young man, are you also heading to Sword Heaven Marsh?"
Fang Wang opened his eyes and glanced at him, responding with a question, "You too?"
He hadn't heard of Sword Heaven Marsh, but given the man's high cultivation level and proximity to his landing spot, they were probably headed to the same location.
"Of course. Sword Saint has finally made an appearance. How could I miss it? They say he'll be waiting at Sword Heaven Marsh for the fated one, and I think I might be that person," the middle-aged man laughed, appearing somewhat frivolous and very much like a wanderer.
The man continued, "By the way, have you heard? The Sword Saint's sole disciple, Song Jinyuan, was defeated by Great Abyss Gate's top talent Fang Wang. They say Song Jinyuan gave up sword practice because of it. Tsk, tsk, I wonder what the Sword Saint would think if he knew about this."
"But then again, Fang Wang is truly formidable. Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure! My oh my, legends become reality. Young man, what sect are you from? Why not switch to Great Abyss Gate? The Great Abyss Gate is destined to rise.
My daughter is in the Great Abyss Gate and has a great relationship with Fang Wang."
```

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 71 Only Looking Forward to Fang Wang of the Great Abyss Gate [Seventh Release, Requesting Monthly Pass]
chapters.content:
"Oh? May I inquire as to your daughter's surname and name, and which branch she hails from?"
Fang Wang looked at the middle-aged man and asked with a smile. Although he had been down the mountain for half a month and had seen many sights, his interactions with people had been few and far between, so he was willing to chat with the man.
The middle-aged man sat down on the spot, took out a wine gourd from his storage bag, and while opening it, said with a smile, "I can't tell you that, young man. What brings you to Sword Heaven Marsh?"
Fang Wang didn't hide anything and answered, "I'm going for Spiritual Refinement."
"Spiritual Refinement? Is there a Spirit Molding Ground in Sword Heaven Marsh? I wasn't aware of that. With the Sword Saint being here, perhaps it truly exists. You really are bold, young man, daring to come here before your Spiritual Refinement. You must have encountered many hardships along the way, right?" the middle-aged man said with a sigh.
With the aid of the Breathless Nature Technique, the middle-aged man was unable to see through Fang Wang's aura.
During the ten years of seclusion, Xiao Zi had also learned a certain technique for concealing its presence, which it found inside the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. Previously, it had needed to emit Demonic Qi to drive away other demons, so it had only touched upon the technique superficially and never deeply studied it.
Now that it had mastered the concealment technique, it looked just like an ordinary snake, save for its vibrant color.
"Indeed, it has been difficult," Fang Wang said with feigned lament.
"Meeting is destiny. Even if you've come for Spiritual Refinement, you must be a Sword Cultivator too. My name is Gu Tianxiong, and yours?" the middle-aged man said with a smile.
He felt that even if Fang Wang had not undergone Spiritual Refinement yet, being able to make it this far was no small feat. Perhaps he was a prodigy, and it would be good to make his acquaintance.
Fang Wang responded, "My name is Zhou Yu."
"Zhou Yu? A fine name. If you could refine an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, you would soar to the heavens. Maybe in the future, I'll have to rely on you," Gu Tianxiong said, chuckling.
For some reason, Fang Wang felt like he had heard the name Gu Tianxiong before.
The surname Gu... his daughter and he were on friendly terms...
Could it be related to Gu Li?
It made sense; the Gu Family was a Sword Dao lineage, and it was only natural for them to follow the Sword Saint.
Fang Wang asked, "May I ask how you are related to the Luo Bei Gu Family?"
Upon hearing this, Gu Tianxiong lifted his chin with pride and responded with a laugh, "I didn't expect you to have heard of the Luo Bei Gu Family. Yes, I am indeed from there."
"That explains the imposing aura and spirited appearance."
"Haha, you sure have a way with words, young man."
Fang Wang offered flattery, bringing them closer. Gu Tianxiong was sociable and began to talk about the legends of Sword Heaven Marsh and the Sword Saint.
The origins of Sword Heaven Marsh were a mystery; it lay to the south of Grand Qi, hidden deep within a hundred thousand great mountains. Legend has it that a long time ago, the sky cracked open, the celestial river poured forth, and the ancient Immortal Gods repaired the heavens, leaving behind Sword Heaven Marsh as a remnant of the celestial waters.
From the tops of the surrounding mountains, the lake resembled a sword, hence its name.
The Sword Saint, whose life had already exceeded six hundred years, was recognized as the most powerful Great Cultivator in the Cultivation Realm three hundred years ago. Later, he traveled south across the seas, in search of eternity. He returned thirty years ago.
His return once caused a stir in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. The Nine Great Sects each sent people to woo him, but he chose to dwell in Sword Heaven Marsh, unwilling to leave the mountains. Over time, the Cultivation Realm gradually forgot about the Sword Saint's existence.
"Some say the Sword Saint's time is nearing its end, and he wishes to pass away in Sword Heaven Marsh. That's why I rushed here. Even if I can't obtain his sword, just catching a glimpse of the Sword Saint's grace would be a great blessing in life," Gu Tianxiong said, his face full of longing.
Fang Wang thought of what Zhou Xue had said.
Could it be that if he successfully underwent Spiritual Refinement in Sword Heaven Marsh, he might inherit the legacy of the Sword Saint?
What exactly are the unimaginable benefits?
Fang Wang's interest in Sword Heaven Marsh grew stronger.
The two continued talking until the moon hung high, and Gu Tianxiong, seeming indefatigable, carried on while Fang Wang, having been bottled up for over three hundred years, was equally enthusiastic.
The conversation lasted all night.
It wasn't until daylight broke and the red sunlight illuminated the mountains that Gu Tianxiong sincerely exclaimed, "Zhou Yu, my young brother, you truly can talk! I thought I was the chatterbox, but it turns out I met my match. Alas, I've come to know you too late, you have no idea how much my precious daughter detests my rambling."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang became even more certain that his daughter was indeed Gu Li.
Gu Li, aside from her interactions with Fang Wang, was usually quite aloof; in crowds, she mostly played the listener's role. Thinking back to when she first joined the sect, she had seemed quite spirited. Fang Wang wondered if she had been pretending, or if she had changed over time.
"Let's go, Big Brother Gu, it's time to head to Sword Heaven Marsh."
Fang Wang stood up and smiled, with Xiao Zi slithering into his embrace.
When facing strangers, Xiao Zi would remain silent, so although Gu Tianxiong had noticed it early on, he did not realize it was a Demon King.
The two immediately took to Flying Sword travel, Gu Tianxiong flying slowly as if concerned that Fang Wang might not keep up.
"Zhou Yu, my young brother, since you keep a snake, I wonder if you know how to play with snakes," Gu Tianxiong queried.
"Play with snakes? How so?"
Fang Wang asked in surprise, clearly feeling Xiao Zi stiffen in his embrace.
Gu Tianxiong burst into laughter and said, "Haha, it seems Zhou Yu, my young brother, has focused solely on cultivation. Big brother should remind you that one cannot be austere all the time; you must find some fun. I know an eccentric who is fond of keeping snakes. After seven days of cultivation, he plays with snakes for two days..."
He began talking non-stop. At first, Fang Wang was genuinely interested, but as the conversation progressed, he was at a loss for words.
This old man is so indecent!
He's just too d**n flirty!
Fang Wang felt disdain toward Gu Tianxiong in his heart, but he still humbled himself to ask questions, to avoid damaging the other's pride.
The more Xiao Zi listened, the more violently her snake body shook, though whether it was from anger or fear was unclear.
An hour later.
They finally arrived near Sword Heaven Marsh. Standing on his flying sword, Fang Wang looked out at the tall mountains that rose in two rows with a dense forest in between, shrouded in thick fog. At the end of the forest, there was a vast lake partially hidden by the mountains, with the water that could be seen gleaming blue, like a heavenly immortal realm from the mortal world.
From a distance, Fang Wang was captivated by the beauty of Sword Heaven Marsh and its scenery. Moreover, the spiritual energy here was very rich, but there was also a lot of demonic qi from all directions.
Gu Tianxiong stopped chatting about playing with snakes and instead cautioned Fang Wang not to wander around once they arrived at Sword Heaven Marsh.
Fang Wang couldn't help but smile wryly; they had only been together for one night, but Gu Tianxiong was already treating him like a brother.
The two hastened their pace, and before long, they flew between the two mountains and came to the front of Sword Heaven Marsh. Although the marsh was surrounded by mountains on all sides, it was quite vast. At the very least, it was a thousand feet wide, with an azure lake surface, resembling an ocean, and a faint mist hovered over the water.
Fang Wang noticed some figures standing on the surface of the lake, eyes closed, quietly sensing something.
The two landed on the lakeshore, with Gu Tianxiong looking around with anticipation, clearly searching for the Sword Saint.
Fang Wang also observed his surroundings, and his gaze was drawn to an old man with white hair. The elder wore plain white clothes and stood barefoot on the lake's surface. Below his feet, whirlpools appeared, creating endless ripples in waves.
Just then, a young boy ran over the waves. He looked to be only seven or eight years old, light as a swallow. The boy quickly approached Fang Wang and Gu Tianxiong.
"Why have you come?" the boy asked. His voice was surprisingly strong, like that of a robust middle-aged man, making Fang Wang and Gu Tianxiong's eyelids twitch.
Gu Tianxiong bowed politely, saying, "I am Gu Tianxiong from the Luo Bei Gu Family, here for the Sword Saint's legacy."
The boy nodded and then turned to Fang Wang.
"I've come for spiritual refinement. May I ask if there's a place for that here?" Fang Wang asked.
On hearing this, the boy made a strange expression and said, "You wait here first."
He looked back at Gu Tianxiong and said, "You, come with me."
Without another word, the boy turned and walked over the water, and Gu Tianxiong winked at Fang Wang before promptly following, soaring over the lake's surface on his sword.
After they had gone far, Xiao Zi raised her head, flicking her snake tongue, and said with a pitiful look, "Young Master, please don't listen to him and pull out my teeth."
Fang Wang replied unenthusiastically, "I don't like playing with snakes. What are you thinking about?"
"Really? That's quite..." Xiao Zi grumbled, her words trailing off mid-sentence. However, Fang Wang's mind was not focused on her, so he didn't pursue the matter.
After a good while.
At the far end of the lake, the dense fog parted to reveal a man in yellow clothes, hands behind his back, walking on the waves. A visible sword aura surrounded him, sharp and clear.
Before the man arrived, the sword wind swept up to the lakeshore, causing Fang Wang's white clothes to billow and rustle.
He quickly approached Fang Wang and sized him up before asking, "You have come for spiritual refinement?"
"Indeed, I hope you can guide me. Is this the place for spiritual refinement?" Fang Wang replied with clasped hands. Although the man before him seemed weak, Fang Wang opted to keep a low profile as he was new to the area.
The man in yellow nodded and said, "There really is, but refining your spirit at Sword Heaven Marsh is extremely difficult. Only those with a middle-grade Profound Origin Precious Spirit or higher can succeed here. If you fail, it doesn't mean your aptitude is truly poor, but failure will complicate your next attempt at refinement. Please consider it carefully."
Is there a threshold? Do they look down on lower-grade treasures?
Fang Wang complained internally but smiled and replied outwardly, "I have prepared myself well, I hope you can lead the way."
"Come with me," the man in yellow said as he landed and headed along the lakeshore, with Fang Wang following closely behind.
"Over the years, some have come for the swordsmanship, some for the Sword Saint's sword, but you are the first to come for spiritual refinement. After all, those wishing to refine their spirit would find it safer to join the Nine Great Sects.
Could it be that you've heard the legends of Fang Wang from Great Abyss Gate and thus wish to test whether you can awaken a high-grade Lifespirit Treasure?" the man in yellow asked as he walked ahead.
"I am not part of the Nine Great Sects. I chanced upon the guidance of an expert who mentioned that there is an opportunity for spiritual refinement here," replied Fang Wang.
The man in yellow chuckled without turning around and said, "Indeed, there is an opportunity. If the Lifespirit Treasure you refine here pleases the Sword Saint, he will bestow upon you a great opportunity."
Fang Wang was curious about the man's relationship with the Sword Saint, as he kept mentioning him.
"I, along with those on the lake, are sword cultivators who admire the Sword Saint's renown. Alas, the Sword Saint no longer takes disciples, so we can only serve him as Sword Servants. Being able to serve the Sword Saint as Sword Servants and comprehend the sword dao with him is also a great honor for us sword cultivators," the man in yellow said, with emotion finally coloring his tone.
"But don't hold too high expectations. I've heard the Sword Saint mention that even Earth Origin Spirit Treasures may not catch his eye; what he is really awaiting is for Fang Wang from Great Abyss Gate to come," the man in yellow said wistfully.
"Who knows just how talented that Fang Wang is, to have a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, unimaginable, truly unimaginable!"

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 72: The Third Lifespirit Treasure [Seeking Monthly Votes]
chapters.content:
Sword Saint is expecting me?
Fang Wang was secretly surprised, debating whether to reveal his identity outright, but then he recalled Zhou Xue's words. Zhou Xue had instructed him to hide his name and identity, certainly with good reason.
On the next part of the journey, the man in yellow chattered incessantly. At first, Fang Wang thought the man was intentionally giving him tips, but he later realized he was just venting his complaints.
After the time it takes an incense stick to burn.
Following the man in yellow, Fang Wang arrived at a pavilion by the lake, where the waters were densely covered with lotuses, and mist veiled the scene, giving the impression of a fairyland.
"This lake area possesses a natural Heavenly Dao Spiritual Vein hidden deep underground. The Sword Saint used a Sword Array to draw it to the surface. You can perform your Spiritual Refinement here and stay as long as you like," he said.
Having spoken, the man in yellow turned and left.
Fang Wang bowed to him in salute, then stepped onto the wooden platform by the lake. The platform before the pavilion was simple, with a broken bridge straight ahead, resembling a sword thrust into the lotus-covered waters.
Fang Wang didn't enter the pavilion; instead, he walked onto the wooden bridge to admire the view before him.
Mist enshrouded the scene in murky beauty, unable to conceal the majestic shapes of mountains across the lake. The lotuses fluttered slightly in the breeze, and occasionally, a red fish would leap from the water as if attempting to escape its fate and transform into a dragon.
Xiao Zi wriggled out of Fang Wang's embrace and started to climb towards the pavilion behind him. Fang Wang did not stop it and simply sat down to meditate on the spot.
