He had already sensed with his divine consciousness that there was no one in the pavilion, no rats or insects, and no human presence for miles around. He was far from the Sword Saint's Sword Servants, and the quiet here was undisturbed.
As he enjoyed the scenery of Sword Heaven Marsh, Fang Wang suddenly grew fond of it. With no rules and no strife, it was indeed a fine place for cultivation. Perhaps this was why so many Sword Cultivators were willing to become Sword Servants.
Half an hour later, Fang Wang finally closed his eyes to practice.
To perform Spiritual Refinement, he first needed to sense the Heavenly Dao Spiritual Vein beneath the lake.
With his eyes closed, day turned to night, and days passed as if a fast-forward button had been pressed on the world, the fog rapidly surged on the lake, and the sea of clouds churned fiercely in the sky.
...
In the blink of an eye.
A month flew by.
One afternoon, Xiao Zi was lazing on a lotus leaf in the sun when it suddenly felt something and looked up sharply. It saw nature's spiritual energy converging towards Fang Wang, forming a visible vortex that whirled around him.
"Is he really about to undergo Spiritual Refinement?"
Xiao Zi was internally astonished. It had thought Fang Wang was merely bluffing Gu Tianxiong since Fang Wang already possessed two Lifespirit Treasures.
Unbelievable...
Three Lifespirit Treasures...
Xiao Zi remembered a legend it had heard within the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven, and its eyes glittered with hope.
After a month, Fang Wang had finally sensed the Heavenly Dao Spiritual Vein, and his Treasured Spirit Space began to tremble. He had found the feeling for Spiritual Refinement.
He was about to undergo Spiritual Refinement now!
Strands of Solaris True Fire emerged from his body, circling around him and moving upwards toward his crown, where they coalesced together.
Meanwhile.
Tens of miles away by the lakeside, Gu Tianxiong and several Sword Cultivators followed a young boy down a corridor, among them was none other than Fang Hanyu.
Fang Hanyu wore a blindfold and walked at the back of the group.
Gu Tianxiong was as enthusiastic as ever, engaging in lively conversation with the accompanying Sword Cultivators.
Fang Hanyu, on the other hand, quietly admired the lakeside scenery.
As they rounded a corner of the corridor, a woman's voice carried to them: "Song Brother, it's time to come out and practice your swordsmanship. How long will you wallow in idleness? Though the Sword Saint hasn't said anything, his lack of summoning you speaks volumes of his dissatisfaction."
Gu Tianxiong and the others fell silent, turning to look. Ahead, a woman in plain clothes with her hair tied in a ponytail and two swords at her waist stood with a determined expression. She waited by the door of a house, furrowing her brow.
Upon seeing Gu Tianxiong and his group approaching, she stepped forward to make way.
The boy nodded slightly to her, then brushed past.
The group passed by the house and hadn't gone far when they heard a mocking voice from within: "Practice the sword? What's the use? In the face of Lifespirit Treasure grades, the so-called understanding and heart of the Sword Dao are nothing. Fate has already set the rules for us..."
Song Jinyuan!
The Sword Saint's sole direct disciple!
Hearing his words, the crowd kept silent, continuing on their way.
After walking a hundred steps, one of the Sword Cultivators finally sighed, "Song Jinyuan was once so spirited when he followed the Sword Saint back to Grand Qi, sweeping across peers from the Nine Great Sects with his sword. Now, to have fallen to... alas!"
Another chimed in, "It can't be helped, Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, ah. Lu Yuanjun became famous throughout the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm with just a mid-grade Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, even capable of fighting across realms. Compared to that, you can't imagine the strength of a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure."
The other Sword Cultivators joined in expressing their emotions, and the name Fang Wang had become thunderous among Cultivators over the past two years.
Fang Hanyu followed at the back, accustomed to these tales, especially during the past month; the story of Fang Wang defeating thirteen contemporary elite talents with a single move had spread like wildfire. The storied achievements of those talents had been excavated once more—the more one understood the strength and legend of those talents, the more incredible Fang Wang's feat seemed.
Moreover, the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art had also become known. A decade ago, the Ji Hao Sect's secret realm emerged, and various sects fought bloodily over the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art and the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, and in the end, they could only excavate the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven together.
Unexpectedly, the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art had already been obtained, and by none other than the exceptional talent with the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure. Some said openly that this Divine Skill was choosing its own successor.
Though cultivators defy the heavens for the pursuit of longevity, the longer they practice, the more they believe in fate.
"What is predestined must eventually come to pass; what's not meant to be should not be forced."
Fang Hanyu, upon hearing the legends about Fang Wang, didn't feel pride but was filled with an endless fighting spirit. He was determined to catch up to Fang Wang and fight alongside him.
Gu Tianxiong began boasting again about how close his daughter was with Fang Wang; of course, the other sword cultivators didn't believe it at all.
After walking a while longer, the boy finally stopped in front of a room door, turned around, and bowed respectfully to it.
"Sword Saint, these people have passed the first round of trials."
The boy whispered. All of Sword Heaven Marsh's sword servants directly addressed Sword Saint by his title, reportedly at his own instruction.
Clang——
The door suddenly opened, and a gust of wind howled out, causing the boy's robe to violently flap backward, startling the sword cultivators into bowing their respects.
As Gu Tianxiong bowed, he raised his eyes and saw a figure in white stepping out from the room, surrounded by numerous tiny shadows of swords. Every step left afterimages, as if his soul was separating from his body, entrancing Gu Tianxiong.
Sword Saint!
His white hair was coiled beneath a white jade crown, his complexion rosy and full of vitality, with eyes brilliantly alive as if two tiny figures were fencing within his pupils, their sword light overflowing.
"Take them to the Sword Nurturing Pond for the baptism."
The Sword Saint said this and then turned into a gust of wind, disappearing into the thick mist above the lake in the blink of an eye. The sword cultivators turned their heads only to see the lingering afterimages of the Sword Saint on the lake's surface, which were created by his sword qi.
"Is this the Sword Saint? I wonder what realm he's reached," Fang Hanyu thought to himself in astonishment.
Even within Great Abyss Gate, he'd never met such an exalted figure.
Not even Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian, in his opinion, could necessarily compare to the Sword Saint.
"Follow me, everyone."
The boy spoke, then continued walking forward. The sword cultivators silently regretted that they couldn't meet the Sword Saint face to face just yet.
...
On the wooden bridge over the lake, Fang Wang was sitting in meditation, his body levitating, as he was afraid of setting the wooden bridge on fire, so he allowed himself to float.
Having mastered the Combat Heart, he could turn his body into a magic artifact and then use the Sword Control Technique to take to the air. Such a method was quite easy for him.
Rolling Solaris True Fire converged above his head, forming a fireball, with waves of heat intermittently spreading out, shaking the pavilions and dispersing the mist over the lake.
Xiao Zi was intently watching Fang Wang, its eyes filled with anticipation.
It didn't notice that at the far end of the lake behind it, someone was approaching through the heavy mist—a figure was slowly emerging, and it was the Sword Saint.
The Sword Saint walked on the waves, his sword qi now dissipated, his whole being merging with nature, virtually invisible. His gaze was fixed on Fang Wang, his white brows furrowed.
"This fire... I feel like I've seen it somewhere before..."
The Sword Saint thought to himself. After pondering for a few moments, his pupils suddenly dilated.
"Could it be Solaris True Fire? No, with his cultivation, how could he possibly have been to such a forbidden place..."
The Sword Saint's eyes remained intently on Fang Wang, watching the Lifespirit Treasure above Fang Wang's head, his eyes revealing a look of expectation.
At that moment, Fang Wang's consciousness was within the Treasured Spirit Space, assessing it.
The third Lifespirit Treasure was taking shape!
As for the third Lifespirit Treasure, Fang Wang had already had an idea. He didn't want to create another long or short weapon. He wanted a support-type Lifespirit Treasure.
Ideally, it would be a Lifespirit Treasure with sealing power. Fang Wang kept leaning toward the idea of a seal in his designs.
But to his disappointment, he failed. Perhaps because his understanding of sealing arts was not deep enough—creating Lifespirit Treasures relies on imagination, but it must be based on one's own insights. One cannot create powers that have never been encountered, and the Soul-Binding Curse was not purely a sealing art.
Since it was temporarily impossible to create a sealing-type treasure, he had to choose another type.
He had no choice but to bring forward his idea for the fourth Lifespirit Treasure.
He wanted to create a folding fan!
A fan with terrifying wind force, akin to the Banana Leaf Fan from "Journey to the West"—of course, creating an actual Banana Leaf Fan was impossible for him now.
This wind was not just for physical objects in the world but also for souls. He wanted this folding fan to have the power to annihilate ghosts and capture souls!
The reason for this was to prepare for Lu Yuanjun, and also for Green Cicada Valley—to disperse poison fog with the fan as if it were nothing.
The Solaris True Fire already had the ability to suppress souls, so his idea was achievable.
Gradually, the fireball above his head began to change, slowly condensing into a folding fan.
Nature's spiritual energy madly rushed towards his head, forming fierce winds that blew from all directions with immense force.
Thunderclouds rolled in from the horizon towards Sword Heaven Marsh, plunging the area into darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 73: Qiankun Fan, Sword Saint's Legacy [Seeking Monthly Votes]
chapters.content:
Watching the Lifespirit Treasure gradually taking shape above Fang Wang's head, Sword Saint's eyes flashed with disappointment.
It's not a sword, what a pity!
But then the Sword Saint thought of his own impending death, and his gaze dimmed again, as he no longer had any other choices.
He stood on the surface of the lake, quietly watching Fang Wang.
As the Lifespirit Treasure became more solid, its aura grew stronger, attracting clouds to gather overhead, rapidly transforming into thunderclouds, with the sound of thunder rolling in the distance.
Afar, the sword cultivators on the surface of the lake who were comprehending the Sword Dao all looked up, confusion appearing on their faces.
Xiao Zi looked up and saw the changing weather, a worried expression in its snake eyes, afraid that the commotion would cause trouble.
Just then, it felt an unimaginable pressure coming from behind, Xiao Zi turned its head and its snake eyes widened in shock.
Sword Saint raised his right hand, and behind the thick mist, shadows of swords rose up, filling the entire lake area with countless sword shadows, forming a Sword Array that emanated Sword Qi, creating a Sword Qi barrier that sealed off the area.
"Don't worry, I'm safeguarding him," said Sword Saint.
Upon hearing Sword Saint's voice, Xiao Zi heaved a sigh of relief.
Wait a minute!
Was he speaking to me?
Xiao Zi tensed up with fear, feeling even more wary of Sword Saint.
Fang Wang heard what Sword Saint said, and his heart settled too. If the other party had malicious intent, there was no need to wait any longer.
At the same time, the far-off sword servants and sword cultivators saw the towering Sword Array and suddenly realized it was Sword Saint's doing.
Sword Heaven Marsh was vast, but when Sword Saint's Sword Array rose, it seemed like a giant mountain of Sword Qi, no smaller than the surrounding peaks, with an even more magnificent aura.
Such Sword Qi was enough to immerse every sword cultivator who witnessed the scene.
With Sword Saint safeguarding him, Fang Wang's subsequent Spiritual Refinement process naturally went smoothly.
Over time, the folding fan above his head gradually solidified, a black fan with flame patterns etched on its leaves, capable of storing Solaris True Fire, designed to target Ghost Instruments.
Heaven's spiritual energy surged tumultuously, with lightning flashing above, not falling, as if the heavens were expressing their dissatisfaction.
Sword Saint looked at Fang Wang's treasure spirit and uttered two words: "Earth Origin!"
Being an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure himself, he was well aware of the characteristics of this tier, but he noticed that the treasure spirit was still absorbing heaven and earth's spiritual energy, meaning its quality had not yet reached the limit of its refinement.
This didn't surprise Sword Saint much; he had set up the array so that only a treasure spirit surpassing Mysterious Origin could be successfully refined. Fang Wang's ability to cause such celestial changes proved he was no ordinary Earth Origin. Sword Saint had laid this trap; even for his own sword servants, he had deliberately lowered the standard, afraid to scare away the fated ones.
A sense of anticipation rose in Sword Saint's heart.
He hoped that this individual could refine a treasure spirit that surpassed Earth Origin.
Just like Fang Wang of the Great Abyss Gate!
Just thinking about Fang Wang made Sword Saint sigh with regret; such a genius had already joined the Great Abyss Gate, and they would certainly not let him go.
With a sect, there are entanglements, which did not fit his criteria for choosing a successor.
Suddenly!
Sword Saint's expression changed slightly; he felt his treasure spirit tremble, which sparked a gleam of excitement in his eyes.
Could it be...
Fang Wang immersed himself fully in Spiritual Refinement, forgetting all about the outside world.
Time passed unknowingly.
Suddenly, Fang Wang opened his eyes wide, stood up, and the Solaris True Fire on top of his head dispersed, sending waves of heat sweeping in all directions, shaking the Sword Array.
He stood up, reached towards the top of his head, grasped the handle of a fan, and a black folding fan with flame patterns appeared in his hand.
He looked intently and saw Sword Saint's Sword Array; with a thought, he waved the black folding fan towards the distant Sword Qi barrier.
Boom——
With a single wave of his hand, the surface of the lake exploded, creating a terrifying gale mingled with surging spray, sending waves nearly thirty feet high crashing into the Sword Qi barrier, causing the entire Sword Array to tremble.
Sword Saint raised an eyebrow, his gaze sharpened, and he pointed his two fingers towards the lake. In an instant, the originally shaking Sword Array became as stable as Mount Tai, eventually dissipating the waves.
Fang Wang let out a sigh, lamenting the missed opportunity.
He turned to Sword Saint and bowed, saying, "Junior Zhou Yu thanks the senior Sword Saint for safeguarding the formation. I was just too excited and couldn't help but try my strength. I hope senior will forgive me."
If he had managed to break the Sword Array with one strike, that would have been fine; the other party would not dare to complain.
Having failed, he could only be polite.
Of course, he indeed had no intention of offense; he merely wanted to test the strength of his third Lifespirit Treasure.
"It's fine, I am honored to witness the birth of a Heaven Yuan, and it's my fortune that this land will see the rise of two Heaven Yuans in the same era. It seems that person did not deceive me; this place can indeed fulfill my wish.
It's just a pity that your treasure spirit is not a sword; otherwise, I would have liked to pass on all my inheritance to you," said Sword Saint, stroking his beard in reflection. Fang Wang, hearing this, grew even more curious about what Sword Saint wanted to give him.
He wanted to bring out the Rainbow Sword, but he couldn't act rashly; what if Sword Saint wanted to seize his body?
Honestly, he wasn't particularly interested in Sword Saint's inheritance; the supreme arts he used for battle were plenty, and he didn't want to spend another few hundred years stifled in the Heavenly Palace.
With a flash of inspiration, Fang Wang spoke up: "Senior, thanks to you, I could refine this treasure. Why don't you do me the honor of naming it?"
Sword Saint hesitated on hearing this, but thinking of his limited time left, he smiled and pondered, "Its power is like fire, its movement like thunder; with a wave it changes Heaven and Earth. Why not call it the Qiankun Fan?"
Qiankun Fan?
Fang Wang thought the name was appropriate and quickly thanked Sword Saint.
```
Sword Saint flicked his sleeves, dispelling the Sword Array. The curtain of Sword Qi shattered, and the dense sword energies dispersed like a thick fog, a spectacle of extreme grandeur.
Then, Sword Saint walked towards Fang Wang.
Xiao Zi immediately rushed to Fang Wang's side, climbed up his leg, and burrowed into his embrace.
Sword Saint landed on the wooden bridge and walked past Fang Wang, leaving behind a sentence, "Continue your cultivation, in a year, I have something to give you."
Fang Wang watched him as he walked into the loft at the back and then closed the door.
A year?
He wouldn't be playing tricks, would he?
Considering the power of the Sword Array just now, Fang Wang knew he was no match for Sword Saint; if Sword Saint wanted to harm him, why would he wait a year?
Even if there was a special reason to wait a year, wouldn't it be prudent to suppress him directly just in case?
After much thought, Fang Wang decided to wait for a year and use this place for his cultivation.
The scenery here was quite nice, very conducive to cultivation.
Fang Wang turned around, toying with the Qiankun Fan in his hand, growing fonder of it the more he looked at it.
A solitary shadow on the cold river, dressed in white, a black fan in hand, approaching with the wind, the lotuses beneath the bridge tossed about, exuding a disheveled beauty, this scene, like a beautiful painting.
...
After the Qiankun Fan was crafted, Fang Wang's strength greatly increased. He did not wander around but instead sat on the wooden bridge to meditate and cultivate.
The Profound Heart Realm was not enough!
He had to reach the Condensation Spirit Realm as soon as possible, first to have the confidence to face all crises in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, and second to obtain the inheritance of Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
Indeed, he was still yearning for the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
In the blink of an eye.
Half a year had passed.
It took him a full six months to break through to the second level of the Profound Heart Realm. He felt it was too slow, but considering that many spent their whole lives stuck at the first level, he came to terms with it.
After breaking through, he continued to sit at the head of the bridge to cultivate, his eyes open, looking towards the lake.
In this half-year, he kept cultivating while Sword Saint had entered the loft behind and had not come out again. Unable to sense the aura inside the loft, he could not tell if Sword Saint was still there and didn't want to disturb him rashly.
In recent days, Fang Wang had taken a keen interest in the changes over the lake surface. He always felt that Sword Saint had a special purpose for his cultivation here. The mist over the lake changed daily, and sometimes when it surged, he thought he could vaguely see a figure practicing swordsmanship.
But whenever he focused on that thought, the figure in the fog was no longer visible upon looking again.
"Why are you here?"
A familiar voice came, and Fang Wang glanced over to see Fang Hanyu riding his sword towards him, a look of surprise on his face.
Fang Wang secretly sighed in relief; fortunately, the boy hadn't called out his real name.
This was Fang Hanyu, perceptive and meticulous. As soon as he saw Fang Wang, he knew he was using an assumed name. After all, there was much talk about Fang Wang in Sword Heaven Marsh, especially with Song Jinyuan still in a state of decline.
Fang Wang beckoned to him, and he immediately flew over, alighting beside Fang Wang.
"I'm cultivating here, what about you?" Fang Wang asked with a smile.
Fang Hanyu replied, "I came for Sword Saint's inheritance, but alas, it's been more than half a year, and I've only seen the elder once. Why don't you give it a try? You must succeed. In terms of talent for the Sword Dao, I think no one can compare with you."
Jinghong Divine Sword Art, with its thirty-six techniques ― who in this world could reach such mastery?
Clang!
A noise came from behind, followed by a gust of wind. Fang Wang and his companion turned their heads to look, and there stood Sword Saint behind them.
Sword Saint's piercing gaze was fixed on Fang Wang as he asked, "Zhou Yu, are you also a sword cultivator?"
Zhou Yu?
Wasn't that a name from the romance of the Three Kingdoms?
Fang Hanyu was secretly astounded. Since childhood, Fang Wang had liked to tell him stories about the Three Kingdoms. As he grew up, he realized there were no actual Three Kingdoms; the romantic Shu Han and the heroic Wei he knew were clearly inventions of Fang Wang's.
What surprised him wasn't that Fang Wang had changed his name, but why choose a name from the Wu faction, which Fang Wang disliked? Why not the name of his beloved Zhuge Liang?
That's right, in the future, I can also use names from the Three Kingdoms to traverse the martial world and create secret codes with Fang Wang.
Faced with Sword Saint's intense scrutiny, Fang Wang fought to keep his composure and said, "Hmm, I dabble a bit, but I'm not a pure sword cultivator."
Sword Saint squinted his eyes and said, "Show me your strongest sword technique. If it pleases me, I will bestow my inheritance upon you too."
Fang Wang frowned.
If he were to use the Jinghong Divine Sword Art or the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, his identity could be easily revealed.
A Tai Yuan Sect disciple who had crafted a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure...
"If you perform well, not only will I give my inheritance to you, but to him as well," Sword Saint spoke again, casting a glance towards Fang Hanyu.
Fang Hanyu did not react with excitement but fell silent.
He was unsure of what Fang Wang was hesitating over, but he feared causing trouble for Fang Wang.
Prior to landing, he had scanned the loft with his spiritual sense and detected no presence...
This meant that the man before them was Sword Saint!
Apart from Sword Saint, who else could be so unfathomable?
But... why was Fang Wang resistant to receiving Sword Saint's inheritance?
```

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 74 Great Perfection of Celestial Sword Intent [Third Release, Requesting Monthly Votes]
chapters.content:
"Alright, since the senior has said so, this junior can only show his modest ability."
Fang Wang clasped his hands and spoke, not for himself, but for Fang Hanyu, he had to brace himself and step forward.
At worst, he could just endure for a few hundred years!
Upon hearing this, the Sword Saint revealed a smile, and Fang Hanyu, also feeling that Fang Wang was doing this for his sake, could only grip his sword hilt tightly.
Fang Wang stood up, facing the lake, while Xiao Zi emerged from beneath the lake, poking her head out and looking toward him.
Fang Wang's gaze condensed, and a sword qi suddenly shot out at an extremely fast speed, piercing through the fog at the far end of the lake; soon afterward, a huge rumbling sound came from a distant mountain.
So fast!
Fang Hanyu was moved, his Absolute Heart Evil Eye barely keeping up with that sword qi just now.
The key question was, how was this sword qi released?
He did not even see spiritual power flowing out from Fang Wang's body; could it be that the sword qi truly shot out from Fang Wang's eyes?
The Sword Saint squinted his eyes and uttered four words: "Divine Nurturing Sword Qi!"
Fang Wang blinked, and his eyes returned to normal, no longer as sharp and cold. He turned back to the Sword Saint and asked, "This is the sword technique I'm most confident in, does it satisfy you?"
"What is your relationship with the Luo Bei Gu Family?"
"I have a good friend from the Gu Family who saw some potential in me, so he passed this sword technique to me."
Fang Wang answered truthfully. His Divine Nurturing Sword Qi had reached Great Perfection, cultivated for ten years, and its power was already comparable to what most members of the Gu Family had cultivated for several decades, or even close to a hundred years.
The Sword Saint chuckled, turned around, and said, "Both of you, follow me."
Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu exchanged glances and immediately followed.
Xiao Zi quickly leaped out of the water and landed on Fang Wang's shoulder.
They walked into the pavilion, and with a wave of the Sword Saint's sleeve, the door closed automatically.
In the hall, the Sword Saint sat on a cushion and gestured for Fang Wang and the other to sit in front of him.
"I started learning the sword at the age of six from a master on the mountain and traveled the world at the age of seventeen. By the age of twenty, I roamed the world unrivaled, but when I was twenty-one, I met a sword cultivator and was thoroughly defeated by him. Only then did I understand what true Sword Dao is: the Sword Dao of the mortal world possesses form but lacks intent."
The Sword Saint slowly began, his gaze becoming distant as he spoke of his past.
These words resonated deeply with Fang Wang.
He, too, thought he was unrivaled at the age of sixteen, and before he could make a name for himself, a cultivator descended from the heavens, nearly leading him to his downfall.
If it had not been for Zhou Xue, an Immortal Venerable reincarnate, he would probably be close to fourteen years old by now.
"After that, I started pursuing the Path of Immortality. Fortunately, fate did not forsake me and allowed me to create an Earth Origin Precious Spirit. I wandered the Cultivation World for three hundred years. Then I traveled south to the overseas regions in search of a higher destiny.
Only then did I realize that there are mountains beyond mountains, and heavens beyond skies," said the Sword Saint with a sigh.
His gaze returned to Fang Wang and the other, "The path of cultivation is long, and Sword Dao is just one of the Three Thousand Great Daos. Too many people pursue pure Sword Dao because their hearts are filled only with competition and rivalry. The true Sword Dao should treat all things as the sword.
When I was five hundred years old, I forgot all the swordsmanship I had mastered in my life and created a Sword Dao that truly belonged to me."
"Celestial Sword Intent, with the intent of all things between heaven and earth as the Sword Intent."
"Now, you can make a choice, one of you will inherit the Celestial Sword Intent, and the other will inherit my lifetime's condensation of Sword Qi. I will solidify this Sword Qi into your Lifespirit Treasure, allowing you to become a Cultivator with multiple Lifespirit Treasures, and the grade will surpass my Lower Grade Earth Origin Precious Spirit."
The Sword Saint spoke in a calm tone, as if he was discussing a trivial matter.
Fang Hanyu couldn't help but ask, "Is it possible to pass all of it to him? I don't want the inheritance."
The Sword Saint glanced at him and asked, "Why?"
"It would be unworthy of me; my comprehension of the Sword Dao is nowhere near his, by what not tens of thousands of miles, and I don't want to divide his chance," Fang Hanyu said earnestly.
Fang Wang couldn't help but say, "You're being offered to choose, do you think you have the right to refuse? Don't take yourself too seriously. If the Sword Saint is willing to pass it to you, you should just be happy. You don't have the luxury of choice in this matter!"
After speaking, he looked towards the Sword Saint and said, "I'll choose the Celestial Sword Intent."
He already had three Lifespirit Treasures and didn't need another, especially since he strongly suspected the Heavenly Palace would prevent the formation of a foreign Lifespirit Treasure. He still remembered the process of the Heavenly Palace Halberd's birth vividly.
Moreover, since Fang Hanyu only possessed a Mysterious Origin Treasure Spirit, if he could obtain a stronger Lifespirit Treasure, it would be a fate-changing fortune against the heavens.
In this life, Fang Wang had few friends. Aside from Gu Li, he was only close to his family. Naturally, he would help if he could.
"But..." Fang Hanyu became anxious.
"Enough. The Celestial Sword Intent and Sword Qi Treasure Spirit cannot coexist; your physical bodies cannot bear both at the same time. One must choose, and my time is running short; I cannot wait much longer," the Sword Saint interrupted their argument and spoke calmly, but his eyes were filled with satisfaction.
Fang Wang couldn't help but ask, "Do you trust us so much?"
The Sword Saint replied, "I can see through the sword heart from which the Sword Qi originates. Your sword heart is pure, free of much greed and distraction, and while his Sword Qi is extremely lethal, he is willing to consider your well-being, proving his loyalty and sense of righteousness. I have waited thirty years and can wait no longer.
Perhaps you are not the ideal inheritors, but I have no other choice."
"My unworthy disciple has scattered his sword heart and is not fit to inherit my Celestial Sword Intent. With such a fragile will, perceiving the grade of a Treasure Spirit as fate, he would likely become arrogant and oppress others if he were to receive a higher grade Treasure Spirit."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang felt somewhat ashamed.
If he had not emerged so unexpectedly, could Song Jinyuan have received the Sword Saint's inheritance?
But what was done was done, and he couldn't be overly sentimental about it.
"Let's begin."
Suddenly, the Sword Saint raised his hand, pointing his right index finger towards Fang Wang. Fang Wang's eyes instantly stilled, and in them flashed the shadows of people practicing swordsmanship.
At this moment, Fang Wang thought of the mysterious shadow practicing swordplay he had seen over the lake all this time, which turned out to be the Celestial Sword Intent.
It seemed that the Sword Saint had long intended to teach him the Celestial Sword Intent, and what happened before was just a test?
Fang Wang's mind briefly entertained the thought, but he soon became immersed in the Sword Saint's legacy.
A multitude of sword moves flooded his vision, and they were branded into his mind, impossible to forget—this feeling was very strange.
It was passive, it was uncomfortable, yet there was an inexplicable thrill.
Not much time had passed.
The Sword Saint stopped, and with a look of nervous anticipation, he looked at the dazed Fang Wang and asked, "How do you feel?"
Fang Hanyu also grew tense, facing Fang Wang.
Fang Wang's gaze gradually became clear, and he seemed to have aged ten years, exuding an air of twilight; he sighed, "Not bad..."
Dammit!
Fang Wang had underestimated the Celestial Sword Intent; it had taken him four hundred and six years, second only to the True Combat Technique.
"From now on, you don't need to learn other sword techniques; focusing solely on my Sword Dao will suffice. With your Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure talent, it should take about ten years to master, fifty years to harness the will of all things in heaven and earth, and a hundred years to surpass me," said the Sword Saint with a chuckling stroke of his beard.
Fang Wang nodded calmly.
"Alright, you can go out now. Next, I must transmit the Sword Qi to him, which will take a month. During this month, do not disturb me," the Sword Saint instructed.
Fang Wang took a deep breath, stood up, then patted Fang Hanyu on the shoulder and walked out of the loft.
Having received the Celestial Sword Intent, he could now trust the Sword Saint!
The door shut behind him, and Fang Wang headed towards the wooden bridge, with Xiao Zi poking its head out from his embrace. It felt that Fang Wang had that sensation of being possessed again, but since this had happened before, it didn't ask.
The Sword Saint looked at Fang Hanyu and said, "In fact, I can feel your sincere devotion to the sword. Zhou Yu cannot compare to you. In terms of the Sword Dao, you might one day..."
Meanwhile, outside the loft.
Fang Wang reached the end of the wooden bridge and slowly spread his arms wide, letting out a roar:
"Ah—"
His voice echoed over Sword Heaven Marsh, traveling far and resonating continuously.
Ten miles away, Gu Tianxiong, who was sitting on the lake surface contemplating the sword, opened his eyes and cursed, "Where did that brat come from, wailing like a ghost!"
It wasn't just him; many sword cultivators were frowning.
Inside the loft.
The Sword Saint's expression changed dramatically; he seemed to sense something, his eyes full of shock and horror.
Fang Hanyu hastily said, "Predecessor, please continue speaking; don't mind him. He has always been eccentric ever since he was little."
The Sword Saint took a deep breath and said, "In the future, you should never compare yourself with him. Focus on your own Sword Dao—that is the right path!"
Fang Hanyu's eyes were covered by a cloth strip, but his expression still looked somewhat confused.
He really wanted to ask, "Did you actually mean what you said before?"
...
"No, I need to take a walk!"
Fang Wang dropped his arms and spoke sternly; although letting out a roar had felt quite relieving, he really didn't feel like cultivating right now.
Xiao Zi followed with, "Master seems very upset. Would you like to play with me?"
Fang Wang pulled it out of his embrace and threw it into the lake, then turned and left.
He walked down from the wooden platform, continuing along the lakeside.
He remembered meeting someone before coming to Sword Heaven Marsh, what was the name again?
He couldn't recall, but after giving it some thought, he figured that the person would definitely recognize him. He had a good impression of that person, who seemed to be someone interesting.
"Master, wait for me!"
Xiao Zi paddled swiftly across the lake surface.
...
At the Great Abyss Gate, within the first lineage, inside a cave dwelling.
Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen sat opposite each other at a stone table, with Zhao Zhen pouring tea for Lu Yuanjun before speaking, "That kid has been gone for more than half a year. Have you found out where he is?"
Lu Yuanjun responded, "I have checked the direction of his disciple token by using the sect's central network of magical artifacts. He's in the south, quite far away, probably in those hundred thousand mountains. Exactly where, I can't say."
Zhao Zhen took a deep breath and said, "During this time, I have been courting the Fang Family Disciples and have established a good relationship."
Lu Yuanjun looked at him with a mockingly bemused expression and asked, "What now? You're not afraid of him finding out anymore?"
"With the emergence of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, the sect will surely protect him at all costs. Neither you nor I can compare with him, so why struggle with him? When Grand Qi becomes a Cultivation Dynasty, I will leave Grand Qi and seek my own path to immortality. I will never return," said Zhao Zhen calmly.
At these words, Lu Yuanjun burst into laughter, but his laughter soon turned dark as he said coldly, "Leave? Where do you think you can go? If I were to kill you, he would have no way to trace it back to me, right?"
Zhao Zhen remained unflustered, replying coolly, "I'm just a living witness. With that ghost instrument of yours having absorbed so many souls, once it emerges, he will undoubtedly realize the truth. When that happens, you still won't escape your fate. Killing me is pointless. Leaving the Great Abyss Gate, leaving Grand Qi, that is the best way out for both of us.
The world is vast; where can we not go?"

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 75 The Great Demon King Attacks [Fourth Release, Seeking Monthly Passes]
chapters.content:
"Leave? Yang Yuanzi, that old codger, said the same thing to me! Why should I leave?"
Lu Yuanjun said in a deep voice, his eyes filled with unstoppable murderous intent at the mention of Yang Yuanzi.
Zhao Zhen sighed and said, "You see, even our own sect stands with Fang Wang, we can only hide. It's frustrating, but there's nothing we can do. It's all the consequence of our choices. At least you've cultivated a Ghost Instrument, and I've at least set foot on the path to immortality. What does it matter if we retreat now?"
"Having been an emperor for so many years, I understand one thing well, when your power is not as strong as another's, you can only endure in silence, even step back. It's only important who laughs last."
Speaking of this matter, his heart was indeed filled with mixed feelings.
He had speculated that Fang Wang was the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, but he hadn't expected it to be true. Moreover, Fang Wang had displayed a strength that could sweep through the Profound Heart Realm, meaning Fang Wang had already realized his potential, and Lu Yuanjun could no longer scheme against him.
Additionally, he felt a hint of relief that, despite Fang Wang being so powerful, he had not killed him. Could this indicate Fang Wang really was unaware?
If that was the case, why should he provoke Fang Wang?
"No! Absolutely not! Why should I give in? Is the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure definitely stronger than me? I have a supreme treasure, it's not impossible for me to take him down! If I devour his soul, his talents will be nothing but tools for my use!"
Lu Yuanjun roared lowly, hysterical in his tone. He no longer had the usual gentle and sunny image; his face was full of resentment, hate, and greed.
Zhao Zhen frowned, sensing something was wrong with him.
Suddenly, Lu Yuanjun looked at him and sneered, "If not for your scheming, how would I have been exposed prematurely? Now that the Great Abyss Gate won't accept me, since that's the case, you will join me in overturning the Great Abyss Gate!"
Zhao Zhen stood up and said in a deep voice, "Have you lost your mind? The world is at peace now, the Nine Great Sects have ceased hostilities and reached an agreement, how can you alone overturn the Great Abyss Gate?"
Streams of black Ghost Qi began to emanate from Lu Yuanjun's body, and a terrifying figure formed behind him. He smiled menacingly and said, "You think you know me well? I called you here today to end your overreaching life. You're nothing but a dog that has earned my pity, daring to scheme against me, even advising me to flee? Ridiculous!"
Zhao Zhen's face changed dramatically, and he turned to flee, but as soon as he did, he found himself unable to move. Strands of Ghost Qi like tentacles had wrapped around his limbs and waist, immobilizing him.
"A dog named emperor, do you know why my supreme treasure needs to absorb souls? I'll have you watch as I overthrow the Great Abyss Gate and slay Fang Wang. I will make sure you have no hope of redemption, as you watch my pursuit of eternal life!"
Lu Yuanjun's voice rang in Zhao Zhen's ears, and he widened his eyes, now feeling Lu Yuanjun's breath on him.
He glanced and saw, to his despair, that Lu Yuanjun was standing right behind him.
...
At noon, the weather was cool.
Fang Wang sat on a large rock by the lakeside, fishing, and called out boredly, "Brother Gu, stop practicing and come chat for a bit!"
Hearing this, Gu Tianxiong's forehead bulged with veins as he stood on the surface of the lake, his eyes closed, and he yelled irritably, "God dammit, finish your Spiritual Refinement and scram, don't distract me from practicing my sword!"
This situation had been going on for a month, and Gu Tianxiong greatly regretted having greeted Fang Wang a month ago; he should have just let the kid wander aimlessly.
Fang Wang yawned and said, "There's always time to practice the sword, but one can't cultivate all the time. We need to find some fun. A friend of mine said this, though I've forgotten who it was."
Gu Tianxiong clenched his fists tightly, cursing the kid in his mind for teasing him.
Little did Gu Tianxiong know, Fang Wang truly had forgotten.
As Fang Wang fished, he reflected inwardly.
He was not sure who had spoken such profound truth, but it was right; he had cultivated arduously for four hundred years in the Heavenly Palace, nearly driving himself mad. Over the past month without any cultivation, just traveling around Sword Heaven Marsh, his state of mind had improved significantly.
Two words described it: exhilarating!
However, this state wouldn't last too long; in three days, he'd have to resume his cultivation.
Cultivation is the foundation of a cultivator. It's possible to relax from time to time, but one must never give up cultivation.
Just then, a gust of wind blew from the east, dispersing the thick mist over the lake. Startled, sword cultivators turned to look to see a group of cultivators flying from the horizon. They weren't riding Flying Swords but flying directly through the air. They were dressed in exquisite clothes, revealing an extraordinary aura; clearly, they were not ordinary people.
Eighteen people in all, men and women alike, four of them carrying a palanquin, which piqued curiosity about the identity of the person inside.
"Tsk tsk, a group in the Spirit Elixir Realm carrying a palanquin for someone. Whose disciple must this be to carry such prestige?"
Fang Wang thought to himself. Xiao Zi suddenly burst out of the lake, diving into his arms, then poked out her head and whispered, "Master, there's Demonic Qi, very fearsome Demonic Qi. It's very likely a Great Demon King."
Great Demon King?
An existence comparable to the Condensation Spirit Realm?
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes, staring at the palanquin.
The group quickly flew to the opposite side of the lake, where the four gently set down the palanquin. With his extraordinary vision, Fang Wang saw a man in black garments with an eerie demeanor step out from it.
The eerie man seemed to sense Fang Wang's gaze and looked back in his direction. Fang Wang immediately retracted his gaze, not wanting trouble.
Gu Tianxiong approached Fang Wang, muttering, "Kid, be careful, stay away from that one across the lake. Something feels off."
Fang Wang replied, "Indeed it's off, but you're the one who needs to be careful. Don't always be so hotheaded."
During this month alone, Gu Tianxiong had argued with other sword cultivators numerous times, often stepping in for others.
With many sword cultivators seeking the Sword Saint's legacy, the crowd grew. Conflicts arose, and Gu Tianxiong, unable to stand those who bullied others with their cultivation level, often stepped forward.
Fang Wang suspected that the annihilation of the Gu Family was related to Gu Tianxiong causing trouble.
Now counting the years, it had been just under six years since the Gu Family was destroyed.
Zhou Xue didn't specify an exact time.
Gu Tianxiong snorted and followed up, "I suspect they are from the Demon Race. There are many demons to the south of Grand Qi, especially those from overseas, which are countless. Often, Demon Kings transform to come ashore seeking immortal fate. Since the Sword Saint has returned from abroad, it might be the same for those demons."
Fang Wang noticed the strange-looking man leading his eighteen followers along the lake shore.
He wasn't worried that these demons would trouble the Sword Saint.
That day, when he had used the Qiankun Fan to shake the Sword Array of the Sword Saint, he knew how terrifying the Sword Saint was. He was definitely not someone that the strange-looking man could compare with.
Although the strange-looking man did give Fang Wang a sense of danger, he was far from being frightening enough to be considered on par with the Sword Saint.
Thus, Fang Wang chatted idly with Gu Tianxiong from time to time.
The other Sword Cultivators on the lake were also discussing the group of mysterious visitors.
By evening of that day, the group of mysterious visitors returned to the lakeshore opposite Fang Wang. They sat down to meditate and cultivate, not interacting with the other Sword Cultivators.
Three days later.
Fang Wang returned to the wooden bridge where he had been during the Spiritual Refinement period to cultivate. The attic's main door was still closed, and he could sense Fang Hanyu's aura; the inheritance process was still ongoing.
Once he started cultivating, time began to speed up for Fang Wang.
Days passed by.
And like that, another month went by.
"Come in,"
The voice of the Sword Saint entered Fang Wang's ears, and what surprised him was that the Sword Saint used the Sound Transmission Technique, and his voice sounded extremely weary.
He immediately got up and went inside. Xiao Zi had been staying in his arms, frightened of the strange-looking man suspected to be the Great Demon King.
As he entered the great hall of the attic, Fang Wang casually closed the door behind him.
He saw Fang Hanyu lying flat on the ground, showing a pained expression, with mysterious energies fluctuating around him.
"Don't worry, he has successfully inherited my Sword Qi and is currently undergoing Spiritual Refinement. It should take at most two more days for him to succeed,"
The Sword Saint said softly while meditating. At that moment, he looked much older; even his back was bent, and his body had thinned considerably.
Fang Wang took a step forward, asking with concern, "Senior, are you all right?"
The Sword Saint lifted his gaze toward him and said somberly, "The departure of the Sword Qi and Sword Intent from my body has also drained my vitality. I have at most seven days left to live."
At these words, Fang Wang's expression changed, and he frowned, asking, "Senior, is there any way to prolong your life?"
"Prolong life? Hehe... My time has come, and no medicine can save me. Your concern is enough for me. What I'm about to give you is the real reason I set up the Spiritual Refinement trap here."
The Sword Saint said this while tremblingly lifting his right hand. A piece of red jade flew out from his sleeve, heading towards Fang Wang.
Fang Wang instinctively caught the jade and saw three characters inscribed on it.
Sword Sovereign of the Yellow Glyph!
Holding the jade, he could feel the strong Spiritual Power and prohibitions contained within, which made him extra cautious.
"I've finally found a successor. With this order, you will be the Sword Sovereign of the Yellow Glyph. Once you surpass the Condensation Spirit Realm, you can take this order and head overseas. It will guide you to your destination, where you can find immortal fate not available in Grand Qi. I was not talented enough and found this immortal fate too late, but you are different..."
The Sword Saint spoke weakly and suddenly burst into laughter, "Hahaha, Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure... Chan'er, in the end, I win... My successor will surely be stronger than you, perhaps even aiming for the position of one of the twenty-four true immortals..."
He couldn't help coughing due to laughing too hard.
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang felt he had gotten himself into something serious.
Was this the surprise Zhou Xue mentioned?
Immortal fate overseas?
And he has to surpass the Condensation Spirit Realm before he can go there?
After the Sword Saint stopped coughing, Fang Wang then asked, "Senior, what exactly is the origin of this order?"
"Senior? You may call me Master," the Sword Saint said softly, looking at Fang Wang with expectant eyes.
Seeing this, Fang Wang kneeled halfway and said with a fist in palm, "Master, thank you for granting the inheritance to both of us!"
The Sword Saint showed a smile, saying, "Good! Very good! I, the Sword Saint, finally have a successor!"
"Good disciple, don't ask anymore about this matter. Once you surpass the Condensation Spirit Realm and probe into this order with your divine sense, you will know everything. However, there is trouble now. A Great Demon King has come from overseas in pursuit, and he is after this Yellow Glyph Sword Sovereign Order,"
The Sword Saint's smile faded, and his face turned serious.
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and asked, "Is that Great Demon King your arch-enemy?"
The Sword Saint took a deep breath and said, "I know your cultivation is not low, and it must be above the Spiritual Refinement Realm, which means you possess a dual-life spirit treasure, but you must not be his enemy. The Great Demon King is comparable to the Condensation Spirit Realm and is definitely not someone you can provoke now. Once Yu Han wakes up, you should take him and leave."
Yu Han, the alias of Fang Hanyu.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 76: As Sword Intent Emerges, Heaven and Earth Fall Silent
chapters.content:
"Equivalent to which level of the Condensation Spirit Realm?" Fang Wang asked, his tone carrying a hint of expectation.
He had been holding back for too long and wanted to let loose!
It just so happened that the person before him was his new master's nemesis; there would be no injustice in killing him!
The Sword Saint furrowed his brow and said, "Roughly equivalent to the fourth or fifth level of the Condensation Spirit Realm, disciple. Do not act rashly. Although you have already grasped the Celestial Sword Intent, it is precisely because your talent and comprehension are so inconceivable that you need to be even more careful in your actions.
As long as you stay alive, the heights you will reach in the future are far beyond what you can currently imagine."
By the end, due to being too agitated, he couldn't help but start coughing again.
Fang Wang could only relent, saying, "Alright, Master, I'll listen to you, please don't worry."
At this moment, the Sword Saint was already at the end of his tether, so it was not good for Fang Wang to go against his wishes.
"The Great Demon King has been deterred by me and won't dare to make a strong move in the short term. After two days, you come back in, take Yu Han, and leave... I want to rest now."
After finishing his words, the Sword Saint slowly closed his eyes. His hunched back made his whole person seem to curl up, showing a sense of vicissitude and desolation.
Fang Wang put the Sword Monarch Order into his storage bag, then bowed to the Sword Saint and turned to leave.
After he left the pavilion, he closed the door behind him.
Just as he stepped down the stairs, he suddenly saw a figure standing on the lake surface—it was that eerily beautiful man, clad in black clothes that fluttered with the lake breeze, with his long hair billowing similarly. Even in broad daylight, he appeared frightfully terrifying.
The eerily beautiful man stared at Fang Wang expressionlessly.
Fang Wang was not afraid at all, striding forward to the bridgehead where he sat down, facing the eerily beautiful man.
Fang Wang took out the Qiankun Fan and gently waved it, appreciating the scenery of the lake surface without cultivating.
Xiao Zi, sensing Fang Wang's attitude, wriggled out from his embrace and coiled around his shoulder, with its snakehead pointed towards the eerily beautiful man, continuously flicking its tongue.
Seeing Fang Wang so confident, the eerily beautiful man furrowed his brow.
After watching for a while, the eerily beautiful man silently retreated backwards, disappearing into the dense fog.
"Young Master, you are really powerful now, even the Great Demon King can be scared away," Xiao Zi said in an admiring tone.
Fang Wang replied calmly, "He's not afraid of me, but of my master."
The time spent cultivating Celestial Sword Intent proved how powerful the Sword Saint's Sword Dao was. Second only to the True Combat Technique, it showed that, in terms of Sword Dao alone, the Sword Saint was comparable to the Great Saint's mastery of the Dao.
Of course, Fang Wang didn't understand the Great Saint, but such a comparison was enough to make him revere the Sword Saint.
The Sword Saint was definitely the strongest individual he had encountered in this world.
Within the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm ruled by the Nine Great Sects, there still existed many powerful cultivators, and the world beyond the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm was even more vast and boundless. Thinking of this, Fang Wang's heart surged with excitement.
If one could stand at the pinnacle of the Mortal Realm, what kind of splendor would be seen?
As Fang Wang pondered, he also felt the Sword Intent of Sword Heaven Marsh.
Since achieving Great Perfection with the Celestial Sword Intent, his world had utterly transformed. All things had their own will, and even the Spiritual Energy from the surrounding objects, like the rocks by the lake, served this Celestial Sword Intent for his use.
Xiao Zi lay on his shoulder, vaguely sensing something and following Fang Wang's lead, it too settled into deep concentration.
...
Two days passed quickly.
Approaching noon.
Fang Wang suddenly felt something and stood up, turning to look towards the pavilion behind him.
Xiao Zi, perched on his shoulder, also opened its eyes, muttering, "Such strong Sword Qi..."
Fang Wang's smile grew, knowing that with the Sword Saint's Sword Qi, Fang Hanyu had obtained not only a higher grade Lifespirit Treasure but his cultivation would inevitably surge dramatically, a true rebirth.
Even the Sword Qi currently revealed, although nowhere near the Sword Saint's, felt sufficient to deal with cultivators at the lower levels of the Profound Heart Realm.
Fang Wang felt reassured; with Fang Hanyu growing stronger, the Fang Family would be even more secure. He himself was busy with cultivation, and Zhou Xue had her own matters to attend to, so it was always good to have someone to protect the Fang Family.
Boom!
The Sword Qi inside the pavilion burst forth suddenly, blowing open the eaves, as a figure soared into the sky, with a pillar of Sword Qi reaching straight to the heavens.
Fang Wang focused his gaze and saw within the pillar of Sword Qi the suspended silhouette of Fang Hanyu. Hovering a hundred zhang in the air, a sword floated above his head, an ordinary-looking sword, simple in design. Yet, it was this very sword that emitted the awe-inspiring Sword Qi that moved heaven and earth.
Surrounding mountains trembled as the lake surface erupted in tidal waves, a testament to the terror of the Sword Saint's Sword Qi.
Fang Hanyu's face was unbandaged, revealing his eyes, blue with blood pupils, wide open like a demon possessed, and emitting an indescribable aura of murder.
Fang Wang slightly raised an eyebrow; the torture Fang Hanyu had endured in Green Cicada Valley seemed to have a profound impact on him that had not yet dissipated, and that murderous nature had become imprinted in his bones.
Simultaneously, waves of powerful auras approached from all directions. The eerily beautiful man and his subordinates arrived first, followed by the Sword Saint's Sword Servants, and even Gu Tianxiong came walking on water.
Now, there were no fewer than five or six hundred Sword Cultivators at Sword Heaven Marsh, the least of whom was in the Spiritual Refinement Realm, and there were twenty to thirty in the Profound Heart Realm, all renowned cultivators.
More and more cultivators arrived, all of them looking up at Fang Hanyu with various expressions, making no rash moves.
"Who is that?"
"Such powerful Sword Qi, what kind of Lifespirit Treasure is that?"
"Wait, isn't that the Sword Saint's Sword Qi?"
"Why does he possess the Sword Saint's Sword Qi?"
"Could it be that he has received the Sword Saint's legacy? I remember him; he participated in the legacy trials before..."
The cultivators buzzed with speculation, and when someone guessed that Fang Hanyu had received the Sword Saint's legacy, they instantly became agitated, some with malevolent intentions in their gazes towards Fang Hanyu.
At that moment, Fang Hanyu hovered midair, his eyes open but clearly not fully conscious yet. Spiritual energy from nature funneled towards him, concentrating between him and the sword.
Gu Tianxiong approached Fang Wang and, out of curiosity, asked, "Brother, what happened?"
Fang Wang was about to answer when a cry of alarm sounded, its tone clearly grinding.
"Fang Wang!"
The name Fang Wang seemed to possess a certain magic, drawing all the cultivators to instinctively look towards the speaker, only to see Song Jinyuan standing by the lake, grinding his teeth in frustration as he stared at Fang Wang.
Following Song Jinyuan's gaze, everyone turned to look at Fang Wang again.
Gu Tianxiong frowned and bellowed, "I'm not Fang Wang, you hear me!"
No sooner had he finished speaking when something seemed to dawn on him, and he suddenly turned his head to look at Fang Wang, his eyes widening in realization.
Fang Wang let out a sigh. It seemed he could no longer keep his identity hidden.
If he couldn't keep it hidden, so be it!
A true man should act with integrity. He used to be too weak, but now there was nothing he feared!
Fang Wang nodded towards Song Jinyuan, a gesture of courtesy, before turning his gaze back to Fang Hanyu in the sky.
Fang Hanyu could be seen slowly raising his right hand to grasp the hilt of the sword above his head.
"That might be the divine sword of the Sword Saint; we can't let him get his hands on it!" someone exclaimed, drawing everyone's attention back to Fang Hanyu.
Immediately, some cultivators soared upwards, their swords propelling them toward Fang Hanyu.
With one taking the lead, even more cultivators rushed forward. At a glance, there were at least fifty of them.
Boom!
An overbearing and unparalleled aura suddenly burst forth, shattering the wooden bridge beneath Fang Wang's feet. Gu Tianxiong was so startled that he staggered and almost fell into the lake.
The cultivators who were advancing all stopped in their tracks, their faces filled with horror and disbelief as they looked at the swords in their hands and under their feet.
Then, they all turned to look at Fang Wang, even the demon-like man on the surface of the lake frowned as he looked towards Fang Wang.
Surrounding Fang Wang was a terrifying sword intent that caused the very space to tremble. His sword intent enveloped the Sword Heaven Marsh in an instant. Although no sword qi was visible, everyone felt as if it surrounded them on all sides, threatening to reduce them to dust with the slightest movement, a chilling sensation that set their hair on end.
"Celestial Sword Intent!" the demon-like man stated, enunciating each word.
Fang Wang's gaze never wavered from Fang Hanyu. He slowly said, "No one act rashly. He is my brother. Whoever dares to harm him will die."
Under the enhancement of the all-encompassing sword intent, his voice echoed above Sword Heaven Marsh, unceasingly reverberating and startling everyone.
What kind of sword intent was this?
Aside from the demon-like man, including the Sword Servants, no one had truly experienced the Sword Saint's sword intent, so they were all filled with fear.
One man's sword intent subdued hundreds of sword cultivators!
With the display of sword intent, the world fell silent!
In the attic.
The Sword Saint slowly looked up, his cloudy eyes expressing a smile as he murmured, "Great Completion of Celestial Sword Intent... No, he has surpassed me... Dual Destiny Heavenly Origin... such unimaginable comprehension in the Sword Dao, truly a person of destiny... This is indeed my greatest fortune..."
His voice trailed off intermittently, and finally, his head dropped suddenly, his arms naturally falling to his sides.
...
Gu Tianxiong looked at Fang Wang, dazed, as though he was in a dream.
His little brother Zhou Yu was the famed Fang Wang?
The genius that his daughter often mentioned in her letters?
Feeling his gaze, Fang Wang turned to look at him, and with a slight smile said, "Do not panic, Brother Gu. If you hold still, I won't kill you."
Despite the absence of any killing intent and a voice that was already very gentle, it still made Gu Tianxiong's skin crawl with fear.
"Hehe, who would have thought the Sword Saint would have a disciple," said the demon-like man, his tone ice-cold.
He walked towards Fang Wang, his black demonic qi spreading and tumultuously churning as if resisting Fang Wang's Celestial Sword Intent.
As his Demonic Qi erupted, most of the sword cultivators were visibly affected.
Such a terrifying Demonic Qi!
That guy must be a demon!
Song Jinyuan paid no attention to the demon-like man; his gaze was fixed dully on Fang Wang.
At that moment, his mind went blank.
Fang Wang's figure began to merge with the image of his master in his eyes.
"Why... How could he learn it..." Song Jinyuan thought desperately; he couldn't even feel jealous because the gap between them was too vast.
Fang Wang turned around to face the demon-like man approaching from across the lake. Behind the demon-like man, those eighteen individuals also emitted Demonic Qi, their faces transforming into monstrous and frightful visages.
Strange Demonic Qi, like a swift black fog, spread over the entire lake, dispersing the mist formed by the Spiritual Energy.
Fang Wang held the Qiankun Fan in his right hand, waving it slightly, displaying the demeanor of Zhou Yu with his feather fan and silk scarf. Facing the Great Demon King, he was entirely unfazed, his eyes even revealing a look of anticipation.
"Master, destroy him!" Xiao Zi couldn't help but cry out from Fang Wang's shoulder, her timid voice stirring Gu Tianxiong awake from his stupor, as he looked at her in astonishment.
So this was a female demon!
Thinking back on what he had said to Fang Wang, Gu Tianxiong's face turned beet red.

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 77: Celestial Sword Intent Slays the Demon King, Fame Spreads Across the World Begins
chapters.content:
Fang Wang ignored Xiao Zi, and didn't care why Gu Tianxiong was blushing; his eyes were fixed only on the strange man.
At this moment, he was thinking about one thing.
How to kill the Great Demon King?
Since this place was Sword Heaven Marsh, and everyone around was an admirer of the Sword Saint, why not use the legacy of the Sword Saint to execute the Great Demon King!
With that thought, Fang Wang's eyes became fierce. He stepped forward into the void, and all eyes were on him and the strange man. Some wanted to take this opportunity to sneak attack Fang Hanyu, but the omnipresent Celestial Sword Intent made them too afraid to act rashly.
All they could hope for now was that the strange man could restrain Fang Wang.
What they didn't realize was that with Fang Wang's display of Celestial Sword Intent, in their eyes, he was no longer simply a genius but had become a peerless powerhouse.
The strange man's eyes sharpened, his flesh disintegrated into a demonic mist that burst outwards. The surging demonic mist churned violently, bringing fierce winds and sweeping towards Fang Wang, lifting waves on the lake surface that reached ten meters high, with a formidable momentum.
Gu Tianxiong stood behind Fang Wang, his legs trembling slightly atop his Flying Sword.
He could directly feel the overwhelming pressure of the Great Demon King. As a cultivator of the Profound Heart Realm, he had never fought against someone from the Condensation Spirit Realm, let alone faced the Great Demon King. How could he not be nervous?
However, when his gaze fell upon Fang Wang's figure ahead of him, his heart instantly calmed down.
Faced with the terrifying waves stirred up by the Great Demon King, Fang Wang's mouth curled into a smile. He held the Qiankun Fan in his right hand and waved it forward.
Just as the Sword Saint had said, its momentum was like fire, its movement was like thunder, a single wave stirred Qiankun!
With a wave of the Qiankun Fan, a terrifying sea of fire erupted, even larger than the waves caused by the strange man.
Boom—
The two powerful forces collided, turning into a steamy mist that scattered.
The next second, the strange man suddenly burst out of the mist. His right hand rose from his side, a bone sword appearing out of nowhere, and he aimed a slashing blow at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang revealed a contemptuous smile. He shifted his right foot to the side, and in an instant, everything seemed to freeze. The ripples on the lake stopped, the wind and waves moved sluggishly, and the expressions of hundreds of cultivators were frozen as well.
Only the strange man kept moving forward!
But his pupils suddenly contracted, and the speed of his sword swing dramatically slowed down.
Reflected in his eyes was the image of Fang Wang, standing amidst the roaring fires, smiling with a superiority that seemed to look down upon a mere insect that could be crushed at a moment's notice.
When time stood still, multiple sword shadows condensed. On the lake, in the sky, on the mountain walls, on the towers, and even around Fang Hanyu, sword shadows appeared. His Absolute Heart Evil Eye underwent a change, coming to life, and in that moment, his consciousness awakened.
What did he see?
So many swords!
Sword Qi?
No!
This was Sword Intent!
Fang Hanyu, floating in the air, looked down and saw Fang Wang standing at the edge of the lake. In front of him was a billowing demonic mist obscuring half the lake, and a figure was rushing towards Fang Wang from beyond the mist.
Such terrifying Demonic Qi!
Just one glance, and Fang Hanyu, who had inherited the Sword Saint's Sword Qi, knew he was no match for this demon.
But he wasn't worried for Fang Wang. Unconsciously, Fang Wang had become the most trustworthy person in his heart.
Sword Intents filled the heavens and earth, densely packed, thousands upon thousands, suspended everywhere, what a spectacular sight!
Almost at the same time, all Sword Intents manifested as sword shadows pointed towards the strange man.
The strange man was still advancing, his dreadful Demonic Qi still spreading, but his speed seemed excruciatingly slow in front of Fang Wang.
Fang Wang's right hand suddenly drew back the Qiankun Fan with a snap, and the thousands of Celestial Sword Intents moved simultaneously like swift thunder, striking at the strange man.
Hundreds of cultivators were brushed by the Celestial Sword Intents, or it flew over their heads, all feeling a peaceful yet incredibly strong Sword Intent.
That was the Sword Saint's Celestial Sword Intent, harmony between heaven and man, the Dao follows nature!
Boom!
The myriads of Sword Intents struck the strange man, the lake surface exploded, waves reached dozens of meters high, and the terrifying Sword Qi caused a huge surge, sweeping all around.
Time returned to normal!
Fang Wang didn't have the ability to stop time; it was merely an illusion created by using the Celestial Sword Intent to suppress Sword Heaven Marsh.
However, the Great Demon King wasn't so easy to kill!
The huge waves scattered, and the bloodied strange man leaped over Fang Wang's head, moving so fast it was almost like teleportation. He raised the bone sword high and furiously brought it down.
Everything happened too quickly, even Xiao Zi's serpent eyes couldn't widen in time.
Puchi!
A Sword Qi shot out fiercely from Fang Wang's eyes, piercing through the strange man's brow. His body was thrown backward, his expression filled with terror.
Divine Nurturing Sword Qi!
A glint of cold light flashed through Fang Wang's eyes, his killing intent unceased.
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi turned around and struck again at the strange man.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh…
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi was as fast as lightning, piercing back and forth through the strange man, blood sprayed wildly, and his body shook violently in the air, utterly defenseless.
In less than a breath's time, the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi halted, and the perforated body of the strange man fell into the lake, blood blossoms blooming on the surface, as the dark-red blood spread across the lake.
"Is that..."
Gu Tianxiong's eyes widened, his face flushed red once again, this time from excitement.
If he wasn't mistaken, that was the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi from their Gu Family!
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi had been a gift he had asked Gu Li to present to Fang Wang, but he hadn't expected that Fang Wang would have trained the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi to such an extent, perhaps even surpassing his own father.
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi returned to Fang Wang's eyes as he glanced towards the minions of the bizarre man in the distance; those monsters had been scared out of their wits. Feeling his gaze, they all turned and fled.
Clang——
The Qingjun Sword at Fang Wang's waist suddenly unsheathed, slashing towards those eighteen monsters.
Great Perfection of the Sword Control Technique!
Xiao Zi, perched on his shoulder, followed suit, darting out like a sharp arrow, so fast that even Gu Tianxiong's eyes could not keep up.
So fast!
This snake is stronger than me!
Fang Wang turned and raised an eyebrow towards Fang Hanyu in the sky, tossing a glance that meant, am I awesome or what?
Fang Hanyu understood and shook his head to signal that he was fine.
A question mark appeared on Fang Wang's forehead.
Isn't this strength?
The Celestial Sword Intent then dispersed, and Sword Heaven Marsh was left with only the sound of splashing water. All cultivators gazed at Fang Wang with their mouths agape, unable to regain their senses for a long while.
The boy who had led the way for Fang Wang and the man in yellow were even more scared in hindsight, pondering whether their attitudes back then had been arrogant and if they might have offended Fang Wang.
Fang Wang said to Gu Tianxiong, "Big Brother Gu, watch over the monster corpses for me. I'm going to go inside for a moment."
Having said that, he walked towards the attic.
Gu Tianxiong came back to his senses, turned his head towards Fang Wang, and hesitated to speak.
He had so many questions.
Meanwhile, Fang Hanyu descended from the sky, with the treasured spirit on his head melding into his body and disappearing from sight.
He landed in front of Fang Wang, and once again, Fang Wang gave him a look, signaling him to follow; luckily, he understood this time.
The two brothers entered the attic, and when Fang Hanyu saw the Sword Saint with his head bowed, his expression changed.
Fang Wang walked up to the Sword Saint, gathered his robes, knelt down, and kowtowed three times, while Fang Hanyu hastily did the same.
"Master, although we haven't been together for long, I will carry on your Celestial Sword Intent and ensure that the Cultivation World does not forget your name."
Fang Wang said softly, feeling regret in his heart that he never saw his master's true strength.
Fang Hanyu didn't speak, but from the look of him grinding his teeth, it was clear he was filled with guilt; he suddenly felt as though the formidable power he now possessed was owed.
Afterward, Fang Wang stood up and had Fang Hanyu hoist the Sword Saint's body.
Fang Hanyu immediately complied, but as soon as he touched the Sword Saint, the latter's right hand suddenly grasped his, and the ring on the thumb shifted onto Fang Hanyu's right thumb. After that, the Sword Saint's hand fell back.
Fang Hanyu was startled and had to check the Sword Saint again, thinking he might still be alive.
...
Night fell.
By the lake of Sword Heaven Marsh, firelight flickered.
Hundreds of sword cultivators were gathered, with Song Jinyuan, Fang Wang, and Fang Hanyu at the front, watching the Sword Saint's body being cremated.
Fang Wang couldn't help but ask, "Do we really have to burn him? Keeping the body and soul might allow for resurrection in the future."
Song Jinyuan shook his head and said, "These were our master's wishes. He was more afraid of becoming a calamity after death than of being resurrected. My master lived a life of integrity, never committed any wrongdoing, and never troubled others. He did not want to cause catastrophe to the Mortal Realm after death."
Fang Wang was silent.
The other cultivators, although regretful, were also saddened by the Sword Saint's passing. After all, most of the people who managed to come here had heard of the legends about the Sword Saint, and upon arriving, were protected by the Sword Saint as they cultivated, earning their respect.
That night, Fang Wang and the two others kept vigil for the Sword Saint.
As the day broke the next morning, cultivators began to leave, while some wished to stay.
Song Jinyuan looked at Fang Wang with a clenched jaw and said, "From now on, Sword Heaven Marsh is yours. I am not worthy to be his disciple, and I will leave on my own."
After saying that, he turned around to leave, but was stopped by Fang Wang grabbing his shoulder; he looked at Fang Wang in surprise.
"Senior brother, now that we're from the same sect, why act like a stranger? Master would definitely want you to buck up. You should continue to manage Sword Heaven Marsh, and I will cultivate here for a few years. We can exchange insights on the Sword Dao," Fang Wang said earnestly.
Song Jinyuan gave a bitter smile and said, "What qualifications do I have to exchange insights with you?"
Fang Wang sighed and said with a tone of frustration, "Senior brother, you really lack perspective!"
Scolded by Fang Wang, Song Jinyuan's anger soared.
"Don't compare yourself with me; who in this world can compare with me? You've picked the wrong target. Besides, I aim to be the supreme, and you strive for second place. Isn't that embarrassing?" Fang Wang said with heartfelt advice.
Song Jinyuan fell silent, his face twitching slightly.
Fang Hanyu nodded and added, "That's right. Before he passed, master said the same to me: don't compare yourself with him. Think about it, have you ever failed before meeting him?"
Fang Wang smiled, tossed out a sentence, and then turned to leave, "Senior brother, I'll pass on the Celestial Sword Intent to you later. You'll miss your chance if you run away."
Hearing this, Song Jinyuan's face lit up with anticipation; he had longed to learn the Celestial Sword Intent, but the Sword Saint had felt he wasn't worthy.
Fang Wang approached Gu Tianxiong.
Standing by the lake, Gu Tianxiong watched him approach and couldn't help but smile, "Having inherited the Sword Saint's legacy and cutting down the Great Demon King, Fang Wang, your reputation will resonate even louder. From now on, you're not just the number one genius of Grand Qi; you're one of the strongest cultivators in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm!"
Hundreds of cultivators watched, as there was no hiding this event, and Fang Wang had no desire to hide it either.
Who wouldn't want to achieve a reputation that resounds throughout the world?

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 78: What Gu Tianxiong Thinks, Tianyuan Sword Saint [Third Update, Requesting Monthly Pass]
chapters.content:
Looking at Fang Wang in front of him, Gu Tianxiong had too many emotions stirring in his heart. Even after a day and a night had passed, the shock in his heart had not yet dissipated.
The first time he saw the name Fang Wang was in a letter sent to him by his daughter Gu Li.
In the letter, Gu Li claimed to have been defeated by a young man named Fang Wang—he was only at the seventh level of the Qi Cultivation Realm, yet he had defeated her with a single sword strike.
At that time, Gu Tianxiong was angry. He had high hopes for Gu Li and did not want his precious daughter to lose confidence after just joining the Great Abyss Gate, so he encouraged her in his reply to challenge Fang Wang again after her Spiritual Refinement.
The second letter arrived at the Gu Residence quickly. Gu Tianxiong was silent for a long time after reading it; his daughter had lost again.
Once could be chance, but losing twice was enough to suggest a disparity in talent: his daughter possessed an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure, yet she had lost twice to a younger boy, leading him to take Fang Wang seriously for the first time and even look forward to meeting him.
In the days that followed, every letter Gu Li sent home contained the name Fang Wang.
Gu Tianxiong finally decided to invest in Fang Wang, instructing Gu Li to pass on the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi to him.
The Divine Nurturing Sword Qi was a proprietary exceptional technique of the Gu Family, stronger in those with more talent. Gu Tianxiong was confident that Fang Wang would continue to use the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi even after becoming powerful; hence, as Fang Wang traveled the world, he would be spreading the renown of the Gu Family.
As he had anticipated, yesterday when Fang Wang executed the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi to slay the Great Demon King, the spectacle amazed him deeply.
Eyes emitting Sword Qi!
What incredible attainment!
Gu Tianxiong recalled his feelings upon learning that Fang Wang's Lifespirit Treasure was actually a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure. At the time, he had already left the Gu Residence and upon hearing the news, his first reaction was disbelief—it could only be a top-tier Earth Origin Spirit Treasure at most.
Until later…
Fang Wang powerfully defeated thirteen of the contemporary first-rate talents!
And thus, the existence of a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure was confirmed!
In that moment, Gu Tianxiong shared the same sentiment as his daughter; the Fang Wang standing before him showed no display of aura, yet seemed to shine with boundless radiance.
He felt as if he was witnessing the legendary figures from ancient myths alive before his eyes.
One day, Fang Wang would surely become the most powerful cultivator in Grand Qi, and his fame would not stop at Grand Qi!
Gu Tianxiong watched Fang Wang with fervent eyes and couldn't help but say, "Fang Wang, how about I betroth my daughter to you?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang quickly responded, "How could that be possible!"
"Impossible!"
The voice of Fang Hanyu echoed as he quickly stepped in front of Fang Wang, staring intensely at Gu Tianxiong with his terrifying Absolute Heart Evil Eye.
Gu Tianxiong felt unnerved by his gaze but still asked irritably, "Why not? My daughter is breathtakingly beautiful, and her Lifespirit Treasure is of Earth Origin grade. Looking across Grand Qi, apart from her, there's not a second woman worthy of Fang Wang!"
Fang Hanyu's face was cold as he said, "Fang Wang is already betrothed!"
"What?"
Fang Wang and Gu Tianxiong exclaimed in unison, the brothers exchanging glances before turning to look at Fang Hanyu again.
"His fiancée is Zhou Xue, who is also among the top five talents of the Great Abyss Gate, and moreover, she was brought up by our Fang Family," Fang Hanyu stated seriously.
Fang Wang looked confused as Fang Hanyu swiftly pulled him away.
Gu Tianxiong became anxious. He couldn't follow them, so he could only shout, "Fang Wang, if not as the main wife, a concubine would also do. My daughter is very beautiful; don't you know?"
Indeed, Fang Wang felt his heart stir upon hearing this, yet Fang Hanyu kept dragging him away.
"Even if you don't fancy her, where there's no business, there's still righteousness. Don't repeat any of this nonsense to my daughter, alright!"
Hearing Gu Tianxiong's words, Fang Wang was at a loss for words.
No wonder he was so enthusiastic!
