So it was to keep his own secrets hidden!
Fang Wang followed Fang Hanyu into the loft where the Sword Saint had passed away, while Xiao Zi was not with him, still by the lake devouring the blood and flesh of the Great Demon King. It was a Demon King itself, and no other cultivator could do anything against it, especially with Fang Wang's standing on its side.
Fang Hanyu looked at Fang Wang and said in a low voice, "This is what grandfather and the uncles intended, and the fourth uncle agreed too. Zhou Xue has indeed helped the Fang Family a great deal, but after all, she is a woman. If she were to marry someone else, how would the Fang Residence then interact with her?"
Fang Wang frowned and said, "That's not appropriate; matters of the heart should be consensual. We can't make decisions for Zhou Xue."
Even if he wanted to, he didn't have the capability!
"Of course, we would not impose, but if you took the initiative, it might be feasible. Zhou Xue clearly cares about you the most; you two are also the closest, and furthermore, the more exceptional a woman is, the more she yearns for a heroic figure.
With your Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure talent, to be honest, in all this world, apart from you, I cannot imagine another man she would have room for in her eyes," Fang Hanyu stated solemnly.
Indeed, in this world, there might be none...
But the heavens might be another story...
Fang Wang inwardly scoffed, and as a vigorous young man, how could he not be moved, but he knew what he wanted.
He and Zhou Xue would not halt their progression for love, and as for Gu Li, the daughter of the leader of the Gu Family, how could she accompany him to wander the ends of the earth?
Even if she was willing, Fang Wang worried he wouldn't be able to protect her.
"We'll see in the future," said Fang Wang, waving his hand dismissively, then turning and walking out of the loft.
Fang Hanyu watched Fang Wang's departing figure with a slight sigh.
He wasn't sighing for Fang Wang, but for Zhou Xue.
In his eyes, Fang Wang shone brighter than Zhou Xue, and he had noticed Zhou Xue's affection toward Fang Wang as well, so he assumed that Fang Wang was not fond of Zhou Xue.
No, this won't do!
To repay the kindness Zhou Xue had shown him, he must protect Fang Wang on her behalf and ensure that Fang Wang wouldn't be tempted by other women.
All of a sudden, Fang Hanyu felt a heavy sense of responsibility.
He liked this feeling of silent dedication.
...
As time passed like the cycles of the moon and sun, a month had swiftly gone by since the Sword Saint's passing, and the secluded Sword Heaven Marsh had become even more tranquil.
By the lakeside, on a wooden bridge, Fang Wang sat with Xiao Zi lying on his shoulder, while Song Jinyuan paced back and forth in front of them.
"Who was Pang Changqing? He wielded the Soul Devouring Blade, notorious and fearsome. Seeing that my master wouldn't fight, he grew impatient, flew into a rage, drew his blade, and slashed at us. Yet, my master didn't even furrow his brow. With the Celestial Sword Intent, he summoned waves as high as mountains, which almost blotted out the sky. Pang Changqing was scared stiff!"
Song Jinyuan dramatically recounted the story, his eyes bulging by the end, which kept Xiao Zi exclaiming in astonishment.
Fang Wang, too, listened with keen interest.
He had known the Sword Saint for too brief a period, with hardly any interaction, thus he was very interested in Song Jinyuan's tales.
Over the past month, every six days of cultivation, Fang Wang would seek out Song Jinyuan to learn more about the Sword Saint's experiences overseas.
Song Jinyuan also hailed from overseas, an orphan whom the Sword Saint had picked up. Although he claimed to be the Sword Saint's sole disciple, he had never truly earned the Sword Saint's approval. That's why after his defeat by Fang Wang, he was deeply struck, knowing that he would never again receive his master's legacy.
"Alright, that's enough for today. Fang Wang, it's time you taught me the Celestial Sword Intent," Song Jinyuan said, halting and speaking earnestly.
Fang Wang patted the ground next to him, signaling Song Jinyuan to sit down, and Song Jinyuan immediately sat in meditation beside him.
"Look at the mist over the lake. Feel it carefully, no matter what you see, don't speak, just experience in silence," Fang Wang advised, his gaze towards the lake, unhurried in his speech.
Sword Heaven Marsh was filled with a powerful Celestial Sword Intent, which was why the Sword Saint had encouraged sword cultivators to meditate by the lake. However, they had not found the perfect spot, and this was it.
Hearing this, Song Jinyuan was skeptical.
Xiao Zi too turned its attention to the heavy mist over the lake. Recently, it had grown quite interested in the way of the sword.
It's worth mentioning that the Great Demon King and his eighteen demon followers were all dead, all consumed by Xiao Zi. This creature had a really big appetite, eating so much yet not getting fatter, but its Demonic Qi was indeed growing stronger.
Gu Tianxiong expressed his amazement; it's true that demonic beasts sometimes consume each other, but it's quite difficult to assimilate the other's demonic power into one's own, usually only bolstering vitality at most.
Yet Xiao Zi had already grown powerful enough to defeat Gu Tianxiong, a cultivator of the Profound Heart Realm.
In fact, it was Gu Tianxiong who had initiated the challenge against Xiao Zi, and had been thoroughly defeated. His Five Saints Sword Technique was nothing but a scrape to Xiao Zi, peeling off a few snake scales without causing any real harm.
In Fang Wang's view, though Gu Tianxiong's Five Saints Sword Technique had impressive momentum and was quite intimidating, it was far less effective than the Jinghong Divine Sword Art, let alone comparable to the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation or the Celestial Sword Intent.
The true pride of the Gu Family was the Divine Nurturing Sword Qi, but unfortunately, it required time to cultivate.
Distractedly looking at the lake, Fang Wang's eyes suddenly fixed on something.
Across the lake, a figure in red was faintly visible through the dense mist.
Fang Wang instantly got up, leapt gracefully like a gliding goose, arousing Song Jinyuan's curiosity, as well as Xiao Zi's.
"Damn it, that bad woman is here!"
Xiao Zi cursed under its breath, its voice filled with resentment.
Fang Wang swiftly flew across to the other side of the lake and landed before the figure in red. He smiled and asked, "What brings you here?"
Zhou Xue looked up. Beneath her bamboo hat, she revealed her delicate yet stern face. With a smile that captivated the heart, she replied in a soft laugh, "I heard you vanquished the Great Demon King with such grandeur. Since I was passing by, I felt compelled to see the renowned Fang Wang for myself."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang feigned a frown and asked, "Really? Word spreads that fast?"
But he couldn't quite suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth.
"Of course. Having inherited the Sword Saint's legacy and bearing the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, you are already being called the Heaven Yuan Sword Saint," Zhou Xue said with a laugh, her eyes roaming over Fang Wang, the amusement in them growing deeper.
She gently pushed Fang Wang's shoulder and asked, "Did you get the Sword Monarch Order?"
Fang Wang nodded and said, "I did. What exactly is the origin of this item?"
Zhou Xue glanced at the lake, her voice carrying a deep significance, "That's a real treasure. Once you go overseas, you'll be able to call upon many at a wish, like a fish in water. In fact, in my original fate, I was meant to seek an Immortal's destiny here. Alas, I did not gain the Sword Saint's approval. Before he passed, he entrusted the Sword Monarch Order to his disciple, Song Jinyuan.
Afterward, Song Jinyuan left Grand Qi and returned overseas. Sadly, his strength was lacking; he was ambushed and killed, and the Yellow Glyph Sword Sovereign Order fell into another's hands."
Is that so tragic?
Fang Wang felt a twinge of guilt when he first heard this, thinking he had stolen Song Jinyuan's opportunity. But as he learned more, he realized he had indeed saved Song Jinyuan's life.

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 79: The World Speaks, Sword Sect Seeks Battle
chapters.content:
"I heard that you have taken the Sword Saint as your master, which is something I did not expect. I originally thought he would only bestow upon you the Sword Monarch Order," Zhou Xue said to Fang Wang, her tone slightly wistful.
This young man always managed to surprise her.
Fang Wang nodded and replied, "Although we haven't been together for long, his Celestial Sword Intent is indeed powerful, and he also transmitted to me the Han Yu Sword Qi. We should indeed call him Master."
Zhou Xue chuckled, "Of course I know the power of Celestial Sword Intent. His reputation to the south, overseas, is enormous, far greater than you imagine."
Fang Wang asked with surprise, "If he is so powerful, why would demons dare to chase after us?"
"The reason the Sword Saint is known as a sword saint, beyond his strength, is his non-killing philosophy. He has cultivated for six hundred years without once taking the life of a person or a demon. This is also why I felt at ease letting you come. Great cultivators like the Sword Saint are rare in the mortal realm.
As for you keeping a low profile, it's only because there are too many cultivators in the Sword Heaven Marsh, and I feared they might trouble you and affect your Spiritual Refinement. After all, the Sword Saint doesn't have much longer, and he could leave this world at any moment."
Zhou Xue's words conjured up the image of the Sword Saint in Fang Wang's mind.
This mentor of his had never killed anyone...
Fang Wang grew even more curious about the Sword Saint's past.
"By the way, have you met Gu Tianxiong, the father of Gu Li?" Zhou Xue changed the subject and asked.
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and queried, "We have met, does this also fall within your calculations?"
Zhou Xue smiled and said, "Gu Tianxiong enjoys making friends. If you were in Sword Heaven Marsh, it's quite likely that you would meet him. But he defends the weak and stands up against injustice. The downfall of the Gu Family was precisely because they offended the Great Demon King, inciting his displeasure, which led to their destruction.
You are on good terms with Gu Li, and the Gu Family took the initiative to draw you in; so you might as well save them to avoid any regrets in life."
At the mention of the word 'regrets,' her eyes took on an ancient sadness, as if she were remembering something from the past.
Fang Wang secretly rejoiced that Zhou Xue was kin to him. If she were an enemy, she would be terrifying indeed. Being able to foresee the future was a frightening ability, indefensible against.
"Sword Heaven Marsh is not bad. Develop this place and make it a second home for the Fang Family. And, should the Sword Saint's Sword Servants wish to follow you, you may accept them. If they are a bother, you can let Han Yu manage them."
After saying this, Zhou Xue turned and walked along the lakeside.
Fang Wang hurriedly asked, "Where are you going?"
Zhou Xue, without looking back, answered, "I'm going to give Han Yu some instructions and then continue south to search for a treasure."
This time, Fang Wang did not ask if he could accompany her; if Zhou Xue truly wanted to take him, she would have said so.
"Is she not at ease with me, and came especially to make sure I was all right?"
Fang Wang watched Zhou Xue's retreating figure and pondered in silence.
But the next second, he hurriedly cast aside the notion.
Too confident!
Isn't this just an illusion of life?
Fang Wang turned and walked towards the other side of the lake.
He planned to cultivate in Sword Heaven Marsh for a while and, at the same time, offer guidance to Fang Hanyu and Song Jinyuan.
Song Jinyuan had been an orphan since childhood and didn't know where to go upon the Sword Saint's death. Invited by Fang Hanyu to join the Fang Family, he hesitated only briefly before agreeing, mainly out of a desire to stay with Fang Wang. For the Fang Family itself, another cultivator in the Profound Heart Realm was naturally good news.
Fang Wang returned to the head of the bridge to continue his cultivation, with Song Jinyuan and Xiao Zi sitting on either side, contemplating swordsmanship while gazing at the lake.
Half an hour later, Fang Hanyu found Fang Wang and told him that Zhou Xue had already left and that the next meeting would likely be at the Great Abyss Gate.
Fang Wang merely nodded slightly, saying nothing more.
Seeing this, Fang Hanyu sighed internally.
The lady has feelings; the gentleman is clueless!
In his view, Zhou Xue's visit was clearly one of concern for Fang Wang—the affection was evident and needed no confession.
Yet Fang Wang played dumb, seemingly oblivious. Fang Hanyu wondered who held Fang Wang's heart.
Fang Hanyu gazed at Fang Wang's backside, zoning out for a while before leaving.
Although he had been bequeathed the Sword Saint's Sword Qi, his expertise in the Sword Dao was still not strong enough, and he had been exchanging and sparring with other Sword Servants lately.
The Sword Servants had come following the Sword Saint, and although he had passed, having witnessed Fang Wang's Celestial Sword Intent, they already regarded Fang Wang as the new Sword Saint in their hearts and were willing to continue following him. Because of Fang Wang, they were also very cordial to Fang Hanyu.
Zhou Xue's visit was just a minor episode.
Besides the Sword Servants, nearly a hundred other sword cultivators, including Gu Tianxiong, had not departed. They were all quite interested in Fang Wang and wanted to see how he cultivated. Fang Wang did not disappoint them, occasionally gathering everyone to teach them about Celestial Sword Intent.
As for how much they understood, that depended on their own fate, and his magnanimity only increased their respect for him.
Eight months later, Fang Wang advanced to the third layer of the Profound Heart Realm.
The Sword Servants in Sword Heaven Marsh were now fully convinced by Fang Hanyu. With the Lifespirit Treasure bestowed by the Sword Saint, he held exceptional talent in swordsmanship. In half a year's time, he mastered several exquisite sets of sword techniques. Now, with his mastery of the Sword Saint's Sword Qi, he could easily sweep away most cultivators in the Profound Heart Realm.
Under Fang Wang's guidance, Song Jinyuan gradually grasped the existence of Celestial Sword Intent. Fully understanding it was still difficult for him, but at least he now held hope, no longer feeling dejected.
An outrageous thought even took root in his mind.
That thought was that Fang Wang's understanding of Celestial Sword Intent surpassed that of his master, the Sword Saint!
All these years following the Sword Saint, he had not even caught a glimpse of the path, but after cultivating with Fang Wang for half a year, he already began to sense it...
One day.
Fang Wang opened his eyes, stretched while looking at the lake.
Xiao Zi leaped out from the lake and said, "Young master, more and more cultivators have been coming to Sword Heaven Marsh lately. It feels like something's about to happen."
Fang Wang, who originally planned to leave Sword Heaven Marsh, couldn't help but raise an eyebrow and spoke, "Oh, is that so? Then you should go ask Han Yu."
Xiao Zi immediately dove into the bottom of the lake and disappeared.
Fang Wang wasn't afraid, his confidence soared after defeating the Great Demon King, and he felt grounded even when facing those in the Condensation Spirit Realm.
Upon his return, he would have to face Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen!
The reputation of the Celestial Sword Saint was enough for the Great Abyss Gate to take him seriously. He believed that between him and Lu Yuanjun, the Great Abyss Gate would certainly choose him, and Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi, regardless of their reluctance, would have no choice.
He just didn't know how much longer it would take the Qi Dynasty to transform into a Cultivation Dynasty.
Fang Wang hadn't been paying attention to this matter and was unaware of its progress.
An hour later, Xiao Zi finally returned, followed by Gu Tianxiong, who wore a look of urgency on his face.
Fang Wang stood at the head of the bridge, gently fanning himself. Though puzzled, he remained calm and waited for them to approach.
"There's terrible news, the Great Elder of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, Kong Xi, has declared he will come to Sword Heaven Marsh to challenge the Celestial Sword Intent of the Sword Saint!" Gu Tianxiong said gravely.
The Great Elder?
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow and asked, "Is Kong Xi very strong?"
Gu Tianxiong took a deep breath and replied, "Though he's not the Sect Master, he has acquired the name of the Sword Sect. In terms of Sword Dao, there are no more than three people in the entire Grand Qi who can rival him! As early as one hundred and thirty years ago, Kong Xi entered the Ninth Level of Profound Heart Realm.
When he was young, he once sought to become a disciple of the Sword Saint but was rejected. I guess he's held a grudge ever since. Having heard that you've received the Sword Saint's legacy, he put out the word that he would come to Sword Heaven Marsh to challenge you in a year's time, and all swordsmen of the world may come to watch the battle.
Counting the time, five months have already passed, and in another seven months, he will arrive."
"This wily old fellow is quite malicious, challenging you in front of the whole world. If you do not accept the battle, everyone will laugh at you. But what status does he have, bullying the young without shame!"
Gu Tianxiong was quite indignant, and without realizing it, he had come to think of Fang Wang as one of his own.
If he couldn't become a father-in-law, becoming brothers will do!
Xiao Zi, however, didn't care and clamored, "What's there to be afraid of? Even if Kong Xi is stronger, could he be more formidable than the Great Demon King? My young master should compete with the top figures of Grand Qi."
Fang Wang hadn't expected anyone would dare to trouble him after he had slain the Great Demon King.
"If that's the case, then let them come."
Fang Wang said calmly, his heart filled with a hint of anticipation.
Until now, he had never truly exerted all his strength in battle.
Moreover, since the challenge had been issued to the entire world, if he were to flee, what would the people of the world think of him, and what would the Great Abyss Gate think of him?
Knowing it was an open scheme, Fang Wang was willing to accept it!
All his confidence stemmed from his cultivation and abilities!
"But..." Gu Tianxiong frowned deeply, wanting to persuade him, but not knowing how, because he wasn't clear on just how strong Fang Wang was.
At that moment, Song Jinyuan descended from the sky and landed in front of Fang Wang. With an expressionless face, he said, "Don't you want to be number one in the world? Then you must face the challenge. The master has cultivated for six hundred years, and the reason he's known as the Sword Saint is not because he's never been defeated, but because he never shies away from any challenge."
Fang Wang raised his eyebrow; this little Song was provoking him.
"With seven more months to go, let's wait then."
Fang Wang shook his head, suddenly recalling another matter.
Lu Yuanjun and Zhao Zhen wouldn't have run away, would they?
Although he had not returned, the news of his inheritance from the Sword Saint and the slaying of the Great Demon King must have spread like wildfire in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm; otherwise, the Great Elder of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect wouldn't have been unable to sit still.
If Lu Yuanjun and company had fled, then they were decisive enough, and he would pursue them slowly later on.
If not, it could only be said that their fate was sealed.
Thinking this, Fang Wang then lifted his gown and resumed his seated meditation, continuing to cultivate.
Seeing that he couldn't be persuaded, Gu Tianxiong gave up. He looked at Song Jinyuan and raised an eyebrow, "Song Jinyuan, how about finding a place to practice?"
This youngster was not being honest, daring to provoke his son-in-law; he must be properly disciplined, or else he might cause trouble for his son-in-law in the future!
For the sake of his daughter's happiness, Gu Tianxiong felt it was necessary to take action.
"Let's go."
Song Jinyuan responded. He too needed a bout of sparring to build confidence.
And so, the two of them stepped on the waves and left, with Xiao Zi following behind, wanting to join in on the fun.
...
Inside a brightly lit grand hall, a black-clad young man arrived; it was none other than the number one prodigy of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, Xu Qiuming.
Xu Qiuming made his way to the steps, his brow furrowed as he looked towards the sitting figure above the steps.
"Uncle-Master, with your status, challenging Fang Wang doesn't seem proper!"
Xu Qiuming owed a favor to Fang Wang since his sister, Xu Tian Jiao, had been saved by him, and he felt compelled to come.
Kong Xi of the Sword Sect, with his slender frame, wore a black robe that was too large for him. His black and white hair was casually draped around, and a red sword mark on his forehead lent his already imposing face an even greater sense of pressure.
Kong Xi opened his eyes, looking down at Xu Qiuming in the hall, and said, "Having received the Sword Saint's legacy and slain the Great Demon King, he's no longer just a prodigy, but a swordsman whose name resounds throughout the world. What's wrong with me challenging him?"
"Don't fault me for being blunt—should I not make a move, Fang Wang will soar to great heights, and for the rest of your life, you'll live in his shadow. The Suspended Vast Sword Sect will be looked down on by the Great Abyss Gate, and we will have to endure their oppression!"

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 80: The Grand Qi Cultivation Realm's Treasured Relic, a Tale for the Ages
chapters.content:
"His Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure is extraordinary, but is the path of immortality really all about the grade of one's spirit treasure? Since ancient times, have all those who achieved immortality possessed Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasures? I don't think so!"
Xu Qiuming spoke calmly and wasn't provoked by Kong Xi.
Kong Xi revealed a smile that seemed mocking. He snorted and said, "You're still young, you have no idea what the grade of a spirit treasure means. It is destiny. Indeed, there are opportunities and fated encounters in the world, and to some extent, opportunities are more important, but that's only for those who can't live forever.
What good does an opportunity do if it only serves to let them live better within their limited lifetimes? Without pursuing immortality, what's the point of cultivation?"
"Earth Origin Spirit Treasures cannot grant immortality. Whether Heaven Yuan can, I'm not sure, but precisely because I'm unsure, I must take action. If Fang Wang achieves immortality and becomes the Sect Leader of Great Abyss Gate, do you think your Suspended Vast Sword Sect and the Nine Great Sects will still exist in the future?"
Xu Qiuming's expression changed slightly. From the perspective of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, such actions were indeed justifiable.
However...
Grinding his teeth, Xu Qiuming said, "Please give me a chance, esteemed uncle master. I will prove that I am not weaker than Fang Wang!"
He was born with pride. Although Fang Wang's rise had shocked him, what he felt more was anticipation and motivation. Setting aside the life-saving grace owed to Xu Tian Jiao, he also wished to have an open and honest exchange with such an opponent.
Kong Xi closed his eyes and said, "This matter can only be handled by me. It's not something your master should do. Go now, my decision is made."
Xu Qiuming furrowed his brows tightly, struggled for a while, but eventually left.
He decided to go directly to his master and let his master make the final decision.
...
Ever since learning that Kong Xi of the Sword Sect was coming to challenge him, Fang Wang found that cultivators visited him every day.
Luckily, the weakest cultivators who could make it to Sword Heaven Marsh were in the Soul Sculpting Realm. Such cultivators had ceased to ingest food, so they wouldn't contaminate his Sword Heaven Marsh.
That's right, he already regarded Sword Heaven Marsh as his property, and so did others. Song Jinyuan and the Sword Servants all recognized Fang Wang's authority.
Unconsciously, in their hearts, Fang Wang had surpassed the Sword Saint, because Fang Wang could directly impart to them the Celestial Sword Intent, something that seemed more magnanimous than the Sword Saint.
Little did they know, it wasn't that the Sword Saint didn't want to impart the knowledge; the Sword Saint had already covered the lake with Celestial Sword Intent, allowing them to perceive it for themselves, but they simply lacked the aptitude.
On the other hand, Fang Wang's mastery of the Celestial Sword Intent had reached Great Perfection, surpassing even the Sword Saint's understanding, and his teachings could help others perceive even more.
Days passed.
The number of cultivators at Sword Heaven Marsh grew ever larger. Looking from the lakeside, one could see the figures of cultivators all along the way. The Sword Servants marked out a three-mile radius around where Fang Wang stayed and forbade other cultivators from approaching.
There were one hundred and twenty-three Sword Servants in total, with the weakest at the sixth level of the Soul Sculpting Realm, and the strongest at the fourth level of the Profound Heart Realm. These people gathered together, forming a powerful force capable of stabilizing the situation.
On normal days, Fang Hanyu and Song Jinyuan would lead the Sword Servants, managing the affairs of Sword Heaven Marsh. Fang Wang's life was easy; he cultivated every day and occasionally fished.
Four months passed in the blink of an eye.
There were now thousands of cultivators at Sword Heaven Marsh, representing various sects and even the Li Family had come.
Li Hongshuang and Li Honggang of the Li Family, with the Li Family's head personally visiting Fang Wang to apologize proactively.
It turned out that the identity of the White Garment Astonishing Swan could no longer be hidden, primarily because Fang Wang's reputation had grown too large. Even disciples within the Great Abyss Gate were frantically searching for information about him; the news spread far and wide. The Li Family was not angry, only afraid.
Li Qingfeng, the head of the Li Family, stood behind Fang Wang and sincerely apologized, his attitude very humble.
Fang Wang, without turning around, said, "Since the Li Family has long expelled Li Hongshuang from the family records, then naturally it has nothing to do with the Li Family. As for Li Honggang, to tell you the truth, I respect him and am not angry. It's only right for a father to stand up for his son. Rest assured, I bear no grudge against the Li Family."
Li Qingfeng breathed a sigh of relief. He was a cultivator at the second level of the Profound Heart Realm, but looking at Fang Wang's back, he felt an immense pressure. Even the purple snake coiled around the wooden stake beside him made his skin crawl.
In his eyes, Fang Wang was not just a Heaven Yuan talent but a peerless powerhouse comparable to those in the Condensation Spirit Realm!
"Young Master Fang, this is a small token from the Li Family, to be conveyed to the Fang Family. The Li Family wishes to maintain good relations with the Fang Family," Li Qingfeng said earnestly, presenting a storage bag with both hands.
Fang Wang raised his hand, and the storage bag automatically flew into it. This motion startled Li Qingfeng internally.
He couldn't sense any of Fang Wang's Spiritual Power.
"I'll thank you on behalf of the Fang Family. Please settle down with your people, and take the opportunity to watch my battle with the Sword Sect," Fang Wang said softly after securing the storage bag.
Li Qingfeng immediately bowed and then turned to leave.
This was just one of several incidents like it. The power of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure and his capability in slaying the Great Demon King attracted many families and sects to come forth, aiming to form good relations with Fang Wang and the Fang Family.
As for the battle with the Sword Sect, although they couldn't assess who would win or lose, taking the initiative to make friends with Fang Wang was certainly advantageous.
They didn't believe Fang Wang would die. Even if he was defeated, it was likely someone powerful would stand out for him. This was, after all, a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, and no one knew how high he could reach. However, a view had already begun to circulate in the Cultivation World.
Fang Wang was the treasure of Grand Qi Cultivation Realm!
As long as Fang Wang lived, the Condensation Spirit Realm would no longer be the pinnacle of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm!
Of course, these were the thoughts of the lower-level cultivators. The bigger sects were more worried about him overturning the power structure of the cultivation world.
As the battle with the Sword Sect drew closer, more and more prominent families visited Fang Wang, including two orthodox sects from the Nine Great Sects, even providing him with information on Kong Xi.
Kong Xi had achieved the Condensation Spirit Realm, and not just recently!
To this, Fang Wang was not surprised. After all, he had slain the Great Demon King previously, and now those who dared to come were naturally in the Condensation Spirit Realm.
...
With only a month left until the battle with the Sword Sect, Sword Heaven Marsh had become a bustling place. The figures of those comprehending the sword were everywhere on the lake, while the lake's edge was thronged with figures from various factions.
On this day, Fang Hanyu led a group of people towards the area.
Fang Wang seemed to sense something, hurriedly opening his eyes and standing up.
He saw his grandfather Fang Meng, his father Fang Yin, and a crowd of clan members approaching, totaling more than twenty people.
"Wang'er!"
Fang Yin, seeing Fang Wang, called out happily.
Fang Wang immediately dashed to their side and asked with a smile, "Grandfather, Father, what brings you here?"
Fang Meng stroked his beard and said, "My grandson is battling the Sword Sect; how could I not come?"
"Indeed, the news has spread all over the world. Our Fang Family has been in the Cultivation World for many years, naturally, we got the message. You little rascal, it's been nearly sixteen years since you left home, and you just refuse to come back, eh? Grown too independent?"
Fang Yin followed up, his eyes wide with a seemingly angry look, but before Fang Wang could reply, Fang Meng let out a cold huff and said, "What do you know? My grandson is pursuing immortality; how could you hinder him?"
Fang Yin smiled awkwardly and could only nod in agreement.
The other clan members greeted Fang Wang one by one. Many of their faces were unfamiliar to Fang Wang, mainly because he had forgotten them, so he could only nod with a smile.
Seeing that Fang Wang, whose name resonated throughout the Cultivation World, was still polite and courteous, everyone felt less pressured.
"Your father has now inherited my Duke position, and you are the heir apparent. Of course, this status is not important to you. It's just to let you know that the royal court is also quite enthusiastic about the Fang Family, probably because the Great Abyss Gate has made a move," Fang Meng said with a smile.
After many years, his physique seemed much more robust, with fluctuations of Spiritual Power within his body.
Fang Wang asked in surprise, "Why didn't you let uncle become the Duke?"
A son of his Uncle Fang Shi laughed and said, "My father is busy with his cultivation. To have Fifth Uncle take on the title of Duke is actually a bother for him."
Fang Yin shook his head and said, "I have only average talent. Thanks to your influence, Zhou Xue provided me with many cultivation resources but, unfortunately, I still cannot compare to your uncles. Why force it?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang didn't know what to say.
Could he tell his father that his own talent was exceptional so his father's couldn't be too bad?
His reliance was on the Heavenly Palace...
"Alright, greetings are enough. Continue with your cultivation, my good grandson. After the big battle is over, your grandfather has some words to say to you in private."
Fang Meng looked at Fang Wang with a cheerful expression and, without waiting for an answer, urged his children and grandchildren to leave.
Fang Hanyu followed up, saying, "I'll settle them in."
Fang Wang watched their retreating figures with a warm heart.
For the members of the Fang Family, it was just short of sixteen years since they had last seen him, but for Fang Wang, it had been two thousand years.
The moment he saw Fang Yin, his heart was tumultuous, yet he controlled it well.
"With their company, what's another five hundred years in secluded cultivation?"
Fang Wang thought with boundless enthusiasm, his thoughts on the upcoming battle now more resolute.
He would decisively defeat Kong Xi!
Show no mercy!
He wanted to tell the whole world just how strong Fang Wang was, that anyone who contemplated provoking the Fang Family should first weigh whether they were qualified to offend him!
...
The scorching sun shone high in the sky, and the eternally spring-like Sword Heaven Marsh remained as picturesque as ever.
On the terrace of a pavilion, Gu Li stood in the corridor, staring blankly at the lake. She was dressed in the robe of a Great Abyss Gate disciple with a light veil covering her face. Although only her eyes were visible, they were still exceptionally captivating.
Gu Tianxiong stepped out from inside the house and said, "Don't worry. You haven't seen that kid displaying his Celestial Sword Intent. I tell you, if Kong Xi witnessed it himself, he definitely wouldn't dare to challenge him."
Gu Li didn't look at him, just continued to gaze calmly at the lake, and said, "I'm not worried he'll lose. I'm just curious why you won't let me see him. My presence wouldn't delay him much."
A flash of embarrassment crossed Gu Tianxiong's face, and he feigned a stern look, "Daughter, he needs to focus now, understand? Your presence would only pressure him. Even if it didn't, it would introduce distractions since you're in his heart."
"Really?" Gu Li turned to look at him with eyes filled with hope and anxiety.
Gu Tianxiong thickened his skin and said, "Of course. Previously, we concealed our identities and treated each other as brothers. He told me that he liked the junior sister from the neighboring cave-abode. Given that they're both exceptionally talented, he didn't want to settle feelings too early lest it affect his dao heart. Daughter, I think he's right.
You're both young and have plenty of time to spend together. Suppressing your emotions to pursue the great path of immortality is the wise move. You should strive to match his commitment. He is a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure but you are an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure; how far behind can you be? Focus on your cultivation, keep up with his pace, and together you can forge an everlasting tale!"
Gu Li furrowed her brows and questioned, "Why didn't you tell me before?"
Gu Tianxiong sighed and said, "Who knew you would be so restless? Daughter, I must criticize you. In this respect, you are far behind Fang Wang. Can't you be a bit more aspiring? He is a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure whereas you are an Earth Origin Spirit Treasure; how far off can that be? Concentrate on your cultivation, keep up with his pace, and then you can create a legendary romance for the ages!"

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 81: The One Favored by the Heavens, The Struggle of Fate [Third Update]
chapters.content:
After much persuasion from Gu Tianxiong, Gu Li finally made up her mind not to disturb Fang Wang. She turned around and entered the loft to start cultivating.
Gu Tianxiong let out a sigh of relief, thinking to himself how close it had been.
This flash of insight in desperation was indeed a stroke of genius.
Indeed!
In this way, he should urge his daughter to focus on her cultivation more in the future, so she won't be in contact with Fang Wang.
"My dear daughter, your father will help you in your pursuit of a husband. You just stay away from him for now. Besides, Fang Wang has no such intentions towards you; it's better to avoid the heartache," Gu Tianxiong thought, and the guilt in his heart vanished, replaced by a sense of being moved.
As a father, no one else could measure up to what he was doing!
Gu Tianxiong turned and left, planning to have a talk with Fang Wang.
Taking a wife or concubines could wait, but some assurances had to be secured!
Meanwhile.
Fang Wang sat at the edge of the bridge, stretching languidly. He sighed, "When will the Sword Sect come? It should be about time, right?"
Xiao Zi lay beside him, looking out over the vast lake, and replied, "Who knows? Maybe they're scared."
If one looked closely, a shadowy figure practicing swordsmanship could be faintly seen in her snake eyes, moving too fast to be clearly discerned.
Fang Wang turned his head to look at Xiao Zi and reached out to rub its snake head.
In recent months, Xiao Zi had behaved itself, a change that made it seem uncharacteristic.
Fang Wang knew the reason; it was immersed in the comprehension of swordsmanship, but the situation was absurd to him.
A snake with a greater understanding of the Sword Dao than Song Jinyuan?
Indeed, it was a snake demon that had survived in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
At that moment, Song Jinyuan walked onto the wooden bridge, stopping behind Fang Wang, and said, "Master, we still haven't found the divine sword."
The Sword Saint transmitted the Celestial Sword Intent to Fang Wang, while the Sword Qi was used to create a treasure spirit for Fang Hanyu. He had even given his storage ring to Fang Hanyu, but the divine sword was not inside.
Before the Sword Saint passed away, most sword cultivators sought after his sword.
It was rumored that the Sword Saint's sword was a superior spiritual weapon, containing the ultimate power of the Sword Dao that enticed swordsmen from all over.
"If we can't find it, so be it. The master must have had his plans. If it's destined for us, it will naturally appear before us."
Fang Wang was not too hung up on the situation; he had three Lifespirit Treasures and was not particularly eager for the Sword Saint's sword.
"Sure, here are the seventy-one superior grade spiritual swords you asked for."
Song Jinyuan nodded, then tossed a storage bag into Fang Wang's lap.
Fang Wang raised an eyebrow, "So soon?"
Song Jinyuan said, "Most of them were gifts from various forces, sorted by Fang Hanyu. After all, as the newly recognized Sword Saint, the treasures gifted to you are bound to be swords. I also contributed two, and I had a few Sword Servants go out to buy a dozen or so more."
The price of a superior grade spiritual weapon was certainly not low.
Fang Wang was about to reach into his own storage ring for Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, but Song Jinyuan turned and left him with a parting word:
"You are the master of Sword Heaven Marsh and my junior brother; consider it a welcoming gift from me. The Sword Servants are also grateful for the Sword Intent you've taught them, so there's no need for you to dip into your storage ring."
Fang Wang turned to look after him. Song Jinyuan had gone five steps before leaping up to ride his sword toward the distant mountains.
He couldn't help but be amused; his senior brother was quite tsundere, wasn't he?
In a low voice, he said, "Xiao Zi, did you see that? That's the advantage of having power. When will you go out and establish your own kingdom to collect Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures for me?"
"Forget it, I don't have that kind of power. It's better for me to stay by your side. If you ever get bored, you can still have some fun with me," Xiao Zi casually replied, causing Fang Wang's mouth to twitch.
It was all Gu Tianxiong's fault!
That old rascal!
Fang Wang fell silent, holding Song Jinyuan's storage bag, taking out the magic swords one by one and beginning to refine their restrictions.
Not long after, Gu Tianxiong arrived, going on and on about wanting Fang Wang to promise not to tell Gu Li about their previous nonsensical conversation. Fang Wang agreed, but Gu Tianxiong, thinking he agreed too readily and suspecting a trick, insisted on obtaining written proof. It took a while before he finally left.
Once Gu Tianxiong was gone, Fang Wang couldn't help but comment, "Xiao Zi, don't you think he's a fool? Isn't getting written proof akin to creating evidence against oneself?"
Previously, Gu Tianxiong could have denied everything outright. Now, with the proof in his hands, losing it would spell disaster.
"He's always been a bit foolish," Xiao Zi responded nonchalantly.
...
When the year's agreement arrived, Sword Heaven Marsh became extremely bustling. The lakeside was filled with people, and representatives from all the major sects were there, including those from Great Abyss Gate led by Greedy Sleeper, Zhao Chuanqian.
"Elder Zhao, the Sword Sect won't dare to come, will they?" Zhou Bo asked, glancing at Zhao Chuanqian who was meditating in front. Around him were hundreds of disciples, all from Great Abyss Gate, and their strength was not to be underestimated, with even the weakest being branch disciples.
The other disciples began to discuss among themselves, all feeling that the Sword Sect had chickened out.
Most people didn't know much about Kong Xi of the Sword Sect, but they regarded Fang Wang as a legend.
Having practiced cultivation for four years, Fang Wang made his name in the Nine Veins Combat Method and was then revealed to have the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure as his Lifespirit Treasure. He swept across thirteen elite talents, and later, after obtaining the Sword Saint's inheritance, he slayed the Great Demon King and was called the Heaven Yuan Sword Saint.
All these achievements were enough for the disciples of the Great Abyss Gate to take pride in.
Now, as they traveled the world, the cultivators who knew they were from the Great Abyss Gate would marvel at Fang Wang's strength, which brought them glory by association.
"You know nothing. Anyone can be afraid, but not him, Kong Xi. That old lad probably came here with killing intent!"
Greedy Sleeper sneered. When he mentioned Kong Xi, he couldn't help but curse, obviously bearing a grudge against him.
Zhao Chuanqian opened his eyes and said calmly, "The name of the Sword Sect should not be underestimated. Even if the Sect Leader faces him, he might not be able to win."
Sect Leader!
The disciples immediately quieted down. They believed that Fang Wang was indeed powerful, but if compared to the Sect Leader, it was almost inevitable that Fang Wang would fall short. After all, as disciples of the Great Abyss Gate, they naturally regarded Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian as the strongest in their sect.
Fang Wang excelled beyond Guang Qiuxian after just sixteen years of cultivation?
That is also...
Zhou Bo, who loved to tout Fang Wang's accomplishments, couldn't help but fall silent.
Greedy Sleeper was about to speak when he suddenly turned his head, frowning in a certain direction. Zhao Chuanqian did the same, his eyes sharpening.
At this moment, all the cultivators at the Profound Heart Realm around the lake looked up in the same direction.
It was a majestic mountain, with the sun just perched at its peak. Following their gazes, one could see a figure standing atop the mountain, silhouetted against the bright sun, their black clothes fluttering in the wind.
Sword Sect!
At the same time.
Fang Wang, who was seated cross-legged at the head of the bridge, slowly stood up. He waved the Qiankun Fan in his right hand lightly as he gazed at Kong Xi in the distance.
Xiao Zi looked in that direction, hissing and speaking, "Master, he's very strong, it feels like he's even more formidable than the previous Great Demon King. No wonder he dares to challenge you."
A breeze stirred across the lake, the mist surged, and Fang Wang's white garments billowed. Locks of hair beside his ears lifted as his eyes brimmed with anticipation.
How could he not look forward to a battle that had caught the attention of the world?
In his youth, who didn't yearn to be famous throughout the world, to become a hero admired by all?
After sixteen years of cultivation, Fang Wang had his own confidence. This battle was also being watched by his family, and he was determined to show his strongest form.
"Mysterious Origin Sword Saint Fang Wang, I am here!"
Kong Xi's voice suddenly rang out, loud as thunder, exploding in the air and startling thousands of cultivators into standing up, with those living in the lofts also emerging.
His voice echoed over the Sword Heaven Marsh, resonating for a long time.
Fang Hanyu, Song Jinyuan, and the Sword Servants all gathered behind Fang Wang. Their gazes reached into the distance. Although they couldn't clearly see Kong Xi's figure, they could feel the powerful Sword Qi.
"I was eight years old when I joined the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, and at twenty, I achieved Spiritual Refinement with only a Middle-grade Profound Origin Precious Spirit. By twenty-five, I traveled the world and had the fortune to meet the Sword Saint. His Sword Dao fascinated me. Unfortunately, the Sword Saint said my talent was not sufficient to be accepted as his disciple."
Once again, Kong Xi's voice rose, and he began to recount his past.
These words moved many of the Sword Servants, for they shared a similar experience; they had all wished to become disciples of the Sword Saint, but were rejected.
"The grade of one's spirit treasure seemed to be determined by fate, a notion that confined me and led me to a moment of loss. However, I later realized that cultivation itself is an act of defying the heavens. If one is to defy the heavens, then why believe in fate? Therefore, I devoted myself to probing the sword.
My enlightenment lasted two hundred years, but when I wanted to prove myself to the Sword Saint, I found that he had already traveled southward to the sea!"
To defy the heavens!
These words resonated with the hearts of most cultivators at Sword Heaven Marsh, causing them to empathize.
Fang Wang remained unmoved, sighing inwardly.
What a clever tactic!
With these words, no one would say that Kong Xi was bullying the less experienced—they would empathize with him, and even support him.
"After the Sword Saint left, I roamed the world, challenging all the great cultivators of the Sword Dao across this land, eventually establishing the name of the Sword Sect. But what of it?"
"Without defeating the Sword Saint, the Sword Sect is but a joke!"
"Sadly, the heavens did not favor me. When my retreat ended and I finally awaited the Sword Saint's return, I learned that the Sword Saint had passed away!"
"Hahaha! The Sword Saint has passed away! And to add irony, before his death, he chose a genius with the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure as his successor! How ironic. The Sword Saint succeeded—at least he proved to me that he could find someone with greater talent than mine!"
"The Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, its legend has been passed down through the ages on this vast land, yet no one has ever seen it!"
"Fang Wang, you are the favored one of the heavens. From birth, you were destined to have everything—the strongest talents, the best master, the best of everything. But defeating the Sword Saint has been the goal of my life's pursuit!"
"This battle today, you shall represent the Sword Saint and his quest for the ultimate talent and face me! Putting aside the Suspended Vast Sword Sect and the Great Abyss Gate, there are no grudges, only a predestined battle!"
Kong Xi's laughter rang out, echoing over Sword Heaven Marsh. His heartfelt words touched the vast majority of the spectators.
At this moment, they seemed to see an ordinary cultivator drawing his sword against his destiny on the brink of doom.
They couldn't help but compare themselves to Fang Wang—what were these spectators in comparison?
At least the Sword Sect dared to challenge, while they could only come to join the excitement, or perhaps to curry favor with Fang Wang!

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 82: Are You Convinced?
chapters.content:
```
The voice of Sword Sect's Kong Xi echoed across the Sword Heaven Marsh, touching the hearts of all cultivators who heard it.
Gu Tianxiong and Gu Li stood at the edge of the corridor, looking up at Kong Xi's figure in the distance. Gu Li bit her lip and whispered, "How shameless, if you want to fight, then fight. What's the use of these hypocritical words?"
Gu Tianxiong's eyes reflected complex emotions as he sighed, "He is trying to justify the actions of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect and himself, but these might also be true words from the bottom of his heart."
The bitterness of the Spiritual Power rank is a hurdle most cultivators have encountered. Even if one possesses peerless talent, there will always be higher ranks emerging thereafter.
When we look up to others, we accept fate, yet when we are surpassed, we refuse to be bound by fate, sinking deeper into misery.
The Fang Family Disciples were indignant.
"Nonsense! If Fang Wang's fate were truly good, would we almost have been wiped out?"
"Exactly, if it weren't for Fang Wang, we would all be dead by now."
"This old man is bewitching the crowd with his deceitful words because he can't afford to lose!"
"What's Fang Wang doing? Hurry up and defeat him, let your strength do the talking!"
Fang Meng and Fang Yin remained silent, their gazes fixed on the figure of the Sword Sect, filled with emotion.
For them, Kong Xi was someone of a much higher generation. It was unimaginable that such a figure would be provoked to this extent by a junior. It seemed they had underestimated the impact of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure on the Cultivation World.
At the peak of the towering mountain, Kong Xi leapt up. He swiftly flew to the center of Sword Heaven Marsh, where terrifying Sword Qi burst from his body, causing his black clothes to flutter more violently, like a raging black flame in the sky.
One saw twelve magic swords rising behind him, forming a circle. Streams of Sword Qi continuously emerged from the swords, creating visible currents of energy that expanded ever outward, a magnificent sight.
Cultivators scattered throughout the Sword Heaven Marsh could see his Sword Qi and sense its momentum, and all were struck with awe.
The aura surpassing the Profound Heart Realm fully erupted!
At this moment, Kong Xi did not hold back. He prepared to face Fang Wang with his strongest stance.
"Fang Wang, be careful!"
Fang Hanyu called out to Fang Wang in front of him, even though he had received Sword Saint's Sword Qi, he still felt the pressure when facing the Sword Sect; he was by no means a match for Kong Xi.
Song Jinyuan was even less worth mentioning. His gaze rested on Fang Wang, full of expectation.
He hoped more than anyone for Fang Wang to win. As long as Fang Wang remained undefeated, then him losing to Fang Wang wouldn't be surprising.
Moreover, this was Fang Wang's first battle since inheriting the Sword Saint's title; he simply could not lose!
Fang Wang leapt up, soaring into the sky like a swift arrow. He flew to the same height as Kong Xi, with his white clothes billowing and a black folding fan in hand, his demeanor graceful.
The two formed a stark contrast, one in black, the other in white!
The gazes of thousands of cultivators were fixed on them. No one shouted; all held their breath in anticipation of the imminent battle.
Kong Xi looked at Fang Wang and expressed sentimentally, "True indeed, heroes emerge from the younger generation. If you had been born five hundred years earlier, even Sword Saint would have lived in your shadow."
Fang Wang shook his Qiankun Fan calmly and responded, "To share an era with me should not be a cause for sorrow, but for fortune. It is in an era where heroes emerge that one can call it a golden age. And a golden age needs someone to become the target of all heroes. Come then, let me experience the reputation of the Sword Sect."
His voice, imbued with Celestial Sword Intent, spread to every corner of Sword Heaven Marsh. Facing Kong Xi's psychological tactics, Fang Wang couldn't be bothered to explain and simply displayed his confidence.
He intended to rise irresistibly, ensuring no one would harbor thoughts of contending with him!
As his voice fell, Fang Wang swung the fan fiercely. A slew of Treasured Swords flew out of his storage bag, with the Qingjun Sword at his waist also being unsheathed quickly.
A total of seventy-two high-grade magic swords were arrayed around Fang Wang, in circles upon circles, an even grander formation than Kong Xi's.
"Could it be…"
Greedy Sleeper was excited, his old face flushed, his lips trembling.
Zhao Chuanqian seemed to realize something, his pupils involuntarily dilated.
The other disciples stared intently at the two figures in the sky, afraid to miss anything.
Kong Xi, seeing Fang Wang's array, furrowed his brows. He declared in a deep voice, "Then let this sect master experience the ultimate technique of Sword Saint!"
Fang Wang's lips curved slightly in a smile. While wielding the fan, he said with a laugh, "The Sword Dao of Sword Saint never takes lives, and I do not wish to tarnish my master's reputation. Therefore, I am using the Great Abyss Gate's ultimate technique. This sword formation is called the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation!"
His confident voice resonated through Sword Heaven Marsh, stirring many cultivators, and uplifting the spirits of the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples even more.
The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation was the strongest and most difficult to master of Great Abyss Gate's secret techniques. Fang Wang had actually mastered it?
"Indeed it is! It really is! Hahaha!"
Greedy Sleeper stood up, laughing heartily. As he rose, hundreds of Great Abyss Gate disciples also stood up.
It was not just them; the cultivators who had heard of the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation all stood up or stepped forward, all looking up to Fang Wang.
Upon hearing this, Kong Xi's anger surged: "Not to take lives? Ridiculous! Sword Saint also humiliated this sect master in the same way! Well then, let this sect master force you to use Sword Saint's ultimate technique!"
Boom!
His Sword Intent erupted, the twelve magic swords vibrating. Azure light burst forth, Kong Xi's right hand forming the shape of a sword, he thrusted towards Fang Wang. The twelve magic swords simultaneously emitted azure Sword Qi, and in an instant, the firmament turned azure. The azure light shone on everyone's faces, illuminating their expressions.
The mighty azure Sword Qi, like a celestial river traversing the sky, charged towards Fang Wang, unstoppable.
Fang Wang's expression remained unchanged. His right hand grasped the Qiankun Fan in reverse and suddenly lifted the fan in a sweeping motion.
```
The Qiankun Fan burst forth with an endless stream of Solaris True Fire, stirring up a terrifying blaze that engulfed Kong Xi's Sword Qi head-on.
With a leap, Kong Xi dodged the sea of flames. The tyrannical fire swept up the opposing mountain, igniting its peak. The mountain trembled, dust rose to the sky, and rocks were violently scattered.
Glancing back, Kong Xi was secretly alarmed. Then, he turned his head to look at Fang Wang, only to discover in horror that the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation had already been activated. Around Fang Wang, countless azure thunders intertwined, and the three sword circles formed by seventy-two premium magic swords were amassing terrifying might.
Fang Wang gazed at Kong Xi, his eyes suddenly shifting, and an indescribable sense of oppression burst forth from within him.
True Combat Technique!
At this moment, he had entered an absolutely focused state of combat, condensing the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation at the fastest speed, his surging Spiritual Power connecting the seventy-two premium magic swords.
When his gaze locked onto Kong Xi, the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation exploded in an instant!
Boom! Boom! Boom...
Huge Sword Qi mixed with azure thunder shot at Kong Xi, creating an overwhelming momentum as sword light shone between heaven and earth.
Kong Xi clenched his teeth, advancing instead of retreating. With a reach behind his right hand, he grasped a sword hilt and swung swiftly. Countless Sword Qi erupted. The eleven magic swords behind him swung in unison as if wielded by unseen hands—sword moves sharp and fierce, Sword Qi sweeping like a violent storm.
A thunderous boom resonated through the heavens and earth!
Kong Xi dispersed the first wave of azure thunder Sword Qi but was surrounded by azure thunder, causing his body to go numb and his complexion to drastically change.
"How is this possible!"
Great shock filled Kong Xi's heart, and fear appeared on his face.
The azure thunder had directly scattered two-tenths of his Spiritual Power!
He immediately turned to flee, but innumerable azure thunder Sword Qi traced arcs in the sky, relentlessly pursuing him.
Turning around, Kong Xi flew backward while rapidly swinging his sword. The eleven magic swords did the same. He exerted all his strength, displaying his strongest swordsmanship. Yet, the Sword Qi that once dominated the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm could not disperse the azure thunder Sword Qi.
All cultivators watching widened their eyes, utterly shocked.
Sword Sect is being suppressed in the fight from the very beginning?
Their gaze remained fixed on Kong Xi as his rapid retreat made them turn their heads.
Boom! Boom! Boom...
The sky above Sword Heaven Marsh was filled with successive roars. The velocity of the azure thunder Sword Qi was too fast. Despite having flown over half of Sword Heaven Marsh, Kong Xi was still overtaken.
All the azure thunder Sword Qi suddenly converged to form a massive sword shadow interlaced with lightning, ten Zhang long, resembling a heavenly sword soaring upwards. Then, it plunged downwards at a speed far surpassing before, directly aiming at Kong Xi.
Kong Xi's Spiritual Power was depleted, leaving him no time to dodge.
Under the gaze of thousands of cultivators, the mighty sword carrying Heavenly Might descended from the sky, striking Kong Xi with overwhelming force, pressing him down to crash into the woods surrounding Sword Heaven Marsh.
Boom!
A deafening explosion rose, causing a mighty gust of wind that forced the cultivators to summon their powers in defense. Their eyes saw a vast dust cloud rising from the woods, accompanied by lightning and thunder, even projecting trees through the air—its destructive power was astonishing.
Has the Sword Sect perished?
This was the thought of all who witnessed the battle, for who could endure such an assault and survive?
Sword Heaven Marsh fell into silence, save for the thunder still echoing around Fang Wang. At that moment, he stood proudly in the sky, with the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation circling around him, as if he were a lord of thunder descending upon the Mortal Realm.
Lightning flickered; Fang Wang's figure stood firm as a peak, his expression stern.
More and more cultivators shifted their gaze towards him. Around his body, seventy-two premium magic swords circled like divine guardians. This sight deeply impacted the cultivators, leaving a scene they would never forget.
Gu Li looked at Fang Wang with eyes full of admiration, while beside her Gu Tianxiong was stupefied. This was his second time seeing Fang Wang take action, yet he was still shocked.
He could not comprehend how such a being could exist in this world!
Celestial Sword Intent, Divine Nurturing Sword Qi had been cultivated to Great Completion by him. Now, even the Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation, the most difficult to learn from the Great Abyss Gate, was easily executed by him!
He had been practicing cultivation for only sixteen years!
Fang Wang raised his left hand, reaching out to the front, while his right hand shaped like a claw snatched through the air, pulling a figure out from the rolling dust at a distance.
It was Kong Xi, his body scorched black, drenched in blood, with one of his own magic swords impaled through his chest, the hilt facing Fang Wang.
His reappearance once again drew the attention of everyone present.
Thousands of cultivators watched as he was pulled towards Fang Wang. The hilt of the sword in his chest was grasped by Fang Wang. At a glance, it seemed as if Fang Wang had impaled Kong Xi, whose limbs now hung limply, his body trembling, devoid of his earlier grandeur.
The Sword Sect has suffered a crushing defeat!
That was the only feeling of those who had witnessed this battle.
Kong Xi was no match for Fang Wang!
If they were not aware of their identities, they would have thought that Fang Wang, with a higher realm, was crushing a lower-realm Kong Xi.
Fang Wang slightly raised his chin, looking down upon Kong Xi on the sword with a cold gleam fading from his eyes. In a soft voice, he asked, "Do you concede?"
These three words, accompanied by Celestial Sword Intent, resonated within Sword Heaven Marsh, echoing endlessly like rolling thunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 83: In this life, never compete with him!
chapters.content:
Do you concede?
These three words, like a heavy hammer, struck the hearts of the thousands of cultivators around. They had already forgotten the provocative words of Kong Xi, filled instead with endless admiration and exhilaration.
This battle was definitely the strongest they had ever seen in their lives. Although brief, it was unforgettable.
Even the Fang Family members felt this way, perceiving Fang Wang as so powerful that he seemed almost a stranger to them. Yet, they did not reject this unfamiliarity; they took pride in it instead.
Fang Yin looked at his son's silhouette, his heart brimming with even deeper emotions.
Oh, heavens above!
How did I father such a seed?
If Fang Wang hadn't closely resembled him, he would have doubted his own life.
Fang Hanyu, Song Jinyuan, and the Sword Servants were overwhelmed with emotion. At this moment, Fang Wang was the Sword Saint in their eyes.
Especially for Song Jinyuan, who had followed the Sword Saint through countless battles. In his eyes, Fang Wang's figure at this moment was the very image of the Sword Saint, absolutely identical.
At this time, only one person wasn't happy.
And that was Kong Xi of the Sword Sect.
Kong Xi was already at the end of his strength, even his vision blurring. He couldn't see Fang Wang's expression, but he heard Fang Wang's pressing question.
"Am I going to die…"
Fear filled Kong Xi's heart; he could no longer concern himself with other matters. He had never been so close to death as he was today.
In past brushes with death, he had at least fought his way out with his own strength, with conviction in his heart. Now, after this battle, his confidence was completely shattered. At this moment, things like his sect, reputation, jealousy—all were thrown to the back of his mind.
After centuries of cultivation, having barely reached the pinnacle of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, was he truly going to stop here?
Fear uncontrollably took root in Kong Xi's heart—he didn't want to die!
"I… concede…"
Kong Xi's difficult reply came. Fang Wang deliberately amplified his voice using Celestial Sword Intent, so all cultivators could hear him speak, even if it was just a word, it was enough to invigorate all the cultivators present.
Boom!
The Sword Heaven Marsh was completely stirred!
"How powerful! Is this the Heaven Yuan Sword Saint?"
"I have never seen the Sword Saint's elegance, but I feel that Fang Wang is already a true Sword Saint."
"I think Fang Wang was holding back!"
"Indeed, if it were a fight to the death, the Sword Sect would have been dead by now. Frankly, for the Sword Sect to bully the younger with the elder's authority is unbecoming. Before the fight, they even used those psychological tactics, and for Fang Wang to spare his life is already magnanimous enough. He has the bearing of a great master.
Compared to the Sword Saint, the Sword Sect is clearly inferior!"
"What Sword Sect? They're nothing special. From now on, for eight hundred years, Grand Qi will bear the name Fang!"
Cultivators from all sides discussed eagerly. They held no enmity or grievance against Fang Wang and were naturally happy to witness the rise of such a prodigious figure.
After this battle, Fang Wang would inevitably become one of the top cultivators in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, powerful enough to shake the whole world.
And most crucially, he was still very young!
Fang Wang heard Kong Xi's words, smiled lightly, and flew towards the lakeside. One after another, high-grade magic swords entered his storage bag. On the distant mountaintop, the flames were still burning, signifying that the battle had indeed taken place.
Originally, Fang Wang had intended to kill Kong Xi, but thinking of how the Great Abyss Gate and Suspended Vast Sword Sect were allied righteous sects and considering the Fang Family behind him, he left a survivor. Moreover, Kong Xi being alive was proof of his own strength.
The dead only bring fear or hate.
Fang Wang landed at the bridgehead, and Song Jinyuan immediately had the Sword Servants take Kong Xi to be healed.
Xiao Zi jumped onto Fang Wang's shoulder and hummed, "Young master, why didn't you just finish him off?"
Fang Hanyu nodded, the murderous intent of his Absolute Heart Evil Eye unable to be concealed behind the cloth strip.
Song Jinyuan then said, "Killing him would be as easy as flipping one's hand, but what's the point? After this battle, his sword heart is shattered, and he poses no threat. In the future, whenever major sects see him, they'll remember his defeat at Fang Wang's hands. That's the best stepping stone."
"My master became the Sword Saint precisely because those he defeated lived on, each and every one extolling his strength. That's how he earned his reputation today. Now think about the Sect Leaders of Suspended Vast Sword Sect and Tai Yuan Gate—they are very powerful, and they have killed many, but can they compare to the Sword Saint?"
This speech gave Fang Hanyu and the Sword Servants something to ponder.
Fang Wang smiled. This Senior Brother Song was really interesting.
"I did not kill him because he abided by the rules and said one year meant one year. He set no ambushes. This doesn't mean I don't kill people. I may be the Sword Saint's successor, but I will not become a Sword Saint like him. To stop killing with killing is my true path," Fang Wang said with a smile.
He had killed many people and had no qualms about taking lives. Not killing Kong Xi was simply a consideration for the bigger picture.
Song Jinyuan heard this and frowned slightly, wanting to say something but also feeling that Fang Wang made sense. Sometimes, killing was indeed necessary, and he had seen plenty of people spared by the Sword Saint come back for more, ungrateful and unrepentant.
Just then, a group of cultivators flew in. They were the disciples of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, and among them was Xu Qiuming.
Xu Qiuming felt too ashamed to face Fang Wang and didn't dare to look directly at him, mainly because Fang Wang had already forgotten who he was.
The group of cultivators took the Sword Sect's barely-breathing body from the Sword Servant's hands.
With his face covered in blood, the Sword Sect struggled to raise his head. He looked at Xu Qiuming and said with a trembling voice, "In this life... you must not compete with him... You mustn't..."
Two lines of old tears unexpectedly streamed from his eyes before he fainted.
Xu Qiuming's heart was shaken. He had witnessed the colossal battle with his own eyes and felt that he was by no means Fang Wang's match. Now, hearing such words from his proud and obstinate uncle, the shock in his heart intensified even more.
Ever since he began his cultivation journey, he had been the center of attention as a prodigy. The entire Suspended Vast Sword Sect held him in high esteem. Even when Lu Yuanjun made his surprise appearance, the Suspended Vast Sword Sect remained confident in him, and he never disappointed anyone.
But now...
A genius named Fang Wang had barged into his world with an extremely aggressive attitude. Ever since the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure became known, all the talk around him was in admiration of Fang Wang. Although no one compared him with Fang Wang to his face, he knew that no one was putting them in the same league.
They were not geniuses of the same calibre, which was exactly why he felt challenged and determined to cultivate diligently to defeat Fang Wang openly and squarely.
But seeing Kong Xi's miserable state and reflecting on his words, Xu Qiuming was plunged into an unprecedented state of confusion.
Sword Heaven Marsh was engulfed in clamor as the Fang Residence members and the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples quickly gathered around Fang Wang, encircling him.
"It's good that you didn't kill Kong Xi. Had you killed him, there would be a rift between the Tai Yuan Sect and the Suspended Vast Sword Sect," Zhao Chuanqian commented with admiration.
Greedy Sleeper said disdainfully, "If he had killed him, so what? What could the Suspended Vast Sword Sect say? They were the ones who caused trouble!"
Zhou Bo excitedly said, "Brother Fang is amazing. You are not far from being the world's number one!"
Fang Yin watched his son being admired by his peers, his face brimming with proud smiles.
Meanwhile, some cultivators had already started to leave. They were spies seeking to bring back the outcome of this battle as soon as possible. However, each person's expression was complex as they departed.
Having witnessed this battle, they knew Fang Wang was now unstoppable. Without needing the Tai Yuan Sect's protection, he had become one of Grand Qi's most untouchable Great Cultivators!
By the lakeside, on a corridor.
Gu Tianxiong said with emotion, "My daughter, cultivate diligently. I don't ask you to catch up to him, but at least compared to the other women in the Cultivation World, you won't be unworthy of him. If you can become the strongest female cultivator in the Cultivation World, even if you are far inferior to him, you'll still be the only one who can match him."
After this battle, he truly felt that his daughter was unworthy of Fang Wang.
Not to mention his daughter, he guessed that even the Tai Yuan Sect couldn't retain Fang Wang!
Such a person would definitely not be confined to the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm!
Gu Li nodded, and although she remained silent, her eyes revealed that her heart was anything but calm.
...
It wasn't until deep into the night that Sword Heaven Marsh returned to its usual tranquility.
Inside a pavilion.
Fang Wang and his grandfather Fang Meng sat opposite each other, each sipping tea. Fang Meng looked at his grandson with increasing pride, his heart filled with indescribable emotions.
Ever since his sons had grown up, Fang Meng had been worried, feeling that they weren't capable of shouldering the family's responsibilities. And with the grandchildren still young, that was why he refused to relinquish the Duke's position.
Who would have thought that the Fang Family would produce a person like Fang Wang!
Forget about sustaining the Fang Residence, even the imperial power was insignificant in front of Fang Wang!
The thought of a future Immortal emerging from the Fang Family almost sent Fang Meng's heart soaring to the heavens.
Fang Wang spoke up, "Grandfather, what did you want to talk to me about?"
Fang Meng snapped back to reality and said with a smile, "Two things. First is your marriage to Zhou Xue. Even if you don't want to marry right now, the words of our parents and the engagement can be set for the time being."
Fang Wang hurriedly said, "Grandfather, I cannot stay with the Fang Family forever. I don't wish to marry. My ambition is to travel the world. Of course, I won't forget my home and will return from time to time. Others in the family can take care of the matter of passing on the lineage."
Fang Meng glared at him and said, "Who said we want to keep you here? Who would dare? I'd be the first to disagree. Whatever you want to do in the future, I'll support you. But Zhou Xue clearly has a capable person behind her. The Fang Family owes much to her, and although she is a woman, if you don't step in, can you ensure that she won't marry someone else for life?
And even if she does marry, can you ensure that her heart still belongs to the Fang Family? Even if the Fang Family shouldn't keep her, over time, she will inevitably become a stranger to us."
"I don't insist on this matter, but I hope you will try, at least make a gesture, and let Zhou Xue know you are considering it. If she's unwilling, I won't force her. She will always be a benefactor to the Fang Family. Your fourth uncle asked her, and she said it's all up to you. Han Yu also told me Zhou Xue certainly likes you, but you, young man, are too proud and aloof!"
"Listen to your grandfather. It's normal for a man to have multiple wives and concubines, but the position of the principal wife shouldn't be based entirely on personal preference. Feelings are transient, but compatibility is more important. Zhou Xue is your best partner!"
Fang Wang opened his mouth, filled with confusion.
Zhou Xue really likes him?
But it doesn't seem like it!
Great!
This was passing the buck!
Leaving the difficult decision to him.
Fang Wang immediately said, "In that case, I agree too. I will find the opportunity to express my intentions to her. If she refuses, then it won't be my fault. Our Fang Family acts with integrity and can't bully her. If she's unwilling, we mustn't coerce her."
Fang Meng stroked his beard and laughed, "Of course."

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 84 Danger Approaches, Return Quickly! [Third Release, Request for Monthly Tickets]
chapters.content:
"Grandfather, what about the second matter?"
As soon as Fang Wang heard his grandfather agree, he immediately shifted the topic and asked.
Fang Meng's smile faded as he asked, "Regarding the transformation of the Grand Qi Dynasty into a Cultivation Dynasty, have you been involved? Or do you know anything about it?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang shook his head and answered, "I am busy with cultivation on normal days and have not inquired about these matters, Grandfather. What do you wish to know?"
"In recent years, there has been a subtle atmosphere in the court, with officials disappearing. The rate at which ministers are replaced is faster than all the women in the Imperial City giving birth. Coming to find you this time, I noticed some cities are far less lively than before, and the common people are fearful for their safety.
I have made inquiries, and it is said that the local yamen are forcibly conscripting people to mine the Spirit Veins, and once they go, they are never heard from again. I followed our ancestor in the uprising and then unified the land together in battle. Although there have been those in Grand Qi who wished us harm, there is a part of my heart and efforts in the land of Grand Qi.
I do not wish to see it destroyed by anyone."
"Moreover, the Fang Residence is the Duke's Mansion, and you are born into wealth and privilege, which is derived from the commoners."
Fang Meng spoke gravely, measuring his words carefully while gauging Fang Wang's expression.
People's beliefs can change with their situation, and he also feared that Fang Wang had completely adopted the standpoint of a Cultivator, that as long as it was beneficial to the Cultivation World, he would not care about the life and death of the countless common folk.
After listening, Fang Wang pondered and then said, "Well, once I return to Great Abyss Gate, I will make inquiries with my master. If he can't give a satisfactory explanation, I will seek out the Sect Leader."
Upon hearing this, Fang Meng inwardly breathed a sigh of relief, then he smiled and patted Fang Wang's shoulder heavily.
"Good grandson, eternal life is illusory. The most important thing in a life is what kind of person one becomes, and if one could become an Immortal, one must then consider what kind of Immortal to be," Fang Meng said with earnest and profound meaning.
What kind of Immortal?
An Immortal who acts willfully and does as they please!
These thoughts ran through Fang Wang's mind, but he dared not voice them out loud. He was not foolish; he understood his grandfather's meaning.
For someone like Fang Meng, the greater good of family and country was above all else.
Afterward, Fang Meng changed the subject and began to discuss the affairs of the Fang Realm with Fang Wang.
After sixteen years, the Fang Family had produced several hundred Cultivators, and although the vast majority were in the Qi Cultivation Realm, it was enough to ensure the Fang Family's safety.
Once upon a time, a single Qi Cultivation Realm Cultivator had almost wiped out the Fang Residence. Now, looking back, grandfather and grandson both sighed with emotion.
That night, they talked for a long time.
...
The next day at noon, Fang Wang was meditating at the bridgehead, practicing Qi Gathering.
In the battle with Sword Sect's Kong Xi, although it was fought with ease, the consumption of Spiritual Power was immense. The Nine Heavens Azure Thunder Sword Formation depleted his Spiritual Power greatly, and just facing Kong Xi had used up half his Spiritual Power. He must recover his Spiritual Power as soon as possible to maintain it in an abundant state.
Xiao Zi lay on his left, continuing to contemplate the sword.
Even the liveliest of scenes must eventually disperse. Most factions had already departed, including the Fang Family Members who had left early in the morning. Those remaining were also preparing to go.
Fang Wang planned to return to Great Abyss Gate after his Spiritual Power had recovered. He had not been back in a long time, and it was time to return. After so many events, he would return with a resounding reputation, which was quite invigorating to contemplate.
Just then...
Fang Wang seemed to sense something, opened his eyes, and flipped his right hand to take out his Disciple Token, from which came the voice of Guang Qiuxian:
"The sect is in danger! Return quickly!"
Guang Qiuxian's tone was incredibly grave, and this was the first time Fang Wang had heard him speak in such a tone.
Fang Wang frowned deeply, wondering whether Guang Qiuxian was summoning him specifically, or all disciples.
Very soon, a figure swept in like a breeze and stopped behind him; it was Fang Hanyu.
"Fang Wang, did you hear the Sect Leader's message?" Fang Hanyu asked in a low voice.
Fang Wang stood up and looked at him, replying, "The sect is in danger, return quickly?"
Fang Hanyu nodded, then said, "It seems that this call is directed at all disciples. It looks like Great Abyss Gate has encountered a serious issue. We must go back, Fang Xin and the others are still inside Great Abyss Gate."
Fang Wang hesitated; he had just been through a considerable battle and was in the midst of recovering his Spiritual Power. Returning now seemed inadvisable.
If Guang Qiuxian was calling all disciples on the outside...
Could it be...
