A thought suddenly came to Fang Wang—Zhou Xue once mentioned that Great Abyss Gate faced an assault by many sects of the Demonic Dao because it had produced several Earth Origin Spirit Treasure geniuses. Now that Great Abyss Gate had birthed a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, could the previous calamity have been brought forward?
Wait!
If the Demonic Dao were to invade, choosing this moment, could it be because they had just learned of his battle with the Sword Sect? After the battle ended yesterday, many had departed immediately, clearly spies.
Fang Wang had already slain a Great Demon King, equivalent to someone in the Condensation Spirit Realm, and if they could launch an invasion against Great Abyss Gate while he had just finished a great battle, the likelihood of success would naturally be higher.
First destroy Great Abyss Gate, then encircle or subdue him, this genius of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure?
Countless thoughts flashed through Fang Wang's mind when, suddenly, figures on Flying Swords came skimming over the lake, the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples.
Zhao Chuanqian approached Fang Wang first, speaking swiftly, "Great Abyss Gate is in trouble; we must return first. Fang Wang, you two stay in Sword Heaven Marsh!"
After speaking, he took off on his Flying Sword, with the others following closely.
The Greedy Sleeper, usually jesting and laughing, now wore a serious expression, and although the other disciples looked towards Fang Wang, they dared not speak.
Fang Wang saw that Gu Li was among them, too; she, wearing a veil, did not look towards Fang Wang, her gaze as cold as ever.
A group of several hundred people flew northward on their swords, quickly crossing the mountaintops and vanishing without a trace.
Fang Wang's brows were tightly furrowed; it was clear Zhao Chuanqian was relaying a message to him—they had come to the same conclusion.
The calamity facing Great Abyss Gate was certainly related to Fang Wang's grand battle.
Fang Hanyu said in a grave voice, "You stay. I'll go back. I can't bear to watch our kin suffer!"
Having said that, he was about to leap up, but Fang Wang held him down by the shoulder.
Fang Wang took a deep breath and said, "Wait for me one day, all right?"
"But..."
"Can you alone turn the tide? The Great Abyss Gate is not so weak that it could be easily annihilated! Remember, the Great Abyss Gate has the protective formation!"
Fang Wang said solemnly. Hearing this, Fang Hanyu found it reasonable and nodded in agreement.
Afterward, Fang Wang sat down again, circulating his energy to gather qi, while taking out spiritual energy pills from his storage bag and consuming them to speed up the recovery of his spiritual power.
Fang Hanyu went to find Song Jinyuan and informed him of the situation.
Song Jinyuan wanted to speak but stopped himself. He really wanted to keep Fang Wang behind. What did the life or death of the Great Abyss Gate have to do with him?
But, if Fang Wang could abandon the Great Abyss Gate, might he also abandon Sword Heaven Marsh in the future?
The sun set and the moon rose.
A day passed, and Sword Heaven Marsh had completely fallen into silence, a silence that was terrifying.
As noon approached, Fang Wang got up and rushed towards Fang Hanyu, who had already been waiting for a long time.
"Let's go," Fang Wang said. Although his spiritual power had not fully recovered, seventy percent was enough to handle the situation.
Xiao Zi immediately burrowed into Fang Wang's embrace.
Fang Hanyu nodded, and the two brothers leaped up, landing on their flying swords, which carried them flying north.
Song Jinyuan and a group of sword servants watched as the two brothers departed.
Gu Tianxiong walked over from the side and said with a smile, "Young Song, I should be going too. Next time, we'll spar again."
Song Jinyuan turned to look at him and bowed with his fists clenched.
The sparring between the two had ended with Song Jinyuan's victory, and thanks to Gu Tianxiong, Song Jinyuan had regained confidence. Gu Tianxiong was humorous and fun-loving, and Song Jinyuan had long considered him a friend.
Gu Tianxiong turned around and walked in another direction, leaving behind some words:
"When we meet again, I don't know how much Fang Wang will have grown. Young Song, you need to work hard, lest you lose even the qualification to follow him."
Song Jinyuan wasn't offended, but instead, he smiled.
...
Over the mountain ranges, Fang Wang and Fang Hanyu controlled their flying swords, traveling at a great speed. In just one hour, they had flown over nine hundred miles, which was still not their full speed, considering the long journey ahead.
Throughout the trip, neither of the two exchanged words, each occupied with his own thoughts.
Suddenly.
Xiao Zi poked her head out from Fang Wang's embrace. Fang Wang seemed to sense something, squinting his eyes, and he came to a stop immediately.
Fang Hanyu stopped as well and asked in surprise, "What's wrong?"
Fang Wang's gaze was deep as he said, "Hanyu, go back, take another direction to return to the Great Abyss Gate."
Hearing this, Fang Hanyu's brows furrowed tightly, and he pressed for an answer, "Why?"
"Idiot! There are enemies ahead! And in huge numbers, we've been ambushed! If you stay, you'll only hold us back!" Xiao Zi shouted, her tone extremely tense.
Ambush?
Fang Hanyu suddenly turned his head to look forward, seeing the mountains rise and fall with no end in sight, with no trace of people to be seen.
He naturally wouldn't question Fang Wang's judgment and turned back, teeth clenched, "I must stay with you!"
Fang Wang took a deep breath and said, "Such a grand deployment must be to ambush me. Hurry back, listen to me, think about Fang Xin and the others. Besides, I can escape on my own if I can't fight them off; I can't be worrying about you at that time, can I?"
After hearing this, Fang Hanyu clenched his teeth, not lingering any longer, and immediately controlled his flying sword to return the way they had come.
Once he had disappeared into the horizon, Xiao Zi couldn't help but ask, "Master, what should we do? Hide?"
Fang Wang fixed his gaze ahead, saying, "We can't hide. If we do, they'll investigate, and that will put Hanyu in danger. Moreover, my clan members are also heading this way."
Half an hour earlier, he and Fang Hanyu had spotted the figures of the Fang Family members. They were proceeding on foot, about four hundred miles away from their current location.
Fang Wang continued to ride the sword forward, but not as fast as before.
Although Xiao Zi was scared, she still positioned herself on Fang Wang's shoulder, vigilantly surveying their surroundings.
After about ten miles, a cold laugh rang out:
"Fang Wang, the Heavenly Sword Saint, do you understand that blood debts must be paid in blood?"
Fang Wang's eyes locked onto a peak several miles ahead, where hundreds of cultivators were standing, with a man in a blood robe at the forefront, wearing a skull crown, and a red scorpion scuttling over his bare chest, both ferocious and terrifying.
It wasn't just that peak—other cultivators also began to appear on other surrounding mountains, and from the woods on both sides of him as well, figures sprang forth.
Green Cicada Valley!
Fang Wang recognized their identity.
Indeed, who else but Green Cicada Valley would dispatch so many people to ambush him?
Fang Wang slowly descended, landing on the mid-mountain slope below.
He raised his right hand and drew out the Heavenly Palace Halberd, whispering, "What follows will be a fierce battle; are you ready?"
In his spiritual perception, there were at least ten thousand enemies surrounding him from all sides—a number that likely wasn't the full extent of his foes.
For the sake of ambushing him, Green Cicada Valley had indeed mobilized a massive force!

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 85: One Man, One Snake Versus an Entire Sect! [4th Update, Vote for Monthly Pass]_1
chapters.content:
As more and more cultivators of Green Cicada Valley leapt out from the surrounding mountains and forests, a surging poison fog rose up in the wilderness. Wherever it passed, flowers, grass, and trees withered at a visibly rapid pace.
Fang Wang stood on the mid-slope, surveying his surroundings, he was completely surrounded.
He didn't attack immediately; instead, he waited for Green Cicada Valley's encirclement to prevent them from going after Fang Hanyu.
Countless poisonous insects flew in from the horizon, darkening the sky. Gradually, the land fell into gloom.
"Even if it were a mountain of knives or a sea of fire, I would accompany the young master. Young master, rest assured, I have stayed in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven for so many years, I've learned quite a few skills!"
Xiao Zi clung to Fang Wang's shoulder, trembling as it spoke, its voice frail but its demonic Qi ready for battle.
Powerful presences erupted, and from even behind Fang Wang in the forest, a multitude of enormous poison insects emerged – beetles, spiders, scorpions, moths, ants, long worms, and more, all were present.
A figure emerged from the rolling poison fog, looking down at Fang Wang, who had his back to him. The man wore a red robe, burly in stature, with a bearded face and long hair streaked black and white, coiled beneath a black centipede. The centipede's long whiskers fluttered like phoenix wings. The poisonous Qi swirling around him was the most formidable.
"Fang Wang, you killed my disciple, Li Hongshuang, do you admit it or not?" the man in red coldly asked, his eyes brimming with greed.
Fang Wang slightly tilted his head, glancing at him with the corner of his eye, and replied, "Who are you from Green Cicada Valley?"
"Green Cicada Valley Master, Pang Tuntian!" the man in red responded, his tone barely concealing his murderous intent.
Fang Wang scoffed mockingly, "I didn't expect the esteemed Green Cicada Valley Master to go to such great lengths just to kill a junior like me!"
Pang Tuntian raised his right hand; blood-colored poison fog gushed from his palm as a whip-like tendril emerged. His expression was ice cold as he said, "Blame yourself for possessing the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure. If you want to live, there is still a chance."
"Kneel down, beg me for mercy, and after I possess your body, I will find a new one for you. You will serve Green Cicada Valley from then on, how about it?"
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang burst into laughter.
More and more Great Cultivators of Green Cicada Valley drew near, all of Profound Heart Realm, numbering in the hundreds. Disciples of Green Cicada Valley beneath the Profound Heart Realm were setting up formations in the distance, each one looking solemn.
Although they had superior numbers, facing Fang Wang, they dared not take him lightly. They believed Green Cicada Valley would capture Fang Wang, but knew subduing the Fang Wang who had slain the Great Demon King and defeated the sword sect would cost them dearly; nobody wanted to be dead.
"If you're unwilling, then wait for me to tear out your sinews and drain your blood until you're utterly weak, before I forcibly possess you!" Pang Tuntian declared coldly, and with that, he viciously lashed out with his whip toward Fang Wang.
The vicious wind tore through nature's spiritual energy, producing a piercing noise.
Rather than retreat, Fang Wang advanced, charging toward Pang Tuntian with the Heavenly Palace Halberd in hand.
The great battle was about to begin!
The Great Cultivators of Green Cicada Valley each brought out their Lifespirit Treasures as they all sped towards Fang Wang.
Facing Pang Tuntian's long whip, Fang Wang dashed forward eight steps before fiercely hurling the Heavenly Palace Halberd.
Boom!
The Heavenly Palace Halberd unleashed a terrifying force, forcefully breaking through the whip and heading unstoppably towards Pang Tuntian.
The Great Perfection's Sword Control Technique!
Enforced with the True Combat Technique!
With each step, Fang Wang had already activated the True Combat Technique; at this moment, he cast aside all distractions, his sole purpose to eliminate as many demonic cultivators of Green Cicada Valley as possible!
That's right, he didn't want to flee!
Pang Tuntian's face turned pale. Faced with the onrushing Heavenly Palace Halberd, he instinctively raised his hands, forming a spiritual power shield.
However, the Heavenly Palace Halberd struck with overwhelming force, scattering the spiritual power shield, severing his arms, and piercing his chest. Blood sprayed as he fell backward into the forest behind him.
Fang Wang came to an almost simultaneous stop, turned, and charged, drawing the Qingjun Sword with his right hand.
In this lopsided battle, he didn't want to deplete his spiritual energy directly, deciding instead to use the simplest methods to slay the most powerful.
"Kill!"
Seeing Pang Tuntian wounded in an instant, the Great Cultivators of Green Cicada Valley, despite shaken expressions, still unleashed their ultimate moves, swarming Fang Wang.
Uncountable spells flooded towards Fang Wang from all directions. He ran to the edge of a cliff and leaped, his eyes ice-cold and resolute, seeing only enemies.
Xiao Zi, perched on Fang Wang's shoulder, also opened its maw wide, its form frozen in time. Man and snake faced the sky full of demonic cultivators, their faces void of fear.
...
In the forest.
Fang Yin walked in the middle of the group, frowning with an inexplicable unease stirring in his heart.
Fang Meng, walking beside him, noticed his expression and scolded, "What's the matter? Tired already? I keep telling you to practice more, but you don't listen!"
Fang Yin replied with a wry smile, "With no progress in cultivation, how can one calm down? I'm not tired, I just feel like something big is happening."
"Humph, always babbling nonsense."
Fang Meng shook his head disdainfully and proceeded onward.
Just then, the Fang Family Disciples ahead gradually stopped, all looking upwards. The forest around them was sparse, allowing a clear view of the sky, and they saw the heavens darken, as if a thunderstorm was about to engulf them, heavily oppressive.
Yet, they heard no sound of thunder.
After a moment of contemplation, Fang Meng spoke, "Alright, let's stop here. Set up camp nearby and prepare to rest."
The Fang Family Disciples had no objections, but while they worked, they couldn't help but turn their heads to look towards the sky repeatedly.
The phenomenon was truly terrifying, filling them with dread and unease.
Fang Yin stood in place, looking toward the horizon with growing unease in his heart.
For some reason, he thought of Fang Wang.
"It shouldn't be possible; that kid is so formidable, how could anything happen to him?"
Fang Yin silently thought to himself, trying desperately to comfort himself, mainly because there was nothing he could do.
At this moment, he suddenly regretted not putting more effort into his cultivation. Even if his talents were mediocre, wouldn't it be worth it to become a little stronger?
...
Dark clouds rolled, the world was enveloped by boundless poison fog. Wherever one looked, forests across the hills had withered, drenched with blood and littered with corpses.
Countless Demonic Cultivators and poisonous insects moved through the poison fog, with various spells bombarding the earth, scattering debris and wildly churning the toxic mists.
On closer look, there was a golden figure flashing swiftly in the direction they faced!
Boom!
The forest exploded, and a giant purple python as vast as a mountain range emerged like a dragon from the abyss, upon whose head stood a dazzling golden figure—Fang Wang himself.
Fang Wang's body was covered with a Golden Scale White Feather Robe, and golden dragon auras swirled around him. He held the Heavenly Palace Halberd in his right hand, his valiant aura as if a divine general had descended from the heavens.
The Golden Scale White Feather Robe was stained with patches of blood, and Xiao Zi was also covered in wounds, but their momentum only grew more ferocious.
"Activate the Myriad Poison Array! Quick, raise the Myriad Poison Array!"
An old cultivator from Green Cicada Valley stood atop the head of a giant ant, his voice hoarse with urgency. As his words faded, a whooshing sound came from the darkness of the poison fog ahead. A cold light flashed, and the Qingjun Sword directly shattered his skull.
New corpses joined the old, uncooled ones!
Xiao Zi rolled forth, its mouth unexpectedly emitting Sword Qi, blasting away the Demonic Cultivators of Green Cicada Valley in its path. Where it passed, dust filled the air, flesh and blood flew, and screams of agony never ceased to reach the ears.
Fang Wang leapt into the air, his figure as majestic as an eagle, wielding the Heavenly Palace Halberd with both hands and furiously smashing downward. A middle-aged Demonic Cultivator tried to block with his knife only to be shaken until his arms and shoulders numbed, his face revealing a look of shock and horror.
He raised his eyes in fear, only to meet Fang Wang's cold gaze.
Without any cruel words, Fang Wang forcefully exerted his strength, chopping off half of the man's body, sending flesh and blood flying, as the middle-aged man screamed in intense agony.
"Stop him!"
Pang Tuntian's voice rose shrilly, his face covered in blood, his arms made up of countless small blood insects, holding a whip in his right hand and a large flag in his left. As he spoke, he quickly gathered power, and a surging crimson miasma, like a tornado, barreled towards Fang Wang.
Fang Wang landed and charged directly towards him, unstoppable.
As he sprinted, he swiftly swung the Heavenly Palace Halberd, scattering the spells that attacked from all directions. Nine fire orbs floated behind his head, forcing the surrounding poison fog to stay away from him. His charge tore a rift through the poisonous morass of the wilderness.
Seeing Fang Wang approaching, Pang Tuntian, despite his trembling heart, immediately swung his whip, smashing it into the ground. The earth cracked open, and strands of blood-colored flames surged from the ground, extending towards Fang Wang.
Protected by the Solaris Scripture, Fang Wang ignored all flames and forced his way through, leaving Pang Tuntian in utter panic.
"This guy..."
Pang Tuntian's heart was filled with terror, as he, with half of Green Cicada Valley's power, was unable to suppress Fang Wang.
How was this possible!
Had the battle with the Sword Sect not cost Fang Wang anything?
Even with the power of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, there had to be a limit to Spiritual Power, right?
Pang Tuntian, realizing this, his eyes hardened with resolve, had no retreat left and was determined to slay Fang Wang.
He let out an enraged roar, his body of flesh exploding into countless blood insects, swarming towards Fang Wang as if to obliterate the sky.
Fang Wang leapt upward, and suddenly, the energy around him condensed into an azure dragon head. As an Azure Dragon, he met the overwhelming tide of blood insects head-on.
The sea of blood insects was torn asunder. Fang Wang's gaze sharpened, and with his right hand wielding the Heavenly Palace Halberd, he thrust forward.
Thrust!
The halberd's blade pieced through Pang Tuntian's chest, revealing that he had not truly transformed into insects but was simply hidden among them.
"You..."
Pang Tuntian's eyes bulged, his face, smeared with blood, resembling a fierce ghost.
Fang Wang's right arm shook, and the Heavenly Palace Halberd immediately cleaved off his head. Endless blood insects tried to get close, but the nine fire orbs behind his head burnt them to ash.
The next second, Fang Wang, holding Pang Tuntian's head, leaped out of the maelstrom of blood insects. He pulled out a cloth from his storage bag, quickly wrapped the head, and then placed it into the bag.
He then turned and, holding the Heavenly Palace Halberd, charged towards Xiao Zi's location.
As the blood insect whirlwind dissipated, Pang Tuntian's headless corpse fell to the ground.
"The Valley Master is dead, kill! We must avenge the Valley Master!"
A gaunt man shouted angrily. Clearly of high status, he stood on a toad as large as a hill with four poison flags revolving around him, gathering a formation.
All Green Cicada Valley cultivators who heard this saw red in their eyes. By now, they had forgotten their fear, their gaze fixed only on Fang Wang and Xiao Zi.
They must slay Fang Wang, or else he would remain an eternal menace!
Boom—
The ground shook violently, and the poison cloud in the distance churned intensely, coalescing into a rising magenta canopy that spread a thick oppressing sensation throughout the land.

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 86 The Myriad Poison Array is Established! Black Dragon Breaks Through the Array!
chapters.content:
```
The earth trembled, and the poison fog that stretched over ten miles churned, with a dark sky curtain forming at its edges, rising up. At a glance, no gap was visible except in the heavens.
Fang Wang swiftly arrived above Xiao Zi, and demonic cultivators from all directions of Green Cicada Valley ceased their attacks, pulling back and distancing themselves.
"Young master, this formation is not simple!"
Xiao Zi said anxiously, her gentle voice again filled with fear and worry.
Fang Wang stared expressionlessly into the distance and said, "A large formation assembled by tens of thousands of cultivators is naturally not simple. Such a formation can easily suppress even Condensation Spirit Realm cultivators."
The battle had been raging for some time, and he had slain no less than a thousand people. His Spiritual Power had been more than half depleted, but the number of demonic cultivators from Green Cicada Valley was still considerable. Looking around, demonic cultivators could be seen in every direction.
Even with Pang Tuntian dead, Green Cicada Valley had not given up.
It seemed their true reliance was on this so-called Myriad Poison Array!
Fang Wang had heard of the Myriad Poison Array of Green Cicada Valley before. It was the valley's premier formation, the reason they could rank among the Nine Great Sects even without a Condensation Spirit Realm Great Cultivator.
Once the Myriad Poison Array was activated, heaven and earth would wail, and all life would decay!
"It seems it's time to get serious."
Fang Wang murmured to himself. He had not yet used spells with a wide range of destruction because there were too many enemies, all nimble cultivators scattered in different directions, attacking him from a distance. If he used energy-consuming spells, he could easily be worn down to death.
Of course, if he wanted to escape, Green Cicada Valley couldn't stop him!
But his fighting now was for the Fang Family members behind him and also for the Great Abyss Gate!
The Great Abyss Gate was likely facing an onslaught from the Demonic Dao. If he could break through and instill fear in Green Cicada Valley, the pressure on the Great Abyss Gate would naturally lessen.
In his previous life, even without him, Zhou Xue, the Great Abyss Gate had managed to turn peril into safety. Without Green Cicada Valley, they should be able to hold on this time as well.
As for the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples from the Fang Family, although he was worried about them, he still held hope in his heart.
Because there was still one person he could rely on!
"The Myriad Poison Array is activated, everyone channel your Spiritual Power to crush this demon in one fell swoop!"
The gaunt man standing on a toad roared angrily. The poison flags around him burst with Spiritual Power, soaring upwards. Thunderclouds above the Myriad Poison Array churned violently, and streaks of green light pierced the clouds and fell.
Tens of thousands of demonic cultivators followed suit. At the same time, outside the Myriad Poison Array, more cultivators from Green Cicada Valley were arriving. They came to the edge of the formation, raising their hands to augment the Myriad Poison Array with their own Spiritual Power. The landscape was filled with the figures of demonic cultivators.
Thunderous roars—
The sea of clouds parted, and a vast green glyph appeared high above the Myriad Poison Array, its diameter exceeding ten miles. Fang Wang looked up, unable to discern what glyph it was—whether a complex character or some kind of pattern. It was gathering nature's spiritual energy, and a terrifying pressure descended, bending the massive serpentine body of Xiao Zi downwards.
"Young master, I can't hold on much longer!"
Xiao Zi cried out with gritted teeth, her body trembling.
This scene greatly exhilarated the demonic cultivators of Green Cicada Valley, and the elders shouted to boost morale.
"He certainly can't withstand the Myriad Poison Array, we must avenge the valley master!"
"No matter how monstrous his talent, he has only cultivated for sixteen years, even his strength has limits!"
"Hahaha, the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure will die by our hands, and once this news spreads, it will certainly deter the other great sects!"
"I have to admit, he really is strong. If it weren't for the elders buying time, we wouldn't have been able to form the Myriad Poison Array and would be at a loss against him."
"After all, his power is comparable to that of a Condensation Spirit Realm, it's no exaggeration to say that he is now among the top five in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm."
Each demonic cultivator was sweating profusely, giving their all to strengthen the Myriad Poison Array. Their faces bore expressions of excitement, anticipation, and disdain.
The greater Fang Wang's strength, the greater the sense of achievement in slaying him.
Facing the Myriad Poison Array, whose might was like that of Heavenly Might, Fang Wang was not afraid. He looked up at the huge green glyph in the sky, his Golden Scale White Feather Robe fluttering in the wind. Strands of golden Qi Dragon swirled around him like flames that could never be extinguished, emitting their unique glow on the dim battlefield, impossible to hide.
"Xiao Zi, don't you yearn to transform into a dragon?"
Fang Wang looked up at the firmament and murmured softly.
Xiao Zi widened her serpentine eyes and asked, "What do you mean? Young master, can you make me turn into a dragon?"
Xiao Zi remembered the spell Fang Wang used to break the forbidden gate in the past. Could it be happening again?
No sooner had the words left her mouth than she felt a scorching wave of Spiritual Power enveloping her serpentine body, Fang Wang's Spiritual Power.
Xiao Zi's serpent eyes brightened. In that moment, she felt as if she was becoming one with Fang Wang.
Fang Wang stood on top of Xiao Zi's head, activating the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art. His Spiritual Power overflowed from his body, turning into Qi Dragon that covered Xiao Zi's massive serpentine body, which began to condense into the shape of a dragon.
Qi Dragon!
Shape Dragon!
White Dragon!
When Xiao Zi transformed into a White Dragon, a dragon's roar echoed between heaven and earth, unstoppable by the rolling fog.
All demonic cultivators' eyes were locked onto the White Dragon. In the dim world, the figure of the White Dragon displayed a majestic and domineering presence.
"What is that?"
"A dragon... the legendary True Dragon?"
"What's happening? How did that serpent demon turn into a dragon?"
"No, it must be some kind of sorcery; everyone, be careful!"
```
"Still trying to struggle at death's door? With so many of us setting up the formation, it's impossible for them to break through!"
The Demonic Cultivators of Green Cicada Valley were continuously shocked, while the higher-level Demonic Cultivators shouted out, calming the unease of their subordinates.
After transforming into the White Dragon, the pressure on Xiao Zi had sharply decreased, and it began to lift its enormous body.
However, Fang Wang felt it still wasn't enough!
Xiao Zi's dragon body began to change color, from white to blue, and then from blue to yellow. With each color change, its body doubled in size, making Xiao Zi appear to grow suddenly larger before the eyes of all the Demonic Cultivators, a sight both majestic and magnificent.
As Xiao Zi grew larger, the fear and unease in the hearts of the Demonic Cultivators deepened. They could only clench their teeth and increase the output of their Spiritual Power.
The yellow turned to purple, purple to red, and red to gold!
The hundred-zhang-tall Golden Dragon roared skyward, its dragon's roar shocking the heavens and earth and stirring the hearts of all.
The gaunt elder hurriedly shouted, "Activate the kill formation!"
The thousand Demonic Cultivators primarily controlling the Myriad Poison Array simultaneously performed their Spells, their hand movements neat and uniform. The azure light runes in the sky trembled violently as the terrifying might of the formation erupted. Vast poisonous fogs poured out, enveloping the azure light runes, which then plummeted downwards.
This descent was like the sky collapsing!
The ground shook, and all the Demonic Cultivators in formation trembled. They gritted their teeth and stared deathly at the Golden Dragon within the formation.
Standing on Xiao Zi's head, Fang Wang's gaze sharpened, and Xiao Zi only felt an irresistible force supporting it to ascend rapidly.
Hum——
The Golden Dragon soared into the sky. In the instant it leaped, the Golden Dragon transformed into a Black Dragon!
The highest level of the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art!
As the Golden Dragon transformed into the Black Dragon, its dragon might grew even more powerful, a momentum that made the hearts of the tens of thousands of Green Cicada Valley disciples tremble came at them head-on!
This was the ultimate aura of destruction!
The Black Dragon's speed increased drastically, its posture wildly aggressive. It viciously ascended into the clouds, shattering the azure light runes. In an instant, a bright flash engulfed the entire heaven and earth, causing all the Demonic Cultivators to instinctively close their eyes.
Even the Fang Family members resting in the distant forest were dazzled by the flash.
Fang Hanyu, who was speeding on his sword through the mountain forest, seemed to sense something. He turned his head and was met with a strong burst of light, which caused his hair to flutter.
Fortunately, the bursts of light were but fleeting.
"Fang Wang... you must survive!"
Fang Hanyu gritted his teeth, thinking that if it were a one-on-one fight, he would be full of confidence in Fang Wang, believing no one could stop him. However, with Fang Wang facing so many enemies, he couldn't help but feel anxious for him.
...
The Black Dragon ascended, powerfully smashing the enormous azure light runes—the Myriad Poison Array was instantly broken!
Overbearingly unparalleled!
All the Green Cicada Valley Demonic Cultivators were still dazed from the light when they opened their eyes to see the Myriad Poison Array broken, and the terrifying backlash caused them to vomit blood and fly backward. Some lower-realm Soul Sculpting Realm Cultivators died on the spot.
The rolling poisonous fog swept through like a terrifying wave in all directions, unstoppable, carrying away the trees along its path.
The gaunt elder was also injured by the shock wave. He used his own set of poison banners to counter the impact. His face was filled with fear and despair, and along his line of sight, a huge hole was torn open in the thunderclouds in the sky, a giant Black Dragon's head peeking through it. In front of this Black Dragon's head, anyone would feel their own insignificance.
"It's over..."
The gaunt elder quivered, his voice trembling and his face completely bloodless.
At that moment, even the poisonous insects raised by Green Cicada Valley felt fear—an instinct they could not control.
In the distance, a male Cultivator lay on the ground shaking as he propped himself up, with a trembling voice he gazed at the distant Black Dragon and said, "The Myriad... Myriad Poison Array... it's broken..."
"Run for your lives!"
From another direction, the exhausted shout of a Demonic Cultivator shattered the silence of heaven and earth. The morale of the Green Cicada Valley instantly collapsed, and the surviving Demonic Cultivators scrambled to their feet, fleeing the scene in utter panic. Even the elders were terrified out of their wits, no longer daring to shout commands, and they ran faster than the disciples.
The Valley Master's death did not scare them, for they still had the Myriad Poison Array!
But with the Myriad Poison Array broken, they truly lost all confidence!
Fang Wang focused his eyes and noticed that a batch of Demonic Cultivators was fleeing in the direction of the Fang Family's retreat path. He immediately instructed Xiao Zi to pursue and kill them.
The Black Dragon dissipated, and the dragon's energy dispersed like wind, revealing Xiao Zi's figure. Xiao Zi's body was originally considered enormous, but after the Black Dragon vanished, it seemed to shrink all at once, its formerly gigantic snake body appearing rather insignificant.
"Master! That was so powerful! I really transformed into a dragon just now!"
Xiao Zi called out excitedly, while standing on its head, Fang Wang managed to crack a smile.
Transforming into the Black Dragon had completely drained all his Spiritual Power, but the battle was not over yet—he could still fight with the strength of his physical body.
He stood proudly on the snake's head, his right hand gripping the Heavenly Palace Halberd, his left hand reaching into his storage bag to take out a Spiritual Energy pill to consume.
The Green Cicada Valley had slaughtered the Tai Yuan Sect Disciples and tortured Fang Hanyu—the feud was already unsettled, and now they had attempted to besiege him. This hatred was now irreconcilable!
Fang Wang's eyes were filled with murderous intent!
Even though he was drained of Spiritual Power, his Combat Heart still burned fiercely.
Xiao Zi was fast, following the direction pointed out by the Heavenly Palace Halberd, swiftly flying and constantly spewing out Sword Qi, shooting and killing the fleeing Demonic Cultivators along the way.
Not being surrounded felt incredibly exciting to it!
The Green Cicada Valley Demonic Cultivators had been scared out of their wits; they dared not counterattack and could only focus on running for their lives. Those Cultivators who were chased met with certain death.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 87: The Position of the Chief Disciple of the Main Meridian
chapters.content:
Dusk gradually descended.
On the hillside, Fang Wang strode forward, his Golden Scale White Feather Robe covered in blood, even his face smeared with traces of it, Xiao Zi lay on his shoulder, equally drenched in blood.
He walked over to a large rock and sat down, the afterglow of the setting sun spilling over him, casting half of his face in shadow, among the mountains between him and the setting sun lay the enormous bodies of poisonous insects and the corpses of Green Cicada Valley demonic cultivators, a shocking sight to behold.
Exhausted!
Exhausted like never before!
Fang Wang stored the Heavenly Palace Halberd in his Treasured Spirit Space, he exhaled a breath of turbid air, at this moment he wanted to do nothing, he didn't even feel like gathering Qi, he just wanted to be idle for a while.
Before this battle, he longed for an opportunity to fight with all his might, and this battle indeed required his utmost effort. However, there were too many enemies, exhausting both his Spiritual Power and physical strength. After using Black Dragon to break through the Myriad Poison Array, he fought for a hundred miles.
Those demonic cultivators dared not confront him, but in their escape, they released poisonous insects wildly, buying themselves time.
Fang Wang didn't know how many poisonous insects he had killed, thankfully the Golden Scale White Feather Robe could block the splashes of venom.
Moreover, with the existence of the Combat Heart, he was able to enter the perfect state for battle, with no insect or spell able to ambush him.
Reflecting on this battle, he realized his shortcomings. His combat strength could sweep through most Cultivators in the Condensation Spirit Realm, but he was ultimately in the Profound Heart Realm, with limited Spiritual Power, not sufficient to eradicate a sect single-handedly.
However, in this battle, he had slain thousands of demonic cultivators, causing great damage to the vitality of Green Cicada Valley. For a long time to come, he guessed they wouldn't dare to show their heads; if some enemies took the opportunity to kick them while they were down, Green Cicada Valley might even be eradicated.
Just among the Profound Heart Realm cultivators, Fang Wang had killed at least a hundred, which was a devastating loss for any sect.
"I need to break through to the Condensation Spirit Realm as soon as possible. Then, when facing such a situation, I can sweep them away cleanly using Celestial Sword Intent,"
Fang Wang sighed inwardly. The Celestial Sword Intent consumed great amounts of Spiritual Power. The demonic cultivators of Green Cicada Valley were spread out widely, with countless poisonous insects.
If he were to use Celestial Sword Intent in battle, probably, not even one-fifth of the enemies would be dead before his Spiritual Power would be exhausted—after all, the participating Green Cicada Valley demonic cultivators were not merely in the Qi Cultivation Realm, and they had mobilized their elite forces, whose variety of spells seemed novel to him even now.
Xiao Zi lay on Fang Wang's shoulder, silent as if dead, also extremely exhausted. Even before the array was broken, it was already wounded all over, and after the array was broken, it got too excited and consumed its demonic power even faster.
Fang Wang slightly raised his head, looking into the dusk, his thoughts drifting.
Only when night descended did he regain some energy and began to sit and gather Qi while also taking Spiritual Energy pills.
Xiao Zi opened its mouth, starting to consume the Essence of the Sun and Moon. The night was solemn; neither the person nor the demon felt like talking.
Until the morning of the next day, Fang Wang was still gathering Qi, the bloodstains on him already washed clean, thanks to Xiao Zi. It possessed water-attribute spells, and with water spraying from its mouth, it helped him clean up.
Suddenly sensing something, Fang Wang lifted his hand and produced the disciple token.
"The crisis of the sect has been resolved."
The voice of Zhao Chuanqian came from within, weary.
Fang Wang breathed a sigh of relief. As expected of the future strongest sect, it only took them two days to repel the enemy. But from Zhao Chuanqian's tone, the battle must have been fierce.
Although Fang Wang was concerned about the Fang Family members, if someone really had died, he going back wouldn't be able to revive them; if they were still alive, the Taiyuan Gate would surely take care of them.
He felt reassured, not needing to rush back to the sect for the moment.
He stood up and said, "Xiao Zi, it's time to collect the spoils of war."
Xiao Zi awoke, dazed for a moment before excitedly saying, "Right, almost forgot, Young Master, let's hurry!"
Fang Wang revealed a smile and headed down the mountain.
Following the direction he moved, the woodlands were withered, the corpses of the poisonous insects adding a sinister atmosphere to the already desolate mountain scenery, with dark poison fog still lingering in the sky, slow to disperse, all signifying the grimness of yesterday's battle.
Thus, Fang Wang and Xiao Zi started to search for storage bags along the way, with each demonic cultivator from Green Cicada Valley having stored poison in their bags, making their collection rather bothersome. Fortunately, they were both unafraid of poison; Fang Wang had the Solaris True Fire, and Xiao Zi was a venomous snake itself.
Two days later, the corpses of the Green Cicada Valley demonic cultivators they encountered had started to rot. Their flesh and blood, filled with poisonous properties, made one wonder what kind of cultivation they had undergone.
It's worth mentioning that along the way they encountered some loose cultivators also engaging in this activity.
"Stop there, you brat, daring to collect corpses alone, aren't you afraid of dying? State your name!"
Four loose cultivators landed in front of Fang Wang. The leader, holding a knife, said in a deep voice. They were quite cautious and did not attack directly.
Fang Wang responded cheerfully, "These are all my spoils of war. And you, daring to rob my things, are courting death?"
Xiao Zi popped its head out from behind Fang Wang, hissing, "My master is a Taiyuan Gate Direct Disciple, the Sword Saint's Successor, known as Heaven Yuan Sword Saint. Have you ever heard of him?"
Upon hearing this, the four loose cultivators' complexions changed drastically, and they backpedaled.
"Is he Fang Wang?"
"Sword Heaven Marsh isn't too far from here; it could indeed be him..."
"Could they be bluffing us?"
"Do you want to bet? I'm not willing to accompany!"
After a few murmurs among themselves, one quickly withdrew, and the other three did not dare stay, even one of them bowed to Fang Wang, scared he would hold them accountable.
Fang Wang couldn't help but chuckle; he didn't pursue them. With so many corpses, surely someone would pick up leftovers; he just didn't want someone to take away the storage bags in front of him.
On the other side.
The Fang Family members also encountered the corpses of Green Cicada Valley demonic cultivators. Looking ahead at the fields strewn with insect corpses, everyone's faces were filled with fear and unease.
Looking around, the mountain forest ahead was withered, forming a straight line stretching to the ends of the earth, eerily spine-chilling. It was hard to imagine what kind of battle had taken place here just days ago.
"Let's make a detour,"
said Fang Meng. Though it would be quite strenuous, no one objected, as everyone preferred to stay away from finding out the truth.
Fang Yin couldn't help worrying about Fang Wang, although Fang Wang should be inside Sword Heaven Marsh, he was terrified that Fang Wang might have been involved in this unknown war.
Previously, to avoid worrying them, Fang Wang had specifically taken a detour when passing by them, so they wouldn't notice him.
...
In the main peak of Great Abyss Gate, within the Shiyuan Hall, the nine peak masters were present, along with many elders and direct disciples.
Guang Qiuxian was meditating on a cushion, his face pale, making him appear very weak.
The major disciples from each peak were reporting the number of casualties, making everyone's faces look extremely grim.
Zhou Xue stood behind the first peak master, listening in silence.
After the major disciples finished their reports, an elder said, "Chi Devil Sect, Huangyu Mountain, and Ancient Demon Mountain ganged up to attack us; we can't let this go unavenged!"
As soon as these words came out, other elders chimed in:
"Exactly, so much for their damned peace treaty; no, we must seek vengeance against these three Demonic Sects!"
"Nearly twenty thousand of our disciples have died; this is the biggest casualty the Great Abyss Gate has suffered in nearly three hundred years!"
"Luckily Green Cicada Valley didn't join them, or we might not have been able to hold out."
"I suggest we write to the Taiqing Gate, the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, the Tian Shu Sect, and the Crimson Sect to join forces and declare war on the Demonic Dao!"
The direct disciples from each peak were equally outraged, barely able to contain the murderous and angry looks in their eyes.
Vice Sect Leader Chen Anshi frowned, "Alright, if we're to seek vengeance, we'll also need time to recuperate!"
At his words, the elders immediately quieted down, a testament to his authority.
Chen Anshi took a step forward, his gaze fixed on Guang Qiuxian, "Sect Leader, you've been gravely injured and will probably need some time to recover. And I have to oversee matters concerning the Dragon Vein. It's time we choose a main meridian great disciple to oversee all our sect's affairs and stabilize the situation."
"I propose Lu Yuanjun for the position of Great Abyss Gate's great disciple. His contributions and experience are sufficient. During this crisis, he single-handedly held off the Chi Devil Sect Sect Master, which was no small feat. Does anyone object?"
As he finished speaking, he turned to look at everyone in the hall.
The atmosphere in the hall became tense.
Yang Yuanzi immediately stood up, "My disciple Fang Wang, having inherited the Sword Saint's legacy, slain the Great Demon King, defeated Sword Sect's Kong Xi, and become a sensation across the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, is the fitting choice for the position of the great disciple according to the public's expectation!"
Following his statement, many elders agreed, although Lu Yuanjun was well-liked, the complicated factions within the Great Abyss Gate would not allow everyone to favor him.
Hearing Yang Yuanzi's words, Lu Yuanjun remained motionless, still standing serenely behind the first peak master.
Chen Anshi, looking at Yang Yuanzi, said in a stern voice, "Fang Wang's talent and reputation are indeed very high, surpassing all other disciples. However, his contributions to the Great Abyss Gate are too few to convince the masses. Should the leadership of the sect also be based on talent? Then what would the meaning be behind the sacrifices our disciples make for the Great Abyss Gate?"
His words won the approval of the elders who supported Lu Yuanjun.
Even someone spitefully said, "Maybe this calamity was brought upon us because he drew too much attention. If we knew about the emergence of a Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure within the Demonic Sect, would we not act?"
This hit home for most of the people present.
The catastrophe had come suddenly, and most of the disciples who had been sacrificed died within the first half hour. Aside from Fang Wang's Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, what else could warrant such a massive move by the Demonic Dao?
"Ridiculous, Fang Wang never told anyone about the grade of his spirit treasure. It's us, the elders, who failed to protect him, and we exposed the grade of his spirit treasure, placing him in danger. How can you blame him for that? Should the Great Abyss Gate not produce unparalleled geniuses in the future?
How would your words make the other sects and the entire Cultivation World view our Great Abyss Gate?" Yang Yuanzi said forcefully, leaving the elder who had spoken speechless.
Lu Yuanjun narrowed his eyes coldly, looking at Yang Yuanzi.
Another elder frowned, "But his contributions are indeed very low, which makes it hard to convince the masses!"
At the mention of contributions to the sect, the elders supporting Lu Yuanjun had more to say.
The hall became noisy once more with ongoing disputes.
Guang Qiuxian's brow furrowed tightly, unwilling to speak.
At this moment,
Zhang, the elder from Task Hall, seemed to sense something. He raised his hand to take out a jade slip from his storage bag and read it with his spiritual sense. His face changed drastically immediately afterward.
Chen Anshi, staring at Yang Yuanzi, snorted coldly, "Yang Junior Brother, the position of the great disciple is crucial to the Great Abyss Gate; please be fair in this matter!"
Yang Yuanzi was about to retort when elder Zhang suddenly exclaimed, "Elders, Green Cicada Valley has mobilized nearly twenty thousand disciples to besiege Fang Wang!"
As these words were declared, the hall fell into sudden silence.
Guang Qiuxian stood up abruptly, his injuries throbbing as he bit back pain and asked, "Where? What's the situation?"

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 88: The Disciple of the Demon Monarch [Third Release]
chapters.content:
Within Shiyuan Hall, all eyes were on Elder Zhang, and Zhou Xue's brows were also deeply furrowed.
Elder Zhang's whole body trembled, the hand holding the Jade Slip seemed to not believe the intelligence he had received.
Yang Yuanzi urged in a hurried voice, "Just say it, will you! What are you quivering for?"
Lu Yuanjun stared intently at Elder Zhang, his eyes unable to hide his anticipation.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, Elder Zhang took a deep breath and ground out through clenched teeth:
"Green Cicada Valley Master Pang Tuntian set up an ambush in the Hundred Thousand Mountains. The elite troops of Green Cicada Valley emerged, with the least powerful disciple also being in the Soul Sculpting Realm. Totalling twenty thousand in number, they also established the Myriad Poison Array!"
Myriad Poison Array!
These three words caused a stir among those present. Guang Qiuxian even spat out a mouthful of blood in shock, falling weakly onto the cushion.
"Green Cicada Valley! Damn them!" Chen Anshi cursed through gritted teeth.
Yang Yuanzi was struck as if by lightning, standing frozen on the spot. The three Direct Disciples from the third branch also showed signs of panic, with the senior disciple Li Yu trembling all over.
Lu Yuanjun struggled to contain the excitement in his heart, but the corners of his mouth involuntarily turned upwards with joy. Fortunately, at this moment, no one noticed him.
Zhou Xue narrowed her eyes, filled with a cold light.
"Wait! Sect Leader, don't panic! I haven't finished speaking! Fang Wang isn't dead!" Elder Zhang, seeing Guang Qiuxian vomit blood, hurriedly shouted, once again attracting everyone's attention.
Yang Yuanzi immediately approached him and, seizing his robe, cursed angrily, "Can't you say everything at once?"
"This news is too shocking; I hadn't yet come to my senses," Elder Zhang said aggrievedly. "Fang Wang is fine. It is Green Cicada Valley that suffered!"
Without waiting for everyone to ask, he quickly reported:
"Green Cicada Valley, with nearly twenty thousand of its elite troops, attacked Fang Wang alone. Little did they know Fang Wang had a Demon King in his hand. One man and one demon resisted the assault of Green Cicada Valley. Green Cicada Valley Master Pang Tuntian was beheaded by Fang Wang on the battlefield. Even the Myriad Poison Array they set up was forcefully broken through by Fang Wang.
It is suspected that Fang Wang performed the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, and what's more, it was the never-before-seen Black Dragon Form!"
"Over five thousand from Green Cicada Valley were slaughtered by Fang Wang. The exact casualties are still unclear. In the end, Green Cicada Valley was so devastated that they were forced to flee in all directions!"
"This news is already starting to spread in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. The intelligence in my hand was extracted from a Green Cicada Valley Demonic Cultivator by one of the Direct Disciples!"
Having said all this in one breath, the entire Shiyuan Hall fell into silence, the expressions on everyone's faces stupefied, even Guang Qiuxian's mouth gaped open unconsciously.
Zhou Xue's expression returned to normal, the corners of her mouth lifting in a smile.
Lu Yuanjun was like a man struck by lightning, standing there dumbfounded.
Chen Anshi, who had been vigorously supporting Lu Yuanjun before, also froze, wondering if he had heard wrong.
"Is it true?" Yang Yuanzi asked while grasping Elder Zhang's shoulder, his voice shaky with excitement coloring his face.
Elder Zhang, equally moved, handed the Jade Slip to Yang Yuanzi and said, "Absolutely true. Read it for yourself if you don't believe me!"
Yang Yuanzi immediately sent his divine consciousness into the Jade Slip.
"Hahahahaha—"
Guang Qiuxian suddenly burst into loud laughter. Laughing too intensely aggravated his injuries, causing him to cough and hastily sit down to channel his cultivation.
After Yang Yuanzi finished reading the Jade Slip, he started laughing as well. The other Elders crowded around, snatching the Jade Slip from his hand to read the intelligence contained within.
"It's true!"
"He has become this powerful?"
"The Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure has never appeared before; indeed, we cannot measure him with common sense."
"No wonder Green Cicada Valley didn't come; they were held back by him."
"More than just held back, so many Elders died, even the Valley Master is dead, Green Cicada Valley is finished!"
The Elders excitedly discussed among themselves, while the Direct Disciples also felt exhilarated, whispering to each other. Disciples who had close relations with Lu Yuanjun looked towards him with worry.
As for this, Lu Yuanjun had no choice but to show a smile of joy, but unfortunately, this time it was clear to everyone that his smile was strained.
There was no helping it, the impact was too great!
If Fang Wang had merely broken through the siege, that would have been shocking enough.
But Fang Wang went so far as to slaughter through Green Cicada Valley!
It was beyond imagination!
Could it be that Fang Wang had become so strong that he could contend against an entire sect by himself?
Zhao Chuanqian turned to Guang Qiuxian and said gravely, "Sect Leader, the position as the senior-most disciple needs reconsideration."
Upon hearing this, quite a few Elders agreed. This time, Yang Yuanzi did not speak; he stood aside, lost in a state of joy for a long time.
Chen Anshi held back his words and, in the end, gave up.
Breaking through Green Cicada Valley was an enormous merit indeed!
Guang Qiuxian took a deep breath and announced, "The position of the senior-most disciple will be discussed upon Fang Wang's return. During the period of my recuperation, Elder Zhao Chuanqian will take charge of the sect's affairs."
No one objected; the vast majority of Elders showed expressions of joy. With a Great Cultivator like Fang Wang in the Great Abyss Gate, the future was bound to soar!
Lu Yuanjun's face remained calm, and no one could see through what he was thinking.
...
Whoosh——
In the midst of the mountains, Fang Wang sat cross-legged by the edge of a small lake, practicing his Qi Gathering meditation. Next to the lake was a waterfall, fifty feet high, with water splashing in all directions.
On the other side of Fang Wang, not far away, numerous storage bags piled up on the grass. Xiao Zi was currently checking each one, and with every bag she opened, poisonous insects would emerge, only to be swallowed by her in one gulp, which was enough to make one feel nauseous.
Six days had passed since the battle with Green Cicada Valley, and Fang Wang planned to return to the Great Abyss Gate after his Spiritual Power had fully recovered, to prevent the possibility of Demonic Sects ambushing him on the rest of the journey.
"Come out now, how much longer would Your Excellency intend to hide in the shadows?"
Fang Wang suddenly spoke out and slowly opened his eyes, his gaze fixed on the woods across the small lake.
Hearing this, Xiao Zi raised her snake head anxiously and looked across the lake.
The woods on the other side of the lake were silent. Five breaths passed, and just as Xiao Zi was about to speak, a voice rang out:
"Oh dear, the young master has discovered me. Don't be angry, young master. I have nothing to do with Green Cicada Valley. I followed you because I care about you."
This voice was coy and charming, striking at one's heartstrings and provoking fanciful thoughts.
A willowy woman dressed in green emerged from the forest; she was barefoot, and as she walked, her thighs gleamed through the slits of her dress, pale and luminescent. Her neckline was low, revealing a deep cleavage. She was strikingly beautiful, with her long hair twisted into a bun, adorned with three pearl-encrusted hairpins.
At first glance, Fang Wang thought the woman had escaped from a brothel, but he felt a dangerous aura emanating from her.
Not weaker than the Sword Sect's Kong Xi!
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and asked, "Who are you?"
So white...
The woman in green covered her mouth and chuckled, "My name is Tu Caiyi. I wonder if the young master has heard of me?"
Fang Wang stared at her, his right hand conjuring the Qiankun Fan, and then he stood up and said, "I haven't heard of you. If you're here as a foe, then come forth."
"Oh, young master, you're really in a hurry. I've already said, I came here out of concern for you. Oh right, I forgot to mention the name of my sect. I am from the Jin Xiao Sect, the Eastern Slaughter Heavenly King. You must have heard of this, haven't you?" the woman in green said with a coquettish pose, throwing a flirtatious glance at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang almost got goosebumps. This woman was really overdoing it, making him itch to fan her aside.
Suppressing the impulse to swat her, he asked, "The Jin Xiao Sect? What brings you here? Does it have to do with Zhou Xue?"
"The young master is truly clever. Ever since the Sword Sect challenged you, Zhou Xue has been worried and asked me to protect you in secret until you return to the Great Abyss Gate. Your battle with the Sword Sect... it really piqued my interest. A man like you is exactly what I adore..." Tu Caiyi said, even licking her lips at this point.
It really was Zhou Xue!
Fang Wang felt warmed by the thought; this woman, like him, said one thing but meant another.
Tu Caiyi sighed, "Seeing the young master being surrounded and attacked by Green Cicada Valley, I was so anxious. I never expected the young master to be so powerful, managing to break through Green Cicada Valley with just a snake demon by his side. I admire you."
"Young master, I see you are recovering your Spiritual Power. Shall I give you a hand? I know a dual cultivation technique that could greatly increase your cultivation."
Having said that, she stared intently at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang didn't fully trust her and directly declined, "No need, I don't like women!"
Tu Caiyi paused for a moment upon hearing this.
Xiao Zi turned its head to look at Fang Wang, its snake eyes shining brightly.
"What exactly is Zhou Xue's status within the Jin Xiao Sect that she could ask someone of your standing to protect me?" Fang Wang couldn't help but inquire.
Tu Caiyi brushed her hair aside and said, "Her? She is the precious disciple of the Demon Monarch. I must say, she has some vision and has helped me a lot. I owe her my life."
Her tone had changed, becoming much colder, a stark contrast to her previously frivolous demeanor.
The disciple of the Demon Monarch?
For some reason, Fang Wang felt inexplicably annoyed.
"May I ask if the Demon Monarch is male or female?" Fang Wang continued to press Tu Caiyi.
Upon hearing this, Tu Caiyi couldn't help but giggle behind her hand.
"What would it matter if the Monarch is a male? If the Demon Monarch wants to marry her, what would you do then?" Tu Caiyi countered with a cold laugh.
Fang Wang calmly responded, "It wouldn't matter to me; I just want to hear the truth, why provoke me?"
Tu Caiyi shook her head, unable to hold back a sigh, "You're just like Zhou Xue, young yet so precocious. I can't deceive you... Alright, I'll tell you the truth, the Demon Monarch is a woman. Are you satisfied now?"
Fang Wang's heart relaxed, but he kept a composed face, "Even if it were a man, it wouldn't matter."
Tu Caiyi rolled her eyes at him, huffed, "Men."
Without waiting for Fang Wang to reply, she earnestly said, "Enough joking around, let's go. Nearby is a blessed land that could help you recover your Spiritual Power sooner. The sooner you recover, the sooner I can send you back to the Great Abyss Gate and be free to leave. Sticking around with a child like you here is dull."
Fang Wang was speechless.
Why had this woman's attitude flipped so drastically?
"For real?" Fang Wang asked cautiously.
"Believe it or not!"
Having said that, Tu Caiyi turned and left, swaying her graceful hips as she went.
Fang Wang immediately stretched out his hand, drawing all the nearby storage bags to surround him, and then he leapt across the small lake.
Xiao Zi hurriedly followed, perching on Fang Wang's shoulder, and whispered, "Young master, be careful. That woman is very dangerous. I have a feeling she's up to no good."
Fang Wang quietly said, "Let's go see. If she has ill intentions, by following us, she'll show her hand sooner or later."
He didn't use the Sound Transmission Technique, purposely letting Tu Caiyi hear.
Tu Caiyi in front didn't turn around as if she hadn't heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 89 The Name of Fang Wang, The Matter of the Marriage Pact
chapters.content:
Tu Caiyi did not deceive Fang Wang; there indeed was a blessed land hidden within this forest, located within a valley. The mouth of the valley and the surrounding mountains were clearly under the influence of a formation, preventing the Spiritual Energy from leaking out, thus concealing the unique nature of the Spiritual Energy in this place.
The Spiritual Energy of this blessed land was more than ten times that of the outside world. After entering the valley, Fang Wang began to sit cross-legged and gather Qi, while Xiao Zi continued to check the storage bags, her serpentine eyes occasionally glancing towards the distant Tu Caiyi.
Inside the valley was a flat plain, lush with flowers and plants, and though there were not many trees, those present were tall and magnificent. Tu Caiyi lay on the trunk of a large tree, feigning sleep, her posture exposing her thigh, coincidentally facing Fang Wang.
Fang Wang wasn't entirely immersed in his cultivation, his consciousness staying fixed on her. It wasn't that he harbored improper thoughts, but rather that he maintained a vigilance towards Tu Caiyi.
In the blink of an eye, five days passed.
Fang Wang's spiritual power was completely replenished. During this time, Tu Caiyi had not moved at all, making Fang Wang suspect that her soul might have departed from her body.
Xiao Zi, tirelessly organizing day and night, finally finished the inspection, collecting all the items useful to Fang Wang into twelve storage bags. Fang Wang attached these storage bags to his belt and then looked towards Tu Caiyi.
"It's time to hit the road," he said.
Upon hearing this, Tu Caiyi opened her eyes and then sat up, stretching lazily, as Fang Wang looked away.
This woman was setting a trap for him!
He would not be fooled!
"Young master is really quick. It seems that the cultivation technique you practice is not simple," Tu Caiyi said as she landed and walked towards Fang Wang, her tone filled with interest.
Fang Wang did not respond but instead soared into the air and flew away on his sword.
He quickly flew out of the valley and, looking back, saw Tu Caiyi barefooted and speeding towards him on two golden Wind Fire Wheels.
"Wind Fire Wheels? Interesting," Fang Wang thought, raising an eyebrow, and then he shifted his gaze towards the horizon.
Xiao Zi, meanwhile, was keeping a close watch on Tu Caiyi.
...
Within a bustling city, a steady stream of cultivators walked the streets, with shops on both sides selling Magic Artifacts, Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, Demon Pets, and various other items.
In an inn.
While drinking, the cultivators listened to a middle-aged scholar in the center of the hall.
"When the Myriad Poison Array is activated, the ghosts wail and the wolves howl, and the wind and clouds change color—it's terrifying. Being in the middle of it feels like falling into the eighteen layers of hell. Sword Saint Fang Wang stood proudly atop the head of the serpent demon, fearless.
The thousands of Demonic Cultivators from Green Cicada Valley never imagined that the Myriad Poison Array, set up by so many working together, would not be able to stop Fang Wang!"
The middle-aged scholar spoke with an impassioned tone, effectively stirring the emotions of his audience.
The surrounding cultivators listened intently, their eyes filled with longing and admiration.
Who wouldn't aspire to the legendary feat of repelling a sect single-handedly?
"Slaying the Great Demon King, defeating Sword Sect, and then slaughtering through Green Cicada Valley—could Fang Wang be considered the number one in the world today?" someone mused aloud.
As soon as these words were spoken, many cultivators echoed the sentiment. Their perspectives were not high, and Fang Wang was the most domineering and strongest person they had heard of.
"Green Cicada Valley has been attacked several times over the years; its strength is no longer worthy of the Nine Great Sects. Moreover, they are from a poison sect. Defeating Green Cicada Valley doesn't merit being considered number one. Poison is only effective in lower realms; cultivators of higher realms can resist toxins solely with their Inner Strength.
Years ago, Yang Yuanzi from Great Abyss Gate was able to fight his way in and out, and just a few years ago, even a Great Cultivator from Jin Xiao Sect could, it's just that Fang Wang's Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure exaggerated the achievement," a discordant voice interjected from a corner, laden with mockery.
It was unclear whether the intention was to ridicule Green Cicada Valley or belittle Fang Wang.
"Oh, you talk a big talk. Why don't you try breaking into Green Cicada Valley yourself?" a man suddenly stood up and shouted angrily. This man was none other than Gu Tianxiong.
Gu Tianxiong was drinking and enjoying the scholar's praises of his brother, feeling very pleased, when someone dared to demean Fang Wang.
That was intolerable!
Gu Tianxiong's gaze stayed fixed on the cultivator who had ridiculed Fang Wang, a man dressed in black with a bamboo hat whose brim hid his face.
In the face of Gu Tianxiong's provocation, the black-robed cultivator drank a cup of wine and snorted coldly: "Green Cicada Valley? I just so happen to have a score to settle with them. I'm going right now to give them trouble!"
With that, the black-robed cultivator stood up and left.
"Wait a minute, shouldn't you leave your name?" Gu Tianxiong called out eagerly—thinking that the man was making excuses to slip away.
Without turning his head back, the black-robed cultivator left behind his words: "Jin Xiao Sect, Xiao Kuang!"
The three words "Jin Xiao Sect" made everyone in the inn change their expressions dramatically, all falling silent as though struck by cold, even Gu Tianxiong didn't dare to speak again.
Though Jin Xiao Sect was not one of the Nine Great Sects and had only been around for a mere decade or so, their recorded feats were truly terrifying, and they were regarded by the Nine Great Sects as a lurking threat in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
After Xiao Kuang had left, the cultivators in the inn finally let out a sigh of relief.
"Continue to eat and drink, esteemed guests. Scholar, aren't you going to continue telling the legendary tales of the Sword Saint?" the innkeeper promptly urged.
Having run this inn for over a hundred years, he had seen all sorts of upheavals.
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged scholar immediately continued his tale.
Feeling a bit embarrassed, Gu Tianxiong stiffened his neck and declared, "That's right, keep talking. Fang Wang is my brother; I want to see if your story matches what I've heard!"
However, the cultivators merely rolled their eyes at him, disbelieving his claim yet no one dared to mock him.
Gu Tianxiong, feeling awkward, had no choice but to sit down and drink sullenly.
After a while,
a young man in plain clothes, appearing to be only sixteen or seventeen, approached his table and seemed hesitant to speak.
Gu Tianxiong gave him a glance and said irritably, "What is it?"
Gathering his courage, the plain-clothed youth took a seat on Gu Tianxiong's right and asked in a low voice, "Senior, is Fang Wang really your brother?"
Gu Tianxiong glared at him and said, "Of course, I never lie!"
Taking a deep breath, the young man said, "Senior, could we talk in a different place? I have a favor to ask of you, and I promise you won't be at a loss."
Hearing this, Gu Tianxiong looked at him with a face full of suspicion.
"Does it concern Fang Wang?"
"That's right."
"Fine, let's go!"
...
Under the blue sky, mountain ranges undulated, looking like azure dragons lying across the land, majestic and imposing.
Fang Wang, who was traveling on his sword, slowed down and turning his head, he said, "We are approaching Great Abyss Gate soon, thank you for accompanying me."
Keeping a distance of thirty feet, Tu Caiyi smiled faintly upon hearing his words and said, "You're welcome; this is where I'll leave you."
After speaking, she stopped and hovered in midair, watching Fang Wang leave.
Fang Wang nodded and continued to speed toward the Great Abyss Gate.
Xiao Zi muttered, "Master, is she really without malice?"
"Who knows? At least for now, it indeed seems like goodwill," Fang Wang quietly replied.
The cloud sea at the horizon already revealed the ten peaks of the Great Abyss Gate, towering through the clouds like a pair of enormous hands or a mirage, blurring the line between illusion and reality.
I'm finally back!
Fang Wang felt a surge of emotion. For him, it had been over four hundred years since his last visit, and naturally, he felt nostalgic for the Great Abyss Gate.
Xiao Zi perched on his shoulder, constantly looking back at Tu Caiyi until she faded from view, not turning its head back.
Without entering the Great Abyss Gate, it would always be uneasy.
Half an incense stick of time later.
Fang Wang entered the Great Abyss Gate. The two disciples who had checked his token previously were very excited to see him but dared not to disturb him further, so they did not delay him.
After entering the Great Abyss Gate, he took out his bamboo hat, put it on and slightly bowed his head, trying not to let anyone see his face.
Even so, as he headed toward the first peak, he could still hear the disciples along the way discussing him and Green Cicada Valley.
"Tsk, the news in the Cultivation World travels truly fast."
Xiao Zi, nestled in Fang Wang's arms, remarked with a sigh as they approached the entrance of the Great Abyss Gate, promptly hiding inside his embrace.
Fang Wang's expression remained calm, but inside he felt secretly pleased.
Such a remarkable feat, he naturally wouldn't want to keep it hidden.
As for making enemies, he was not worried. Even without this event, his possession of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure had already put him in a precarious position.
Fang Wang swiftly arrived at Zhou Xue's abode. As soon as he landed, the door to her cavern abode opened.
He raised his eyebrows and stepped inside.
"Master, why are you looking for her as soon as you return? I thought you didn't like women," Xiao Zi said with a hint of jealousy.
Fang Wang pressed its snake head down and walked on, unwilling to bother with it.
The gate closed, and the cavern abode was plunged into darkness.
He walked up to Zhou Xue, who was meditating in a small pond, surrounded by a strange black aura.
Huh?
It seems to be Ghost Qi!
Fang Wang frowned and asked, "Are you injured?"
Without opening her eyes, Zhou Xue replied, "It's just a minor injury, nothing to worry about."
"How did you get it?"
"Injured by Lu Yuanjun's Ghost Instrument."
"What?"
Hearing this, Fang Wang's frown deepened, and a murderous intent spilled out of his eyes.
Zhou Xue opened her eyes and, seeing his expression, couldn't help but smile, "Lu Yuanjun left Great Abyss Gate with Chen Anshi, so I followed the Demon Monarch to chase the two of them. I didn't expect Lu Yuanjun's Ghost Instrument to possess three more ghost gods, and even Yang Yuanzi came to his rescue.
The Demon Monarch is very interested in Lu Yuanjun's Ghost Instrument, so he deliberately let Lu Yuanjun and Chen Anshi escape to investigate its origins. I couldn't persuade the Demon Monarch, but at least they were severely wounded."
Fang Wang raised his eyebrows, surprised that Lu Yuanjun was so hard to kill, that even his master had to take action.
Tsk, and that Demon Monarch, so formidable...
Chen Anshi was the Vice Sect Leader of Great Abyss Gate, yet together with his master, they nearly lost their lives to the Demon Monarch?
Zhou Xue continued, "With Lu Yuanjun gone, it's improbable he will come back. Once the Demon Monarch gets his Ghost Instrument, his death is certain. You can take the position of the eldest disciple with ease, let go of your hatred, and I will seek the truth to completely convince Great Abyss Gate to abandon Lu Yuanjun."
After listening, Fang Wang had many questions, such as whether the Demon Monarch was really nearby the Great Abyss Gate?
However, he restrained himself and instead asked, "Is everyone else okay?"
Zhou Xue responded, "Three suffered serious injuries but will recover in a few years. It's already fortunate that nobody died."
Fang Wang let out a sigh of relief. He looked at Zhou Xue seriously and said, "Thank you!"
He guessed it was Zhou Xue's timely return that had saved the lives of the other six Fang Family disciples.
"Go see your master. First, out of disciple's duty since you've just returned, you should visit him, and secondly, his injuries are severe, likely needing twenty years to recover," Zhou Xue said with her eyes closed.
The Demon Monarch was so ruthless?
Fang Wang frowned, immediately turned around, and left. After taking three steps, he seemed to remember something and turned to ask, "By the way, grandfather and the others want to facilitate our marriage. Fourth Uncle said it is all up to me, is that true?"

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 90: Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, The Appearance of an Immortal Fate
chapters.content:
Facing Fang Wang's inquiry, Zhou Xue answered without opening her eyes, calmly saying, "I just don't want to bother with them. Even if I say I won't marry in this lifetime, they probably won't be at ease. It's better to set an engagement now, anyway. Since both of us need to concentrate on cultivating, this identity won't affect much.
Of course, if you're concerned about that junior sister, you can refuse."
Fang Wang pondered for a moment, then said, "I also dread the hassle and don't want to marry or have children. I just wish to cultivate. Let's just set the engagement to get it over with."
"Mhm."
Zhou Xue acknowledged with a sound, and seeing that she didn't wish to continue speaking, Fang Wang stopped bothering her and turned to leave.
After leaving the cave dwelling, Fang Wang flew towards the peak of the third vein.
"Master, didn't Tu Caiyi say earlier that Zhou Xue is the disciple of the Demon Monarch? Since when does a master follow the arrangements of their disciple? Could there be some deceit?" Xiao Zi curled up in Fang Wang's embrace, asking through the Sound Transmission Technique.
Fang Wang replied using the Sound Transmission Technique, "Who knows? Just pretend you didn't hear anything about it."
Demon Monarch?
That's somewhat interesting.
Carefully considering, the Jin Xiao Sect appeared at around the same time as he began cultivating.
And coincidentally, the Demon Monarch is a woman...
Why would someone reborn need to take a master?
Joining the Great Abyss Gate was for resources; what about joining the Jin Xiao Sect?
Moreover, Zhou Xue was able to mobilize Cao Ran and Tu Caiyi, the two Guardian Kings. Her status doesn't seem as simple as just being a disciple of the Demon Monarch.
The Demon Monarch let Lu Yuanjun go for the sake of a Ghost Instrument, but why spare Yang Yuanzi?
Fang Wang had a bold guess in his mind before, but he didn't directly ask. Some things are better left unsaid. With the existence of the Jin Xiao Sect, the Fang Family could also be safer.
After so many events, Fang Wang trusted Zhou Xue. If a person trusts no one, how sad that would be, showing they have no judgment. Even if Zhou Xue had any schemes, why bother with such an elaborate plan when there would be plenty of ways to control him from early on?
Of course, Fang Wang had to remain cautious. He could trust others, but the person he must trust the most has to be himself.
He must cultivate diligently to keep growing at a steady pace, always keeping an ace up his sleeve. That's the real confidence to face any crisis!
Soon enough.
Fang Wang arrived at the peak of the third vein, landed in front of Qingxin Hall, bent at the waist to bow, and said, "Disciple has come to see Master!"
Fortunately, no disciples were cleaning the plaza in front of Qingxin Hall, saving him some trouble.
This time back, he could feel that the Great Abyss Gate was still in mourning, with each vein becoming more desolate and bleak than before.
The doors of Qingxin Hall opened.
Fang Wang walked straight in, and upon entering, saw Yang Yuanzi meditating. His face was pale, his lips dry, lacking his usual vitality.
Seeing Fang Wang return, Yang Yuanzi smiled and said, "Disciple, you've finally returned. You have truly made your master proud!"
Seeing Fang Wang, Yang Yuanzi was genuinely happy.
He began incessantly praising Fang Wang's performance, to which Fang Wang could only respond modestly.
After a while, Fang Wang found an opportunity to ask, "Master, are you injured?"
Yang Yuanzi nodded, "Injured by a Demonic Cultivator, but not fatally. Don't worry about me. As for the calamity the Great Abyss Gate has faced, don't dwell on it. You just focus on your cultivation. With your talent, reaching the Condensation Spirit Realm is not difficult. Once you step into the Condensation Spirit Realm, you'll be the one calling the shots in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
No need for any further concerns."
His voice sounded weary, and his smile became forced.
Fang Wang saw he was deliberately hiding matters regarding Lu Yuanjun, so he knew he intended to save Lu Yuanjun's life.
Once the Ghost Instrument was revealed, all the wrongdoings Lu Yuanjun had committed couldn't remain hidden. Yang Yuanzi might even know about the near-annihilation of Fang Wang's entire family by Lu Yuanjun's minions.
Knowing this made Fang Wang uncomfortable, but Yang Yuanzi was his master, and he couldn't hold his master accountable.
The master and disciple continued their conversation, which was mostly Yang Yuanzi instructing him on how to be a great disciple of the Great Abyss Gate, though the atmosphere wasn't as enthusiastic as before.
"By the way, Master, about the transformation of Grand Qi into a Cultivation Dynasty, how much do you know? How can it be successful? Must the common people be used to extract Spirit Veins?" Fang Wang asked.
He hadn't forgotten about his grandfather's matters.
Yang Yuanzi replied, "I don't know much either. The Qi Dynasty indeed conscripted the common people to help mine the Spirit Veins, and the Nine Great Sects are arranging Formations. It will take many years. Once successful, the land where Grand Qi lies will experience a surge of Spiritual Energy, and the number of Cultivators will surely double.
The Condensation Spirit Realm might no longer be the summit of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm."
He paused for a moment, then said earnestly, "The process is long and arduous, involves complex strata, and there's always a dark side to it. Sacrificing one generation for the success of myriad future ones is also worthwhile."
Fang Wang found these words quite jarring.
At first glance, they made sense, but the present generation only lives once. Reincarnation, in reality, means becoming another person.
Fang Wang was a Cultivator too; he had no place to condemn Yang Yuanzi. He also lacked the power to change this matter.
"Go back and cultivate. As for the Sect Leader, you don't need to visit him. His injuries are more serious than mine; we don't know how many more years he can hold on."
Yang Yuanzi waved his sleeve and then closed his eyes to continue healing.
Fang Wang raised his hand in respect, then turned and left.
Several breaths later, the doors of Qingxin Hall closed once again.
Yang Yuanzi frowned slightly and began to channel his cultivation forcefully. Behind him, his shadow suddenly split into another figure, like a ghastly spirit struggling, with a terrifying and gruesome shape.
