...
Before returning to his cave dwelling, Fang Wang went to find Fang Hanyu, who happened to be in his dwelling, nursing his injuries. Fang Wang relayed the information he had gathered and asked him to write to their grandfather when he had the chance.
Fang Hanyu readily agreed and then advised him to go out less often.
Fang Wang's momentum was too strong, and he was concerned that Fang Wang might suffer an even more terrible encirclement.
Fang Wang consented, then stood and returned to his cave dwelling.
Upon returning to his dwelling, Fang Wang finally let out a sigh of relief.
"Finally back!" Fang Wang exclaimed, reflecting on everything that had happened since he had learned the Celestial Sword Intent. His recent experiences, while thrilling, exhausted him more than anything he had ever experienced.
Next, he planned to diligently cultivate, striving to reach the Condensation Spirit Realm as soon as possible and condense his fourth Lifespirit Treasure!
Tu Caiyi and the Demonic Cultivator from Green Cicada Valley had witnessed his Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art, and his need for stronger power was urgent so he could settle down.
Once he broke through to the Condensation Spirit Realm, Fang Wang planned to seek the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique.
To acquire the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique, he first needed to master the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art. This indicated that the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique was of a higher level, which is why, even after so many years, Fang Wang still longed for it.
Fang Wang tossed all his storage pouches onto the table, then removed his clothes and headed toward the small pool, preparing to take a bath. Although Xiao Zi's water-based spell had cleaned his body, he felt a bath was invigorating in a way that spell-cleaning couldn't match.
Xiao Zi lay on the white jade bed, watching Fang Wang and flicking her snake tongue, apparently lost in thought.
...
The news of Fang Wang rampaging through Green Cicada Valley spread throughout the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. The Great Abyss Gate, having just suffered from the invasion of the Demonic Dao, gained significant prestige, effectively repelling the entire Demonic Dao with the strength of one sect!
Although the Great Abyss Gate suffered heavy losses, they gained greater respect. More Cultivation families came to visit, some bringing resources and others sending their family's youths.
Within just a year, the Great Abyss Gate had replenished its Disciple ranks. Even the righteous Cultivation Sects began to visit the Great Abyss Gate to establish better cooperative relations.
Spring went and autumn came.
Three years passed.
The name Fang Wang continued to circulate in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm, becoming the most revered genius amongst the younger generation. He fully inherited the title of Sword Saint, and even senior Cultivators dared not underestimate him.
Major Sects mentioned him when giving lectures on doctrine, claiming that the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm would experience unprecedented changes because of Fang Wang.
Gradually, Fang Wang's fame began to spread to the Cultivation Worlds of the surrounding dynasties.
Around Grand Qi lay Wei, Chu, Hong, Zhao, Han, and the Northern Territories—seven dynasties in constant strife and mutual aggression that had lasted for over a thousand years. From the perspective of the Cultivation World, one could see that the size of territories in these seven dynasties was closely related to the disputes within their respective Cultivation Worlds.
One day.
A voice came from outside the cave dwelling:
"Fang Wang, are you there? I've brought someone who would like to see you."
Fang Wang opened his eyes and extended his divine sense, contemplating for a moment before remembering the identity of the other.
Fang Zigeng!
He was a cousin from the Great Abyss Gate.
Next to Fang Zigeng stood a young man dressed in the robes of the Great Abyss Gate's disciples—Fang Wang did not recognize him at all.
"Come in," Fang Wang said, then used his Spiritual Power to remotely activate the gate mechanism.
The gate opened.
Fang Zigeng and the young man stepped inside, while Xiao Zi hid behind Fang Wang.
The two men approached Fang Wang, and the young man was the first to clasp his fists and bow. "I am Zhao Qi, and I have the honor to meet the Sword Saint!" he said.
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and asked, "Your surname is Zhao?"
Upon closer examination, Zhao Qi bore a striking resemblance to the Emperor of Grand Qi, Zhao Zhen.
Suddenly, Zhao Qi lifted the hem of his clothes, knelt before Fang Wang, took out a Jade Slip from his storage bag, raised it up, and said through clenched teeth, "This holds one of the Three Great True Cultivations from the Ji Hao Sect, the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong. Zhao Zhen, before his death, ordered me to pass it to you as an apology for his sins."
Fang Wang looked at Fang Zigeng, who nodded and said, "His father was born to the late emperor and a Palace Maiden, and was abandoned to the common folk when he was a child. Shortly after he was born, his parents were murdered, leaving only him alive. He was raised by the common people until seven years ago when a mysterious person delivered a package to Zhao Qi, revealing the truth to him.
The Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong was inside that package."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang looked at Zhao Qi anew.
Zhao Qi gritted his teeth and said, "It was Zhao Zhen who had my parents killed to eliminate any concerns for himself, yet he spared my life because he feared being calculated against by Lu Yuanjun, leaving a last trace of the imperial bloodline.
Zhao Zhen told me that if he did not come for me within five years, it would mean he had died, and he asked me to find you and give you the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong!"
"He confessed everything to me. He pursued the Path of Immortality, but the Cultivation Sects did not want an Immortal Emperor, and Lu Yuanjun approached him, wanting to massacre the common people to nurture his Ghost Instrument.
For the sake of cultivation, he allocated cities with perceived threats from Duke's Mansions to allow Lu Yuanjun's people to harvest souls, then created the illusion of a power struggle."
"Zhao Zhen deserves death, and I despise him, yet he's now dead. The Grand Qi Kingdom is in turmoil, and the people suffer in great distress. I have no choice but to come to you. Zhao Zhen mentioned that the high ranks of the Great Abyss Gate all favor Lu Yuanjun. If we want to confront Lu Yuanjun, I have to come to you!"
"This Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong is genuine, taught to him by Lu Yuanjun. The version previously intended for you was only partial and could not be fully realized. However, the technique in this Jade Slip is complete, with both Yin and Yang aspects! Moreover, Lu Yuanjun said if someone gathers all Three Great True Cultivations of the Ji Hao Sect, they might gain a chance at an Immortal fate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 91 True Accomplishment of Great Perfection, The Way of Yin and Yang! [Third Update, Request for Monthly Pass]
chapters.content:
After hearing Zhao Qi's words, Fang Wang felt a surge of emotion.
Zhao Zhenzhen was ruthless!
He even factored in the possibility of his own death, wanting Fang Wang to avenge him, and the key thing was Fang Wang couldn't refuse because killing Lu Yuanjun was also his own need.
Fang Wang stared at Zhao Qi and asked, "Although Lu Yuanjun is the root of everything, it is the imperial power that wants to annihilate the Fang Family. How do you know I don't want to kill you first and then kill Lu Yuanjun?"
Zhao Qi looked up and said, "Because I have inquired about what kind of person you are. Since you started cultivating, those you have killed were all villains. You received the Sword Saint's inheritance, and although the Sword Sect clearly wanted to eliminate you, you let them go in the name of the Sword Saint's aversion to killing. This shows your respect and gratitude to your master.
You have taught so many swordsmen at Sword Heaven Marsh without holding back any of the Sword Saint's legacy, which shows your magnanimity."
"Someone like you who respects their master and upholds justice would surely distinguish between gratitude and resentment. Of course, if you really want to kill me, then do it; you are my only hope. If you do not help me, there is no meaning to my life."
Fang Wang narrowed his eyes and asked, "Who did you ask?"
"Your brother, Gu Tianxiong!"
"..."
Suddenly speechless, Fang Wang wondered if Gu Tianxiong was really praising him like that outside?
But he truly bore no killing intent towards Zhao Qi. After all, Zhao Qi was a victim too, and besides, his grandfather Fang Meng still cherished the friendship with Qi Gaozu.
Fang Wang took the jade slip from Zhao Qi's hand and calmly asked, "What exactly do you want my help with? It can't be just to kill Lu Yuanjun."
Zhao Qi showed a hint of joy. Clenching his fists, he said, "Now the Grand Qi Dynasty is controlled by the Prime Minister. Although he is the Prime Minister, he has become the de facto emperor. However, his governance is nepotistic and brutal; government officials are replaced every day. I've investigated, and this Prime Minister is the offspring of an elder of the Chi Devil Sect.
He forcibly conscripts people to excavate spirit veins, disregarding their lives. No one who has been sent to dig has returned alive. If this continues, the world will fall into chaos, and maybe many years from now, Grand Qi will become a Cultivation Dynasty, but that Cultivation Dynasty will certainly not be Grand Qi!"
"Sword Saint, you were born in the Fang State Duke's Mansion. The old Duke and Gaozu met in humble circumstances and fought side by side for a full twenty years to establish this Grand Qi dynasty. The world of Grand Qi contains a part of the Fang Family's blood, sweat, and tears. Can you really just watch Grand Qi fall apart? Please help me ascend the throne.
You are the foremost talent of Great Abyss Gate. If you back me, Great Abyss Gate will have no choice but to support me wholeheartedly. Lu Yuanjun might not be able to suppress you!"
"If I ascend the throne, I will promote the Fang State Duke's Mansion and appoint the Duke as Prime Minister!"
After speaking, Zhao Qi bowed deeply, pressing his forehead to the ground, unwilling to raise his head.
Fang Wang watched him and said, "It is an inevitable trend that Grand Qi becomes a Cultivation Dynasty. How can I reverse this situation alone?"
Zhao Qi said gravely, "I don't want you to reverse the trend, but rather to slow down the process. If we can extend the period, not so many common people would die. The Nine Great Sects are greedy for quick success, allowing a person from the Chi Devil Sect to become Prime Minister while they pretend not to notice, only hoping to enjoy the rewards."
Fang Wang thought of his own grandfather, of the common folk friends he made in Southern Hills City before he began his cultivation, and then of his former self.
All of these flashed rapidly before his eyes.
Reason told him that those who cultivate should be selfish, striving for immortality; after hundreds of years, the Mortal Realm would have witnessed countless changes of generations.
There is a difference between immortals and mortals, a fact that has never been a mere truism.
Yet he also remembered his grandfather's words.
"My good grandson, eternal life is elusive. The most important thing in life is what kind of person you become. If you can become an immortal, then you must consider what kind of immortal you should be."
Fang Wang sighed. In truth, this matter was not difficult; it didn't require him risking life and death. He just needed to help push things along and support Zhao Qi.
"Enough. You may go back. Wait for my message. This matter cannot be rushed, especially since the Sect Leader is still recovering from his injuries," Fang Wang said aloud.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Qi was overjoyed and hastily thanked Fang Wang before rising and leaving.
Fang Zigeng also turned to leave, but Fang Wang stopped him.
Zhao Qi looked back, hesitated and said, "Senior, I have no deep connection with Brother Fang. It was I who sought him out, and his stance was to listen entirely to you."
Fang Wang nodded slightly, and seeing this, Zhao Qi could only depart.
After Zhao Qi left, the mountain gate closed.
Fang Zigeng asked nervously, "Fang Wang, you won't blame me for bringing him here, will you?"
Though the two were cousins, Fang Wang's renown had grown so immense that Fang Zigeng couldn't help but feel a hint of fear. In the battle against Green Cicada Valley, Fang Wang has killed at least five thousand people, an achievement no cultivator in the world could overlook.
"What are you thinking? We are brothers. Why make it so formal? The reason I asked you to stay is so that I can review this Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong. If it's genuine, you should take it for your cultivation. Han Yu said you're the most diligent cultivator among them, but your talent is limited.
This Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong is a divine skill of our time, and it will surely compensate for your lack of natural talent," Fang Wang said with a touch of irritation.
"Really? Is that okay..." Fang Zigeng replied, surprised but hesitant.
Fang Wang smiled and said, "We don't need to mince words among family."
With that, he took the jade slip and read it with his spiritual sense.
Fang Zigeng took a deep breath, sat down at a stone table nearby, staring blankly at Fang Wang, his heart filled with a torrent of emotions.
Fang Wang shone so brightly; it would be impossible for Fang Zigeng not to feel envy.
Over the years of cultivation, everyone had changed, and the Fang Family Disciples had changed too. It seemed that only Fang Wang remained the same.
He was still as open-hearted and generous as he had always been, from childhood to adulthood, always able to win the affection of the elders and the admiration of his peers.
Fang Zigeng looked at Fang Wang, feeling moved.
At the same time, he made a decision; one day he must repay Fang Wang, even if it means trading his life for Fang Wang's.
Nineteen years ago, had Fang Wang not intervened, he would have perished along with the Fang Residence on that night. He already owed Fang Wang his life.
Fang Wang didn't know what Fang Zigeng was thinking. At the moment, he was focused on reading the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong. With Xiao Zi around, he wasn't afraid of a sneak attack from Fang Zigeng.
After a long while.
Fang Wang's gaze changed, and the always watchful Fang Zigeng couldn't help but nervously ask, "What's wrong? Is there a problem with the technique?"
Fang Wang closed his eyes and took a long breath. When he reopened them and looked at Fang Zigeng, he said, "The technique is fine. Here, practice it well. If you master it, you'll have a formidable reputation in the Mortal Realm."
The Jade Slip fluttered into Fang Zigeng's hands. He looked at Fang Wang, somewhat astonished.
For some reason, he felt that Fang Wang had suddenly changed, but he couldn't pinpoint exactly how.
"Right, tell me about the major events in the Cultivation World recently," Fang Wang said, as Xiao Zi climbed onto his shoulder.
Xiao Zi looked at the side of Fang Wang's face, thinking to herself that strange state had appeared again!
Fang Zigeng collected himself and said, "The biggest event in the past three years has to be the eradication of the Green Cicada Valley. Xiao Kuang of the Jin Xiao Sect stormed into Green Cicada Valley, committing a mass slaughter; the newly appointed valley master was slain by him.
In the following year, the four Guardian Kings of the Jin Xiao Sect came out together, launching a crazed reprisal and manhunt. Now, no disciples from Green Cicada Valley are to be seen, at least not publicly. As a result, the Jin Xiao Sect has replaced Green Cicada Valley as one of the Nine Great Sects."
Fang Wang's expression shifted subtly. Thinking of a possibility, he felt an inexplicable joy in his heart.
"Besides that, a cultivator from the Grand Wei Dynasty is currently challenging the top experts of the various sects. His name is Lv Changge. He has consecutively defeated the leaders of Huangyu Mountain, Ancient Demon Mountain, and the Crimson Sect. Where he will go next is unknown to all."
Fang Zigeng spoke with envy in his eyes.
When could he have such a carefree and spirited life? Though he was modest and honest, he too harbored the desire to be well-known throughout the land.
Fang Wang listened with great interest. As for Lv Changge, he didn't consider him a concern at all.
After three years of retreat, he had reached the fifth layer of the Profound Heart Realm. Compared to three years ago, his strength was unfathomably stronger.
And so, Fang Zigeng continued speaking for an entire hour before Fang Wang let him leave.
Once the gate was closed, Xiao Zi couldn't wait to ask, "Master, is the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong powerful?"
Fang Wang revealed a smile and replied, "Powerful. Not just ordinarily powerful."
The Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong had taken him three hundred and eighty years to cultivate, and this was with the foundation laid by the Nine Dragons Divine Transformation Art and the True Combat Technique. Initially, he didn't find it challenging, as many aspects were similar to the True Combat Technique. However, the longer he practiced it, the more he could feel the strength of this technique.
It was a complicated and exceptional art involving the elements of Yin, Yang, and the Ghost Path!
It had the power to capture souls, reanimate the dead, and see through the mysteries of Yin and Yang!
The most formidable move was the Xuanming Seal. If he placed the Xuanming Seal on an enemy, it would imprint on their soul. Once marked, even if they were worlds apart, the caster could continually erode the marked person's soul. The absorbed soul would slowly turn into the caster's ghost soldiers.
The stronger the ghost soldiers, the weaker the marked person's soul would become, until the ghost soldiers reached Great Completion, and the marked person lost their soul, leaving only an empty shell to die in extreme agony.
Fang Wang had already mastered the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong to Great Perfection. Against enemies of lesser cultivation, he could extract their souls with a single palm strike, turning them into his ghost soldiers!
Moreover, he was even capable of halting the transformation of the souls into ghost soldiers, and could even grant power to the marked individuals with the Xuanming Seal!
This process could transcend spatial distances!
The mysteries it encompassed were boundless!
Without exaggeration, the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong was the most exquisite art he possessed. Its power was not reflected in its destructive or killing force. It was deadly, but it also allowed him to step onto the paths of Yin, Yang, and the Ghost Path.
Because the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong was so vast and complex, the last three hundred and eighty years had not been dull for Fang Wang; each day brought new discoveries and insights, which he found endlessly fascinating.
Of course, the Xuanming Seal was not invincible; if the disparity in realms was too great, he would be unable to forcefully penetrate an enemy's mana to control their soul.
While the True Combat Technique helped him master magic artifacts and weaponry, and the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong helped him master the paths of Yin and Yang, what about the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique?
At that moment, Fang Wang's desire for the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique reached its peak; he still remembered what Zhao Qi had said.
Gathering the Three Great True Cultivations would give one the chance to encounter an Immortal fate.
What sort of fate would that be?
Fang Wang's heart was filled with confidence and anticipation. He had set foot on a path completely different from Zhou Xue's, who, in a past life, had not obtained the Ji Hao Sect's Three Great True Cultivations.
Only by walking a different path could they keep pace with each other, and maybe even surpass each other!

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 92: Peering into Life and Death by Sun Gazing, Advancing to a Senior Disciple
chapters.content:
Apart from the Xuanming Seal, the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong included other spells, and even possessed techniques for seizing the bodies of others—so varied and numerous that it would not be an exaggeration to say that the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong was like an encyclopedia of the Dao of Yin and Yang.
Fang Wang could now peer into the Yang Energy of living beings, and the amount of Yang Energy could indicate the lifespan of that creature.
Take Xiao Zi, for example.
Xiao Zi's Yang Energy signifies that she could live for another eight hundred years.
The Yang Energy of demons differs from that of humans, and is difficult to perceive as it is covered by a rich and cold Yin Qi. But for Fang Wang, who has reached Great Perfection in the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, discriminating the Yang Energy of demons is still effortless.
The Yang Energy of humans is much hotter, hence demons like to devour the Yang Energy of humans to balance their own Yin and Yang, and to better pursue the Heavenly Dao. If a demon's cultivation is insufficient, and the Yang Energy of the human they face is too scorching, the demon will suffer backlash from the human's Yang Energy.
Fang Wang stood up, ready to go out for a stroll, and Xiao Zi immediately followed behind him.
After leaving his cave dwelling, Fang Wang went first to visit Zhou Xue, but unfortunately, she wasn't there. He then visited Fang Hanyu, but this fellow wasn't in either, so he had to look for other clan members.
Apart from Fang Zigeng, there were two other relatives present. Fang Wang looked at their Yang Energy, and their lifespans were both about two hundred years.
The lifespan represented by the Yang Energy is not fixed; it's just a reflection of the current state of the body. An advancement in cultivation and some Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures can extend Yang Energy.
So it was, after wandering outside for several days, that Fang Wang returned to his cave dwelling with Xiao Zi.
Upon arrival at the mountain gate, Fang Wang always felt as if something was off. His gaze involuntarily drifted towards the cave dwelling next to his.
Gu Li hadn't sought him out for a considerable length of time.
That's for the best, a prodigy like her should concentrate on her cultivation.
Fang Wang shook his head with a smile, then entered his own dwelling to cultivate.
The fifth layer of the Profound Heart Realm wasn't enough; he had to reach the Condensation Spirit Realm as soon as possible, and then move on to the Heavenly Gang Saint Body Technique. Only then would he truly become the number one person in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm!
Meanwhile.
Gu Li was meditating in her own dwelling. With her eyes open and biting her lip, she took a deep breath and continued her cultivation.
Ever since Sword Heaven Marsh parted ways, every time she heard movement from the neighboring cave, she restrained herself from going out.
She felt she was about to succeed.
Only by temporarily curbing her longing for Fang Wang could she have a chance of catching up to him!
...
In the dimly lit cave chamber, Lu Yuanjun was seated in meditation on the ground, the surface beneath him covered with dried grass. As he cultivated, three black ghosts formed behind him, their faces indistinct.
Before him floated a black gourd from which a strand of Ghost Qi spilled out, solidifying into the form of Zhao Zhen.
Zhao Zhen watched Lu Yuanjun in silence, expression calm.
After a while.
Lu Yuanjun suddenly spewed a mouthful of blood, turning instantly pale, his hands trembling.
Zhao Zhen remarked pensively, "The Demon Monarch is indeed formidable, seemingly coming from nowhere. It seems that in the future, the Jin Xiao Sect will dominate the winds and clouds of the Cultivation World."
Lu Yuanjun wiped the blood from his mouth and said with a cold voice, "Sooner or later, I will slaughter my way through the Jin Xiao Sect and refine the Demon Monarch into a ghost soldier."
Zhao Zhen gave a cold smile but did not proceed with the conversation; his smile was just that chilling.
Lu Yuanjun looked up at Zhao Zhen and inquired, "How goes your cultivation of the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong?"
At these words, Zhao Zhen let out a self-deprecating smile and said, "This technique is inscrutable. I cannot learn it."
Lu Yuanjun's expression shifted between shades of gloom and clarity, contemplating something.
"You've already cultivated it, haven't you? You've started absorbing the souls of the Sect Leader and Yang Yuanzi," Zhao Zhen inquired further.
Lu Yuanjun took a deep breath and replied, "I have only begun the initial stages, and I cannot fully control it yet. The Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong is profound and complex, and there are many aspects I have yet to fully understand. Even this Xuanming Seal was only forcibly implanted into both of them.
Who knows how many years it will take for their souls to be completely transformed into my ghost soldiers."
Zhao Zhen remarked sarcastically, "Then you'd better run fast. Be careful not to be found by the Jin Xiao Sect. Besides, your Ghost Instrument has been seen by the Sect Leader, the Vice Sect Leader and Yang Yuanzi. It might even reach Fang Wang's ears. Wait another ten years, and Fang Wang will certainly be unrivaled in Grand Qi. With his temperament, he is bound to hunt you down."
Lu Yuanjun said coldly, "Run? Where could I run? Besides, I may not necessarily lose. If I refine Fang Wang into a ghost soldier, his Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure and his Swordsmanship will all be put to my use!"
"Tsk tsk, such grand ambitions. But if you really did succeed, it would indeed be a case of defying the heavens and changing fate, worth a gamble," remarked Zhao Zhen with a hint of admiration.
Lu Yuanjun confidently stated, "I've been cultivating the Ghost Path from a young age. No matter how difficult the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong is, given time, I will surely master it. Let Fang Wang live for now. As for the Jin Xiao Sect, even the Demon Monarch couldn't hold me back, so they're not worth worrying about."
Zhao Zhen grinned but said no more.
Lu Yuanjun continued his practice, cultivating the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong.
The cave chamber fell into silence, Zhao Zhen hovered above the black gourd, his eyes deep and thoughtful, pondering something unknown.
...
Time flowed gently by.
Ever since Zhao Qi departed, Fang Wang had been in seclusion for another two years. His cultivation had reached the sixth layer of the Profound Heart Realm, and he was very close to the seventh layer.
One day, his Disciple Token vibrated with the fluctuations of Spiritual Power. Opening his eyes, Fang Wang drew the token from the table into his hand; following that, the weary voice of Guang Qiuxian came through from the token:
"Fang Wang, come to the Shiyuan Hall immediately."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately got up. This time, he did not take Xiao Zi with him, leaving her to cultivate earnestly within the cave dwelling.
Before long, he swiftly arrived at the Shiyuan Hall in the Main Meridian.
As soon as he touched down, the doors opened, and he stepped inside the hall.
He noticed that many elders were standing within, including all nine Peak Masters, among them was Yang Yuanzi.
Fang Wang, who had cultivated the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, habitually checked their Yang Energy to see how many years they had left to live.
One hundred and twenty years!
Ten years!
Three years!
Eighty-seven years!
One hundred and one years!
With one glance, life and death, destiny and fate, were all in Fang Wang's vision, when suddenly, his pupils contracted, his gaze resting on a woman.
Tu Caiyi!
She was actually wearing the robe of an elder of the Great Abyss Gate, her demeanor dignified, no longer flirtatious, with a cold face, looking at Fang Wang with very cold eyes.
Guang Qiuxian, sitting cross-legged on a cushion, noticed Fang Wang's gaze and couldn't help but introduce with a smile, "This is the newly appointed Vice Sect Leader Chai Yi, she is a Great Cultivator of the Condensation Spirit Realm."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang immediately bowed to Tu Caiyi.
Caiyi, Chai Yi...
The former Vice Sect Leader was a spy from the Demonic Dao, and now they've been replaced by a spy from the Jin Xiao Sect?
Fang Wang did not expose her but asked curiously, "Where is Elder Chen?"
At these words, everyone in the hall had a subtle change in expression. Guang Qiuxian sighed and said, "Chen Anshi has joined the Chi Devil Sect, betraying the Great Abyss Gate. From now on, if we meet, it will be as enemies. Sister Chai is a disciple taken in by the former Sect Leader in the Northern Territories and can be trusted."
Tu Caiyi remained expressionless, her face unwelcoming to strangers.
She's really good at pretending!
Fang Wang asked again, "May I know why the Sect Leader summoned me here?"
At this question, everyone except Chai Yi smiled.
Although the Great Abyss Gate had suffered great changes, seeing Fang Wang filled everyone with hope.
Zhao Chuanqian laughed and said, "Fang Wang, from today onwards, you're the chief disciple of the Great Abyss Gate, in charge of the main meridian's affairs and all other chief disciples."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang raised an eyebrow, glancing at Guang Qiuxian.
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and nodded with a smile, while other elders and Peak Masters began to praise Fang Wang.
"In terms of cultivation and contributions, you are fully qualified to take the position of chief disciple."
"Fang Wang, the future of the Great Abyss Gate now depends on you."
"Hahaha, Fang Wang, once you break through to the Condensation Spirit Realm, the position of Sect Leader should be yours, right, Brother?"
"With Fang Wang as the chief disciple, he will definitely attract more geniuses to join the Great Abyss Gate. I support this."
Fang Wang feigned being flattered and awkwardly glanced at the elders while Tu Caiyi remained expressionless, though there was a trace of imperceptible amusement in her eyes.
"This is your new disciple token, which can be used to address all members of the Great Abyss Gate. Your contribution points have been transferred into this token, including your achievements in repelling the Green Cicada Valley and slaying Pang Tuntian."
Guang Qiuxian raised his hand, and a piece of jade with golden edges flew towards Fang Wang.
Fang Wang caught it, holding the chief disciple token, and felt quite emotional.
He had finally won it!
After twenty-one years since joining, he ascended to the position of chief disciple. He wondered what rank this speed would hold in the annals of Great Abyss Gate history.
"Disciple, now that you're the chief disciple of Great Abyss Gate, you must lead by example and not stray from the path," Yang Yuanzi said earnestly, looking at Fang Wang with eyes full of relief and pride.
Fang Wang suddenly raised an eyebrow, noticing something in Yang Yuanzi's demeanor, but he did not speak of it now. He nodded to Yang Yuanzi, then glanced over the elders and Peak Masters before looking towards Guang Qiuxian.
"Sect Leader, respected uncles and seniors, I have a request, let it be the first matter I handle as the chief disciple," Fang Wang said thoughtfully, his tone serious.
Greedy Sleeper couldn't help but laugh, "You're not thinking of promoting your clan members, are you?"
The Peak Masters and elders all showed smiles, but there was no mockery; after all, it was human nature.
Guang Qiuxian was quite fond of Fang Wang, not least because Fang Wang was decisive and unhesitant. As the chief disciple, he should have his own judgments, capable of changing the Great Abyss Gate, doing things, rather than just sitting in the position and enjoying the perks.
Fang Wang shook his head and said, "Zhao Zhen has been missing for many years and is likely dead. Grand Qi cannot be without an emperor for a day. I know a descendant of the royal family and would like to recommend him to be the Emperor of Grand Qi. After all, my Fang Family is from the Duke's Mansion and bears responsibility for this world.
Although the land seems stable now, the people are living in deep distress and need an emperor to govern. This person has joined the Great Abyss Gate and has a way to prove his royal bloodline."
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone looked at him in surprise, not expecting such a request.
Yang Yuanzi frowned slightly, thinking about Fang Wang's question that day, but he did not say anything.
"Indeed, Grand Qi cannot be without an emperor for a day. As a righteous sect, the Great Abyss Gate has the duty to protect the common people. I agree. Sister Chai, can you arrange this?" Guang Qiuxian pondered, he did not even assess whether the person was truly from the Grand Qi royal family, as it did not seem important to him.
He wanted to send a signal, that he unconditionally supported Fang Wang!
Tu Caiyi nodded slightly and said, "Alright, I will personally take him to the Imperial City and establish him as Emperor, then arrange a group of disciples to assist him."

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 93 Unrivaled, Ninth Level of Profound Heart Realm
chapters.content:
Is it that easy?
Fang Wang looked at Guang Qiuxian, feeling a wave of emotions in his heart.
He realized he had underestimated the power and influence of the sect's First Disciple. Essentially, becoming the First Disciple meant becoming the next Sect Leader, and Guang Qiuxian's attitude was clearly about helping him establish authority.
In Fang Wang's eyes, Guang Qiuxian's yang energy indicated he had less than thirty years to live. Not only that, but he and Yang Yuanzi had suffered the same injury.
The elders and peak masters began to agree that Fang Wang had great righteousness, and they also discussed the state of Grand Qi. They had heard about the hardships of the common people, yet, unfortunately, the Prime Minister was from the Chi Devil Sect.
In the past, they might have turned a blind eye for the sake of peace in the Cultivation World, but now, with the Great Abyss Gate and Chi Devil Sect at a life-and-death impasse, they naturally supported Fang Wang's decision, hoping the Chi Devil Sect would pay a price.
"Alright, you may go back to your cultivation. If you have any questions in the future, you can ask any of the elders," Guang Qiuxian spoke again.
The elders and peak masters all nodded, their expressions warm as they looked at Fang Wang.
Fang Wang did not bow and take his leave but instead said, "Sect Leader, Master, I have something to discuss with you both privately."
Guang Qiuxian raised an eyebrow and then, with a wave of his sleeve, the others took their leave. Fang Wang did not put on airs and bowed to them as they departed.
As the doors of Shiyuan Hall closed, leaving only the three of them, Guang Qiuxian asked with a smile, "Fang Wang, what is it that you wish to discuss with the two of us?"
Fang Wang spoke evenly, and as he did, the expressions of Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi changed greatly, and their faces turned so dark it was as if they could drip water.
...
Half an hour later.
Fang Wang walked out of Shiyuan Hall, a mysterious smile on his face, thinking to himself, "Lu Yuanjun, let's see if you can restrain yourself!"
He hadn't completely erased the Xuanming Seal from Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi, only suspended its effects. Even if he had directly removed it, the two's injuries wouldn't have fully healed, and their souls would remain damaged. But by suspending it, given Lu Yuanjun's mastery of the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, he might suspect it was due to his own lack of skill.
Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were unaware they had been afflicted with the Xuanming Seal, thinking instead that the Demon Monarch's spiritual power was incredibly malicious. Fang Wang feared that if he told them it was Lu Yuanjun's doing, they might tip off Lu Yuanjun, so he kept silent on this point.
Now, Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi no longer had to suffer the ravages of the Xuanming Seal, but Lu Yuanjun was in the dark about this fact.
Fang Wang was willing to bet, betting that Lu Yuanjun would return.
The Xuanming Seal could turn others into ghost soldiers for oneself, and perhaps Lu Yuanjun would covet such power.
Putting himself in their shoes, without Heavenly Palace, possessing the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, he too would want to turn powerful enemies into ghost soldiers.
However, the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong could not absorb ghost soldiers endlessly. At different stages of cultivation, one could control a different number of ghost soldiers, with a maximum of eighteen at one time. Furthermore, if the ghost soldiers were to grow, they would need to be fed spiritual energy. For Fang Wang, ghost soldiers weren't very useful.
One's own strength was the most important!
Fang Wang returned to his cave dwelling. He sat in meditation on the white jade bed and extended his spiritual sense into the First Disciple's Token.
In an instant, his spiritual sense entered a virtual landscape where he could overlook the entire Great Abyss Gate, including the nine veins, the main meridian, and the Sect's Main City. It was full of densely packed points of light, with lights scattered in all directions outside the map of the Great Abyss Gate, although sparse and varying in distance.
When Fang Wang concentrated on a small point of light, the identity information of that point would appear in his mind.
Well, this is even more miraculous than Earth's internet, giving off the vibe of a virtual world.
As long as Fang Wang covered all points with his spiritual sense, he could send messages to all disciples' tokens, or he could speak privately to one individual.
Even the tokens of Guang Qiuxian, Yang Yuanzi, and Tu Caiyi were included.
Nice!
In the future, he could also use the First Disciple's Token to track the whereabouts of Fang Hanyu and others.
Fang Wang noticed there was one light very far from the Great Abyss Gate. His attention concentrated on it, and the identity of the light emerged in his mind.
First Vein, Direct Disciple, Zhou Xue.
Fang Wang was speechless. This person really knew how to run.
After searching for a while, he couldn't find Lu Yuanjun's Disciple's Token, confirming that he had indeed defected.
Then, he looked up Zhao Qi's Disciple's Token, sending him a message to go to the main meridian and find Vice Sect Leader Chai Yi, who would arrange for his ascension.
Not half an incense stick's time later, Zhao Qi appeared outside of Fang Wang's dwelling hesitating for a moment before speaking up, "Sword Saint, are you there?"
Fang Wang opened the door to his cave and let him in.
Zhao Qi hurried in and knelt down in front of Fang Wang, bowing his head deeply three times.
"Sword Saint, I will never forget your great kindness. Once I ascend to the throne, I will ensure that my descendants always treat and utilize the Fang Family well, never letting them suffer any grievances," Zhao Qi pledged.
Upon hearing Zhao Qi's promise, Fang Wang simply smiled faintly. He spoke softly, "Go ahead and do what you must do. If you encounter any troubles, talk to me, but remember, if you cannot be an emperor who does good for the people, I, who supported your rise, can also dismiss you with a single word. I hope you live up to the aspirations you previously voiced."
Raising his hand in an oath, Zhao Qi declared, "If I, Zhao Qi, fail the people, then let my later years be unhappy, plagued with misfortune, and my lineage perish!"
Fang Wang nodded. "Go ahead. The Vice Sect Leader will arrange everything."
Zhao Qi nodded, stood up, bowed, and took his leave.
His visit was meant to show his stance and express his gratitude.
Although Fang Wang seemed stern, he was quite satisfied inside. Regardless of anything else, the fact that Zhao Qi thought to visit him as soon as he knew of his ascension was commendable.
```
Boom!
The mountain gate closed, and Fang Wang couldn't help but think of Tu Caiyi.
He was curious about how exactly this person had managed to occupy the position of Vice Sect Leader. It seemed that in the years of his seclusion, Tu Caiyi had made quite an effort.
Once Zhou Xue returned, he would have to ask her whether Tu Caiyi was trustworthy.
Fang Wang didn't dwell on it any further and continued his cultivation.
He would break through to the Ninth Level of the Profound Heart Realm first!
That day, the news of Fang Wang becoming the Great Abyss Gate's head disciple quickly spread throughout the sect, with announcements posted in all nine branches as well as the Sect's Main City.
Almost all disciples agreed with the decision and even felt excited to have such a leader. Each person held higher expectations for the future.
In the following half-month,
the news of Fang Wang becoming the head disciple spread throughout the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm.
...
At the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, surrounded by a sea of clouds, the peak of a mountain emerged from the mist, and, sitting under an ancient tree atop the mountain, Xu Qiuming fiddled with a wooden sword in his hands.
A figure glided through the fog and came to him—it was his sister, Xu Tian Jiao.
"Brother, Fang Wang has become the Great Abyss Gate's head disciple!"
Xu Tian Jiao said excitedly. She had once been saved by Fang Wang and had been curious about him ever since. Ever since the tale of Fang Wang's Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure had spread throughout the world, her interest in him had grown even further.
Upon hearing this, Xu Qiuming's hands stopped moving, and he looked up with a smile, "What's so surprising about him becoming the head disciple? Isn't that to be expected?"
Xu Tian Jiao said with emotion, "But he's only thirty-seven years old. Looking across the Nine Great Sects, throughout history, no one has become head disciple at such a young age."
Hearing this, Xu Qiuming's expression turned complex.
Ever since Fang Wang's meteoric rise, all the talents in Grand Qi paled in comparison. Nowadays, there were only two types of geniuses: one was Fang Wang, and the other was all the rest. Xu Qiuming was one of the rest.
Xu Qiuming didn't show it on the surface, but deep down, he was determined to prove he was no less than Fang Wang!
Xu Tian Jiao talked non-stop, her words filled with curiosity and admiration for Fang Wang. Although Xu Qiuming couldn't share the excitement, finding it hard to get angry in front of his sister, he could only feign enthusiasm in agreement.
"By the way, Lv Changge has already issued a challenge to the Suspended Vast Sword Sect. He will come to challenge us in six months. Clearly, he's leaving the Great Abyss Gate for last. This is a contempt for our Suspended Vast Sword Sect!" When Xu Tian Jiao brought up another matter, indignation showed on her face.
Her admiration was for Fang Wang, but for the Great Abyss Gate, she held no respect. In her view, a peerless genius like Fang Wang belonged in the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, especially since he had inherited the Sword Saint and was a Sword Cultivator.
In fact, the Suspended Vast Sword Sect had indeed planned to recruit him, but they were unable to make contact, given Fang Wang's constant seclusion.
...
After becoming the head disciple, Fang Wang continued his low-profile seclusion, with the Great Abyss Gate not assigning him any tasks and hoping he would focus on his cultivation.
Disciples from all branches were in awe of Fang Wang's perseverance. With unmatched talent and such dedication to cultivation, he left no opportunity for others to surpass him.
And so, four years passed.
Fang Wang finally broke through to the Ninth Level of the Profound Heart Realm!
At forty-one years old, having reached the Ninth Level of the Profound Heart Realm, he wanted to ask the world, who else could claim such a feat?
Since his promotion to head disciple, the spiritual energy of nature in his dwelling had greatly increased, indicating that the sect had indeed started to allocate more resources to him.
After the breakthrough, he took seven more days to consolidate his cultivation. Once stabilized, he immediately rushed out of his dwelling and shouted loudy from the edge of a cliff.
Passing disciples were startled, but upon turning to see it was Fang Wang, they dared not disturb him.
Rumble—
The mountain gate to the neighboring dwelling opened, and Gu Li walked out. She wasn't wearing a veil, revealing her delicate and cool features. She approached Fang Wang and asked, "Felt too stifled?"
Fang Wang gave her a big smile and said, "Miss Gu is making fun of me. I didn't disrupt your cultivation, did I?"
Gu Li shook her head gently, "Half a year ago, I broke through to the eighth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm, so my cultivation doesn't require too much focus right now. You didn't disturb me, and I actually wanted to come out and take a look."
"Not bad, not bad at all, breaking through to the eighth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm," Fang Wang commended.
Gu Li stared at him and asked, "What about you? What realm are you at now?"
Fang Wang replied modestly, "I'm still in the Profound Heart Realm."
After hearing this, Gu Li sighed, "It seems that we won't be able to spar when I reach the ninth level of the Spirit Elixir Realm. Looking back now, I was really naive."
"If you want to spar, that's fine," Fang Wang said with a soft laugh.
After all, you've beaten me at a higher realm before, why don't you let me try the same now?
Gu Li rolled her eyes at him, "Are you going to continue your seclusion?"
Fang Wang nodded, "Of course, I fear going out only to be besieged by the Demonic Sect again."
Gu Li suddenly felt he was truly irritating, making her want to lash out, but remembering that she was no match for him, she restrained herself.
"Tell me what has been happening in the Cultivation World lately." Fang Wang saw the resentment in her eyes and swiftly changed the subject.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 94: Second Best in the World, Xiao Zi's Insight [Third Update]
chapters.content:
Facing Fang Wang's request, Gu Li did not refuse, she actually wanted to talk more with Fang Wang.
"Let's start with Lu Yuanjun from Grand Wei. Three years ago, he challenged the Suspended Vast Sword Sect and was defeated. He was even imprisoned by them," Gu Li said, with a tone filled with contemplation.
Fang Wang asked in surprise, "Isn't that very normal? After all, the Suspended Vast Sword Sect is considered the strongest sect. They can't let Lu Yuanjun sweep through the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm alone, can they?"
If the Grand Wei Cultivation World were truly that strong, wouldn't they have invaded and seized the Spirit Veins long ago?
Grand Qi had waged war against Grand Wei at the dawn of its founding, in which his grandfather, Fang Meng, had participated, smashing the Wei army and expanding the nation's territory by five hundred miles.
The rivalry of dynasties shows that the Cultivation World is also competing. Grand Wei's defeat meant the defeat of the Grand Wei Cultivation World.
Though mortals are unaware of Cultivator's existence, Cultivators do lead wars in the Mortal Realm, not by appearing directly but by using spells.
For example, when Qi Gaozu was almost encircled and attacked by the feudal lords, surrounded by the sound of enemy troops on all sides, a meteor shower fell from the sky, instantly killing a hundred thousand enemy soldiers. The remaining foes were so terrified that they dispersed in panic and fled.
Only after joining the Great Abyss Gate did Fang Wang learn that the historical battle that would go down in history was orchestrated by the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, who dropped huge rocks from above the clouds, pretending it to be a natural disaster.
"The one who defeated Lu Yuanjun was not the Sect Master of the Suspended Vast Sword Sect, but Xu Qiuming, and he did it using Profound Heart Realm cultivation to defeat someone in the Condensation Spirit Realm. Now, throughout the Cultivation World, everyone is talking about him, calling him the second most talented person in the world," said Gu Li.
Upon saying this, Gu Li couldn't help but look toward Fang Wang, filled with emotion.
Such an accomplishment was indeed remarkable, but it still couldn't shake Fang Wang's status.
Fang Wang wasn't surprised, Zhou Xue had long said that Xu Qiuming would become Grand Qi's top Cultivator in the future, and that he would even leave Grand Qi to stand at the pinnacle of the entire world.
Zhou Xue, before ascending, may not have been his match; unfortunately, he had bad luck and missed the opportunity to ascend.
"Moving on to the second matter, the Chi Devil Sect has suffered a massive blow from Jin Xiao Sect's ambush. The Jin Xiao Sect is truly powerful; it has never known defeat since its inception, and their number of masters keeps growing. That Xiao Kuang has even surpassed the fame of the four Guardian Kings.
It's astounding how the Demon Monarch manages to recruit so many Great Cultivators," Gu Li marveled.
Fang Wang had not yet met Xiao Kuang, but he had heard the name more than once.
Tu Caiyi is in the Condensation Spirit Realm, and this Xiao Kuang is very likely in the same realm.
Tsk tsk, does the Jin Xiao Sect have more Condensation Spirit Realm cultivators than the Nine Great Sects combined?
Of course, that's just public knowledge, just as with Sword Sect's Kong Xi, who never told the world that he had reached the Condensation Spirit Realm before challenging Fang Wang.
Gu Li continued talking about matters of the Cultivation World, and Fang Wang listened attentively, occasionally expressing his own feelings, as if those figures stirring up the world were beyond his reach.
Meanwhile.
Within the Shiyuan Hall, Guang Qiuxian and Yang Yuanzi were also in conversation.
Yang Yuanzi said with emotion, "This junior sister Chai is truly impressive. She has already helped Zhao Qi consolidate the imperial governance and even helped him contend with the claws of other sects."
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and laughed, "Naturally, our master never accepts disciples from outside. To accept her means she is extraordinary. She has mastered our master's unique skills and reached accomplishments that even you and I dare not dream of."
"Thinking back to when she wanted to become the Vice Sect Leader, I almost came to blows with her. Fortunately, she gave me face and didn't embarrass me, choosing instead to prove her abilities through accomplishing missions," Yang Yuanzi said, his expression complex.
Guang Qiuxian laughed proudly, "Without her being tough on outsiders, how could Great Abyss Gate have added so many Spirit Veins? And those noble families, how could they willingly contribute several times more resources?"
Yang Yuanzi snorted, "That being said, you still need to be cautious of her, especially considering Chen Anshi is a lesson from the past."
At the mention of Chen Anshi, Guang Qiuxian's smile vanished—Chen Anshi's betrayal was the greatest pain in his heart.
He even felt guilty towards Lu Yuanjun, believing that if he had not allowed Chen Anshi to take the young Lu Yuanjun out for training, Lu Yuanjun would not have turned out this way today. Thus, even when Lu Yuanjun defected, he could not bear to issue a warrant for his arrest.
"Let's talk about the Jin Xiao Sect. You and I have been recuperating for many years; it's time to face the threat of the Jin Xiao Sect. They attacked the Chi Devil Sect, and coupled with the earlier incident at Green Cicada Valley, they've shown the strength to not fear the Nine Great Sects," said Guang Qiuxian with a frown.
Yang Yuanzi furrowed his brow too, his eyes filled with wariness as he thought of the Demon Monarch's figure.
Guang Qiuxian's brows were also knitted as he spoke gravely, "The strength of the Demon Monarch is unfathomable. Before the Demonic Dao invaded the Great Abyss Gate, I had sparred with her. I felt she could kill me but deliberately chose not to, seemingly preferring to watch us and the Demonic Dao slaughter each other."
Yang Yuanzi raised his eyebrows and asked, "Was it then that you were inflicted with the same curse as me?"
"It seems likely."
"Why didn't you tell me? I thought you went to escort Lu Yuanjun and were ambushed by the Demon Monarch on the way."
"How could I say that? Would I not lose face if I admitted that I was no match for the Demon Monarch? Besides, she merely tested me before leaving."
"Heh, you really do care about your dignity," Yang Yuanzi mocked.
After Yang Yuanzi's scoffing, Guang Qiuxian harrumphed and said, "No matter, Fang Wang has already grown. When he breaks through to the Condensation Spirit Realm, the Demon Monarch may not be his match!"
Speaking of Fang Wang, Guang Qiuxian's pride surged again. Having a genius like Fang Wang emerge during his tenure as Sect Leader meant that even in death, he could proudly face the past Sect Leaders of the Great Abyss Gate!
"My disciple is destined to be unrivaled in the world. But if Lu Yuanjun comes back and they fight, you can no longer shield Lu Yuanjun! That scoundrel struck me with a palm when I was helping him, truly ungrateful!" Yang Yuanzi said angrily, cursing incessantly as he spoke of Lu Yuanjun.
Guang Qiuxian gave a wry smile and sighed, "We've already done our best to protect him and keep him alive. If he comes back and dies at Fang Wang's hands, then it's his fate. But tell me, do you think Fang Wang knows the truth?"
Yang Yuanzi replied calmly, "Nonsense, if he didn't know, why would Fang Wang compete for the position of chief disciple with his temperament?"
Guang Qiuxian fell silent, then asked, "Will he hold a grudge against us?"
Yang Yuanzi shook his head and said, "I'm not clear on what he truly thinks, but at least on the surface, he still respects us. You can't expect him to not have any hard feelings, can you? He's human after all. Let's just leave it at that. Anyway, we don't have many years left to live, so what if he resents us? As long as he doesn't take it out on the Great Abyss Gate, it's fine.
Fortunately, his attitude towards his fellow disciples is extremely good. He never bullies the weak."
After listening, Guang Qiuxian felt that it made sense, but he couldn't help sighing nonetheless.
"Junior brother, do you think she will blame us when we die and see her?"
"What right does she have to blame us? Indeed, she saved our lives back then, but we've repaid our debt to her. She deserves it for insisting on marrying that guy. Look at what kind of person he is, no good at all!" Yang Yuanzi cursed through gritted teeth, his eyes filled with sorrow.
Guang Qiuxian said earnestly, "Junior brother, stop thinking about her. It's all my fault for not protecting you well back then. On our first trip down the mountain for training, we encountered an attack by the Demonic Dao. If it weren't for her intervention, we would both be dead.
And it was because it was your first time descending the mountain, you hadn't yet experienced the turbulent mortal world, that you developed feelings for her. It's all my fault."
Yang Yuanzi snorted, "What nonsense are you talking about? How could I possibly have feelings for her!"
Guang Qiuxian wanted to say more but stopped himself, finally letting out a sigh.
"Let's continue discussing the Jin Xiao Sect. I suggest we ally with the orthodox sects, come to a consensus, share intelligence on the Jin Xiao Sect, and if possible, join forces to eradicate them!" Yang Yuanzi changed the subject. When he mentioned the Jin Xiao Sect, a fierce expression appeared on his face.
Guang Qiuxian also started to ponder.
…
After chatting with Gu Li for a full hour, the two said their goodbyes.
Back in his cave dwelling, Fang Wang sat on the white jade bed, his face showing an expression of wanting to say more.
Heroes from all over the world were competing ceaselessly, and he too longed to show off...
Cough cough, he too longed to win glory for the Great Abyss Gate!
Unfortunately, he had to restrain himself and break through to the Condensation Spirit Realm first.
"My lord, what's with that expression? You're not getting attached to her, are you?"
Xiao Zi lay on the desk, watching Fang Wang's expression and couldn't help but ask.
Fang Wang glared at it and said irritably, "Who I'm concerned about is none of your business, is it?"
Xiao Zi stuck out its tongue and asked, "My lord, should I learn some Transformation Technique, transform into Gu Li, and satisfy you? You can do whatever you want with me."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang almost shattered the white jade bed. He glared at Xiao Zi and scolded, "What are you thinking with that little head of yours, where did you learn such things? You haven't even gone out!"
"Of course I learned it in the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven. It was demonstrated in person by you human cultivators. That female cultivator liked to transform into various forms to please the male cultivators, and every time, the male cultivator would praise her for being great. Don't you like that sort of thing, my lord?" Xiao Zi asked seriously.
"Nonsense! Whether I like it or not, what's it to you? You are but a snake, so please mind your behavior, or else watch out, I'll deal with you!" Fang Wang rebuked.
He couldn't let the snake continue talking!
It made his mind wander!
A demon is a demon, always trying to destroy my cultivation path!
Fang Wang raised his hand and with a wave of it, he sent Xiao Zi flying into a small pond behind him, and then he began to meditate and cultivate.
Xiao Zi popped its head out of the water, the wet snake staring at Fang Wang's back, continuously flicking its tongue, seemingly contemplating something.
…
In a dimly lit cave chamber.
Lu Yuanjun, who was practising his skills, opened his eyes and frowned, murmuring to himself, "Why can't I succeed? Where exactly is the problem?"
Hovering above the black gourd, Zhao Zhen asked, "Could it be that you haven't mastered it at all?"
"It's possible, but if that's the case, how was I able to absorb their souls before?" Lu Yuanjun was puzzled.
Zhao Zhen spread his hands and said, "It's quite normal. The more you absorb, the stronger the ghost soldiers become. You still need to improve your skills. Forget about Fang Wang. By the time you fully master the Yin Yang Xuan Ming Zhen Gong, I suspect Fang Wang will have already left Grand Qi."
"His treasure is the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, and no one knows how fast his cultivation is progressing. Just accept it, you are not his equal."
As the words fell, Lu Yuanjun looked up, staring coldly at Zhao Zhen, frightening him into silence.
Lu Yuanjun snorted coldly, his gaze flickering as he said, "That's right, I can't wait any longer. The longer I wait, the more troublesome it gets."

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 95 Breakthrough to the Condensation Spirit Realm, A Current Era Myth
chapters.content:
```
The Condensation Spirit Realm is the realm of condensing the Primordial Spirit, which represents a deeper connection between cultivators and their own souls.
The birth of the Primordial Spirit allows cultivators to touch upon the soul's realms that mortals cannot, to glimpse at the unseen specters and shapes of Jiu You, and also aids cultivators in pursuing more of heaven's mysteries.
Fang Wang, through his study of the Solaris Scripture, had come to understand the importance of the Primordial Spirit, but the Condensation Spirit Realm was still not sufficient to enable the leaving of the Primordial Spirit from the body.
With the Primordial Spirit, you could practice creating an avatar, and taking over bodies would be easier too.
During his cultivation, Fang Wang fantasized about the Primordial Spirit, his mind full of speculations.
For example, if one were to keep taking over bodies with their Primordial Spirit in the Condensation Spirit Realm, could one find another path to longevity and life eternal?
According to Zhou Xue's words and what he currently understood about the Cultivation World, there were no immortals in this world.
Within his cave dwelling, spiritual energy surged into Fang Wang's body, forming swirling vortexes around him.
Breaking through the Condensation Spirit Realm does not require external objects. All realms before the Profound Heart Realm are about building the foundation and require external items, but breakthroughs afterward rely on one's understanding and talent. Of course, perhaps even higher realms would need external objects to break through the heavens' decree.
After all, everyone has their own limits.
But with the Heavenly Palace, where were his limits?
Lost in thought, Fang Wang's mind drifted to the fairy fate that Zhao Qi had mentioned.
Perhaps by sticking close to Zhou Xue, he could find the opportunity for ascension, but in doing so, Zhou Xue might not respect him in the long run. At least in his heart, Fang Wang felt indebted to her, and with the Heavenly Palace, he must walk a path that belonged to himself.
No immortals came from the Mortal Realm, but he didn't believe in such curses and wanted to try for himself!
Days passed by.
Fang Wang's cultivation level kept increasing, inching ever closer to the Condensation Spirit Realm.
Even as a direct disciple, no one disturbed him, which allowed him to focus on his practice.
Xiao Zi was also practicing; since Fang Wang didn't allow it to go out alone, it had no choice but to cultivate.
Time passed, unknown how much.
Finally, Fang Wang felt the opportunity for a breakthrough. He opened his eyes and asked, "Xiao Zi, how many years has it been?"
Unlike before. During his Qi Gathering cultivation, his thoughts did not enter a state of enlightenment, allowing him to maintain his awareness of the outside world.
Xiao Zi, lying in the pool, replied, "Almost two years, I guess."
Upon hearing this, Fang Wang thought to himself how time flies.
As he delved into the Cultivation Technique of the Condensation Spirit Realm, time escaped him swiftly, feeling as though just a few days had passed.
Thankfully, he had finally grasped the chance for a breakthrough. Thinking about his imminent advancement through the Condensation Spirit Realm, he became excited.
Fang Wang continued his cultivation, preparing for the breakthrough.
Elsewhere.
At the Main Meridian, in the square in front of Shiyuan Hall.
The Nine Veins disciples stood in nine rows, twenty in each vein, including Fang Hanyu, Fang Zigeng, Ye Xiang, Zhou Xing Shi, Gu Li, and Zhou Bo among them.
Zhao Chuanqian stood in front of everyone, with a serious expression, saying, "This mission is fraught with immense danger. Even for those in the Profound Heart Realm, there is a risk of death. But this matter is crucial, possibly determining the future safety of the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm. No one must take it lightly, understand?"
Upon hearing this, the one hundred and eighty disciples answered in unison, "Understood!"
Some were expectant, others anxious.
Fang Zigeng was among the anxious, standing at the back of the fifth vein, continuously calming his emotions.
The direct disciple of the third vein, Li Yu, asked, "Which sects will support us?"
Zhao Chuanqian looked at him and calmly said, "That will be discussed when the time comes."
Knowing he spoke out of turn, Li Yu did not dare to ask again.
After that, Zhao Chuanqian leaped into the air. A flying sword appeared beneath his feet, and the other disciples immediately followed on their swords, creating a spectacular scene.
Disciples who witnessed this along the way were curious about what they were going to do.
Zhao Chuanqian held a high position within the Great Abyss Gate, and the disciples behind him were mostly direct disciples, like Ye Xiang, Fang Hanyu, and Gu Li, who carried significant reputations. This kind of lineup clearly indicated they were embarking on an important mission.
Inside Shiyuan Hall.
Guang Qiuxian sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion, with the nine Peak Masters standing below.
Yang Yuanzi spoke, "They've set out. When do we inform my disciple?"
Upon hearing this, the other Peak Masters all turned their gaze expectantly toward Guang Qiuxian. Each disciple they had sent was an elite of their respective veins, and the loss of any one of them would pain them. If Fang Wang would take action, the death rate would naturally decrease.
In their hearts, Fang Wang was already the number one figure of the Great Abyss Gate, and they even believed that Guang Qiuxian might not be a match for Fang Wang.
They were aware that Fang Wang had not taken action for many years, and his strength was sure to have far surpassed his past self.
Guang Qiuxian pondered, "Let's wait a little longer. It's a good opportunity for the other disciples to gain experience. Those talents who possess Earth Origin Spirit Treasures should also grow. Imagine, if there was no Fang Wang, they would be like Lu Yuanjun, revealing their sharpness upon reaching the Profound Heart Realm."
A Peak Master frowned and said, "Although the Chi Devil Sect has been weakened by the Jin Xiao Sect's attack, they still remain the foremost demon sect in Grand Qi, and we will be in their territory. I always feel there is a ploy."
His sentiment received agreement from the other Peak Masters, who then voiced their concerns, hoping Guang Qiuxian would not be complacent.
"No need to worry. This operation is also supported by the Suspended Vast Sword Sect and the Tian Shu Sect. The Chi Devil Sect will definitely be reduced to ashes!" Guang Qiuxian declared, revealing a rare intensity in his demeanor.
Because of Chen Anshi, he hated the Chi Devil Sect the most.
The Peak Master of the Second Vein stepped forward and asked, "With the three sects working together, to whom will the ultimate treasure belong?"
```
Guang Qiuxian squinted his eyes and said, "Natural selection dictates the worthiest shall occupy it. I have already come to an agreement with the other two sects, to join forces and wipe out the Chi Devil Sect first, then discuss the ownership of the supreme treasure. Even if we do not obtain the supreme treasure, we can still acquire the wealth of the Chi Devil Sect or their territory.
In any case, none of the three sects will suffer a loss."
Hearing this, the Peak Masters were no longer confused.
Guang Qiuxian continued to assign tasks, and everyone listened attentively.
…
A month later.
The entrance to Fang Wang's cave dwelling slightly trembled, the disturbance gradually increasing, until eventually, the whole third vein's mountain peak quaked, alarming the disciples within the dwelling who flew out in a flurry. The second and fourth veins, too, noticed the commotion from the third vein.
Yang Yuanzi descended from the sky and landed at the entrance to Fang Wang's mountain gate. He hovered in midair, his face showing a look of astonishment, his eyes complex.
The elders of the third vein arrived one after another, likewise looking towards Fang Wang's dwelling.
"Is this commotion coming from his breakthrough?"
"When the Sect Leader had his breakthrough to the Condensation Spirit Realm, it was with similar tumult. Could it be…"
"Hiss... the Condensation Spirit Realm, how old is he? Has he reached fifty yet?"
"No, he should be only forty-three, unbelievable. From ancient times to the present, has there ever been a forty-three-year-old in the Condensation Spirit Realm?"
"Such a powerful aura, it feels like the protective enchantments inside the dwelling are about to fail to contain him."
As the third vein's disturbance grew, more and more people rushed over, including Sect Leader Guang Qiuxian and Vice Sect Leader Chai Yi.
Nature's spiritual energy within the Great Abyss Gate surged crazily towards Fang Wang's dwelling, the momentum was spectacular.
The Direct Disciples watched behind the elders, buzzing with discussion, and behind them were disciples of various levels, all floating in the air, their numbers growing.
Guang Qiuxian stroked his beard and sighed, "Indeed, he is about to break through to the Condensation Spirit Realm. It seems I should also be ready to step down."
He had long been aware that Fang Wang was definitely capable of achieving the Condensation Spirit Realm. Although not surprised, he felt somewhat bittersweet.
All the elders felt the same; compared to Fang Wang, they were truly mediocre.
Vice Sect Leader Chai Yi did not make a sound, but his gaze towards the dwelling's gate was meaningful.
Soon, the news of Fang Wang's imminent breakthrough to the Condensation Spirit Realm spread, and everyone who heard it was invigorated.
The Condensation Spirit Realm ah!
That was a legendary realm, one that most disciples never even approached, and the realms of Guang Qiuxian and Chai Yi had not been passed down to the lower-level disciples. Thus, Fang Wang's breakthrough seemed even more shocking.
To reach what they believed was the highest realm before the age of fifty was like a living legend in their eyes.
As time passed, the third vein's disturbance became greater and greater. The other eight veins, the main vein, and the main city could all feel it; the earth-shaking sound was deafening.
The Fang Family Disciples who remained in the Great Abyss Gate also came, gathering together. Disciples who knew them approached to offer their congratulations to the Fang Family.
Today, in the Grand Qi realm, not a single influential family possessed a Great Cultivator of the Condensation Spirit Realm, at least not openly!
Meanwhile.
Inside the dwelling.
Fang Wang was in the midst of his breakthrough. The Solaris Scripture had condensed nine fireballs that hovered behind his head. Above his crown floated a silhouette, a mirror image of himself - his Primordial Spirit, also in a meditative posture.
Xiao Zi lay on the edge of a pond, watching Fang Wang, with eyes filled with envy.
It too wanted to be that powerful!
Fang Wang continued to change hand gestures, circulating his cultivation technique; his Spiritual Power climbed higher and higher.
After a while.
Fang Wang suddenly opened his eyes; his Primordial Spirit at his crown instantly merged back into his body. A powerful surge of force erupted from within him, sweeping across the mountain and lashing out in all directions, forming a shockwave visible to the naked eye.
Guang Qiuxian immediately cast a spell, forming a massive barrier with his Spiritual Power to resist this force, protecting the disciples behind him from the impact.
The second and fourth veins, at the same elevation as Fang Wang's dwelling, were hit by the shockwave. Thankfully, the force did not destroy the two mountains but merely caused them to shake.
The tornado of spiritual energy swirling around the third vein abruptly dispersed, and the tremors of the third vein stopped, bringing a return to tranquility.
All was quiet once again, but everyone could feel an immense pressure emanating from the third vein!
"He's succeeded, worthy of the Heaven Yuan Spirit Treasure, indeed smooth." Guang Qiuxian exclaimed in awe, recalling how he had almost failed his own breakthrough to the Condensation Spirit Realm, where failure would mean death and obliteration of his path.
He had been feeling Fang Wang's steady rise in aura, remarkably smooth, which truly made him realize the gap between their innate talents.
Inside the dwelling.
Fang Wang felt the Spiritual Power of the Condensation Spirit Realm and showed a satisfied smile on his face.
If he were to encounter the same situation as in the Green Cicada Valley ambush again, he truly had the confidence to annihilate the Green Cicada Valley. The upgrade in realm was not just an increase in Spiritual Power, but the quality of the Spiritual Power had also improved.
He had finally reached the Condensation Spirit Realm!
Not only that, but he could also forge another Lifespirit Treasure!
Awesome!
Fang Wang could feel the throngs of people outside, but he did not pay them any heed, continuing to consolidate his cultivation.
Guang Qiuxian sensed Fang Wang's successful breakthrough and immediately disappeared into thin air, leaving only a sentence behind: "Tell the disciples to leave, don't disturb Fang Wang as he consolidates his cultivation."
Hearing this, the Peak Masters and elders of the Nine Veins promptly signaled for the disciples to disperse.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 96 How Can One's Strength Reach This Level?
chapters.content:
```
After seven days, Fang Wang had stabilized his cultivation level. He began to pack up his belongings, preparing to leave. Upon seeing this, Xiao Zi immediately became excited.
"Young Master, where are you planning to go?" Xiao Zi asked.
Fang Wang replied casually, "To the Sword Heaven Marsh."
He could create multiple Lifespirit Treasures, a fact he intended to keep secret. Now, the world believed he was a sword cultivator, which was a good thing.
Only enemies on the brink of death would have the chance to witness all of his treasures!
Upon hearing this, Xiao Zi was happy as long as they were leaving the Great Abyss Gate. It immediately joined Fang Wang on his shoulder.
After packing, Fang Wang hung three storage bags around his waist and, together with the Qingjun Sword, he walked out of the cave entrance.
The Qingjun Sword could be put into a storage bag, but he felt it looked more impressive hanging at his waist.
His first stop was to visit Guang Qiuxian to let him know he'd be going out for a while.
"I won't ask where you're going, but there's something I need you to do," Guang Qiuxian said with a chuckle, looking at Fang Wang with expectation in his eyes.
Fang Wang smiled, "Please tell me, Sect Leader. I've been in seclusion for so many years; it's time to show my divine skills."
Guang Qiuxian nodded, and said, "A year ago, we learned that the Chi Devil Sect got their hands on a treasure, a treasure that hasn't been seen in the Grand Qi Cultivation Realm in a thousand years. However, the Chi Devil Sect seems to have run into trouble and can't get the treasure to recognize a master.
So, they're gathering their followers to hold a grand sacrifice, offering a million living beings to awaken the spirit of the treasure."
"The Suspended Vast Sword Sect, Tian Shu Sect, and I have discussed it— we plan to take this opportunity to completely eradicate the Chi Devil Sect. Considering the time, I suspect the Chi Devil Sect's sacrifice is about to begin.
The exact date hasn't been pinned down by the spy I planted, but with the token of the head disciple, you can search the locations where most of the names on this list are concentrated."
With a wave of his hand, Guang Qiuxian sent a piece of yellow paper flying into Fang Wang's hand.
Fang Wang glanced at it without changing his expression.
But he had already caught three names.
Fang Hanyu, Fang Zigeng, Gu Li!
Without delay, Fang Wang stored the yellow paper in his storage bag, saluted Guang Qiuxian, and turned to leave.
Watching Fang Wang's retreating figure, Guang Qiuxian asked on a whim, "What would you do if you encountered Lu Yuanjun?"
Fang Wang stopped in his tracks, answering without turning around, "A traitor to the sect deserves only death."
Guang Qiuxian frowned slightly and sighed, "Go then. Remember, you are the top disciple of the Great Abyss Gate, and you will be our Sect Leader in the future."
Fang Wang turned his head, smiling at Guang Qiuxian, "Sect Leader, I will not bring shame to the Great Abyss Gate."
After that, he lifted his foot and left the Shiyuan Hall.
Guang Qiuxian's gaze became distant as if recalling the past, and a hint of sorrow appeared in his eyes.
...
After leaving the main meridian, Fang Wang flew directly towards the Sect's Main City. Along the way, he put on a bamboo hat and slightly lowered his head, making it difficult for people to see his face.
He made his way to the Daofa Pavilion, flashing his identity as the head disciple, and ordered someone to lead him to the top floor—he was going to practice the art of sealing.
In the highest loft of the pavilion, only a few people walked around, all of whom were elders and peak masters. When they saw Fang Wang approaching, they smiled and nodded at him. No one spoke; Fang Wang smiled and nodded back in response.
The head disciple had access to all the cultivation techniques of the Great Abyss Gate because to become one, you must first have made a substantial contribution.
Shelves after shelves of books stood there, each in front of which hung wooden signs marking the type of spells.
Fang Wang directly went to the shelf dedicated to the art of sealing. There were numerous jade slips on the shelf, and next to each slip, there was a piece of yellow paper describing the spell inside the jade slip.
Two hours later.
Fang Wang walked out of the Daofa Pavilion. He slightly raised his head, and the sunlight shone upon his face, making his expression appear worn.
He took a leap and turned into a beam of white light, speeding towards the outside of the Great Abyss Gate.
"Young Master, you looked at so many spells; can you remember all of them?" Xiao Zi poked its head out from Fang Wang's arms and looked up at him, asking cautiously.
Here it comes again, this strange state!
Fang Wang had a vacant look in his eyes as he stared at the horizon and said quietly, "I can."
It was more than just being able to remember them.
Damn it, he had already mastered all of them to Great Perfection!
A full five hundred and twenty years!
Fang Wang even felt he was being harsh on himself, but there was no helping it. The creation of his fourth Lifespirit Treasure was at stake, so he had to be tough on himself.
The Great Abyss Gate's sealing spells were not many and were less intricate than those of the Tian Shu Sect, but they were enough for Fang Wang to establish an exceedingly high level of mastery in the art of sealing.
Five hundred and twenty years was not spent on learning a single spell, but rather on seven complete sets, with the most profound set taking one hundred and six years of work.
As Fang Wang left the Great Abyss Gate, he organized his thoughts.
"Right, what was I preparing to do before entering the Daofa Pavilion?" Fang Wang suddenly asked.
Xiao Zi's snake eyes widened as it quickly responded, "Going to Sword Heaven Marsh."
"Besides that?"
"The Sect Leader wants you to go to the Chi Devil Sect."
Only then did Fang Wang remember, and he said with satisfaction, "Good memory. I was just testing you. Keep it up."
"Young Master, it's only been such a short time, how could I possibly forget..."
"I was concerned you weren't listening. We are now dependent on each other; my business is your business, understand? You must think of us as one entity."
"Fang Wang spoke seriously, and no sooner had the words left his mouth than Xiao Zi became excited, instinctively lunging forward until her forked tongue nearly touched Fang Wang's mouth. He quickly stuffed it back in, startled."
"This damn snake, trying to rise above her station again!"
"Master, rest assured, I will focus from now on!" Xiao Zi said excitedly, her delicate feminine voice stirring the imagination.
Fang Wang did not engage further.
His heart was still numb, requiring time to recover.
Soon, he left the Great Abyss Gate. He had Xiao Zi enlarge and carry him as they flew.
Xiao Zi had mastered a flying spell, which was also an inheritance from the Great Saint's Grotto-Heaven.
Sitting atop the snake's head, Fang Wang extended his spiritual sense into the Token for the First Disciple, seeking the locations of Fang Hanyu, Fang Zigeng, and Gu Li. Their light spots were concentrated in one place, surrounded by over a hundred disciples, in the southwest direction.
An idea came to Fang Wang's mind, and he immediately sent a message through Fang Hanyu's disciple token, "If you need my help, make a large detour."
